phal chen/ sgroshirtsi (37)0061 shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo sangs rgyas phal po che zhes bya ba 3sum cu dgu pa/ sangs rgyas kyi chos bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa'i le'u / 3bzhi bcu pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i mtshan rgya mtsho bstan pa'i le'u/ 87bzhi bcu gcig pa/ dpe byad bzang po'i 'od zer bstan pa'i le'u/ 118bzhi bcu gnyis pa/ kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa bstan pa'i le'u/ 133bzhi bcu rtsa gsum pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa skye ba 'byung ba bstan pa'i le'u / 158bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi pa/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i le'u/ 300bzhi bcu lnga pa/ sdong bos brgyan pa'i le'u/(stod) 590bsdur mchan/(854) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(1013)

kho garlabs na da gas byang nargyur zabayangasags/ / / / nga ba ma da 'a na pa/ /rje'i che rjesnyi 'irdo rdo potshasgyur mkhas rgyal ma na / / nga rgyal ba sras/ /

༄ga /sangs rgyas phal po che zhes bya ba zhin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/tshi༄7zha / shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo sangs rgyas phal po che zhes bya ba②/bam po dang po②/ ④de nas byang chub sems dpa'ir+sātshogs chen po de'i nang nas byang chub sems dpa' kha cig 'di snyam du sems te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing ni ci 0tsam zhig tu bsam gyis mi khyab/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sngon gyi smon lam dang 'byung ba rnam par dag pa ni ji tsam zhig tu bsam gyis spyishekhyab/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i ⑨gdung ni ji tsam zhig tu bsam gyis myi khyab/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi ⑩skye ba ni ji tsam zhig tu bsam gyis mi khyabatunye/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku ni ji tsam zhig tu bsam gyis myi khyab/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung ni ji tsam zhig tu bsam gyis myi 37—3

khyab / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes ni ci7tsam zhig tu bsam gyis mi khyab/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa ni ji tsam zhig tu bsam gyis myi khyab/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi chags pa myi mnga' ba'i rnam par spyod pa ni ji tsam zhig tu bsam gyis myi khyab/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi rnam par thar pa ni ji tsam zhig tu bsam gyis myi khyab snyam pa dang /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' de dag gi sems thugs kyisakhuthugs su chud nas/ byang chub sems dpa' ut+paphula'i snying po/ sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabasatswakyis byin du brlabs so/ /sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyisakyibyin dang ldan par mdzad do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od kyis snang bar dumadzad do/ /sangs rgyas kyi gzi brjid kyis yongs su rgyas par mdzad do/ /sangs rgyas kyi myi 'jigs ⑦pa la rab tu gzhogashego/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi dbyings la 'jug pa khong du chud par mdzad do/ /sangs rgyas kyi bdag nyid che ba nyid dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi yul rab tu rtogs par mdzad do/ /chags pa myed pa'i rgyud 'byam7klas pa la rab tu gzhog go/ /sangs rgyas thams cad gcig nas gcig tu brgyud7pa'i rigs rab tu rtogs par mdzad do/ /sangs rgyas kyi tshul gyi gnas brjod du med pa la rab tu gzhag 8pa mdzad do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' ut+pa la'i snying pos chos kyi dbyings la 'jug pa rig cing khong du chud pas chags pa med pa'i dbyings su sgrubatshwanyepa'i yid dang / chos thams cad la bsgribs (nyepa med par gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dang /kun tu bzang po'i smon lam dang ldan pa'i yang dag par 'jug pa dang /37—4

sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rjes su song ba'i sangs rgyas blta ba dang / snying rje chenakhupos lta ba'i sems can thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i go chashechen po dang /byang chub sems dpa'i yi dam dang / spyod pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyun chadasapa myed pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi ye shes mngon par bsgrub pa skad cig gi cha shas lasarnam par spyod pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sgo mthong ba mi zad pa dang / so so0yang dag par rig pa'i rnam pa gzungs thams cad kyis snang bar byas pa dang ldan pas sangs rgyas kyi mthus byang chub sems dpa' pad mo'i snying po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni/ tshad med pa la rnam par spyod pa ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni rnam par 'phrul ba chen po la rnam par spyod pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa thams cad la/ sku'i mtshanasathams cad rab tu brnyes pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi chos kyi 'khor lo 'khor ba ni ting nge 'dzin dang / dgongs pas sbyar ba'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi so sonyeyang dag par rig pa bzhi ni brjod du med pa yang brjod du med pa shin tu bstan pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad la bsam gyis mi khyab par rnam par spyod pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi gsung dang dbyangs ni tshad med pa'o / /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyitshwanyechos kyi dbyings thugs su chud pa ni brjod du myed pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyipha/nyekhyu mchog gi mthu phyung ba ni thams cad mngon par〈nyemakhyen pa'o/ /kye rgyal 37—5

ba'i sras dag /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis chos kyi dbyings thugs su chud cing / bstan pa ni bsgribs7pa med pa'i mthar thug pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras/ bcu po 'di dag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi chos kyi dbyings mtha' dang dbus7med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams te / bcu gang zhe na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyisnyigazugs kyi skusnyinam par dag pa ni rnyog pa med par rgyud thams cad du byung bas mtha' dang dbus med pa'o / /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi chags pa medarnyupa'i spyan ni chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid kyi spyan mngon par sangs rgyas pas mtha' dang dbus med pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi chags pa med pa'i snyan ni 'gro ba thams cad kyi sgra bsgribasalgepa med par thugs su chud pas mtha' dang dbus med pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi shangasasnyikyi skye mched ni sangs rgyas kyi mnga' thams cad kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brnyes pas mtha' dang dbus med pa'o/ /lasangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi ljags shin tu yangs pa ni chos kyi dbyings thams cad du gsung gi dbyangs rjes su 'gro bas mtha' dang dbus med pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sku'i chos nyid ni sems can thams cad ma lus pa'i sems kyi rnam pa la ⑩ de bzhin gshegs pa mthong ba rnam par dmyigs pas mtha' dang dbus med pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi thugs kyi 'phrin las ni chos kyi7sku dang tha mi dad cing dus gsum chags pa med par thugs su chud cings3)rnam par dag pas mtha' dang dbus med pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyitshwa rnam par thar pa bsgribs mipa mi mnga' ba la rnam par spyod pa ni 37—6

sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang dang rnam par 'phrul pa dang / cho 'phrul mi zad pa yang dag par ston pas mtha' dang dbus med pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad rnam par dag pa ni brjod du med pa'i rgyan byin gyis brlabs pas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing nye bar nyon mongs pa med pa yang dag par bstan te/ bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du rnam par dmyigs par mdzad pas mtha' dang dbus med pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i khyad par dang / smon lam thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa ni rnam par rol pa'i ye shes kyis7chos yongs su rdzogs te/ chos thams cad rdzogs par byang chub par bya ba la mtha' dang dbus med pa ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras/ bcu po desadag ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos kyisadabyings mtha' dang dbus med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi skad cig 6)la ye shes kyi phyemangon par sgrub pa yang dag par bstan pa'o/ /bcu gang zhe na/ skad cig gcig la 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du dga' ldan gyi7gnas nas 'pho ba yongs su bstan pa dang / skad cig gcig la 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du byang chub sems dpa'i tshe yongs su bstan pa dang / skad cig gcig la 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du mngon par 'byung ba yongs su bstan pa dang /skad cig gcig la 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du byang chub kyi shing drung du bzhugs shing mngon par 'tshang rgya ⑦ba yongs su bstan pa dang / skad cig gcig la 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du chos kyi 'khor lo bskorasnyib yongs 37—7

su bstan pa dang / skad cig gcig la 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du 'dul ba'i sems can yongs su smin pa'i tshul ji lta ba bzhin du/ dus la bab pa7shes pas sangs rgyas bsnyen bkur ba yongs su bstan pa dang / skad cig gcig la 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du sems canakhuji ltar 'dul ba'i tshul bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa brjod du med pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi sku sna tshogs rnam par dmigs pa yongs su bstan pa dang / skad cig gcig la 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du/ rgyan sna tshogs dang rgyan brjod du med pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i khyu mchog gi mthu phyung ba dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i mdzod yongs su bstan pa dang / skad cig gcig la 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du rnam par dag pa gcig ma yin pa ①thams cad yongs su bstan pa dang /skad cig gcig la 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas skye ba thams cad du dbang po dang /brtson 'grus rnam pa tha dad pa byung ba dang / mos pa dang / spyod pa rnam pasnyitha dad pa byung ba la dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyi rgyud dukhumangon par 'tshang rgya ba yongs su bstan pa ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi skad cig la niye shes mngon par bsgrub pa yang dag par bstan pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi dus las mi 'da' bsheste/ bcu gang zhe na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi mngon par 'tshang rgya ba ni/de'i dus las mi 'da' hunyabs dus la bab pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi tshidage ba rnam par smin pa dang / rnam par mnyemin pa mnyam 37—8

pa nyid ni de'i dus las mi 'da' bas dus la bab pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis ①yongs su smin pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams lung bstan pa ni de'i dus las mi 'da' bas ②dus la bab pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis sems can gyi bsam pa'i rgyud du cho 'phrul yongs su bstan pa ni de'i dus lasakhumi 'da' bas dus la bab pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis sems can mos pa ji lta bu dang ldan pa'i tshul bzhin du sku yongs su bstan pa ni de'i dus las mi 'da' bas dus la bab pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams btang snyoms su bzhugs pa ni de'i dus las mi 'da' bas dus la bab pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams yul dang / grong dang / grong rdal du gshegs pa de ni de'i dus lasakyimi 'da' bas dus la bab pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dad pa ji lta bu dang ldan pa'i tshul bzhin du sems can yongs su 'dzin pa nisti/ de'i dus las mi 'da' bas dus la ⑩bab pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams sems can kun nas nyon mongs pa dang ldan zhing gdul dka' ba la gzhan la stos pa mi mnga' bar 'dul ba ni de'i dus las mi 'da' bas dus la bab pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ rnam par 'phrul pa bstan pa ninyede'i dus las mi 'da' bas dus la bab pa yin/ kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi dus las mi 'da' ba'o/ /kye 8rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi yul dpe med cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa7ste/ bcu gang zhe na/37—9

'jig rten gyi khams thams cad ma lus par skyil mo krung gcig gis rgyas par dgang ba dang / dus gcig ①tu sangs rgyas thams cad yongs su bstan pa dang ske/ 'od gzeramo gcig gis 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa thams cad snang bar bya ba dang / sku gzugs gcig gisashelus dang gzugs thams cad yongs su bstan pa dang / gnas gcig na bzhugs kyang 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad ma lus par byon pa'i skur 'gyur ba dang / ye shes gcig rtogs pas chos thams cad la bsgribs9)pa med par 'gyur ba dang / thugs gcig bskyed pas chos kyi dbyings thams cad ma lus par rgyas par 'gengs pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi che ba nyid tshad med pa dang ldan pa'i gshegs stabs gcig gis de kho na nyid yang dag par bstan pa dang / dus gsum thams cad sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang gis rgyas par 'gengs pa dang / 'gro ba thams cad dang ma 'dres par bzhugs shing 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang / myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis rgyud kyi tshulasnyigacig pa ste/kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni sangs rgyas ⑥bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi yul dpe med cing bsam gyis myi khyab pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs ⑦mngon par bsgrub pa'i ye shes te/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'jug pa myed pa'i chos thams cad la 'jug pas/ smon lam mngon par bsgrub pa'i ye shes dang /lus med pa la lus mngon par bsgrub pa'i ye shes dang / chos thams cad mi gnyis pa la mngon par 'tshang rgya ba mngon par bsgrub pa'i ye shes dang /sems can gyi mthar thug par bdag med pa la sems can 'dul b.rasnyimangon 37—10

par bsgrub pa'i ye shes dang / chos thams cad mtshan ma med pa latumatshan ma sna tshogs mngon par bsgrub pa'i ye shes dang / 'jig rten gyi khams kyi yul ma skyes pa la 'jig rten gyi khams 'du ba dang / 'jig pa mngon par bsgrub pa'i ye shes dang / yul thams cad mngon par 'du bya ba med pa la/ las kyi rnam par smin pa mngon par bsgrub pa'i ye shes dang / chos thams cad brjod du med pa la/ chos kyi dbyings su gsung mngon par bsgrub pa'i ye shes dang /chos thams cad kun nas nyon mongs pa dang / rnam par byang bas 'jug pa med pa la kun nas nyon mongs pa dang / rnam par byang ba mngon par bsgrub pa'i ye shes dang / chos thams cad ma skyes55)pa la skye ba dang / 'jig5gepa'i mtshan nyid rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba mngon par bsgrub pa'i ye shes te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi gyomangon par bsgrub pa'i ye shes so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi tshad med pa'i khongs su chud pa dag ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sku ni dus gsum thams cad kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i khongs su chud pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams sems can thams cad 'dul ba sa)mdzad pa ni/ cho 'phrul chen po gsum gyi khongs su chud pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams tshig rab tu dbye ba thams cad la mkhas pa ni sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi gzungs thams cad kyi khongs su chud pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi chos kyi 'khor lo thams cad ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i so so 45yang dag par rig pa bzhi'i ༅khongs su chud pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams sems can thams cad 37—11

yongs su mi gtong ①ba ni thugs rje chen po'i khongs su chud pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams rtag tu mnyam par gzhag⑧pa ni dus thams cad du sems can thams cad la rnam par gzigs pa'i khongasakhusu chud pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyikhudage ba'i rtsa ba ni sems can rnam par 'dulasnyeb thams cad khongs su chud pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi chags pa mi mnga' bar spyod pa ni chos kyi dbyings thams cad khongs su gachud pa yin/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi skad cig gcig tu ni 'das pa dang ma byon pa dang da ltar rmyeng ba'i sangs rgyas skye ba thams cad khongs su chud pa yin/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi nyi ma gcig tu ni dus gsum gyi bskal pa'i grangs khong du7chud par bstan pa thams cad khongs su chud pa yin/ kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi tshad med pa'i khongs su chud pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi shin tu rgya che ba'i chos bzod par dka'arkyub rnams te / bcu gang zhe na/ bdud kyi dkrugs ma rab tu 'jom ⑩zhing rnam par 'thor /—1ba ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi shin tu rgya che ba'i chos bzod par dka'asngo ba'o/ /mu stegs can gzhan dang pas kyi rgol ba tshar gcadatshwanyepa ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi shin tu rgya che ba'i chos bzod par dka'atshabeba'o/ /'dul ba'i sems can thams cad rab tu tshim par mdzad pa ni/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi shin tu rgya che ba'i chos bzod par dka' ba'o / /sems can 'dul ba'i dbang gis 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad tu gshegs pa ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi shin tu rgya che ba'i chos 37—12

bzod par dka' ba'o/ /chos kyi dbyings thugs su chud pa'i ye shes ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi shin tu rgya che ba'i chos bzod par dka' ba'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams thams cad ma lus par skus khyab cing sangs rgyas kyi sku rnam par phye ba sna tshogs thams cad du mi gnyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi shin tu rgya che ba'i ①chos bzod par dka' ba'o/ /gsung gi yan lag thams cad la sems can mos par bya ba dang / thos par bya ba dang /gdul bar bya ba don yod ②par so so ②yang dag par rig ④pa thogs pa med pas bstan pa'i tshul du so so ⑤yang dag par rig ⑥pa bzhi 'byung ba ni/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi shin tu rgya che ba'i chos bzod par dka' ba'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ⑦kyi ba spu'i bu ga gcig nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed ⑧bsam gyis mi khyab cing / thogs pa med pa'i tshul du 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi thabs kyis/ 'byung zhing de bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi sku'i ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas 'byung ba ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi shin tu rgya che ba'i chos bzod par dka' ba'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdul shin tu phra ba gcig la sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed ( gleyongs su ston cing / sangs rgyas kyi rgyan dang rang bzhin gyi lhab lhub dang /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor (nyeb rgyun mi 'chad cing sems can rnam par 'dul ba thogs pa med pa la〈nye'ajig rten gyi khams de dag tu gtogs pa rnams la'ang mi bde ba dang / gnod pa med kyang rdul shin tu phra ba de'ang0yangs par ma byas/37—13

'jig rten gyi khams de dag kyang chung bar ma byas par ji ltar gnas pa'i chos kyi dbyings kyang thugs su chud pa'i ye shes mnga' ba ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi shin tu rgya che ba'i chos bzod par dka' ba'o/ /mun pa med pa'i khams de bzhin gshegs pas mngon par sangs rgyas te/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad la mun pa med cing bsgribasalgepa mi mnga' la sems can pha rol gyi bsgribs /pa sna tshogs kyi gnas rnamasapar sel na/ de la de〈 )bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang ldan pa ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams zhusashin tu rgya che ba'i chosamathobazod par dka' ④ba ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi shin tu rgya che ba'i chos bzod par dka' ba'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag skyebacu po 'di dag ni/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bdag nyid che ba rnam pa thams cad du kha na ma tho ba med cing shin tu dag pa ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi yang dag par bsgrubs the )pa bdag nyid che ba ni sngon gyi mtha' nas rnam pa nyu1thams cad du kha na ma tho ba med cing rnam par dag pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas kyi rgyud du rigs dang ldan par 'byung ba'i bdag nyid che ba ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs rnam par dag pas/ rnam pa thams cad du kha na ma tho ba med cing shin tu rnam par dag pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni rnam par shes pa la mi gnas pa ste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bdag nyid che ba ni phyi ma'i mtha'i mur thug par gnas pas/rnam pa thams cad du kha na ma tho ba med cing / shin tu rnam par dag pa'o/ /37—14

sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni dus gsum la mi gnas par rnam par spyod cing chos thams cad la rten pa 6)yang dag par ②bcom pas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bdag nyid che ba ni/ rnam pa thams cadakhudu kha na ma tho ba med cing shin tu rnam par dag pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni dngos po rnam pa tha dad pa la rnam par gzhag pa gcig gis len pa med pas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bdag nyid che ba ni rnam pa thams cad du kha na ma tho ba med cing shin tu rnam par dag pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni sngon gyi mtha' dang / phyi ma'i mthar chos kyi dbyings la gnas pas/ mnyam pa'i bsod nams mi zad pa dang ldan pas mi zad pa'i bsod nams mnga' ba ste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bdag nyid che ba ni rnam pa ④thams cad du kha na ma tho ba med cing shin tu rnam par dag pa'o / /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni sku gzugs dang kha dog mtha' yas pas/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na sems can 'dul ba'i dus dang dbang gis chags pa med par bzhugs pas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bdag nyid che ba ni rnam pa thams cad 5)du kha na ma tho ba med cing shin tu rnam par dag pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mi 'jigs pa bzhi brnyes pas bag tsha ba mi mnga' bar bzhugs shing / khyu mchog dang seng ge'i nga ro 'byin te rgol ba'i nang na stag lta bu'i khya)mthu dang ldan57)la chos thams cad bstan pa la thugs sgron ma lta bu mnga' bas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bdag nyid che ba ni rnam pa thams cad du kha na ma tho ba med cing shin tu rnam par dag pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni yongs su mya ngan 37—15

las 'das nas bskal pa brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa zhig lon yang mtshan gyi tshig thos pa tsam gyis bzhugs pa dang 'dra bar sems can rnams kyi yon 1shin tu sbyong zhing mya ngan las 'das nas/ de srid kyi yun ring po 'das kyang sangs rgyas la bskyed pa'i yon tan55)zad par mi 'gyur bas/ sangs rgyas lgekyi bdag nyid che ba ni rnam pa thams cad du kha na ma tho ba med cing shin tu rnam par dag pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni ge'ajig rten gyi khams brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa dag na bzhugs shing 'jig rten gyi khams rgyang ring po na bzhugs kyang 'jig rten gyi khams 'disasems can rnams kyis rjes su dran par byas nas 5sku mngon par ston pa mdzad57pas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bdag nyid che ba ni rnam pa thams cad du kha na ma tho ba med cing shin tu rnam par dag pa ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bdag nyid che ba ni rnam pa thams cad du kha na ma tho ba med cing shin tu rnam par dag pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dgashebacu po 'di dag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi shin tu rnam par dag pa ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni/ sangs rgyas kyi tshangs pa'i spyod pa rnam par dag pa la sngon gyi smon lam gyis shin tu rnam par dag pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni chags pa med pa'i tshul khrims 9)kyis shin tu rnam par dag pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa sel bas shin tu rnam ⑩par dag pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni sangs rgyas kyi zhing gis shin tu rnam par dag pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni 'khor 37—16

gyis shin tu rnam0)par dag pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni rigs rnam par dag pas shin tu rnam par dag pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni gzugs kyi sku'i mtshan dang / dpe byad bzang po rnam par dag pas shin tu rnam par〈gudag pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni chos kyi sku rnyog pa med pas shin tu rnam par dag pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi phung po bsgribs5zhe )pa med pas shin tu rnam par dag pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni sangs rgyas kyi rnam par thar pa thams cad la mthu chen po brnyes54)shing / pha rol tu phyin pa dam pa brnyes pas shin tu rnam par dag pa yin te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi shin tu rnam par dag pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras nyabacu po 'di dag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi mdzad pa 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du 'byung zhing dus thams cad du gnas pa ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa56)thob pa'i sems can rnams la dus thams cad du sangs rgyas bstan pa dang / sems can sems cang shes dang ldan pa rnams la/ dus thams cad du chos bstan pa dang ske/ sems can sangs rgyas la dad pa'i sems dang ldan pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dus thams cad du bskyed (7pa dang / chosaman)skyon med par 'das pa'i sems can rnams dus thams cad du ye shes khong du chud par bya ba dang / 'gro ba thams cad du sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa dus thams cad du rgyun mi 'chad pa dang /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du dus thams cadamathosadu / chags pa mi nyu )mnga' bar gshegs pa dang / sems can thams cad la thugs 37—17

rje chen po 1)dus thams cad du mi gtong ba dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa dus thams cad du thogs pa med pa dang /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa sna tshogs dus thams cad du thogs pa med pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams chos kyi dbyings (geganas pa'i sangs rgyas dus thams cad dusa'abyung ba ste/kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi 54)mdzad pa 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du 'byung zhing dus thams cad du 5gnas pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi ye shes rgya mtsho mi zad pa'i tshul rnams te6)/ bcu gang zhe na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i skus ⑦ye shes rgya mtsho mi zad pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das (8)rnams ni sangs rgyas kyi phrin ⑨las tshad med pa〈rtebarnyes pas ye shes rgya mtsho mi zad pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyi 17yul mnga' bas ye shes rgya mtsho mi zad pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni dge ba'i rtsa ba tshad med pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' bas ye shes rgya mtsho mi zad pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni chos kyi char 12mngon par 'bebs sna pas ye shes rgya mtsho mi zad pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni sangs rgyas kyi yon tan dang legs pa mang po mnga' bas ye shes rgya mtsho mi zad pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni sngon gyi mtha' 3 thams cad mkhyen pa'i smon lam dang khyad7par mnga' bas ye shes rgya mtsho mi zad pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni phyi ma'i 37—18

mtha'i mur 'gro ba thams cad sangs rgyas kyi phrin las rgyun mi 'chad0)par sgrub pas ye shes rgya mtsho mi zad pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni sems can gyi rigs thams cad ma lus pa'i sems dang spyod pa la ye shes rgya mtsho mi zad pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni thams cad mkhyen pa'i bsod nams zil gyis mi non pas ye shes rgya mtsho mi zad pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi ye shes rgya mtsho mi zad pa'o/ /kye〈rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi tshul rnams te③la/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad kyis mngon par byung ④ba 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi tshul yin no/ /'di lta ste chos thams cad la mi mkhyen pa gang yang mi mnga'aman)ba 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi tshul yin no/ /'di lta ste/ 6)thams cad kyang thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi tshul yin no/ /'di lta ste thams cad kyang stobs bcu tshad med pa dang ldan pa 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi tshul yin no/ /'di lta ste thams cad kyang bla na med pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor ba 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi tshul yin no/ /'di lta ste thams cad kyang sems can 'dul ba la 2)yang dag par zhugs pa 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi tshul yin no/ /'di lta ste thams cad kyang 'gro ba thams cad kyi don du mngon par sangs rgyas pa 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi tshul yin no/ /'di lta ste 'dul ba'i sems can rnams 'dul ba la thogs pa mi mnga' ba 'di ni 37—19

sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi tshul yin no/ /'di lta ste mi gnyis par yang dag par spyod pa'i mtshan nyid kyi 0)chos la rab tu gzhol ba 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi tshul yin no/ /'di lta ste ji ltar yongs su smin par 'gyur bsngo dang / dul bar gyur pa'i〈 )sems can rnams la sangs rgyas kyi yul mu med pas sangs rgyas kyi yongs su mya ngan las 'da'akheb ston pa 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnamasasnyikyi tshul yin te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi tshul lo/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi 6)chos mtha' yas pa shin tu bstan pa'i sgo rnams te/ bcu gang zhe na/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni sems can gyi khams shin tu bstan pa'i sgor mtha' yas pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni sems can gyi spyod pa sna tshogs shin tu bstan pa'i sgor mtha' yas pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni sems can thams cad kyi las dang rnam par smin pa shin tu bstan pa'i sgor mtha' yas pa'o/ /9)sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni sems can thams cad la gdams ngag dang man ngag shin tu bstan pa'i sgor mtha' yas pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni sems can mtha' yas pa rnam par spyod pa'i 48)nan tan gyi sgor mtha' yas pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad la gdams ngag dang59noman ngag gis yongs su gzhog pa'i sgor mtha' yas pa'o sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni byang chub sems dpa'amanyanyakhyad par gyi smon lam rnam pa tha dad pas 'byung ba shin tu bstan pa'i sgor mtha' yas pa'o sangs 37—20

rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad ma lus pa'i 'du ba dang 'jig pa shin tu bstan pa'i sgor mtha' yas pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams 6)kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnam par dag pa ni byang chub sems dpa'i bsam pa dang mos pa ji lta ba bzhin du yongs su bstan pa'i sgor mtha' yas pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa thams cad du 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa ni bskal pa yangs pa de dang de dag tu bstan cing brjod pa dang / yongs su bshad pas/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes thams cad khong du chudakupar bya ba'i sgor mtha' yas pa ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi chos mtha' yas pa shin tu bstan pa'i sgo'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi phrin las sems can rnams la sgrub pa ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sku yongs su bstan pa ni sems can rnams la sangs rgyas kyi phrin las sgrub bo/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi gsung yang sems can rnams la sangs rgyas kyi phrin las sgrub bo/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams len pa mdzad pa ③yang sems can rnams la sangs rgyas kyi phrin las sgrub bo/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams len pa mi mdzad pa yang sems can rnams la sangs rgyas kyi phrin las sgrub bo/ /sa dang chu dang mye dang / rlung gis kyang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams sems can rnams la sangs rgyas kyi phrin las sgrub bo/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni byin gyi rlabasatswakyi yul dang mi dmigs 37—21

pa thams cad yul du mdzad pas kyang sems can rnams la sangs rgyas kyi phrin las sgrub bo/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi7mtshan kyang sems can rnams la sangs rgyas kyi phrin las sgrub bo/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni zhing la dmyigs par mdzad pas kyang sems can rnams la sangs rgyas kyi phrin las sgrub bo/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnam par dag pas kyang sems can rnams la sangs rgyas kyi phrin las sgrub bo/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams mi gsung bar bzhugs pa yang sems can rnams la sangs rgyas kyi phrin las sgrub ②ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi sangs rgyas kyi phrin las sems can rnams la sgrub pa'o// // sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/② bam po gnyis pa④/ kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sems can gyi gtso bo'i chos te/ bcu gang zhe na/ smon lam chen po la rab tu brtenasngon zhing smon lam zhig pa mi mnga' bas ji skad du gsung ba de ltar mdzad cing gnyis su mi gsung ba 'di ni sems can gyi gtso bo'i chos dang po'o / /phyi ma'i mtha'i mur thug pa'i bskal7pa thams cad du byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la yon tan thams cad yongs su rdzogs par mdzad pasasherab tu brtson zhing sgyid lug pa mi mnga' ba 'di ni sems can gyi gtso bo'i chos gnyis pa'o / /sems can 'dul bar 'gyur ba gcig gcig gzigs kyang 'jig rten gyi khams brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med par gshegs shing 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du gshegs pa la thag ⑧thogs med pa 'di ni sems 37—22

can gyi gtso bo'i chos gsum pa'o/ /zhe snang ba'i sems can rnams la thugs rje chen pos snyoms pa dang / dad pa'i sems can rnams la thugs rje chen pos snyoms pa 'di ni sems can gyi gtso bo'i chos bzhi pa'o/ /gang gi tshe bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yang dag par zhugs nas/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par sangs rgyas kyi bar du de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su mi 91)'gyur ro/ /snyam du byang chub kyi sems ma nyams pa 'di ni sems can gyi gtso bo'i chos lnga pa'o/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad yang dag par sgrub cing /thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su bsngosabs 'jug gi/ 'jig rten pa'i rgyud la ma yin pa 'di ni sems can gyi gtso bo'i chos drug pa'o/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rjes su sngon 5)sangs rgyas kyis spyad pa'i sems su lus kyi las dang /ngag gi las dang / yid kyi las kyis slob cing nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi spyod pas thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su bsngo ba med pas/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par sangs rgyas pa 'di ni sems can gyi gtso bo'i chos bdun pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i sems rnam par dag cing 'od gsal ba dang chos/ thams cad du snang zhing kun tu 'od 'byung ba na/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad la snang zhing thams cad du snyoms pas / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par byed pa 'di ni sems can gyi gtso bo'i chos brgyad pa'o/ /'jig rten pa'i bde ba thams cad yongs su spangs te/ 'jig rten pa'i dga' ba thams cad la ma chags pa dang / 'jig rten thams cad kyis gos pa med pa'i smon lam thams cad du mnyam pa nyid kyis/37—23

'jig rten thams cad bde ba thams cad dang ldan par byas te/ sdug bsngal dang spros pa thams cad rab tu 'joms ①pa 'di ni sems can gyi gtso bo'i ②chos dgu pa'o/ /sdug bsngal gyi myi bde ba thams cad nyams su bab ste/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi don du dka' thub kyis shin tu gdungs kyang bla ②bar sems bskyed pas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rigs yongs su bsrung ba dang ldan pa dang ske/ stobs bcu'i sa'isnyibar du sangs rgyas kyi yul la mos pas mthar thug pa 'di ni sems can gyi gtso bo'i chos bcu pa ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sems can gyi gtso bo'i chos so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi rnam par spyod pa chags pa med pa rnams te༅/ bcu gang zhe na/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa thams cad du gshegs pas chags pa mi mnga' bar rnam par spyod pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa thams cad na ⑦bzhugs pas chags 25pa myi mnga' bar rnam par spyod pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na bzhugs pa dang bzhengs pa dang / ⑨bzhud pa 7chags pa mi mnga' bar rnam par spyod pa yin/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa thams cad du chos ston pa 37chags pa mi mnga' bar rnam par spyod pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa thams cad kyi dga' ldan gyi gnas na bzhugs kyang chags pa mi mnga' bar rnam par spyod pa yin / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams 37—24

cadanyekyi ⑤sngon gyi mtha' dang / phyi ma'i mtha' dang / da ltar byung ba'i mtha' la chags pa mi mnga' bar rnam par spyod pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad tsam gyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor na bzhugs kyang chags pa mi mnga' bar rnam par ③spyod pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni sems can ma lus pa thams cad kyi sems dang spyod pa la gzigs shing / thugs kyi skad cig gcig la cho ④'phrul chen po gsum gyis sems can rnam par 'dul yang chags pa myi mnga' bar rnam par spyod pa yin / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni sku gcig gis kyang tshad myed pasnyibasam gyis mi khyab pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rnam par spyod pa chen por rnam par spyod kyang chags pa myi mnga' bar rnam par spyod pa yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni sems can gyi khams 'byamanyeklas pa ma lus pa thams cad du de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos ma lus pa thams cad kyi mthar thug pa bsam gyis myi khyab par ston cing gsung yang chags pa mi mnga' bar rnam par spyod pa yin te/kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi rnam par spyod pa chags pa med pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi7rgyan mchog dam pa bla na med pa rnams te/ bcu gang zhe na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sku mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po sna tshogs kyis rnam par brgyan pa ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sku'i rgyan mchog dam pa ⑧bla na med pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi gsung yan lag gi mchog dam pa drug culostedang ldan zhing / yan lag lnga brgyas yongs su bzung ba dang / rgyan brgya stong 37—25

du mas rab tu brgyan pa dang / dbyangs kyi yan lag mtha' yas mu med pas rnam par dag pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi don dang tshig dang yi ge brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pas rab tu tshim par mdzad pa dang / bag tsha ba mi mnga' bar7seng ge'i nga ro chen po sgrog⑧pa dang / 'jigs pa myed pa chen pos bsnyengs pa mi mnga' bar gyur pa dang / chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad du (2)sems can thams cad la grag cing gsal ④te/ khong du chud par 'gyur ba dang / sems can bsam pa tha dad pa dang / dbang po tha dad pa rnam pa sna tshogs 'dul bar nye bar gnas pa 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi gsung gi rgyan mchog dam pa bla na med pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi thugs kyi phrin las ni stobs bcus brgyan pa sangs rgyas kyi ting nge 'dzin chen po thams cad kyi me tog shin tu rgyas pa sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa ba'o ⑤brgyad kyi rgyan gyis shin tu brgyan cing bsgrubs ⑥pas chags pa med pa'i spyod yul dang ldan pa7chos kyi dbyings kyi gzhi la rab tu rten pa / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chosalgegating med pa rab tu brnyes pa/ chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad kyi rgyan du gyur pa/ dus gsum gyi chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad kyi sems can kun gyi sems dang spyod pa thams cad skad cig gcig dang ldan pa'i shes rab kyisasherab tu mkhyen pa ste/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi thugs kyi ⑩rgyan mchog dam pa bla na med pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni 'od zer bye ba brjod du med pa rab tu 'gyed par nyunyamadzad de/ 'od zer de dag re re la yang 'od zer gyi 'khor gyi dra ba brjod du med pa dang ldan pa/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'byam5)37—26

klas pa thams cad ma lus par snang bar7byed cing 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud thams cad mun pa med par ston pa/ sangs rgyas skye ba dang mi 'bral ②bas/sangs rgyas kyi phrin las las ①phyir mi ldog cing don yod pa/ sangs rgyas skye ba brjod du med pas gnas pa7med pa rang bzhin rnam par dag cing kun tu snyoms par 'byung ba ste/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi 'od zer gyi rgyan mchog dam pa bla na med pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bzhad ⑤mo 'dzum par ston na/ zhal gyi sgo nas 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs kha dog du ma dang ldan pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong brjod du myed pa phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa thams cad snang bar byed pa sems can gyi khams tshad med grangs med bsam gyis yimyi khyab pa rnam par ston pa/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu rnam pa gzhan du mi 'gyur bar lung ston pa/ 'gro ba thams cad du shin tu gsal bar7)'byung ste/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bzhad mosnyi'adzum pa bstan pa'i rgyan mchog dam pa bla na med pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi chos kyi sku ni tshad med pa stelta/ bsgribs 7pa med pas rnam par dag pa chos thams cad5)chags pa med pa nyid kyitshwa)mthar thug pa mtha' dang dbus med pa'i chos kyi dbyings la gnas pa/ 'jig rten thams cad dang ma 'dres pa 'jig rten thams cad dang 'dzi tunyeb med pa/ 'jig rten thams cad kyi de kho na nyid la yang dag par zhugs pa/ 'jig rten thams cad las gyen du 'phags pa/ 'jig rten thams cadatshwastelas 'das pa'i chos kyis yang dag par spyod pa/ tshig gi lam dang bral ba/ brjod du med pa'i mthar phyin pa/ phung po dang khams dang / skye 37—27

mched dang7)bral ba ste/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi chos kyi sku'i rgyan mchog dam pa bla na med pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni 'od tshad med pa mnga' bas ste/ 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa thams cad du 'odamagum 'dres shing / rgyan du ma dang ldan pa kha dog sna tshogs brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i rgyan dang ldan pa(4)/ 'od ⑦kyi snang ⑥ba kun tu thogs pa med cing / thams cad du chags pa med pa 'od kyi dkyil 'khor bsgribs rtso pa med pa tshad med pa'i mdzod du gyur pa/ 'od thams cad kyi 'byung gnas su gyur pa ste/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi 'od kyisnyergyan mchog dam pa bla na med pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni kha dog mtha' yas pa mnga' ba ste/ kha dog yid du 'ong ba mnga' ba'o/ /kha dog 'od gsal ba mnga' ba'o/ / kha dog tshad med pa mnga' ba'o ⑨sems can gyi khams ma lus pa thams cad kyi7bsam pa dang / mos pa bzhin du rnam par dmigs pa'i kha dog mnga' ba'o/ /de ma yin pa'i kha dog gzhan khams gsum du gtogs pa thams cad zil gyis gnon pa'i kha dog mnga' ba'o/ /kha dog thams cad kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brnyes pas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni kha dog bla na med pa mnga' ba ste/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi kha dog gi hu1rgyan mchog dam pa bla na med pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni dge bas shin tu rnam par dag pa ste/ 'das pa dang /ma byon pa dang da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rigs dge ba rin po che'i 'byung gnas su gyur pa la shin tu byung ba'o/ /chos nyid kyi rnam pa thams cad du khyad par yod pa dang khyad par med pa'i spyod pas rnam par dag pa'i rgyan 37—28

gyi7ye shes skye ba thams cad kyilanang du gtogs pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs bsgribasalgepa med pa'i rgyud rnam par dag pas/ 'jig rten gyi mi snyan pa thams cad kyis mi snyan parasnyibarjod du med pa ste/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi rigs dang / rgyud rnam par dag pa'i rgyan mchog dam pa bla na med pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni byams pa chen po'i mthu dang rang bzhin gyi rgyan mnga' ba ste/ shin tu dang btso/yongs su rtog pa'i rtog pa myi mnga' ba sku'i phrin las yongs su gsal ba blta 6)bas mi skyo ba/ dgongs pa ④shin tu rnam par gsalasab/ thugs rje chen po mnga' ba/ 'gro ba thams cad skyob pa yon ④gyi gnas kyi dam pa bla na med pa yongs su 'dzin pa'i nang na thugs brtse ba can phan par mdzad pa sems can thams cad kyi don tu ye shes chen po byin gyis brlab stekho/ bsod nams chen pos yongs su 'phags pa 'gro ba thams cad kyi bsod nams kyi zhing du gyur pa sems can rnams kyi yon tan dang / ye shes kyi51phung po thams cad rnam par 'phel bar mdzad pa ste/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams 3)kyi byams pa chen po dang / thugs rje chen po'i mthar thugatshwanyepa'i bsod nams kyi rgyan mchog dam pa bla na med pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi rgyan mchog dam pa bla na med pa'o//kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi mnga' chen pos mnga' bsgyur chaba'i chos rnams te/ bcu gang zhe na / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni chos thams cad la mnga' ba dang /chos thams cad la78snang bar 8mdzad pa'i mnga' bsgyur sprebs/ tshig dang yi ge 37—29

mtha' yas pa la thogs pa mi mnga' ba'i spobs pa mnga' ba dang / chos thams cad ma lus par yongs su brjod pas mnga' che ba ste/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi mnga' chen pos mnga' bsgyur ①ba'i chos dang po'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni sems can ji ltar yongs su smin pa dang / smon lam ji ltar btab pa'i tshul bzhin du/ 'dul ba la thogs pa mi mnga' bas mnga' che ba ②ste/ 'di ni sangs rgyas kyi mnga' chen pos mnga' bsgyur7ba'i chos gnyis pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa thams cad sems can gcig la yang gnod pa med par rnam pa drug tu rab tu bskyod pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams rgyan rnam par bkod pa grangs med tshad med pa dang ldan pa nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mthasalgegatugs pa thams cad gcig nas gcig tu 'phang ba dang / gcig nas gcig tu gzhug pa dang /⑤ gcig nas gcig tu bsdu ba dang / gcig nas gcig tu bsre bas7'jig rten gyi khams gzhan dang gzhan dag gzhan dang5megazhan gyi phyogs su rab tu bzhag kyang sems can gyi52)khams rnams 'khor zhing rmongs par mi 'gyur la/ the tsom7du mi 'gyur bar mdzad pas mnga' che ba ste/'di ni sangs rgyas kyi mnga' chen pos mnga' bsgyur hu staba'i chos gsum pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa thams cad byin gyis rlob /nyapa'i ye shes kyis 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyan phan tshun du byin gyis brlab pa dang / dgongs pa'i〈rnyeskad cig gis 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rgyan yang dag par bstanamo/nyepa dang / bskal pa grangs med par brjod kyang yi ge shin tu bstan pa zad mi shes pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams ma 37—30

lus pa thams cad rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa dang / mi mthun pa med cing nye bar nyon mongs pa med pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gcig tu yongs su 'du bar sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnam par dag pa thams cad byin gyis brlabashepa la mnga' che ba ste/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi mnga' chen pos mnga' bsgyur miba'i chos bzhi pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams nim nasangs rgyas kyisasnyi'adul ba'i sems can gzigs na sems can gcig gi don du bskal pa brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med par skyil mo krung gcig gis bzhugs na yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku la myi bde ba mi mnga' zhing thugs la mi bde ba mi mnga' ste/ gang zag de yang mi bsnyelamadu 9bas 'dul ba'i dus las mi 'da' ba dang / gang zag gcig la ji lta 6)ba des dzonabazhin du rim pa rim pas/ 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa thams cad du phyi ma'i mtha'i50mur thug pa'i sku tshe la mnga' bar byin gyis brlabs te du'o)bzhugs kyang ske/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyo ba mi mnga'am ste/ de /nyaltar sems can gyi khams thams cad mthar gyis rim pas sangs rgyas kyis 'dul ba'i gang zag gi don du yongs su skyo bar nya mdzad pa la mnga' che ba ste/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi mnga' chen pos mnga' bsgyur sna ba'i chos lnga pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa thams cad du yang dag par gzhol ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa 7bzhud pas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du bzhud pa la thag 32thogs mi mnga' ba dang /phyogs bcu'i chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad kyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud rgya mtsho 'byam myaklas pa dang / phyogs kyi dra ba'i rgyud thams cad du 37—31

dgongs pa'i7skad cig gcig dang ldan pa'ikhu bzhud par byin gyis rlobashecing /chos kyi dbyings shin tu bstan pa khong du chud par bya bas chos kyi 'khor lo thogs pa med pa rab tu bskor ba la mnga' che ba ste/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi mnga' chen pos mnga' bsgyurasnyiba'i chos drug pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni 'dul ba'i sems can gyi khams thams cad kyi don du dgongs pa'i7skad cig re re la/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya bar mnga' che ba ste/ de la chos thams cad mngon par sangs ma rgyas pa gang yang med la/ gang mngon par sangs rgyas pa gang yang med la/ gang gis ⑧mngon par sangs rgyas pa'ang med de/mngon par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba med kyang slob pa'i sa la gnas shing /mngon par 'tshang rgya bar yang mi brjod pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyang bsgribs 1)pa med par rtogs par thugs su chud pas sems can thams cad gdul kyi riba'i don du ye shes tshad med pa'i tshul gyis sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa chen po'i yul yongs su rgyun mi gcod5nyepa 'di ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi mnga' chen pos mnga' bsgyur 8ba'i chos bdun pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni〈 spyan gyi skye mched kyisalgesangs rgyas kyi phrin las gang bsgrub pa de snyan gyi skye mched kyis yongs su grub par mdzad do/ /snyan gyi skye mched kyisashisangs rgyas kyi phrin las gang bsgrub pa de shangs kyi skye mched kyis yongs su grub par mdzad do/ /shangs kyi skye mched kyisalgesangs rgyas kyi phrin las gang bsgrub pa de ljags kyi skye mched kyis yongs su grub par mdzad do/ /ljags kyi skye mched kyis sangs rgyas kyi phrin las gang bsgrub pa 37—32

de ni sku'i skye mched kyis yongs su grub par mdzad do/ /sku'i skye mched kyis sangs rgyas kyi phrin las gang bsgrub pa de thugs kyi skye mched kyis yongs su grub par mdzad do/ /thugs kyi skye mched kyis sangs rgyas kyi phrin las gang ①bsgrub pa de 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa thams cad kyi dmigs pa 'jig rten pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa sna tshogs rnam par phye ba thams cad dukhugrub par mdzad do/ /de bzhin du dmigs pa thams cad re re ①yang snrel zhir dubasgrub pas sangs rgyas kyi phrin las bsgrub pa la mnga' che ba ste/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi ⑤mnga' chen pos mnga' bsgyur ⑦ba'i chos brgyad pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni rang gi sku'i ba spu'i bu ga gcig gi nang du sems can gyi khams ma lus pa thams cad gzud pa7mdzad cing khongs su chud par mdzad pa dang / sems can re re zhing yang lus sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa tsam du yangs par mdzad kyang sems can de dag la gnod pa dang mi bde bar7mi 'gyur ba dang / de dag tu yang sems can re re zhing 'jig rten gyi khamasalgegacig tu brgyud pas bskal pa grangs med pa zad par gnas par bya ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med par gom pa gcig gis phyin pas/ 'jig rten gyi khams de dag tu sangs rgyas byung ba rnams kyi spyan sngar 'gro bar bya ba dang / sangs rgyas de dag byung ba'i tshe yang brjod du med pa'i 'jig rten gyi〈nyekhams kyi rgyud dang / gling de dag na sems can gyi gtso bo ()brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bya ba dang / ba spu'i bu ga de nas sangs rgyas gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa tunyebarjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa 'byung bar bya ba dang /37—33

sems can gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du ①med pa 'byung bar bya ba dang / chos kyi 'khor lo gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa bskor bar bya ba dang / chos kyi dbyings bstan pa dugegacig nas gcig tu brgyud ①pa brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa shin tu bstan par bya ba dang / 'das pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa brjod du med pa dang / ma 'ongs pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa brjod du med pa dang / da ltar byung ba gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa brjod du med pa yongs su rdzogs rtso)par bya ba dang / nam mkha'i dbyings mtha' dang dbus med par bstan pa kun tu mtshams med par sems can thams cad 'ong zhing 'gro ba dang / skye ba'i skye mched thams cad du 'dod pa'i longs spyod rgya chen po bgegs phyo)med pa thams cad 'byung bar bya ba la mnga' che ba ste/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi mnga' chen pos mnga' bsgyur rilaba'i chos dgu pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad du pad+mo'i rgyan chen pos brgyan rtso)pa'i seng ge'i khri pad mo'i snying po can la de bzhin gshegs pa gcig gi chos kyi dbyings tshad med pa thams cad du khyab pa'i skus byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te/sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa thams cad yongs su bstan par ⑧mdzad pa dang —/ de bzhin gshegs pa gcig gis7ji lta bar 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad nyu kyi rdul shin tu phra ba nyunye snyed kyi sems can gyi gtso bo thams cad kyang de bzhin du dgongs pa skad cig ma re re'i byin gyi rlabs kyis brlabs 32pa dang /dgongs pa skad cig la ji lta ba de nyi bzhin du dgongs pa skad cig ma 3stethams 37—34

cad la yangatu/ pad mo'i rgyud kyis yongs su dag par mngon par 'tshang〈mirgya bar bya ba dang / de bzhin du chos kyi dbyings thams cad ma lus pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa rnam par dag pa/ rgyan sna tshogs dang ldan pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams su dmigs pa rnam pa sna tshogs dang ldan pa'i zhing rnam par dag pa 'byam7klas pa/ brjod du med pa mtshan nyid tha dad pa rnam pa7tha dad pa'i rgyud tshad med cing 'byamasnyiklas pa/ dus kyi rgyud grangs med pa dang ldan pa bstan pa ma 'dres pa dang ldan pa/ blo tshad med pa dang mos pa shin tu yangs pa dang ldan pa/ mtshan nyid sna tshogs kyi gnas med pa/ mtshan nyid bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan pa/ tshad med pa thams cad dgongs pa skad cig ma las dgongs pa skad cig ma gcig gis thams cad yongs su bstan kyang /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ched du bsgrub pa mi mdzad pa la mnga' che ba ste / 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi mnga' chen pos mnga' bsgyur7ba'i chos bcu pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag nisdom sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi mnga' chen pos mnga' bsgyurasheba'i chos so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi chos yongs su rdzogs pa tshad med pa bsam gyis7mi khyab pa rnams te/ bcu gang zhe na/ mtshan re re zhing bsod nams brgya ba'i mtshan yongs su dag par 'gyur ba 'di ni yongs su rdzogs pa dang po ste/des sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams yongs su rdzogs pas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya'o/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad yongs 37—35

su rdzogs pas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya'o / /yon tan thams cad kyi 'byung gnas phun sum tshogs pa'i spyod pa yongs su dag pa yongs su7rdzogs pas/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya'o/ /sems can yongs su smin par bya ba dang /gdulamadun/ba yongs su rdzogs pas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi mnga' 'gro ba thams cad kyis zil gyis mi non pa/ yongs su rdzogs pas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya'o/ /zhing yongs su dag par bya ba yongs su rdzogs pasasresangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya'o / /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes yongs su rdzogs pas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya'o/ /mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po dang gzugs kyi sku blta na⑧don yod pa yongs su rdzogs pas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang mnyam pa nyid yongs su rdzogs pas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya ste/ sangs rgyas kyi phrin las thams cadamameyongs su rdzogs par mdzad nas yongs su mya ngan las 'da' 'o / /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi chos yongs su rdzogs pa tshad med pasnyibasam gyis mi khyab pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi thabs mkhas pa ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams nishechos thams cad byin gyis brlabs pa med cing spros pa thams cad med par yang 37—36

thugs su chud la/ dge ba'i sgo nas sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs7kyang shin tu ston cing brjod de/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi thabs mkhas pa dang po'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni chos thams cad la gzigs pa med cing phan tshun du mkhyen pa med do/ /ma bcings ma grol ba dang gzung ba med cing bstsags ②pa med de/ yongs su rdzogs pa med par yang thugs su chud la sangs rgyas kyi ③chos thams cad la mnga' dam pa'ang brnyes te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams chos thams cad la mnga' bsgyurabab de yang / yang dag pa de kho na nyid ma nor ba rnam pa gzhan du mi 'gyur ba dang / chos thams cad bdag gi med cing yongs su 'dzin pa med la de kho na nyid kyi mtha' las rnam par mi 'da' yang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mnga' chen pos chos kyi dbyings thams cad snang ba la yang /rab tu mkhyen pa 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi/ sangs rgyas kyi thabs mkhas pa gnyis pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mtshan ma'i mtha' thams cad mi mnga' ste/ mtshan ma thams cad dang mi 'grogs shing /mtshan ma'i mngon par shes pa thams cad dang ma 'dres la de'i rang bzhin du ngo bo nyid med pa dang / ji ltar ngo bo nyid med pa'i sgra'i tshul thams cad thugs su chud kyang gzugs kyi mtshan ma'i sku gzugs rnam par dag pa grangs med pa dang / zhing gi mtshan ma dang rnam par spyod pa'i mtshan ma zad mi shes pa rnam pa sna tshogs yang dag par bstan cing bshad pa'i ye shes kyi phung po mun pa med pa 'gro ba thams cad kyi sgron ma chen por gyur pas/ mun pa med pa'i snang ba ston pa 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi thabs mkhas pa 37—37

gsum pa'o/ /chags pa med pa'i mtha' ni sngon gyi mtha' yang ma yin/ phyi ma'i mtha' yang ma yin/ da ltar byung ba yang ma yin te/ chos kyi dbyings su gnas pa ni 'das pa'amatsho/ ma 'ongs pa'amatsho / da ltar byung ba yang ma yin pas de bzhin nyid kyisagasamatshan nyid kyis 'byung ba med kyang / sangs rgyas 'byung ba rnams kyi rigs tshad med pa'i phyir shin tu bstan pa brjod du med pas 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas ③skye ba yang rab tu brjod cing kun tu gzigs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi yul gyis de bzhin du gzigs pa 'di ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi thabs mkhas pa bzhi pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni phyi sku'i phrin las dang gsung gi phrin las dang / thugs kyi phrin las kyis nemangon par 'du mdzad pa yang mi mnga' la/ yongs su blang ba mi mnga' bas bzhugs shing / rnam par phye ba med pa'i mthar thug 7pa ste/ dor ba med pa'i chos kyi gnas kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 8la/ bgrang ba'i tshul las 9rnam par 'das kyang tshul des pa 9med pa'i mdzod du gyur cing / bgrang ba 1 dang mngon par bsgrub pa mtha' yas pa dang /'jig rten pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa rnam pa sna tshogs tha dad pa'i grangs kyi 12tshul thugs su chud pa ye shes bsgribs 1 pa med pas gzigs pa rnams 1 rite / chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad kyi sems can gdul ba rnam par dmigs pa la/ rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs tshad med mu med par mngon par sgrub pa mdzad pa 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi mthabs mkhas pa lnga pa'o / /chos thams cad lta ba med pas tha mi dad pa dang bye brag med pa dang /'byung ba med pa dang mtshan nyid med pa dang / sna tshogs med pa dang / blang 37—38

ba med pa dang / dor ba med pa dang / rang bzhin med par rab tu mkhyen kyang ske/ chos kyi rgyud 1)shin tu nges pa yang dag par sgrub cing / 'jig rten gyi tshul dang 'gal ba med pa dang / rang bzhin med pa yang yang gudag par gzigs pas thams cad mkhyen pa/ thams cad gzigs pa mkhyen par bya ba thams cad ma lus par gzigs pas chos la mnga' bsgyur 3)ba thams cad kyang rab tu ston la/ de bzhin nyid kyi rang bzhin las kyang mi nyams 5pa 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi thabs mkhas pa drug pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni thugs su chud pa'i rnam pa gcig gis gzhan dang gzhan mkhyen par bya ba chos de'i skyon med pa las rnam par ma 6 'das pa gnas )med pa dge ba'i rtsa ba rnam par dag pa mnyam pa nyid kyi chos skyon med pas/ dus thams cad du gnas pa rab tu mkhyen te/ de la yang nyi ma gcig gam/ zla ba phyed dam/ lo gcig gam/ lo brgya'am/ bskal pa 'jig ga pa dang / 'du bas rjes su bsnyag pa dang / phyir phyogs pa mi mnga' bar dus tshad med pa dang / nyi ma gcig dang / yud tsam gcig gi dus dang snga dro nas nyi ma phyed kyi 9dus dang / phyi dro nas snga dro'i dus dang / nyi ma gung nas phyi dro'i dus dang / nyi ma bgrangs pa'i 1 dus dang / nyi ma bdun dang /zla ba phyed kyi dus dang / zla ba dang / lo dang / lo brgya'i dus dang bskal pa gcig gi 11dus dang / tshad med grangs med pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dus nas / phyi ma'i mtha'i mur thug 12pa'i dus su chos bstan pa dang / chos kyi 'khor lo thogs pa med cing phyir mi ldog /rgyun chad 12par mi 'gyur/ bral bar mi 'gyur/ bar chad par mi 'gyur/ med par mi 'gyur/ 'jig par 37—39

mi 'gyur/ g.yo bar mi 'gyur/ ring du mi 'gyur/ 'khor de natuganas pa nyid du yang rgyun chadango par mi 'gyur te/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi thabs mkhas pa bdun pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad du ①rtag tu dus la bab par bzhugs pa ste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mi 'jigs pa tshad med pa pyo )mnga' ba'o/ / so so ⑤yang dag par rig ⑥pa grangs med pa mnga' ba'o / / so so ④yang dag par rigashepa tshad med pa7mnga' ba'o so so yang dag par rig01pa zad hurtemi shes pa mnga' ba'o/ / so so03yang dag par rig 8pa thogs pa med pa mnga' ba'o/ / so sosnyiyang dag par riganyepa mtha' yas pa mnga' ba'o/ /thun mong ma yin pa'i so so tu 7yang dag par rig tunyepa mnga' ba'o/ / so so rmo/rtseyang dag par rigar+sāX pa mthar thug pa med pa mnga' ba'o// so so 31yang dag par rig pa zhu de kho na dang ldan pa mnga' ba'o so so nyeyang dag par rig 3stepa tshig gi tshul thams cad rab tu rtogs pa mnga' ba'o chos thams cad so so (2yang dag par rig pa mnga' ba'o/ /bsam pa dang mos pa dang ske/ dbang po ji lta ba bzhin du chos kyi tshul dang rnam grangs tshul ji ltar rnam par bkod pa bzhin dus mtshams zhu med par ston te/ mdo sde bye ba khrag khrig brjod du med pa'i yang brjod dus rtemed pa rnams mdo sde demakhyedang de la thog ma dang tha ma dang0 skudabus kyi tshetshul gyis yang dag par ston te6rte/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi thabs mkhas pa brgyad pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni ming med kyang mying dang rigs su 'byung5nyeba'i chos thams cad tshig dang yi ges shin tu dbyangs pa'i dbyings5hemangon par 37wa 40

sangs rgyas pa ste/ mying 'das pa ma yin pa dang / mying ma 'ongs pa ma yin pa dang ske/ mying da ltar byung ba ma yin pa dang / mying sems can ma yin pa dang /mying zhing ma yin pa dang / mying chos ma yin pa dngatu/ ming yon tan ma yin pa dang / mying byang chub sems dpa' ma yin pa dang / mying sangs rgyas ma yin pa dang / mying grangs ma yin pa dang / mying grangs med pa ma yin pa dang ske/ mying skye ba ma yin pa dang / mying 'gag pa ma yin pa dang / mying myed pa ma yin pa dang / mying yod pa ma yin pa dang / mying gcig pa ma yin pa dang ske/ mying tha dad pa ma yin pa dang / mying thams cad ma yin pa dang /chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis brjod du med pa dang / phyogs med pa dang /brdasamed pa dang / tshig gi lam med padu/ sgra dang bral ba dngas/ sgra'i rnam pa thams cad mi 'byung ba/ yongs su bsgrubs rgyapa med pa/ byas pa dang rnam par byas pa med pa rnam pa gcig ma yin pa/ rnam pa mang po ma yin pa yang thugs su chud la/ brjod pa dang spyod pa thams cad la yang pha rol tu phyin pa'i mchog brnyes pa dag ste/ rnam par rtog pa'i yul mi mnga' ba dag go/ /mngon par 'du mdzad pa med pa la rab tu brtson pa dag go/ /rtog 6)pa dang kun tu rtog pa dang ⑦yongs su rtog pa 'gags gshepa dag go/ /spyod pa thams cad la mi gnas par spyod pa dag ste/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi thabs mkhas pa dgu pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni zhu)chos thams cad kyi gzugs ma skyes pa rab tu mkhyen pa ste hu byetshor ba'i spros pa med pa dang / 'du shes kyi grangs med pa dang / 'du byed kun tu rgyu ba med pa dang / rnam par shes pa nye bar len pa med pa dang /37—41

rang bzhin gyis zhi ba nyarab tu mkhyen te/ chos thams cad skye mched kyi rgyud med pa dang / khams rnams mi dmigs pa dang / chos thams cad mi 'jigasho pa dang / chos thams cad bskyodam )du med cing / rang bzhin gyis nam mkha' lta bu dang / chos thams cad dben pa dang / las med pa dang / rnam par smin pa med pa dang / spyod pas 'byung ba med pa dang / ma grub pa dang / ma byung ba dang / grangs kyis ring)mi brjod pa dang / yod pa ma yin pa dang / med pa ma yin pa dang 5/ ma skyes pa dang / ma 'gags pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa med pa dang / rnam par byang ba med pa dang / skyon 7med pa dang ske/ gnas pa 75med pa dang / yongs su gnas pa med pa dang / yongs su smin par byas pa med pa shedang / rnam par btul ba 9med pa dang / sems can med pa dang / sems can med pa ma yin pa dang / srog med pa dang /srog med pa ma yin pa dang / rkyen med pa dang / rkyen med pa ma yin pa dang /rten pa 1 med pa dang / rten pa 11med pa ma yin par chos thams cad thugs su chud kyang chos kyi dbyings thams cad shin tu bstan pa la pha rol tu phyin pa'i dam pa brnyes pa dag ste/ nges pa dang ma nges pa dang / log par nges pa'i phung po gsum rnam par dgod pa rnams la stobs bcus thugs su chud pa'i ye shes mi 'jigs pa bzhis rnam par dag pa'i sangs rgyas kyi yul chen po dang ldan pas seng ge'i sgra sgrog pa 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi 12thabs mkhas pa bcu pa ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi thabs mkhas pa'o// // sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/ bam po 37—42

gsum pa/hu) kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi phrin rilas rgya chen po tshad med pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams te/ de dag nims)sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabasa'i rim gtogs par lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten dang / 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis 'jug par 55mi nus pa'ol/ /bcu gang zhe na/ phyogs bcu'i nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mthas gye gtugs pa'i chos kyi dbyings thams cad kyi 7'jig rten gyi 37/khams ma lus pa thams cad du dga' ldan du skye ba bstan pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa mu med pa dag la sangs rgyas kyi phrin las mdzad de/ kha dog tshad med pa gzi brjid tshad med pa snang ba tshad med pa/ dbyangs tshad med pa dbyangs kyi yan lag rnam par dag pa tshad med pa gsung brjod pas rnam par dmyigs 9)pa tshad med pa/ting nge 'dzin tshad med pa la spyod pa/ shes rab dang ye shes kyi 1 7yul tshad med pa mnga' ba 31rnams lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten la phan 'dogs pa mdzad de/bdud dang bcas pa tshangs pa dang bcas pa/ dge sbyong dang 12bram ze'i skye dgu dang bcas pa/ lha dang mi dang / lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten la phan 'dogs pa mdzad do/ /byams pa chen po'i spyod yul thogs pa med pa dang /thabs thugs rje chen po'i sgo'i mthar thug 12pas sems can la phan 'dogs pa mdzad do/ /bsod nams kyi stobs dang / mnga' phun sum tshogs pa dang /dbang po rnam par sbyang ba 1 dang / cang shes kyi sems yongs su dag pas kyang sems can rnams la phan 'dogs pa tshamadzad do/ /theg pa sna tshogs rnam par dag pas kyang sems can rnams la phan 'dogs pa mdzad do/ /theg pa chen po 37—43

yongs su rdzogs par bya bas kyang sems can rnams la phan 'dogs pa7mdzad do / /'gro ba thams cad gdonasngo pas kyang sems can rnams la phan 'dogs pa mdzad de/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi phrin las dang po'o/ /dga' ldan gyi pho brang nas 'phos pa med kyang yum gyi skur gshegs shing / byang chub sems dpa'i sku tha ma skye bar ston zhupa/ sgyu ma lta bu'i ri4yongs su spyod pa/ sprul pa lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi mthar thug ⑤pa/mig yor lta bur rnam par dmigs pa/ nam mkha'i yul tshad med par khyab pa/bzhed pa bzhin du skye ba moyang chags pa mi mnga' ba mig rgyu ⑦lta bur bstan pa/nyon mongs pa med pa'i chos la yang dag par gzhol ba/ gnas med pa'i ye shes la gnas pa/ rang bzhin gyis 'dod chags dang bral bas rnam par dag pa/rgyan shin tu rgya che ba'i mdzod kyis sangs rgyas kyi phrin las mdzad do/ /khang pa brtsegs pa rin po che las byas pa'i pho brang chen po rin po lache'i rgyan mang po dang nyunoldan pa na bzhugs pas kyang sangs rgyas kyi phrin las mdzad do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyis kyang sangs rgyas kyi phrin las mdzad do/ /yid la bya ba'i byin gyi rlabs sna richen pos kyang sangs rgyas kyi phrin las mdzad do/ /rnam par 'phrul pa'i mdzod chen po yang dag par bstan pas kyang sangs rgyas kyi phrin las mdzad do/ /ye shes kyi nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor chen pos kyang sangs rgyas kyi phrin las mdzad do/ /yum sku bskyed kyi pa'i sku na bzhugs pas kyang sangs rgyas kyi phrin las mdzad do/ /sangs rgyas kyi yul gyi spyod yul chen po brnyes pas kyang sangs rgyas kyi phrin las mdzad do/ /sangs rgyas kyi byin gyis 'jig rten byin duchabarlabs pa mtha' yas pas kyang nyusnyesangs rgyas kyi phrin las mdzad do/ /ting nge 'dzin chen po grangs 37—44

med pa la rnam par spyod cing / snyoms par 'jug pas kyang sangs rgyas kyi phrin las mdzad do/ /ting nge ①'dzin las bzhengs pa de dang de dag gis kyang sangs rgyas kyi phrin las mdzad do/ /spyod pa'i thog ma la yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po'i mthar thug ②pa'i bar du thog ②ma dang dbus dang tha ma'i tshul gyis kyangakyisangs rgyas kyi 'phrinasnyilas mdzad do/ /sa 'di la gnyis su med pasakyithams cad mthar phyin par byas nas tha mar 'jig rten gyi grangs kyi skye ba yongs su ston te/ skye bas kyang 'jig rten thams cad du sangs rgyas kyi phrin las mdzad do/ /gzhonaphunur gyur pas kyang 'jig rten thams cad du sangs rgyas kyi phrin las mdzad do/ /byang chub sems dpar gyur pas kyang 'jig rten thams cad du sangs rgyas kyi phrin las mdzad do/ /mngon par 'byung bas kyang 'jig rten thams cad du sangs rgyas kyi phrin las mdzad do/ /mngon par 'tshang rgya bas kyang 'jig rten thams cad du sangs rgyas kyi phrin las mdzad do/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bas kyang 'jig rten thams cad du sangs rgyas kyi phrin las mdzad do/ /thabs mkhas pa sna tshogs kyis kyang 'jig rten sna tshogs 'jig rten tshad med pa/ 'jig rten kun 0tu mtha' yas pa phyogs kyi dra ba'i rgyud dang /rigs ⑫ thams cad kyi 'jig rten ma lus pa thams cad du sangs rgyas kyi phrin las mdzad do/ /zhing gi rgyud ma lus pa'i 'jig rten du sangs rgyas kyi phrin las mdzad do/ /las kyi rnam par smin pa ma lus pa'i 'jig rten du sangs rgyas kyi phrin las mdzad do/ /sems can gyi rgyud ma lus pa'i 'jig rten du sangs rgyas kyi phrin las mdzad do/ /skye ba dang shi 'pho ba'irwa1rgyud ma lus pa'i 'jig rten du sangs rgyas kyi phrin las mdzad do/ /sprul pa chen po'i rgyud dang / sangs rgyas 37—45

kyi rigs dang / chos dran pa'i sgo'i 'khor los kyang sangs rgyas kyi phrin las mdzad de37/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi phrin las gnyis pa'o/ /dge bar spyod pa'i las rnam par dag cing gdung rabs thams cad du ye shes kyi tshul rnam par dag pas/ sku tshe'i rgyud kyi tshul dang ldan pa sems can thams cad gdul ba thugs su chud pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad yongs su rdzogs par mdzad dochos/ /btsun mo'i 'khor gyi nang dumachos)bzhugs pa ston kyang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'dod chags dang bral ba'i tshul gyis nga gnas la bzhugs pa rnams sgra dang / tshig thams cad dang bral bar brtags pas / dngos po thams cad dngos po med pa las byung bar khong du chud par bya ba dang / dngos po thams cad shes pa la gzung bar 45bya ba dang / tshul khrims thams cad 6rimakhyen pa nyid kyi mthar thug par yongs su rdzogs par bya ba dang ske/ snying rje chen pos 'gro ba mu med pa la rnam par blta bar bya ba dang /byams pa chen pos sems can med pa'i yul la rab tu rtogs 77)par bya ba dang /dga' ba chen pos 'jig rten 8chibarjod du med pa 9rikhong du chud par bya ba dang /btang snyoms chen pos sems la dbang bsgyur 1 ba la gnas par bya ba dang /thams cad mkhyen pa'i yon tan gyis rang yongs su rgyas par byed par bya ba dang /chos kyi dbyings kyi lus ma lus par mngon par bsgrub par bya ba dang / thams cad du gnas med pa'i lus yongs su rdzogs par byed par 11bya ba dang /'khor thams cad rnam par dag par nan tan tu byed par bya ba dang / chos bstan pa rnam par brjod par 12rab tu brjod par bya ba dang / 'jig rten gyi dngos po la smod par bya ba dang / 'gro ba thams cad kyi nyes pa la rtog par bya 37wa 46

ba mdzad cing spyod pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa bas4)rnam par smin pa yang dag par bstan pa dang / ji ltar bkod pa'i tshul du sems can gdul ba dang /yongs su ma smin pa'i sems can yongs su smin par bya ba dang / yongs su smin pa 2rnams tshul bzhin du gdul ba dang / grangs med pa'i thabs mkhas pa mngon par bsgrub pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi phrin las phyir mi ldog pa yongs su bstan pa dang / sgo sna tshogs ṭa nas chos kyi spyod pa rab tu brjod pa dang /sems can rnams kyi bsam pa sna tshogs par gisna/rnam par sbyang ba dang / thugs rje chen po las byung ba'i chos kyi sprin gyis mngon par spang 5ba dang / thams cad la skyob pa'i byams pa chen po bskyed pa'i cho 'phrul gsum gyis yongs su brlan pa dang / sangs rgyas thams cad mngon pa riganodang / rnam par dmigs par ༅btsun mo'i 'khor gyi nang du bstan pa yan chad rin/du 'jig rten mtha' dang dbus med par sangs rgyas kyis9phrin las yongs su bstan pa mdzad cing / ye shes kyi mthu 1 tshochen po thogs pa med pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi mngon par mkhyen pa bsgribs nyi pa med par bsgrub pa dang / chos rnam pa gsum gyi 12thabs mkhas pa dang ldan pa'i phrin las kyi mtha' dang / sku'i phrin las kyi mtha' shin tu rnam par dag pa dang / gsung gi phrin las ye shes nyams pa med pas rnam par dag pa dang / thugs kyi phrin las kyi mtha' zab cing chags pa med pa'i mthar thug nyi pa'i thabs la mkhas pas sems can rnams kyi don mdzad de 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 1 rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi phrin las gsum pa'o/1snye /rnam par rgyal ba chen po mnga' ba rnams ni btsun tshamo'i 'khor rgyan rnam par phye 17ba tshad med pa dang ldan pa yid du 'ong ba spangs te/ mngon par 'byung ba'i 37—47

spyod pa yongs su bstan pas sems can rnams 'jig rten gyis3)gnas las bskyodamugepa dang / 'jig rten gyi mngon par zhen pa rnam par bzlog pa dang / 'jig rten du gtogs pa thams cad mi rtag par shes par bya ba dang / 'jig rten gyi tshul la mngon par zhen pa rnam par bzlog pa dang / 'jig rten gyi dga' ba la sred pa yongs su gcadas pa dang / 'jig rten gyi 45nyon mongs pa byang zhing nub pa la yang dag par spyod par bya ba dang / sems can gyi don rjes su dran par bya ba'i phyir/ mngon par 'byung ba'i don la rab tu gzhol ba dang / khyim 45)pa'i tshul yongs su spang ba 6)bstan pa dang / nyon mongs pa med pa'i chos kyi sbyor ba la yang dag par gnas par bya ba dang / sngon gyi smon lam yongs su rdzogs par bya ba dang / yon tan gyi dkyil 'khor tshad med pa yongs su snang bar bya ba dang / ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor chen po brnyes pas sems can rnams kyi mi shes pa'i sgrib pa rab tu bstsal (dzo)ba dang / bdag nyid bsod nams kyi zhing bla na med par gyur par 'gro ba thams cad la bstan pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad sangs rgyas la bskyed pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba'i nang du 'dus par 'gro ba thams cad la yang dag par brjod pa dang / bdag nyid kyis ye shes kyi don gzigs par bstan pa dang / sems can rnams rnam par dag pa'i sgor brjod pa dang / sems can rnams kha na ma tho ba med pa'i sgor bsgrub pa dang /'jig rten thams cad du 'byung ba'i sgo rab tu bstan pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi rgyal mtshan yang dag par bsgreng bar 48)mdzad cing mngon par 'byung ba 9ste/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi tso phrin las bzhi pa'o/ /don gcig ma yin pa mkhyen pa dang ldan pa/ thams 37—48

cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi mthar thug pa rnams ni chos thams cad mngon par 'tshang rgya bar bya'o zhes byang chub kyi shing drung du byon te/ byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya bas kyang bdud kyi dpung thams cad rab tu gzhom pa dang /sku'i byin gyi rlabs sna kyi mdzod kyis 2chos kyi dbyings kyil snam lus pa thams cad du rgyas par dgang ba'i phyir byin gyi rlabs mazad mi shes pa'i mthar thug pas mtha' rnam par spangs pa spyod pa tshad med pa rab tu brnyes pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i yul gyis rnam par rol pa'i ye shes kyi don dang ldan pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i yon tan yang dag par bsgrub pa yongs su rdzogs pa 'jig rten gyi zhe khams ma lus pa thams cad du gdan rnam par bkram pas yongs su rgyas pa/sangs rgyas kyi zhing ma lus pa thams cad du byang chub sems dpas 6)rnam par dmigs pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dam pa thob pa rnams kyi 7skuzhal du blta ba/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi rnam pa dang / smon lam khyad par can dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad kyis yang dag par bsam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo zab mo rab tu bskor 87ba/sangs rgyas kyi yul tshad med pa brtsams pas9/ byang chub sems dpa' brjod du med pa'i 'byung gnas su gyur pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa sna tshogs spyod pa la yang dag par gzhol ba1 / byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnam par dag pa mnga' ba/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad sangs rgyas kyi byin gyis byin du rlob 11pa'i yul mnga' ba/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa'i sems can gyis rnam par dmigs pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad tha mi dad pa dang ldan pa 'byung ba'i sa/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa mtha' yas pa'i 37—49

mthu'i gnas la yon tan gyi 1)khyad par thams cad rab tu brnyes nas pabazhugs pa / 'jig rten gyi rnam pa thams cad ma lus pa'i mthar thug pa/ sems can gyi rnam pa thams cad dang / zhing ri gi rnam pa thams cad dang / chos kyi rnam pa thams cad dang / byang chub sems dpa'i rnam pa thams cad dang / yongs su smin par bya ba'i rnam pa thams cad dang / dus kyi rnam pa thams cad dang /gdul caba'i rnam pa thams cad dang / sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa'i rnam pa thams cad ma lus pa'i mthar thug pa 5rnams 'gro ba ma lus pa thams cad du mos pa ji lta ba bzhin du rnam par 'tshang rgya bas sangs rgyas kyi phrin las mdzad de / 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi phrin las lnga pa'orka/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams 6)chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar mdzad pa 7phyir mi ldog pa'i tshul gyis phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo dang / 'jig rten thams cad kyi 8khong du chud par 'gyur ba'i tshul gyis tshad med pa'i 'khor lo dang / mi 'jigs pa'i seng ge'i nga ro chen po'i tshul gyis thams cad ma lus par mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i 'khor lo dang / chos kyi mdzod mun pa 9med pa'i sgos snang bar byed pa'i tshul gyis 1 chos thams cad mkhyen pa'i mdzod kyi 'khor lo dang / ye shes nam mkha'i dbyings ltar tshad med pa'i tshul gyis chags pa med pa'i 'khor lo dang / chos thams cad kyi dngos po med pa'i rang bzhin rab tu rtogs par bya ba'i tshul gyis bsgribs 11pa med pa'i 'khor lo dang 12/sems can thams cad kyi chos kyi mig rnam par sbyong ba'i tshul gyis 'jig rten thams cad kyi sgron ma'i 'khor lo dang / 'jig rten thams cad du rgyas par 'gengs pa'i tshul gyis thams cad mkhyen pa'i chos brjod pa'i 'khor lo dang /37—50

sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad dang mi 'gal ba'i tshul gyis sangs rgyas thams cad 'dab 'dres par gyur pa'i 'khor lo dang / de dag la stsogs 1pa rnam pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bas sems can thams cad kyi sems dang spyod pa'i rnam pa la/ chos kyi 'khor lo skoralate/ de ltar chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bas kyang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams sangs rgyas kyi phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad de/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bsangs rgyas kyi phrin las drug pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni grong dang grong khyer dang grong rdal dang / rgyal po'i gnas su gshegs pas kyang sems can rnams la sangs rgyas kyi phrin las mdzad de/ mi'i rgyal po'i gnas ④dang / lha'i rgyal po'i gnas dang / klu'i rgyal po'i gnas dang /gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po'i gnas dang / dri za'i rgyal po'i gnas dang / lha ma yin gyi rgyal po'i gnas dang / nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po'i gnas dang /mi'am ci'i rgyal po'i gnas dang / lto 'phye chen po'i rgyal po'i 5)gnas dang /srin po'i rgyal po'i khyaganas dang / sha za'i rgyal po'i gnas dag tu gshegs pas 7kyang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni sangs rgyas kyi phrin las mdzad de/'di lta ste/ grong khyer gyi sgor byon nas nagayo ba dang / 'od zer snang ba dang /long ba rnams mig 'thob pa dang / 'on pa rnams sgra thos par 'gyur ba dang /smyonas pa rnams dran pa 'thob 1 par 'gyur ba dang / gos med pa rnams gos 'thob 11par 'gyur ba dang / sdug bsngal ba rnams bde ba 'thob 12pa dang /rol mo'i cha byad nyanam dkrol ma brdungs par sgra yid du 'ong ba rang 'byin pa dang /rgyan snod na 'dug pa dang / gnas nas ma phog pa dang / ma bskyod ma dkrol 37—51
