bar bskyod cing dkrol ba'i sgra 'byung ba dang / bya sna tshogs mang po'i sgra skad yid du 'ong ba 'byung ba dang / blta0)na gtang mi bra zhing mi mthunadza pa med pa'i sku mthong bas kyang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams sems can rnams la sangs rgyas kyi phrin las mdzad do/ /mtshan dang dpe ri )byad bzang po bstan pas kyang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ④sems can rnams la sangs rgyas kyi phrin las mdzad de/ yongs su gzigs pa dang / rnam par gzigs pa dang / brkyang ba dang / bskum pas kyang sems can rnams la sangs rgyas kyi phrin las mdzad do/ /gshegs pa dang slar bzhud pa dang /bzhengs pa dang / 'chag55)pa dang / bzhugs pa dang / gzims pas kyang sems can rnams ri la sangs rgyas kyi phrin las mdzad do/ /chos bstan pa dang /mi gsung bar bzhugs pas kyang sems can rnams la sangs rgyas kyi phrin las mdzad do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul dang / yongs su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul dang /rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul gyis kyang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams 'jig rten gyi khams kyi yul sems can bsam pa sna tshogs rgya mtsho dang ldan pa 'jig rten gyi spyod pa thams cad rgyu zhing 'byung ba dang ldan pa dge ba'i rtsa ba chen pos shin tu brtan 57pa/ sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa dang ldan pa/ sngon 'grogs du 'grogs pa'i 49 byang chub sems dpa' dang gnas pa'i sems can rnams la sangs rgyas kyi phrin las mdzad do/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni sku gzugs blta na mi ngoms 1 pa'o zhes bya bar gzhol ba dang / sangs rgyas rnams skye bar dkon 31no zhes bya bar yid ches par byed pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa mthong zhing / de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung thos 12pa ni bsod 37—52

nams kyi chos dkar po'i 'byung gnas su gyur pa'o/ /zhes sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa yid la byed pa dang / 'jig rten thams cad rnam par dag pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa skye ba yin no zhes bya bar khong du chud par byed pa dang /sangs rgyas kyi yon tan bsngags pa ni mtha' yas pa'o zhes bya bar yang dag par lta ba dang / ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas 'byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs yang dag par bsgrub pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba dang mos pa'i tshul thams cad kyis sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams mnyes par byed pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ni yon tan mtha' yas pa'o/ /zhes khong du chud par byed pa dang ske/ de bzhin gshegs pa ni sems can thams cad la〈snamangon du gyur par rtogasalgepa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa ni sems can gyi ris 7bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas su gyur par sems pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa ni zhing thams cad na'agesnang bar khong du chud pa dang / de lta bu'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad 'byung bas 'jig rten thams cad na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams sems can rnams la sangs rgyas kyi phrin las mdzad do/ /dad par byas pa cir dang ske/ phyag 'tshal 6)ba dang / thal mo sbyar bar ri byas pa dang / rjes su bstod dunyepa dang / spyan drangs pa dang / mchod pa dang / mngon du mthong ba dang ske/ 'dzum pa byas pas1dang / sangs rgyas la dga' ba'i sems kyis mos par byas pa'i〈 spradage ba'i rtsa ba'i sgo nas kyang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni sems can rnams la sangs rgyas kyi phrin las mdzad do/ /sangs rgyas rjes su dran par gyur pas kyang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni sems can rnams la sangs rgyas kyi phrin las mdzad do/ /sangs rgyas mthong bar 'dod 37—53

par byas pas 1 kyang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni sems can rnams la sangs rgyas kyi phrin las mdzad do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku kha dog dang dbyibs kyi rnam pa tshad med pa bstan pas kyang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni sems can rnams la sangs rgyas kyi phrin las mdzad do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung thos 3par bya bas tshos kyang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni sems can rnams la sangs rgyas kyi phrin las mdzad de/ de dag la stsogs 4pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi phrin las mdzad pa 5rnam pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong brjod du med pa dag /'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa thams cad du sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa dang / mthu dang 'dul ba ji lta ba'i tshul las mi 'da' bar 'byung ngo / /de ltar sangs rgyas kyi phrin las 'jig rten thams cad kyi sems can kun gyi sems dang spyod pa dang bsam pa la gnas pa6/ dge ba rgya che ba tshad med pa dag phyir mi ldog pa'i yul dang ske/ snying rje chen pos rab tu bskul ba dang / sngon gyi smon lam gyis yongs su skyo ba med pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi phrin las mkhyen pa'i stobs dang /shugs kyis 'jig rten thams cad du me'abyung ste/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi phrin las bdun pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni dgon 8pa la bzhugs sam9/ zhi bar bzhugs sam/dben par bzhugs sam/ sangs rgyas kyi rnam par spyod pa la bzhugs sam/ting nge 'dzin chen po'i gnas la bzhugs sam/ gcig pu dgyes par bzhugs sam / sku myi snang bar bzhugs sam/ ye shes zab mo'i gnas la bzhugs sam/sangs rgyas kyi yul gyi stobs tshad med pa la bzhugs sam/ sku'i 7yongs su spyod 37—54

pa mi mthong bar bzhugs kyang rung ste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi phrin las gzhan gyis mi tshugs pa'i ye shes dang / smon lam gyi tshul gyis mos pa bzhin du 'dul ba'i sems can rnams la rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung ste/ sangs rgyas lha yongs su tshol bas kyang / sangs rgyas kyi phrin las rgyun mi 'chad do/ /sangs rgyas klu yongs su tshol bas kyang sangs rgyas kyi phrin las rgyun mi 'chad do/ /sangs rgyas gnod sbyin yongs su tshol ba dang /sangs rgyas mi'am ci yongs su tshol ba dang / sangs rgyas lto 'phye chen po yongs su tshol ba dang / sangs rgyas srin po yongs su tshol ba dang / sangs rgyas mi dang mi ma yin pa tshoyongs su tshol ba dang / sangs rgyas nyan thos dang /sangs rgyas rang sangs rgyas dang / sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yongs su tshol bas kyang sangs rgyas kyi phrin las rgyun mi 'chad do/ /chos ston pas kyang sangs rgyas kyi phrin las rgyun mi 'chad do/ /sangs rgyas gcig brjod pas kyang sangs rgyas kyi phrin las rgyun mi 'chad do/ /sangs rgyas thams cad brjod pas kyang sangs rgyas kyi phrin las rgyun mi 'chad do/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i khyad par dang / smon lam thams cad gcig tu brjod pas kyang sangs rgyas kyi phrin las rgyun mi 'chad do/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa gcig rnam par phye ste/ spyod pa tha dad pa brjod pas kyang sangs rgyas kyi phrin las rgyun mi 'chad do / /'jig rten gyi yul sangs rgyas kyi yul du brjod pas kyang sangs rgyas kyi phrin las rgyun mi 'chad do/ /sangs rgyas kyi yul 'jig rten gyi yul du brjod pas kyang sangs rgyas kyi phrin las rgyun mi 'chad do/ /yul ma yin pa sangs rgyas kyi yul du brjod pas kyang sangs rgyas kyi phrin las rgyun mi 'chad do/ /nyin 37—55

mtshan dang zla ba yar kham mar kham dngas3)/ zla ba dang / lo 'grangs par ②bzhugs pa dang / yongs su bzhugs pa nas/ de bzhin du bskal pa brjod du med pa'i riyang brjod du med pa'i bar du bzhugs pa dang / yongs su ④bzhugs pas kyang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams sems can rnams la sangs rgyas kyi phrin las mdzad de45)/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyisngonaphrin las brgyad pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams la 'byung gnas lta bu/ sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa kun la rnam par spyod pa57)lta bu/ sangs rgyas rnams la dad pa lta bu/sems khong du chud par bya ba la shin tu mos pa lta bu/ dbang po rnams la bsgrub pa lta bu/ sems can skye dgu thams cad la 'dul ba lta bu/ 'gro ba thams cad la mos pa lta bu/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la 'byung ba lta bu/byang chub tu zhugs pa rnams la bskul lab lta bu/ gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog pa rnams la ye shes kyis49)snang ba lta bu dag ste sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni 'jig rten mi rtag par ston pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi phrin las rgyun mi 'chadama'ipar brjod pa dang / phrin las mdzad pa'i mthar thug par bstan pa dang /chos kyi rgyud humanyams pa med pa'i dngos por brjod pa dang / srid pa'i tshul rtsa ba nas chad par brjod nyugepa dang / sems can thams cad skyo bar bya bar bstan pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi rjes su 'gro ba'i sems su mthun tu par bya ba dang / sku tshe'i mtha' lta bur sems can rnams kyis shes par bya ba dang /sems can rnams kyis 'jig rten thams cad du dga' bar bya ba med par bstan pa dang / sems can rnams la ma byon pa'i sangs rgyas gcig nas/37—56

gcig tu brgyud pa mnyes par gyis shig par bstan pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams chos kyi 'khor lo bskor 37ba bstan du mi rung bar khong du chud par bya ba dang / 'jig rten rnams kyi rtsol ba bskyed pa dang sangs rgyas la dmigs par brtson pa'i sems la dgod pa dang / yun du dran pa rnam par dag pas de bzhin gshegs pa mthong ba'i rnam par rtog pa bskyed pa dang / skye5naba'i dbang po phyir bzlog cing yongs su dag par mdzad pa dang / sangs rgyas la mos pa bskyed pa dang / skyo bar gyur pa'i sems can rnams dul byin gyis brlab par bya ba dang / sangs rgyas la dmigs pa'i rkyen 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa thams cad du phyin par dgongs pa mdzad pa dang / sku thams cad bshig ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung gis sems can rnams yongs su gzung ba mdzad pa dang / 'jig rten rnam par 'khrugs ci pa dang / dregs shing myos pa'i sems can rnams sdom pa la dgod 5pa mdzad cing / yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba (67ston pas kyang / sangs rgyas kyi phrin las rgyun mi 'chad de / 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi phrin las dgu pa'o / /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams mya ngan las 'da' ba'i 7 tshe/ 'jig rten thams cad na sems can rnams smre sngags 'don cing ngu ba dang / mya ngan byed pa dang / mchi〈8)ma 'byin pa dang / yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhe'am / thugs rje chen po zhe'am/ ded dpon chen po zhe'am/ phan par bzhed pa thugs brtse ba can zhe'am/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi sems can thams cad kyi skyabs su gyur pa/ mgon du gyur pa/ rten du gyur pa/ bla na med pa/ bsod nams kyi zhing nub par gyur to zhe'amakha/ sangs rgyas 37—57

bcom ldan 'das rnams ni 'byung bar dka' 'o/ /zhes rnam pa de lta bur smre sngags 'don cing 1)/ mya ngan byed pa dang / sangs rgyas mthong ba rjes su dran pa'i sems can rnams kyi bsam pa dang / yid la bya ba de dang de dag gi sgor sangs rgyas kyi phrin las tshad med pa rgyun mi 'chad ④do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 2rnams yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba'i 6)tshe/ 'di lta ste/sems can rnams kyi sems dad par bya ba'i dbang dang / sems can rnams dad pas 5mchod par bya ba'i dbang dang / sems can rnams lhag pa'i bsam pa rnam par spyod par 6 bya ba'i dbang dang / sems can rnams yongs su smin par bya ba'i dbang dang / sems can rnams yongs su sbyang bar bya ba'i dbang dang ske/ sems can rnams gdul khyaba'i dbang dang / sems can rnams kyi sa bsod nams kyi tshogs yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i 9dbang dang / sems can rnams de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pas dmigs par bya ba'i dbang dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod 1 rten rnam 11pa sna tshogs su brgyan pas/ phyogs dang yul sna tshogs su sems can rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba bstsags nyi par bya ba'i dbang gis sems can rnams kyi bsam pa dang mos pa ji lta ba bzhin du sku gdung dang ske/ ring bsrel byin gyis rlob ste/ lha dang klu dang / gnod sbyin dang /dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi'i gnas thams cad du 'dul ba dang / mos pa'i tshul ji lta ba bzhin du/ sku gdung dang ring bsrel byin gyis rlob 3 po/ /rang gi sku rnam par phye ste/ sku gdung dang ring bsrel botshad med pa grangs med pa dpag tu med pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa byin 37—58

gyis rlob bo17/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten gyis nasangs rgyas kyi sku gdung 'jig rten thams cad du rnam par phye ba ride'i yul dang / phyogs kyi klu'i gnas dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po'i gnas dang / mi'i gnas dang / srin po'i gnas dag tu sku gdung dang / ring bsrel mchod pa cabyed par 'gyur bas/ sku gdung gi ring bsrel 5dang dbu dang / phyag sen gyi mchod rten dang / sangs rgyas bzhugs pa'i mchod rten la 'gro ba thams cad nges par sangs rgyas dran par 'gyur te/ chos la rab tu rten par 'gyur ro/ /dge 'dun la dad pa rab tu 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /yul dang phyogs kyi gnas de dang de dag tu yang rgyun mi 'chad par sangs rgyas mchod pa la brtson pa'i bsam pas sbyin pa yongs su gtong bar 'gyur ro/ /bsod nams byed par 'gyur ro/ /mtho ris de dang de yongs su dag pa rab tu 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /rigs dang rgyud kyi bdag nyid che ba rab tu 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /longs spyod chen po dang / 'khor rnam par dag pa rab tu 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /lha dang mi'i phun sum tshogs pa nyams su myong 6bar 'gyur ro/ /log par ltung ba med pa'i lam yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas byung 7ba don yod pa rab tu bsgrub par 'gyur ro/ /chos dkar po la gnas pa yongs su rdzogs par byed par 'gyur ro/ /khams gsum pa las 'byung ba'i lam 8yongs su sbyong bar 9'gyur ro/ /theg pa gang la dad pa'i smon lam gyis 1 nges par 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de dang 11de dag la drin du gzo ba rab tu 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la rten 12pa dang /37—59

skyabs btsal 3)ba dang / mgon btsal cib dang / dpung gnyen btsal ba'i sems bskyed par 'gyur te/ba de ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni yongs su mya ngan las 'das kyang yon gebasam gyis mi khyab par sbyong brtson/bsod nams zad mi shes pa'i yon 3gyi gnas dag ste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni 'jig rten du byungamatshon)na de ltar sems can rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba rnam 95pa mang po rab tu bstsags nyu )pas bsod nams kyi tshogs rab tu (7rdzogs par 'gyur 32te/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi hu phrin las bcu pa'o1 ri/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi phrin las rgya chen po tshad med pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnams so/ /de dag ni sangs rgyas kyi byin rlabs nyusnyem gtogs par lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis tshad gzung bar mi nus pa'o8/ /'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis 1 'jug par mi nus pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi gnyis su med par spyod cing / dngos po rnam pa gnyis su med pa'i chos kyi dbang phyug gi chos rnams te/ bcu gang zhe na/'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas 12bcom ldan 'das rnams ni lung bstan pa thams cad ston pa la gnyis su med par spyod do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni sems can sangs rgyas 19rjes su dran pa la brtson pa 2 )rnams kyi sems dang bsam pa brjod du med pa 'byam 217sa pa rnams la gnyis su med par spyod do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi don ma lus par mngon par sangs rgyas pas gnyis su med pa'i sku dmyigs 22par mdzad do/ /'das pa dang / ma byon pa 37wa 60

dang ske/ da ltar byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la rang bzhin gnyis su med par thugs su chud pa mnga' ba'o/ /'byung ba dang byang (1)ba'i mtha' gnyis su med pa dang / sngon gyi mtha' dang / phyi ma'i mtha' dang /nano da ltar byung bsaganyis su med par thugs su chud pa mnga' ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad gnyis su med pas dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad gcig par rab tu mkhyen cing ston pa thugs su chud pa mnga' ba'o sangs rgyas gcig dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gnyis su med par thugs su chud pa mnga' ba'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis thugs su chud pa dang ske/ 'dul ba mdzad pa'i rnam par dmigs pa gnyis gesu med par thugs su chud pa mnga' ba'ozhu)/ /'jig rten gyi chos thams cad dngam no/ sangs rgyas kyi chos gnyis su med par thugs su chud pa mnga' ba'o/ /'das pa dang ma byon pa dang ske/ da meltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad dge ba'i rtsa ba gcig ste/ gnyis su med par thugs su chud pa mnga' ba'o /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi gnyis su med par spyod cing / dngos po gnyis su med pa'i chos kyi dbang phyug gi chos sol/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa bzhugs pa'i 8)chos thams cad la rab tu zhugs 9)pa rnams so/ /bcu gang zhe na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni chos 3 )kyi dbyings gnas pa'i ye shes thugs su chud pa la bzhugs pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni thugs rje chen po mi nyams 31pa la bzhugs pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni smon lam ji lta ba bzhin du 'byung ba la 37—61

bzhugs pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni 'dul ba'i sems can yongs su mi gtong ba la bzhugs pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni dngos po med pa la gnas pa'i chos nyid la bzhugs pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku skal 1 snab mnyam pa tha mi dad cing don yod pa la bzhugs pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni rtag tu mnyam par gzhag napa'i thugs la bzhugs pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni chos thams cad nyams pa med par gzhol ba la bzhugs pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni chags pa med pa'i dgongs pas ri rnam par spyod pa la bzhugs pa'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni chos thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid la 'jug pas grub pa med pa'i yang dag pa'i mtha'i mtshan nyid la bzhugs pa ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa bzhugs pa chos thams cad la zhugs 4pa rnams so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi chos thams cad ma lus par mngon par mkhyen pa rnams te/bcu gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad kyi 'das pa bgrangs 5pa mtha' dag thams cad mngon par mkhyen pa dang / ma 'ongs pa bgrangs 6pa mtha' dag thams cad mngon par mkhyen pa dang / da ltar byung ba bgrangs 7pa mtha' dag thams cad mngon par mkhyen pa dang / tshig gi lam mtha' dag thams cad mngon par mkhyen pa dang / 'jig rten gyi rgyud mtha' dag thams cad mngon par mkhyen pa dang / sems can gyi bsam pa dang shes pa mtha' dag thams cad mngon par mkhyen pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i 37—62

dge ba'i rtsa ba chung 3)ngu dang 'bring dang chen po dang / rnam pa sna tshogs su ri rnam par gnas pa'i mtshan nyid kyi ri dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams la bsam pa tshad med pa yongs su mi gtong la bas sangs rgyas kyi ye shes 'bar bar bya ba dang /yongs su rdzogs par bya ba mtha' dag thams cad mngon par mkhyen pa dang /chos thams cad 'tshang rgya ba'i mkhyen pa mtha' dag thams cad mngon par mkhyen pa dang / 'jig rten gyi rgyud thams cad rnam par dbye ba'i ye shes gzigs pa mtha' dag thams cad mngon par mkhyen pa dang / chos kyi dbyings kyi gzhi 37)myig 'phrul gyi rnam pa lta bur dbye ba thams cad mngon par mkhyen pa ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de gye dag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi 7chos thams cad ma lus par mngon par namakhyen pa'o// // sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo(9/ bam po bzhi7 )pa/ kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi stobs chen po/ stobs dam pa stobs tshad myed pa stobs bdag nyid che ba / stobs thug 31 pa med pa/ stobs mi mnyam nya pa stobs snying po dang ldan pa/stobs mi shigs pa/ stobs 'jig rten thams cad kyis bsam gyis mi khyab pa/stobs sems can thams cad kyis mi 'phrogs nyu pa/ sangs rgyas kyi rgyal mtshan stobs po che/ dpa' bo chen po'i stobs rnams te14/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas kyi sku ni pha rol gyi gnod pa thams cad kyis mi shigs mi chod pa'o / /'jig rten gyi yul thams cad kyis sku che'i dbang po nyams par mi nus pa'o / /'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi bskal pa'i mye'i gdung bas 'tshig par myi nus pa'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams thams cad 'jig par gtogs pa'i 37—63

chu'i phung por 'grongs par myi 'gyur ba'o/ /bdud thams cad dang / bdud kyi sde thams cad dang / lha thams cad kyi dpung dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang / myi ma yin pa thams cad kyi dpung dang ske/ sha za dang / srin po thams cad kyi dpung dang / sems can ma lus pa thams cad kyi dpung gis brgal 1)bar dka' ②ba'o/ /rdo rje ri rab kyi ri tsam gyi'ad char pa dang / khor yug gi ri chen po tsam 'am / stong gsum gyi stong chen po choge tsam gyi rdo rje'i char bab kyang / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ba spu gcig kyang 'gul bar myi 'gyur/ g.yo bar myi 'gyur te/ bag tsha ba'i shas57mi mnga' 'o⑦/ /bzhugs sam bzhengs sam bzhud dam/ gzims kyang rung ste/ spyod lam 'gyur ba med do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa gang na bzhugs pa'i yul de dang de'i 'khor gshedag tu yang de bzhin gshegs pa dgyes na kun tu 'bab par myi 'gyur rol/ /sangs rgyas kyi zham ring larnams la yang gnod par myi 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi hu zibyin gyis brlabs pa'i sems can rnams la yang gnod par mi 'gyur zhing / mi g.yo na de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku lta la51smos kyang ci dgos te/'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi mthu bo che chen po'i stobs sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi chos dang po'o/ /gzhan yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dgyes na/ chos kyi dbyings thams cad kyis klas pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad ri rab kyi ri dang bcas pa/ khor yug dang khor yug chen po'i ri dang bcas pa/ rgya mtsho dang / ri dang nags tshal thibs po dang /37—64

sems can gnas pa'i gnas tha dad pa kun dang bcas pa de lta bu'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i ba spu'i bu ga gcig tu btsud de/phyi ma'i mtha'i ①bskal pa'i mur thug ②par bzhag kyang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabasalgem gtogs par sems can rnams kyis shes par myi nus so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de dag ni de snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams sku'i ba spu'i khung bu gcig gis bzung ste/ phyi ma'i mtha'i babaskal pa'i mur thug par bsnams shing ske/ gshegs sam/ bzhugs sam/ bzhengs sam/ gzims kyang rung ste/de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs skad cig tsam yang skyo ba mi mnga'o/ /chad cing dub par mi 'gyur ro/ /mthu dang stobs la yongs su nyamasalgepar 'gyur ba mi mnga' 'o/ /spyod lam rnam par 'gyur ba mi mnga' 'o/ /6)kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' ni chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad 'dzin kyang skyo ba med do/ /dub pa /med do/ /gnod pa med do/ /med par mi 'gyur ro/ /mi g.yo mi 'byung mi 'jig go/ /de bzhin du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyang ba spu'i khung bu gcig tu 'jig rten kyi khams ma lus pa thams cad bsnams kyang de'i rgyus thugs skad cig tsam du yang mi bde ba'i sku nyams mi 'byung ste/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi mthu bo che chen po'i stobs/ sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi chos gnyis pa'oni/ /gzhan yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams gshegs stabs gcig tu bzhud 1)pas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi mkhams yongs su 'da' zhing dgongs pa /tsho1bskyed pa gcig gis bskal pa tha dad pa'i rim pas7237—65

sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed 1'byung bar namadzad do/ /de lta bur gshegs pas bskal pa 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed du gshegs shing / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi sems kyi rgyud ji snyed pa'i bskal gyipar bzhud de/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi/ 'jig rten gyi khams tsam du khor 4kun tu rgya che zhing yangs pa'i khor 45yug chen po'i rdo rje'i ri dang /sangs rgyas kyi 6)zhing gi 7)rnam pa brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa la bsgresam ripa snyed kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyang / de la bsgres (9)pa de snyed ba spu'i khung bu gcig tu btsud de/ ba spu'i khung bu gcig tu ji lta ba bzhin du/ sku'i ba spu'i khung bu thams cad du btsud de/ ba spu'i khung bu yang sems can thams cad de 1 snyed du gyur la de dag thams cad bsnams te/ de snyed kyi ba spu'i khung bur 11tshul de bzhin du bshams te/ thugs bskyed pa de lta bus/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du rgyu zhing gshegs sam/ phyogs kyi dra 12ba thams cad du rgyu zhing gshegs sam/ nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad du rgyu zhing gshegs sam/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud 'grangs pa sngon gyi mthar gtogs pa nas bzung ste/ phyi ma'i mtha'i bskal pa'i mur thug par/ de bzhin 1lhagashegs pas bskal pa thams cad zad par gyur kyang de bzhin gshegs pa bzhud pa la brtson pa ni nyams par mi 'gyur ro/ /sku nyams 7chung bar mi 'gyur ro/ / dgongs pa rnam 15par 'khrug tshapar mi 'gyur ro/ /ting nge 'dzin nyams par mi 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku yongs su nyams par mi 'gyur te/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi mthu bo che chen po'i 37—66

stobs sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi chos gsum pa'o/ /gzhanas༄1yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni rinabasod snyoms gcig bzhes nas bskal pa brjod du med par skyil gumo krung gcig bcas pas/ nyin mtshan gyi rgyud 49du sngon gyi tshematha' dang / phyi ma'i mtha'i mur gtogs pa'i bskal pa 'das par thubazhugs kyang / sku mi g.yo zhing bde ba'i dam pa la spyod pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi rnam par spyod pa bsam gyis mi khyab par /rnam par spyod kyang / sems can 'ga' tsam la yang sangs rgyas kyi phrin las rgyun 'chad par mi 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku de la 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad yongs su bkod de/'jig rten gyi khams de dag gi sems can gcig gi lus kyang 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang 8brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed tsam du che ba de lta bur gyur la/ sems can gcig gi lus kyi tshad ji tsam pa de tsam gyi lus su sems can thams cad kyang 9gyur la/ sems can de dag re re'i gzugs kyang 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi lcid 1 ji tsam yod pa de tsam du gyur te/ sems can gcig ji ltar 11rtsi ba bzhin du sems can thams cad re re'i lcid 12kyang de tsam du gyur 1 te/ sems can de dag thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i phyag sor gyi rtse mo gcig la/ phyi ma'i mtha'i bskal pa'i mur thug par bsnams te/ phyag sor gyi rtse mo gcig gis ji ltar bsnams pa de bzhin du phyag sor thams cad kyi rtse mo la'ang / de tsam re re bsnams kyang / de'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa la sku mnyel ba'am/ dgongs pa 'dub par mi 'gyur te/ thugs bskyed pa'i cha shas shin tu phra ba gcig tsam du yang sdug bsngal mi bde ba skye bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi 37—67

khams la 'jug pa dang / nam mkha'i dbyings la 'jug pa dang / phyogs kyi dra ba'i rnam pa la 'jug pa re re dang de lta bu la 'jug pa nam mkha'i khams ma lus pa'i dbyings kyis klas pa/ chos kyi dbyings kyi mthas gtugs7pa skra'i rtse mo'i cha shas kyis migazhal ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams la 'jug pa thams cad re re zhing yang / skra'i rtse mo'i cha shas kyis gzhal te/ nam mkha'i dbyings kyis shu kun tu khyab pa thams cad ma lus pa'i skra'i rtse mo'i cha shas kyi tshad kyis nam mkha'i dbyings la 'jug pa thams cad du zhugs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyod lam 'di'i tshul dang / skyil mo krung gcig tu bzhugs pa'i spyod pas/sngon gyi mtha' dang / phyi ma'i mtha'i mur thug pa'i bskal pa zad par mdzad de/bskal pa 'da' bar mdzad cing / bskal pa la rab tu 'jug ste/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi mthu bo che chen po'i stobs sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi chos bzhi pa'o/ /gzhan yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni sku gcig la/ dbu sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed byin gyis rlobarlabs 5nyete/ dbu re re la yangs/sna ljags sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed byin gyis brlabs nas/ de dag re res kyang dbyangs kyi yan lag dang sgra skad kyi gsung / sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed re re brjod de/ chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa'i sems can gyi khams thams cad go bar mdzad cing dbyangs kyi yan lag dang sgra skad kyi gsung re res kyang mdo sde sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed bshad la mdo sde re re la'ang 37—68

chos bstan pa/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang0)brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed rab tu gzhol bar mdzad de/ chos bstan pa gcig las kyang chos kyi tshig dang yi ge sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod tshonidu med pa'i ①rdul shin tu phra ba snyed brjod par gyur la/ chos bstan pa gcig las ji lta ba desnyibazhin du chos bstan pa thams cad las kyang de snyed kyi chos kyi tshig dang yi ge brjod de/ de ltar brjod pas bskal pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang ⑥brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed du rab tu bstan 'dzo/ bskal pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed zad par gyur kyang / da dung gzhan yang bskal pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang 3)brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed du brgyud cing rab tu ston pa'i tshul gyis 1)rnam grangs 'dis bskal pa 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed du rab tu bstan la/ rnam grangs 'di 'dra bas bskal pa 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed zad la sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi spyod pa snyed kyi bskal pa 'das par gyur te/ phyi ma'i mtha'i mur thug pa'i bskal pa zad cing 'das par byas kyang ske/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa chos thams cad snang ba'i 'khor lo bskor ba dang / chos thams cad rab tu shes par bstan cing lung bstan pa dang /the tsom tunyethams cad rab tu gcod pa'i chos kyi /lha'akhor lo bskor ba dang /chos thams cad snang bar byed pa'inyurte/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor 32ba dang /byang chub sems dpa'itsha spyod pa thams cad brjod pa'i rgyun dang ldan pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / ye shes kyi nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor chen po'i rgyan dang 37—69

ldan pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / 'gro ba thams cad ma lus par 1ye shes kyi sgron ma chen pos brgyan 2pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / so so yang dag par rig 4pa dang / mi 'jigs pa chen pos brgyan pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba rgyun mi 'chad der/ sangs rgyas kyi sku gcig gi byin gyi rlabs kyis /ji lta ba de 7bzhin du chos kyi 'khor lo'i sprin chen po dpe thams cad la / dpe med par rab tu 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad kyi nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mthas 9gtugs pa skra'i rtse 0mo'i cha shas kyis gzhal ba 1ma lus pa thams cad chags pa med par rnam par dbye bas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa snyed kyi sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa de snyed de snyed du dgongs pa'i 12skad cig re re la phyi ma'i mtha'i mur thug pa'i bskal par sprul pa mdzad cing / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa'i sku thams cad las de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku re re la'ang de snyed de snyed kyi dbu mnga' bar 'gyur 1 la gzhung de bzhin du dbu khore re la yang de snyed de snyed kyi ljags tshomanga' bar gyur te/ ljags tsire re las kyang de snyed de snyed kyi dbyangs kyi yan lag dang / sgra skad kyi gsung 1 chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa'i sems can gyi khams thams cad go bar mdzad par byung 1 la/ dbyangs kyi yan lag dang / sgra skad kyi gsung 19de dag re res kyang de snyed de snyed kyi mdo sde bshad par gyur la mdo sde de dag re re la yang de snyed de snyed kyi/ chos bstan pa la rna rab tu gzhol bar na mdzad de/ chos bstan 22pa de dag de /re re las kyang ske/ de snyed de snyed kyi chos kyi tshig dang yi ge 2 brjod par gyur la/ chos kyi tshig dang yi ge de dag re res kyang chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad dbyangs 37—70

kyis0)rgyas par bkang ste/ sems can gyi khams ma lus pa thams cad go bar mdzad kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbyangs la dub pa (0mi mnga' ste/ nyams par mi 'gyur la thogs pa mi mnga' zhing dma' bar mi 'gyur te6)/ de lta bu'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor geyang bskal pa phyi ma'i mtha'i mur thug pa'i bar du rgyun 'chad par mi 'gyuralogate/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi mthu bo che chen po'i stobs sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi 6)chos lnga pa'o/ /gzhan yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni thugs dpal gyi be'us brgyan pa / rdo rje chen po ltar shin tu brtan 3)par grub pa mnga' ba dag ste/ de dag byang chub kyi shing drung du byon na bdud sdig to can gyis sems can thams cad snyed kyi bdud kyi sde/ gzugs sna tshogs can shin tu mi sdug pa/ 'jigs 'jigs ltar 'dug pa/ rab tu snang ba'i gzugs can 'jig rten thams cad shin tu 'jigs pa'i gzugs can rab tu skyi g.ya' ba bskyed 2pa'i gzugs can/bdud shin tu mi sdug pa'i gzugs 'chang 9rib rab btsog nyi )por 'jigs pa11 /'jigs pa chen po skyed nyi pa/ 'gro ba thams cad gsod pa/ 'jig rten thams cad phung bar byed pa de lta bu sha stag gis/ byang chub kyi shing drung dang /chos kyi dbyings thams cad dang / nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mthar thug par gang bar gzigs kyang byang chub kyi shing drung na bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la bsnyengs nya pa mi mnga' 'o/ /bag tsha ba mi mnga' 'o/ /ba spu gcig kyang g.yo ba med do/ / dgongs pa'i nyi cha shas 7shin tu phra ba 'ga' tsam gyis kyang de ltar rnam pa tha dad pa'i gzugs la mtshan ma rnam pa tha dad pa 8'dzin pa mi mnga' ste/ shin tu brtan no1 / /g.yo ba med do/ /mi sgul to/ /'gyur 37—71

ba myed do/ /rnam par rtog pa med do/ /shin tu zhi'o①/ /bsnyengasalgepa dang bag tsha sarab thams cad dang shin tu bral lo/ /sdug pa dang khong khro ba shin tu spangs 4)so/ /sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa rgyun mi 'chad dege/ byams pa chen po'i stobs dang ldan pa'o/ /thugs rje chen po'i gnas kyi dbang po'i shin tu dben pa'o/ /bag tsha ba mi mnga' ba'i dgongs pa nidang ldan pa'o/ / dgongs pa 9shin tu brtan kyi )zhing nyams pa mi mnga' ba'o/ / tshur zil gyis mi non la phar zil gyis gnon pa'i dgongs pa nyuskyedang ldan pa ste/ bdud thams cad dang / bdud kyi ris su gtogs pa'i lha thams cad dang / bdud kyi sde thams cad shin tu zil gyis gnon to/ /shin tu spa 'gongapha/)ngo / /de ltar zil gyis 1 rimanan te/ spa gong 8ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa la skyabs tshol lo/ /de dag la'ang bcom ldan 'das de dag cho 'phrul chen po gsum gyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'dul skab mdzad pa nye bar bsgrubs te⑩/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ro/ /'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi mthu bo che chen po'i stobs sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi chos drug pa'o/ /gzhan yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi gsung nya thogs pa med pa ni 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa de dang / de dag thams cad du sems can rnams 'dul ba'i don gyi nyusnyernam par dmigs par kun tu khyab pa 38'byung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung )de ni ri rnams la thogs pa myed do/ /ri rab la thogs pa med do/ /rin po che'i ri51la thogs pa myed do / /khor zhu yug dang khor yug ri rtechen po la thogasamanyepa med do/ /lha'i khyim la thogs pa med do/ /klu'i khyim la thogs pa med do/ /gnod sbyin gyi khyim la 37—72

thogs pa med do/ /dri za'i khyim la thogs pa med do/ /lha ma yin gyi khyim la thogs pa med do/ /nam mkha' lding0)gi khyim la thogs pa med do/ /mi'am ci'i khyim la thogs pa med do/ /lto 'phye chen po'i khyim la thogs pa med do/ /mi dang mi ma yin pa'i khyim la thogs pa med do/ /gal te brgya la 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na yod pa'i sgra chen po 'jig rten rnam pa snotha dad pa'i sgras/'jig rten gyi khams thams cad gang ste/ ca co 'dres par gyur kyang / de la ri de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs〈gepa'i gsung ni 'dul ba'i sems can rnams kyi rna ba'i rnam par dmigs pa la bsgribasapotshopa med pa yin te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung ༅'ba' shigashede dag gi rna ba'i ⑧rnam par dmigs pa la/ lhang nge lham me lhan ne ste go bar mdzad pa'i tshig dang / yi ge rnams kyang rlag par mi 'gyur te/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi mthu bo che chen po'i stobs sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi chos bdun pa'o/ /gzhan yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi thugs /1)ni chags pa mi mnga' ba ste/bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med par yongs su sbyangs 7pa'o/ /'das pa dang ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang / rgyan gcig tu gyur pa'o/ /rnyog pa med cing rnam par dang (1ste shin tu gsal ba'o/ /bdag gi zhes bya ba mi mnga' ba'o/ /chos thams cad la mi gnas pa'o/ /nang na gnas pa ma yin pa'o/ /phyi rol na gnas pa ma yin pa'o/ /ma skyes pa'o/ /dmigs pa thams cad kyis dben pa'o / /zhi zhes hurteganas nyi med pa'o/ /rtsom pa med pa'o/ /'du shes sna tshogs thams cad la mi gnas pa'o/ /dngos po'i rnam par rtog pa thams cad 'gags 37—73

pa'o / /rang bzhin gyis 1'od dang zhing gsal ba'o/ /yongs su dag pa'o/ /dmigs pa dang yid la bya ba 5thams cad dang gum 'dres pa'o/ /chos thams cad nyon mongs pa med pa'i yul dang ldan pa'o/ /yang dag pa'i mtha' 'dod chags dang bral bas dag pa'o/ /chos kyi dbyings shin tu bstan pa'i mthar thug 4pa'o / /chos kyi dbyings kun nas mi zad pa dang ldan pa'o/ /'du shes kyi rnam pa thams cad kyi tshad dang tshad med pa dang bral ba'o/ /'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas kyi brjod pa thams cad 'gags pa'o/ /tshig 5 gi lam gyis brjod du med pa'i mthar thug 6pa'i yul lo/ /mi zad pa dang chags pa med pa'i dbyings kyi mthar thug 75pa'o/ /ye shes sngon du 'gro ba'o/ /stobs bcu'i rgyan du gyur pa'o/ /chos thams cad kyis 8rnam par dag pa'o/ /thabs mkhas pas byung 9ba'o/ /chos sna tshogs dang chos du ma dang / chos thams cad shin tu bstan pa dang mi 'gal ba'o/ /dus gsum du nyu ritha dad pa med pa'o/ /chos kyi dbyings thams cad du 11chos gzhi med pa thams cad kyi mnga' ba'i nyu pha rol tu phyin pa brnyes 1 pa'o/ /chos thams cad la mnga' ba'i 'byung gnas dang /mdzod du gyur pa'o/ /chos kyi tshul thams cad khudagongs pa khyad par du rmongs pa med pa'o/ /zhing gi rgyud du gtogs pa thams cad dang phyogs kyi dra ba dang /rgyud 'byam 1 klas pa ma lus pa thams cad la mi gnas pa brtan 7zhing mi g.yo la nyams pa med pa'i ye shes kyis rab tu gzigs pa/ chos ma lus pa thams cad kyi mthar thug pa zag pa thams cad yongs su zad pa dgongs pa 1 rnam par grol zhing zag pa mi mnga' ba dang / shes rab rnam par grol bas shin tu rnam par grol ba yang dag pa'i mtha' mi zad pas klas pa/ chags pa med par rnam par 37—74

spyod pa rtag tu mnyam par bzhag 1)pa dus gsum thams cad du bsgribs pa ri snye/med par 'byung ba/ sems can thams cad kyi dus gsum gyi sems dang spyod pa thams cad ma lus par thugs skad cig gis rab tu mkhyen pa ste/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnamasam kyi mthu bo che chen po'i stobs sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi chos brgyad pa'o/ /gzhan yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi chos kyi sku ni sku mi mnga' ba ste/ rang bzhin gcig tu gyur pa〈desangs rgyas thams cad kyi yul tshad med pa'i sku'o/ /mtha' dang dbus 5)med par yongs su grub pa'i sku'o/ /'jig rten thams cad kyis cigazad par mi nus pa'i sku'o/ /khams gsum pas gos pa med pa'i sku'o/ /brtenam7)pa'i skus nirnam par dmigs pa'o/ /lhag pa'i bsam pa dang rjes su dran pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyis 99)sku'i rang bzhin yang dag par ston 1 )pa'o/ /bden pa med pa dang ske/ brdzun /stopa med pa'i sku mnyam pa nyid kyis 12yongs su dag pa'o/ /chos kyi sku bzhud pa dang byon pa med pa'i sku'o/ /'dus ma byas pas 'jig 912pa med pa'i sku'o/ /mtshan nyid med pas mtshan nyid gcig pa'i chos kyi sku'i rang bzhin rnam/ /yul na mi gnas pa dang phyogs na mi gnas pa'i sku'o/ /ma lus pa thams cad kyi lus kyi sku'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi khyu mchog gis khamathu phyung ba dang / rnam par 'phrul pa mtha' yas pa'i masku'i rang bzhin no/ /lus thams cad du yongs su gzhol nyu5ba'i sku sna tshogs su rnam par dmigs pa mdzad kyang chos kyi sku'i tshul gyi rjes su 'brang ba'o/ /ye shes kun tu snang ba'i snying po can no/ /sku yongs kyi mdzod du gyur pa'o/ /chos kyi dbyings rnam pa tha dad pa med pa shin tu bstan pa'i sku'o/ /khams 17ma lus pa thams cad rgyas par 'gengs pas/ kun tu 37—75

khyab pa'i sku'i rang bzhin no/ /mi g.yo mi dgongs pa'i sku rnam par dag pa'o/ /yod pa 'ang 1ma yin med pa'ang ma yin pa'i tshul dang tshul ma yin par rab tu brjod pa'i sku'o/ /sems can gyi mos pa rnam pa sna tshogs 'dul bar gyur pa'iphusku'ol/ /'gags pa'ang ma yin ma 'gags pa'ang ma yin pas 'dul ba ston pa'i sku'o/ /riyon tan rin po che thams cad yang dag par 'byungakhebs shin tu 'phags pa'i sku'o/ /chos thams cad sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi de bzhin nyid du yang dag par bsgrubs ⑧pa'i sku'o/ /rang bzhin gyis rab tu zhi zhing bsgribasalgepa med pa'i mthar thug pa'i sku'o/ /thogs pa mi mnga' bas chos thams cad thugs su chud pa'i sku'o/ /thams cad kyi rjes su song ba'i chos kyi dbyings kyis〈pernam par dag cing 'jig rtenaman)thams cad dus0shin tu rnam par phye ba'i sku'o/ /phyir mi ldog cing bsgribs 0pa mi mnga' la/ sangs rgyas kyi rnam par thar pas ye shes thams cad 11rjes su 'brang zhing 3ge/ yang 3nyedag par gzhol bas thugs su chud pa'i sku stepa/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi mthu77bo che chen po'i stobs sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi chos dgu pa'o8/ /gzhan yang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi ye shes mnyam pa med pa dang /mnyam pa ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 3 thugs su chud pa ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad kyis /shebyung ba'o/ /mngon par 'grub yipa'i spyod pa khyad par du 'phags pa'i smon lam dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pas rnam par dag pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad kyis yongs su rdzogs par byas pa'o rme/ /tha dad pa med pa'o/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad kyis byung 31ba'o/ /byang chub 37—76

sems dpa'i spyod pa rgya mtsho'i spyod pa'i tshul thams cad thugs su chud pa'o/ /smon lam dang spyod pa chen pos7yongs su mi dog⑧pa'o/ /spyod pa thams cad mi mnyam pa med pas yongs su rdzogs par byas pa'o/ /spyod pa'i stobs la thubs par dka' ba'i spyod pa thams cad kyis mngon par byungasnyiba'o/ /spyod pa thams cad kyis rnam par dag pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa legs par spyad pas rgyud dma' ba med pa'o/ /sangs rgyasamamathams cad kyis7tshad med par spyod pa'o/ /ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyis7spyod yul mtha' yas pa'o lam thams cad kyis rab tu brjod pa ma yin pa'o/ /lam gyi yul med pa'o/ /lam thams cad la terab tu zhugs〈nyepa'o/ /ye shes dam pa'i stobs kyi0tshul mkhyen pa'o/ /bag tsha ba mi mnga' bas chos kyi char 'bebs pa'i 'khor lo dang ldan pa'o/ /dge ba dris pa dang ma dris pa la rjes su 'thun7pa'i chos kyi tshul ston pa mkhyen pa'o/ /mnyam pa med pa dang mnyam pas shin tu dag pa'o/ /sku dang thugs dang gsung7gi yang dag par spyod pa rnams la phrin las gsum yongs su dag pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi bsgom pas brnyes pa'o⑩/ / sangs rgyas kyi rnam par spyod pas brnyes pa'o/ /tunyede bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs thams cad bskyed7)pa'i don du sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi du ) mdzad pa thams cad rab tu 'byung ba'o/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i gnas kyi bstan pa tshad med pa'i gnas rtsa ba med pa dang ldan pa'o/ /mngon par shes pa'i ye shes thams cad kyi51mthar thug par mi 'gyur ba'o/ /'jig rten gyi sems kyi zhu)spyod pa'i shes pa thams cad kyis bsam gyis mi khyab pa'o4)/ /chos thams cad ma lus par mkhyen cing gzigs pas sems can thams cad yongs su skyob pa'o/ /dus gsum yangs pa 37—77

thams cad kyi tshul shin tu phra ba mtha' dang dbus med pa ma lus par mkhyen pa'o / /'jig rten las 'das pa'i 1don mkhyen pa'i phyir phra ba'i ye shes thugs su chud pas na'ajig rten gyi khams ma lus pa thams cad rnam par dag pa phyir mi ldog pa'i ye shes kyis sangs rgyas kyi phrin las brjod du med pa 'jig rten thams cad du sbyor ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi sku 'grangs 4pa thams cad thugs su chud pa'i ye shes kyis yi ge med pa'i chos thugs su chud pa'o/ /yi ge sna tshogs rnam par phye ba dang / yi ge thams cad smos shing brjod pa mkhyen pas/brjod du med pa thugs su chud pa'o/ /kun tu bzang po'i ye shes kyi 5dge ba'i rtsa ba'i 6chos spyad pa thams cad rnam par dag pa'o/ /dam bcas pa'i tshul bzhin du sems can thams cad kyi lus dang skye mched ji ltar dgongs pa'i 7skad cig dang ldan pa'i shes rab kyis /chos thams cad khong du chud par ston pa mkhyen pa'o/ /chos thams cad kyi don du chos yongs su btang zhing 9rim gror byas pas 10thugs su chud pa'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams thams cad ma lus par yul du gyur pa'o/ /chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa 11thams cad yul du gyur pa'o/ /dus gsum thams cad la dgongs pa 12skad cig gis chags pa med par mkhyen cing thugs su chud pa'i yul dang ldan pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sangs rgyas 'byung ba ma lus par yul du gyur pa'o/ /'jigs pa med par 'dul ba thams cad yul du gyur pa'o/ /thams cad kyi rjes su song zhing rnam par dag pa'i yul thams cad mngon par sangs rgyas pa'o/ /sa mtshams dmed cing thug pa med 1 pa'i mngon par shes pa rnam par sangs rgyas pa'o/ /sems can thams cad kyi sems dang yid dang rnam par shes pa'i rnam pa dus gsum du 37—78

brjod pa ma lus pa thams cad dgongs pa'i 17skad cig gis mkhyen cing thugs su chud pa'o/ /sems can gyi rnam pa thams cad la sa5gematshams ma bcad pa'o//'jig rten gyi khams kyi rnam pa thams cad la mu med pa'o/ /dus gsum gyi rnam pa thams cad la mtha' yas pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi khyu mchog gi mthu phyung ba'i rnam pa thams cad la tshad med pa'o/ /shes bya'i rnam pa thams cad la lhag ma ma lus pa ste/ de dag thams cad lhag pa (med par mngon par sangs rgyas pas sangs rgyas kyi ye shes sangs rgyas kyi rdzu 'phrul dang rnam par 'phrul pas byung ba thams cad thugs su chud pa dang / mkhyen pa thams cad rgyun 'chad 4pa med de / de la sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams sangs rgyas kyi khyu mchog gi mthu phyung5geba'i skus/ mtha' dang dbus med par spyod pa yin/ chags pa med pa'i dgongs pas shi spyod pas mtha' dang dbus med par spyod pa yin/ thugs rje 7chen po'i sbyor bas dus thams cad du rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par chos bstan pa la spyod pas mtha' dang dbus med par naspyod pa yin te/ 'di ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ri9kyi sangs rgyas kyi mthu bo che chen po'i stobs sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi chos bcu pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi 1 tshomathu bo che chen po'i stobs sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi chos rnams te/ 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang /da ltar byung ba'i sems can thams cad dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis 17bsam gyis lha mi khyab cing dpag tu mi 12nus pa dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di thudag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi thogs pa mi mnga' ba rnams te/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni dga' 37—79

ldan gyi tshe ji srid par bzhugs nas 'pho ba la thogs pa mi mnga' 'o sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni zla ba bcus bltams0)pa bstan pa la thogs pa mi mnga' 'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mngon par 'byung b.rashedagyes pa'i dgongs pas da zhimangon par 'byung ba la thogs pa mi mnga' 'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni byang chub kyi shing drung du bzhugs nas sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad mngon par 'tshang rgya ba lashethogs pa mi mnga' 'o//sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni dgongs pa'i〈skad cig gis sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad mngon par sangs rgyas nas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa thams cad yongs su bstan pa la thogs pa mi mnga' 'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni dus ⑥bzhin du 'dul ba rnams la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ④ba la thogs pa mi mnga' 'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni dge ba'i rtsa ba ji ltar bskyed pa'i tshul bzhin du dus la bab par bshad cing lung bstan pa la thogs pa mi mnga' 'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni dus la bab pa'i tshul bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi phrin las mdzad pa la thogs pa mi mnga' 'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni byang chub sems dpa' yongs su grub pa rnamasal lung bstan pa la thogs pa mi mnga' 'o/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni skad cig gcig tu sems can thams cad kyis thonadri ba yongs su dris pa skad cig gcig gis lung bstan pa la thogs pa mi mnga' ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi thogs pa mi mnga' 'o⑩/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi de bzhin 37—80

gshegs pa mthong ma thag tu myur du 'byung ba'i chos rnams te/ bcu gang zhe na/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mthong ma thag tu sems can rnams myur du ngan song dang bral bar 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mthong ma thag tu sems can rnams myur du bsod nams yongs su rdzogs pa 'thob0)par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mthong ma thag tu sems can rnams myur du dge ba'i rtsa ba zhu)yongs su smin par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mthong ma thag tu sems can rnams myur du mtho ris su skye ba yongs su dag pa thobar par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mthong ma thag tu sems can rnams nisemyur du yid gnyis dang la/ nem nur yang dag par bstsal ba thobalgepar 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mthong ma thag tu sems can rnams myur du byang chub kyi sems bskyed nas phyir mi ldog pa 'thob par 'gyurasho'u)te/ sems can mos pa yangs pa dang ldan pa sangs rgyas kyis 'dul ba las byang chub tu sems ma bskyed pa rnams kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed do / /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dzo ni mthong ma thag tu skyon med par ma 'das pa ⑨dmyigs pa'i lta ba can gyi sems can hu )rnams myur du skyon med par〈tshe/'da' ba'i rgyu rab tu 'dzin to/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mthong ma thag tu sems can rnams myur du 'jig rten pa72dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dbang po rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mthong ma thag tu sems can rnams myur du bsgribasatshwa pa thams cad byang ba thob 7par 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams 37—81

ni mthong ma thag tu sems can rnams myur du snang ba 'thob 11cing mi 'jigs pa zhum pa med pa'i spobs pa rab tu rtsom sten/ kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa mthong ma thag tu myur du 'byung ba'i chos rnams so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi rjes su dran pa rnam par dag pa ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni ri sngon gyi sbyor bas kyang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis 4rjes su dran par bya ba yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni spyod pa rnam par dag pas kyang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis 5rjes su dran par bya ba yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs pas kyang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis rjes su dran par bya ba yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni smon lam chen po yongs su rdzogs pas kyang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ne rjes su dran par 7ribya ba yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni yang dag par bsgrubs pas kyang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis narjes su dran par bya ba yin/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni sngon gyi mthar sangs rgyas kyi tshangs par spyod pa la spyad pas kyang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ri9rjes su dran par bya ba yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni mngon par 'tshang rgya ba'i sgo nas kyang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis rjes su dran par bya ba yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni gzugs kyi sku tshad med mu med pas kyang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis 1 rjes su dran par bya ba yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni sangs rgyas kyi yul gyis rnam par 'phrul pa tshad med mu med 37—82

pas kyang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis 71)rjes su dran par bya ba yin/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni stobs bcu dang mi 'jigs pas kyang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis rjes su dran par bya ba yin te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di chadag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi rjes su dran pa rnam par dag pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi rnam par spyod pa ste/ bcu gang zhe na/'di ltar chos kyi bdabyings thams cad dang / dus gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyi sems sna tshogs dang / sems du ma dang spyod pa dang g.yo ba'i rgyud thams cad ma lus pa dgongs pa ④gcig gis thugs su chud pa dang / dus gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyi las dang las kun nas blangs pa sna tshogs cha 95ma cho dgu rnam pa tha dad pas mngon par 'gro zhing nye bar stsogs 6)pa mang nyung dang ske/ rnam par smin pa tha dad par 7 ma lus par dgongs pa gcig nigis thugs su chud pa dang / chos kyi dbyings thams cad kyi sems can gyi rigs 7sna tshogs dang / sems can gyi rigs 1 du ma'i 11sems can ma lus pa thams cad 'dul ba'i dus ji bzhin du yongs su bstan 12pa'i cho 'phrul dang rjes su bstan nyi pa'i cho 'phrul dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul gyis byin gyi rlabs 'iyang dag par bstan pa tsham lus par /'thugs su chud pa dang / chos kyi dbyings thams cad dang / phyogs dra ba'i rgyud thams cad dang / 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud thams cad kyi sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi mtshan ma bzung 1 ste/sangs rgyas bstan pa dang / skye ba dang rnam par dbye ba ma lus par thugs su chud pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams 1 thams cad kyi sems can rnams kyi bsam 37—83

pa ji lta ba dang / mos pa ji lta ba dang 'dul ba ji lta ba bzhin du rnam pa tha dad pa tshad med par skad cig du sangs rgyas 3)bstan pa dang / rnam par dmigs par bya ba dang / byin gyis brlab57pa ma lus par thugs su chud pa dang ske/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi sems can pha rol gyi bsam pa la/sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabasam yang dag par bstan pa ma lus pasamathugs su chud pa dang / chos kyi dbyings thams cad kyi sems can rnams 'dul ba ji lta ba bzhin du nye bar len pa med pa'i sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur bar(sri/ gdams ngag dang rjes su bstan pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba bstan4)pa ma lus par thugs su chud 7pa dang / chos kyi dbyings thams cad kyi sems can thams cad kyi thams cad du 'gro ba dang / de dang der 'gro ba'i lam ma lus par dgongs pa'i 8skad cig gcig gis thugs su chud pa dang / chos kyi dbyings thams cad kyi sems can rnams kyis/ sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa 7phyogs thams cad du btang ba'i tshul ma lus par dgongs pa'i 0skad cig gcig gis thugs su chud pa dang / chos kyi dbyings thams cad kyi sems can rnams kyirwa 1mos pa dang / sems kyi tshad ji lta ba bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi sku kha dog mu med pa dbyibs mtha' yas pa bstan pa ma lus par dgongs pa'i /2skad cig gcig gis thugs su chud pa ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi rnam par spyod pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi ting nge 'dzin tshad med bsam gyis rmo/nyemi khyab pa rnams te/ bcu 37—84

gang zhe na/ 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni chos thams cad la rtag tu mnyam par bzhag kyang chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad kyi sems can rnams la'ang skad cig gcig tu chos ston pa mdzad do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad kyi0)sems can thams cad la mnyam par bzhag rngo )kyang skad cig gcig gis sems can gyi khams sna tshogs ②rnam pa tha byadad pa rnams kyang bdag med pa'i mtha' la gnas par yongs su ston to/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad kyi dus gsum la mnyam par bzhag57kyang dgongs pa'i7skad cig gcig gis cha shas la'ang mnyam par bzhag cing rnam par spyod do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad kyi phyogs 'byam tshuklas pa'i dra ba thams cad kyi sangs rgyas kyi (bzhing gi 6)rgyud dang nyu )/rnam pa thams cad la mnyam par bzhag kyang mi zad pa'i zhing gi mtha' la'ang bzhugs shing rnam par spyod do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad kyi 3skyesangs rgyas kyi sku mu med pa la mnyam par bzhag kyang 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyis kyang sangs rgyas kyi sku sna hu tshogs rnam par dmigs par yang dag par ston pa mdzad do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad sku dang gsung dang thugs kyisatshwa yongs su rgyas par rtag tu mnyam par bzhag 7kyang sems can thams cad kyi sems 'byung ba'i mdzod sna tshogs la yang mos pa dang yid la byed pa ji lta ba bzhin du rnam par spyod do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad kyi chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin la rtag tu mnyam 37—85

par bzhag kyang 'dod chags dang bral ba'i mtha'i mur thug pa la bzhugs pa yang yongs su mi gtong tsho1 ngo / /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad kyi 'jig rten thams cad kyi rten (snyepa la rtag tu mnyam par bzhag kyang dgongs pa 4)skad cig (3)gis rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba brjod pa yang rab tu ston to/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad kyi 'jig rten pa dang 'jig rten las 'das pa 'byam 6skuklas pa la rtag tu mnyam par bzhag medakyang dgongs pa ⑧skad cig 9gis sems can thams cad la sangs rgyas mu med pa bstan pa rnam par bkod 1 ripa'i tshul mu med pas 31sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyun mi gcod do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad du bsgribs 12pa med par rtag tu mnyam par bzhag kyang dgongs pa /rnyeskad cig nya dīgis sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyang rtogs par thugs su chud cing sangs rgyas kyi rnam par thar pa mu med pa'i 7pha rol tu phyin pa'i mchog brnyes par bzhugs te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi tshating nge 'dzin tshad med pa 1 bsam gyis 18mi khyab pa rnams so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi rnam par thar pa rnams te/bcu gang zhe na/ rdul shin tu phra ba gcig la sangs rgyas skye ba brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa yongs su bstan pa'i rnam par thar pa dang / rdul shin tu phra ba gcig la chos kyi 'khor lo brjod du med pa'i yang 3)brjod du 3 rimed pa bskor ba yongs su bstan pa'i rnam par thar pa dang rdul shin tu phra ba gcig la 37wa 86

sems can yongs su smin par bya ba dang / gdul ba brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa yongs su bstan pa'i rnam par thar pa dang 1/ rdul shin tu phra ba gcig la zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa yongs su bstan pa'i rnam par thar pa dang / rdul shin tu phra ba gcig latshanano'adas pa dang ma byon pa dang ske/ da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas skye ba thams cad yongs su bstan pa'i rnam par thar pa dang rdul shin tu phra ba gcig la 'das pa dang ma byon ripa dang da ltar byung ba'i zhing gi rgyud yongs su bstan pa'i rnam par thar pa dang / rdul shin tu phra ba gcig la 'das pa dang ma byon pa dang da ltar byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdzu 'phrul dang / rnam par 'phrul pa yongs su bstan pa'i rnam par thar pa dang / rdul shin tu phra ba gcig la 'das pa dang / ma byon gepa dang da ltar byung ba'i sems can gyi khams thams cad yongs su bstan pa'i rnam par thar pa dang / rdul shin tu phra ba gcig la 'das pa dang ma byon pa dang da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas kyi phrin las thams cad yongs su bstan pa'i rnam par thar pa ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das gernams kyi rnam par thar pa'o/ / shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo sangs rgyas phal po che zhes bya ba las 6risangs rgyas kyi chos bsam gyis 7mi khyab pa 8bstan pa'i le'u ste sum cus dgu pa'o// // sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdonyi tsho/ bam po lnga 11pa/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos mtshan rgya mtsho brjod du med 12pa'i don du byang chub sems dpa' de dag la smras pa/ kye rgyal ba'i 37—87

sras dag de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu la mi chen po'i mtshan chos kyi rgyan rin po che sna tshogs sum cu nye rtsa gnyis mnga' bas de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu de ni 'khor kun 5)nas 'od zer gyi dra ba geshin tu 'phro ba'i sprin rab tu ④'byung zhing rgyas par gang ba 45ste/ de la myi chen po'i mtshan rin po che'i 4)dang po dbu'i dbu mtshams 7rin rin po che sna tshogs thams cad kyi rgyal po (kyilas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du snang ba bkye bas/ dpal gyis7yongs su rgyas shing yan lag dang nying lag thams cad nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprin rnam par bkye ba yongs su 'khyil pa'i klong gi dbyibs kyisal) phyogs thams cad 'od kyis rnam par snang ba zhes bya ba mnga' ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi dbu la 'phro ba'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor glog 11gi phreng nyi ba lta bur 'byung bas/ phyogs mtshams thams cad du de bzhin gshegs pa 1gesnying po byang chub tu bzhugs pa ston cing thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi nam mkha'i sprin kun tu 'dal bas yichos kyi dbyings kyi gzhi de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan rin po che'i rgyal po sna tshogs mdzod spu g.yas phyogs 7su yongs su 'khyil pa'i dbyibs las gser gyi kha dog bzang por 'od zer 'bar bar 'jig rten gyi khams su byung ba'i tso'od kyis chos kyi dbyings thams cad dumo de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan gsal ba'i 'od kyi sprin ces bya ba mnga' ba dang the de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu la rin po che'i 'od kyi klong 19g.yas phyogs su yongs su 'khyil pa/ chos kyi dbyings ri )thams cad dang ske/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du de bzhin gshegs pa'i bsod nams dang ye shes kyi sgron ma snang bas/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho thams cad du sangs rgyas kyi sprin rnam par 'dal 21ba/ byang chub sems dpa'i mchog rnams 37—88

la snang bas chos kyi dbyings rgyas par khyab pa'i sprin ces bya ba mnga' ༅ba dang dushe/de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan gser yid du 'ong ba'i sprin sna tshogs kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i khyu mchog gi mthu phyung ba 55)rab tu 'bar bas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'od zer rnam par snang bar byas pas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing bsam gyis mi khyab pa snang bar bstan pa'i 'od kyi sprin ces bya ba mnga' ba dngasaX/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu la de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan rin po che be+e ḍūr+ya'57'od zer dang / me tog gi mdog gis chos kyi dbyings thams cad snang bar rnam par 'phrul pa'i sprin nor bu rin po che'i 6)rgyal po'i mtshan nyid lta bu'i (medabu skra rin po che sna tshogs snang ba'i mtshan nyid kyi 'od chags pas/phyogs thams cad rnam par snang bar byed pan / sangs rgyas kyi sngon gyi dka' thub dang / dpal gyi ye shes las rnam pa de lta bur 9byung ba'i rin po che'i 'od zer rab tu bkye ba'i sprin ces bya ba mnga' ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu la de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan dang / 1 rin po che'i 'od zer g.yas phyogs su 'khyil zhing nyu1'phro bas byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par 'phrul pa rin po che'i cod pan gyi 'od de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs kyis 1rtarnam par rgyas pas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du rin po che'i 1lha'od tshad med par de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi rang bzhin gyis rnam par 'phrul pa yang dag par ston pa'i sprin ces bya ba mnga' ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi dbu tshal de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan rin po che rnam par 'phrul pas/ nor bu rin po che rgya mtshos bkye ba'i 'od dang / 'od zer dri ma med par dirab tu 'phros pas byang chub sems dpa'i chos bstan pa rgya mtsho rnam par snang bar tsha'adas pa dang / ma byon pa 37—89

dang ske/ da ltar byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi ye shes kyi7rgya mtsho shin tu yangs pas/ chos kyi dbyings kun tu de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsungasagi sprin 'byung ba zhes bya ba mnga' ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu la rin po che'i rgyal po sems kyi rgyal po dang / in+t+ra nī la zhe las 'od bkye ba g.yas phyogs su 'khyil pas 'jig rten gyi khams dang / chos kyi dbyings 9)thams cad du snang ba'i byang chub sems dpa'i 'od 'phro ba sgron ma'i sprin de bzhin gshegs pa thams 5cad kyi yon tan rgya mtsho rab tu sgrog du ripas 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho thams cad du 7ring ro 'byin cing sangs rgyas kyi stobs (8༄yongs su dag pa/ rgya mtsho dang sangs rgyas rgya mtsho 'byin pa'i sprin 1)shin tu yangs pa'i 'od ces bya ba mnga' ba dang / 3 )de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan rin po che'i me tog sna tshogs dang —/ rin po che'i rgyal po bai ḍūr+ya'i 31'od zer rin po che nyurtethams cad kyi 'od zer kun tu 'byung ba'i dra ba mngon par 'phags pa las/ chos kyi lus dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i 1 ri'ajig rten gyi khams thams cad dang /phyogs rgya mtshor de bzhin gshegs pa'i sa yang dag par ston cing / sangs rgyas kyi stobs chos kyi dbyings la mngon tu gyur pa rab tu ston par bzhugs pa/sems can thams cad la yongs su ston pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sa tshad med mu med par 1 yang dag par 'phags shing yongs su dag la dri ma med pa yongs su mnan te/ rin po che thams cad kyi 'od kun tu snang ba'i rang bzhin rab tu bkye ba'i 'od zer dkyil 'khor gyi sprin ces bya ba mnga' ba dang / 8de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan 'jig rten gyi khams tshad med pa na bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi mtshan rin po che las 'od rab tu bkye bas 8zhing 37—90

thams cad kun nas yog cing bsgribs 17pa med de/ chos kyi dbyings thams cad du zhusangs rgyas kyi gsung gerin po che'i me tog shin tu rgyas pa'i 'od zer 'phro ba rab tu bkye bas6)/ chos kyi rgya mtsho chen po rab tu sbyar ba las/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad kyi snying po dang snang ba can gyi sprin langs pa'i 'od ces bya ba mnga' ba dang / zhe de bzhin 6cigashegs pa'i mtshan rin po che be+e ḍūr+ya 3)dang / in+d+ra nī rinal dang rdo rje mang po las nor bu rin po che rnam par bton tsa)te/ rab tu bkram pa'i kha dog mtha' yas pa'i 'od rnam par dag pabo / rin po che be+e ḍūr+ya'i 31'od kun tu 'byung ba las sgra skad rgya mtsho thams cad kyis chos kyi dbyings su sangs rgyas kyi snang ba rnam par ston pa'i chos rgya mtsho'i ye shes sangs rgyas sprul pa'i 'od kun tu 'gyed pa'i sprin rab tu snang ba zhes bya ba mnga' ba dang sangs rgyas kyi dbu la de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan rin po che'i 'od 3gegayas phyogs su 'phro ba'i me tog rin po che'i lhab lhub kyis brgyan pa hu 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po byang chub kyi rgyan gyi sprin mngon par 'thon pa/ chos kyi dbyings dang 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du74chos rnam par dag pa 15ste/ bskal pa thams cad du rnam par thar pas tshachos kyi dbyings rnam par sangs rgyas pa'i sprin ces bya ba mnga' ba dang ske/ sangs rgyas kyi dbu la de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan rin po che sems kyi rgyal po'i 'od zer dam pa rgya mtshos brgyan pa'i chos kyis 1 rgyan du mtshan rnam par bkod pa las 'jig rten gyi khams na 'khod pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i sprin la snang ba shin tu 'byung zhing ye shes kyi sku dang / chos kyi skus 18de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mtshan rgya mtsho la spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpas 1637—91

yongs su khyab pa'i sprin dang / chos kyi dbyings kyi sprin gyi 'od ①ces bya ba mnga' ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu la de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan rdo rje'i gzhi me tog dang ldan pa bai ḍūr+ya tshonakun tu snang bas chos kyi dbyings thams cad kyi rgyan du gyur te / rnam par snang bas chos kyi dbyings rgya mtsho yongs su rgyas par 'gengs shing 'jig rten gyi khams su rin po che thams cad kyi pad mo'i 'od kyi rgyan thams cad 4kyis chos kyi 5dbyings thams cad du khebs par byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bzhis rnam par 'phrul pa dang / nga ros chos kyi dbyings thams cad du rgyas pa'i mtshan rgya mtsho 6)thams cad rgyanashepa'i sprin snang ba zhes bya ba mnga' ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu la de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan chos kyi dbyings rgya mcho1re gzhi gang sna richen mtsho thams cad kyi rgyan dang ske/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rgyan tshad med pa dgongs pa'i 7skad cig gis yang dag par ston cing / chos kyi dbyings dang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du bsam gyis mi khyab par 'gengs pas sangs rgyas kyi ting nge 'dzin rgya mtsho'i spyod pa rnam par gzigs pa'i sprin snang ba zhes bya ba mnga' ba dang /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu la de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan pad mo'i gzhi dang /rgyan gyi k+ṇi rime tog ri rab rgya mtsho'i 'od zer rin po che'i gzhi sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa las byung ba dang / rnam par snang mdzad kyi sprul pa rgya mtsho mi zad pa'i 'od kun tu snang ba'i sprin ces bya ba mnga' ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu la de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan dpal rin po che dri ma med palho dze+e/sangs rgyas kyi 'od sna tshogs de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi seng ge'i khri dang rgyan dang / sangs rgyas kyi sku'i gzugs brnyan khong na srel cing / rin po 37—92

che'i 'od 'phro ba'i gzhi rgya mtsho dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos khyu mchog gi mthu rmophyung ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi tshul gyis zhing rgya mtsho thams cad du snang ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rnam par grol ba'i sprin ces bya ba mnga' ba dang /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu la de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan be+e ḍūr+ya (kyerin po che'i me tog dang / gser gyi pad mo ⑧las chos kyi 'od zer gyi sprin dang /rin po che'i rgyal po7sgron ma lta bur5bde bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'od rnam par dag pas snang ba'i rgyan bstan pas/ chos kyi dbyings thams cad du dmigs shing rnam par bkye bas tha mi dad cing / sangs rgyas kyi dbu'i rin po che'i sprin dang / rdo rje 'od 'phro ba'i zhu'od zer stug po'i sprin gyis chos kyi dbyings la 'jug cing chos ⑦rgya mcho'i tshul gyis rnam par 'phrul pas snang ba'i sprin ces bya ba mnga' ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu la de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan 'khor lo rtsibs stong pa rin po che'i 'od zer sna tshogs tshad med pa dang ldan zhing ⑧rnam pa thams cad du rnam par dag la dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyis7phyogs bcu thams cad du shes rab kyi nyi ma shin tu gsal skyab dang ske/ ye shes kyi 'od (1chos rgya mtsho'i dbyangs dang ldan pa sangs rgyas kyi gdung rnam par dag pa'i sprin ces bya ba mnga' ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu la de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan rin po che'i phreng hunyeb rnam par bkye ba dang ske/ rin po che'i me tog dang / rin po che bai ḍūr+ya'i hu 'od du 'phro ba'i sangs rgyas kyi 'od seng ge rnam par snang ba'i 8mthu dang ldan pas chos kyi dbyings thams cad du rnam par gnon pa'i mtshan rgya mtsho'i sprin gyi rdulas gcig las sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi rdul snyed du yang dag par 'phro bas sangs 37—93

rgyas kyi mtshan yang dag par bstan 1cing de'i dkyil 'khor gyi ye shes ston pas/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mtshan dang rnam par 'phrul pa'i sprin snang ba zhes bya ba mnga' ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi dbu la de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan de kho na thugs su chud pa'i mtshan nyid rin po che'i rgyan rnam par dag pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa 2dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ye shes kyi snying po tshad med pa dang / chos kyi dbyings thams cad du snang ba'i 'od la 'jug pa zhes bya ba mnga' ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu la de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan rin po che be+e ḍūr+ya'i 4me tog dang / seng ge'i zla ba 'od gzer rnam par snang bsngon dang ske/ rin po che'i rgyal po 'od zer 6brgya pa kun tu snyoms pa〈dpal gyi sprin gyis nachos kyi dbyings dang / nam mkha' khyab pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'od zer snang bas zhing dang / 'jig rten mang por de bzhin gshegs pa bzhugs pa'i 'od rnam par snang ba'i sprin ces bya ba mnga' ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu la de bzhin gshegs pa'i 9mtshan sangs rgyas kyi snang ba rin po che thams cad kyi 'od 'phro ba'i sgron ma chos kyi dbyings kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud kyis kun tu rnam par dag pas/ sangs rgyas kyi 'od kyi sprin phyogs bcur bkye ba kun tu snang ba'i sprin ces bya ba mnga' ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu la de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan rin po che'i 'od 'phro ba'i na bun gyis byang chub sems dpa' 1 thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po 12byang chub tu bzhugs te/chos kyi dbyings thams cad du dgongs pa'i 1 skad cig re re la byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun yang dag par bstan 〉cing rgyan brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa thams cad yongs su ston pa'i sprin snang ba zhes bya ba mnga' ba dang /snye/37—94

de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu la de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan rin po che rgya mtsho dang ske/ spos yid du 'ong ba sna tshogs kyi 'od zer rin po che'i dra ba rab tu 'phel bas sems can gyi khams kyi las rgya mtsho thams cad sgrog pa dang / chos kyi dbyings thams cad sgrog pa'i dbyangs kyi sprin ces bya ba mnga' ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu la de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan yongs su dag pas zhing thams cad kyi rgyan rabs11tu snang ba rnam par dgodas napa'i phyir chos rgya mtsho'i sgra bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ sangs rgyas nas 'das pa dang ske/ ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i chos kyi rang bzhin gyi cigazhi sna tshogs kun tu snang bas sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa mang po kun tu snang ba'i sprin ces bya ba mnga' ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu la de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i sprin chos kyi dbyings thams cad du bsgribs 47)pa mi mnga' ba/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho thams cad du bzhugs pa'i 'od rab tu snang ba'i sprin ces bya ba mnga' ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu la de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan byang chub sems dpa' dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / sems can rgya mtsho bsam gyis 5mi khyab pa'i chos kyi dbyings la 'jug pa'i tshul mang po chos kyi dbyings thams cad du snang ba'i sangs rgyas kyi sprin kun tu mched 6pa dang 7/ rin po che'i sprin gyi sgron ma'i sprin ces bya ba mnga' ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu la de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan ye shes kun tu yangs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa dang /byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dang / chos rgya mtsho'i 8lam tshad med pa dang / zhing gi dkyil 'khor dang / byang chub sems dpa'i bsngo 9ba 37—95

sems can gyi rgyud thams cad kyi bsam pa ji bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi spyod yul gyis zhugs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i smon lam dang spyod 1pa'i nga ros sangs rgyas kyi ye shes khugazhi kun gyi mthar thug cing thams cad mngon par mkhyen pas chos kyi dbyings kyi gzhi kun tu thug ③par 'byung ba'i sprin ces bya ba mnga' ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu la de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan chos kyi dbyings dang nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad du rin po che snang ba'i sprin yid du 'ong ba/ snying po byang chub kyi gzugs brnyan yongs su ston par mngon par 'phags pas byang chub sems dpa' dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku 4yang dag par ston pa'i sprin kun tu bkye bas 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho thams cad du sprin gyi 'od du gnas pa zhes bya ba mnga' ba dang /de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu la de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan gtsug tor 'od kun tu snang ba tshad med pa ston pas/ byang chub sems dpa'asnyedang de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od rnam par dag pa dang 6)/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'odashernam par gnon pa dang / gzi chen pos chos kyi dbyings kyi gzhi kun tu snang ba'i nirin po che'i rgyal po ltar 'od kun nas 'byung ba yongs su grub ste/ chos kyi dbyings thams cad du 'od zer gyi sprin dang / 'od kyi rgyan phyogs thams cad snang bas rnam par snang bar byung 9 zhing / byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho dang /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs shin tu 'phel ba'i mthu dang / sangs rgyas kyi rnam par gnon pa'i sprin gyis/ / phyogs bcu'i zhing gi dra ba dang / nam mkha'57thams cad rgyas par khyab pa'i byang chub kyi sems rin po che'i 'od zer gyi sprin zhes 12bya ba mnga' ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu la de bzhin 37—96

gshegs pa'i mtshan gtsug tor0)dbu'i gtsug nas mthoshogeb rim gyisalgemangon par 'phags shing / 'dzam bu chu klung gi gser dang / rin po che'i tshon gyis kha dog bzang po rnam pa sna tshogs kyi 'od dang ldan par gyur pa/ gser gyi thig le dri ma med pa'i myig 'phrul gyis kun nas shin tu brgyan pa 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dgongs pa'ilo )skad cig re re la7yongs su ston pa'i sprin gyis9)kun tu rgyas7par khyab cing / zhing gi dkyil 'khor snang bar gyur pas zhing gi dkyil 'khor byang chub sems dpa'i gnas su gyur pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis〈kyerab tu brgyan pa kun tu snang ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor 1)mtshan sum cu7 )rtsa gnyis kyi rgyan du gyur cing /chos kyi dbyings thams cad kyi rgyan 17du gyur pa'i sprin snang ba zhes bya ba mnga' ba'o / /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag sangs rgyas kyi mdzod spu la de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan sangs rgyas rgya mtsho thams cad kyi 'od rab tu snang ba rin po che thams cad kyi 8mdog ltar snang ba/ nyi ma dang zla ba ltar snang zhing shin tu rnam par dag pas phyogs bcur 'od zer rgya mtsho rab tu 'gyed pa/ kun nas rin po che'i 'od zer 'byung ba (snye'od kun tu snang ba kyi dpal kun tu rgyas pa'i sangs rgyas nyidekyi sku rab tu 'bar ba'i79sgron ma dri ma myed pa'i me tog shin tu rgyas shing rinas3 rmepo che'i sprin chen po shin tu 'gyed pa/ phyogs kyi 'khor thams cad du rnam par snang zhing de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos rgya mtsho thams cad du dbyangs kyi sgra chosal kyi dbyings thams cad the shin tu 'phags pa'i mar me rab tu snang bas rin po che'i rgyal po'i me tog kun tu rgyas shing chos kyi dbyings thams cad rgyas pa'i sprin ces bya ba mnga' 'o3 bye/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan la de bzhin gshegs pa'i 37—97

mtshan 1rin po che sna tshogs sems can gyi khams su chags pa med pa'i ye shes kyi spyan rnam par dag pas grub pa/ 'od 'phro ba'i sprin rin po che dngul gyi mdog tu kun tu ston pas/ rnam par 'phrul pa'i sprin ces bya ba mnga'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i shangs la de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan rin po che sna tshogs kyis yi yongs su dag pas rin po che thams cad kyi 'od dang mdog sa dang / kha dog dang ldan par gyur pa de bzhin nyid 4thugs su chud pa/ rin po che'i me tog gi sprin gyis pakun tu rgyas shing byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi sangs rgyas kyi chos rgya mtsho bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / sems can gyi 'jig rten thams cad mngon par mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi sprin ces bya ba mnga' 'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi ljags yangs pa la 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho thams cad ljags yangs pa'i sprin gyis kun tu khyab pa'i mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa bas yongs su grub pa/ rin po che thams cad kyi rgyal po'i gzhi las 'od 'phro bas rinechos kyi dbyings thams cad rnam par snang bar mdzad pa'i ngang tshul can/'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sems kyi gzugs brnyan dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi dbyings kyi rgyan thams cad shin tu ston pa'i gsung dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi mtshan gyi ljags yangs pa'i sgo 7rin po che thams cad kyi kha 8dog dang mdog gis rab tu brgyan pa 'od zer rgya mtsho bsam gyis mi khyab pa rab tu snang ba bzhad mo 'dzum pas/ phyogs bcur rab tu bkye 9zhing 'gro ba thams cad shin tu dang ste/ rin po che 1 rgyal po'i 'od 'phro bas rab tu brgyan par de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung sna tshogs rnam par dag pa rab tu brjod cing / shin tu rgya che ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams rgya 37—98

mtsho thams cad du chos kyi nga ro 'byin pa bskal pa tshad med par sangs rgyas kyi gsung gi sgra 'byin pa dang (17)/ chos kyi dbyings gnas pa thams cad du nga ro yangs pa 'byin pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du rgyudabyangs shin tu sgrog cing ske/ snang ba yang dag par ston pa'i dbyangs kyi sprin ces bya ba mnga' 'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i ljags kyi 'og gi drung na de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan rin po che sna tshogs thams cad ltar snang zhing mdzod spu yongs su 'khyil pa'i dbyibs lta bu/ rin po che thams cad kyi rang bzhin lta bu/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi dkyil 'khor phyogs cibacu nas btang ba'im tshodabyangs dang ldan par dun)sangs rgyas kyi gsung gi sbubs can ljags kyi mtshan nyid yongs su dag pa/sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi rdul gyi mtshan nyid med pa'i rang bzhin du sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung rgya mtsho bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbyangs sgrog 6 pa'i sprin ces bya ba mnga' 'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i ljags kyi rtse mo la de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan rin po che gser gyi 'od 7'phro bas sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i dbyings thams cad du snang zhing yid du 'ong ba'i rin po che'i rgyal po'i dbyangs kyi yan lag 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du sgrog 8cing / gsung snyan pa'i ro myong bas sems can la 9 go bar mdzad cing bskal pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa 1 rimanyan du yod par dbyangs kyi yan lag gi sgra yang dag par ston pa'i sprin sems can thams cad la yid du 'ong ba'i chos su snang bas chos kyi dbyings rnam par snang ba'i sprin ces bya ba mnga' 'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i ljags kyi rtse mo la de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan zhing tshad med pa yongs su dag pa na bzhugs pa'i gsung rin po che'i rgyal pos kun nas brgyan cing sna tshogs su gyur 37—99

pas / sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi dbyings kyi klong 1 du bsngags pa rab tu 'jug pa rnam par phye ba gzhan dang gzhan du byang chub sems dpa' rnams la yang dag par ston pa'i sprin gyis 5chos kyi dbyings kyi gzhi dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kun nas yog par sangs rgyas kyi gsung la byang chub sems dpa' 'dzud cing zhing thams cad du rin po che'i rgyal po sgo kun nas ston pas/ chos kyi dbyings su snang ba'i sprin ces bya ba mnga' 'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhal gyi rkan la de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan in+d+ra nī gel sna tshogs dang ske/ be+e ḍūr+ya'i 5 dbyings kyis zhe chos kyi dbyings kyi khongs su gtogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i sprin yongs su rgyas par mdzad pa/ phyogs thams cad du rin po che 7'od 'phro zhing dri ma med pa byung bas rnam par snang ba'i spos kyi sgron ma'i sprin gyi khongs su byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs 'dus par snang bas zhing rgya mtsho'i ming du bya ba thams cad du rnam par 'phrul ba'i tshul lasarab tu gnas shing / chos kyi dbyings bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i chos nyid yang dag par ston pa'i sprin ces bya ba mnga' 'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshems mche ba g.yas kyi 'og ma la de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan 'od rin po che'i mtshan gyi rgyan gyis chos kyi dbyings yangs pa 'od zer snang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo sna tshogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshems mche ba rin po che du9)rnam pa thams cad du mdzes par 7byung ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i 'od gsal bas 'od kyi dra ba kun tu bkye ba/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho'i sems can du gtogs pa thams cad la bkra shis dang / 'khor lo rnam pa kun tu mdzes pas/rnam par snang ba'i sangs rgyas kyi tshems mche ba de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprin ces 37—100
