khong du chud/ /yangs dang yangs min mkhas pas na①/ /'jig rten zab mo rnams la rab tu 'jug parashebyed/ /lus la zhing rnams de shes te/ /zhing la'ang de bzhin gcig min lus 'dzud srido/ /phyogs rnams bcu po ④thams cad du/ /phyogs rnams kun la 'jug cing skad cig du ma dang / /'jig rten khams rnams 'byamasnyiklas la/ /tshad med gzi brjid ldan pa rab tu 'jug /gang yang zhing rnams mtha' yas shing / /dbus med gzung ba byas shing dus kyi dbyings su 'dzud/ /zhing gi rgyud la mkhas pa'i rnams/ /shes dang ldan pas ye shes rab tu 'byung / /bzang po'i yon tan ldan pa'i rnams/ /phyogs dang 'jig rten khams kyi rgyud du gyur pa dag /ji snyed yod pa de 'jug ste/ /brjod du med pa de dag rab tu shes/ /zhing dang zhing gi sa rnams kyi/ /brjod du med pa'i zhing rnams kun kyang rab tu mthonga'i bye/ /de dag tshul yang rab tu shes/ /las rnams gang gis sbyangs pa'ang khong52)du chud/ /gang yang zhing rnams du ma dag /las rnams khrag khrig kun gyis kun nas nyon mongs par/ /'gro bas kun tu bsgrubs byas pa/ /de dag thams cad rgyud kyang ci 'dra shes/ /brjod du med pa yangs pa'i rnams/ /zhing gcig bstan pas de dag yongs su shes par 'gyuranyunye/ /de 'dra'i zhing la 'jug pa dang / /gang la grangs med de dag kun la 'jug /'jig rten khams ni gcig la yang / /'jig rten khams rnams thams cad yang dag 'dzud pa byed/ /'jig rten gcig tu dgongs glemi 'gyur/ /'jig rten khams rnams de bzhin 'dres mi 'gyur/ /spyi'u tshugs rnams dang gong ma'i rnams/ /bla dang 'og gi sa rnams yongs su gzung byas teyi / /'gro ba'i rnam par ming thogs pa/ ci /'jig rten kun la 'jug cing rab 37—149

tu shes/ /snrel zhir 3)rgyu ba'i rgyud rnams dang / /zhing rnams mtha' yas mtha' dang dbus yod ma yin pa/ /sna tshogs yangs pa rab tu shes/ /rnam pa gcig shes rnam pa tha dad shes/ /zhing gi grangs rnams rab tu shes/ /ye shes chags myed mtha' ldan kun gyi grangs rnams kyang / /bzang po'i theg pa spyod pa yis/ /rgyal sras kun tu bzang rnams rab tu shes/ /'jig rten thams cad sprul pa dang ske/ /sems can rnam par sprul dang de bzhin zhing sprul dang / /chos rnams sprul pa'i tshul shes pa/ /sangs rgyas sprul pa'i pha rol phyin pa dun rnams/ /'jig rten phra zhing zab pa dang / /yangs shing sna tshogs yangs pas cho ma cho dgu tshirnams / /sna tshogs tha dad rnam bstsagasas4)pa/ /las kyi rnam smin gnas pa'i 'jig rten rnams/ rdzu 'phrul rnam par 'phrul pa yis/ /chos dbyings 'jug par bya la shin tu bslabs pa yi/ /rgyal sras mtha' dang dbus med pa3)/ /phyogs bcu thams cad ma lus 'gengs par 46)byed/ /'jig rten khams rnams de dag gi/ /ming ni bskal pa 7)sems can snyed kyi du namathar thug cing / /zad par brjod 9par mi nus tenyurte/ /ming bshad gal te sangs rgyas gsung na gsung ske/ /'jig rten mgon po rnams kyi yang / /mtshan rnams mtshan nyid mi 'thun 11rnam pa sna tshogs mtshan/ /bskal pa brjod med zad byas kyang / /mtshan rnams gcig nas gcig brgyud mthar thug med/ /'on kyang dma' ba'i the sems med par/ /mkhas pa rnams ni dus gsum bde gshegs sangs rgyas phyir//chos kyi dbyings las 12byung ba ste/ /sangs rgyas ye shes sa la'ang rab tu zhugs/ /dran pas chags med dag pa ste/ /chags med yid dang ldan zhing blo gros mtha' yas pas/ /ye shes blo gros mchog ldan pa/ /chos dbyings bshad la pha rol 37—150

phyin pa thob/ /gang gis 'jig rten khams kyi rnams/ /yangs dang phra ba rnam pa sna tshogs shes gyur cing / /der ni 'das pa'i dus rnams la/ /sems gcig bskyed pas rab tu 'jug pa byed/ /mi yi seng ge de dag tu/ /sangs rgyas spyod pa sna tshogs rnam par nya)chags med par/ /byang chub mchog tu sangs rgyas shing / /rnam par 'phrul pa thams cad ston pa mdzad/ /de bzhin ma 'ongs dus rnams kyi/ /rjes su gang byon de yi bskal pa ci 'dra dang / /de la myi yi seng ge gang / /skye bar 'gyur ba de dag kun kyang shes/ /smon lam spyod pa ci 'dra dang / /spyod yul gang rnams bsgom ②pa gang gis grub gyur cing ske/ /bsgrub pa'i rnam pa ci 'dra bas/ /bskal pa gang la byang chub 'tshang rgya dang ske/ /de dag 'khor kyang khong du chud/ /sku tshe'i tshad dang sems can 'dum ba ci 'dra dang / /chos kyi sgo mo gang zhig gis/ /'gro bar chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ④ba shes/ /de ltar kun tu bzang po yi/ /ye shes mchog gis bsgrubs sni pa'i spyod pa'i sa gnas shing / /de dag thams cad rab tu shes/ /de ni 'gro gtso kun gyi 'byung gnas yin/ /da〈peltar byung ba gzung byas shing / /'jig rten khams rnams thams cad 'dab chags ma lus par/ /'jig rten khams la rabam tu 'jug /de bzhin chos kyis3)dbyings rnams rab tu shes/ / de na khyami yi gtso bo rnams/ /dgra las rgyal zhing thams cad gzigs pa ji snyed pa/ /mi thub rgol ba dpa' bo / nornams/ /chos kyi mnga' la pha rol phyin brnyes pa/ /de dag 'khor kyang rab tu shes/ /sems can 'dul dang zhing rnams rnam par dag pa dang / /rgyal ba'i rnam par 'phrul pa 37rnams/ /sems pas02bskal pa yangs pa zad par byed/ /skyes bu'i mchog rnams 'dul mdzad cing / /'jig 37—151

rten mchog tu phyin pa'i byin rlabs7dam pa la/ /mi zad mdzod kyi shes yangs pas / /ye shes tshul la mkhas pa rab tu 'jug /chags med mig gis blta ba dang ske/ /chags med rna ba mngon par bsgrub pa sgrub byed cing / /chags pa med pa'i lus yangs dang / /yangs pa'i lces kyang 'jig rten tshim par byed/ /dam pa'i sems la chags myed de/ /bsam pa kun tu rnam yangs rnam par dag dang ldan/ /ye shes 'byung gnas bdag nyid tshemi/ /dus gsum sems rnams ma lus des khyab bo/ /sprul pa'i pha rol phyin thob cing / /zhing rnams sprul pa'i bslabar par bya la bslabs5bapa'i rnams/ /sems can sprul la mkhas pa dag /sprul pa sprul pas 'jig rten 'dul ba byed/ /'du shes rnam pa du ma ste/ /des ni 'jig rten sna tshogasalgem lus rnam param༅bris/ /de dag thams cad rab tu shes / /sangs rgyas ye shes tshul la rab tu 'jug /'khor rnams brjod du med pa dag /sangs rgyas sku57rnams re re dag la yod pa'i rnams/ /kun la 'jug cing mthong bar byed/ /sems can rnam par 'dul ba'i mtha' 'ang myed/ /ye shes zab mo mthong bas na/ /ye shes nyi ma shin tu gsal bar7shar gyur pa'i/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i spyod pa la/ /'jig rten 'byams7klas kun tu 'jug pa byed/ /ji lta'i tshul du zhugs gyur cing / /'jig rten 'di dag thams cad rnam par bkod 'dra bar/ /sems can tshul bzhin rab tu 'phags/ /khams gsum thams cad myig yor tshul 'drar shes/ /'on kyang rtog dang rnam rtog med/ /'jig rten mtha' dang dbus med kun la rtog mi byed/ /rtog dang rtog med mkhas pa ste/ /rtog pa'i shes pas rnam par rtog pa med/ /bskal pa brjod du med pa71 rnams/ /sems bskyed gcig la yang dag 'du bar 'dzudarwa)byed cing //37—152

'jig rten mi khom 'di mthong nas/ /skad cig sems kyis7thams cad shes par byed/ /brjod du med pa'i zhing rnams kyang / /sems bskyed gcig gis thams cad yongs su 'da' bar byed/ /bskal pa brjod med zad byed kyang / /skra7rtse'i cha shas gcig las g.yo ba med/ /bskal pa brjod du med pa dag /nyi ma gcig dang yud ①tsam gcig tu 'dzud byed kyang / /ring dang thung la gzhol ba med/ /skad cig gcig la 'jug pa'i pha rol phyin/ /sems kyi rnam pa 'jig rten kun/ /'jig rten rnam pa sems canadzabakun gyi sems yin te⑤/ /rnam pa gnyis kyi grangs su zhugs/ /'on kyang de dag mi gnyis rtog pa med/ /sgyu ma'i rnam pa 'jig rten te/ /sems can zhing dang sangs rgyas chos kyang de bzhin no/ /'on kyang 'jig rtenasamagon po rime)rnams/ /chos kyi dbyings rnams kun la gcig tu snyoms/ /lus rnams brjod du med pa yis/ /phyogs bcu thams cad rgyas par bkang zhing yongs su ston/ /'on kyang lus la gzhol ba med / /chos nyid rten pa gnas med rab tu shes/ /'on kyang myi yi seng ge rnamasal/ /gnyis la gnas pa'i shes pas byung ba ma yin te/ /mi gnyis pa la'ang gnas pa med/ /gnyis dang gnyis myed chos rnams rab tu shes/ /ji ltar snyig rgyu rab rib dang / /myig yor sgra brnyan (8)de bzhin spyi lam 'dra ba dang ske/ /mi lam rnam pa sprul pa ltar/ /'gro ba thams cad ma lus rab tu shes/ /de ltar spyod yul nyams med pas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rigs kyi rjes su 'byung ba yin/ /kun tu bzang po'i ye shes dang / /chos kyi dbyings la shin tu bdal ba yin/ /snying rje chen po mtha' yas kyang / /sems can med dang mnyam par zhing rnams thams cad sgom/ /sngonashenas nyon mongs nyams myed pa'i bsam pa 37—153

dag pas 'jig rten kun tu 'gro/ /mi zad mkha' ltar rnamanyedag pa'i②/ /rgya che shin tu yangs pa'i sa la rab tu zhugs/ /gsung ba'i seng ge thams cad kyi/ /tshul gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad rjes su dran/ /'jig rten rab tu spros pa la/ /smon lam tshad med yongs su gdab pa byas pas na/ /de dag spyod pa yongs su dag /'jig rten khams rnams thams cad rgyas par khyabang )/ /sangs rgyas rnams dang rgyal musras dang / /de bzhin sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos rnams thams cad dang / /'jig rten rnams dang 'jig rten chos/ /chags med tha dad med pa'i tshul du shes/ /chos kyi sku yi snying po can/ /de yi lus la 'jig rten thams cad gzudas3byas shing / /'jig rten de yi lus yin yang / /'jig rten kun gyi 3 de la gos pa med/ /ji ltar dang ba'i chu gsal la/ /gzugs brnyan na yongs su snang yang der song 'phos pa med/ /de bzhin 'jig rten thams cad kyi/ /rjes su lus 'gro der song 'phos pa med/ /desheltar 'jig rten thams cad kyis1 sku/ /gos pa med cing 'jig rten yongs su dag pas na/ /lus ni mkha' dang 'dra ba ste/ /de yi lus rnams gang yang 31skyes pa med/ /mi zad pa yi 1gelus shes pas/ /de ni nam yang skyes shing 'gags tsho/rtepa med pa ste/ /rtag dang mi rtag ma yin par/ /'jig rten kun la'ang 6rnam par dmyigs pa byedarka/ /lta ba'i rnam pa rab tu 'gags3ge/ /brtan lngapa de dag yang dag lta 3 7ba ston pa byed/ /bdag gi myed cing gnas pa med/ /len pa med cing chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam/ /ji ltar sgyu mkhan mkhas pa zhig1nye /sna tshogs mtshan nyid rnam pa tha dad gshegs nya/'phrul byed/ /'on kyang de la 'gro ba med/ /gang du'ang shu 'gro ba de bzhin myi dmyigs so/ /sgyu ma tshad myed ma yin te/ /sgyu 37—154

ma tshad kyis dmyigs par bya ba'ang ma yin no/ /tshad med tshad dang ldan par mtshoyang ske/ /tshogs kyi dbus su ston pa /ltarab tu byed/ /de bzhin rtogs pa'i blo ldan pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams las byung / /sems ni tshad yod ma yin te/ /tshad ma ri med pa la gnas pa'ang de dag min/ /'du shes rnam pa gcig min te/ /de dag tshad med pa dang tshad dang ldan pa ston/ /lam gyi rgyud dang 'brel pa med/ /tshad med rnams la 5)gnas pa'ang de bzhin myed/ /sangs rgyas chos rnams zab pa ste/ /shin tu yangs pas zab cing zhi bas de bzhin zab/ /zab mo sna tshogs rgyud rnams dang / /mtha' yas zab pa rnams kyang rab tu shes/ /ye shes bzang po rmongs pa med/ /rgyud la dri ma med pas bsam pa rnam par dag /byin gyis rlob la mkhas pas na/ /srog chags bye ba shin tu dag par〈nyebyed/ /dge bar byed pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams/ /rab tu rjod 6)cing dge dang mi dge rnam par ston/ /gnas la mngon par ma chags pas / /chos kyi dbyings rnams kun tu rab tu rgyu/ /sems can med mthar phyin gyur kyang / / 'jig rten thams cad ma lus de dag khong du chud tsho/ /'jig rten thams cad ma lus par/ /rnam par sangs rgyas mya ngan gar mi 'da' / /chos rnams bgrang ba'i tshul la mkhas/ /sems can bgrang tshul shes kyang grangs la skyes pa med/ /chos kyi sprin chen char na'abebs shing / /'jig rten khams rnams thams cad snang bar byed/ /sangs rgyas byang chub ma lus la/ /sems bskyed gcig gi sa de dag rab tu 'jug /de dag phyir ldog myed pa ste/ /sems can kun gyi khams las phyir mi ldog /sangs rgyas sku ni thob gyur kyang / /chos rnams 'di dag lus yodas9 ma yin rab tu shes/ /lus rnams kun gyi tshul 37—155

la mkhas/ /lus kyis rnam phye 'jig rten rab tu shes/ /sems can kun tu rgyu ba dang / /bskal pa rnams dang zhing la pha rol phyin pa thob/ /phyogs rnams rgya mtsho gang chen 17mtshor/ /ye shes rgya mcho1re tshul la mkhas pas zhugs/ /lus rnams thams cad re re las/ /sems can kun gyi lus rnams sna tshogs ji snyed dang ske/ /sangs rgyas skusani mtha' yas pa/ /ye shes shin tu yangs pa de ston to / /skad cig gcig gi dus tshul la/ /mi yi gtso bo mang po 'byung ba rab tu shes / /bskal pa mang po brjod med du/ /mi yi seng ge bgrang bas zad mishe'agyur / /de dag mya ngan 'da' ba yang / /skad cig gcig la tshad med shin tu yangs pa 'byung / /ring bsrel rnam dbye mang po yang / /ye shes dri med phra bas ston pa byed/ /de bzhin ma 'ongs dus kyi yang / /mi yi seng ge mtha' yas smon lam 'debs pa'i rnams/ /byang chub dri med sems bskyed pa/ /ye shes yangs shing (0shin tu phra bas shes/ /bzang po'i ⑤spyod la gnas bcas shing —/ /de bzhin dus gsum gshegs pa'i57sems can gtso bo rnams/ /ci snyed skyes par gyur pa rigadag /de dag thams cad ma lus rab tu shes/ /de ltar rab tu shes pas na/ /mtha' dang dbus med spyod pa'i sa dang de bzhin du//ye shes 'byung gnas blo gros la/ /ye shes 'khor lo'i ༄7spyod pas phyir mi ldog /ye shes phra mo ra ba yangs pa/ /stobs bcu rnams kyi spyod yul mchog la de dag zhugs / /bzang po rtogs pa'i blo can rnams/ /phyir mi ldog la 'jug pa brjod byasalan/ /sangs rgyas rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ /yang dag gzhol bar bya la de dag zhugs pas nyunyan/ /spyod las phyir ldog med pa ste/ /byang chub dam pa zhi bar 'tshang rgya yang 3rnye/ /de 'dra'i gesems rgyud gcig la yang / /mtha' 37—156

dang dbus med sems rnams yang dag 'dzud pa byed/ /shin tu yangs pa'i tshad med las/ /'du shes de dnganyede la yang dag bsgrubs②/ /nyon mongs med dang nyon mongs dang / /slob dang mi slob sems kyang de bzhin rab tu shes/ /sems rgyud de dag re re la'ang / /sems rnams brjod du med pa mngon 'tshang rgya / /gcig dang gnyis su shes pa myed/ /desnyedag yongs su 'dres par 'gyur ba'ang med pa ste/ /so so'i 'du shes rnam pa la/ /sems can de dag skyes par gyur pa yin/ /'di na 'dug par mthong gyur kyang / /sems can brjod med gzhan dang gzhan ④sems ldan pa'i rnams/ /gzhan gyi zhing phyir ⑤'du shes kyang ske/ /'jig rten sna tshogs rnams la rab tu skye/ 'di 'dra'i tshul la 'jugatso)pa la/ /spyod pa'i mchog gi rjes su zhugs par gyur pasarnams/ /kun tu bzang po'i ming thob ste/ /'jig rten mgon po kun gyi rjes su skyes/ /sems can bye ba la la ni/ /ngan song 'grangs pa'i ming thogs mtho ris 'du shes 'gyur / /la la mtho ris sa rnams kyi/ /rnam pa kun la ngan song 'du shes 'gyur / /'jig rten mi mtshungs skal ba79ltos/ /rnam pa tha dad las kyi sa las rab tu skyes/ /'du shes rnam pa mtha' yas te'i/ /gcig min yangs71la 'jig rten rab tu 'jug /'jig rten khams rnams thams cad kyi/ /'du shes dra ba skal ba mi mnyam rab tu shes/ /mig 'phrul sgyu ma'i tshul gyis na/ /skad cig gcig gi52sems kyis rab tu gzhol/ /de bzhin dbang po rnams la ste / /mig gi skye mched rna ba sna yi skye mched dang / /lce dang lus dang yid la yang ske/ /'jig rten rnam pa tha dad 'du shes 'jug /mig rnams re re'i yul la yang〈nye/ /mtha' dang dbus med mig rnams rab tu 'dzud pa byed/ /rnam 37—157

pa tha dad du ma ste/ /tshad med kun la'ang zhen par 'gyur ba med/ /'on kyang phan tshun gcig gis gcig /bde zhing gnod par 'gyur ba de dag kun na med / /bdag bdag so so'i las kyi rnams/ /ji ltar bstsagasalgepa'i tshul bzhin nyams su myong / /bzang zhes bya ba de dag kun/ /tshad med stobs dang ye shes sa yi shes rab kyisang )/ /'byam rgyaklas mig rnams thams cad la/ /rab tu zhugs pas shin tu rtogs pa yin/ /de bzhin 'jig rten thams cad kyang / /thams cad ma lus rnam pa thams cad 'jig tshul du/ thams cad shin tu shes gyur kyang / /rgya chen spyod pas mya ngan mi 'da' 'o/ /sangs rgyas shin tu bstan pa dang / /sems can bstan dang de bzhin zhing rnams bstan pa dang / /dus rnams shin tu bstan pa dang / /bstan pa sna tshogs rnam pa kun kyang shes/ /la la 'di la 'das gyur kyang / /gzhan dang gzhan rnams ma 'ongs dus la gnas pa yin/ /'on kyang ma 'ongs dus kyi rnams/ /la las da ltar byung bar rab tu shes / /de 'dra'i tshul can gcig min pa'i/ /'jig rten mtshan nyid tha dad thams cad rab tu shes/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nyid tshul gyis0/ /sangs rgyas ye shes kun tu mtha' yang yas/ / shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/ /sangs rgyas phal po che zhes bya ba lasalta/ kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa bstan pa'i pole'u ste/bzhi bcu gnyis pa'o// // sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo / bam po brgyad tshon)pa/ bcom ldan 'das ye shes chen pos rnam par sangs rgyas pa'i dgongs pa 9mnga' ba 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung 37—158

ba'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang / sku gcig pas 6)mnyam pa nyid brnyes pa/sangs rgyas thams cad kyi spyod pa mnyam pa nyid dang ldan pa/ chags pa med pa'i spyod yul mngon par mkhyen pa/ ye shes kyi rang bzhin gyi ( chos kyi sku mnga' ba/ mtshan nyid yod nas med pa'i chos la rten pa/ chos kyi dbyings mi gnyis pa'i spyod yul gyi5kyeyang dag par spyod pa/ mtha' dang dbus med cing mtshungs pa'i mngon par 'tshang rgya ba brnyes pa/ rnam par thar pa bsgribasamang pa med pa'i spyod yul la shin tu dgyes pa/ chos kyi sku nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mthas klas pa mnga' ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs mekyi pho brang khang pa brtsegs pa'i gzhal med khang de bzhin gshegs pa bzhugs pa/ chos kyi dbyings kyi snying po can/ 'odas⑥kun nas 'byung ba rgyan chen po dang ldan pamu/'od dang zhing gsal ba/ rnam par snang ba'i snying po can sangs rgyas skye ba chos kyi dbyings mtha' dang dbus med pa'i gnas/ byang chub sems dpa'i lus las byung b.le/ gzhi 'od zer gyis ༄9 rnam par brgyan pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i lus rang bzhin du gnas pas rab tu bsgrubs panyu sta/ chos chen po'i gzhir gyur pa/ chos kyi dbyings kun tu rgyas pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od dang ldan pa/ nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mthas gtugs 11pa/ ye shes kyi yul yang dag pa'i mtha' spyod yul chags pa med pas sna rnam par gsal ba na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rin po che bzang po'i pad mo 1 chen po rang rang gi smon lam gyis 'byung ba'i dbus kyi snying po la 'khod pa nyanakun kyang tshe gcig gis thogs pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan dang gzhan nas phyin pa/ye shes chen po rnam par phye ba'i spyod yul la gzhol tshab/ chos kyi dbyings tha mi 37—159

dad pa'i gzhi hu)mnyam pa nyid la zhugs pa/ nam mkha'i dbyings gzhi ②med cing ske/ mtha' dang dbus med pa la rnam par spyod ①pa/ chos thams cad 'byung ba med cing / mngon par grub pa med pa mngon du byas pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i lus las ma g.yos par ④thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes rab tu thob pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du kun gyis brjod pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes lasalgemangon du byung ba/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byang chub mngon sum du gyur pa'i ye shes snang ba thob pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyod yul rgyun ma chad pa/ ye shes kyi rang bzhin chos kyi lus gcig cing tha mi dad pas/ gzugs kyi lus mtha' yas pa'i sgo kun tu ston pa/ chos kyi dbyings mtha' dang dbus med pa la 'jug pa shin tu shes pa/ sems can gyi khams su rnam par spyadam pa las phyir mi ldog pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi dbyings dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' mnyam pa nyid thob pas sprul pa mngon par sgrub pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad dang / sngon lhan cig tu skyes shing dge ba'i rtsa ba bstsags ⑧pa sha stag la kha'adi lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po dang / kun tu grags pa'i dbang phyug rgyal po dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su byung ba'i dpal dang ske/ rdo rje dpal gyi rgyal mtshan hu )dang / rnam par grol ba bsgribs hunyapa med pa'i zla ba dang / nyi ma'i 'od zer dri ma med pa'i snying po dang / mngon par shes pa chen pos rnam par 'phrul pa'i blo dang / 'od dri ma med pa'i dpal gyi gzi brjid 'od zer gyi rgyal po dang / blo gros rgya mtsho'i mchog 'dzin cing blo la rnam par rtse ba gsal bas mngon par shes pa'i dpal dang / byang chub sems 37—160

dpa' sems dpa' chen po stobs bcu7mi 'jigs pa'i seng ge'i nga ro chen pos rnam par rtse bas mngon par shes pa dang / de dag las stsogasashon/pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong brjod du med pa phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs sol/ /de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi semadzod spu nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i 'od zer 'od zer5gegyi 'khor bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong grangs med pa mang po'i 'od zer dang ldan pa byung ste/ des 'jig rten gyi khams 'byamasnyiklas pa thams cad du55)ma lus par snang b.ramanya)byas/ 'jig rten g.yas phyogs su lan bcur bskor te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i risarnam par 'phrul pa bstan nas/ byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong mang po bskul ba byas te/ 'jig rten gyi khams 'byams(klas pa thams cad rab tu bskyodakyinas/ ngan song gi rgyud thams cad kyi skye ba dang / shi 'pho ba rab tu zhi bar byas te/ bdud kyi khyim thams cad zil gyis mnan nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mngon par 'tshang rgya bas(1/ rnam par sangs rgyas pa'i gdan bstan pa byas tetunye/ sangs rgyas kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnam par bkod pa/ 'byamatshwanyeklas pa rab tu bstan nas/ 'jig rten gyi khams chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs par 'byam snyiklas pa thams cad ma lus par rgyas par khyab par byas nas phyir 'ongs te/ byang chub sems dpa'isnyi'akhor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad la g.yas phyogs nas bskor nas/ ⑩byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su byung ba'i dpal gyi spyi bor nub bo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor de dgasko thams cad ngo 37—161

mtshar cher 3)'dzin cing / dga' ba thob par gyur7te/ 'od zer gyi dra ba snang ba 'di lta bu byung bas na chos chen po brjod par ni 'gyur dusko nges so snyam nas / rtogasaring)pa'i blo yang ri thob par gyur to/ /'od zer de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su byung ba'i dpal gyi57lus la phogs kyipar gyur ma thag tu/ de nas de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su byung ba'i dpal pad mo'i stan las langs te/bla gos phrag pa gcig tu nagazar nas/ pad mo'i snying po de thodal pus mo5 snagayas pa'i lha nga 11btsugs nas/ bcom ldan 'das gang na kyi ba der thal mos hu) btud te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'du shes dang ldan pa'i yid la byed pas/de bzhin gshegs pa la tshigs su bcad de gsol pa/ /rnam dag blo mnga' yon tan mkhyen pas 'phags pa/ /spyod yul chags pa med pa'i pha rol phyin brnyes/ /dus gsum mnyam pa'i chos nyid mnyam pa nyu0ston pa/ /khyod la bdag ni bsti 8stang rim gro bgyid do/ /mtshan nyid med pa'i spyod yul pha rol phyin brnyes/ /mtshan gyis shin tu brgyan pa'i sku'ang saston mdzad/ /dri med 'od chen hu tsho'od zer stong dang 3 ldan 'gyed17/ /bdud kyi sde rnams ma lus rab tu 'jom mdzad ske/ /phyogs bcu kun na gang rnams ji snyed mchis pa'i/ /zhing rnams thams cad ma lus rab tu bskyod 21kyang / /thugs rje ldan pas su la'ang 'jigs par mi mdzad/ /khyod kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu ni de 'dra de tshul/ /nam mkha'i dbyings la mnyam pa nyid du rab zhugs rta/ /de bzhin chos dbyings mnyam pa nyid kyang brnyes gyur/ /sems can stong phrag bye ba grol bar mdzad cing ske/ /sems can kun gyi sdig chen rab tu zhi mdzad/ /bskal pa stong du 37—162

brtul zhugs dam po spyad 3)de/ /byang chub mchog gi lam ni yang dag bsgrubs nas / /chags pa med pa'i ye shes spyod yul 'di brnyes/ /sangs rgyas kun dang rang bzhin gcig tu rab gyuradu / /rnam par 'dren pa khyod kyis 'di nas 'ong57bkye/ /'jig rten thams cad ma lus kun tu bskyod nas/ /cho 'phrul mtha' yas yang dag bstan par bgyis te④ni/ /bdag gi lus 'dir de dag ma lus zhugs gyur/ /de la bdag gi blo gros 'di ltar skyes te/ /chos rje khyod la bdag gis zhu ba'i dus bab/ /shin tu nges pa'i chos la rab tu bslabs pa'i/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyang 'dus par gyur snyam/ /tshogs ge'adi dag pa 'dus pas rnam par dag pa/ /'jig rten slob dpon mgon pos rab tu bsngags pa/ /ye shes mtha' yas ldan pa yul la chags 6med/ /de 'dra'i mthu chen dpa' bo 'di dag 'dir phyin/ /de'i 47don 'jig rten slob dpon drang srong chen po/ /ye shes stobs dang brtson 'grus mtha' yas byung gyur/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'dimadun/dag snang bar mdzad gsol/ /chos rab 9bdag gis gang zhus de yang bshad gsol/ /drang srong chen po'i spyod yul 'di dag bstan cing ske/ /yang dag ma nor brjod par nus pa gang lags/ /skyes bu khyu mchog rnams kyi sras ni gang lags/ /'jig rten mgon gyi nyu rigatso bo khyod kyis bshad gsol / /tshigs su bcad77pa de dag gsol ma thag tu/ de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal gyi sgo nas mi bsnyengs pa'i mthar phyin pa zhes bya ba'i 'od zer 'khor gyi 'od zer khrag khrig brgya stong grangs med pa dang ldan pa byung ste/ des 'jig rten gyi khams 'byam tu klas pa thams cad ma lus par snang bar byas nas/'jig rten nyunyegayas phyogs su lan bcur bskor te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i 37—163

rnam par 'phrul pa bstan07nas/ byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong mang po bskulatshan/ba byas te/ 'jig rten gyi khams 'byam7klas pa thams cad rab tu bskyod nas/ ngan song gi rgyud thams cad kyi skye ba dang / shi 'pho ba rab tu zhi bar byas te/ bdud kyi khyim thams cad zil gyis mnan nas/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mngon par 'tshang rgya bas/ rnam par sangs rgyas pa'i gdan bstan pa byas te/ sangs rgyas kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnamasasnyibakod pa 'byam bklas pa rab tu bstan nas/ 'jig rten gyi khams chos kyi dbyings kyis klas 6)pa/ nam mkha'i mthas 9)gtugs par 'byamanyeklas pa/thams cad ma lus par rgyas paramatho)khyab par byas nas phyir 'ongs te/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi tsodakyil 'khor thams cad la g.yas phyogs nas bskor nas / byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i kha'i sgor nub bo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od zer nges byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po la reg par gyur ma thag tu de nas de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po'i lus kyi seng ge'i khri/ sngon ci 'dra ba de las byang chub sems dpa'i lus kyi seng ge'i khri brgya phrag stong gyur (1du bzang zhing /khyad par du 'phags par 'dug ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i seng ge'i gdan ma gtogs par byang chub sems dpa' gzhan gyi lus kyi seng ge'i khri las byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i lus kyi seng ge'i khri brgya phrag stong gyur hunyedu bzang zhing khyad par du 'phags par snang ngo / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su byung ba'i dpal gyis/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po la 'di skad ces 37—164

smras so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de bzhin gshegs pas hu)cho 'phrul chen po 'jig rten thams cad kyis khong du chud par dka' ba/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams rab tu dga' bar 'gyur ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'di lta bu bstan na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras de gang gi sngon gyi mtshan mar 'gyur/ de skad ces smras pa dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang pos/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su byung ba'i dpal la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de ni bdag 'di 3)snyam du sems te/ sngon gyi yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi cho 'phrul chen po 'di 'dra bdag kyang mthong ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ni de bzhin gshegs pa skye bsre'abyung ba bstan pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs bstan par dgongs pa dang / cho 'phrul chen po'i rnam pa 'di lta bu dag ston pa mdzad do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su byung ba'i ④dpal gyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa skye ba tshonye'abyung ba bstan pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs kyi ming thos par gyur ma thag tu/ de'i tshe sa chen po4)g.yos par gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su byungasheba'i dpal gyis/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras legs par spobs par (2)mdzod cig /ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos ⑨de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi skye ba 'byung tho )ba bstan pa khong du chud par bya(me/ kye rgyal ba'i sras 'khor 'dus pa 'di ni shin tu dag pa ste/ byang chub sems dpa' bye 37—165

ba khrag khrig brgya stong kun nas 'dus pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sngon spyad 3)pa shin tu spyad pa/ las kyi mtha' shin tu sbyangs pa/ dran pa dang blo gros dang / rigasho pas shin tu 'phags pa/rgya chen po'i pha rol tu phyin pa/ mchog thob pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi spyod yul dang / spyod pa dang tshul lamagrwarab tu gnas pa/ sangs rgyas kyi rjes su song ba'i 'du shes yid la byed pa ma nyams pa/ snying rje chen pos 'gro ba thams cad la rnam par lta ri ba/ byang chub sems dpa'i mngon par shes pa chen pos rnam par rol pa'i spyod yul can/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin rang gi 6rgyud du len pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi dpal gyi byin gyis brlabs pa ste/ de dag las stsogs chupa yon tan dang legs pa tshad med pa mang po dang ldan pa sha stag 'ongs shing 'dus pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras khyod kyang sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong mang po bsnyen bkur ba/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyod pa'i mchog tu phyin pa/ ting nge 'dzin dang snyoms par 'jug pa'i sgo thams cad kyis 3)rnam par rol par mngon zuXpar mkhas pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba'i gnas su chud pa/sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad la the tsom 1 )yongs su chad kyi1pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis byin du brlabs pa/ sems can thams cad kyi dbang po la mkhas pa dang ldan pa/ sems can thams cad kyi mos 1 pa dang rnam par grol ba'i lam yang dag par ston pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs dang / rgyud yang dag par 'byung ba'i ye shes dang ldan pa/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad bstan pa la pha rol tu 1 phyin pa'i mchog thob pa de dag 37wa 166

la stsogs ①pa yon tan mang po tshad med pa'i khyad par kyi mthar ( thug pa yin gyisal / kye rgyal ba'i sras de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi skye ba 'byung ba bstan pasapa dang / sku yang dag par bstan pa dang / dbyangs rab tu brjod pa dang thugs kyi mthu dang /yul gyi gnas dang / spyod yul bstan pa dang / mngon par byang chub pa'i gnas dang / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba risamangon par bsgrub pa dang /yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po bstan pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams mthong zhing thos pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa dang 'grogs pas/dge ba'i rtsa ba 'byung ba bstan pa la legs par spobs par skumadzod cig /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su byung ba'i dpal gyis7)/ don 'di nyid yang bzlas dbarjod pa'i phyir/ de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po la tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ /chags med blo gros shin tu rnam par sangs rgyas blo ldanartso/ /ye shes mtha' yas yul la mnyam pa nyid du gyur panyi )/ /rgyal ba'i spyod yul tshad med (nyalegs par yang dag shod cig /de thos sangs rgyas sras rnams thams cad rab tu dga' 'gyur/ /rgyal ba mchog rnams 'byung ba ji ltar byang chub sems dpas/ /khong du chud bya ji ltar de dag yang dag blta bya/ /de bzhin gshegs thugs ji 'dra 32sku dang dbyangs kyang 32ci 'dra/ /skyes bu khyu mchog rnams kyi yul dang spyod yul ci 'dra/ /de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub ji ltar rnam par 'tshang rgya/ /chos kyi 'khor lo dam pa rgyal ba ji ltar skor dzolamadzad/ /bde gshegs mya ngan 'das pa'i yang dag nyid kyang gsung ste/ /sangs rgyas sras 37—167

po mtha' yas 'di dag dga' bar mdzod cig /gang gis bde gshegs chos rgyal chen po mthong bar gyur cing / /gang rnams 'grogs shing dge ba yang dag bskyed nyu par byed pa/ /de dag bsod nams 'phel ba yang ma nor brjod par mdzod cig /bde gshegs mthong na jir〈'gyur de dang 'grogs na jir mi'agyur / /bde gshegs mya ngan 'das dang 'on tam bzhugs kyang rung ste/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan rnams gang gis thos par gyur cing / /yon tan 'byung gnas rnams la gang rnams dad pa bskyed pa/ /de dag don kyang cirasre'agyur 'khor 'dir bstan par 52mdzod cig /byang chub sems dpa' 'di dag thams cad thal mo sbyar cing / /bde bar gshegs dang khyod dang bdag la kun kyang lta sdod sna/ /dris pa 'di dag sems can dag pa khyod kyis lung ston/ /yon tan rgya mtsho che mnga' rnams kyi spyod yul bstan mdzod/ /de dag don tu chos rab ldan pa'i gsung mchog rjod (8)cing / /mkha' 'dra khyod kyis nyuskye bo rnams kyi the tsom bogacad mdzod/ /dpe dang rgyur ldan tshig gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs ston/ /thos nas sems can khrag khrig byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed11/ /ji ltar zhing rnams thams cad ma lus rgyas par bkang zhing / /rgyal ba'i 12sku yi yan lag sna tshogs yang dag ston mdzadahunye/ /ji ltar khrag khrig chos dang ldan pa'i gsung rab brjod skopa/ /sangs rgyas byang chub dpe dang rgyu yis bstan par tshemadzod cigatso /gang zhig phyogs bcu'i zhing rnams khrag khrig thams cad kun tu/ /bstan 3 tshopa mang po bye ba mtha' yas bgrang bar〈nyesong yang ske/ /de ring rgyal sras 'dir tshogs 'di 'dra'i〈nye'akhor dang )'dra ba/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis mthong bar〈 1shin tu dka' ba'o(nye/ /de bas 37wa 168

rgyal sras rang bzhin dag pa khyod kyis bshad mdzod/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi rigs yang hu)yongs su ②ston cig( ne+e /byang chub sems dpa' 'di dag thams cad thal mo sbyar te/ /yangs pa'i chos kyis skomadzabazhing chos la don gnyer gnas so/ /de skad ces smras pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang pos/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su byung ba'i dpal la dmyigs nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad la smras pa/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di lta ste/de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas skye ba 'byung ba58)bstan pa/ tshad med pa'i chos kyis 'byungasnyib 'di ni bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi skye ba 'byung ba ni/ rgyu gcig ma yin pa dang / rkyen gcig ma yin pas yang dag par 'grub bo/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /chos bcu po 'di dag la sogasalgepa/ chos rnam pasatha dad pa brgya stong tshad med grangs med pa yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i tshul yang dag par bsgrubs pa'i rgyus de bzhin gshegs pa rnams 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sngon 'gro ba thams cad yongs su bskyabs1)pa'i sems dang / byang chub kyi sems tshad med pa bskyed pa yang dag par bsgrubs pa dang / bsam pa dang lhag pa'i bsam pa sngon shin tu sbyangs shing yang dag par bsgrubs pa dang / byams pa chen po dang / thugs rje7chen po tshad med pas sems can yongs su skyabs hu1pa tsoyang dag par bsgrubs / pa dang ske/ spyod 8pa dang smon lam tshad med pa rgyun chad 7pa med par yang dag 37—169

par bsgrubs pa dang / bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs chen pos 31mi ngoms par yang dag par bsgrubs pa dang / sangs rgyas mchod cing rim gro bya ba dang /sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i 2rgyun tshad med pa yang dag par bsgrubs pa dang / thabs dang shes rab kyi lam rnam par dag cing / tshad med pa yang dag par bsgrubs pa dang / yon tan rnam par dag pa'i rnam pa tshad med pa yang dag par bsgrubs pa dang / lam gyi tshan lag rnam par dgod ( pa tshad med pa'i ye shes yang dag par bsgrubs pa dang / don dang ldan pa'i chos tshad med pa khong du chud pas/ mthar phyin par bya ba yang dag par bsgrubs pa ste/kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /chos cabacu po 'di dag la stsogs pa/ chos rnam pa tha dad pa brgya stong tshad med grangs med pa yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i tshul yang dag par bsgrubs pa'i rgyus de bzhin gshegs pa rnams 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag rine'adi lta ste dper na/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'byung ba ni rgyu gcig gis 'byung ba ma yin/ rkyen gcig gis 'byung ba ma yin te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams ni rgyu tshad med pa dang / rkyen tshad med pa dang /bsgrubs 7pa tshad med pas yongs su 'grub par 'gyur te/ 'di ltar sprin chen po'i char dus las myi 'da' bar rab tu 'bab pas kyang rgyu byas la/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor bzhi rgyun mi chad napar ldang bas kyang rgyu byas na ri9yongs su 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /bzhi po de dag kyang gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor yongs su 'dzin pa zhes bya ba ni yongs su gzung ba'i phyir ldang ngo / /rlung gi dkyil 'khor yongs su skem 1 pa zhes bya ba ni/ chu'i phung po yongs su bskam 37—170

pa'i phyir7)ldang ngo / /rlung gi dkyil 'khor yongs su gzhogaphasapa zhes bya ba ni gzhal ②med khang thams cad yongs su dgod pa'i phyir ldang ngo / /rlung gi jidakyil 'khor rnam 5)par dgod pasngonazhes bya ba ni/ sems can stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams su gtogs pa thams cad kyi rkyen du skyes pa'i las dang / byang chub sems dpa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba'i ri ristobs dang shugs kyis/gnas kyi rnam pa'i rgyan 3)rnam par phye ba shin tu rnam par dbye bas stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams rnam par 77)dbye ba'i phyir ldang ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de dag la stsogs 7pa'i rnam pa tshad med pas stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 31chos nyid rab tu thob pa'i phyir/ yongs su 'byung bar hu)'gyur ba yang 'byung ba de la 'byung bar byed pa gang yang med de/'byung bar 'gyur ba'ang med pa hu ma yin no/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de bzhin du hu9de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyang rgyu gcig ma yin pa dang / rkyen gcig ma yin pas 'byung bar 'gyur 8te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni rgyu tshad med pa dang / rnam pa tshad med pa dang ske/ yang dag par bsgrub nyu7pa tshad med pas 'byung nya tshoste/ 'di ltar yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi drung du sngon chos kyi sprin gyi char chen po bab pas kyang rgyur 1 byas la/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi rlung gi dkyil 'khor bzhi 1)rgyun mi chad 2 par ldang bas kyang rgyu byas nas 1yang dag par 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /bzhi gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi rlung gi dkyil 'khor chen po dran pas yang dag par bzung 22zhing gzungs kyis 37—171

chud mi za ba zhes bya ba yod de/ de ni7de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gi chos kyi sprin chen po'i char yang dag par gzung ba'i phyir ldang ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi rlung gi dkyil 'khor chen po lhag mthong dang / zhi gnas kyis bsgrubs ( pa zhes bya ba yod de/ de ni nyon mongs pa thams cad yongs su bskam (0pa'i phyir ldang ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi rlung gi dkyil 'khor chen po yongs su bsngo ba la mkhas pa zhes bya ba yod de/ de ni dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad yongs su bsngo ba'i phyir ldang ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi rlung gi dkyil 'khor chen po sprul pa'i rgyan rnam par bkod pa rnam par 'byed cing rnam par 'god 9)pa zhes bya ba yod de/ de ni sems can sngon yongs su smin par byas pa rnams kyi rkyen du byung ba'i dge ba'i⑧ma ba yongs su dag pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba zag pa med pa'i stobs dang shugs kyi phyir ldang ngo / /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de dag la stsogs7pa'i rnam pa tshad med pa dang / yang dag par bsgrubs57pa tshad medasapas/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams chos nyid rab tu thob phyirapa'i phyir 'byung bar 'gyur te/ de la 'byung bar byed pa'am skye bar byed pa gang yang med de'i/ 'byung yang med pa'angarwadzom yin no/ /de ltar rgyal ba'i sras dag dpe'i sgo dang pos khong du chud par bya ba 'dis/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas skye ba 'byung ba khong du chud par bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gzhan yang 'di lta ste dper na/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams yongs su 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i tshe/ gcig tu stug〈nyecing tha mi 37—172

dad pa zhes bya ba'i sprin chen po'i char 'bab ste/ de ni stong gsum gyi stong chen ponyeyongs su grubalgepa'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor ma gtogs par sa'i phyogs gzhan gyisalgegazung ba'am bzodakyipar mi nus so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams 'byung5geba'i tshe/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs tha mi dad pa zhes pa'i7chos kyi sprin chen po'i char 'bab ste/ de ni byang chub sems dpa'50chen po de dag nyid kyi stobs dang shugs kyis bsgrubs pa'i sems kyi rgyud ma gtogs par byang chub sems dpa' bsam pa dma' bsnyecan dngamatho)/ nyan thos dang / rangalo tshosangs rgyas thams cad kyis gzung ba'am/ bzod par mi nus so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag khong du chud par bya ba'i sgo gnyis pa 'dis kyang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi skye ba 'byung ba khong du chud par bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gzhan yang 'di lta ste dper na/ sprin chen po'i char de dag 'bab pa'i tshe/ gang nas kyang 'ongs pa myed la gang du yang 'gro ba med rdogle / /sems can rnams kyi las kyi tshogs chen pos char 3gerab tu 'bab pa yang yod do//kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de bzhin durwartede bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyil tshochos kyi sprin chen po'i characa'abab pa yang gang nas kyang 'ongs pa med la/ gang du yang 'gro ba med de byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba'i stobs dang shugs chen pos/ char mngon par 'bab pa yang yod do/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag khong du chud par bya ba'i sgo gsum pa 'dis kyang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos/ de bzhin 37—173

gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi skye ba 'byung ba khong du chud par bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gzhan yang 'di lta ste dper na/ sprin chen po'i char mngon par 'bab nya)pa de dag ni stong gsum gyi stong chen por gtogs pa'i sems can thams cad kyis shes pa'am/ bgrang bar sla ba ma yin te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams su gtogs pa'i sems can rnams ni sprin chen po'i char de la sems pas rimago rmongs par 'gyur ro/ /sprin chen po'i char de la bltas sne)pas mig 'khrugs par 'gyur ro/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i dbang phyug chen po ni ma gtogs te/ de'i sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su sbyangs pa'i khyad par gyis / de la chung ngu na char pa'i thigs pa gcigashol kyang ma rig par mi 'bab po//kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa de dag yang dag par 'byung ba'i tshe/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par5ge'abab pa yang / sems can thams cad dang nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ri shes pa'am 7bsam par mi nus te/ de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi sprin gyi nachar la sems pas 9mgo rmongs par 'gyur ro/ /'gro therdzo ba thams cad kyi dbang phyug /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag ni ma gtogs te/ blo shin tu sbyangs pa'i mthu dang shugs kyis de dag la ni 11 chung ngu na tshig dang / yi ge 'ga' tsam yang ma rig par sems can 12gzhan gyi sems kyi rgyud la mi 'bab bo/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras 1 khong du chud par bya ba sgo ge bzhi pa 'dis kyang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi skye ba 37—174

'byung ba0)khong du chud par bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gzhan yang 'di lta ste dper na/ sprin chen po'i char de dag 'bab pa'i nang na/ rab tu zhi bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i sprin chen po'i char 'bab pa yod de/ de ni me'i phung po de rab tu zhi bar byed do/ /'byung bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i sprin chen po'iman char 'bab pa yod de/ de las chu'i phung po de dag 'byung ngo / /yongs su gcod pa zhes bya ba'i sprin chen po'i char 'bab pa yod de/ de ni chu'i phung po de dag yongs su gcod do/ /yongs su sgrub pa zhes bya ba'i sprin chen po'i char 'bab pa yod de/ de ni nor bu rin po che mang po yongs su 'grub par byed do/ /rnam par 'byed pa zhes bya ba'i sprin chen po'i char 'bab 5pa yod de/ de ni stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams de rnam par 'byed do/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de bzhin gshegs pa yang dag par 'byung ba la yang rab tu zhi bar byed pa zhes bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa'i rgyu mthun (4 pa'i chos kyi sprin chen po'i char 'bab pa yod de/ de ni sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa 'bar ba thams cad rab tu zhi bar 3 byed do/ /'byung bar byed pa zhes bya ba'irtso6)chos kyi sprin chen po'i char 'bab pa yod de/ de ni sems can thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba'i tshogs thams cad yang dag par 'byung bar byed do/ /yongs su gcod pa zhes bya ba chos kyi sprin chen po'i char 'bab pa yod de/ de ni sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa dang lta ba'i rnam pa thams cad yongs su gcod do/ /yongs su sgrubs7)pa zhes bya ba chos kyi sprin chen po'i char 'bab pa yod de/ de ni thams cad mkhyen pa'i chos rin po che yongs su grub par byed do/ /rnam par 'byed pa zhes bya ba chos kyi sprin chen po'i char 'bab pa yod de/ de ni sems 37—175

can thams cad kyi sems dang bsam pa rnam par 'byed do/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag khong du chud par bya ba'i sgo lnga pa 'dis kyang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi skye ba 'byung ba khong du chudatre①par bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag 'di lta ste dper na/ char sprin chen po yang ro gcig la chu'i phung po yang rnam par mi rtog ②mod kyi de ltar rnam pa tshad med par tha dad pa'i char rnam par phye ba 'bab bo/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de bzhin du ①de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs rje chen po'i char sprin ro gcig pa las/ de ltar tshad med cing rnam pa tha dad pa'i chos kyi char sna tshogs 'bab ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa ④yang yongs su 'byung ngo / /chos rnam par phye ba tshad med pa yang snang zhing yod rga/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag khong du chud par bya ba'i sgo drug pa 'dis kyang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi skye ba 'byung ba khong du chud par bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gzhan yang 'di lta ste/ dper na/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po yongs su 'grub par 'gyur ba'i tshe/ thog ma nyid du gzugs la spyod pa'i lha'i bu rnams kyi gzhal med khang yongs su 'grub par 'gyur ro de'i 'og tu 'dod pa la spyod pa'i lha'i bu rnams kyi gzhal med khang yongs su 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de'i 'og tu mi rnams kyi gnas yongs su 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de'i 'og tu de ma yin pa'i sems can lhag ma gzhan rnams kyi gnas rnam56)par phye ba sna tshogs 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de bzhin du〈pede bzhin gshegs pa yang dag par 'byung ba'i tshe/ yang thog ma nyid du byang chub 37—176

sems dpa'i ye shes kyi7rgyud rnams 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i 'og tu rang sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi rgyud rnams 'byung ngo / /de'i 'og tu nyan thos kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba'i ye shes kyi rgyud rnams 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i 'og tu de ma yin pa'i sems can gzhan gyi (mi'adus byas kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba dang shes pa'i rgyud rnams 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de ltarashedaper na/ char sprin chen po yang ro gcig la chu'i phung po yang rnam par mi rtog pa las/ sems can gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba rnam pa tha dad pas gzhal med khang rnam pa tha dad pa yod cing snang ngo / /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs rje chen po'i char sprin ro gcig pa las/ sems can gyi snod rnam pa tha dad pa'i phyir / dge ba'i rtsa ba rnam pa tha dad pa yod gecing snang bar 'gyur ro9ge/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag khong du chud par bya ba'i sgo bdun pa 'dis kyang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par ༅rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas skye ba 'byung ba khong du chud par bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gzhan yang 'di lta ste dper na/ chus 'jig pa'i bskal9)pa chen po byung50ste/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams gang rtsi)chen mtsho gcig tu gyur pa'i tshe/ chos nyid thob pas de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba'i yon tan rin po ches rnam par brgyan 1 )pa zhes bya ba'i pad mo mang po 'byung ste/ de dag gis 11ni chu'i bskal pa thams cad kun nas khebs so/ /de dag ni 'jig rten thams cad 'od kyis rgyas par 'gengs the te/ pad mo de dag byung ba dang lha'i bu dbang phyug chen po dang / gnas gtsang ma'i ris 32kyi lha'i bu gzhan rnams kyis kyang / bskal pa 'di la ni nyirwayang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 37—177

'di snyed cig 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes bya bsho1)khong du chud do/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams yongs su 'grub pa'i tshe/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor dag cing 'od gsal ba zhes bya ba ldang ste/ de ni gzugs la spyod pa'i lha rnams kyi gzhal med khang yongs su gnas par byed do//rlung gi dkyil 'khor dag cing dang la 'od gsal bas rgyan bzang po zhes bya ba ldang ste/ de ni 'dod pa la spyod pa'i lha'i bu rnams kyi lha'i gzhal med khang yongs su 'god do/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor gcig tu stug (5)cing tha mi dad pa zhes bya ba ldang ste/ de ni khor 5yug dang khor ri4)yug chen po'i ri rnams yongs su gzhog pa byed do/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor khyad par du 'phags pas④zhes bya ba ldang ste/ de ni ri rab ri'i rgyal po yongs su gzhog pa byed do/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor brtan pa 6zhes bya ba ldang ste/ de ni rin po che me)bcu yongs su gzhog pa0nibyed do/ /bcu gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ seng ldeng can dang / drang srong ri'udang ske/ bdud las rgyal dang / bdud las shin tu rgyal tshadang / gnya' shing 'dzin dang / sa 'dzin dang / btang bzung dang / btang bzung 1)chen po hu dang ske/ spos kyi ngad can dang / kha ba can no/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor rab tu gnas pa zhes bya ba ldang ste/ de ni sa chen po kun nas gnas par byed do/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor rnam par bkod pa zhes bya ba ldang ste/ de ni sa bla'i lha dang ske/ klu dang dri za'i khyim kun nas gnas par byed do/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor mdzod mi zad pa zhes bya ba ldang ste/ de ni stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams su gtogs pa'i rgya mtsho chen po kun nas gnas par byed do//rlung gi dkyil 'khor rnam par snang ba'i dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba ldang ste/ de ni 37—178

stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 11'jig rten gyi khams gyi rin po che'i rigs thams cad kun nas gnas par byed do/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor rtsa ba brtan pa zhes bya ba ldang ste/ de ni yid bzhin gyi shing thams cad kun nas gnas par byed do/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras ci de ltar char sprin chen po'i char ro gcig tu 'bab ri )pa dang /chu'i phung po rnam par mi rtog pa las/ chos nyid thob pa dang / 54)sems can rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba tha dad pa'i khyad par gyis/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor rnam pa 45)tha dad pa yod cing snang ngo / /rlung gi dkyil 'khor rnam pa tha dad par gyur pas/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 6'jig rten gyi khams kyang yod cing snang ngo / /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de bzhin du /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dge ba'i rtsa ba'i tshogs thams cad shin tu bstsags (8 pa/ bla na med pa'i ye shes chen po snang ba la mngon du 9gyur pa rnams 'byung ba'i tshe/ ye shes kyi 'od zer chen po bsam gyis 1 mi khyab pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs rgyun mi gcod 11pa zhes bya 12ba 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa thams cad rgyas par 'gengs pa nya 'byung ste/ 'od zer des ni de bzhin 1 rigashegs pa dang / dbang bskur ba thob pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis kyang / byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyed cig de bzhin gshegs pa'i mthu 'dis yang dag par 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /zhes bya bar thugs sumanya5chud do/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i tshe/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs 'byung ba'i mthus/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi 'od zer chen po 'od bzang po dri ma med pa zhes bya ba 'byung ste/ 'od zer des de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi ye shes zag pa med 37wa 179

cing mi zad pa yang dag par 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi 1)'od zer chen po kun tu snang ba zhes bya ba 'byung ste/ 'od zer des de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab pa chos kyi dbyings su gzhol ba yang dag par 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi 'od zer chen po de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs yang dag par 'byung ba zhes bya ba 'byung ste/ 'od zer des de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi stobs mi skul ba yang dag par 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi 'od zer chen po zil gyis mi non cing / yang dag par 'phags pa zhes bya ba 'byung ste / 'od zer des de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi stobs dang mi bsnyengs pa zil gyis mi non pa'i ye shes yang dag par 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi 'od zer chen po thams cad mngon par mkhyen pa zhes bya ba 'byung ste/ 'od zer des de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi ye shes thams cad du brjod pa las 'das shing thams cad du thogs pa med pa yang dag par 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi 'od zer chen po sprul pas mngon par bsgrubs55)pa zhes bya ba 'byung ste/ 'od zer des de bzhin gshegs pa risamathong zhing thos pa dang de dang 'grogs pa don yod pas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba chud mi za ba'i ye shes yang dag par 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi 'od zer chen po mnyam pa nyid kyi rjes su song ba zhes bya ba 'byung ste / 'od zer des de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi bsod nams dang / ye shes mi zad pa'i tshogs 'gro ba thams cad nye bar 'tsho ba yang dag par 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi 'od zer chen po 'jug par 37—180

dka'atub zhes bya ba 'byung ste/ 'od zer des de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi ye shes dkon⑧mchog gsum gyi'i )rigs rgyun mi gcod cing / ye shes zab mo thugs su chud pa yang dag par 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi 'od zer chen po rgyanasnyisna tshogs can zhes bya ba 'byung ste/ 'od zer des de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi ye shes mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis zhi)'gro ba thams cad rnam pa thams cad du dga' bar 'gyur ba yang dag par 'grub bo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i yiye shes kyi 'od zer chen pospyomi 'phrogs pa zhes bya ba 'byung ste/ 'od zer des de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi ye shes sangs rgyas kyi yul chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs par sku tshe'i tshad rgyun mi 'chad pa yang dag par 'grub par 'gyur te/kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i thugs rje chen po'i char sprin chen po ro gcig pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi 'od zer gyi dkyil 'khor chen po ro gcig pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'asnyeyang dag par bsgrubs pa'i chos nyid thob pa dang / sems can gyi bsam pa dang / dbang po dang / brtson 'grus rnam pa tha dad pa'i chos nyid thob pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyis49)'od zer rang bzhin gcig pa lasarwa )rnam pa tha dad du gyur pa yod cing snang ngo / /ye shes kyi 'od zer rnam pa tha dad pa las de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba yang dag par 'grub pa rnam pa tha dad pa yang yod cing snang ngo / /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de bzhin gshegs pa yang dag par 'grub pa rnam par phye ba'i ro gcig pa las yon tan rnam pa tha dad pa'i rgyan tshad med bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung zhing de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs〈137—181

kyis sems can rnams kyis kyang / de bzhin du shes par 'gyur ba la ltos/kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de ni 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi byin gyis ma brlabs 11na sems can sngon cad 5de bzhin gshegs pa la dge ba'i rtsa ba ma bskyed pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes la chung ngu na cha shas gcig tsam bstan pa yang shes par 'gyur ba'am/khong du chud par 'gyur ba'i gnas med skabs med de/ de ni gnas ma yin no//kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i mthu'i khyad par gyis/sems can rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes chen po'i mthu la 'jug cing rtog pa dang / khong du chud par byed kyang / de bzhin gshegs pa la rtog pa mi mnga' / rnam par rtog pa mi mnga' ste/ 'byung ba med cing kun nasam sna'abyung ba med la yang dag par 'grub pa med de/ bya ba med cing de la byed pa su'ang rib)med mod kyi/ yang dag par 'byung ba'i grangs su bgrang ba yang yod do/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag khong du chud par bya ba'i/ sgo brgyad pa 'dis kyang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas skye ba 'byung ba khong du chud par bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gzhan yang 'di lta ste/ dper na/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor chu'i phung pos zheri'adzin pa bzhi neni/ nam mkha' la gnas shing lding mngo / /bzhi gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor brtan pa dang / rlung gi dkyil 'khor gnas pa dang ske/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor mi nyams napa dang / rlung gi dkyil 'khor snying po dang ldan pa zhes bya ba dag ste/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor chen po de bzhi ni 59rab tu lding zhing chu'i phung po 'dzin te/ chu'i phung po la gnas pa'i sa chen po ni mi 37—182

'jig /rnam par mi 'jig pas de'i phyir sa ni chu la gnas so/ /chu ni rlung la gnas so/ /rlung ni nam mkha' la gnas so/ /nam mkha' ni mi gnas pa zhes bya ste/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams ni tshul de lta bur gnas so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag /de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi rlung gi dkyil 'khor chen po shes rab kyi snang ba chags pa med pa la gnas pa bzhi ldang ste/ de dag ni 'gro ba thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su 'dzin to/ /bzhi gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi rlung gi dkyil 'khor chen po bsdu bas 1sems can yongs su dga' bar 'gyur ba zhes bya ba dang / ye shes kyi rlung gi dkyil 'khor chen po chos rnam par dgod pa la 'gro ba mos par byed pa zhes bya ba dang / ye shes kyi rlung gi dkyil 'khor chen po dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad yongs su srung ba zhes bya ba dang / ye shes kyi rlung gi dkyil 'khor chen po 'khor ba thams cad zag pa med pa'i dbyings su khong du chud pa zhes bya ba dag ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag bzhi po de ri dag ni shes rab kyi snang ba chags pa med pa la gnas pa'i ye shes kyi rlung gi dkyil 'khor chen po rnams te/ de dag ni 'gro ba thams cad byams pa chen pos yongs su bskyab pa dang / thugs rje chen pos 'gro ba thams cad yongs su dgrol zhing gzung ba'i phyir ldang ste/ byams pa chen po dang ske/ snying rje chen po la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' ni/ 'gro ba mang po rnam par phye ba 'byam la klas pa'i nang na thabs mkhas pa la gnas pa'i byams pa chen pos/ sems can thams cad nye bar 'tsho ba yin te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba ni tshul de lta bur 'grub cing / de ltar 37—183

gnas pa yin te/ shes rab kyi snang ba chags pa med pa ni mi gnas pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag khong du chud par bya ba'i sgo dgu pa 'dis kyang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi skye ba 'byung ba khong du chud par bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag gzhan yang 'di lta ste dper na/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams grubar3)pa ni tshad med pa'i sems can rnams yongs su spyod pa ge rnam pa tha dad pas nye bar 'tsho ba yin te/ 'di ltar chu la gnas pa'i sems can rnams kyang gnas kyis nye bar 'tsho ba yin/ sems can sa'i steng na 'khod pa rnams kyang sa'i steng na yod pa'i rnam pa tshad med pas nye bar 'tsho ba yin / gzhal med khang na gnas pa rnams kyang gzhal med khang gis/ nye bar 'tsho ba yin/ nam mkha' la gnas pa rnams kyang bar snang gi ②gnas kyis nye bar 'tsho ba yin/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de bzhin dusade bzhin gshegs pa yang dag par 'grub 45)pa yang rnam pa tshad med pas 'gro ba thams cad nye bar 'tsho ba yin te/ 'di ltar mthong b.ralo)dga' ba dang / dad cing mos par gyur pa'i sems can rnams kyang sangs rgyas mthong bas nye bar 'tsho ba yin/tshul khrims kyi stobs kyi rtsimathu la gnas pa rnams kyang sangs rgyas kyi tshul khrims kyis 8)nye bar 'tsho ba yin/ bsam gtan dang tshad med pa la gnas pa rnams kyang 'phags pa'i 49)'jig rten las 'das pa'i mngon par shes pas nye bar 'tsho ba yin/ chos kyi sgo snang ba la gnas pa rnams kyang rgyu chud mi za bas nye bar 'tsho ba yin/ snang ba med 8pa la gnas pa rnams kyang chos 'byam〈nyaklas pa chud mi za bas nye bar 'tsho ba yin pas12/ de'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa yang dag 37—184

par 'grubatupa ni 'gro ba thams cad nye bar 'tsho ba yin zhes bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag khong du chud par bya ba'i sgo〈rnam pa bcu pa〈mi'adis kyang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gekyi skye ba 'byung ba khong du chud par bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos de bzhin gshegs pa skye ba 'byung ba bstan pa ni de lta bur shes par bya ste/ spyod pa yongs su bsgrub pa tshad med pas na/ tshad med par shes par bya'o/ /phyogs bcu thams cad rgyas par 'gengs ⑤pas na shin tu yangs par shes par bya'o/ /skye ba dang 'jig pa'i gnas dang bral bas na len pa med cing 'dor ba ༷myed par shes parashebya'o/ /sems dang yid dang rnam par shes pa dang bral bas na rgyu ba med cing rgyu ba dang bral bar shes par bya'o/ /nam mkha'i rang bzhin lta bu yin pas na / lus med par shes par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad la bdag med pas na mnyam par shes par bya'o/ /sems can thams cad la zad mi shes pa'i zhing du gyur pas na mi zad par shes par bya'o/ /phyi ma'i mtha'i mur thug par rgyun mi 'chad pas na/ phyir mi ldog par shes parashebya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes la gnyen po med pas na mi 'phrogs par shes par bya'o/ /'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas mnyam pa nyid du thugs su chud pas na/ mi gnyis par shes par bya'o / /sngon yongs su smin par byas pa'ishesems can gyi bsam pa'i khyad par yongs su rdzogs par mdzad pas na/ 'gro ba thams cad nye bar 'tsho bar shes par bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras dag tshade dag la stsogs07pa rnam par byang ba 1gernam pa tha dad pa tshad med pa shin tu bstan pa'i sgos hurtebyang chub sems dpa' sems 37—185

dpa' chen pos de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung zhing yang dag par 'grub pa bstan pa shes par bya'o/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang pos don 'di nyid yang brtag par bya ba'i nyuphyir/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /'jig rten kun las 'das shing stobs bcu mnga' 2gyur te/ /mi mnyam mnyams dang mnyam zhing lke bar snang gemakha' mnyam pa'i / /mgon po rnams kyi spyod yul mtshungs med mtha' yas nyon/ /de dag 'jig rten kun na yon tan mtshungs pa med/ /stobs bcu yon tan tshad med mnga' bam thams cad kyin/ /mthu la 9sems dang yid kyi tshul gyis mi bsam ste//skyes bu seng ge rnams ni 'jig rten thams cad kyis/ /sgo rnams re rer sabaskal pa bye bar mi dpogs 11so/ /phyogs bcu kun nas 1 zhing rnams ji snyed yod pa 1 rnams/ /skyes bu la las bshig ste rdul phran bgrang nus kyang / /des ni stobs bcu mnga' ba'i spu 3 gcig yon tan yang / /bskal pa khrag khrig brgyas kyang tshad gzung mi nus so/ /skyes bu la la nam mkha'i dbyings la 'jal byed cing / /de ltar la las rtsis 'go mabazung ste bgrang byas kyang / /gzhal bar mi nus mtha' yang lornyed par mi rung ba1 / /de bzhin bde gshegs rnams kyi spyod yul tshad kyang med/ /dus gsum sems can rnams kyi rigs rgyud ji snyed dang / /de dag dus gsum spyod pa sems can 'ga' 18zhig gis/ /sems kyi skad cig yud 19kyis shes kyang 'gro snyed 2 kyi/ /bskal pas thams cad zil gnon rang bzhin shes mi nus/ /ji ltar chos kyi dbyings ni kun tu mtha' yas shing ske/ /kun yin thams cad ma yin mi snang gzung du med/ /de bzhin stobs bcu mnga' ba'i spyod yul tshad med de/ /thams cad yin yang 21kun min chos 37wa 186

dbyings rang bzhin yin①/ /de bzhin nyid ni de bzhin nyid du mi rtog zhing ge/kun nas 'byung ba med cing nam yang nub pa med/ /de bzhin 'jig rten kun 'das de dag spyod yul te/ /de bzhin nyid dang tshul mtshungs 'phel dang 'grib 2pa spangs/ /yang dag mtha' ni mtha' med mtha' la gnas pa ste/ /dus gsum kun dang du ge)rnam pa kun tu rnam par bral/ /de bzhin mgon po phan mdzad kun gyi spyod yul te/ /dus gsum rgyas mdzad rnam pa 5kun tu chags mi mnga' / /rang bzhin byas pa med pas rnam par 'gyur ba med/ /rang bzhin mkha' 'dra dri med nyon mongs med pa ste/ /de bzhin rgyal ba rnams kyi rang bzhin kun tu dag /rang bzhin 'gyur dang bral zhing yod dang med pa min/ /sgra dang tshig las rnam grol dbyangs 6)rnams thams cad med/ /'gro dang 'od bral tsa)rnam rtog med pas mya ngan 'das/ /de bzhin stobs bcu mnga' 'chiba'i spyod yul rang bzhin med/ /tshig gi rang bzhin kun gyis brjod par mi nus so//de ltar chos kun rang bzhin zhi ba mkhyen gyur pas/ /ji ltar nam mkha'i rlung dang bya rjes 'dra ba ste/ /sngon chad smon lam mdzad pa 9rigazugs kyi skur yang snang ske/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba rnams kyi cho 1 'phrul ci 'dra ltos/ /rgyal ba'i spyod yul 'di la 'jug par su 'dod pa/ /des ni nam mkha' 'dra ba bsam nyu1 pa yongs su spyongs3 / /rtog dang rnam par rtog dang 'du shes 'dzin spangs te1snyel/ /nam mkha' lta bu'i yid kyis de la 'jug par gyis/ /de bas bde gshegs sras rnams mgon po'i spyod yul rnams/ /bdag gis dpe tsam chung shas bshad kyis mnyan par gyisang/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba'i yon tan mthar phyin mi nus kyang / /shas tsam shes par bya ba'i don du chung 15zad brjod/ /de 37—187

dag sku yi phrin las ji ltar 'byung ba dang / /mgon po rnams kyi gsung dang thugs kyi spyod yul dang / /stobs bcu rnams kyi yul dang 'khor lo bskoratub dang ske/ /mya ngan 'da' dang dge rtsa thams cad bshad kyis59nyon/ /'jig rten 'di dag ma lus skye zhing 'byung ba'i tshe/ /de la rgyu yi rnam grangs gcig ces bgrang med kyi/ /rgyu dang tshul gyi rnam pa khrag khrig brgya mang gis / /'jig rten stong gsum kun nas gnas pa'i grangs su 'gro/ /de bzhin skyes bu'i ④mchog rnams skye bar 'gyur ba'i tshe/ /de dag yon tan 'di snyed yin zhes bgrangs3)ba med/ /rdul dang rdul phran bgrang nus sems can kun bsam nus/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba rnams kyi 'byung ba rnams la min/ /ji ltar sprin dang dus kyi char la brten (nyabyas shing / /char chen 'bebs byed rlung rnams bzhi po de bzhin te/ /dge rtsa kun dang byang chub sems dpa'i mthus/ /'jig rten stong gsum kun nas gnas pa'i grangs su 'gro/ /de bzhin stobs bcu rnams kyi chos sprin rgyur byas shing / /bsam pa rnam dag byed pa'i ye shes rlung ldang ste/ /sngon gyi dge ba chosarkyen skyes 2)rigs par yongs ri()bsngos pas/ /stobs bcu mgon po rnams ni 'byung zhing skye bar 'gyur/ /steng gi 1 )mkha'i dbyings las sprin chen char brugs nyu1pa/ /stong gsum stong chen 'jig rten kun nas 'jig 'gyur tshe/ /mkha' dbyings rgya chen dag pa'i rlung langs tsho ma gtogs par/ /sa phyogs tunyegazhan gyis bzod cing gzung gebar mi nus so/ /de bzhin stobs bcu mnga' ba 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i /5tshe/ /phyogs bcu kun gyi chos dbyings yongs su rgyas bkang zhing / /chos tshul char chen 'bab par gyur la lhag pa'i sems/ /rnam par dag pa ma gtogs gzhan gyis 'dzin mi nus/ /nam mkha'i dbyings las 37—188

sprin chen char pa 'bab gyur pa/ /de la 'gro dang 'ong ba nam yang yod pa min①/ /de la byed pa med de tshor ba po yang med/ /de dag chos nyid thob 'byung rnam pa gzhan gyis min/ /de bzhin stobs bcu mnga' ba'i chos sprin char 'bab pa②/ /de dag 'pho dang 'ong ba yod pa ma yin yang / /byang chub sems dpa'i mthu dang legs par spyad pa'i rgyus/ /byang chub sems dpa'i chos kyi rang bzhin sprin kyang 'byung / /sprin gyi char bkye char thigs yongs su bgrang nus pa'i / /sems can de 'dra khams gsum 'di nasko —nayod pa min/ /stong gsum dbang po'i dbang phyug de ni ma gtogs te/ /dbang bsgyurasnyide ni sngon gyi smon lam 'bras bus bgrang / /de bzhin bde gshegs char chen 'bab pa ma lus par / /sems can kun gyis bgrang bsapo)gzhal bar sla ba min/ /'jig rten kun na 'gro ba'i mchog gyur dbang phyug rnams/ /de dag sprin chen char chen7rin chen lag bkod dzo/ /rab tu zhi byed zhi byed 'byung bshoga'abyung bar byed/ /gzhan yang yongs su gcod pa de ni yongs su gcod/ /sgrub pa de bzhin gzhan te de ni rin chen sgrubaskyu/ /rnam par 'byed pa stong gsum thams cad rnam par 'byed / /stobs bcu mnga' ba'i zhing tu sprin nyon mongs kun zhir byed/ /'byung ba dge stong nyunyebargya 'grangs nyi kun nas 'byung bar byed/ /yongs su gcod pa lta ba'i rnam pa yongs gcod de/ /rgyal ba'i rin chen 1)sgrub cing bsam pa rnam par 'byed/ /bar snang mkha' las char 'bab ji ciltar ro gcig kyang ske/ /gnas kyi khyad 8kyis yongs su 'gyur ba sna tshogs mang / /'on kyang chu la rtog med rnam par rtog pa med/ /tha dad rnam pa 'grangasalgepa de dag chos nyid tshul/ /de bzhin chos kyang gcig min tha dad ma yin te/ /ro gcig zhi 37—189

zhing rtog med rnam par rtogam/med de/ /'on kyang sangs rgyas chos 'grangasakhumu med 'byung bar 'gyur/ /de ni rdul bralashogyirnams kyi chos nyid tshul yin no/ /ji ltar thog mar gzugs khams gzhal med khang pa 'byung / /de nas 'dod khams gzhal med khang rnams rnam par 'god/ /de nas sa stengs/mi yi gnas rnams cho5)rnam bkod de/ /de nas klu dang dri za 'gro ba kun gyi gnas/ /de bzhin stobs bcu mnga' ba de dag 'byung ba'i tshe/ /thog mar byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa mu med 'byung / /de nas zhi dga' rang rgyal theg la gnas pa stsornyirnams / /de nas dbang du gyur pa'i de nas 'gro kun gyi/ /ji ltar pad mo sangs rgyas skye ba'i ltas gyur pas/ /sngon chad masangs rgyas mthong ba'i lha rnams dgar 8)'gyur zhing / /chu las 59)brten cing 'od gsal gzhal med khang yang 'byung ske/ /rlung las 1 )'jig rten ris nya1 ris cha char 'god pa byed/ /sangs rgyas sngon gyi nyusnyedage ba'i nyurte'od gsal ltas yin te/ /des rnyini sangs rgyas rgyal sras kun gyi thugs chud 'gyur/ /ye shes yongs dag dkyil 'khor mkha' ltar rnam dag pa'i/ /stobs bcu tha dad ji snyed sangs rgyas chos 'byung mkhyen/ /rlung ni 15chu phung ma lus kun gyi gnas yin te/ /de 7phyir sa steng nyi gnas rnams 'jig par mi 'gyur ro/ /sa yang shing dang gel pa 1 sman gyi gnas yin te/ /mkha' la gnas su bya ba gang yang med pa yin/ /mgon po rnams kyang shes rab ye shes gzhi 19la bzhugs/ /ye shes thugs rje byams pa thabs kyis yongs su bzung 2 / /rgyal ba'i chos rnams ji snyed de dag thabs 31su 'dus/ /rdul med shes rab de ni gnas med lus kyang med/ /'jig rten byung nas tshad med mang po kun kyang 'tsho/ /sa la gnas dang chu la gnas pa thams cad dang / /nam 37wa 190

mkha'i lha rdzas ①gzhal med khang la gnas pa dang / /rkang gnyis rkang bzhi sems can thams cad nye bar 'tsho/ /de bzhin skyes mchog dbang po chos kyi rgyal skyes pa/ /'gro ba ma lus thams cad nye bar 'tsho ba yin/ /mthong zhing thos par gyur dang mchod pas de bzhin te/ nyon mongs bstsal du bas sems can thams cad nye bar 'tsho/ /'byung ba mthar thug med pas 'jig rten mgo' /rmongs 'gyur/ /'on kyang 'gro la phan donasabyasems can shes bya'i phyir/ /mi mkhas 3)'gro ba bstan phyir ye shes bstan don du/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi don rab dpe med dpes brjod do// // sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo5)/ bam po dgu〈)pa/ de skad ces smras pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su byung ba'i dpal gyis/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku bltar yod pa ji lta bur khong du chud par bya de skad ces smras pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang pos/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su byung ba'i dpal la 'di skad ces smras so//kye rgyal ba'i sras de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku bltar yod pa ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos tshad med pa'i rjes su 'gro bas khong du chud par bya'o / /kye rgyal ba'i sras de ci'i phyir zhe na/ da ni na de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku bltar yod pa ni byang chub sems dpa'am9chos gcig gam/ rnam pa gcig gam/37—191

sku gcig gam/ zhing gcig gam/ sems can gcig0)gis khong du chud par bya ba ma yin te/ 2/kye rgyal ba'i srasaX de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku bltar yod pa ni thams cad du munarjes su song bar byang chub sems dpas()khong du chud paraponabya'ol/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i dbyings ni thams cad kyi rjes su song ba ste/ 'dod pa dang gzugs yod pa dang / gzugs med pa'i gnas thams cad du khyab pa yin yang / gang du'ang song ba med cing rjes su 0)song ba med par shes par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni nam mkha' la gzugs med pa'i phyir ro/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de bzhin dusade bzhin gshegs pa'i sku yang thams cad kyi rjes su song ba ste/ sems can thams cad dang ske/ chos thams cad dang / zhing thams cad kun tu khyab par shes par bya'o/ /'on kyang gar yang gshegs pa med cing rjes su bzhud pa med ⑨de/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku la lus med pa'i phyir te/sems can gyis rnam par dmigs pa yod pa'i phyir skur bstan pa yang yod do/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos khong du chud par bya ba'i sgo dang po 'dis de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku bltar yod par 31shes par bya'o / /kye rgyal ba'i sras gzhan yang 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' la yinegazugs med de/ yangs shing rgya che ba'i phyir sems can thams cad7kyi bya ba snang zhing yod par 'gyuramasate/ nam mkha' la rtog pa med do/ /spros pa med dol/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku ye shes kyi 'od snang ba la brtenadzagecing / sems can thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa brtsoskyelas 'jig rten pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa rnams yod cing snang bar gyur kyang / de 37—192

bzhin gshegs pa'i sku la rnam par rtog pa mi mnga' ste/ spros pa mi mnga' 'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku ni thog maspyinas spros pa thams cad yang dag par chad pa'i phyir ro/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos khong du chud par byasheba'i sgo gnyis pa 'dis kyang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku bltar yod par 7shes par bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras gzhan yang 'di lta ste dper na/ 'dzam bu'i gling du nyi ma shar ba ni 'od kyis tshad med par khyab pas/ sems can rnams tshad med pabarnam pas nye bar 'tsho ste / 'di ltar ri la bab cing rtswa dang nags tshal skye bar byed pas kyang nye bar 'tsho ba yin/ mun pa'i mun nag yongs su sel cingasnyisnang bar byed pas kyang nye bar 'tsho ba yin/ sa la bab cing 'dam rdzab yongs su skemarnyupas kyang nye bar 'tsho ba yin/ lo thog ⑦la bab cing yongs su smin par byed pas kyang nye bar 'tsho ba yin/ nags tshal dang gel pa dang sman la bab cing skye ba dang rnam par 'phel bar byed pas kyang nye bar 'tsho ba yin/ nam mkha' la bab pas po/kyang bar snang la spyod pa'i sems can rnams nye bar 'tsho ba yin/ pad mo'i nags tshal la bab kyang kha 'bye zhing rgyas par byed pas (1)nye bar 'tsho ba yin/grong dang grong khyer dang / ljongs dang pho brang 'khor dang / rgyal po'i gnas la bab kyang gzugs sna tshogs gsal bar ston pas nye bar 'tsho ba yin/ chu la bab kyang chu la gnas pa'i sems can yongs su longs spyod pas nye bar 'tsho ba yin / las kyi rnam pa sna tshogs la bab kyang dgos pa brtsams pa yongs su grub par byed pas nye bar 'tsho ba yin/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyis 7'od zer tshad med pa bkye ba'i phyir ro/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de 37—193

bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku bltar yod pa'i nyi ma yang rnam pa tshad med pas / sems can thams cad nye bar 'tsho ba yin te/ 'di ltar dge ba'i las yongs su bskyed 1)cing sdig pa'i las rnam par zlog 40pas kyang nye bar 'tsho ba yin / shes rab kyi 'od snang bar sa mdzad cing gti mug gi mun pa rnam par sel bas kyang la nye bar 'tsho ba yin/ 'gro ba thams cad yongs su skyob cing byams pa chen po dang ldan pas kyang nye bar 'tsho ba yin/ 'gro ba thams cad yongs su 'grel ci'icing thugs rje chen po dang ldan pas kyang nye bar 'tsho ba yin/dbang po dang stobs dang / byang chub kyi yan lag 'phel bar mdzad cing /chos kyi lo thog 6la bab pas kyang nye bar 'tsho ba yin/ sems can gyi rnyog pa yongs su sel bas dad 47)pa bskyed pas kyang nye bar 'tsho ba yin/ rgyu dang 'bras bu rnam par chud mi za bas mthong ba don yod pas kyang / nye bar 'tsho ba yin / skye ba dang 'pho ba yang dag par ston cing / gzugs snang bar mdzad pas kyang nye bar 'tsho ba yin/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rnam par chud mi gzon 3)cing khong khro ba mi mnga' bas kyang nye bar 'tsho ba yin/ slob ma'i yon tan pad mo'i spukha phye zhing rgyas par mdzad de/ sems can rnams la ye shes kyi 'od zer tshad med pa rab tu gtong bas kyang nye bar 'tsho ba yin/ spyad pa brtsams chopa yongs su grub par 11mdzad cing / byang chub sems dpa'i spro ba bskyed pas kyang nye bar 'tsho ba yin/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku'i lha nyi ma ni ye shes kyi 'od zer 12dkyil 'khor tshad med pa dang ldan pa'i phyir ro/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub 7sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos khong du chud par bya ba'i sgo gsum pa 'dis kyang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku bltar yod par skushes 37—194

par bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras gzhan yang 'di lta ste dper na/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 4)de nyid 'dzam bu'i 5)gling du 'char ba'i tshe/ thog ma nyid du ri'i rgyal po chen po 'di lta ste/ ri rab ri'i rgyal po la snang bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i 'og tu de ma yin pa'i ri chen po gzhan la snang bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i 'og tu ri nag po dag la'ang snang bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i 'og tu sa phyogs mthon po rnams su snang bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i 'og tu 'dzam bu'i gling 'di'i tshephyogs dma' ba dag kyang snang bar byed de42/ 'on kyang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la 'dir ni thog ma nyid du 'od zer dgye'o zhe'am / 'dir ni thog mar snang bar bya'o/ /zhes bya ba'i rnam par rtog pa med de/ spros pa med kyang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od mnyam du gtong zhing 'char ba ni med pa ma yin te/ sa mthon dman gyi khyad par gyis mtho mtho la sngar 'char ro/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi ye shes kyi sku 9)nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor yang chos kyi dbyings mtha' dang dbus myed pa'i rigs〈kyesu 'char bar gyur pa'i 7)tshe/ rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par thogs pa med pa'i ye shes kyi 'od zer snang ba 'gyed de/ /de yongs su bkye ba'i tshe yang thog ma nyid du lhag pa'i bsam pa ri'i rgyal po chen po lta bu dang ldan pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams la/ chos kyi snang ba chen po yang dag par ston pa'i tshul du 'char bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i 'og tu nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg par zhugs pa rnams la 'char bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i 'og tu dge ba'i rtsa ba nges pa dang ldan pa'i sems can rnams la bsam pa'i snod ji lta ba bzhin du ye shes kyi snang ba chen po yang dag par bstan 1 ripa'i tshul gyis 'char bar 'gyur ro/ /de'i 'og 37—195

tu chung ngu na log par nges pa'i sems can yan chad/ sems can thams cad la'ang de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi 'od zer chen po nya)'char bar 'gyur ro/ /de ltar shar nas kyang sems can rnams la shin tu phan par 'gyur ②te/ ma 'ongs pa'i rgyu yang yongs su smin par mdzad cing / dge ba'i chos kyis rnam par 'phel bar mdzad kyang (rnyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi sku nyi ma'i 'od zer de dag ni sems can 'di rnams la/ bdag cag gis thog ma nyid du theg pa chen pos snang bar byas te0/ de'i 'og tu bsam pa 'bring dang ldan pa rnams la/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pas rnam par dag par bya ba'i phyir snang bar bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu sems can dge ba'i bsam pa can mos pa'i theg pa dang ldan pa rnams la bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du yongs su smin par bya ba'i tshul gyis snang bar bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu chung ngu na sems can log par ranges pa yan chad5sku/ sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa yongs su sbyang bar 7bya'o/ /ltas rib bsrang bar bya'o zhes rnam par rtog pa mi mnga'/ spros pa mi mnga' ste/ 'on kyang 'od zer mnyam par 'gyed pas/ 'od zer gyi mnyam pa nyid ri9)kun tu bsgribs tsho pa med par sems can thams cad la rab tu snang bar 'gyuras/1te/ de ni nyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi sku nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la rnam par rtog pa mi mnga' 3)ba'i phyir ro/ /de yang 'di lta ste dper na/nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rnam par rtog pa med cing / 'od zer mnyam pa nyid du 'char yang ri chen po rnams la rnam pa tha dad du snang bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi sku nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rnam par rtog pa mi mnga' zhing / 'od zer mnyam pa nyid du 'char yang sems can rnams kyi dge 37—196

ba'i rtsa ba rnam pa tha dad pa dang / bsam pa'i rnam pa tha dad pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od zer rnam pa tha dad pa yang snang zhing yod do/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos khong du chud par bya ba'i sgo bzhi patu'adis kyang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku bltar yod paradza gshes par bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras gzhan yang 'di lta ste dper na/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de nyid shar kyang sems can dmus long rnams kyi mig lam du snang bar mi 'gyur te/ de ni mig dang mi ldan pa'i phyir ro/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de ltar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de sems can dmus long〈rnams mig dang mi ldan pa'i phyir mig lam du mi snang du zin gyis kyang / sems can dmus longs)rnams la yangalo' nyi mar gdags pa dang / kha zas 'ju ba dang / bde bar spyod pa dang /lus kyi grang ba bstsal ri4pa dang / lus yang ba dang / myig nad dang / lus la gnas pa'i nad rlung ngam/ mkhris pa'am/ bad kun las byung ba de dag thams cad sel bar byed pa'i sgor mi phan pa ma yin te phan 'dogs so/ /kye rgyal ⑦ba'i sras de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi sku nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor yang sems can lhag pa'i bsam pa'i mig mdongs ri par gyur pa mos pa log pa/ lta ba log pa/ sbyor ba log pa/ 'tsho ba log pa/ dmus long7)lta bur gyur pa'i mig lam du snang bar mi 'gyur 7te/ de ni dad pa'i mig dang mi ldan pa'irwanyephyir ro/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi sku nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor sems can dmus long sngo lta bur gyur patsho/nye/ dad pa'i mig dang mi ldan pa de dag gi mig lam du snang bar ma gyur tu zin kyang /sems can rnam pa de lta bu dag la de bzhin gshegs pa'i mthus/ sems can 37—197
