thams cad zhi bar byed/ /de bzhin stobs bcu rnams ni mthong ngam thos kyang rung 1/ /yon tan kun ldan sangs rgyas ye shes 'thob dpar 'gyur/ /de nas de'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi mthus/ phyogs bcur 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed gyi 'jig rten gyi khams rnams 3rnam pa drug dang ltas chen po brtswa 4brgyad du g.yos so/ /rab tu g.yos so/ /kun tu g.yos so/ /'gul to/ /rab tu 'gul to/ /kun tu 'gul to/ /ldeg go rab tu ldeg go/ /kun tu ldeg go/ /chem chem rab tu chem chem/ kun tu chem chem mo/ /'ur 'ur rab tu 'ur 'ur/ kun tu 'ur bur ro/ /shig shig rab tu shig shig kun tu shig shig go/ /'di lta ste shar phyogs dma' bar gyur na/ nub phyogs mtho bar gyur 5to/ /nub phyogs dma' bar gyur 6)na shar phyogs mtho bar gyur to/ /lho phyogs dma' bar gyur na byang phyogs mtho bar gyur to/ /byang phyogs dma' bar gyur na lho phyogs mtho bar gyur to/ /dbus dma' bar gyur na mtha' mtho bar gyur to/ /mtha' dma' bar gyur na dbus mtho bar gyur to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i mthus lha rdzas las 'das pa'i me tog gi sprin dang na bza'i sprin dang / gdugs kyi sprin dang rgyal mtshan gyi sprin dang / ba dan gyi sprin gyi char snyamangon par bab bo/ /lha rdzas las 'das pa'i spos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par bab bo/ /lha rdzas las 'das pa'i phreng ba dang ske/ byug pa'i sprin gyi char mngon par bab bo/ /lha rdzas las 'das pa'i rgyan dang lhab nalhub kyi sprin gyi char 9mngon par bab bo/ /lha rdzas las 'das pa'i nor bu rin po che rte 'od chen po dang 11ldan pa'i sprin gyi char mngon par bab bo / /lha rdzas 12las 'das pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i legs so/ /zhes brjod 37—294

pa'i sprin gyi char mngon par bab bo/ /lha rdzas las 'das pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i lus brjod du med pa'i sprin gyi char mngon par bab bo/ /'jig rten gyi khams bsam gyis lhami khyab par yongs su dag pasalamangon par 'tshang rgya ba'i sprin gyi char mngon par bab bo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung chos kyi dbyings mtha' dang dbus myed pa rgyas par 'gengs pa'i sprin gyi char mngon par bab bo rka/ /gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir de bzhin gshegs pa'i byang chub thugs su chud pa'i chos kyi byin gyi rlabs dzu)kyis/ byang chub sems dpa' dga' bar gyur pa de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa thams cad du'ang phyogs bcu rgyas pa thams cad rab tu dga' bar gyur to/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong brjod du med pa brgyad cu'i (gertsal shin tu phra ba snyed kyi pha rol cadag nas kyang / de bzhin gshegs pa sangs rgyas kyi5)rizhing bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong brjod du med pa brgyad cu'i 6)rdul shin tu phra ba snyed 'omatshan kun tu bzang por mthun pa sha stag gis/byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po la zhal mngon par bstan te/ 'di skad ces gsungs so/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i mthu bsam gyis 1 mi khyab pa'i tshul mang po sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs 11dang / chos nyid rjes su bsnyegs pho pas bstan pa legs so legs so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de bzhin gshegs pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong brjod du med pa brgyad cu'i hu rdul shin tu phra ba snyed thams cad kyang mtshan mthun 1 ripa sha stag chos bstan pa 'di la legs pa 3gebarjod pa mdzad do/ /nged kyis kyang de 7skad du brjod pa yin no/ /nged kyis ji skad du brjod pa de bzhin du sangs rgyas thams 37—295

cad kyis kyang brjod do/ /chos bstan pa 'di shin tu bstan pa'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing brgya phrag stong gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin thams cad mngon par shes pa rab tu thob par gyur te// de dag kyang nged kyis thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu tshe gcig gis thogs par lung bstan to/ /sems can sangs rgyas kyi zhing brgya phrag stong gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed de/ de dag kyang ma 'ongs pa'i dus bskal pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis sangs rgyas kyi tsho yul/ phun sum tshogs5)pa zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dag tu 'gyur bar nged kyis lung bstan to/ /chos bstan pa 'di yang ma 'ongs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ma thos pa'i chos thos par bya ba'i phyir nged kyis byin gyis brlabs so/ /gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir sems can rnams kyis ji ltar shes par gyur cing dul bar gyur pa de bzhin du phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi ④khams bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong tshad med pa (snyegangs med pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa mtshungs pa med pa mtha' yas pa mu med pasalgematshams med pa dpag tu med pa brjod du myed pa mchos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa nam mkha'i dbyings kyi ⑧mthas gtugs pa thams cad ma lus pa dag tu yang sems can rnams rnam par dul bar gyur tol/ /sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi sngon gyi smon lam gyi byin gyi rlabs tu) dang /chos nyid rab tu thob pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba'i mthu dang / de bzhin 37—296

gshegs pa'i ye shes nyams pa myed pa las myi 'gyur ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi sku 'thob ①pa las gzhanakhudu mi 'gyur ba dang / dus la ri ji ltar bab pa bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang dag par bskul 54 ba dang / sngon mngon par bsgrub pa chud ma zos pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa dang mthul/ shin tu yangs pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes gyi mnga' bsgyur gcib yang dag par bstan pa'i mthus phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong brjod du myed pa phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi pha rol nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong brjod du med pa phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed phyogs bcu'i chos kyi dbyings rgyas par 'gengs shing byang chub sems dpa'i ri5)rgyan chen po rab tu bstan pa dang / 'od gzer gyi dra ba chen po rab tu bkye ri ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad bskyod pa dang / bdud kyi khyim thams cad rab tu gzhig pa dang / ngan song gi yul thams cad rab tu zhi bar bya ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i che ba nyid rab tu brjod pa dang / chos yang dag par 'gro ba rnam pa tha dad pa tshad 58med pas de bzhin gshegs pa'i legs pa brjod pa dang ske/ rnam pa thams cad du chos kyi char tshad myed pa dbab pa'i sprin gyi char mngon par dbab (spupa dang / lus rnam pa tha dad pa tshad 3 tshomed pa rab tu bstan pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi sprin chen po rang 31rang gi rgyud kyi snod tshad med pas yang dag par gzung ba byed cing 'ongs par gyur to/ /de dag kyang sangs rgyas kyi byin gyis 1ge'adi skad du brjod 32de/ kye rgyal ba'i sras de ltar khyod kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos nyid myi 'phrogs shing 37wa 297

bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'di brjod pa legs so/ /legs so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bdag cag kyang thams cad kun tu bzang po zhes bya bar ming mthun7)pa sha stag ste / de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan kun tu grags 3)pa'i dbang phyug rgyal po zhes bya ba dag gi drung nas 'jig rten gyi khams gyi mying〈 takun tu snang ba'i 'od ces bya ba dag nas 'dir phyin nga te/ thams cad du'ang sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos nyid rab tu thob 3)pas chos bstan pa 'di nyid byung bar gyur 6)to/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de ltar bdag cag kyang dbang du gyur pa sha stag /sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs 7kyis 'khor 'dir phyin te/ ji ltar bdag cag 'khor 'dir phyin pa de bzhin du phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa nam mkha'i mthas phyogatugs pa thams cad kyi gling bzhi pashethams cad du yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs hu )dang mthus byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong brjod du med pa phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed phyin par gyur te/ thams cad na'ang de bzhin gshegs pa'i mnga' mi 'phrogs pa'i chos 'di 319nyid tshig 'di dag nyid dang / yi ge 'di dag nyid dang 12/ nges pa'i tshig mngon par bsgrub pa 'di dag nyid kyis 1 don 'di nyid brjod 1 de lhag chad myed par brjod do/ /de nas 8byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang pos byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad la rnam par bltas nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs brjod0zhecing sangs rgyas kyi che ba nyid smos pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos nyid mi 'phrogs pa yongs su brjod pa dang 1 / sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba tshad med cing yangs pa don yod par brjod pa dang / rnam pa'i mchog thams cad dang ldan 37wa 298

pa'i sangs rgyas skye ba smos pa dang nyarme/ sems can ma lus pa thams cad kyi sems kyisabasam pa rab tu brtagasho pa dang / 'gro ba thams cad la dus la ji ltar 'bab pa bzhin du chos bstan pa rnam par dgod pa yongs su mi gtongs4)ba dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi chos (5)snang ba mtha' dang dbus med pa sne)yang dag par bskyed pa dang 7)/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa dang /byin gyi rlabs ⑧rnam par dgod pa chen po rab tu bstan pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang rang bzhin gcig pa'i lus mi 'khrugs par bya ba byed cing sngon gyi spyod pa'i stobs dang shugs kyis mngon par bsgrubs te rang gi rgyud kyi mthus yang dag par blangs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 59)byin gyi rlabs nyu rikyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /dpe rnams ji snyed 'jig rten kun na gang yod pa/ /de dag thams cad sangs rgyas spyod lam 'di dang bral/ /'on kyang 'gro la phan phyir sems can bstan pa'i phyir/ /dpe med rnams la don gyi tshul gyis hunyedape yang blangs/ /bde gshegs gsang ba 'di dag tha mal dmas 32mi thos/ /bskal pa brgya phrag stong du de yi sgra dkon no/ /gang rnams brtson 'grusal blo ldan shin tu dul gyur pa/ /de 'dra'i skye bus 1 ༷sangs rgyas gsang ba 'di 'dra thos/ /gang gis 'di thos gyur nas rab tu dga' 'gyur ba/ /de beni sngon cadalasangs rgyas brgya stong bkur cing mchod/ /bde gshegs rnams kyis byin brlabs rgyal bas 1 yongs su bzung 18/ /lha dang mis 3/bstod mkhas pas rim gro 2 )bya ba yin/ /'di ni bde gshegs 'jig rten 'das pa kun gyis 31 dkor / /rgyal ba 32sems can sgrol ba kun kyang 'di las 'byung / /'di ni dkar po'i nu lam mnga' nu kun kyi mtha' yas rigs/ /de phyir bag yod gyis te tsho ge37wa 299

'di ni gzung bar gyis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sherisangs rgyas kyis 3)mngon par gnang50ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang pos detswaskad ces smras pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su byung ba'i dpal yid dga' ste/byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor de dag 5)thams cad dang lha dang mi dang / lha ma yin dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / brgya byin dang /tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten gyi mgon po dang / dbang phyug chen po dang gtsang ma'i gnas kyi 'khor du bcas pa thams cad byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang pos bshad pa la mngon par dga' 'o/ / shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo sangs rgyas phal po che zhes bya ba las de bzhin gshegs pa skye ba 'byung ba bstan 75pa'i le'u ste bzhi bcu rtsa gsum pa'o④// // sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo1)/ bam po bcu gsum 1 pa/ bcom ldan 'das shin tu rnam par sangs rgyas pa'i dgongs pa 1 mnga' ba mi gnyis pa kyi la yang dag par spyod pa/ mtshan nyid med pa'i chos la rab tu brten 1 pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam pa nyid brnyes lapa/ bsgribs 15pa med pa thugs su chud palartogs pa/ phyir mi ldog pa'i chos dang ldan pa/ spyod yul la 'phrogs pa med pa/ dus gsum rnam par dgod pa bsam gyis 1 mi khyab pa la mnyam pa nyid du byung ba/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du shin tu khyab pa'i sku mnga' ba/ chos thams cad la the tsomadza3mi mnga' ba'i ye shes can spyod pa thams cad dang ldan pa'i dgongs pa mnga'5)37wa 300

ba / chos kyi ye shes la nem nur mi mnga' ba/ rnam par ma brtags pa'i sku dang ldan pa7byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis yang dag par mnod7pa'i ye shes can sangs rgyas kyi spyod pa mi gnyis pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i mchog brnyes pa / de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par thar pa tha mi dad pa'i ye shes kyilamathar phyin pa/ sangs rgyas kyis mtha' dang dbus med pa'i mnyam pa nyid thugs su chud pa/ chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mthas gtugs pa sangs rgyas kyi spyod pas rnam par spyod cing yul ma ga dha'isnyichos kyi dgon pa'i snying po'i ⑥byang chub la ④tha brang 'od kun nas byung ⑧ba na gdan seng ge'i khri pad mo'i snying po can la bzhugs7shing / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong brjod du med pa phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed thams cad kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu tshe gcig gis thogs pa 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan dang tsogazhan nas 'dus pa kun kyang / byang chub sems dpa'i ye shes kyi tshul thams cad rab tu thob pa sha stag ste/ 'di ltar sems can gyi khams thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba dang / rnam par gdul ba dang byang chub sems dpa'i chos la ḍa/marab tu dgod par mkhas pa 'jig rten gyi khams 'byam triklas pa thams cad dpyadamu pa'i tshul gyi7ye shes 'byam rme/nyeklas pa la zhugs77pa dag ste/ 'di ltar mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa dang spyod yul dang / ye shes la spyod cing rtog pa spros pa thams cad yongs su chad〈 pa/ spyod /shepa nye bar gzungasko/rkyeb rgyun mi 'chad pas sems can thams cad yang dag par gzung ba la mkhas pa/ chos kyi tshul la 'jug par bya ba mtha' dang dbus med pa la rab tu zhugs shuste pa/ sems 37—301

can thams cad kyi las rnam 1par smin pa chud mi za shing (gyimi dmigs par brtags shing gdapyad pa la shin tu mkhas pa/ sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa dang bag la nyal ba dang / dbang po dang / rtsom rngo )pa dang sbyor ba mthon ⑧dman brtags cing dpyad 6pa la rab tu mkhas pa/ 'das pa dang ma byon pa dang ske/ da ltar byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsungs pa'i don ge dang tshig dang yi ge gzung zhing bcang ba dang shes par bya ba dang /mnyam par gzung ba dang brtag par bya ba la shin tu mkhas pa/ 'jig rten dang 8'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos kyi tshul la 'jug par bya ba mtha' dang dbus med pa la shin tu zhugs pa/ 'dus byas dang / 'dus ma byas dang /dus rnam 9pa tha dad pa'i tshul brtag pa la rab tu mkhas pa/ 'das pa dang /ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor skad cig gcig gis 1 )de ma thag 11tu rab tu nyu2thob pa la / rnam par spyod pa sems kyi skad cig re re la nyu mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa yang dag par ston pa/ sems can thams cad kyi 8sems bskyed pa dang mi 'bral bar byang chub tu rnam par 'tshang rgya ba sasems can gcig gi sems kyi dmigs pa la zhugs pas sems can ma lus pa thams cad kyi sems kyi dmigs pa la mkhas par khong du chud pa rang 'byung 1 gi ye shes dang sa mngon du gyur pa las mi nyams 1 pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i lus dang ldan pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i sa thob kyang rgyun mi 'chad pa'i spyod pa las phyir mi ldog pa/ byang chub sems dpas mngon par 'du 19bya ba'i mthu rgyun mi chad pa mngon par 3 ri'adu bya ba myed pa'i ye shes kyi tshul la zhugs pa/ sems can gcig gi don du bskal pa mu med 37wa 302

par spyod pa yongs su 'dzin pa'i byin gyi rlabasatul mkhas pa/ bskal pa grangs med par 'byung5bzhing mthong bar dka' ba'i byang chub sems dpa' rin po che shin tu bzang po chos kyi 'khor lo thogs pa med pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyisashe'agro ba thams cad rnam par gdulam④ba'i dbyings la 'jug par mkhas pa/ 'das pa dang ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rnam par dag pa'i gnas yang dag par gzungasnyiba'i phyir sngon gyi spyod pa'i mthu'i khyad par dang smon lam phun sum tshogs pa dag ste/ de dag dang de ma yin pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis yon tan bsngags shing yongs su brjod kyang bskal pa mu med par mi zad ④mi thug pa/ legs pa shin tu brjod pa rab tu thob pa sha stag stese/ 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu mig dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu 'phrul pa dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu shes rab dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu lta ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu 'od dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu snang ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun nas ('onagasal ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu dpal dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu blo dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shugs chen po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shugs chen po 'dzin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam par 'phrul pa chen po dang / byang chub 37—303

sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po7rnam par 'phrul pa chen posasherab tu mdzes pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po brtson 'grus kyis7rnam par gnon gepa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam par bsgyings pa chen po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam par bsgyings pa chen po'i stobs dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po glang po chen po'i dam pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po glang po chen po spos kyi glang po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zla ba chen po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zla ba du bzang po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yon tan zla ba dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rin chen ⑥sla ba dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zla ba kun tu snang ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos dri ma med pa'i zla ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam par snang ba'i zla ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam par grags pa'i mesgra ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'od zer rab tu 'gyed pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zla ba yongs su rgyas pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshangs ⑤pa'i dbyangs dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshangs pa'i dbang po 'brug gi⑥dbyangs dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa grum hu )pa'i sgra'i (spedabyangs dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po hurtechos kyitshwanyedabyings rab tu sgrog pa'i dbyangs dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po bdud kyi dkyil 37—304

'khor thams cad rnam par 'joms hu)pa'i dbyangs dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos kyi rnga sgra'i dbyangs dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu go bar byed pa'i dbyangs dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po mi rtog ②rnam par mi rtog pa'i dbyangs dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sa gzhisherab tu sgrog⑧pa'i dbyangs dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yan lag thams cad kyisnyi dbyangs kyi yizil gyis gnon pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun nas snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun nas dri ma med pa'i snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po yon tan gyi snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnam par snang ba'i snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rin po che'i snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje'i snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po zla ba'i snying po dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nyi ma'i snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gtsangamaduma'i snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pad mo'i snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po pad mo'i7dpal gyi snying po dang / de dag la stsogs pa'i nyi nobyang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong brjod du med pa phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kun kyang kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa dang smon lam du ldan pa/ smon lam dang lhag pa'i bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa dang5me/ sangs rgyas byung ba thams cad kyi drung du 'gro zhing 37—305

gsol ba gdab pa la mkhas pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi tshul yang dag par 'dzin nyu1pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rigs rgyun myi gcodasapa / sangs rgyas 'byung ba gcig nas gcig tu lung bstan pa dang / mngon par 'tshang rgya (ri ba dang mying dang zhing dang 'khor lo'i tshul yongs su sbyong ba/sangs rgyas myi bzhugs pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams su sangs rgyas skye ba yongs su ston pa/ kun nas nyon mongs pa'i sems can gyi khams thams cad yongs su dag par 4)byed pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i las kyi sgrib pa thams cad rab tu sel ba/ chos kyi dbyings bsgribs rigesapa myed pa la shin tu zhugs pa sha stag dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs te/ de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po de'i tshe/ sangs rgyas phal po che zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang pos ting nge 'dzin chen po sangs rgyas phal po che zhes bya ba de la mnyam par bzhag ma thag tu de'i tshe/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'byam7klas pa chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa ma lus pa thams cad rnam pa drug tu g.yos te 7rigayos so/ /rab tu g.yos so/ /kun tu g.yos so / /'gul to rab tu 'gul to/ / kun tu 'gul to/ /tsasdeg go rab tu ldeg go / /kun tu ldeg go/ /chem chem rab tu chem chem/ kun tu chem chem mo/ /'ur 'ur rab tu 'ur 'ur/ kun tu 'ur 'ur ro/ /shig shig rab tu shig shig9ni /kun tu shig shig go/ /de ltar 'jig rten gyi khams 'byam hu skuklas pa ma lus pa thams cad 11rab tu bskyod de/ dbyangs kyis mngon par go bar byas nas ting nge 'dzin de las langs par gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 37—306

sems dpa' chen po kun tu shes rab kyis byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs chen po 'dus par shes nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang po la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras legs par bstan pa mdzod cig /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi rgyu mthun71 pa ni gang / ngo mtshar gyi 'du shes ni gang / spyod pa ni gang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni gang brtson 'grus rtsom pa ni gang / dbugs tsho phyin pa thob pa ni gang / sems can yongs su smin par bya ba ni gang / tshul khrims ni gang /lung bstan pa ni gang/ kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byang chub sems dpa' la 'jug pa ni gang / de bzhin gshegs pa la〈('jug pas④ni gang ske/ sems can gyi rigabasam pa dang spyod pa la 'jug pa ni gang / 'jig rten gyi khams la 'jug pa ni gang / bskal pa la 'jug pa ni gangs6)dus gsum bstan pa ni gang / dus gsum la 'jug pa ni gang / myi skyo zhing yongs su sgyid lug pa med pa'i sems bskyed pa ni gang / kun tu dbye ba'i ye shes ni gang ⑧/ gzungs ni (7)gang / kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpas tu byesangs rgyas bstan pa'isngo1rjes su rtogs par bya ba ni gang / kun tu bzang po'i sems bskyed pa ni gang / kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa'i chos ni gang / snying rje chen po rab tu thob pa ni gang / rkyen gang gis byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi rkyen ni gang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen la gus pa'i sems ni gang / yongs su dag pa ni gang / pha rol tu phyin pa ni gang / shes pa khong du chud par bya ba ni7rtegang rab tu rtogs pa ni gang / kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi stobs kyi shugs ni gang / mnyam pa nyid ni 37—307

gang ske/ sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi tshul gyi lam ni gang / chos bstan pa ni gang /yongs su gzung ba ni 37gang / spobs pa ni gang / dbang ni gang /la myi gnas pa ni gang / sems mnyam pa nyid ni gang / ye shes mngon par bsgrub pa ni gang / kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams gyi sprul pa ni gang ske/ byin gyi rlabs cini gang / dbugs phyin pa chen po rab tu thob pa ni gang glu/ sangs rgyas kyi chos zab mo la 'jug pa ni gang / gnas su bya ba ni gang /sems bskyed pa brtan 44pa ni gang / nem nur thams cad gcod pa'i sems bskyed pa ni gang / bsam gyis mi khyabamachigepa ni gang / dgongs te bshad pa la mkhas pa ni gang / ye shes rnam par dbye ba la mkhas pa ni gang / kye rgyal ba'i yosras byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi snyoms par 'jug pa ni gang / ril po ni gang / rnam par thar pa ni gang / mngon par shes pa ni gang / rig pa ni gang / rnam par grol ba ni gang / skyed mos tshal ni gang / gzhal med khang ni gang / dga' ba ni gang / rgyan ni gang / kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sems bskyed pa myi sgul57ba ni gang / lhag pa'i bsam pa yongs su mi gtong ba la gnas pa ni gang / ye shes kyisarnam par blta7ba ni gang ske/ chos shin tu bstan pa ni gang / yongs su dag pa ni gang / phyag rgya ni gang /nyu no ye shes snang ba ni gang / byang chub sems dpa'iloganas mtshungs pa med pa ni gang / sangs rgyas kyi byang chub tu zhum pa med pa'i sems bskyed pa ni gang / lhag pa'i bsam pa ri bo lta bu ni gang / kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu ye shes kyis 'jug pa rgya mtsho lta bu ni /shegang / byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par spyod pa 37—308

rin po che lta bu ni gang / theg pa chen po'i go caturdo rje lta bu'i sems bskyed pa ni gang / rtsom pa chen po nisnyigang / brtsams pa chen po mthar phyin par bya ba ni gang / dad pa myi phyed pa ni gang / lung bstan⑧pa ni gang / dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su bsngo ba ni gang / ye shes khong du chud pa ni gang / sems bskyed pa rgya chen po mtha' dang dbus med pa ni gang / kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gter ni gang / sdom pa ni gang / dbang7ni gang /rnam par 'phrul pa ni gang / sems can la rnam par 'phrul pa ni gang / zhing la rnam par 'phrul pa ni gang / chos la rnam par 'phrul pa ni gang / lus la rnam par 'phrul pa ni gang / smon lam la rnam par 'phrul pa ni gang / spyod yul la rnam par 'phrul pa ni gang / kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ye shes la rnam par 'phrul pa ni gang / mngon par shes pa la rnam par 'phrul pa ni gang / rdzu 'phrul la rnam par 'phrul pa ni gang / stobs la rnam par 'phrul pa ni gang / rnam par rtse ba ni gang / khyu mchog gi mthu phyung ba ni gang ske/ stobs ni gang / mi 'jigasalgepa ni gang / byang chub sems dpa'i ma 'dres pa'i chos ni gang / las ni gang lus ni gang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lus kyi las ni gang / rang bzhin ni gang / ngag ni gang / ngag yongs su dag pa ni gang / yongs su 'dzin pa ni gangapo)/ gang gis shin tu bzung ④zhing byang chub sems dpa'i ngag 'chi'abyung bar 'gyur/ byang chub sems dpa'i ngagashegis ni ngag gi las gang zhig 'grub par 'gyur/ sems ni gang sems bskyed pa ni gang sems kyis rgyas par dgang ba ni gang / kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dbang po ni gang / bsam pa ni gang /37—309

lhag pa'i bsam pa ni gang / sbyor ba ni gang / mos pa ni gang / 'jig rten gyi khams su mos pa la 'jug pa ni gang / sems can gyi khams su mos pa la 'jug pa ni gang / bag chags ni gang / nye bar len pa ni gang / nan tan ni gang / kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi 'grub pa ni gang ske/ sangs rgyas kyi chos las 'gol ga1)ba'i lam ni gang / skyon med pa ni gang /byang chub sems dpa'i nachos nges pa 'thob pa ni gang / sangs rgyas kyi chos lakhu'abyung ba'i lam ni gang / skyes bu dam pa'i mying thob pa ni gang / lam ni gang ske/ lam tshad med pa ni gang / lam gyi tshogs ni gang / lam bsgomasepa ni gang / kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lam gyi sa)rgyan ni gang ske/ rkang pa ni gang / lag pa ni gang / lto 6ni gang / snying po ni gang /snying ni gang /7 go cha 8ni gang / mtshon cha 497/ni gang / mgo ni gang / myig ni gang / kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rna ba ni gang / sna ni gang / lce ni gang / lus ni gang / yid rnam par rgyu ba ni gang / 'gro ba ni gang / gnas pa ni gang /hu ) stan la 'dug pa ni gang / mal hu)ni gang /rnam par spyod pa ni gang / kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spyod yul ni gang / lta ba ni gang / rnam par lta ba ni gang / rnam par bsgyings pa ni gang / seng ge'i nga ro ni gang / sbyin pa yongs su dag pa ni gang ske/ tshul khrims yongs su dag pa ni gang / bzod pa yongs su dag pa ni gang ske/ brtson 'grus yongs su dag pa ni gang / bsam gtan yongs su dag pa ni gang / kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi shes rab yongs su dag pa ni gang / byams pa yongs su dag pa ni gang / snying rje yongs su 37—310

dag pa ni gang / dga' ba yongs su dag pa ni gang / btang snyoms yongs su dag pa ni gang / don ni gang / chos ni gang / bsod nams kyi tshogs ni gang ske/ ye shes kyi tshogs ni gang / rig pa skye ba rtsi)ni gang / kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi chos yongs su tshol ba ni gang / chos rab tu brjod pa ni gang chos kyi nan tan ni gang / bdud ni gang / bdud kyi las ni gang ske/ bdud kyi las bzlog mipa ni gang / sangs rgyas mthong bar bya ba ni gang ske/ sangs rgyas kyi phrin las ni gang / nga rgyal gyi las ni gang / ye shes kyi las ni gang / kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bdud kyi byin gyi rlabasalge ni gang / sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs sa ni gang / chos kyi byin gyi rlabasamacho5)ni gang / dga' ldan na gnas pa'i las ni gang /snyon dga' ldan gyisarinaganas nas 'chi 'pho ston pa ni gang / mngal na gnas par ston pa ni gang /shin tu phra ba'i rgyud ston pa ni gang / cher skye ba ni gang / gad mo cher dgod pa ni gang / gomashepas rnam par gnon pa ni gang / kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gzhon nu'i sa kun tu ston pa ni gang / btsun mo'i 'khor nye bar ston pa ni gang / mngon par 'byung ba ni gang / dka' ⑨ba spyod pa'i sbyor ba ni gang / snying po byang chub tu 'gro ba ni gang / snying po byang chub la 'dug pa ni gang / snying po byang chub la 'dug pa rnams kyi ngo mtshar rmad 1 ridu byung ba'i chos ni gang / bdud 'dul ba ston pa ni gang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa ni gang / chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor 31ba ni gang / chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor nyatheba'i chos dkar po'i rnam pa nya ni gang / kye rgyal ba'i sras de bzhin gshegs pa dgra 37—311

bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba chen po bstan hu)pa ni gang / de skad ces smras pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun du bzang pos/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu shes rab la dmyigs nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs na/de dag thams cad la smras pa/ kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'dishedag ni byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi rgyu 'thun pa ste/ bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar chud mi za ba'i phyir/ byang chub kyi sems kyi rgyu 'thun pa dang ske/ rgyud kyi tshul gcig tu bya ba'i phyir dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rgyu 'thunashepa dang / shin tu bstsags nipa'i phyir dge ba'i rtsa ba'i rgyu 'thun ⑨pa dang /nan tan du 7bya ba'i phyir pha rol tu phyin pa'i rgyu 'thun5nyapa dang / 'byung ba'i phyir chos thams cad kyi rgyu 'thun nya pa dang / byang chub brtan pa'i phyir smon lam gyi rgyu 'thun 32pa dang / rgya chen po yang dag par bstsags yipa'i phyir spyod pa'i rgyu 'thun gepa dang / tshul gcig tu bya ba'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang rgyu 'thun 8pa dang / sems rab tu dang ba'i phyir sangs rgyas mchod pa rgyu 'thun lha pa dang / pha lta bur brjod pa'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang rgyu 'thun 1shepa'o kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rgyu 'thun77pa ste/ de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes chen po bla na med pa rdzu rte'athob par 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams ri —)kyi ngo mtshar kyi 'du shes te rte/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di ltar dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad la mi dge bar 'du shes pa dang / dge ba thams cad la byang chub 37—312

kyi sa bon du 'du shes pa dang / sems can thams cad la byang chub kyi snod du 'du shes pa dang / smon lam thams cad la smon lam med par 'du shes pa dang /chos thams cad la 'byung bar 'du shes pa dang / spyod pa thams cad la spyod pa med par 'du shes pa dang / chos thams cad la sangs rgyas kyi chos su 'du shes pa dang / tshig tu spyod pa thams cad la ngag gi lam myed par 'du shes pa dang /sangs rgyas thams cad la par 'du shes pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la gnyis su med par 'du shes pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ngo mtshar gyi 'du shes te①/ de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams 2'du shes rnam par bzlog pa la mkhas pa bla na med pa thobalgepar 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spyod pa ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di ltar sems can thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba'i don du spyod pa dang / chos thams cad yongs su btsal ba'i don du spyod pa dang / bslab pa thams cad nan tan tu bya ba'i don du spyod pa dang / dge ba'i 44)rtsa ba thams cad bstsags zhi)pa'i don du spyod pa dang / ting nge 'dzin rtse gcig tu bya ba'i don du spyod pa dang /ye shes rab tu shes par bya ba'i don du spyod pa dang / bsgom 61pa yongs su bsgom pa'i don du spyod pa dang / zhing brgyan pa'i don du spyod pa dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsnyen bkur ba'i don du spyod pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa mchod cing rim gror ④bya ba'i don du spyod pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spyod pa ste/ de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes chen po'i58)spyod pa bla na 37—313

med pa yongs su rdzogs pa 'thob par 17'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen te/bcu gang zhe na/ 'di ltar byang chub kyi sems la rab tu gzhog pa'i bshes ④ gnyen dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba la sbyor ba'i bshes gnyen dang / pha rol tu phyin pa la 'jug par byed pa'i bshes gnyen dang / chos thams cad ston pa'i bshes gnyen dang / sems can thams cad yongs su sbyin par bya ba la gzhog pa'i bshes gnyen dang / spobs pa la rnam par gdon myi za bar byed pa'i bshes gnyen dang / 'gro ba thams cad gnas ri )gyen du bskyod 4pa'i bshes gnyen dang ne/ bskal pa thams cad du gnas shing mi skyo ri bar byed pa'i bshes gnyen dang ske/ kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa la rab tu gzhog pa'i bshes gnyen dang /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes la 'jug cing 'bab par byed pa'i bshes stiganyen te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni 7 byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen no/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' na rnams kyi brtson 'grus brtsams pa 9)ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di ltar sems can gyi khams thams cad yongs su smin par bya'o snyam ste/ brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang / chos thams cad 1 )gzung bar bya'o snyam ste/ brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad yongs su sbyang bar bya'o snyam ste/ brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa thams cad shes par bya'o snyam ste/ brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi nyes byas zad par bya'o snyam 11ste brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang / sems can dmyal ba dang / byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten 37—314

gyi sdug bsngal thams cad rgyun gcad do snyam ste/ brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang /bdud thams cad las ①rgyal bar bya'o snyam ste/ brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang /sems can thams cad ladzami'akhrug pa med par bya'o snyam ste/ brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang / sangs rgyas thams cad la mchod pa zhubya'o snyam ste/ brtson 'grus rtsom pa dang ④/ (5)de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad ⑥mnyes par bya'o snyam ste/brtson 'grus rtsom pa'o/ /rtso)kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi brtson 'grus rtsom pa ste/ de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa 'thob ④par 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dbugs phyin pa thob pa ste/bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar bdag ni byang chub kyi sems la gnas pa yin gyisapod dung gzhan yang byang chub kyi sems la dgod dorwa )zhes te dbugs phyin pa rab tu 'thob bo/ /bdag ni 'jig rten gyi rtsod hu1pa thams cad kyis rtsod pa lha myed pa la gzhol ba yin gyis nyi da dung gzhan yang rtsod nya ripa med par dga' ba la midagod par bya'o/ /zhes dbugs phyin pa 'thob 7bo/ /bdag ni byis pa'i chos las 'phags kyi 3 7da dung pha rol kyang 12byis pa'i chos las gyen du bskyod de nyamasangs rgyas kyi chos la dgod par bya'o zhes dbugs phyin pa 'thob 32 bo/ /bdag ni dge ba'i rtsa ba btsal ba la 21brtson pa yin gyis / da dung gzhan yang dge ba'i rtsa ba tshol na bar brtson pa la rab tu dgod par bya'o zhes dbugs phyin pa 'thob ni tshobo/ /bdag ni pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam du zhugs pa yin gyisani / da dung gzhan yang pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam du 'jug pa la dgod par bya'o/ /zhes 37—315

dbugs phyin pa 'thob bo/ /bdag ni sangs rgyas kyi rigs su skyes pa yin gyis1 / da dung gzhan yang sangs rgyas kyi rigs su skye ba la ②rab tu dgod par bya'o zhes dbugs phyin pa 'thob 92)bo/ /bdag ni dngos po med pa'i chos kyi tshul la zhugs pa yin gyisang / da dung gzhan yang dngos po med pa'i chos kyi tshul la dgod par bya'o zhes dbugs phyin pa 'thob bo/ /bdag ni sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad mi spong ba la brtson pa yin gyis⑤/ da dung gzhan yang sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad myi spong bar brtson pa la dgod par bya'o zhes dbugs phyin pa 'thobar bo bdag gis ni thams cad mkhyen pa'i byang chub tu smon lam yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur gyisame/ da dung gzhan yang thams cad mkhyen pa'i byang chub tu smon lam yongs su rdzogs par byed pa la dgod par bya'o zhes dbugs phyin pa 'thob bo/ /bdag ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi mdzod mi zad par zhugs pa yin gyisal/ da dung gzhan yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi khaye shes kyi mdzod myi zad par 'jug pa la dgod par bya'o zhes dbugs phyin pa 'thob bo/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dbugs phyin pa thob pa hu )ste/ de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes chen po'i dbugs phyin 11pa bla na med pa 'thob par 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sems can yongs su smin par bya ba dag 12ste/ bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni sbyin pas kyang sems can gyi khams yongs su sbyin hu par byed do/ /gzugs kyis kyang sems can gyi khams yongs su sbyin par byed do/ /chos ston pas kyang sems 37—316

can gyi khams yongs su spyin par byed do/ /skal hu)ba mnyam pas kyang sems can gyi khams yongs su phyin par byed do/ /gnas med pas kyang sems can gyi khams yongs su sbyin par byed do/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa brjod pas kyang sems can gyi khams yongs su sbyin par byed do/ /'jig rten gyi khams kun tu 'bar ba yang dag par bstan⑧pas kyang sems can gyi khams yongs su sbyin par byed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi che ba nyid brjod pas kyang sems can gyi khams yongs su sbyin par byed do/ /rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs kyi rnam par 'phrul pas kyang sems can gyi khams yongs su phyin par byed do/ /thabs mkhas pa'i sbyor ba dang / tshul gyis 'jig rten du spyad7pa sna tshogs kyis kyang sems can gyi khams yongs su sbyin par byed do/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sems can/ yongs su spyin par bya bsnyiste/ de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis④sems can gyi khams yongs su smin par byed pa dag goshi/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi tshul khrims te/ bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar byang chub kyi sems myi nyamasalgepa'i tshul khrims dang / nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi sa yongs su spong5༷ba'i tshul khrims dang / sems can thams cad la phan par dga' bas rnam par lta spuba'i tshul khrims dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad la rab tu dgod pa'i tshul khrims dang / byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa thams cad la nan tan tu bya ba'i tshul khrims dang / chos thams cad myi dmyigs pa'i tshul khrims dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad byang chub tu yongs su bsngo ba'i tshul khrims dang / sangs rgyas kyi sku 1 rithams cad las phyir77phyogs su mi sna lta ba'i 37—317

tshul khrims dang / chos thams cad nges par rtogs pa la mngon par zhen pa med pa'i tshul khrims dang / dbang po sdom pa'i tshul khrims so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi tshul khrims te/ de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshul khrims rgya chen po'i pha rol tu phyin pa bla na med pa 'thob zhi)par 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lung bstan pa ste / lung bstan pa de dag gis lung bstan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni bdag cag lung bstan to/ /zhes bya bar shes so/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di ltar snying thag pa nas byang chub kyi sems phun sum tshogs pa ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rang gi rgyud las lung bstan pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la mi skyo ba ni nabyang chub sems dpa'i lung bstan pa'o/ /bskal pa thams cad du zhe non pa ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lung bstan pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad skul nan tan du byed pa ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lung bstan pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bka' la gcig tu chad par mos shing yid ches cal mngon par dad pa ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lung bstan pa'o5/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad yang dag par sogs shing sgrub 6pa ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lung bstan pa'o/ /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi byang chub la rab tu dgod par brtson pa ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lung bstan pa'o/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen thams cad dang rgyud kyi tshul gcig tu byed pa ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lung bstan pa'o / /dge ba'i bshes gnyen thams cad la ston par 'du shes pa ni byang chub 37—318

sems dpa' rnams kyi lung bstan pa'o/ /sngon gyi byang chub gyi smon lam rjes su bsrung7ba ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lung bstan pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lung bstan pa ste/ lung bstan pa/ de dag gis lung bstan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni bdag cag lung bstan to zhes bya bar shes so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byang chub sems dpa'ar+sā)la 'jug pa ste/ bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar sngon gyi smon lam la 'jug pa dang / spyod pa la 'jug pa dang ske/ yang dag par bsgrub pa la 'jug pa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa la 'jug pa dang / bsgrub pa la 'jug pa dang / smon lam rnam pa tha dad pa la 'jug pa dang / mos pa tha dad pa la 'jug pa dang / zhing gi⑧rgyan la 'jug pa dang ske/ rdzu 'phrul gyis ④rnam par 'phrul pa la 'jug pa dang / skye ba bstan pa la 'jug pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byang chub sems dpa' 'a)la 'jug pa ste/ 'jug pa de yidag gis ni 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la 'jug pa dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di medag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyisabade bzhin gshegs pa la 'jug pa ste/ bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar mu med pa'i mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa la 'jug pa dang /mu med pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba la 'jug pa dang / mu med pa'i chos kyi tshul la 'jug pa dang / mu med pa'i dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor la 'jug pa dang /mu med pa'i sems can 'dul ba la 'jug pa dang / mu med pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyis rnam par 'phrul pa la 'jug pa dang / mu med pa'i sku sna tshogs la 'jug pa 37—319

dang ske/ mu med pa'i ting nge 'dzin la 'jug pa dang / mu med pa'i stobs dang mi 'jigs hu)pa la 'jug pa dang / mu med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa yongs su bstan pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa la 'jug pa ste/ 'jug pa de dag gis ni 'das pa dang /ma byon pa dang da ltar byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la 'jug par 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sems can gyi bsam pa dang / spyod pa la 'jug pa ste/ sems can gyi bsam pa dang spyod pa la 'jug pa de dag gis ni(2ri/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa dang / spyod pa la rab tu 'jug go rim/ /bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar sems can thams cad kyi sngon gyi mtha'i spyod pa la 'jug pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi phyi ma'i mtha'i spyod pa la 'jug pa dang ske/ sems can thams cad kyi da ltar byung ba'i spyod pa la 'jug pa dang /sems can thams cad kyi dge ba'i spyod pa la 'jug pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi mi dge ba'i spyod pa la 'jug pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi spyod pa la 'jug pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi dbang po'i spyod pa la 'jug pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi mos pa sna tshogs kyi spyod pa la 'jug pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa'i bag chags dang bag la cir/nyal ba'i spyod pa la 'jug pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi dus dang dus ma yin par yongs su sbyin par bya ba dang / rnam par 'dul ba'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'o6/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sems can gyi bsam pa dang spyod pa la 'jug pa ste/ de dag gis byang 37—320

chub sems dpa' rnams sems can gyi 1)bsam pa dang spyod pa la 'jug par 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams la 'jug pa ste/ bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar 'jig rten gyi khams rnams la kun nas nyon mongs par 'jug pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams rnams la rnam par dag par 'jug pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams rnams la chung 'a/ngur 'jug pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams rnams la chen por 'jug pa dang 'jig rten gyi sne/khams rnams 4)la rdul shin tu phra mor chud da par 'jug pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams rnams la rab tu phra bar 'jug pa dang /'jig rten gyi khams rnams la yangs par 'jug pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams rnams la 'byung bar 'jug pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams rnams la sangs rgyas dang bcas par 'jug pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams rnams la sangs rgyas med par 'jug pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi 6༄'jig rten gyi khams la 'jug pa ste/ de dag gis ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad la 'jug par 'gyur ba dag gom/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni mebyang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bskal pa la 'jug pa ste/ de dag 2)gis byang chub sems dpa' rnams bskal pa thams cad la rab tu 'jug go/ /bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar 'das pa'i bskal pa la 'jug pa dang / ma 'ongs pa'i bskal pa la 'jug pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i bskalas7pa la 'jug pa dang / grangs yod pa'i bskal pa la 'jug pa dang /grangs med pa'i bskal pa la 'jug pa dang / grangs yod pa dang 3 grangs med pa'i bskal pa la 'jug pa dang / grangs med pa grangs yod pa'i bskal pa la 37—321

'jug pa dang / bskal pa thams cad la bskal pa gcig ①tu 'jug pa dang /bskal pa ma yin pa la bskal par 'jug pa dang / bskal pa thams cad la skad cig gcig gis 'jug pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bskal pa la 'jug pa rnams te/ de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' rnams bskal pa la 'jug par 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni mibyang chub sems dpa' rnams kyishedus gsum bstan pa ste / de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' rnams dus gsum shin tu ston to/ /bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar 'das pa'i dus la 'das par bstan pa dang / 'das pa'i dus la 3)ma 'ongs par bstan pa dang / 'das pa'i dus la da ltar byung bar bstan pa dang / ma 'ongs pa'i dus la 'das par bstan pa dang / ma 'ongs pa'i dus las ciltad ltar byung bar7bstan pa dang / ma 'ongs pa'i dus la mi zad par bstan pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i dus la 'das par bstan pa dang /da ltar byung ba'i dus la ciX ma 'ongs par bstan pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i dus la mnyam pa nyid du bstan pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i dus la dus gsum skad cig tu bstan pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dus gsum bstan pa ste/ de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' rnamasashedus gsum ston par 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dus gsum la 'jug pa ste/ bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar brda lho)la 'jug pa dang / tshig gi lam la 'jug pa dang / mngon par brjod rtso )pa la 'jug pa dang / gdags pa la 'jug pa dang / 'du shes la 'jug pa dang / legs par bsngags pa la 'jug pa dang / spyod pa la 37—322

'jug pa dang / mi zad pa la 'jug pa dang / zhi ba la 'jug pa dang /dben pa la 'jug pa'o①/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dus gsum la 'jug pa ste/ de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' rnams dus gsum la 'jug par 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mi skyo zhingakhuskyid lug ga⑧med pa'i sems bskyed pa ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di ltar sangs rgyas thams cad mchod cing rim gror0bya bas mi skyo zhing yongs su sgyid lug pa med pa'i sems bskyed pa dang ske/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen thams cad bsnyenasnyibakur bas mi skyo zhing yongs su sgyid lug pa med pa'i sems bskyed pa dang / chos thams cad btsal ba la mi skyo zhing yongs su sgyid lug pa med pa'i sems bskyed pa dang / chos thams cad mnyan pa la mi skyo zhing yongs su sgyid lug pa med pa'i sems bskyed pa dang /chos thams cad bstan pa la mi skyo zhing yongs su sgyid lug pa med pa'i sems bskyed pa dang / sems can thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba dang /gdul bas mi skyo zhing yongs su sgyid lug pa (9med pa'i sems bskyed pa dang /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi byang chub la rab tu57)dgod par bya bas mi skyo zhing yongs su sgyid lug pa med pa'i sems bskyed pa dang / bskal pa brjod du myed pa'i yang brjod du med par 'jig rten gyi khams re rer ⑧byang chub sems dpa'i7spyad pa spyod pas mi skyo zhing yongs su skyid lug pa med pa'i sems bskyed pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa thams cad du rjes su spyod pas mi skyo zhing yongs su sgyid lug pa med pa'i sems bskyed pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad rtogs hu)par bya ba dang / yang dag par blta 9/rteb la mi skyo 37—323

zhing yongs su sgyid lug pa med pa'i sems bskyed pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi0)mi skyo zhingasaskyid lug pa med pa'i sems bskyed pa ste/ de dag la du riganas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes chen po yongs su skyo ba med pa bla na med pa thobartsomapar 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi kun tu dbye ba'i ye shes te/ bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar sems can kun tu dbye ba'i ye shes dang / dbang po kun tu dbye ba'i ye shes dang / las dang rnam par smin pa kun gtu dbye ba'i ye shes dang / skye ba kun tu dbye ba'i ye shes dang / 'jig rten gyi khams kun tu dbye ba'i ye shes dang / chos kyi dbyings kun tu dbye ba'i ye shes dang / sangs rgyas kun tu dbye ba'i ye shes dang ske/ chos kun tu dbye ba'i ye shes dang / dus gsum kun tu dbye ba'i ye shes dang / tshig gi rgyud ci thams cad la ngag gi lam kun tu dbye ba'i ye shes so / /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi kun tu dbye ba'i ye shes te/ de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes chen po kun tu dbye ba bla na med pa 'thob chosapar 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gzungs tsho te/ bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar chos thams cad mi brjed par 'dzin pa'i phyir thos pa'i gzungs dang / chos thams cad ji lta ba bzhin tu rab tu 'byed pa'i phyir chos khong du chud pa'i gzungs dang / chos gyi rang bzhin rjes su rtogs pa'i phyir chos thams cad nges par rtogs pa'i gzungs dang ske/ sangs rgyas kyi chos bsam gyis mi khyab pa thob pa'i 3༷ )phyir chos snang ba 37—324

rab tu thob ①pa'i gzungs dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams las chos mngon du thos pa yongs su mi zad pa'i phyir ting nge 'dzin gyi gzungs dang / sgra skad dang tha snyad bsam gyis mi khyab pa la gu'ajug pa'i phyir dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor la 'jug pa'i gzungs dang / 'das pa dang ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas kyi chos bsam gyis mi khyab pa shin tu ston pa'i phyir ①dus gsum gyi gzungs dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos mtha' dang dbus med pa rnam pa tha dad pa thams cad shin tu ston pa'i phyir rnam pa sna tshogs su spobs pa'i gzungs dang / sangs rgyas byung ba brjod du med pa thams cad du rna ba'i dbang pos khyab byapar byed pa'i phyir thogs pa med pa'i rna ba mngon par (gebasgrub pa'i gzungs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang ske/ mi bsnyengs pa la rab tu dgodang pa'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi gzungs so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gzungs te'u/ de dag thob par bya ba'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi brtson par bya ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sangs rgyas bstan pa rjes su rtogs par bya ba ste/bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar mngon par byang chub pa'i sangs rgyas dang / smon lam gyi sangs rgyas dang / las rnam par sbyin pa'i sangs rgyas dang / byin gyis59ribarlabs pa'i tsosangs rgyas dang / sprul pa'i sangs rgyas dang / chos kyi dbyings kyi sangs rgyas dang / sems kyi sangs rgyas dang 1nya/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sangs rgyas dang / rang bzhin gyi sangs rgyas dang / bsam pa ji lta ba'i sna sangs rgyas so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' 37—325

rnams kyi sangs rgyas bstan pa rjes su rtogs par bya ba rnams so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi kun tu bzang po'i sems bskyed pa ste/ bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar sems bskyed pa de ni 'gro ba thams cad yongs su skyob pa'i phyir byams pa chen po dang ldan pa'o/ /sems bskyed pa de ni 'gro ba thams cad kyi sdug bsngal kyi phung po rang gi lus kyis len0)pa'i phyir snying rje chen po dang ldan pa'o②/ /sems bskyed pa de ni ci bdog pa yongs su gtong ba'i phyir btang nib thams cad yongs su gtang ④ba sngon du 'gro ba'o/ /sems bskyed pa de ni sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad la mngon par mos pas zhi thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes yid la byed pa sngon du 'gro ba'odu/ /sems bskyed pa de ni byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa thams cad la nan tan du byed pas yon tan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /sems bskyed pa de ni skye ba'i skye mched thams cad du nyams par mi 'gyur bas rdo rje lta bu'o/ /sems bskyed pa de ni chos dkar po thams cad la yang dag par gzhol bas rgya mtsho lta bu'o/ /sems bskyed pa de ni gzhan gyis〈pengan du brjod pa dang ngan du smra ba dgashebazod pa'i phyir ri bo chen po'i dbang po dam pa lta bu'o/ /sems bskyed pa de ni sems can thams cad la dbugs phyin pa chen pos sdud pa'i phyir bde bar7byed pa'o/ /sems bskyed pa de ni chos thams cad rab tu dbye ba la mkhas pas mi dmyigs pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pas huXrtogs par 'khong du chud par bya ba'onyuge / /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi kun tu bzang po'i sems bskyed pa ste/ de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams myur du 8kun tu bzang po'i ye shes khong du chud pa la mkhas pasalge37—326

'thob par 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa'i7chos te②/ bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar ma 'ongs pa'i bskal pa thams cad du gnas pa'i smon lam ni kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa'i chos so/ /ma byon pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mchod cing rimanyegror bya ba'i smon lam ni kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa'i chos so/ /sems can thams cad byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa la dgod pa ni kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa'i chos so/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad yang dag par bstsagasalgepa'i smon lam ni kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa'i chos so/ /pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad la 'jug pa'i smon lam ni kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa'i chos so/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyod pa yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i smon lam ni kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa'i chos so/ /'jig rten gyi khams thams cad brgyan pa'i smon lam ni kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa'i chos so /sangs rgyas gyi zhing thams cad du skye ba gzungasnyiba'i smon lam ni kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa'i chos so/ /chos thams cad yongs su btsal7zhing rab tu dbye ba la mkhas par bya ba'i smon lam ni kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa'i chos so/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya ba'i smon lam ni kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa'i chos so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa'i chos te⑤/ de dag gis smon cing mngon par brtson par byas na/byang chub sems dpa' rnams myur tu kun tu bzang po'i smon lam dang / spyod pa yongs su rdzogs pa7'thob par〈 )'gyur ba dag go// //37—327

sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo0)/ bam po bcu bzhi lapa/ kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi snying rje chen po rab tu 'thob gepa ste/ de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' rnams rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta'o④/ /bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar sems can gyi khams mgon med pa rnams la rnam par ltasaXgeba'i snying rje chen po rab tu thob pa dang / sems can gyi khams theg pa med pa la rnam par lta neba'i snying rje chen po rab tu thob pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa bas dbul ba'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta chuba'i snying rje chen po rab tu thob pa dang / yun ring po nas gnyid kyis58dbargyal ba'i sems can7gyi khams la rnam par lta 1 ba'i snying rje chen po rab tu thob pa dang / dge ba med pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta 11ba'i snying rje chen po 32rab tu thob pa dang /'dod chags kyi 1 bcing bas glags pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta (༄ba'i snying rje chen po rab tu thob pa dang / srid pa'i gang7chen mtshor rab tu gzhol 16bar gyur pa'i 1 sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta〈nyeba'i snying rje chen po rab tu thob pa dang / yun ring po nas na ba'i sems can gyi7)khams la rnam par lta gi chiba'i snying rje chen po rab tu thob pa dang / dge ba'i chos la mos pa med 31pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta du rteba'i snying rje chen po rab tu thob pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos las shin tu 'khyams par gyur pa'i sems can gyi khams la rnam par lta sa ba'i snying rje chen po rab tu thob pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi snying rje chen po (zurab tu thob pa ste de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' rnams rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par sems 37wa 328

can gyi khams la rnam par blta ༅7ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams ri rkyen gang gis byang chub tu sems bskyed param ri'agyur ba'i byang chub kyi sems kyi rkyen rnams te/ bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar sems canamagegyi khams yongs su spyin par bya ba 3modang / rnam par gdul bar bya ba'i rkyen ni byang chub kyi sems kyi rkyen to/ /sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal gyi phung po rnamatsha47par bzlog pa'i rkyen ni byang chub kyi sems kyi rkyen to/ /sems can thams cad la bde ba'i yo gebyad kyis sdud (shepa'i rkyen ni byang chub kyi sems kyi rkyen to/ /sems can thams cad kyi mi shes pa bstsal 493ba'i rkyen ni nyu byang chub kyi sems kyi rkyen to/ /sems can thams cad la sangs rgyas kyi ye shes nye bar bsgrub pa'i rkyen ni byang chub kyi sems kyi rkyen to/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod cing rim gror nyu7bya ba'i rkyen ni byang chub kyi sems kyi rkyen to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mnyes par bya ba'i rkyen ni byang chub kyi sems kyi rkyen to/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku tshagazugs dang mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po yongs su bstan pa'i rkyen ni byang chub kyi sems kyi rkyen to/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes la 'jug cing khong du chud par byed pa'i01rkyen ni byang chub kyi sems kyi rkyen to/ /sangs rgyas kyi stobs dang mi bsnyengs pa thams cad yongs su bstan thupa'i rkyen ni byang chub kyi sems kyi rkyen to/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byang chub kyi sems kyi rkyen te /rkyen de dag gis byang chub kyi 7sems sna yang dag par skye bar 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' gang gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa des kyang thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes 37—329

mngon par 'tshang rgya bar bya ba'i phyir dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la rim gro dang bkur stetudang bsnyen bkur〈pebya'o/ /deshedage ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la rim gro dang / bkur stimajugadang / bsnyen bkur byed pa'i tshe/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la sems bskyed pa bcu po 'di dag bskyed par bya ste/ bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar rim gro ④bya ba'i sems dang / dga' bar bya ba'i sems dang ji skad bsgo ba bzhin du nan tan tu7bya ba'i sems dang yid mi 'byung ba'i sems dang / ji snyam yang mi byed pa'i sems dang / gcig tu nges pa'i sems dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad la rgyud kyi tshul gcig tu gyur pa'i ⑧sems dang / smon lam gcig pa'i sems dang / ston pa'i sems dang /spyod pal)mtshungs par hu )yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i sems te(te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la sems bskyed pa rnams so//de sems bskyed pa bcu po 'di dag bskyed pa'i tshe'ageyongs su dag pa bcu rab tu 'thob par 'gyur〈nyete/ bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar chud mi za ba'i7phyir lhag pa'i bsam pa yongs su nyunyedag pa dang / sems can ji lta bur 'dul ba bzhin du bstan pa'i phyir gzugs yongs su dag pa dang / sgra skad dang tha snyad bsam gyis mi khyab pa la 'jug par bya ba'i phyir dbyangs tu 7kyi dkyil 'khor yongs su dag pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos bsam gyis mi khyab pa bstan pa la (nyemakhas par bya ba'i phyir spobs pa yongs su dag pa dang / mi shes pa thams cad dang bral bar bya ba'i phyir ye shes yongs su dag pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi dbang rab tu thob par bya ba'i phyir skye ba yongs su dag pa dang /sngon skal ba hu'emanyam par spyad pa'i sems can rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su 37wa 330

smin par bya ba'i phyir 'khor yongs su dag pa dang / sgrib pa'i las thams cad spangs pas rnam par bzlog hu)pa'i phyir rnam par smin pa yongs su dag pa dang /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang tshul gcig tu bya ba'i ②phyir smon lam yongs su dag pa dang / kun tu bzang po'i theg pas 'byung ba'i phyir spyod pa yongs su dag pa ste/ yongs su dag pa bcu po 'di dag 'thobalgepar 'gyur ro/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gho/ bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar bdogatso)pa thams cad yongs su btangatsho)ba'i phyir sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi tshul khrims yongs su sbyang ba'i phyir tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i stobs kyisam bsam pa mi 'khrugs pas sangs rgyas kyi stobs la sbyar ba'i phyir bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / mos pa thams cad las phyir mi ldog par bya ba'i phyir brtson 'grus kyi ⑨pa rol tu phyin pa dang / dran pa rtse gcig tu bya ba'i phyir bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / chos thams cad yang dag pa ji lta tsob bzhin du rab tu rtogs par bya ba'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang /sangs rgyas kyi stobs la 'jug pa'i phyir ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / kun tu bzang po'i smon lam yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir smon lam gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / rdzu 'phrul dang rnam par 'phrul pa yongs su bstan pa'i phyir rdzu 'phrul gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / chos thams cad la yang dag par gzhol bar bya5)ba'i phyir chos kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ste/ de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes chen po'i pha rol tu 37—331

phyin pa bla na med pa 'thob par 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi shes pa khong du chud par bya ba ste/bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad la tshirnam pa tha dad pa shes pa khong du chud par bya ba dang / sems can gyi khams thams cad kyi rigs bsam gyisadza mi khyab pa la 'jug pa'i shes pa khong du chud par bya ba dang / chos thams cad las gcig pa dang tha dad par yang dag par gzhol bar bya ba'i shes pa khong du chud par bya ba dang / chos kyi dbyings 'byam ge)klas pa thams cad shin tu bstan snipa'i shes pa khong du chud (9par bya ba dang / nam mkha'i lpidabyings ma lus pa thams cad kyis 2kras pa'i shes pa khong du chud par bya ba dang /'jig rten gyi khams thams cad la ma 'ongs pa'i dus kyi 'jugatsun / pa'i shes 8pa khong du chud par bya ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad la tshome'adas pa'i dus kyi 'jug 12pa'i shes pa khong du chud par bya ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad la da ltar byung ba'i dus kyi 'jug pa'i 12shes pa khong du chud par bya ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi spyodam/stepa dang / smon lam rnam pa tha dad pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bya bas gcig tu rtogs par 'gyur ba'i shes pa khong du chud par bya ba dang / 'das pa dang ma byon pa dang ske/ da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyod pa gcig gis byung ba'i shes pa khong du chud par bya'om/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi shes pa khong du chud par bya ba ste/ de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams chos snang ba thams cad la dbang bsgyur ba thob 1stepa dang / bsam pa ji lta ba 1 cibazhin du smon shelam yongs su rdzogs pa thob 17pa 37wa 332

dang ske/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad mtshan nyid gcig tu mos pas sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar hu)'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di 2dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rab tu rtogs pa ste/ bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar chos thams cad la tshul gcig tu rtogs pa dang / chos thams cad la tshul tha dad par rtogs pa dang / chos thams cad la mtshan nyid gcig tu rtogs pa dang / sems can gyi ribasems dang /bsam pa thams cad la chags pa med pa'i ④ye shes su rtogs pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi dbang po byamanyam pa nyid du rtogs pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa dang / bag chags kyi spyod pa rtogs pa dang /sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa dang / bag la nyal ba'i spyod pa rtogs pa dang ske/ sems can thams cad kyi dge ba yidang / mi dge ba'i spyod pa thams cad rtogs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dang / smon lam gedang rnam par rtse0)ba dang / 'phrul pa dang / byin gyi rlabs tshormethams cad rtogs pa dang ske/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu ma lus par mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i byin gyi rlabs 7/3 rtogs pa'o/ /kye /1rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi 32rtogs pa ste/ de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams chos thams cad kyi tshul la mkhas pa hu bla na med pa 'thob par 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye 1)rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi stobs kyi shugs te/ bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin la 'jug pa'i stobs kyi shugs dang / chos thams cad sprul pa lta bu'i stobs kyi shugs dang / chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bu'i stobs kyi shugs dang /37—333

chos thams cad la sangs rgyas kyi chos su 'jug pa'i stobs kyi shugs dang /chos thams cad la mngon par chags pa med pa'i stobs kyi shugs dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad la shin tu mos pa'i stobs kyi shugs dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen thams cad la shin tu gus pa'i bsam pa mi gtong ba'i stobs kyi shugs dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyis ye shes kyi rgyal po chen po mnyesatupar byed pa'i stobs kyi shugs dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad la zab par yid chesar pas mi spangs pa'ibastobs kyi shugs dang / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sems las myi ldog par mkhas pa'i stobs kyi shugs so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi stobs kyi shugs te/ de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu bla na med pa 'thobasrepar 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mnyam pa nyid de/ bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar sems can thams cad la mnyam pa nyid dang / chos thams cad la mnyam pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad la mnyam pa nyid dang / lhag pa'i bsam pa thams cad la mnyam pa nyid dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad la mnyam pa nyid dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la mnyam pa nyid dang /smon lam mthams cad la mnyam pa nyid dang / pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad la mnyam pa nyid dang / spyod pa thams cad la mnyam pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas thams cad la mnyam pa nyid do/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mnyam pa nyid de/ de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams yisangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid bla na med pa 'thob 37—334

par 'gyur ba0)dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi tshul gyi lam rnams te/ bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar chos thams cad ni ming tsam mo/ /chos thams cad ni sgyu ma lta bu'o/ /chos thams cad ni mig yor lta bu'o/ /chos thams cad ni rten pa tsam du mo /chos thams cad ni las dang bral ba'o/ /chos thams cad gi⑧mi zad pa'i sbyor ba'o/ /chos thams cad ni yang dag pa'i mtha' 'o/ /chos thams cad ni mtshan ma med pa'o/ /chos thams cad ni don dam pa'o/ /chos thams cad ni chos 0kyi dbyings so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de ⑤dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi tshul gyi lam ste/ de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes gyi tshul la mkhas pa bla na med pa 'thob par 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi chos bstan pa ste/ bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar zab mo'i chos bstan pa dang / yangs pa'i chos bstan pa dang / sna tshogs kyi53)chos bstan pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid brjod pa mang po'i chos bstan pa dang / pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i chos bstan pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs mngon par bsgrub pa'i chos bstan pa dang / dus gsum dang ldan pa'i chos bstan pa dang / phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpasamatsobya ba'i chos bstan pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi yon tan dang / legs pas)rab tu brjod pa'i chos bstan pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa thams cad dang ske/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la dmigs pa dang ldan pa'i chos bstan7pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras 37—335

bcu khya)po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi chos bstan pa ste de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi chos bstan pa chen po bla na med pa stonasapar 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yongs su gzung ba ①ste/bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar dge ba'i rtsa ba dang / bsod nams kyi tshogs rnams yongs su gzung thub dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsungs pa'isnyichos bstan pa rnams yongs su gzung〈6)ba dang / dpe dang mthun par bstan7pa thams cad yongs su gzung50ba dang / chos kyi tshul dang / sgo thams cad yongs su gzung 9ba dang / gzungs thams cad mngon par bsgrub pa'i sgo rnams yongs su gzung tsob dang / the tsom (rmithams cad yongs su gcod pa rnams yongs su gzung /deb dang / byang chub sems dpa'i bsgrub pa thams cad yongs su gzung 1 ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin shin tu bstan pa'i sgo rnams yongs su gzung〈nyeb dang / chos snang ba'i sgo thams cad yongs su gzung 8ba dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnam par sprul pa dang / rnam par rol pa dang / byin gyi rlabs hunyernams yongs su gzung 1 ba'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' hu rnams kyi 33yongs su gzung ba ste/ de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes chen po yongs su gzung ba'odu 1ske/ /bla na med pa 'thob par 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spobs pa ste/ bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar chos thams cad la rnam par ma brtags sa pa'i spobs pa dang / chos thams 37—336

cad la mngon par 'du byed pa med pa'i spobs pa dang / chos thams cad la mi gnas ①pa'i spobs pa dang / chos thams cad la stong pa nyid du snang ba'i spobs pa dang / chos thams cad la mun pa med pa'i spobs pa dang / chos thams cad la sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyilaspobs pa dang / chos thams cad la gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog pa'i spobs pa dang / chos thams cad la tshig gi bye brag mkhas pa'i spobs pa dang / chos thams cad la de kho na ge nyid bstan pa'i spobs pa dang / sems can gyi sems dang / spyod pa thams cad la bsam pa ji lta ba0)bzhin du tshim par byed pa'i spobs pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spobs pa ste/ de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams sangs rgyas thams cad kyi spobs pa la mkhas pa bla na med pa 'thob par 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dbang ste/ bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar sems can thams cad yongs su smin par byed cing 'dul ba'i ye shes kyi dbang dang / chos thams cad snang ba rab tu 'thob 5)pa'i dbang dang dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad la spyod pa'i dbang dang ye shes chen po'i dbang dang mi gnas pa'i tshul khrims kyi dbang dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad byang chub tu yongs su bsngo 7ba'i dbang dang / brtson 'grus brtsams pa thams cad las phyir mi ldog pa'i ye shes kyi dbang dang / bdud thams cad shin tu pham par bya ba'i ye shes kyi dbang dang / gang du dga' bar 'gro bar byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa'i ye shes kyi dbang dang / sangs rgyas thams cad ni)kyi byang chub nam〈pe'adod pa na 3 )mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i ye shes kyi dbang po/ /kye rgyal ba'i 37—337

sras tu)bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dbang ste/ de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams ⑧de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes chen po'i dbang bla na med pa 'thob par 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mi⑧gnas pa ste/ bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad la mi gnas pa dang / sems can thams cad la mi gnas pa dang / chos thams cad la mi gnas pa dang / bya ba thams cad la mi gnas pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad la mi gnas pa dang ske/ skye ba'i skye mched thams cad la mi gnas pa dang / smon lam thams cad la mi gnas pa dang / spyod pa thams cad la mi gnas pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la mi gnas pa dang / sangs rgyas thams cad la mi gnas pa'o/ / kye rgyal ba'i ④mas bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mi gnas pa ste/ de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams sems yangs par bsgyur sarab yongs su shes pa'i ye shes yongs su dag cing bla na med pa 'thob par 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag duni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sems mnyam pa nyid de/ bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar bsod nams thams cad bstsags pa la sems mnyam pa nyid dang / smon lam rnam pa tha dad pas 'byung ba thams cad la sems mnyam pa nyid dang /sems can gyi rigs 3thams cad la sems mnyam pa nyid dang / sems can gyishelas rnam par smin pa la 'jug pa thams cad la sems mnyam pa nyid dang /chos la 'jug pa thams cad la sems mnyam pa nyid dang / zhing kun nas nyon mongs pa dang / rnam par dag pa thams cad la sems mnyam pa nyid dang /37—338

sems can gyi ①mos pa la 'jug pa thams cad la sems mnyam pa nyid dang /spyod pa'i rnamakhupar rtog⑧pa thams cad la sems mnyam pa nyid dang / sangs rgyas kyi stobs dang mi bsnyengs pa la 'jug pa thams cad la sems mnyam pa nyid dang ske/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes la 'jug pa khong du chud par bya ba la sems mnyam pa nyid do/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de byadag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sems mnyam pa nyid de/ de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i dgongs pa0)mnyam pa nyid rgya che zhing bla na med pa 'thob par 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ye shes mngon par bsgrub pa ste/ bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar sems can gyi khams thams cad kyi mos pa khong du chud par bya ba la zhugs pa'i ye shes mngon par bsgrub pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing sna tshogs khong du chud par bya ba la zhugs pa'i ye shes mngon par bsgrub pa dang /phyogs kyi dra ba rnam par dbye ba ④thams cad khong du chud par bya ba la zhugs pa'i ye shes mngon par bsgrub pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams spyi'u tshugs su rgyu bsnyedang snrel zhir7rgyu ba thams cad khong du chud par bya ba la zhugs pa'i ye shes mngon par bsgrub pa dang / chos thams cad gcig pa dang / tha dad pa'i 'byam klas par rnam par dgod pa la mkhas pa khong du chud par bya ba la zhugs pa'i ye shes mngon par bsgrub pa dang / lus kyi rgyud thams cad khong du chud par bya ba la 'jug par zhugs pa'i ye shes mngon par bsgrub pa dang / 'du shes kyis phyin ci log tu gyur pa'i 'jig rten gyi hunyernam pa'i 'du shes dang /rlomanyesems khong du chud par bya ba la zhugs pa'i ye shes mngon par bsgrub pa 37—339

dang ske/ chos kyi rgyud thams cad la 'byung ba gcig gi0)mthar thug par 'jug pa khong du chud par bya ba la zhugs pa'i ye shes mngon par bsgrub pa dang / chos kyi dbyings thams cad kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa dang / byin gyi rlabs —rikhong du chud par bya ba la zhugs pa'i ye shes mngon par bsgrub pa dang /'gro ba thams cad kyi dus gsum du 'dus pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rigs thams cad rgyun mi gcod pa khong du chud par bya ba la zhugs pa'i ye shes mngon par bsgrub pa'o / /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ye shes mngon par bsgrub pa ste/ de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams chos gang la yang mgo rmongs par mi 'gyur ba dag go/ /kyete③rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sprul pa ste/ bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar sems can sprul pa dang / lus sprul pa dang / zhing sprul pa dang ske/ mchod pa casprul pa dang / dbyangs sprul pa dang / spyod pa dang5shesmon lam sprul pa dang / sems can yongs su smin par bya ba dang gdul ba sprul pa dang ske/ mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa sprul pa dang / chos bstan pa sprul pa dang / byin gyi rlabs )sprul pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de 3)dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sprul pa ste/ de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams chos thams cad sprul pa yongs su rdzogs pa bla na med pa 'thob par 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye'ishesargyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byin gyi rlabs sna cite/ bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs /1dang / chos kyi byin gyi rlabs52dang / sems can gyi byin gyi rlabs sna dang / las kyi byin gyi rlabs tsha dang / spyod pa'i byin gyi rlabasatso37—340

dang ske/ smon lam gyi byin gyi rlabs7dang / spyod yul gyi byin gyi rlabs7dang /dus kyi byin gyi rlabasashedang / dge ba'i byin gyi rlabasasnyidang / ye shes kyi byin gyi rlabs7so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byin gyi rlabs (7te/ de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams chos thams cad la dbang bsgyur ④ba'i byin gyi rlabs521bla na med pa 'thob par 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi shin tu dbugs phyin pakha rab tu rnyed7pa bcu ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di la byang chub sems dpa' hunya'adi ltar sems bskyed de / ma 'ongs pa'i dzus na de bzhin gshegs pa gang 28snyed cig 'byung bar 'gyur ba de dag thams cad mnyes par bya'o/ /zhes dbugs phyin pa chen po rab tu 'thob bo/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag la yang sangs rgyas kyi tshul dang 'dra ba'i rim gro bla na med pa bya'o(nye/ /mchod pa dang bsnyen mibakur bla na med pa bya'om/ /zhes dbugs phyin pa chen po rab tu 'thob botso/ /bdag gis de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag khye tshomachod nas kyang gdams ngag gang gis byang chub sems dpa' rnams byang chub sems dpa'i 32sar byung bar gyur pa dang / 'byung ba dang 'byung bar 'gyur ba de lta bu'i gdams tu'engag dang man ngag dro )bstan pa mdzad kyis ( stogadams ngag dang man ngag ( nyede'ang bdag gis bsam pa thag pas rim gro byas te( snye/ mnyan la yang dag par nan tan tu bya'o/ /zhes dbugs phyin pa chen po rab tu 'thob bo(snye /kye rgyal ba'i sras gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du sems te/37—341

bdag bskal pa7)brjod du med par byang chub sems dpa'ikhuspyad pa spyod pa'i tshe/sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang mi 'bral bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes dbugs phyin pa chen po rab tu 'thob po kye rgyal ba'i sras gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam dushesems te/ sngon bdag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i ④byang chub tu ma zhugs pa'i ①tshe/'di lta ste/ 'tsho yi ba med pa'i 'jigasalgepa'am/ grags pa med pa'i 'jigs pa'am / 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa'am/ ngan song gi 'jigasalgepa'am/ 'khor du bag tsha ba'i 'jigs 59)pa'ang rung ste/ ji hu )snyed kyi 'jigs〈nyepar gyur pa7de dag thams cad ni rnam par bzlogatshwa par gyur/ ring du byas par gyuratswarnam par bcil bar gyur te/ byang chub kyi sems bskyed ma thag tu cis kyang mi 'jigs par gyur geto/ /mi sngangs par gyur 8to/ /skyi g.ya' ba med par gyur〈rteto / /cis kyang 'jigs par mi 'gyur ro/ / sngangs par〈nyemi 'gyur ro/ /skyi g.ya' bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de bas na brtan zhing rnam par gnon la zil gyis mi non pas bdud dang mu stegs can dang / pas kyi rgol ba thams cad kyis mi thub par gyur 17to/ /zhes dbugs phyin pa chen po rab tu thob (3 bo/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' 'di snyam du sems bskyed de/bdag byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe/ sems can gyi khams thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su smin par bya'o/ /rab tu dgod par bya'o/ /de dag byang chub thob par gyur nas kyang de bzhin gshegs pa dgra zhu1bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag la dad pa chen po dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed pas che'i tshad kyi mthar thug gi bar du 37—342
