las phyir ltas7kyang sems can thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba'i bsam pa ma btang ba/ rtag tu chos kyi dga' bas dga' zhing mos kyang lha'imad ci)bu mo brgya phrag stong gi sgra rab tu phyung geb dang rtse ba/ mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po dang /dge ba'i mchog brgya phrag stong gis brgyan ④pa'i lus dang ldan yang dbul ba thams cad kyi tshul yongs su ston pa/ rtag tu kha na ma tho ba med pa'i las dge ba spyad kyang sems can dmyal ba dang / byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten du skye ba yang yongs su ston pa/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mchog thob kyang / byang chub sems dpa'i ye shes kyi lus las gyen du ma g.yos pa dag ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras de ltar byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni ye shes mu med pa dang ldan pas/ de'i phyir de dag nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis kyang khong du chud par dka' na sems can byis pa gzhan gyisasalta smos kyang ci dgosar+sāte/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i chos ma 'dres pa lnga pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni lus dang ngag dang yid ye shes sngon du 'gro ba dang ldan pa ste/ las shin tu dag par spyod cing ske/ srog gcod pa dang bral ba nas sdig pa'i lta ba'i bar dang bral bas byams pa phun sum tshogs shing yang dag pa'i lta ba la zhugs pa yin te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras de ltar lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las ye shes sngon du 'gro ba dang ldan pa 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi chos ma 'dres pa ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i chos ma 'dres pa drug pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni snying rje chen po dang ldan pas sems can thams cad yongs su mi gtong zhing sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal gyi phung po rang gi 37—441

lus kyis0)len par mkhas pas/ sems can dmyal ba dang / byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi sdug bsngal gyis7sems can gyi don du yongs su skyo ba med pa'i sems dang ldan zhing sems can gyi khams thams cad dgrol ba la zhugs pa/ 'dod pa'i dga' ba thams cad kyis rtse zhing yongs su longs spyod pa la chags pa med pa'i yid dang ldan pas rtag tu sems can rnams sdug bsngal gyi phung po las dgrol ba lasamangon par brtson pa ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras de ltar snying rje chen po'i stobs yongs su mi gtong ④ba 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi chos ma 'dres pa ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i chos ma 'dres pa bdun pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni 'gro ba thams cad kyi yid du 'ong zhing mthong na dga' ba ste/ brgya byin dang tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten gyi mgon po thams cad kyis0phyag bya ba/ 'gro ba thams cad mthong bar 0smon pa/ sems can thams cad mngon par dga' ba'i sems dang ldan pa niste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de7ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams sngon nas las kyi mtha' kha na ma tho ba med pa dang ldan zhing yongs su dag pa'i las kyi tshul gyis spyod pas/ de'i7phyir de dag mthong bas / 'gro ba thams cad mi ngoms pa yin⑩/ kye rgyal ba'i sras de ltar 'gro ba tsothams cad mthong bar mngon par dga' ba de ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi chos ma 'dres pa ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi chos ma 'dres pa brgyad pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams ⑩ni thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sems brtan pa dang ldan pa'i lhag pa'i bsam pa'i go ca7shin tu bgos pas/ de dag ji ltar nyon mongs shing byis pa'i skye bo'i 37—442

'du 'dzi7dang / ji ltar bsten tam/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi tshogs kyishenang du ji ltar phyin kyang rung ste/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i sems rin po che bzang po 'od dang ldan pa de 'jig par mi byed doge/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de ni 'di lta ste dper na nor bu rin po che chen po rgyan bzang po zhes bya ba de chu55)dang bar byed pa ni pad mo'i rdzing bu ji ltar rnyog mu/kyang rung ste/ nang du bcug na nor bu rin po che'i ni'od gsal zhing bzang po 5)de nyid rnam par mi spong ste/chu de thams cad kyang rnyog pa med par rab tu dang bar byed do/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' yang byis pa'i skye bo'i 'du 'dzis 7ji ltar bsten (7kyang thams cad mkhyen pa'i sems rin po che'i bo'od gsal zhing snang ba bzang po de〈nyechud zos par mi byed de sems can de dag kyang nyon mongs pa'i rtog pa de las zlog cing thams cad mkhyen pa'i sems rin po che'i sko'od gsal zhing snang ba de nyid la rab tu 'god do/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de ltar ci 8ltar nyon mongs par gyur kyang rung / byis pa'i tshaskye bo'i 'du 'dzi 3 sgyudang / ji ltar bsten5)tam/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi tshogs kyi nang du ji ltar phyin kyang rung ste/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i sems rin po che de nyid 'jig par mi byed pa de ni byang chub sems dpa'i chos ma 'dres pa ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i〈nyechos ma 'dres pa dgu pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni rang gi yul gyi ye shes kyi chos la dbang bsgyur 32ba'i pha rol tu phyin pa dam pa thob pa ste/ rang byung gi ye shes kyi dbang bskur07bas dbang bskur〈nyezhing go 'phang skyon med pa la gnas kyang dge ba'i bshes gnyen la gnas pa ring du mi spong zhing de bzhin gshegs pa la rim gro bya ba'i ri )rgyun mi gcod de mi/37wa 443

de ltar tshul phun sum tshogs pa dang / 'gro ba thams cad du dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsten 3)pa las phyir mi ldog cing de bzhin gshegs7pa la rim grosabya ba rgyun mi gcod pa de ni byang chub sems dpa'i chos ma 'dres pa ste/ 'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i chos ma 'dres pa bcu pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi chos ma 'dres pa ste/ de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos ma 'dres pa bla na med pa 'thob par 'gyur ba dag go ge/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'disnyedag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi las te④/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di ltar tso)'jig rten gyi khams thams cad yongs su sbyang ba'i las dang / sangs rgyas thams cad bsnyen bkur ba'i las dang / byang chub sems dpa'i grogs thams cad dang dge ba'i rtsa ba gcig tu bya ba'i las dang / sems can gyi khams thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba'i las dang / ma 'ongs pa'i dus thams cad kyi phyi ma'i mtha'i'an mur thug par yongs su gzung laba'i las dang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du 'gro yang 'jig rten gyi khams gcig nas mi g.yo ba'i rdzu 'phrul gyi las dang / kha dog mtha' yas pa'i 'od gzer dgye ba'i 'od tshekyi las dang /pad mo'i snying po la byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs 'khod pa yongs su bstan pa'i 'od gzer gyi las dang / mya ngan las 'das pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyi bstan pa gzung nyu1bas dkon mchog gsum gyi nyu2rigs rgyun mi gcad nyu pa'i las dang / 'jig rten thams cad du rgyu 〉zhing chos bstan pa dang /sems can gdul ba 'iyang dag par bsgrub pa'i sprul pa'i spulas dang / nam 'dod pa dang nam sems bskyed pa na smon lam yongs su rdzogs par sems can 37—444

la yang dag par ston pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyi las 1)so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi las ri te/ de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'phrin rilas rgya chen po bla na med pa 'thob par 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lus te/ bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar 'gro ba thams cad du byungatso)ba med pas/ byang chub sems dpa'i lus ni phyi'ongs pa med pa'o/ /'gro ba thams cad du mi dmigs pa med pas byang chub sems dpa'i lus ni 'ongs pa'o/ /'jig rten thams cad kyis na)dmigs pa ji lta ba bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i lus ni bden pa ma yin pa'o/ /'jig rten gyi bden pa rnamanyepar dmigs pa ji lta ba bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i lus ni brdzun pa ma yin no0/ /phyi ma'i mtha'i nyi )mur rgyun mi 'chad pas byang chub sems dpa'i lus ni rgyun mi zad pa'o/ /bdud thams cad kyis mi shigs pas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lus ni brten 11pa'o/ /bdud kyi rgol ba thams cad kyis mi sgularwarnyebs byang chub sems dpa'i lus ni sra ba'o/ /bsod nams brgya pa'i〈nyematshan gyis shin tu rnam par dag par snang bas byang chub sems dpa'i lus ni mtshan bzang po dang ldan pa'o/ /chos kyi mtshan nyid med pa'i mthar thug pas byang chub sems dpa'i lus ni mtshan 14nyid med pa'o/ /'das pa dang /ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang mnyam pa nyid thob mapas byang chub sems dpa'i lus ni kun tu song ba'o kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lus te/ de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku mi 37—445

zad pa bla na med pa 'thob 1)par 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lus kyi las te/ bcu gang zhe na/'di ltar 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad lus gcig gis rgyas par 'gengs pa'i lus kyi las nanodang / sems can gyi khams thams cad du sgo yongs su ston55pa'i lus kyi las dang / skye ba thams cad du gnas pa'i lus kyi las dang /'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du 'gro ba'i lus kyi las dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyis 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du 'gro ba'i lus kyi las dang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad lag pa gcig gis kun tu khebasalgepar byed pa'i lus kyi yelas dang / khor 7)yug dang / rdo rje'i ri thams cad lag pa gcig gis nyug pa'i lus kyi las dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du rang gi lus 'jig pa dang / 'byung ba yongs su ston pa'i lus kyi lasasnyedang sems can gyi khams thams 9cad lus gcig gis yongs su 'dzin pa'i lus kyi las dang /sems can gyi khams thams cad lus med par khong du chud pas zhing yongs su dag pa dang / yongs su rdzogs pa kun tu ston pa'i lus kyi las so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lus kyi las te/ de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams sangs rgyas kyi chos 'gro ba kun gyis rnam par rig par bya ba bla na med pa 'thob par 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rang bzhin te/bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar nan tan dang ldan pas pha rol tu phyin pa'i rang bzhin dang —/ 'gro ba thams cad yongs su mi gtong bas/ bsdu ba'i dngos po'i rang bzhin dang / sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal gyi57phung po tsharang gi lus 37—446

kyis 1len kyang / yongs su mi skyo bas snying rje chen po'i rang bzhin dang /'gro ba thams cad yongs su skyob pas byams pa chen po'i rang bzhin dang /'gro ba thams cad nye bar 'tsho bas bsod nams kyi rang bzhin dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku dang / gcig tu 'dres pas 5ye shes kyi rang bzhin dang /skye ba'i skye mched thams cad las 'das pas kyichos kyi rang bzhin dang / thams cad du rme/sgo yongs su ston pas thams cad kyi rang bzhin dang / rdzu 'phrul dang rnam par 'phrul pa thams cad yongs su ston pas/ rdzu 'phrul gyi 5cirang bzhin dang ske/ nam 'dod pa'i dus su mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bas kyi/ byang chub kyi rang bzhin no/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi 3)rang bzhin te/ de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes chen po'i rang bzhin bla na med pa 'thob 8par 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ngag ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di ltar sems can thams cad bde bar byed pas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ngag ni 'jam pa'o/ /sems can thams cad kyi sems sim par byed pas/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ngag ni snyan pa'o/ /yang dag pa 1 ji lta ba bzhin du go bar byed pas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ngag ni mi brdzun 11pa'o/ /rmi lam na yang log par mi smra bas byang chub sems dpa'i ngag ni bden pa'i rjes su 'brang ba'o/ /brgya 7byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten gyi 1lhamagon po thams cad zil gyis gnon pas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ngag ni rgya che ba'o/ /chos kyi rang bzhin ston 7pas/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ngag ni zab mo'i 37—447

dbyangs 1su sgrog pa'o/ /chos bstan pa thams cad mi zad pas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ngag ni snying po dang ldan pa'o/ /sgra ji lta ba bzhin du khong du chud par byed pas/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ngag ni shin tu gsal ba'o/ /dus dang las dang 2rnam par smin pa ji lta ba bzhin du yongs su ston pas/byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ngag ni rnam pa tha dad pa'o/ /bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du rnam par spyod pa la 'dzug par byed pas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ngag ni 'gro ba thams cad la 'gro ba'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag cani byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ngag ste/ de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams de de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung bla na med pa 'thob par 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa'i ngag de yang las rnam5 tshopar dag pa bcus yongs su sbyangs pa yin te/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung la mos pa yongs su dag pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i tshig sngon ma thos pa la mngon par mos pa yongs su dag pa dang / 'gro ba thams cad kyi yid du mi 'ong ba'i tshig 5yongs su spangs pas yongs su dag pa dang / sngon gyi mthar ngag gi nyes pa bzhi dang bral bas yongs su dag pa dang ske/ dga' ba dang / mos 6pa chen pos de bzhin gshegs pa mngon param bstod pas yongs su dag pa dang / sgra chen pos de bzhin gshegs pa mchod par 'os 8pa yang dag pa 9 ji lta ba bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi yon tan dang /legs pa brjod pas yongs su dag 1 pa dang / bsam pa thag pas sems can gzhan la chos kyi sbyin pas/ sdud pa 11yongs su dag pa dang / glu'i dbyangs dang ske/ rol mo brdung ba dang / dkrol ba'i dbyangs kyis de bzhin gshegs pa 37wa 448

la mngon par bstod pas yongs su dag pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams lasalgemangon sum du chos thos nas/ rang gi lus 'bul bas yongs su dag pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i chos smra ba thams cad las chos thos nas/rim gro bya ba'i phyir bdag 'bul zhing snying thag pa nas yongs su btangs ri/bas yongs su dag pa ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa'i ngag ni las rnam par dag pa bcu po de dag gis shin tu sbyangs par 'byung ngo / /kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gengag de ltar yongs su sbyangs pa de yang jiyongs su 'dzin pa bcus/ yongs su gzung ltabar 'byung ste/ bcu gang zhe na/'di ltar lha'i dbang po la stsogs (6)pa lha thams cad kyis yongs su gzung〈7bar 'byung ba ⑧yin/ klu'i dbang po dang / gnod sbyin gyi 9dbang po dang / dri za'i 7dbang po dang / lha ma 17yin gyi dbang po dang / nam mkha' lding gi dbang po dang / mi'am ci'i dbang po dang / lto 'phye 12chen po'i dbang po dang ske/ tshangs pa'i dbang po la stsogs 1 pa tshangs pa'i ris su gtogs tshapa'i lha thams cad kyis yongs su gzung bar 'byung tshab yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi dbang po la stsogs 7pa chos nya smra ba thams cad kyis yongs su gzung bar 'byung /sheb yin te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa'i ngag 16ni yongs su 'dzin pa/ bcu po de — byedag gis shin tu gzung 31bar 'byung ngo 52/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa'i lhangag de ltar shin tu gzung 2 bar 'byung ba de yang dgos 25pa bcu yongs su grub 7par byed de/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di ltar sems can gyilo khams mngon par dga' bar byed do/ /'jig rten gyi 2 khams su go du bar byed do/ /dbang po'i0 khams la 'jug par byed do/ /mos pa'i 37wa 449

khams rnam par dag par7)byed do/ /nyon mongs pa'i khams sel bar byed do/ /bag chags kyi khams spong bar mibyed do/ /bsam pa'i khams sbyong bar byed do/ /lhag pa'i bsam pa'i khams rnam par 'phel bar byed do/ /chos kyi khams rgyas par byed do/ /mya ngan las 'das pa'i khams yang dag par rtogs par byed do//dgosalo pa bcu po gede dag yongs su sgrub bo/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sems te/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'gro ba thams cad rige)kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba yang dag par 'dzin cing rton pas dubyang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sems ni sa lta bu'o/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes rgya chen po'i rgya mtsho mtha' dang dbus med pa la zhugs pas/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi 7)sems sa ni rgya mtsho lta bu'o/ /'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba shin tu mtho ba la 'gro ba thams cad rab tu dgod pa'i7phyir/ byang chub sems dpa'i sems ni ri bo chen po lta bu'o/ /kun nas nyon mongs pa med cing bsam pa dag pa dang ldan pas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sems ni nor bu rin po che lta bu'o/1/ /chos thams cad la rab tu rdo7bas/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sems ni rdo rje lta bu'o/ /bdud dang mu stegs can gzhan dang phas kyi margol ba thams cad kyis mi skulachabs/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sems ni ri'i rgyal po rdo rje'i khor 7yug shin tu brtan zhing mi shigs pa lta bu'o/ /'jig rten gyi chos thams cad kyis mi gos pas/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sems ni pad mo lta bu'o/ /bskal pa thams cad du 'byung ba dang / mthong bar dka' 3)bas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sems ni me tog u dum 'i〈per lta bu'o/ /'gro ba thams cad kyi ma rig pa'i mun pa 37—450

mun nag dang / rab rib kyi rmugs 3)pa sel ba'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sems ni nyi ma lta bu'o/ /'gro ba thams cad kyis brjod du med pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ②sems ni bar snang lta bu'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sems te/ de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i dgongs pa /ri rgya chen po yongs su dag pa bla na med pa 'thob par 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang mchub sems dpa' rnams kyi sems bskyed pa ste / bcu gang zhe natso)'di ltar 'gro ba thams cad rab tu dgrol bar bya'o zhes byang chub sems dpa' sems bskyed khya)do/ /sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa bstsalashebar bya'o/ /zhes byang chub sems dpa' sems bskyed do/ /bag chags kyi mtshams 'brel pa thams cad spang bar bya'o/ /zhes byang chub sems dpa' sems bskyed do/ /chos thams cad la the tsom med param81thob par bya'ol/ /zhes byang chub sems dpa' sems bskyed do/ /sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal gyi phung po rab tu zhi bar bya'o/ /zhes byang chub sems dpa' sems bskyed do/ /ngan song dang mi khom pa thams cad gcad bopar bya'o/ /zhes byang chub sems dpa' sems bskyed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mnyes par bya'o/ /zhes byang chub sems dpa' sems bskyed do/ /byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa thams cad la nan tan tu bya'o/ /zhes byang /1chub sems dpa' sems bskyed do/ /skra'i sbubs su 'jug pa tsho/2thams cad kyang ma lus par 'gro ba thams cad du sangs rgyas thams cad byang chub tu 'tshang rgya ba hu bstan par bya'o/ /zhes byang chub sems dpa' sems bskyed do/ /'gro ba ma lus pa 37—451

thams cad kyi bsam pa dang / dbang po rab tu rtogs pas/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du grags par bya bar chos kyi rnga bla na med pa brdung bar bya'o/ /zhes byang chub sems dpa' sems bskyed do/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sems bskyed pa ste/ de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i dgongs pa7rgya chen po'i phrin las bla na med pa rtsom par 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sems kyis rgyas par dgang ba khuste / bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar sems shin tu yangs pa dang ldan pas nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad rgyas par dgang ba gudang / mtha' dang dbus med par9)khong du chud pas chos kyi 45)dbyings/ thams cad rgyas par dgang ba ༅dang /skad cig gcig tu 'dzud pas dus gsum thams cad rgyas par dgang btsodang /gshegs pa dang skye ba dang 'byung ba dang rnam par 'tshang rgya ba dang / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor 8)ba dang / mya ngan las 'das pa chen po mngon sum du shes pas sangs rgyas skye ba thams cad du rgyas par dgang bamakhadang / bag chags dang mdabang po nam mkha' lta bur khong du chud pas/ sems can gyi khams thams cad du rgyas par dgang ba dang / chos kyi dbyings thams cad khong du chud pa'i ye shes dang ldan pas mig yor (1lta bu'i ye shes kyis rgyas par dgang ba dang ske/ sgyu ma'i dra ba rnam pa tha dad pa lta bur khong du chud pas mtha' dang dbus /rtemed par sna rgyas par dgang ba dang rang bzhin mi dmigs pas mi skye bar rgyas 8par dgang ba dang / rang gi sems dang gzhan gyi sems la thogs pa med pas mchags pa med par rgyas par dgang ba dang / sems bskyed pa thams 37—452

cad la mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa yongs su ston pas dbang gis rgyas par dgang ba'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sems kyis7rgyas par dgang ba sterig/ de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyis rgyas par dgang ba mtha' dang dbus med pa'i rgyan bla na med pa 'thob gepar 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu ④po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dbang po ste/bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar sangs rgyas thams cad mthong bar 5dad pa phyir ldog pa med pas/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dbang po ni dga' bar byed pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad mngon par 'tshang rgya bar byed pas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyipo)dbang po ni mngon par mos pa'o/ /bya ba thams cad 97thogs pa med pas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dbang po ni phyir mi ldog pa'o//byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad rgyun mi gcod pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dbang po ni gnas pa'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshul khong du chud pa'i 8)phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dbang po ni shin tu phra ba'o/ /sems can thams cad kyi dgos pa yongs su grub par byed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dbang po ni rgyun mi 'chad pa'o / /chos thams cad la rab tu rnos/ 1ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dbang po ni rdo rje lta bu'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yul la snang ba thobasngo pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dbang po ni rdo rje'i 'od 'phro ba ltar snang bar byed pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang lus gcig tu gyur pas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dbang po ni tha mi dad pa'o/ /37—453

de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs kyi ha)rjes su zhugs pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dbang po ni chags pa med pa'i mthararnyuphyin pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dbang po ste/ de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbang po rgya chen po yongs su rdzogs pa bla na med pa 'thob par 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bsam pa ste/bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bsam pa 'jig rten gyi chos thams cad kyis ma gos pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bsam pa nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yid la bya ba dngasam 'dres pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bsam pa sangs rgyas kyi byang chub kyi rjes su song ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bsam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes su 'byung ba'i lam dang mthun⑧pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bsam pa bdud dang mu stegs can gzhan dang / mu stegs spyod pa'i sa/rgol ba thams cad kyis mi 'phrogs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bsam pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gyis rnam par dag pas kun nas 0nyon mongs pa med pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bsam pa chos ji skad du thos pa yongs su mi gtong bas/shin tu zin par yang dag par 'dzin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bsam pa skye ba'i skye rinamached thams cad kyis ma gos pas yongs su nyams pa med pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bsam pa ye shes phra ba la zhugs pa'i phyir zab phyo pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bsam pa sangs rgyas 37—454

kyi chos thams cad la shin tu brtson pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bsam pa ste/ de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams thams cad mkhyen pa'i dgongs pa bla na med pa yongs su rdzogs patu'athob par 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'im sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lhag pa'i bsam pa ste/ bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lhag pa'i bsam pa dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad bstsagasalgepa la phyir mi ldog paras tshodabang bsgyur 3ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lhag pa'i bsam pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dgongs pa'i tshul bstan pa la nem nur med pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lhag pa'i bsam pa smon lam dang spyod pa chen po'i rgyun yongs su 'dzin pa dang /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lhag pa'i bsam pa sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad la 'jug par bya ba la phul (67du phyin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lhag pa'i bsam pa sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad la dbang bsgyur bas 7 mngon sum du gyur pa ninodang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lhag pa'i bsam pa chos sna tshogs kyi tshul la rab tu zhugs pas/ rgya che brtso( dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lhag pa'i bsam pa brtsams pa thams cad mthar phyin par byed pas gtso bor gyur pa codang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lhag pa'i bsam pa ting nge 'dzin dang / snyoms par 'jug pa dang / rnam par 'phrul ba'i rgyan thams cad la dbang bsgyur 31ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lhag pa'i bsam pa sngon gyi smon lam gyis 33yongs su bzung 12bas shin tu brtan mipa dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lhag pa'i bsam pa sems can 37wa 455

thams cad tsho yongs su smin par bya ba dang / gdul ba la ②rgyun mi gcod ①pa'o / /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lhag pa'i bsam pa ste/ de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams sangs rgyas thams cad kyi lhag pa'i dgongs pa bla na med pa yongs su dag pa 'thob par 'gyur ba dag go// // sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo④/ bam po bcu dgu 5pa/ kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sbyor ba ste/ bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar rnam par smin pa la re ba med par bdog pa thams cad yongs su gtong bas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sbyin pa'i sbyor ba dang / gzhan la brnyas pa med pas〈pebyang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi tshul khrims dang / bslab 3 pa dang / sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang /sdom pa dang / brtul zhugs nadang dka' tso)thub thams cad du yi dam bcas pa la nan tan byed pa'i sbyor ba dang / bdag dang pha rol gyi 'du shes med pas byang chub sems dpa' rnams nyu kyi gnod sems kyi tha ba dang / gshe ba thams cad rna la gzon 11cing sems can gyi nyi ngan du byas pa thams cad bzod pa'i sbyor ba dang / lus dang ngag dang sems yang dag par bskulamanyebs brtsams pa thams cad mthar phyin par byed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi brtson 'grus brtsams pa thams cad las phyir mi ldog pa'i sbyor ba 3stedang /'dod pa'i 'khrug 15pa dang nyon mongs pa'i g.yog 'khor yongs su mi 7sgong bas/byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi nyu bsam gtan dang / rnam〈nyepar thar pa dang ting nge 'dzin dang / snyoms par 'jug pa dang / mngon par shes pa thams 37—456

cad mngon par bsgrub pa'i sbyor ba dang bsod nams bstsags7)pa thams cad la skyo ba med pas/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi shes rab kyi phyinan tan gyi kyisbyor ba dang / sems can med pa la zhugs pas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byams pa chen po'i sbyor ba dang / chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis dben pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi 'gro ba thams cad kyi sdug bsngal rang gi lus kyis len pa'i snying rje chen po las phyir mi ldog pa'i sbyor ba dang /chags pa med par khong du chud pas 'gro ba thams cad yang dag par ston pa'i phyir / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu rnam 4par 'tshang rgya ba'i sbyor ba dang / sems can gzhan gyi rgyud du phyin par byed pas / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba las phyir mi ldog pa'i sbyor ba'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sbyor ba ste/ de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnamasam5)de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes chen po'i sbyor ba bla na med pa 'thob par 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mos pa ste/ bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar bsgrub bar dka' po ba'i nyam ba sbyor bas rlabs po che'i7mos pa dang / rgyan sna tshogs she mngon par bsgrub pas sna tshogs kyi mos pa dang / yid zhum pa med pas rgya chen po'i mos pa dang / chos zab mo'i tshul la zhugs pas zhi bar byed pa'i mos pa dang / sems rgya chen po bskyed pas yangs pa'i mos pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs lho mokyi mthu dang /shugs su ldan pas rang gi 17skabs phye ba'i mos pa dang / bdud kyi las thams cad rab tu 'joms 32pas mi 'phrogs pa'i mos pa dang / las kyi rnam par 37—457

smin pa la gcig tu nges pas shin tu gdon mi zatuba'i mos pa dang / ci 'dod pa'i cho 'phrul yongs su ston pas mngon du〈migyur pa'i mos pa dang stobs dang mi ldan pa med pa'i phyir dus gang du ③'dod par byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bas sangs rgyas thams cad kyis lung bstan pa yang dag par nod pa'i mos pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mos pa ste de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i ④mos pa bla na med pa 'thob57par 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di 6)dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams su mos pa la 'jug pa ste/ bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad 'jig rten gyi khams57gcig tu mos pa la 'jug pa dang / 'jig rten gyi risakhams gcig 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du mos pa la 'jug pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad pad mo'i gdan gcig la bzhugs pa'i khulade bzhin gshegs pa'i skus yongs su khyab par mos pa la 'jug pa dang /'jig rten gyi khams thams cad nam hu3 mkha'i rang bzhin du yang dag par bstan par mos pa la 'jug pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad sangs rgyas kyi rgyan gyis brgyan par mos pa la 'jug pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad byang chub sems dpa'i 37lus kyis rgyas par dgangakhebar mos pa la 'jug pa〈nyedang ske/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad skra'i sbubs gcig tu dgod par mos pa la 'jug pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad sems can gcig gi lus kyi rgyud kyi 8rjes su 'brang bar mos pa la 'jug pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa gcig gi byang chub kyi shing dang / de 37—458

bzhin gshegs pa gcig gi snying po byang chub kyis yongs su rgyas par gang bar mos pa la 'jug pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du sgra'i dbyangs gcig gis go bar bya ba dang / sems can gyi khams0)thams cad kyi sgra skad rnam pa tha dad pa la 'jug pas tshim par bya bar mos pa la 'jug pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams su mos pa la 'jug pa ste/ de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing la mos pa bla na med pa 'thob par 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag⑧ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sems can gyi khams su mos pa la 'jug pa ste/ bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar sems can gyi khams thams cad rang bzhin gyis lus med par mos pa la 'jug pa dang / sems can gyi khams thams cad sems can gcig gi lus kyi rgyud du 'dus par mos pa la 'jug pa dang / sems can gyi khams thams cad byang chub sems dpa'i khong du 'dus par 9 mos pa la 'jug pa dang /sems can gyi khams thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i skur 'dus par mos pa la 'jug pa dang / sems can gyi khams thams cad du sems can gcig gi lus yongs su zhugs par 'gyur bar mos pa la 'jugs pa dang / sems can gyi khams thams cad sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi snod du mos pa la 'jug pa dang /sems can gyi khams thams cad brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten gyi mgon po dang / ci 'dod pa dang / gar mos pa'i gzugs dang / kha dog dang cha byad du mngon par blta567bar mos pa la 'jug pa dang / sems can gyi khams thams cad nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi gzugs dang kha 37—459

dog dang cha byad du yongs su bstan par mos pa la 'jug pa dang / sems can gyi khams thams cad byang chub sems dpa'i0yon tan gyis yongs su brgyan par byin gyisang brlab cing yongs su bstan par mos pa la 'jug50pa dang / sems can gyi khams thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs dang / mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po dang / gzugs kyi sku sna tshogs kyi spyod lam dang / tshul dang spyod pa yongs su bstan cing gzhan gyis53)rig par bya bar mos pa la 'jug pa'o / /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sems can gyi khams su mos pa la 'jug pa ste/ de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i55)dgyes pa dang / khyu mchog gi mthu phyung ba bla na med pa 'thob par 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bag chags teyi/ bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar byang chub kyi sems kyi bag chags dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba'i bag chags dang ske/ sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i bag chags dang / sangs rgyas blta 7ba'i bag chags dang / 'jig rten gyi khams yongs su dag par skye ba'i bag chags dang / spyod pa'i bag chags dang / smon lam gyi risabag chags dang /pha rol tu phyin pa'i bag chags dang / chos mnyam pa nyid nges par rtogs pa'i bag chags dang / spyod pa rnam pa tha dad pa'i bag chags so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bag chags te/ de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams nyon mongs pa'i bag chags ma lus pa 7spangs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes chen po'i nyu bag chags thugs su chud pa bla na med pa 'thob 11par 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu 37—460

po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi nye bar len pa ste/ nye bar len pa de dag gis byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rgyun mi gcod pa'o/ /bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar yongs su smin pa'i mthar phyin par bya ba'i phyir nyu7sems can gyi khams nye bar len pa dang / lhag ma med par yongs su dag par bya ba'i phyir 'jig rten gyi khams nye bar len pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pas mnyes par bya ba'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa 5nye bar len pa dang / mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po dang / sangs rgyas kyi yon tan yang dag par bsdu laba'i phyir dge ba'i rtsa ba nye bar len pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal gyi phung po nye bar blangs te/ rab tu zhi bar bya ba'i phyir snying rje chen po nye bar len pa dang / sems can thams cad thams cad tshamakhyen pa'i bde ba la rab tu dgod pa'i phyir byams pa chen po nye bar len pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i rgyan yang dag par bsdu ba'i phyir pha rol tu phyin pa nye bar len pa dang ske/ sgo thams cad yongs su bstan pa'i phyir thabs mkhas pa nye bar len pa dang ske/ chags pa med pa'i ye shes kyi 5phyir byang chub nye bar len pa dang /mdor na thams cad mngon sum du shes pas mngon par shes par bya ba'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa'i shesachos thams cad nye bar len pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi nye bar len pa ste/ nye bar len pa de dag gis byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rgyun mi gcod cing / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rmenye bar len pa med pa bla na med pa 'thob 9par 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa'amatshernams kyi nan tan te/ bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar pha rol tu phyin pa'i 37—461

nan tan yo)dang / bslab pa'i nan tan dang / ye shes kyi nan tan dang /don gyi nan tan dang / chos kyi nan tan dang / mngon par bsgrub pa'i nan tan dang / yang dag par bstan pa'i nan tan dang / spyod pas mi skyobaba'i nan tan dang / mngon par rdzogs par byang chub par bya ba'i nan tan dang /chos kyi 'khor lo bskoramacho ba'i nanasnyirtan no/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po desadag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi nan tan te/ de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams chos thams cad kyi nan tan bla na med pa 'thob par 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ⑦'grub pa ste/ bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar dge ba'i bshes gnyen la sems pa nini sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams 'grub pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' la mngon par yid ches pa ni sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams 'grub pa'o/ /dam pa'i chos la 0mi spong ba ni sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams 'grub pa'o/ ri /tshad med pa'i sems kyis 3 risangs rgyas su dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su bsngo ba mi zad pa ni sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams 'grub pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i yul sa mtshams med par yid ches pa ni sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams 'grub pa'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams kyi yul la 'jug pa ni sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams 'grub pa'o/ /chos kyi5nyedabyings kyi yul las 1 mi g.yo ba ni sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams 'grubalgepa'o/ /bdud kyi yul las gyen du spags pasani sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams 'grub 8pa'o/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 7rjes su dran pa ni sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams 'grub pa'o / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu'i yul la mngon par mos pa ni sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams 'grub pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang 37—462

chub sems dpa' rnams kyi 'grub pa ste/ de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes chen po 'grub pa bla na med pa 'thob par 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyishisangs rgyas kyi chosasalas gol ba'i lam ste / de dag ni byang chub sems dpas ④yongs su spang ⑧bar bya ba dag go/ /bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar7dge ba'i bshes gnyen la brnyas 3)pa ni sangs rgyas kyi chos las gol〈khuba'i lam mo/ /'khor ba'i7sdug bsngal gyis 1 )'jigs pa ni sangs rgyas kyi chos las gol hunyeba'i lam mo/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pas skyo ba ni sangs rgyas kyi chos las gol7ba'i lam mo/ /'jig rten gyi khams na gnas pas yongs su skyo ba ni sangs rgyas kyi chos las gol 3lheba'i lam mo/ /mnyam par gzhag 3napa la gnas su byed pa ni sangs rgyas kyi chos las gol geba'i lam mo/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba la chags shing zhen pa ni sangs rgyas kyi chos las gol tshaba'i lam mo/ /dam pa'i chos spong ba ni sangs rgyas kyi chos las gol 3 ba'i lam mo/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa las dpar bas 'byed /shepa ni sangs rgyas kyi chos las gol 3)ba'i lam mo/ /nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas su 'dod pa ni sangs rgyas kyi chos las gol du ) ba'i lam mo/ /byang chub sems dpa' la nistozhe sdang zhing khong khro ba ni sangs rgyas kyi chos las gol sa ba'i lam mo/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi chos las gol nunyeba'i lam rnams te/de dag ni du stebyang chub sems dpas dgeyongs su spang bar bya'o/ /de dag yongs su spangs nas de'i 'og tu byang chub sems dpa' rnams byang chub sems dpa'i skyon med pa nyid du 'da' bar 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag 37wa 463

ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi skyon med pa ste/ bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'ang0)mngon par bsgrub la sems can thams cad la'ang rnam par lta tshoXb dang / lta ba'i rnam pa thams cad dang yang bral la/lta ba'i bcing bas glagasam pa thams cad kyang rab tu 'bral ba dang / mtshan ma thams cad kyis pa yid la 9)mi byed la mtshan ma la mngon par dga' ba'i sems can thams cad kyang mi 'dor ba dang / khams gsum pa thams cad las yang dag par 'das te 'jig rten gyi khams kyi gnas thams cad na gnas pa dang /nyon mongs pa rnams kyang rnam par bzlog la/ sems can rnams dang yang niphrad cing 'grogs pa dang / chos rnams la yang ⑨'dod chags dang bral la/sems can thams cad la yang snying rje chen pos byams pa dang / dngos po thams cad kyis kyang dben la 'khor thams cad kyang yongs su ston pa dang /'jig rten gyi khams las kyang gyen du 'phags la skye zhing shi 'pho pa'i spyode pa yang mngon par bsgrub pa dang / 'jig rten gyi chos thams cad kyis kyang ma gos la/'jig rten gyi bya ba thams cad la'ang thogs pa med pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi byang chub kyang mngon du gyur la spyod pa dang smon lam chen po'i nyi ma yang rgyun mi gcod pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi skyon med pa/ 'phags pa 'jig rten las 'das pa/ 'gro ba thams cad dang ske/ thun mong ma yin pa nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad dang ma 'dres pa ste/ skyon med pa de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams byang chub sems dpa'i chos nges pa rnam par 'thob par 'gyur ba dag go / /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byang 37wa 464

chub sems dpa'i chos nges pa 'thob pa ①ste/ bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su skyes pa yin/ sangs rgyas kyi yul la gnas pa yin/byang chub sems dpa'i las la zhugs pa yin/ pha rol tu phyin pa la nan tan du7byed pa yin/ sangs rgyas kyi rgyud minas byung ba yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdungakyilas skyes pa yin/ sangs rgyas kyi stobs la gnas pa yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i byang chub tu rjes su song ba yin/ sangs rgyas thams cad dang sku dang rang bzhin gcig pa yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rnam par spyod pa dang mi gnyis pa yinadu/ kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byang chub sems dpa'i chos nges par 'thobalgepa ste/ de dag ni skyon med pa la tshiganas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi 'thob pa 'u)dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di〈)dag nitshwa )byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi chos la7nya'abyung ba'i lam ste/ bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams dang rgyud kyi tshul gcig tu 'gyur ba dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba thun mong du mos pa ni sangs rgyas kyi chos la nyurte'abyung ba'i lam mo/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rnam par 'phrul pa dang / tshul mthun /)zhing smon lam chen po la dbugs phyin pa thob pa ni sangs rgyas kyi chos la78'byung ba'i lam mo/ /sems rgya chen pos rang gi dge ba'i rtsa ba'i go 'byed pa ni sangs rgyas kyi chos la ci'abyung ba'i lam mo/ /las ji ltar byas pa chud mi za bas bskal pa 'grangs pa tsothams cad du mi skyo ba ni/ sangs rgyas kyi chos las hu 7'byung ba'i lam mo/ /phyi ma'i mtha'i nyushenur thug pa thams cad du yongs su 'dzin pas/'jig rten gyi khams grangs med par gnas par bya ba ni sangs rgyas kyi chos la7)37—465

'byung ba'i lam mo/ /sems can gyi khams thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba la mkhas pas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rgyun mi gcodamanyupa ni sangs rgyas kyi chos la na'abyung ba'i lam mo/ /snying rje chen po bskyed de sems tshad med par byed pa ni sangs rgyas kyi chos la du )'byung ba'i lam mo/ /nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad sems bskyed ③pa gcig gis rgyas par dgang bas spyod pa dang smon lam chen po'i khyad par la ge'ajug pa ni sangs rgyas kyi chos la7'byung ba'i lam mo / /sngon mngon par bsgrubs pa gachud mi za bar nide bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs yang dag par 'dzin pa ni sangs rgyas kyi chos la ⑨'byung ba'i lam mo/ /'gro ba thams cad la byang chub kyi 7sems yongs su ston cing / byang chub tu5tesems bskyed 15pa rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad nye bar ston pa ni sangs rgyas kyi chos la /lha'abyung ba'i skelam mo/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de 8dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi chos la 19'byung ba'i lame ste/ de dag gis byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi nyurteskyes bu dam pa'i ming bcu 'thob par 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di5snyedag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi skyes bu dam pa'i ming 'thob pa ste/ bcu gang zhe na/'di ltar 19byang chub kyi ye shes kyi lus dang ldan pas byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya ba yin/ theg pa chen po la rab tu gnas pa'i phyir (2 sems dpa' chen po zhes bya ba yin/ chos kyi dam pa mngon par rtogs zhunyapas dam pa'i sems dpa' zhes bya ba yin/ mchog gi chos mngon par 'tshang rgya bas (rtemachog gi sems dpa' zhes bya ba yin/ ye shes kyi khyad par rab dang ldan pas rab kyi sems dpa' zhes bya ba yin/ phul du brtson 'grus rtsom zhunyepas phul gyis stesems dpa' 37—466

zhes bya ba yin/ gong na med pa'i chos yang dag par ston pas bla na med pa'i sems dpa' zhes bya ba yin/ stobs bcu'i ye shes yangs pa dang ldan pas stobs kyi sems dpa' zhes bya ba yin/ 'gro ba thams cad nas༄1ridape med pas mi mnyam mi 'dra ba'i sems dpa' zhes bya ba yin/ nam 'dod pa'i du sems kyi skad cig la byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i sems dpa' zhes bya ba yin/ kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi skyes bu dam pa'i ming 'thob gepa rnams so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lam ste/ bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar gcig pu grogs med par byang chub kyi sems mi gtong bas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lam gcig la rten 0pa dang / thabs dang shes rab kyis mngon par bsgrub pas/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lam yan lag gnyis pa dang / stong pa nyid kyi sbyor ba dang / mtshan ma med pa'i mtha'i rtse mor phyin pa dang / smon pa med pa'i phyir khams gsum dang mi 'dre bas (3byang chub sems dpa'i lam rnamal)pa gsum pa dang / nyes pa bshags 3)pa'i tshul dang / bsod nams thams cad la rjes su yi dbyerang ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa la gsol ba gdab pa'i rim gro rgyun mi gcod pa dang / yongs su bsngo ba la mkhas pas shin tu bsngo ba'i phyir byang chub sems dpa'i lam spyod pa bzhis smos tu )pa dang dad pa'i rtsa ba tshugs 11te/ shin tu brtan pa dang /brtson 'grus chen po las phyir mi ldog pa dang / dran pa nyi rtse gcig pa nyi dang ting nge 'dzin gyi tshul ma 'khrugs 8pa dang / rab tu rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi spyod yul la mkhas pas/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams 8kyi lam skyedabang po 37—467

lngas0)rnam par spel ba dang / 'di lta7ste lha'i mig gis 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi gzugs kyi rnam pa thams cad dngas/ sems can gyi shi 'phoshedang ske/ skye ba thams cad yongs su mthong ba'i rang bzhin dang ldan pa dang /lha'i rna bas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos bstan pa mnyan cing dran par bya ba dang / yongs su gzung bar bya bas sems can pha rol gyi dbang po la yang dag par phyin par byed pa dang bdag gi sems chags pa med pas/ pha rol gyi sems shes pas mthong ba la dbang bsgyur ⑤ba mngon par bsgrub pa dang /sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pas bskal pa 'grangs dupa thams cad rjes su dran zhing dge ba'i rtsa ba rnam par 'phel bar byed pa dang / rdzu 'phrul dang rnam par 'phrul pa chen po bsgrubasalgepas sems can ji ltar 'dul ba bzhin du chosa'aphrul sna tshogs yongs su ston cing / sems can thams cad la chos brjoda'akhyapa dang /zag pa zad pa'i ye shes dang ldan pas yang dag pa'i mtha' mngon sum du mthong zhing byang chub sems dpa'i 8spyod pa bsgrub pa rgyun mi gcod pas/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lam mngon par shes pa drug gis rnam par 'phrul ba dang /'di lta ste/ sems can gyi gtso bo mtha' yas pa thams cad skra'i rtse mo gcig la bzhugs par mthong ste1)/ yang dag par yongs su gzung7zhing sems can gyi〈gebasam pas rnam par rig par ⑩bya ba la 'jug pas sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa dang ske/ de bzhin gshegs pa gcig gi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor nas ma g.yos par de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'khor gyisnyidakyil 'khor du mngon du zhal nas chos bstan pa bsgrags pa nyartemi zad pas 'gro ba thams cad kyi bsam pa dang /dbang po ji lta ba bzhin du rnam par rig par〈nyebya ba la 'jug pas chos rjes su 37wa 468

dran pa dang / phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs mthong ba dang mi 'bral zhing 'gro ba thams cad la byang chub sems dpa'i7lus yongs su ston pas dge 'dun rjes su dran pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi sbyin pa yongs su gtong ba ②la yang dag par gzhol zhing gtong ①ba chen pos rnam par spel ba7yid la byed pas gtongasnyeb rjes su dran pa dang / byang chub kyi sems dang mi 'bral bas ⑥dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad 'gro ba thams cad la stobs ⑦pas/ tshul khrims rjes su dran pa dang / dga' ldan gyi pho brang gi mchog na byang chub sems dpa' tshe gcig gis thogs pa bzhugasalgepa rjes su dran pas lha rjes su dran pa dang / thabs kyi ye shes chen pos 'gro ba thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba dang / gdul ba rgyun mi 'chad pa la zhugs te/ sems can rjes su dran pa'i phyir dge 'dun rjes su dran pas byang chub sems dpa'i lam rjes su dran pa bdun gyis〈nyamangon par bsgrubs 12pa dang / 'di lta ste log par lta ba thams cad yongs su spangs pas yang dag pa'i lta ba'i lam du 'byung tsho/rteb dang ske/ rtog pa dang / rnam par rtog pa dang / yongs su rtogs 7pa dang bral bas thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang mthun7zhing don yod la hu 3yid la bya ba med pas7byung ba dang / ngag gi nyes hu7pa bzhi dang bral bas 'phags pa dang mthun 0zhing yang dag pa'i ngag rab tu brjod pa dang / lus kyi las thams cad sems can nye bar 'tsho bas 'gro ba thams cad thogs pa med par yongs su smin par byed cing 'dul bas mngon par bsgrubs 3)pa dang / 'phags pa'i rigs la rab tu gnas shing sbyangs pa'i yon tan gyis du nyesdom pa byang chub kyi lam dang ldan pa'i spyod lam dang / spyod pa dang tshul la rab tu gnas shing thams 37—469

cad du kha na ma tho ba med pas yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi brtul zhugs dang / dka' thub kyis kun nas gdungs pa dang ske/ yongs su gdungs pa yang dag par ston cing / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu'i rang bzhin thogs pa med pa dang ldan pa'i phyir yang dag pa'i rtsol ba dang / sgra thams cad 'dzin cing dran pa 'jig rten gyishernam par 'khrug pa thams cad kyis bar du mi chod pa'i phyir yang dag pa'i dran pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ting nge 'dzin gcig gis ting nge 'dzin thams cad mngon par bsgrub pa la mkhas pa'i phyir yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pas byang chub sems dpa' du rnams kyi lam ni 'phags pa'i lam gyi ri4)yan lag brgyad tshodang ldan zhing byang chub dang mthun ye par gyur pa dang / 'di lta ste 'dod pa dang gnod sems dang / 'tsho ba med pa dang ngag gi las thams cad kyis ma bsgribs par 9)chos ston pa'i tshul dang ldan pas rnam par rtog pa dang / rnam par dpyod pa gsal slob dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i she)bsam pa 3 riyongs su mi gtong zhing dga' ba zing zing 31po dang bral ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mthong bas dga' ba'i yid bde ba yang rgyun mi 'chad cing 'jig rten pa'i bde ba dang / sdug bsngal dang bral bas 'phags pa 'jig rten las 'das pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i lam dang mthun hurtepa dang /mi g.yo 12ba'i gzugs med pa'i snyoms par zhugs 8pas mngon par bsgrubasalgepa dang ske/ 'dod pa'i khams dang gzugs kyi khams su skyes pa las ma g.yos par 'du shes pa tshadang / tshor ba thams cad 'gog pa'i snyoms par 'jug pas 37—470

mngon par bsgrubs7shing / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bsgrub pa rgyun mi gcod pas/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lam mthar gyis spyod cing snyoms par 'jug pa dgus mngon par bsgrubs lapa dang / 'di lta ste gnas dang ci gnas ma yin pa la mkhas pa'i ye shes dang / ldan pa dang / 'gro ba thams cad kyi 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i las dang /rgyu dang rnam par smin pa yongs su len pa shin tu rtogs ④pa dang / dbang po ji lta ba bzhin du chos ston cing go bar byed pas sems can gyi khams thams cad kyi dbang po rab dang tha ma shes pa'i ye shes kyis shin tu brtags 95pa dang khams tha dad pa dang7khams du ma la mkhas pa dang ldan pa dang / rab dang tha ma dang /'bring la mos pa rab tu rtogs pa'i chos kyi tshul la zhugs pa dang / 'gro ba thams cad dang zhing dang dus dang / bskalas7)pa thams cad byang chub sems dpa'i lus dang / gzugs kyis rgyas par dgang zhing de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshul yongs su bstan pas/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bsgrub pa yongs su mi gtong ba dang / bsam gtan dang rnam par thar pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang ske/ snyoms par 'jug pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa dang / rnam par byang ba thams cad lasam3)rnam par ldang ba dus la bab pa dang 7/ dus la ma bobab pa rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi tshul gyis mngon par bsgrubs 31pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa la rab tu gnas pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi02skye ba dang / shi 'pho ba dang lam gyi hu)rgyud dang / 'pho ba tha dad pa'i gnas la mkhas pa dang ldan pa dang / dus gsum gyi bskal pa 'grangs pa mthams cad skad cig gcig tu gzung ba rtogs nyugepa'i ye shes snang bas mngon par bsgrubs lnga 37—471

pa dang / 'gro ba thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa dang bag chags dang bsam pa dang ske/ bag la nyal ba hu)byang bar ②thob pa'i ye shes kyi tshul gyis mngon par bsgrubasalgepa'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bsgrub pa mi gtong bas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lam nispobade bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu rab tu rtogs pa la yang dag par btang ba'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lam ste/ de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi lam ⑥la mkhas pa labla na med pa 'thob ④bar 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lam ni tshad med pa'o/ /lam gyi7tshogs ni tshad med pa'o/ /lam bsgom pa ni tshad med pa'o/ /lam gyi rgyan ni tshad med pa'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras de la ⑩bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lam tshad med pa57ste/ bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar nam mkha'i dbyings tshad med pa dang / mtha' dang dbus med〈rtepa'i chos kyi dbyings tshad med pa dang ske/ mi zad pa'i sems can gyi khams tshad med pa dang / mu med pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams tshad med pa dang / mi zad pa'i bskal pa 'grangs〈nyepa tshad med pa dang / 'gro ba thams cad kyi tha snyad mtha' yas shing tshad med pa dang ske/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku tshad med pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung migi dbyangs tshad med pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs tshad med pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes tshad med pa ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lam tshad med pa rnams so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de ci'i phyir zhe na/ nam mkha'i dbyings ci tsam du tshad med 37—472

pa de tsam du tshad med pa'i ①byang chub sems dpas lam gyi ④tshogs yongs su bsdu bar bya'o/ /ji ltar chos kyi dbyings mtha' dang dbus med pa de ltar mtha' dang dbus ①med par byang chub sems dpas lam gyi getshogs yongs su bsdu bar bya'o/ /ji ltar sems can gyis/khams mi zad pa de ltar mi zad par byang chub sems dpas lam gyi〈)tshogs yongs su bsdu bar bya'o/ /ji ltar 'jig rten gyi khams mu med pa de ltar mu med par byang chub sems dpas lam gyi rtso)tshogs yongs su bsdu bar bya'o/ /ji ltar bskal pa grangs su bgrang7zhing bstan pa mi zad pa de ltar 'gro ba thams cad mi zad par byang chub sems dpas lam gyi 0tshogs yongs su bsdu bar bya'o/ /ji ltar 'gro ba thams cad kyi tha snyad mtha' yas pa de ltar 'gro ba thams cad kyi sgra dang tha snyad la 'jug pa'i ye shes kyis (nyamangon par bsgrubs pa mtha' yas par byang chub sems dpas lam gyim/rnyetshogs yongs su bsdu bar bya'o/ /ji ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku tshad med pa de ltar 'gro ba dang zhing dang dus dang / sems can dang bskal pa thams cad du rgyas par 'gengs zhing tshad hunyemed par byang chub sems dpas lam gyi78tshogs yongs su bsdu bar bya'o/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas kyi gsung gi dbyangs tshad med pa de ltar byang chub sems dpasam tshig gi lasalgegacig brjod pas chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad du rgyas par khyab cing sems can gyi khams thams cad go bar byed pa'i lam gyi (nyetshogs yongs su bsdu bar bya'o/ /ji ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs tshad med pa de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs kyis bstan tsho/snyepa'i byang chub sems dpas lam gyi〈nyetshogs yongs su bsdu bar bya'o/ /ji ltar thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes tshad med pa de ltar tshad med par byas te( )/37—473

byang chub sems dpas lam gyi hu)tshogs yongs su bsdu bar bya'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lam gyisatshogs te / de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes mtha' dang dbus med pa 'thobalgepar 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ④ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi melam bsgom ⑦pa ste/bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar lus dang ngag dang sems kyis mi longs pa med pas ⑧blang ba med pa dang / dor ba med pa bsgom7pa dang / yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du 'jug pa'i ye shes dang ldan pas bsnan huX pa med pa dang / dbri ba med par bsgom 11pa dang / rang bzhin gyis 'jug pa med pas bsgomatshwanyepa med pa dang / rnam par bsgom hu pa med pa bsgom 8pa dang / mngon par zhen pa thams cad dang bral bas sgyu ma dang rmi lam dang mig yor nyusnyedang / sgra brnyanatsodang gzugs brnyan nyu dang smig rgyu kyisnyedang chu'i zla ba lta bur bsgom tunyepa dang /khams gsum rna pa'i bsod nams blta bas bstsags pa bstsalamachaba'i phyir stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa dang / mngon par 'du bya ba med pa bsgom na pa dang / chos su gdags pa rnamam par dgod pa dang bral bas brjod du med pa dang / bstan du med pa dang smos su med pa dang /bshad du med pa bsgom sa0pa dang / chos thams cad la zhugs pa'i ye shes mngon sum dang ldan pas/ chos kyi dbyings tha mi dad pa bsgom (nyepa dang /de kho na nyid dang / de bzhin nyid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa khong du chud pas de bzhin nyid dang / yang dag pa'i mtha' ma nyams par bsgoms nyepa dang /mngon par 'du byed pa'i stobs rgyun mi 'chad pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa'i 37—474

ye shes yangs pa bsgom ①pa dang / chos thams cad mngon sum du gyur mite/the tsomashemed pas de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobasamarigebacu dang / mi bsnyengs 7pa bzhi dang so so yang dag par rig 3)pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang ⑦mtshungs pa med pa bsgom chos)pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lam bsgom 49)pa ste/ de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes bsgom hu )pa la mkhas pa bla na med pa 'thobasngo1par 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lam gyi 32rgyan te 1nyebacu gang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras / 'di〈stel byang chub sems dpa' hu'u'adod pa'i khams nas kyang mi g.yo la/gzugs dang gzugs med pa la spyod pa'i bsam gtan dang / rnam par thar pa dang ting nge 'dzin dang snyoms par 'jug pa la snyoms par 'jug 8kyang / de dag gi dbang gisasngo 7mi skye ba 'di ni lam gyi rgyan dang po'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' nyan thos kyi lam mngon sum du gyur pa'i 38ye shes la zhugs kyang lam des /6'byung ba'ang ma yin pa 'di ni lam gyi 2 rgyan gnyis pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' rang sangs rgyas kyi lam la mngon sum du gyur pa'i ye shes snang ba la tsho stomakhas kyang snying rje chen po'i stobs rgyun mi gcod pa 'di ni lam gyi rgyan gsum pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' g.yog 'khor mang po dang ldan zhing 22/g.yog 'khor lha dang mi'i ( gernam par dag pa dang ldan zhing / lha'i bu mo brgya stong gis rol mo brdung ba dang dkrol (ra ba'i sgra phyung ste brjod pa la spyod kyang byang chub sems dpa'i lam dang ldan pa'i bsam gtan dang / rnam par thar pa 37—475

dang ske/ ting nge 'dzin dang snyoms par 'jug pa mi 'dor ba 'di ni lam gyinyergyan bzhi pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' 'gro ba thams cad kyi rtse rgal dka' ②dgod pa dang / sems can dang 'dres shing 'bur ldog pa byed kyang sems kyi skad cig gcig la yang byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin mnyam pa nyid mi 'dor ba 'di ni lam gyisargyan lnga pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten gyi chos thams cad dngasnyem 'dres shing 'jig rten gyi4)pha rol du phyin pa yin yang / sems can bsgral ba'i phyir pha rol tu mi 'gro ba'i lam yang mi gtong ba 'di ni lam gyi rgyan drug pa'o / /kye rgyal ba'i sras gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin gyi ye shes snang ba la zhugs pa'i lam la gnas kyang lam ngan par zhugs pa'i sems can phyir bzlog57pa'i phyir lam ma yin pa dang / lam ngan pa yang gnon la/ lam des 'khor ba 'dzin pa'ang ma yin te/ desasnyedag par yang mi sems pa 'di ni lam gyi7rgyan bdun pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu tshul khrims legs par bsrungs pa dang ldan zhing de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshul khrims rnam 1— )par dag pa la rten pas/ lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las kyi mtha' kha na ma tho ba med pa dang ldan yang tshul khrims ngan pa dang ldan pa'i sems can yongs su smin parama3nyabya ba'i phyir so so'i skye bo tha malarwa pa'i spyod pa thams cad ston cing / byang chub sems dpa'i〈nyelam la rten skopas / bsod nams kyi tshogs rnam par dag pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa yin yang sems can dmyal ba dang / byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i ma'ajig rten dang / mi khom pa dang dbul bar skyes pa'i lam du zhugs 37—476

pa'i sems can thams cad rnam par bzlog pa'i phyir/ de dag gi lam du skyes pa yang ston la/ lam de dag la yang dag par gzhol ba yang ma yin pa 'di ni lam gyiturgyan brgyad pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad la gzhan gyi ②dring mi 'jog cing thogs pa med pa'i spobs pa thob pashesangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad la ye shes snang bas rnam par lta ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs ④pa/sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi sku dang / lus gcig tu gyur pa sems can thams cad kyi chos kyi snying po'i ④tsal can dgongs 6)pa'i snang ba khong du chud pa/theg pa thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid la rab tu gnas pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi spyod yul la mngon par mos pa 'gro ba thams cad kyi yid du 'ong ba/ sems can gyi ④khams thams cad kyis52)ngor lta phyi)ba/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi slob dpon du bya ba yin yang / chos yongs su btsal bar bya ba rgyun mi gcod cing ngo mtshar gyis yongs su zin par snang bas sri zhu'i las thams cad la gnas te/ mkhan po dang tu) slob dpon du ston kyang de nyid 'gro ba thams cad kyi 31slob dpon du 'gyur ba 8yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni thabs mkhas pa dang ldan par byang chub sems dpa'i lam la shin tu gnas pa yin pas/ de dag ni thabs gang dang gang gis sems can rnams 'dul bar 'gyur ba de dang de thabs hu sems can rnams la yongs su ston te/ 'di ni lam gyi7rgyan dgu pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad yongs su 'dus shing byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dang rdzu 'phrul thams cad thob pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dbang 37—477

bskur bas mngon par dbang bskur ①ba/ chos thams cad la dbang ba'i dbang phyug gi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mchog thob pa/ chags pa med cing dri ma med pa'i thabs dang ldan pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du thogs pa med paradzagede bzhin gshegs pa'i sku yang dag par ston pa/ chos kyi 'khor lo thogs pa med par bskor ba'i gebyin gyi rlabs sridang ldan pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du khyab pa'i lus dang gzugs bdog pa'an/ chos thams cad kyi dbang phyug gi pha rol tu phyin pa dam pa dang ldan pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i dbang thams cad rab tu thob pa/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi zhing du skye ba yongs su ston pa la mkhas pa 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang yul gcig tu gyur pa'ang yin la/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'ang rgyun mi gcod cing / byang chub sems dpa'i sne)chos nyid kyang rnam par mi spong / byang chub sems dpa'i las 3)las kyang rnam parasami ldog /byang chub sems dpa'i lam las kyang phyir mi ldog /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'ang 9rgyun mi gcod/ byang chub sems dpa'i nye bar len pa'ang 'chad par mi byed/ byang chub sems dpa'i thabs mkhas pa las kyang phyir mi ldog /byang chub sems dpa'i bya ba yang thogs par 1— )mi byed/ byang chub sems dpa'i mngon par 'du byed pa'i stobs kyis kyang yongs su skyo 31ba med cing byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i byin gyi rlabs /2las kyang ring du 'phang ba ma r+sha yin te/kye rgyal ba'i sras de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ltar byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rgyun mi gcod /gepa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sgo la rnam par lta ba de lta bus snyeni byang chub sems dpa' bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 37—478

tu myur du 'byung ba'i phyir te/ 'di ni lam gyi rgyan0)bcu pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyilo lam gyi rgyan te/ de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i lam rin po che'i rgyan bla na med pa thob par gyur kyang / byang chub sems dpa'i lam gyi rgyun mi gcod pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rkang pa ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di ltar smon lam chen po'isko khyad par yongs su bsdu ba shin tu rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir tshul khrims kyi rkang pa dang ske/ byang chub kyi yan lag thams cad yang dag par bsdu ba las phyir mi ldog pa'i phyir5gebartson 'grus kyi rkang pa dang / sems can rnams bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du yongs su tshim par bya ba'i phyir mngon par shes pa'i rkang pa dang /sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du 'gro yang zhing gcig nas mi g.yo ba'i phyir rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dang / khyad par du 'gro ba'i phyir lhag pa'i bsam pa'i rkangamathu/pa dang / brtsamasamardzi)pa thams cad mthar phyin par bya ba'i phyir dam bcas pa brtan pa'i rkang pa dang / bla ma thams cad kyi bsgom tshob las 'gal bar mi byed pa'i phyir mthun⑧par 'dzin pa'i rkang pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsungs pa nyu)yang dag par gzung 1 bas mi skyo ba'i phyir chos mnyan pa mi ngoms par tshol ba'i rkang pa dang / tshangs pa'i gnas nas 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad du 'gro bar 31nyid lug pa med pa'i phyir chos kyi char 'bebs pa'i rkang pa dang / thams cad du kha na ma tho ba med pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa chen po la nan tan du byed pa'i rkang pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de hunyedag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rkang pa ste/ de dag la gnas 37—479

shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhabs kyi mchog gis/'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du 'gro ba bla na med pa 'thob par 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lag pa ste/ bcu7)gang zhe na 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsungs pa la gcig tu mos shing yid ches pas mthar phyin par bya ba'i phyir dad pa'i lag pa dang / slong ba thams cad yid bzhin du tshim par bya ba'i phyir gtongalteb rab tu gtong ba'i lag pa dang / lag pa g.yas pa brkyangasaba'i phyir tshur shog bde bar 'ongs sam zhes 'dor ④te/ gsong por ⑤smra ba'i lag pa dang /bsod nams bsags pa rnam ⑥par spel ba las ⑦mi g.yo ba'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mchod cing rim gro byed pa'i lag pa dang / semasasnyecan thams cad kyi the tsom gcad7pa'i phyir thos pa thams cad la mkhas pa'i lag pa dang ske/ 'dod pa'i 'dam du thogs pa'i sems can gyi khams la lag pa ring du brkyang ste/ 'ju bar rnyebasngortepa'i phyir khams gsum dang bral7zhing shin tu 'byung bar byed pa'i lag pa dang / chu bo chen po bzhis khyer ba las7lag pa ring du brkyang zhing gdon husteba'i phyir bde ba'i thang la gzhog pa'isnyilag pa dang /'gro ba thams cad la gnod pa med par bstan pa'i chos rab tu bstan pa'i phyir yang dag par 16sbyor ba'i chos la slob dpon gyis mi 'chab tunyepa'i lag pa dang /lus dang sems kyi nad rab tu bsal ba'i phyir 'jig rten pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtsug lag thams cad shes pa'i lag pa dang / nyon mongs pa'i mun pa thams cad dang bral ba'i chos kyi snang ba mtshungs pa med pa5)yongs su bstan pa'i phyir shes rab dang ye shes rin po che'i lag pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i 37—480

sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lag pa ste/ de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i phyag 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kun nas yog par skyob pa bla na med pa 'thob par 'gyur ba dag go// // sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo)/ bam po nyi shu pani / kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'disnyedag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lto ste/ bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar bsam pa dag pas g.yo bas)med pa'i lto dang drang bas sgyusamed pa'i lto dang / thibs po med pas 'chos pasari'u)med pa'i lto dang / dngos po thams cad la mngon par chags pa med pasasheyul la mi 'dzin pa'i lto dang / shes pa'i phyir nyon mongs pa thams cad sel ba'i lto dang ske/ skyon med pa'i phyir sems dag pa'i lto dang / chos ji lta bshebazhin du yid la bya ba'i ①phyir kha zas thams cad yongs su shes par bya ba so sor rtogasngortepa'i lto dang / rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba rjes su rtogs par bya ba'i phyir mngon par 'du mi byed pa so sor rtog nyu1pa'i lto dang / bsam pa shin tu smin pas 'byung ba thams cad shes pa'i lto dang / sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi sku'i nang du chud parwa khong du chud pa'i phyir dri ma mtha' yas pa'i lta ba thams cad dang bral ba'i sto'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lto ste/ de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku/ 'gro ba thams cad yongs su 'dzin pa lha bla na med pa 'thob par 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi snying po ste/ bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs 37—481

pa thams cad kyi tshul gyi mthu 3)tshad med pa yongs su bskyed pa'i phyirab byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi snying po/ sangs rgyas kyi rigs rgyun mi gcod par kun nas gnas pa dang / ye shesam snang ba chen po yongs su bstan pa'i phyir7byang chub sems dpa'i snying po chos kyi rigs rab tu gsal bar byed parashekun nas gnas pa dang / phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo6)yang dag par gzhol bar bya ba'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi snying po dge 'dun gyi rigs yongs su sdud par kun nas gnas pa dang / dus ji lta ba bzhin las()mi 'da' bar bya ba'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi snying po chos thams cad nges par gleng b.rashebyed pa dang / rgyu gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa'i rgyun mi 'chad77par bya ba'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi snying po nges pa hu7med par yongs su smin par byed par gnas pa dang / ma 'ongs pa'i rgyu skyon med par bya ba'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi snying po sems can log par nges pa rnams lasngonasnying rje chen po skye bar kun nas gnas pa dang bdud kyi sde thams cad btul te/dge ba'i rtsa ba mi 'phrogs par bya ba'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi snying po de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu thub pa med pa'i rgyu yongs su rdzogs par byed par kun nas gnas pa dang / 'gro ba ma lus pa thams cad yongs su tshim par bya ba'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi snying po mi 'jigs pa chen po'i seng ge dang / khyu mchog gi nga ro 'byin par kun nas gnas pa dang / thams cad du ye 12shes yang dag par gzhol bar bya ba'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi snying po sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa ba'osnyibargyad 'thob pa'i0)phyir kun nas gnas pa dang / skad cig gcig tu mi mnyam par77med par zhugs 37—482

pasatunye / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi snying po zhing thams cad dang / chos thams cad dang sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam pa nyid du khong du 2chud par gnas pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi7snying po ste/ de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad ma log pas de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes chen po'i snying pos /bla na med pa 'thob par 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di rigadag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi snying57ste/ bcu gang zhe na brtsams 7pa thams cad mthar phyin par bya ba'i phyir zhe non pa'i snying na dang / mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po'i bsod nams kyi tshogs yongs su bsdu ba'i phyir sems zhum pa med pa'i snying dang / bdud kyi sde thams cad rab tu gzhom pa'i phyir rnam par gnon pa chen po'i snying dang / nyon mongs pa thams cad kyis mi tshugs51)pa'i phyir tshul bzhin du sbyor ba'i hu) snying dang / snying po byang chub kyi bar du phyin par bya ba'i phyir phyir mi 'gyur zhing / phyir mi ldog pa'i snying dang / sems 'pho ba med par khong du chud pas mngon par chags pa med pa'i phyir rang bzhin gyi 3lha'od gsal ba'i snying dang / ji ltar mos pa'i tshul bzhin 12du rnam par thar pa 'thob pa (nyebya ba'i phyir/ sems can gyi tshul shes pa'i snying dang / theg pa gzhan la mos pa 3stemed par sems can gyi khams yongs su bskyab 35pa'i phyir/tshangs pa'i rnam par spyod pa rgya chen pos tsosangs rgyas kyi chos la 'jug pa'i snying dang ske/ lta ba'i mtshan〈 7mas khams gsum 18la mngon par chags pa med par bya ba'i phyir (6stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa dang /mngon par 'du bya ba med pa'i snying dang / sems can thams cad bdud du 37—483

gyur pa'i sgos bdud thams cad 'ongs par gyur7kyang / spu gcig kyang mi g.yo bas dpal gyi〈be'us brgyan cing rdo rje'i khams ltar sra zhing brtan⑧pa'i snying po dam pa dang ldan pa'i snying ngos/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi snying ste/ de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes snang ba chen po'i ④snying po dang ldan pa'i snying bla na med pa 'thob5zhe par 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi go ca ste/ bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar 'gro ba thams cad yongs su bskyab pa'i phyir byams pa chen po'i go ca dudang /mi dga' ba thams cad bzod par bya ba'i phyir snying rje chen po'i go ca dang /brtsams 6)pa dzams cad mthar phyin par bya ba'i phyir smon lam gyi go ca (medang /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rgyan /nya'abyung bar bya ba'i phyir yongs su bsngo ba'i go ca〈nyedang ske/ 'gro ba thams cad nye bar 'tsho bar bya5)ba'i phyir bsod nams kyi go cachadang ske/ 'gro ba thams cad bsgral ba'i phyir pha rol tu phyin pa'i go ca (nyedang /'gro ba thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa'i mun pa rab tu zhi bar bya ba'i phyir ye shes kyi go ca skyedang / sgo kun dang tu 1ldan pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba mngon par bsgrub pa'i phyir thabs hu)mkhas pa'i go ca hunyedang / theg pa gzhan la mos pa med pa'i phyir thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sems brtan zhing 'khrug pa med pa'i go ca ()dang /chos kyi rlom sems med pas gcig tu nges pa'i go ca'o(skye/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi go ca 3)ste/ de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams bdud kyi nyesde thams cad spa 'gong steb bla na med pa 'thobamanyepar 'gyur ba lhadag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni 37—484

byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mtshon ca7ste/ bcushegang zhe na/ 'di ltar ser sna'i skyon rab tu gzhom pa'i phyir gtong ba'ishe mtshon cacadang / tshul khrims ngan pa thams cad bsal ba'i phyir tshul khrims gyi mtshon casadang / rnam par rtog pa thams cad bstsal7ba'i phyir chos mnyam pa nyid kyi mtshon cashedang /'gro ba thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa yongs su gcad7pa'i phyir shes rab dang ye shes kyi mtshon ca7dang / 'tsho ba thams cad la kha na ma tho ba med par bya ba'i phyir / yang dag par〈pe 'tsho ba'i mtshon ca (medang / sgo thams cad yongs su bstan pa'i phyir thabs mkhas pa'i mtshon ca5nyedang / nyon mongs pa'i sgo nas sems can bzlog pa'i phyir/ 'dod chags dang / zhe snang dang / gti mug dang / mdor bsducan nyon mongs pa thams cad kyi mtshon cacadang / spyod pa rgyun mi 'chad pas sems can gyi khams yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir 'khor ba'i mtshon cacadang / mngon par zhen pa thams cad rab tu bstsalasnyiba'i phyir/chos tshul gcig pa bstan pa'i mtshon ca dang / spyod pa'i sgo las phyir phyogs su mi bltasnyiba'i phyir thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi mtshon ca'o37/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po desridag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mtshon ca5teste/ mtshon ca7de dag gis5nyebyang chub sems dpa' rnams sems can thams cad kyi sems dang bsam pa la yun ring po'i nye bar nyon mongs pa dang / bag la nyal ba yod pa thams cad rab tu 'joms pa dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mgo ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di ltar spyi gtsug ltar5nyemi snang ba'i phyir mya ngan las 'das pa'i mgo dang / lha ()dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad 'dud par bya ba'i phyir bla ma la 'dud pa'i 37—485

mgo dang / stong gsum thams cad kyi bdag por 'gyur bar bya ba'i phyir mos pa yangs pa'i mgo dang / khams gsum gyis mchod par bya ba'i phyir dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad sngon du 'gro ba'i mgo dang / gtsug tor dang ldan pa'i spyi bo 'thob par bya ba'i phyir/ sems can thams cad kyi khur khyer ba'i mgo dang /thams cad du khyad par du 'gro bar bya ba'i phyir gzhan gyi ltung ba la brnyas pa med pa'i mgo dang / spyi bo la gnas pa'i chos thob par bya ba'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mgo dang / sems can thams cad kyi mgo mnyam pa spyiyongs su bstan pa'i phyir ye shes dang thabs su ldan pa'i mgo dang / 'gro ba thams cad slob par bya ba'i phyir sems can thams cad yongs su smin par byed pa'i mgo dang / dkon mchog gsum gyisagadung rgyun mi gcadasnyepa'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi9)chos kyi tshul yongs su sdud pa'i⑧mgo'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mgo ste/ de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes chen po 46)spyi bor gyur pa 3bla na med pa 'thob par 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di 8)dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mig ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di ltar gzugs thams cad blta ⑨ba'i phyir sha'i tu )mig dang /sems can thams cad blta tistoba'i phyir lha'i mig dang / sems can thams cadam kyi dbang po dang yul blta ba'i nyu phyir shes rab kyi mig dang / chos thams cad yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du blta geba'i phyir chos kyi mig dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu blta boba'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi mig dang / chos yongs su shes pa blta tsheba'i phyir ye shes kyi mig dang / sangs rgyas kyi mthu'i 'od nyurte37—486

snang ba blta7ba'i phyir/ snang ba'i mig dang / mya ngan las 'da' bar7bya ba'i phyir mngon par bsgrub pa'i mig dang / bsgribasalgepa med par bya ba'i phyir chags pa med pa'i mig dang / chos kyi dbyingasasnyosgo thams cad nas blta'akhyaba'i phyir thams cad mkhyen pa'i mig go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mig ste/ mig de dag dang ldan pas ⑥byang chub sems dpa' rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes chen po'i spyan bla na med pa 'thob par 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag〈peni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rna ba ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di ltar bsngags pa thos nas medaga' ba spong ⑨ba dang / mi snyan pa thos na 6) khong khro ba spong ba dang /nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi gtam thos na 'dod pa med cing mi smod (7pa dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa'atshwa 'byung ba'i gtam thos na dga' ba dang mos pa dang spro ba chen po skye ba5nyedang / sems can dmyal ba dang / /byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten dang / yi dgas tsodang / lha ma yin dang ske/ mi khom pa dang / dbul por skyes pa thos na snying rje chen po'i go gyon pa dang / lha dang mi'i rgyud kyi bye brag thos na8/ rtag tu chos la gzung ba'i blor 'gyur ba dang / sangs rgyas kyis yon tan dang / bsngagasarwanyepa thos na de'i yon tan dang / bsngags pa yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i brtson 'grus dang ske/ pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsdu ba'i dngos po dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod kyi gtam thos na thams cad kyi pha rol tu 'gro ba dngaponye/ kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa'i rna ba'i (pedabang po la ni phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams nas bsgrags pa'i sgra thams cad kyang rdu )grag cing thos par 'gyuramanya37—487

te / sgra thams cad sgra brnyan 1)lta bur brjod du med pa'i don du khong du chud cing geshes pa dang / kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa'asnyichos kyi rna bkyimanyam par gzhag 46pa dang / ldan te thog ma sems bskyed pashenas/ snying po byang chub kyi bar du byang chub sems dpa'i lam dang〈mi gnas kyang sems can yongs su smin par bya ba mi 'dor ba'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rna ba ste/ de dag la gnas shing ⑨byang chub sems dpa' rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes chen po'i snyan bla na med pa 'thob 7par 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sna ste /1/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di ltar 'thun〈gepa'i dri la mi mthun par gnas pa dang / mi mthun pa'i dri la 'thun tu)par gnas pa dang /sru/ dri 'thun 1depa dang / mi 'thun7pa la mnyam pa nyid du gnas pa dang ske/ dri 'thun 1 pa dang / mi 'thunatshwanyepa ma yin pa la btang snyoms su gnas pa dang / gos dang / mal ca 17dang / yan lag dang / nying lag gi dri la 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug dang / cha mnyam pa5༷ spyod pa'i sems can gyi tsho 1shes par gnas pa dang / gter chen po de dag dang / rtswa dang ske/ gel ba dang / sman dang / nags tshal ji snyed pa de dag gi dris gter thams cad mngon sum du shes par gnas pa dang / 'og gi sems can dmyal ba chen po mnar med pa yan cad du gesrid pa'i rtse mo man cad na (rteganas pa'i sems can rnams kyis cidri tshor ba tsam gyis sngon gyi (2spyod pa ston par gnas pa dang / nyan thos kyi tshul khrims dang / thos pa dang / gtong ba dang —/ shes rab kyi dri tshor bas thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sems mi 'khrugasam tsho37wa 488

par gnas pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyod pa'i dri tshor zhing de bzhin gshegs pa'i sa la yang dag par gzhol ba'i ye shes la gnas pa dang ske/ 6)de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yul dang ye shes kyi dri tshor zhing byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rgyun mi gcod par zhuganas pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sna yongs su dag pa ste/de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams sride bzhin gshegs pa'i shangs mtha' dang dbus 3)med pa bla na med pa 'thob par 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag (5)ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lce ste/bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar sems kyi yispyod pa mi zad pa rab tu ston pa'i lce dang /chos kyi tshul mi zad pa rab tu ston pa'i lce dang / sangs rgyas kyi yon tan dang bsngagasalgepa mi zad pa rab tu ston pa'i lce dang / nges pa'i tshig dang spobs pa mi zad pa ston pa'i lce dang / theg pa chen po'i tshogs mi zad pa ston pa'i lce dngapo)/ de'i lce de phyogs bcu'i nam mkha' rgyas par 'gengs pa dang / de'i lce de sems can thams cad la yang dag par gzhol ba dang / de'i lce de sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du 'od kyis snang bar byed pa dang / de'i lce de sangs rgyas thams cad tsamanyes par byed cing phyag 'tshal ba dang / de'i lce de bdud dang ske/ rgol ba dang / nyon mongs pa dang / 'khor ba thams cad 'jig cing mya ngan las 'da' ba'i7lam ston pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lce ste/ de dag la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i ljags sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad rgyas par khyab pa bla na med pa 'thobs/1par 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu 37—489
