drung du byang chub sems dpa' de la blta ba dang phyag bya ba dang / bsnyen bkur0)ba'i phyir phyogs bcu tshon nas dga' ldan gyi gnas rab na 'khod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams 'ongs te / byang chub sems dpa' de dag gi sems dang bsam pa yongs su tshim par bya ba dang / smon pa yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir chos yang dag par bgro 4)ba'i sgo chen po yang dag par ston te/ so so'i sapo)la gnas pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis gang56)bya ba dang / gang spang ba dang gang bsgom pa dang gang mngon du bya ba de dag kyang yang dag par ston to//yang dag par bgro 7ba'i chos de dag thos nas kyang rab tu dga' zhing mgu ba dang ske/ rangs pas legs par rjod cing 2)/ rang rang gi zhing dang (nye rang rang gi gnas su 'dong bar nyu ci'agyur ba 'di ni dga' ldan na gnas pa'i las lnga pa'o / /kye rgyal ba'i sras dga' ldan gyi gnas rab na gnas pa'i gan du nam bdud sdig can 'dod pa'i khams kyi dbang po 'khor mang pos yongs su bskor ba zhig 11glags btsal ba'i phyir 'ongs par gyur na'ang de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' bdud thams cad tshar gcod pa zhes bya ba'i rdo rje'i tshig la gnas shing shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / thabs mkhas pas yang dag par gzung ba'i 12ye shes kyi sgos mnyam zhing mnyanas3napa'i mtha' gnyis bzung nas ci nas kyang bdud sdig can gyis 6glags rnyed par mi 'gyur ba de lta de ltar byin gyis rlob 'bo/ /de lta de ltar chos kyang ston te bdud kyi 'khor chen po des byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par 'phrul pa de lta bu mthong nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed par 'gyur ba 'di ni dga' ldan na gnas pa'i las drug pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' dga' ldan gyi 37—538

gnas rab na gnas pa ni gang gi ti tshe 'di ltar 'dod pa'i khams kyi lha'i bu 'di rnams chos mnyan pa dang / yang dag par bgro ri bas skyo bar gyur to/ /zhes bya bar shes par gyur pa de'i tshe/ 'dod pa'i khams kyi gnas thams cad du sgra sgrog cing dbyangs 'byin te/ grogs po dag de ring byang chub sems dpa' btsun mo'i 'khor chen po ston pa mdzad kyis blta 5ribar su 'dod pa de dag myur du shig shigashogeces nas/ der 3)lha'i bu rine bye ba khrag khrig brgyas stong kun nas 'du bar 'gyur te/ de dag dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kun nas 'dus par gyur nas kyang / lha'i bu de dag gis sngon cad nam mthong ma thos pa'i btsun mo'i 'khor de lta bu bstan nas/ de dag 9nam dga' bas mos par gyur pa de'i tsotshe/ de dag gis rol mo brdung ba dang / dkrol ba de dag las kye grogs po rnams 'du byed thams cad ni mi rtag 11go/ /'du byed thams cad ni sdug bsngal ba'ohurte/ /chos thams cad ni bdag med pa'o1na/ /mya ngan las 'das pa ni zhi ba'o/ /zhes sgra 'byung ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pas 8ni thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro 15zhes bya ba'i sgra 'byung77ba thos par 'gyur te/ de dag gis chos kyi sgra de thos pa dang /skyo ba skye bar 'gyur hurtete/ byang chub kyi sems la yang dag par gzhol bar 'gyur ba 'di ni dga' ldan na gnas pa'i las bdun pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' dga' ldan gyi gnas rab na 'dug pa ni dga' ldan gyi gnas nas kyang lus mi snang bar ma gyur la/ phyogs bcur yang de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la blta ba dang / phyag bya ba dang / bsnyen bkur bya 18ba dang ske/ chos mnyan pa'i phyir 'gro ste/ de la sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de 37—539

dag gis byang chub sems dpa'i sa mngon par dbang bskur ba thob pa'i mchog tu phyin pas thams cad mngon par shes pa zhes bya ba yang yang0)dag par bstan par 'gyur ba dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes yan lag dang nye ba'i yan lag thams cad dang rildan zhing / rnam pa'i mchog thams cad dang ldan pa la 'jug pa sems kyi 5skad cig gcig gis sbyor ba yang dag par bstan par 'gyur ba 'di ni dga' ldan na gnas pa'i las brgyad pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' dga' ldan gyi gnas rab na gnas pa'i mthus khyad par 'dod pa zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs gepa'i mchod pa dang / rim gro rnam pa tshad med pas rnam par dag pa mtha' yas pa'i rnam pa yongs su ston pa/ chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams 'byam klas 455pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod pa'i las kyi don 6)du 'byung ste/ mchod pa ༷de mthong nas sems can grangs med tshad med pa'i⑧rnams bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed de/ 'di ni dga' ldan na gnas pa'i las dgu pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' dga' ldan gyi gnas rab na 9gnas pa mtha' dang dbus med pa'i chos sgyu ma la zhugs pa ni nyu rimig yor lta bus shin tu bsgrubs 17pa'i ye shes kyis 8'jig rten gyi khams 'byam //klas pa thams cad du gzugs sna tshogs dang / kha dog sna tshogs dang dbyibs sna tshogs dang / spyod lam sna tshogs dang bya ba sna tshogs dang ske/ sbyor ba sna tshogs dang / bstan pa mngon par bsgrub pa sna tshogs dang / dgongs pa rnam 1 ripa sna tshogs kyis sems can rnams 8mos pa ji lta ba bzhin du sems dang bsam pa mgu bar bya ba'i phyir chos ston cing gzugs yongs su ston 37—540

te / 'di ni dga' ldan na gnas pa'i las bcu pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de ①dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dga' ldan na gnas pa'i las te/de dag byas nas byang chub sems dpa' rnams phyis mi'i rin/'jig rten du 'ong bar 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dga' ldan gyi gnas nas shi 'pho (ston pa ste/ bcu gang zhe na/kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di la byang chub sems dpa' rnams lha'i ris dga' ldan nas shi 'pho ba'i tshe/ rkang pa'i mthil gyi 4)'og nas bde ba'i rgyan ces bya ba'i 'od zer 'byungasreste/ de byung nas kyang stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams snang ba chen pos rgyas par bkang zhing ngan song dang mi khom pa'i rgyud du skyes pa'i sems can rnams kyil)lus la 'bab )bo/ /de ltar 'od des 48)lus la bab ma thag tu de nyid kyi tshe/ sems can de dag bde ba thams cad kyis tshim zhing sdug bsngal gyi 6)tshor ba rtse zil 3 )bar 'gyur ro/ /bde ba'i nyams ni (/ nyanyams su tshor ma thag tu de dag gis 'di ltar grogs po dag sems can gzhan zhig ni 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir skyes so zhes bya bar shes te/ 'di ni dga' ldan gyi gnas nas shi 'pho ston pa dang po'o/ /kye 12rgyal ba'i sras gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' de'i smin mtshams kyi mdzod 3 spu nas yang dag par bskul sab zhes bya ba'i 'od zer 'byung ste/ de byung nas kyang stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams rgyas par bkang zhing sngon bolhan cig tu spyod 7spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lus la 'bab nyi bo/ /'od zer des de ltar lus la bab ma thag tu/ de nyid kyi tshe byang chub sems dpa' de dag gis byang chub sems dpa' dga' ldan gyi gnas nas shi 'pho bar 12khong du chud de 16de 37—541

dag thams cad 'dus nas byang chub sems dpa' la mchod pa'i las mngon par bsgrub 1pa 'di ni dga' ldan gyi naganas nas shi 'pho ston pa gnyis pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa'i chalag pa g.yas pa'i mthil ④nas yongs su dag pa'i yul zhes bya ba'i 'od zer 'byung ste/ de byung nas kyang stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams yongs su sbyong zhing de na zag pa med pa'i rang sangs rgyas 'khod pa de dag 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan du sel to//zim yin na yang gang gis 6shes par gyur pa de dag tshe'i 'du byed 'dor ro/ /gzhan yang 'dul ba'i dbang du de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyis byin du 3ribarlabs pa'i sems can ma gtogs par bdud dang mu stegs can gzhanamustidang phas kyi rgol ba dang kun tu rgyu ba dang / dmigs pa la mngon par zhen pa'i sems can rnams 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan du sel te/ 'di ni dga' ldan gyilo/gnas nas shi 'pho ston pa gsum pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' de'i pus mo gnyis kyi 1 lha nga gnyis nas dri ma med cing bzang la 'od gsal ba'i rgyan ces bya ba'i 'od zer 'byung ste/ de byung nas kyang lha'i gnas tha ma nye bar bzung 11ba yan cad 12'og min gyi nyi lha'i gnas man chad du snang bar byed de/ des lha'i bu de dag gis kyang byang chub sems dpa' dga' ldan gyi gnas kyi 1 gnas nas shi 'pho bar 15shes nas/ de dag kun kyang skyo ba skyo tshaba'i yid kyis me tog dang / phreng 1 ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dang /phye ma dang / na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan thogs te/ rol mo brdung ba dang / dkrol ba'i sgra rab tu byung 32nas byang chub sems dpa'i drung du mchod pa'i las kyi phyir 'dong ste/ shi 'pho /9nye bar bzung ba nas 37—542

yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po bstan gyi bar du bsnyen bkur byed do/ /phyi bzhin 'brang ngo / /'di ni dga' ldan gyi gnas nas shi 'pho ba 1 ston pa bzhi pa'o / /kye rgyal ba'i sras gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' de dpal gyi be'u'i rgyan dang ldan pa/ rdo rje'i khams ltar sra zhing brtan pa'i snying po can gyi snying ka nanas gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba'i 'od zer gtong ste/ de btang nas kyang lag na rdo rje'i 'jig rten thams cad yongs su snang bar byed do//de nas lag na rdo rje khrag khrig phrag brgya 'ongs te / shi 'pho ston pa nye bar bzung ba nas/ yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa 4chen po bstan gyi bar du byang chub sems dpa'i phyi bzhin 'brang ste/ 'di ni dga' ldan gyi 5gnas nas shi 'pho ston pa lnga pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' de'i ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas 'gro ba thams cad du rnam par phye ba zhes bya ba'i 'od zer 'byung ste/ de byung nas kyang stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 6'jig rten gyi khams thams cad snang bar byas nas byang chub sems dpa'i lus la 'bab 7bo / /byang chub sems dpa'i lus la bab nas lha dang mi'i gnas su 'char ro/ /des byang chub sems dpa' de dag kyang bdag cag gis 'dir gnas te/sems can yongs su smin par bya ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa la na mchod par phyibya bar 'gyur ro/ /snyam du khong du chud pa 'di ni dga' ldan gyi gnas nas shi 'pho ston pa drug pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' de'i khang pa nor bu rin po che chen po'i snying po can nas1 / rnam par bstsags71pa shin tu gnas pa zhes bya ba'i 12'od zer 'byung ste/ de byung nas kyang khyim gang du byang chub sems dpa' skye bar 'gyur ba'i khyim der 'char ro/ /37—543

'od zer de0/de ltar shar ma thag tu de nyid kyi tshe/ byang chub sems dpa' de dag khyim mam pagrong khyer ram grong rdal lam/ 'dzam bu'i gling du sems can 'dul ba nye bar bzung zhing skye ba rab tu 'dzin te/ 'di ni dga' ldan gyi niganas nas shi 'pho ston pa bdun pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' de'i khang pa brtsegs pa lha thams cad kyi gnas kyi rgyan ces bya ba ④las gnas thams cad rnam par dag pa'i rgyan ces bya ba'i 'od zer 'byung ste/de dag byung ma thag tu yum gang gi dgu gegayas par skye bar 'gyur ba de'i lus la 'bab po/ /de ltar bab ma thag tu de nyid kyi tshe byang chub sems dpa'i56)yum bde ba thams cad 'thob gepar 'gyur te/ yon tan dang sdom pa thams cad la'ang gnas par 'gyur ro/ /yum gyi sku der yang pho brang brtsegs pa chen po rin po che'i rinadam pas brgyan pa byang chub sems dpa'i7longs spyod kyi don du 'byung ste/ 'di ni dga' ldan gyi gnas nas shi 'pho ston pa brgyad pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa'i 'irkang pa'i mthil gyi 'og nas gnas pa zhes bya ba'i 'od zer 'byung ste/ de byung ma thag tu lha'i bu'am/tshangs pa nyu1gang la la byang chub sems dpa'i mchod pa'i las kyi don du shi 'pho bar 'dod par gyur 12la byang chub sems dpasatshwa kyang lha'i bu de dgacan 'khod pa gebazhin du de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa'i las/ mngon par sgrub par nus par shes 9pa de dag gi 1 lus la 'bab 3)po/ /de ltar 'od zer des bab par gyur ma thag tu de nyid kyi tshe lha'i bu de dag shi 'pho'i las de las rnam par ldang ste/ de dag de 17na 'khod bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' la5) shi 'pho nye bar bzung ba nas yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa〈 tebastan gyi bar du mchod pa'i 37—544

las byed de①/ 'di ni dga' ldan gyi gnas nas shi 'pho ston pa dgu pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa'i dpe52byad bzang po rnams las nyi ma sna tshogs kyi tshul zhes bya ba'i 'od zer 'byung ste/ de byung nas kyang byang chub sems dpa'i lasam sna tshogs ston to/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de la lha dang mi la las ni byang chub sems dpa' dga' ldan gyi gnas rab nyid na 'dug pa na mthong ngo / /la las ni yum gyi skur bzhud pas3mthong ngo / /la las ni skye bar mthong ngo / /la las ni 'byung bar mthong ngo / /la las ni rnam par 'tshang rgyagle'ubar mthong ngo / /la las ni chos gyi 'khor lo bskor bar mthong ngo la las ni de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan las 'da' bar mthong ste/ 'di ni dga' ldan gyi gnas nas shi 'pho ston pa bcu pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de ltar byang chub sems dpa'i 'od zer bcu po de dag las sogs pa kyi/ 'od zer grangs med pa brgya stong phrag bcu byang chub sems dpa'i lus las 'byung ste/ de bzhin du stan dang ske/ gzhal med khang dang / khang pa brtsegs pa dag nas kyang 'byung ste/de dag byung nas kyang byang chub sems dpa'i las she sna tshogs yongs su ston to/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de ltar lasamatsheyongs su grub pa'i byang chub sems dpa' 7rnams chos thams cad rab tu grub pa'i phyir 11lha'i gnas dga' ldan nas shi 'pho ston to / /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mngal na gnas par ston pa ste/ bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar sems rgya chung ba dang /dma' ba la mos pa tu rnams yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir byang chub sems dpa'i dngos po'i bsod nams kyi rtsa ba la nye yid mi ches par gyur du 'ong zhes byang chub sems dpa' mngal na gnas par ston pa 'di ni mngal na gnas par co37—545

ston pa dang po'o/ /pha dang 1ma dang gnyen bshes kyi tshogs dang / sngon lhan cig tu spyod spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang / sems can gang gi dge ba'i rtsa ba mngal na gnas pas yongs su smin par bya ba de dag gi don du byang chub sems dpa' mngal na gnas par ston te 'di ni mngal na gnas par ston pa gnyis pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' ( ni rmongs pa med cing dran la shes bzhin du ma'i ltor 'gro ste/ ma'i lto na 'dug pa'i tshe'ang dran pa nyams 3pa med do / /'di ni mngal na gnas par ston pa gsum pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' ni ma'i mngal na 'dug kyang 'di lta ste phyogs dang / 'jig rten gyi khams nas 'dus pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dang brgya byin dang tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten gyi mgon po rnams dang lhan cigatso'agrogs shing chos bsgrag pa dang / yang dag pa'i gtam bya ba rgyun mi gcod cing byang chub sems dpa'i stobs tshad med pa yang yongs su ston te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras de dag mngal na snyoganas kyang de lta bu'i smon lam gyi rmo khyad par bdog pas byang chub sems dpa' de dag ni ye shes mu med pa dang ldan pa ste/ 'di ni mngal na gnas par ston pa bzhi pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' ma'i namangal na gnas pa'i tshe/ de ni 9'khor gyi dkyil nyu ci'akhor kun nas gnas par 'gyur ba yod de/ byang chub sems dpa' de dag gi sngon gyi smon lam gyis 11de dag yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' mngal na gnas par ston te/ 'di 12ni mngal na gnas par ston pa lnga pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' ni 1 mi'i 'jig rten du byung nas kyang mir skyes pa rnam pa'i 1 mchog thams cad dang ldan pa ston te/ 'di ni mngal 37—546

na gnas par ston pa drug pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' ni ma'i lus namanya)'dug(2)bzhin du 'di lta ste dper na me long gi dkyil 'khor yongs su dag pa labazhin gyilo④nodakyil 'khor lta bur stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams su snang ste/ de la mos pa chen po dang ldan pa'i lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang lha ma yin dang nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang lto 'phye tsochen po dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa de dag gis shes par gyur nas de dag nye bar 'ongs shing mchod pa dang / rim gro byed de 'di ni mngal na gnas par ston pa bdun pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' mngal na gnas pas 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan na 'khod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' snyosrid pa tha ma ⑦par gyur pa rnams dang tshogs te/ chos kyi brda'i sgo chen po ye shes chen po'i snying po zhes bya ba 8)yang dag par 'gro 9bar bya ba yod dos/ /de dag dang 'du ba'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' mngal na gnas par ston te/'di ni mngal na gnas pa 11ston pa brgyad pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' ni dri ma med pa'i snying po can zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms 12par zhugs shing ma'i mngal du 'gro ste/ ting nge 'dzin de'i mthus ma la yang gnod par mi 'gyur bar dga' ldan gyi gnas rab 1 bas kyang lhag pa'i rgyan ma'i khong du mikun nas gnas par 'gyur tes/ 'di ni mngal na gnas par laston pa dgu pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' ma'i mngal na 'dug pa'i mthus 'jig rten gyi khams 'byam 1 klas pa thams cad du de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod pa'i las kyi phyir bsod nams chen po'i me tog kun nas rgyas pa zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod pa'i rim gro 'byung ste/ sangs 37—547

rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag kyang de la byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par spyod pa chos kyi dbyings kyi mosnying po mtha' dang dbus med pa yang dag par ston te/shes par bya ba de shes pas byang chub sems dpa' rnams mishin tu phra ba'i 'gro ba bcu ston to / /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ④ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi shin tu phra ba'i rgyud ston pa ste(57/ bcu gang zhe na kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di la byang chub sems dpa' ma'i mngal na yang gnas la thog ma50sems bskyed pa nye bar bzung ba nas dbang bskur ba'i bar du yang yongs su ston pa dang /ma'i mngal na yang gnas la dga' ldan na gnas pa yang yongs su ston pa dang /ma'i mngal na'ang gnas la skye ba yang yongs su ston pa dang / ma'i mngal na'ang gnas la gzhon nu'i sa yang yongs su ston pa dang / ma'i mngal na'ang gnas la btsun mo'i 'khor gyi nang du ma'adug par yang yongs su ston pa dang /ma'i mngal na'ang gnas la mngon par 'byung ba yang yongs su ston pa dang /ma'i mngal na'ang gnas la nadaka' ba spyod pa'i57sbyor ba dang / snying po byang chub tu 'gro ba nas rnam par 'tshang rgya 1 )ba'i bar du yang yongs su ston pa dang /ma'i mngal na yang gnas la chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba yang yongs su ston pa dang ske/ ma'i mngal na'ang 11gnas la yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba yangam yongs su ston pa dang / ma'i mngal na'angs/lhaganas la shin tu phra las rgya che bar 'jug pa'i tshul gyis 15mngal gyi gnas de nyid du byang chub sems dpa'i4spyod pa thams cad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa'i byin gyilo tshorlabs kyi rnam pa dang / sgo yang yongs su ston pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi shin tu phra ba'i rgyud ston pa ste/ de dag 37—548

la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa' rnams ye shes chen po shin tu phra ba bla na med pa 'thob par 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi tsher skye ba ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras de la byang chub sems dpa' dran zhing shes bzhin du skye ba dang / 'od zer gyi 1dra ba〈snang ba chen pos stong gsum gyi bstong chen po'i nga'ajig rten gyi khams rgyas par bkang ste/ lus snang ba dang ldan par skye ba dang phyir mi ldog cing srid pa'i 5tha ma par gyur par skye ba dang ma skyes shing 'byung ba med par skye ba dang khams gsum pa sgyu ma'i rnam pa lta bur khong du chud de skye ba dang / phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams su lus yongs su ston cing skye ba dang / lus de nyid kyis thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes khong du chud par bya bar skye ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa ma lus pa thams cad kyi 'od zer bkye bsam)yang dag par bskul ba'i lus su 8skye ba dang / ye shes chen pos rnam par 'byed pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms 9par 'jug pa'i lus su skye ba dang / kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' skyes nas kyang sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyang rab tu g.yo bar 1 'gyur/sems can thams cad kyang rab tu 'grol bar 'gyur/ ngan song thams cad kyang rab tu zhi bar 'gyur/ bdud thams cad kyang rab tu spa 'gong bar 'gyur/byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa yang 'ong bar 'gyur ba'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi tsher skye 11ba ste/ de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams hu sems can 'dul ba'i don du yongs su ston pa dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gad mo cher dgod pa ste/ bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar kye ma'o/ /'jig 37—549

rten gnas pa 4)'di ni 'dod pa'i 'dam du bying ba ste/ 'di la nged ma gtogs par gzhan 'byin par byed pa su'ang med do snyamaphunas/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams gdashemo cher dgod pa dang / kye ma'o 'jig rten gnas pa 'di ni nyon mongs pas mdongs ④par byas pa'o/ /bdag ni shes rab dang ye shes kyis shin tu brgyan pa'o/ /zhes nas byang chub sems dpa' rnams gad7mo cher dgod pa dang / lus kyi gzhi 'di nyid kyis de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi sku bla na med pa chen po dus gsumadzagergyas par 'gengs pa 'thob par 'gyur ro zhes byang chub sems dpa' rnams gad (shemo cher dgod pa dang / kye rgyal ba'i sras gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' rnams byang chub sems dpa'i mig bsgribs 99)pa med pas phyogs bcur tshangs pa'i lha'i tshiganas nye bar bzung ba nas dbang phyug chen po'i gnas kyi bar du rnam par lta zhing 'di snyam du sems te/sems can 'di dag ni lus su 'phel ba'o(1/ /bdag ni ye shes kyi stobs dang ldan pa'o zhes bya bar mthong nas/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams gdam7mo cher dgod pa dang / sngon dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa'i sems can rnams da dung phyir mi sna ldog par mthong nas byang chub sems dpa' rnams gad〈nyemo cher dgod pa dang sa bon chung ngu las 'bras bu cher 'gyur ba 8mthong nas/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams gdam mo cher dgod pa dang / yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis 1 tshobastan pa don yod par mthong nas/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams gad hu mo cher dgod pa dang / sngon theg pa la lhan cig tu zhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams chags pa'i gnas gzhan dang gzhan la chags pas sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi che ba nyid ma thob pa mthong nas byang chub sems dpa' rnams 37—550

gad7mo cher dgod pa dang / largyal ba'i sras gzhan yang sngon 'grogs par gyur pa'i lha dang mi rnams chung ngu na byis pa'i sa las kyang ma 'das shing yongs su skyo ba'i dbang po dang ldan par 'gyur bsngosamathong nas byang chub sems dpa' rnams gad mo cher dgod pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa ma lus pa thams cad kyi 'od zer dbugs phyin pa chen po rnam par 'phel bar byed pas reg par gyur nas byang chub sems dpa'algenams gad mo cher dgod pa'o⑤/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gad7mo cher dgod pa ste / de dag gisal byang chub sems dpa' rnams 9)sems can 'dul ba'i dbang gi phyir dgod par 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa'i gom pas rnam par gnon pa ste/ bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa'i mthu yongs su bstan pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' rnams gom pas rnam par gnon pa dang / nor bdun yongs su gtong bar bstan pa'i phyir gom pas57rnam par gnon pa dang / sa'i lha'i bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir tsho/rtegom pas rnam par gnon pa dang / khams gsum las 'das pa'i rnam par gnon pa dang / 'gros yongs su bstan pa'i phyir gom kyi pas rnam par gnon pa dang / glang po'i 'gros dang / khyu mchog gi 'gros dang ske/ seng ge'i 'gros dang / 'gros thams cad las 'das shing byang chub sems dpa'i 'gros khyad par du 'phags pa yongs su bstan pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ge'agros kyis rnam par gnon pa dang / kye rgyal ba'i sras sa chen po yang rdo rje'i dbyings kyis kun nas bzung bar 'gyur te/ sa'i phyogs gzhan gyis tsobyang chub sems dpa'i lus bzung 7bar mi nus pa bstan 37—551

pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' rnams gom pas rnam par gnon pa dang /sems can gzhan spro bar bya ba'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' rnams gom pas rnam par gnon pa dang / byang chub kyi yan lag rin po che bdun gyi nan tan yongs su bstan pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' rnams gom pas rnam par ①gnon pa dang / chos nyid rab tu thob pas gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog pa yongs su bstan pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' rnams gom pas rnam par gnon pa dang /bdag ni 'jig rten na gtso bo yin/ bdag ni 'jig rten na phul du phyin pa yin non/ /zhes tshig brjod pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams gom pas rnam par gnon pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni ①byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi cagom pas rnam par gnon pa ste/ de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams sems can 'dul ba'i don du ston pa dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di 5dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi7gzhon nu'i sa kun tu ston pa'i las te/ bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar yi ge dang grangs dang brdashedang rtsis kyi sbyor ba thams cad las rab tu 'das pa'i bya ba kun tu58)ston pa'i las dang / rta dang glang po dang / shing rta rgyug pa rtso)thams cad skya'aphong kun las 'phags pa kun tu ston pa'i las dang / cho lo dang brda (1thabs dang /gar dang / rgyan po nyu dang rtsed mo dang / 'jig rten gyi dga' ba la phal las 'phags pa'i bya ba kun tu ston pa'i las dang / lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las kha na ma tho ba med pa kun tu ston pa'i las dang / mya ngan las 'das pa'i7sgo'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par 'jug pas/ 'jig rten gyi 8khams tshad med pa 8rgyas par dgang ba 1 kun tu ston pa'i las dang / mi thams cad dang / lha 37—552

thams cad dang / klu dang gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang /nam mkha' lding dang / mi'am ci dang lto 'phye chen po dang / brgya byin dang /tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten gyi mgon po thams cad las shin du 'das par byang chub sems dpa'i 1)mthu kun tu ston pa'i las dang / brgya byin dang /tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten gyis mgon po'im gzugs dang kha dog dang gzi brjid las shin tu 'das par byang chub semasam dpa'i gzugs dang / kha dog dang ske/ gzi brjid kun tu ston pa'i las dang / 'dod pa dang / dga' ba dang / rtse bas myos gepa'i sems can rnams la chos kyi dga' bas nerab tu dga' ba yang dag par bskyed pa kun tu ston pa'i las dang / chos kyi rim gro bskyed pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa dang rim gro lde bya bas 'dod pa'i khams thams cad rgyas par 'gengs pa kun tu ston pa'i las dang / chos la dga' ba'i snang bas she de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs 1— tshoyang dag par blang ba kun tu ston pa'i las so/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gzhon nu'i sa kun tu ston pa'i las te de dag yongs su bstan nas de'i 'og tu byang chub sems dpa' 11rnams btsun mo'i 'khor gyi nyananang du 'dong b.rapha/na'agyur ba'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi btsun mo'i 'khor nye bar ston pa ste/ bcu gang zhe na / 'di ltar sngon lhan cig tu spyod spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su smin par bya ba'i don tu byang chub sems dpa' rnams btsun mo'i 'khor nye bar ston pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i dge ba'i brtsa ba brjod pa'i phyir btsun mo'i 'khor nye bar ston pa dang / longs spyod dang 37—553

skyid pa la chags pa'i lha dang mi rnams la longs spyod dang skyid pa'i che ba nyid yongs su bstan pa'i phyir btsun mo'i 'khor nye bar ston pa dang / rtog 3)pa lnga'i zhing du sems can rnams kyi bsam pa'i grusarjes su 'brang ba'i phyir btsun mo'i 'khor nye bar ston pa dang / btsun mo'i 'khor gyi nang na ting nge 'dzin la gnas shing byang chub sems dpa'i mthu dang che ba nyid yongs su bstan pa'i phyir btsun mo'i 'khor nye bar ston pa dang / sngon gyi smon lam dang ldan pa'i sems can rnams kyi bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir btsun mo'i 'khor nye bar ston pa dang / pha dang ma dang gnyen pa'i tshogs kyi bsam pa yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir btsun mo'i 'khor nye bar ston pa dang / chos kyi dbyings chen po dang ldan pa'i rol mo brdung ba dang / dkrol ba'i sgras de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mchod cing bsnyen bkur ba yongs su grub par bya ba'i phyir/ btsun mo'i 'khor nye bar ston pa dang / btsun mo'i 'khor gyi nang nas byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin la gnas shing shin tu phra ba'i mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba nas yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po'i bar du bstan pa'i phyir/ btsun mo'i 'khor nye bar ston pa dang / chos kyi skyabs dang ldan pa yang dag par bstan pa'i phyir/ btsun mo'i 'khor nye bar ston pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi btsun mo'i 'khor nye bar ston pa ste/ de dag ni srid pa tha ma pa'i ri byang chub sems dpas 33yongs su bstan nas de'i 'og tu mngon par 'byung bar 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di ridag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mngon par 'byung ba ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di ltar khyim gyi rigaganas smad pa'i phyir/37—554

byang chub sems dpa' rnams 3)mngon par 'byung ba dang / gnas la dga' ba'i sems can gyen du bskyod tsho pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' rnams mngon par 'byung ba dang / 'phags pa dang mthun 5pa'i lam gyi 4legs pa 5yongs su bstan pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams mngon par 'byung ba dang /rab tu byung ba'i yon tan dang / legs pa yang dag par bsngags pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' rnams mngon par 'byung ba dang / mtha' tsiganyis kyi lta ba dang bral ba yang dag par bstan pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams mngon par 'byung ba dang / 'dod pa'i bde ba dang phrad par brtson zhing bdag gi bde ba lhur len pa'i sems can skyo bar bya ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams mngon par 'byung ba dang / khams gsum pa 7thams cad las 'byung ba'i sngon gyi ltas yang dag par bstan pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams mngon par 'byung ba dang / rang la rag las par spyod cing gzhan gyi dring mi 'jog pa la bstonamachos)pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams mngon 9par 'byung ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang mi bsnyengs pa thobs tshopa dang / mthun 31par yang dag par bstan pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams mngon par 'byung ba dang / kye rgyal ba'i sras chos nyid kyis 12kyang ske/ byang chub sems dpa' srid pa'i 1 tha ma pa ni gdon mi za bar mngon par 'byung ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams sems can 'dul ba'i dbang gi 1 phyir mngon par 'byung ba yongs su ston pa dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi dka' ba spyod pa'i sbyor ba ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di ltar dma' ba la mos 37—555

pa'i sems can gyi nyakhams yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams dka' ba spyod pa ston pa dang / lta ba'i rnam pa la gnas pa'i sems can rnams gyen du bskyod pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams dka' ba spyod pa ston pa dang / las dang bya bas 'khyams ②par gyur pa'i sems can rnams la las kyi rnam par smin pa mngon sum du bstan pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' rnams dka' ba spyod pa ston pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'byam zho — klas par chos nyid rjes su 'brang bar bya ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams dka' ba spyod pa ston pa dang /bdag gi dub pa nye bar zhi zhing mthu dang ldan pa yongs su bstan pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' rnams dka' ba spyod pa ston pa dang / ma yin na chos la chags pa rnams kyi don du byang chub sems dpa' rnams dka' ba spyod pa ston pa dang ske/ 'dod pa'i bde ba dang phrad par brtson zhing rang gi bde ba lhur len pa'i sems can rnams skyo bar bya ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' byarnams dka' ba spyod pa 55ston pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i 7spyod pa brtsams pa'i khyad par yongs su bstan pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams dka' ba spyod pa ston pa dang / skye bo phyi ma rnams brtson 'grus rtsom pa la yang dag par sbyar meba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams dka' ba spyod pa ston pa dang /ma yin na dbang po yongs su ma smin pa'i lha dang / mi rnams yongs su smin par bya ba'i dus bsdad pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams dka' ba spyod pa ston pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams sems can 'dul ba'i dbang gis phyir dka' ba spyod pa'i sbyor ba yongs su ston 37—556

pa dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di 1)dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi snying po byang chub tu 'gro ba ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di ltar 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad lasnang bar bya ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams snying po byang chub tu 'dong ba gudang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad rab tu bskyod pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams snying po byang chub tu 'dong ba ④dang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du bdag gi 5lus rnam par phye ba yongs su bstan pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams snying po byang chub tu 'dong bcadang / sngon lhan cig tu spyod pa 7spyod pa'i grogs kyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams bskul ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams snying po byang chub tu 'dong ba bdang / snying po byang chub kyi rgyan rnam par phye ba yongs su bstan pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' rnams snying po byang chub tu 'dong ba /phyidang ske/ sems can ji ltar mos pa rnams la lus dang spyod lam dang / byang chub 1 )kyi shing gi rgyan rnam par phye ba yongs su bstan pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams snying po byang chub tu 'dong ba 11dang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mngon du blta 32ba'i phyir ske/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams snying po byang chub tu 1lha 'dong ba skadang /gom pa dor ba dang / 'deg dpa thams cad du ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo la snyoms par 'jug cing / skad cig skad cig du rnam par 'tshang rgya ba las mi 'da' ba'i phyir / byang chub sems dpa' rnams snying po byang chub tu 'dong ba 1 dang /lha dang klu dang / gnod sbyin dang dri za dang / lha ma yin dang nam mkha' lding dang ske/ mi'am ci dang lto 'phye nyu chen po dang / brgya byin dang / tshangs pa 37—557

dang ske/ 'jig rten gyi mgon po thams cad kyi mchod pa blang ba'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' rnams snying po byang chub tu 'dong ba 3)dang / chags pa med pa'i ye shes chen pos rnam par phye ba'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa spyad ②pas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad rnam par blta ri ciba'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad yid la byed cing / phyogs thams cad du rnam par phye ba'i mngon par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 4yongs su bstan pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams 5snying po byang chub tu 'dong ba'o / /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' 7rnams kyi snying po byang chub tu 'gro ba sems can 3)'dul ba'i dbang gi phyir yongs su bstan pa dag go// // sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo49tsho/ bam po nyi shu gsum 1 pa/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi snying po byang chub la 'dug pa ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di ltar 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad rab tu bskyod 11cing / byang chub sems dpa' rnams snying po byang chub la 'khod do/ /'jig rten gyi khams thams cad snang bar byed cing / byang chub sems dpa' rnams snying po byang chub la 'khod do/ /ngan song thams cad rab tu zhi bar byed cing byang chub sems dpa' rnams snying po byang chub la 'khod do/ /'jig rten gyi khams thams cad rdo rje'i rang bzhin du byin gyis rlob cing / byang chub sems dpa' rnams snying po byang chub la 'khod do1 / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdan seng ge'i khri la rnam par lta zhing /byang chub sems dpa' rnams snying po byang chub la 'khod do/ /yid nam mkha' dang mnyam pa la rnam par mi rtog cing byang chub sems dpa' rnams snying po byang 37—558

chub la 'khod do/ / ji ltar mthun ti pa'i lus dang spyod lam yongs su ston cing byang chub sems dpa' rnams snying po byang chub la 'khod do/ /rdo rje'i snying po'i ting nge 'dzin rjes su rtogs par byed cing / byang chub sems dpa' rnams snying po byang chub la 'khod do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyi rlabs rnam par dag pa'i gnas yang dag par len cing / byang chub sems dpa' rnams snying po byang chub la 'khod do/ /bdag gi dge ba'i rim ba'i mthus da'agro ba thams cad byin gyis rlob cing / byang chub sems dpa' rnams snying po byang chub la 'khod do/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams bya/snying po byang chub la 'dug pa'og/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams snying po byang chub kyi tsho mchog la 'khod 7nas kyang ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos bcu 'byung ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras de la snying po byang chub mchog la 'khod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis zhal mngon par bstan te/ phyag g.yas pa brkyang ne zhing / kye ded dpon chen po rgyal bar gyur cig /rgyal bar gyur cig ces gsung brjod 3 de 'di ni ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos dang po'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras snying po byang chub mchog la 'khod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad dgongs pa dang / byin gyis rlob lho ripa yang dag par mdzad de 'di ni ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos gnyis pa'o / /kye rgyal ba'i sras snying po byang chub mchog la 'khod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la sngon lhan cig du spyod sbyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams 37—559

'ongs te/ byang chub sems dpa' de dag la kunatunas bskor cing mchod pa'i las rnam par phye ba rnam pa sna tshogs mngon par bsgrubasreste/ 'di ni ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos gsum pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras snying po byang chub mchog la 'khod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rtswasadang gel ba dang / sdong po dang / nags tshal thams cad kyang bsam pa yod gosalta ste/ snying po byang chub gang na0ba der 'dud cing phyag 'tshal te/'dirak+tani ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos bzhi pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'ishespyod pa thams cad las yang dag par 'da' ba'i tshe yang chos kyi dbyings rnam par 'byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin mngon du gyur7te/ ting nge 'dzin de thob 3 rim thag tu byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad las yang dag par 'da' bar 'gyur te/ 'di ni ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos lnga pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras rgya mtsho mchog gi dam pa dri ma med cing kun nas snang la 'od gsal ba'i sa'i snying po (1la 'khod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi sprin chen pos tunyekun nas yog par 'gyur te/'di ni ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos drug pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras snying po byang chub kyitshwa mchog la 'khod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mthus de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa dang / rim gror bya ba shin tu rgya chen po rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod pa'i las kyi phyir 'jig rten gyi 8khams 'byam liklas pa thams cad du 'byung ste/ 'di ni ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos bdun pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras snying po byang chub mchog la 'khod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la 8ye shes mchog gis sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa dang / dbang 37—560

po dang spyod pa mngon du 'gyur te/ 'di ni ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos brgyad pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras snying po byang chub mchog la 'khod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la blo shin tu rnam par dag pa zhes bya ba'i 1)ting nge 'dzin mngon du 'gyur te/ ting nge 'dzin de thob ma thag tu nam mkha'i dbyings tshad med pa dang / dus gsum rgyas par 'gengs pa'i lus kun nas gnas par 'gyur te/ 'di ni ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos dgu pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras snying po byang chub mchog la 'khod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lus kyi ②las dus thams cad la yang dag par gzhol zhing ye shes chen po chags pa med pa rdul dang bral ba'i snang ba dang ldan par 'gyur te/ 'di ni ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos bcu pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de0skadag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos rnams te/ byang chub sems dpa' snying po byang chub mchog la gnas pa rnams la 'byung bar 'gyur ba dag go/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras don rnam pas 5)bcu po 'di dag gi dbang yang dag par mthong nas snying po byang chub mchog la 'dug pa'i byang chub sems dpa' bdud 'dul ba ston te/ bcu ⑥gang zhe na 'di ltar zukun nas nyon mongs pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'byam 3)klas pa na thab (7mo dang / g.yul la mos pa'i sems can rnams la byang chub sems dpa'i stobs kyi che ba nyid yang dag par bstan pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' bdud 'dul ba ston to/ /yid gnyis dang the tsom tho byedu gyur pa'i mi dang lha rnams kyi yid gnyis dang the tsom gcad hu1 pa'i phyir bdud 'dul ba ston to/ /bdud kyi sde yongs su smin par bya ba'i phyir bdud 'dul ba ston to/ /thab nyugemo dang g.yul la mos pa'i lha dang mi rnams 37—561

kun nas bsdu ba dang / kun nas 'dus pa'i lha dang mi rnams 'dul ba'i dbang gis 1phyir bdud 'dul ba ston to/ /byang chub sems dpa'i mthu la thub pa med pa yongs su bstan pa'i phyir bdud 'dul ba ston to/ /sems can gzhan mos shing spro 5bar bya ba'i phyir bdud 'dul ba ston to/ /phyi ma'i skye bo rnams la snying brtse dba'i phyir bdud 'dul 4ba ston to/ /snying po byang chub kyisabar gyi bdud kyi las yongs su bstan pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' bdud kyi lam 6thams cad las 'das pa yongs su bstan pa'i phyir bdud 'dul ba ston to / /nyon mongs pa'i stobs kyis nyams dzomad cing58)stobs med par byas pa yongs su bstan pa dang 9/ dge ba'i rtsa ba brjod pa dang / byams pa'i stobs yang dag par bstan pa'i phyir bdud 'dul ba ston to/ /kun nas nyon mongs pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'byam 1 klas pa dag tu nyamachos nyid rjes su 'brang bar bya 12ba'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' bdud 'dul ba ston tehurte/ kye rgyal ba'i sras/ don bcu po de dag gi dbang mthong bas na / byang chub sems dpa' bdud 'dul ba ston to/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po 'di dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa ste/ bcu gang zhe na/ kye rgyal ba'i sras de la byang chub sems dpa' rnams bdud dang las dang nyon mongs pa thams cad las 'das shing byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa yin/ byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo thams cad la rnam par rtse tshab yin/ byang chub sems dpa'i bsam gtan 'byam 17klas pa thams cad dang ldan pa yin/ chos dkar po'i tshogs thams cad yang dag par bstsags nya tshopa yin/ chos snang ba 37—562

rnam par dpyad par bya ba thams cad shin tu rnam par phye ba yin/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du khyab pa'i lus dang ldan pa yin/ sems can thams cad la snyoms pa'i sems dang dbyangs su ldan pa yin/ byin gyi (rlabs thams cad kyis rab tu chog por byin gyis brlabs napa yin/ 'das pa dang ma byon pa dang da ltar byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung ridang thugs rnam par mi rtog pa thob pa yin/ skad cig gcig gis dus gsum rnam par 'tshang rgya ba yin/ shin tu rnam par sangs rgyas pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 4'dzin kyang rab tu thob pa yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs dang ldan pa yin te / 'di ltar gnas dang gnas ma yin pa'i stobs dang ldan pa yin/ zag pa zad pa shes pa'i bar gyi stobs dang ldan pa yin te/ kye rgyal ba'i sras bcu po de dag ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa ste/ stobs bcu po de dag dang ldan pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ni de bzhin gshegs pa zhes bya ba'i grangs su 'gro'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de ltar mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni chos kyi 'khor lo chen po rnam pa bcur ribaskor te/ rnam pa bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar myi 'jigs pas 6shin tu sbyangs pa'i ye shes dang ldan pa dang / so sor 7yang dag par rig pa bzhi'i 8sgra rjes su bsgrags pa dang / bden pa bzhi'i tshul gyis shin tu brtags 9pa dang ske/ sangs rgyas kyi rnam par thar pa bsgribs 1 pa myed pa'i rjes su song ba dang ske/ sems can thams cad kyi sems dga' bar 'gyur ba dang / thogs pa myed cing blta bar dka' la g.yo 11ba myed cing sdug bsngal gyi gsal shing 'byin 37—563

pa dang / sngon gyi snying rje chen po'i byin gyis brlabs7pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du gragasngo pa dang / bskal pa grangs myed par chos ston pa rgyun mi 'chad pa dang / dbang po dang stobs dang byang chub kyi yan lag dang /bsam gtan dang rnam par thar pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang snyoms par 'jug pa dang / legs par spyadasapas bskor ba'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras sgo rnam pa bcu po de dag la stsogs ④pa rnam pa tshad myed par ⑤de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi 'khor lo skor 45)ro/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos kyi 'khor lo de ni sems can gzhan gyi 0rgyud la chos dkar po'i rnam pa bcus thogs pa myed pa dang /mngon par chags pa duskyed par 'byung bar 'gyur te/ bcu gang zhe na/ 'di ltar smon lam thams cad kyi stobs kyi shugs dang / snying rje chen po'i byin gyi rlabs dngapo)/ sems can gyi khams thams cad mi gtong ba dang / ye shes kyi rnam par 'phrul pa bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du ston pa dang / dus la bab par thob par byed pa dang / rigs pa'i tshul bzhin du myi 'khrul pa dang / dus gsum shes par bya ba rab tu rtogs pa dang / lus kyi dbang zil gyis mi non pa dang ske/ tshig gi dbang dmyigs par dka' ba dang / ye shes kyi dbang tshigs78bzhin du khong du chud par byed pa ste/ kye rgyal ba'i sras chos dkar po'i57rnam pa bcu po de dag gis sna de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos kyi 'khor lo sems can gzhan gyirwanyesems kyi rgyud la thogs pa myed pa dang / mngon pa myed par 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras sangs rgyas kyi phrin las rdzogs par mdzad zin pa'i de bzhin gshegs 37—564

pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ni don bcu'i dbang gzigs nas yongs su mya ngan las 'da'atub chen po ston te/ bcu gang zhe na 'di ltar yang dag pa jilalta ba bzhin du 'du byed myi rtag pa yongs su bstan⑧pa dang ske/ 'dus byas thams cad yid brtan du mi rung bar bstan pa dang / mya ngan las 'da' ba'i phyogs bde bar 'gro bas 'jigs pa dang bag tsha ba thams cad dang bral ba yang dag par bstan pa dang / gzugs kyi lus la zhen pa'i lha dang myi rnams la gzugs kyi lus myi rtag pa nyid du yang dag par bstan pa dang / chos kyi sku la yang dag par sbyar ba dang / rnam par 'gyur ba'i mthus tshogephyir myi zlog ①par yongs su bstan pa dang / 'du byed thams cad 'dod gedagur myi rung zhing dbang bsgyur ④du myed pa yongs su bstan 9)pa dang / sa gsum gyi 'khor ba thams cad sgyu ma'i rnam pa lta bur yongs su bstan pa dang /mya ngan las 'das pa ni snying po dam pa ste/ myi 'jigs pa'i chos nyid du yang dag par bstan pa dang / kun 'byung zhing 'jig pasamatsha'abral bar 'gyur ba / rkeyongs su bstan pa dang / kye rgyal ba'i sras sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi chos nyid kyis kyang de bzhin te/ sangs rgyas kyi phrin las thams cad rdzogs par mdzad de/ dgongs pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs shing chos kyi 'khor lo shin tu bskor te/ 'dul ba thams cad shin tu dul nas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad shin tu lung bstan par 'gyur te/ mnyam pa med pa'i go 'phang yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba chen por yongs su mya ngan las 'da'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras don7bcu po de dag yang dag par gzigs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mnyam pa myed pa'i go 'phang 37—565

yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po yongs su ston to/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras 'di ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spyod pa yongs su sbyong bas3)zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sgo ste/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mang pos gsungs pa'o/ /don tshad myed pa khong du chud par 'gyur ba'o/ /mkhas pa'i skye bo dga' bar byed pa'o / /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyod pa dang / smon lam chen po rgyun myi 'chad par byed pa'o/ /sems can gang gis na 'di thos par gyur ri )te/thos nas kyang mos par byed pa dang / mos par gyur nas kyang nan tan gyis yang dag par bsgrubs 4pa de dag thams cad myur du bla pa na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su mngon par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub ni byang chub sems dpa' nan tan lhur byed pa rnams kyis 'grub kyi 6nan tan dang myi ldan pa rnams kyis ma yin no/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de lta bas na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po nan tan la gnas pas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos kyi sgo'i le'u byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dang yon tan gyi 'byung gnas don rnam par gdon myi za ba'i me tog chos kyi sgo thams cad la yang dag par gzhol ba/ ye shes kyi sgo la 'jug pa 7 'jig rten gyi lam 8thams cad las 9yang dag par 'das pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi lam dang bral 1 ba/ 'gro ba thams cad dang thun mong 11ma yin pa/ chos thams cad kyi sgo snang bar byed pa 'gro ba thams cad kyi 'jig rten dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnam par 'phel bar byed pa 'di rim gror byas te12/ mnyan par bya'o/ / blang bar nyi bya'o/ /yongs su gzung 1 bar bya'o/ /yongs su bzung genas kyang nges par tshartogs pa'i 37—566

sgos hu)yongs su sbyang ba dang / smon lam mngon par bsgrub pa la brtson par bya'o / /kye rgyal ba'i sras de ltar brtson pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub dkon pa ma yin no/ /'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos kyi sgo'i le'u chos thams cad kyi sgor yang dag par gzhol ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bstan pa'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'i chos nyid thob pas phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams tshad myed grangs myed pa rnams rab tu g.yos par gyur to/ /'jig rten gyi khams g.yos par gyur pa de dag thams cad kyang snang ba chen pos rgyas shing gsal bar gyur to / /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyang dgyes par gyur ten/byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po la zhal bstan nas gsung brjod pa/ kye rgyal ba'i srasam legs so legs so/ /ji ltar khyod kyis 4byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams la 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos kyi sgo'i le'u byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dang / yon tan gyi 5'byung gnas don rnam par gdon mi za ba'i me tog chosang kyi sgo thams cad la yang dag par 7gzhol ba ye shes kyi sgo la 'jug pa ldeno'ajig rten gyi lam thams cad las yang dag par 'das pa49 kyil/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi lam dang bral ba 'gro ba thams cad dang thun mong ma yin pa 1 chos thams cad kyi sgo snang bar byed pa/'gro ba /rmethams cad kyi 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 12'das pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnam par 'phel bar byed pa 'di bstan 12pa ni rgyal ba'i bu khyod chos 'di dag la legs par bslabs 'apas shin tu byang ba ste/ rgyal ba'i bu khyod kyis chos kyi byin gyi brlabs dang mthus/ mos pa'i chos kyi rnam grangs 'di legs par 37—567

bshad de nged kyis kyang mngon par bsngags so/ /de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis kyang mngon par bsngags so/ /kye rgyal ba'i bu khyod kyi7chos kyi rnam grangs 'di da ltabadang ma 'ongs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyisasnyem thos pa'i chos thos par bya ba'i phyir nged kyis0byin gyis brlabalgepa mdzad do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang posakyisangs rgyas kyi byin gyis rlabs kyis phyogs bcur bltas te/ 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad la bltas nas/ chos kyi dbyings thams cad la7bltas te/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /gang rnams de dag bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig stong du brtul zhugs dka' spyad pa/ /gang rnams de dag sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig stong las byung ba'i chos kyi sras/ /gang rnams de dag sems can bye ba khrag khrig stong rnams byang chub rab 'god pa/ /dpe zla myed pa deshedage rnams kyi spyod pa 3 ribashad kyis 3tertse gcig mnyan par rgyas/ /gang dag sangs rgyas khrag khrig mtha' yas mchod kyang bdag ni sangs rgyas myi gnas pa8/ /gang dag nyon mongs bcings pa'i 'gro ba thar byed sems can 'du shes mi gnas dang / /gang rnams de dag sangs rgyas yon tan rtag tu tshol yang yon tan myi gnas pa/ /de dag 'jig rten rab tu dga' bar byed pa'i spyodarwanyemachog mdzes pa brjod par byat+nadzā / /gang rnams de dag srid pa gsum nachalas dang nyon mongs bdud kyi dbang song snang / /gang rnams de dag 'phags pa'i yon tan ldan zhing khyu mchog spyod pa ston pa po/ /gang rnams de dag gti mug nyon mongs nyes bral bsam pa zhi zhing rab zhi ba/ /'gro ba rnams la spyod pa'i rim pa ston pa de dag yon tan brjod par bya/ /gang rnams de dag bdud g.yo 'gro ba kun las rgal 37—568

te thams cad dbang byed pa/ /'gro ba thams cad bdag0)la sprul pa sna tshogs tha dad mtha' yas rab tu ston/ /sems bskyed gyur ma thag tu gnas dang 'jig⑧pa'i bya ba thams cad ston byed pa/ /de dag yon tan sna tshogs mdzes pa sems can dga' bar byed pa brjod par bya/ /srid pa'i rgyud na sems can sdug bsngal nyen cing skye dang rga ②bas gzir ba dang / /'chi dang mya ngan dag gis gtses shing gnod byas nyon mongs kun tu gzir mthong nas/ /de dag thar bar bya phyir snying rje rgya cher bskyed nas ye shes mchog dgodashogepa/ /de dag yon tan shin tu dge ba phyogs tsam bshad kyisalo7rtse gcig mnyan par byos/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod pa brtson 'grus dga' bar bsam gtan la yang rnam par rtse na/ /shes rab thabs kyi pha rol phyin cing byams dang snying rje lhag pa'i bsam pa dang / /dga' ba'i chos la brtson zhing btang 7snyoms dga' bas bskal pa brgyar yang spyod spyad pa/ /de dag spyod ldan yon tan ldan pa rnams kyi yon tan bstan gyis7de dag nyon/ /gang rnams de dag byang chub gnyer phyir bye ba khrag khrig stong gi lus skemasam1)pa/ /gang rnams byang chub zhi ba tshol phyiramatshasrog la lta ba myed par gyur pa dang / /gang rnams de dag sems can phan phyir rtag brtson bdag gi bde ba myi tshol ba/ /byams dang snying rje'i sems ldan thub pa de dag kun gyi spyod mchog brjod par bya/ /rgya mtsho'i chu thigs bgrangs pa re res57thams cad zad par bya bar rung srid kyi3rte/ /de dag yon tan bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig du ma stong du brjod byas kyang / /dpe 1nyatsam bya bar mi nus legs par brjod cing bstan par myi nus 'on kyang go/ /sems can phan7pa'i don du sangs rgyas yul rnams bstan par bya ba mnyan par rgyas/ /gang dag 37—569

'gro ba rnams kyi don phyir dge ba 1kun 'dzin dkar po 'phel byed kyang / /mtho bar myi sems dma' bar sems myed myi dman ge chos tshol ngoms par yongs mi 'gyur / /'gro ba kun nas cadon gnyer chu klung ye shes mtsho chen shes rab shing sdong ste/ /ston pa'i mkhas pa de dag rnams ni sa ltar 'gro ba thams cad 'tsho ba yin/ /byams pa rlan yin cir snying rje rtsa ba dga' bas0sdong po brtan pa sdom pa ste/ /ze ba ye shes dri ni tshul khrims bzang po rtsilo ma me tog yon tan can / /sangs rgyas 'od kyis narab tu rgyas byas blo gros ldan pa sems can dgar 9byed pa/ /de dang de dag pad+mo lta bur 'dus byas ma gos 'gro ba rnams la snang / /sa bon mos pa sa gzhi bsam pa byams dang tshesnying rje dag ni 31rtsa ba ste / /sdong po shes rab thabs ni 12yal ga lcug ma dag ni pha rol phyin rab lnga/ /bsam gtan shes rab mngon shes me tog rgyas pa kun mkhyen ye shes 'bras bu ste//chos kyi shing mchog rdzu 'phrul bya 'khod de dang 1 des ni 'jig rten gsum po khebs / / rim gyis 1 dkar yangs yongs su spel ba lus yin bden skapa rnams ni rkang pa ste/ /dran pa mgrin pa spyod mchog shes rab mgo yin ral pa rnam skyapar grol ba dge/ /stong pa don dam sul dang phug yin byams dang snying rje dag ni myig gnyis te1 / /de dag seng ge 18lta bur bdag myed sgra 'byin bdud sde rab tu skrag par byed/ /'gro ba ma lus rnams ni 'khor ba'i 'brog dgon nyon mongs mi zad 19'khyams 'gyur te/ /bdud kyi bya ma rta dang rkun por bcas pas zin gyis 21gti mug mdongs gyur pa/ /lam ni rab ston na myi mkhas sems can mthong nas ded dpon mkhas pa de dag ni/ /lam gyi 2snyemathar khrid 'jigs pa myed pa'i grong khyer dam pa mchog la rab tu 'god thu/ /'gro ba dag ni 'dod 37—570

chags zhe sdang mun0)pa nyon mongs sna tshogs nad btab cing / /yun ring nas ni 'dus byas sdug bsngal dag la gzhol zhing sdug bsngal rab 'bar ba sems can mthong nas snying rje bskyed de nyon mongs pa yi 2nad pa kun gso zhing / /nad rnams zhi bar byed pa stong phrag brgyad cu rirtsa bzhi dam pa dag kyang ston/ /rgyal po lta bu de dang de dag 'khor rnams dga' 4byed 'gro la chos ston par/ /sdig pa spongs dzi/la dge la snyen ri7 cing sangs rgyas yon tan rnams kyang tshol cig ces / /rkang gnyis dbang po'i chos kyi yul la kun mkhyen ye shes dbang por nadabang bskur ba/ /rgya chen byang chub yan lag rin chen 'byung gnas de dag 'gro ba'i 'phags pa'i nor/ /tshul khrims lte 9ba ting 1 'dzin mu khyud brgyan pa'i 37yi shes 'od dang shes rab mtshon/ /ye shes rno ba'i gzhung 12can nyon mongs 'joms nyurtezhing bdud kyi sde rnams dkrug byed pa/ /chos kyi sgron ma che 'byin mchog rnams de dang de dag sangs rgyas bskor ba yi1 / /'khor lo mchog rnams bskor 8zhing pha rol rgol ba dag dang mu stegs thams cad 'joms/ /ye shes chu ni zab cing myi zad shin tu rgya chen chos kyi ro dang ldan/ /byang chub yan lag de bzhin bsam gtan rin chen gang ba 'gro kun shes par dka'10/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i gnas kyi mtha' rlabs mtha' yas yul rnams dag cing lhag bsam dge/ de dang de dag ye shes rgya mtsho mtshungs myed bstan pa 1 zad par myi 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten rab 'phags rtag tu yul gyis myi gos 'gro ba rnams kyi 38gnas gyur pa/ /bsam gtan mngon shes rab 'phel ye shes rtse mo lhag pa'i bsam pa myi sgul ba/ /gang dag de dang 19nyer phrad shes rab ye shes mchog gis rab tu 'dra bar 'gyur/ /de dang de dag yon tan ri rab shes rab 37—571

rab brtan 'gro ba kun gyis bltasaspyi/ /lhag pa'i bsam pa mchog gi〈rdo rje mtshungs shing 'dra ste brtul zhugs thams cad brtan/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun thams cad mkhyen pa'i spyod yasaphubasam pa mi phyed de/ /bdud dang sems can nyon mongs 'jig rten rlungasredag gis ni myi bskyodaphurab brtan pa/ /de dang de dag 'jig rten dam pa nyon mongs 'bar ba dag las bzlog ⑥par byed / /byams pa'i sprin rnams kun 'dus snying rje stug po rig pa'i glog chen rgyu ldog pa58)/ /thub pa rnams ni rdzu 'phrul gnas bzhi dbyangs kyi 'brug sgra 'byin cing rab tu sgrog / so so ⑨yang dag rigacadang tshul khrims yan lag brgyad ldan chu'i char 'bebs pa/ /de dang de dag sprin chen nyon mongs zhi byed sems can don phyir mngon par 'phags/ /shes rab themedaga' dang khrel ba dag ni 'obs hurtete chos kyi rgyal mtshan bsgreng / /ye shes shing thags7yin te thar pa'i sgo phye dran pa de dag sgo ba yin/ /bden pa rnams ni lam chen bzhi ste shin tu dge ba'i rdzu 'phrul rab brgyan pa/ /srid pa gsum na bdud sde dag gis myi thul grong khyer chos nyid dag tu ston/ /thams cad mkhyen gyi tsosems mchog shing la rab 'dug rdzu 'phrul rkang pa'i rkang pa brtan/ /gshog pa thabs kyi stobs te pha rol gnon skyemathu byams dang snying rje myig gnyis yin/ /ston pa de dag 'gro ba hu snakun na 32thub myed mkha' lding dbang po'i drag shul 'dra/ /srid pa'i mtsho nas 'don cing lha myi rnams kyang mya ngan 'da' ba'i mchog la 'god/ /tshul khrims〈rtedakyil 'khor rdzu 'phrul rkang pa'i shugs 3 ldan ye shes 'od zer phreng5 tsheb mdzes/ /'od snang kun 'char nyon mongs 'joms zhing srid pa'i rgya mtsho rab tu skem par byed/ /stobs dang dbang po dge ba'i sman 'phel sems can padadza g+ne37—572

mo yongs su rgyas byed pa①/ /de dang de dag snang byed chos kyi nyi ma'i khyu mchog 'gro ba kun tu 'byung / /chos dbyings rnam par dag pa dkyil 'khor 'gro ba kun gyis blta na mdzes pa ste/ /nyan thos rang rgyal rnams kyi tshogs mang skar ma 'dra ba dag ni zil gyis mnan②/ /sems kyi rgyud rnams mthong nas srid pa gsum du 'phel dang 'grib pa rnam par ston / /de dang de dag ye shes zla ba 'gro la 'char zhing mkhas pa nam mkha'i mtha'/ /chos kyi dbang po 'gro ba kun la dbang byed gzugs dang yon tan dag gis brgyan/ /ye shes rdo rje mnga' ba thabs ni myig ste chos la dbang chen bsgyur geganas pa/ /lus dang mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po sna tshogs kun gyisnyibalta ba'i dbang po ste/ /chos kyipo)'gro ba kun las rgyal ba de dang de dag chos kyi dbang po yin/ /srid pa gsum na 'dod pa'i 'damashedang nyon mongs las lasaphurab 'das kun dbang po/ /byams pa snang dang thugs rje bsam gtan dga' dang btang snyoms rnams la mos/ /srid pa gsum po kun tu tha dad lus ston chos kyi sgras kyang go byedakrepa/ /de dang de dag tshangs pa lta bur rnam dag mos shing lta ba'i rnam pa skyasel/ /'khor las rab tu 'das shing rnam dag yul dang ldan pa bdag po chos kyi dbang / /phyir ldog myi 'gyur blo gros che 'chang gang rnams theg pa dma' dang tha dad la/ /chos kyi dbang por dbang bskur 'jig rten dam pa ye shes phyir ldog myi 'gyur ba/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'itshwanyeyon tan dbang phyug grags chen de dang de dag 'jig rten dbang / /nam mkha'i mkha' dbyings lta bur dngos dang rnam bral dmyigs pa thams cad rnam bstsal7ba/ /'gro ba kun tu bya ba nyams len khyu mchog ci la'ang gnas pa myed pa ste/ /'gro ba kun tu spyod pa dkar zhugs mkhas pa de 37—573

dag rab tu myi gnas pa/ /de dang de dag ye shes dge zhing dag pas shes rab nam mkha'i dbyings dang 'dra/ /de dang de dag shin tu rgya chen thabs ldan sa ltar 1'gro ba kun gyi gsosarin / /chu 'dra de dang de dag byams dang snying rjesalgenyon mongs rnams pa ni rab tu sel/ /de dang de dag ye shes myes nyani nyon mongs sreg cing bag chags bcas pa bstsal6)/ /ston pa de dag myi gnas rlung dang 'dra bar srid pa gsum na rab tu rgyu/ /de dang de dag rin chen 'dra ste shin tu dkon zhing 'gro ba dbul 3yang sel/ /de dang de dag rdo rje lta bur srid pa gsum na lta ba kun tu 'joms48kyi/ /de dang de dag yon tan kun gyi 'phring cu'ib sna tshogs 'jig rten gsum mdzes byed/ /ston pa de dag nor bu rin chen mtshungs 'dra spyod pa kun gyi gtsug tu phyin/ /de dang de dag me tog lta bur yon tan rab rgyas 1 byang chub yan lag rtse/ /phreng ba lta bur de dang de dag smon lam bcings shing 'jig rten mgon 11la gnas/ /de dang de dag tshul khrims ma nyams skyon med rnam 12dag dri ni dri rab zhim/ /de dang de dag mejig rten gsum na chos dang ye shes kyi 3lhani bag chags dganyu /gdugs 'dra de dang de dag stobs kyi bla res nyon mongs rdul las skyob par byed/ /ye shes rgyal mtshan bsgreng 15ba'i thugs mnga' de dang de dag nga rgyal rgyal mtshan snyol/ /de dang de dag spyod pa'i ba dan sna tshogs yid 'ong ye shes kun tu 'phags/ /gos 'dra de dang de dag rdzu 'phrul yon tan 'gro ba kun la khebs par byed/ /theg pa 'dra tshab khyu mchog mtha' yas de dang de dag 'jig rten gsum las 'byin/ /de dang de dag rab dul glang po lta bur yid kyis rtag tu dul la gnas/ /de dang de dag rdzu 'phrul rtas ni khal chen 1 khyer zhing 'jig rten gsum las 'da'/ / klu 37—574

yi dbang7po lta bu de dang de dag sems kyi yul du mchos char 'bebs de dngasade dag 'gro ba kun la me tog u mdum ba ra55)mtshungs 'dra shin tu dkon// dpa' bo ⑥lta bu de dang de dag nyon mongs 'joms zhing bdud kyi sde rnams 'khrugal /myi ldog 'khor lo lta bus8)de dang de dag 'dren pa rnams kyis rab tu btsud / /de dang de dag sgron ma lta bur mun pa sel cing sems canas9rilam yang ston / /de dang de dag chu klung lta bur yon tan ded cing lam rgyud borjes su 'grol/ /de dang de dag zam pa lta bur ngal ba skyed par rtag tu 'gro ba sgrol/ /gru dang gru chen lta bur smon lam rab /)btab ye shes gang 32chen mtsho thob byed/ /de dang de dag mnyan pa lta bur 'gro ba ye shes thang chen mchog la 'god/ /de dag skyed〈nyemos tshal gyi dga' la brtse zhing 'gro la yang dag spyod pa ston/ /de dag chos kyi rnam thar mngon shes me tog ye shes gzhal myed khang dag pa/ /mkhas pa de dang de dag sman ltar nad zhi byed cing nyon mongs rab tu sel/ /sman gyis rgyas pa'i gangs miri lta bur de dang de dag ye shes 'byung gnas so/ /de dag sangs rgyas lta bur ye shes kyis ni 'gro ba gnyid log mun pa sel/ /yang dag sangs rgyas lta bur gzhan myin yid kyis 'gro ba yang dag rtogs 7par byed/ /de dang de dag rgyal ba ci 'dra de ltar 'ongs te mkhas pa de nyid gnas/ 1 7/de dag thams cad mkhyen pa lta bur ye shes 'byung gnas kun nas sgor yang zhugs/ /zhi ba skyedarwa pa de dang de dag ston pas rab bsngags 'gro ba kun la ston/ /de dang de dag rang gi ye shes yul dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i 17spyod yul shes/ /de dang de dag tshad myed dpung dang 'dra bar 'gro ni ba kun na thub pa myed/ /de dag ye shes myi 'jigs blo gros 'chang ba thams cad mkhyen pa'i chos kyang shes/ /37—575

gang na gang dag 'gro ba kun gyi gzugs dang 67rnams ji snyed snang yod pa/ /kun tu gzugs snyoms gzugs kyi rjes su song zhing mying dbyangs rjes su song ba yin / /gzugs rnams kun las 'das shing mying dang rnam par bral yang bya ba thams cad ston/ /de dag mthu ni 'gro ba rnams kyis rnam pasakun tu brjod par mi nus so/ /gang dag 'di 'dra'i yon tan thob cing dngos bral dngos po myed pa'i chos gnas shing / /yod dang myed pa'i⑧mdud pa thams cad bral ba mkhas pa ye shes mngon sum can/ /thams cad shes kyang ye shes rten pa ma yin ye shes de la gnas pa min/ /de dag spyod la 'jug pa〈peyid 'ong 'jig rten dga' bar byed pa bshad par bya/ /chos kyi tshul ni sgyu ma'i rang bzhin dngos po dben pa lta bur rab rtogs nas/ /mkhas pa〈lde)sangs rgyas byin gyisnyirlabs kyis smon lam thabs dang snying rje dag kyang byed/ /sprul pa'i ye shes sgo dang ldan pas khyu mchog bya ba sna tshogs rab stonas3)pa'i/ /byang chub sems dpa' ma nor yid can rtse gcig mnyam pa myed pa legs par grag3) /lus gcig rme ni mtha' yas lus dang rgya chen lus rnams tha dang rab tu ston/ /sems myed yid myed sems kyi yul myed 'on kyang 'gro ba kun tu de dag ston/ /khyu mchog brjod pa'i pha rol phyin pa de dag dbyangs gcig rnam par rjod ri9 byed kyang / /'gro ba dag gi〈 )sgra skad ji snyed yod pa de dag thams cad rab tu brjod(17/ /nyon mongs rgyud byung lus dang bral yang sems can rnams nya kyi lus la dbang bsgyur hu te/ /brjod du myed pa'i tshul gyis zhi ba rtogs shing sgra rnams thams cad rab tu ston/ /de dag sems kyi rang bzhin zhi zhing 'od gsal nam mkha' mtshungs par yang dag shes/ /'gro ba kun la bya ba rnam pa sna tshogs sgo nas 'jig rten sna tshogs ston/ /de 37—576

dag lus rnams gang la'ang gnas pa myed de lus kyanganyede dag ston pa byed/ /'gro ba thams cad kyi ni skye ba dag dang rgyu mthun laganas pa ji snyed pa( ri/ /thams cad kun tu skye ba'i lus dang ldan yangatshageskye ba dag la gnas pa myed/ /rang gi lus la mkha' 'dra dngos bral sems can sems la sna tshogs rnam pa ste/ /mkhas pa kun la dbang bsgyuras3)de dag lus ni mtha' yas kun tu ston byed cing //me tog dri dang byug pa phye ma sil snyan gdugs dang ba dan ⑥rgyal mtshan rnamasarim/ /thams cad mkhyen la〈〈snamachod pas rkang gnyis gtso bo 'jig rten mchog la mchod byed cing / /mkhas pa bsam pa thag pas lus kyis shesa'adu byed mchod pa dam pa kun tu ston/ /mkhas pa de dag rgyal ba0 rizhabs kyi drung 'khod 37rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ /'khor rnams kun na snang zhing mtshungs myed de dag zhu ba kun kyang zhu ba byed/ /chos kyi dam pa thos nas ting 'dzin re re mtha' yas sgo ldan thob gyur cing ske/ /blo gros ldan pa de snyed rnam par ldan pa 3 ston pa byed kyang zad pa myed//'gro ba sgyu ma lta bur rtogs nas shes rab ye shes thabs kyi 3 pha rol phyin/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i chos dang gzugs spobs khomatha' yas dang ba 'gro ba kun la ston/ /sna tshogs gzugs dang sgra rnams mtha' yas shin tu rgya che sems kyang rab tu ston//'gro ba thams cad la ni 'du shes dra ba 'jug pa ston kyang gnas pa myed/ /'gro don rjes 'gro de dag la la dag tu mi thog ma'i sems su 'gro la 8ston/ /la lar 'gro ba kun la byang chub spyod pa mtha' yas rgya chen 1 tshodag kyang ston/ /la lar sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod pa brtson 'grus brtan dang 18shes rab rnams/ /la lar tshangs pa'i lam nyamasdud kha cig tu ni spyod pa mchog kyang rab tu ston/ /mkhas pa rtog 2 )myed de dag la lar spyod pa rdzogs shing bzod pa thob pa ston/ /37—577

la lar skye ba gcig gis thogs par nges shing la lar rgyal bas0)dbang bskur ba//la lar nyan thos gzugs su gyur cing la la dag du rang rgyal gzugs su 'gyural//bye ba khrag khrig mang po'i zhing du mya ngan 'da' yang spyod lasasaldog pa myed/ /de dag la lar lha dbang brgya byin lha dang bcas pa la lar tshangs par 'gyur/ /de dag la lar lha'i bu mo brgyas bskor la54)lar gcig pu spyod pararnyuston/ /la lar dge slong rab tu zhi zhing yid zhi la lar rgyal po dbang phyug 'gyur/ /la lar chos kyi dra bar 'jug pa'i ye shes khyu mchog gzugs kyang rab tu ston/ /la lar bud myed sgyu rtsal pha rol rab phyin la lar 6)dka' thub can du 'gyurame/ /la lar 'dod pa'i longs spyod rgya chen ston cing la lar bsam gtan thub pa byed she/ /la lar mya ngan 'da' dang tshe'i sa dang la lar rgan dang byis par ston/ /de dag spyod pa bsams na skye bo mos par 'gyur te yid gnyis rnyed par 'gyur/ /la lar lha dang 'grogs shing la lar shi 'pho la lar mngal 6)'gro gnas par (3 ston / /la lar mngal zhugs la lar rnam par sangs rgyas la lar 'khor lo rab tu bskor11/ /la lar skye ba la lar mya ngan 'das pa la lar bzo yang rab tu slob / /la lar bud myed tshogs kyi dbus gnas 3nyal lar ting nyi 'dzin la lar mngon par nga'abyung / /la lar khyu mchog byang chub dam par sangs rgyas byang chub shing gi bodrung na bzhugs/ /la lar 'khor lo rab tu bskor77zhing la lar sna tshogs chos rnams yongs su tshol/ /la lar sangs rgyas gyur cing zhing rnams bye ba brgyar khyab 'gro bar ston byed kyang / /byang chub don du spyod pa dag gi5nyetshogs rnams las kyang phyir ldog ma yin no/ /bskal pa'i grangs lasngo 'jug pa'i pha rol phyin pas bskal pa bye ba phrag brgya dag /khyu mchog sems gcig nang 37—578

ston sems gcig bskal pa brgyar yang de bzhin ston pa byed/ /'gro ba thams cad la'ang rtog dang myi rtog pa yi7)yul rnams thams cad ston/ /stsogs ri pa myed cing phyogs la gnas myed spyod pa de dag kun kyang rab tu ston/ /gang phyir rgyal ba nyesargyal de dag nyi tse'i0)phyogs myed kun na bzhugs pas na/ /'gro ba kun gyi rgyal ba ji snyed pa dag thams cad rdul gcig steng du mthong / /sangs rgyas zhing rnams bsgrub dang sems can yul dang chos kyi rgyu tshul rnams kyang mthong ske/ /de ltar brtson pas bskal pa khrag khrig brtson byed 'on kyang cha shas zad mi 'gyur/ /de ltar 'gro ba kun gyi sems can tshul rnams mtha' yas rgya che cirarab tu shes/ /sems can gcig la mtha' yas lus dang rgyu dang bye ba khrag khrig yod papo)rnams/ /de dag 'gro ba gcig dang ma lus thams cad dag la rnam pa kun tu ston pa byed/ /bslab pa 'di yi phyogs la pha rol phyin te ma bslabs rnams ni ston pa ⑦byed/ /dbang po rnon po dang ni rina'abring dang gang dag dbang po rtul ba'ang rab shes nas/ /'gro bar skal 9 ba yod dang skal tu tshob med pa'i dbang po'i 'khor lo skor ba 31byed/ /dbang po re re la yang dbang po thams cad rnam pasngogephan tshun gnas pa dang / /dbang po'i dngos po phra ba'i tshul dang gang dag dbang po brtan tsho/nyapa'ang rab tu shes/ /de ltar khams dang mos dang bsam pa spyod dang nyon mongs bag chags rnams kyang shes/ /sngon gyi mtha' dang phyi ma'i mtha' yi sems spyod da / ltar byung ba'ang de bzhin te/ /sems can kun gyi spyod pa'i pha rol 8phyin kyang 'ong tshadang 'gro ba yod ma yin/ /ma nor spyod pa shes nas 'gro ba kun 1 tshol chos kyi dam pa ston pa byed/ /de ltar sems kyi sems spyod sna tshogs kun nas nyon mongs nyon mongs 18skyed pa dag36 /37—579

sems gcig la ni khong du chud nas byang chub mchog tu kun mkhyen rnam sangs rgyas3)ske/ /sems kyi skad cig gcig gis 'gro ba rnams phye rang gi shes pas rtogs gyur nas/ /sems kyi tshul shes sems myed rab tu gzhol bsakhuye shes mchog la kun kyang 'god/ /rdzu 'phrul mchog thob ye shes khyu mchog mngon par shes pa kun gyis rab tu 'phags/ /sems bskyed5kyegacig gis khrag khrig mtha' yas zhing dang phyogs rnams thams cad du yang 'gro/ /de ltar ye shes dbang bsgyur ca'agro zhing bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig zad byed kyang / /sgra mergyud shin tu phra ba gcig la zhugs par gnas las gar yang 'pho ba myed9/ /'tsho ba'i don du sgyu mkhan gzugs rnams sna tshogs 'gro ba kun la stonamadzo)byed kyang / /sgyu ma kun btsal nagazugs su myi dmyigs gzugs yod mchu)yin par yang dmyigs pa myed/ /de ltar mkhas pa ye shes thabs dang shes rab rgya chen sgyu mar zhugs pa rnams/ /sprul pa phun sum tshogs pas 'jig rten phal chen khyab par byas shes rab tu ston//nyi ma zla ba mkha' la 1 skurgyu zhing mdzes la shin tu 'phags pa nyu1rnams/ /ma rnyogs chu rnams ji snyed dag tu snang yang de ni chu dang 'dres ma yin/ /de ltar chos nyid dag pa'i dkyil 'khor mchog la shes pas 12shin tu 'phags pa nyusnyernams/ /'gro ba dag pa'i sems kyi yul la snang yang 'gro ba dag dang mdzes tsham yin/ /la la saganyid log rmyi lam dag na bya ba rnam pa sna tshogs tha dad byed/ /lo ni bye ba khrag khrig mang po zad par mis kyang mtshan mo de ma zad8/ /de ltar chos nyid rang bzhin mtshungs par rjes rtogs bya ba sna tshogs kun ston tenyurte/ /skad cig gcig la bskal pa bye ba zad byed de dag ye shes zad myi 'gyur/ /ri yi dbang po'i 18ri sul gnas pa 'jig rten dag dang mnyam du thos pa'i sgra/ /kun nas 37—580

sgra'i0sgra brnyan de dang 'dra bar brjod kyang rtog cing g.yo ba myed/ /de bzhin chos kyi rang bzhin shes pa'i khyu mchog byang chub sems dpa' mkhas pa dag /rtog pa myed par sems can sgra rnams ji snyed par ni chos dang spyod pa ston/ /dpyid zla dag gi snyig rgyu g.yos la5geji ltar sems can chur ni 'du shes nas/ /de nas chu rnyed myi 'gyur btung du myed cing je bas je skom rnam 'phel ba / de ltar mkhas pa thar la zhugs pa sems can dag gi nyon mongs g.yo ba5gernams/ /shes pas rtogs nas gesems can 'du shes bya myed phyir zhing bya ba rnam par 'phel / /gzugs ni dbu ba lta bur khyu mchog ston te tshor ba chu'i 6)chu bur 'dra//'du shes thams cad phyig7rgyu lta bur rag las 'du byedapo chu skyes shing dang 'dra//sems ni sgyu 'dra bsgrub bya skyedas7byed de bzhin bya ba sna tshogs rab tu ston/ / de ltar ⑩phung po dgod pa ston hu7kyang dbang bsgyur 12dag ni de la gnas pa myed/ /skye mched stong ba'i〈gerang bzhin dbang myed 'khrul 'khor bya ba kun tu 'byin byed dang ske/ /khams ni chos kyi dbyings mtshungs dngos po dag dang bral bar 'gro ba rnams la ston/ /dam pa'i don tshul zhi ba las ni bden pa sna tshogs rnams kyang rab tu 8ston/ /de ltar de dag chos tshul rnam par dgod 15pa ston pa byed kyang gnas pa myed/ /'ong ba myed cing phyogs su 'gro ba myed la rgyud 19du gnas 9/lhemyed pa'i/ /nyon mongs rgyu las byung ba'i las dang las las 1 sdug bsngal de ltar lam gsum du(nye/ /rkyen la sum̐ )rag las 'byung ba rnams dang yod dang myed las rab tu 'das pa yo —1/ /yang dag don dam dbu ri 2ma'i lam ni dngos po myed la gnas pa rab tu ston/ /skad cig gcig la dus gsum khong du chud kyang skad cig sna tshogs rnams kyang bstan gi/ /'dod dang (rigazugs myed khams kyi yul 37—581

dang bya ba sna tshogs ston pa byed/ /sdom pa gsum gyi7spyod dngakhurab tu ldan zhing thar pa gsum yang rab tu ston/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du gcig la theg pa gsum du rnam par dgod pa de bzhin ston/ /gnas dang gnas ma yin pa rab tu dbye ba'i chos dang dbang po pha rol phyin/ /khams dang mos pa dag dang nyon mongs rnam 'byed kun tu 'gro ba thob gyur pa/ /myig gi yul gyur sngon gyi ciganas pa dran 4 zhing nyon mongs zhi bar mkhas pa dag /sangs rgyas stobs bcu dag gis ye shes shin tu yangs 5 kyang stobs la dmyigs pa myed/ /sangs rgyas thams cad rjes su dpog stong 'gro ba kun tu mngon sum mechos bzhed de/ /nyon mongs zag pa lhan cig skyes pa7)myi mnga' byang ba'ang brnyes par 'gyur ba dusamyed / /'byung bas ༄9)thugs su chud pa'i ye shes rgya chen des ni 'gro ba 'don pa mdzad / /'di yi gnas la rgyal sras 'jigs pa myed cing 'on kyang zhi bar spyod pa myed/ /'khrul pa myi mnga' lam las g.yo ba'ang myi mnga' dgongs tshipa nyams pa'ang mi mnga' ste/ /mos dang brtson 'grus ting 'dzin shes rab rnam par 'byed pa ye shes gang du'ang 37nyams pa myed/nye/ /thams cad mkhyen mdzad sdom pa gsum mdzad dus gsum kun la mngon sum mkhyen mnga' ba/ /'gro ba kun gyis ma thob 1 byams pa'i chos nyid myi 'phrogs chags pa myed pa rnyes (stepa/ /chos sgo gang dag gis ni spyod pa 'di dag rab tu thob pa smra ba'i gemachog /de dag yon tan mang po don gyis brgyan pa'i phyogs tsam tshabadag gis brjod par bya / /de dag spyod pa bskal pa khrag khrig dag tu brjod kyang zad par myi nus te/ /'on kyang ji sna ltar sa las 12rdul 'dra ye shes spyod pa phyogs tsam brjod par bya/ /sangs rgyas ye shes rten ldan bsam pa thob pas ngo mtshar 'du shes gnas pa nyurte37—582

rnams / /spyod pa mchog dang ldan zhing byams pa'i rjes song brtson 'grus brtan pas rnam ①gnon cing / /tshul khrims myi g.yo dbugs phyin de dag 'gro ba thams cad yongs su smin par byed/ /lung bstan rab tu thob nas rgyal sras rnams kyi spyod pa tshul bzhin thob par byed/ /sangs rgyas yon tan dag la zhugs kyang sems can sems dang zhing la sems pa byed/ /bskal pa'i dus la 'jug pa'i ②ye shes ldan zhing mkhas pa skyo ba'i 'du shes myed/ /gzungs kyi tshul dang yang dag tha dad stobs rnams thob cing yang dag don gyis rgal / /bstan pa mtshungs myed sems kyis mkhas pa byang chub zhi ba rnam par 'tshang yang rgya / /sems kyi spyod pa thams cad bzang po'i yon tan spyod pa'i mchog tu smon pa byed/ /snying rje'i rkyen dang byams pa mchog sten 4byang chub dam pa spyod par byed dang ldan/ /brtson pas pha rol phyin rtogs cigarab tu mkhas shing skyodzagaba'i pha rol phyin gyur pas/ /khyu mchog mos dang rab tu rtogs pa'i stobs thob byang chub dam pa mngon 'tshang rgya/ /mnyam pa nyid kyis 7)mnyam pa thob cing ye shes tshul gyis rin/chos mchog ston byed pa/ /yon tan thob byed spobs dang ldan pa de dag chos kyi dbang phyug mchog tu 'gyur/ /dbang la gnas kyang gnas pa myed pas mnyam pa myed pa'i sems kyi 'brug sgra sgrog97) /ye shes mchog dang de bzhin sprul pa 9/ )sgrub cing byang chub tsho/stonye bar 'gro/ /mkhas pa de dag bskal pa 'byam thenaklas byin rlabs shes pas 1rnyedabugs phyin rab tu 'thobanyi / /zab la gnas pas brtan 8par 'gro na gnas shing nem nur bstsal tshabs mkhas pa 7rnams/ /ye shes bsam gyis mi khyab chos kyi dgongs pa mkhas shing rnam phye pha rol phyin/ /snyoms lha par 'jug pa'i ye shes yul la zhugs nas thams cad mkhyen par 'tshang 37—583

yang rgya/ /ye shes rnam thar kun gyi pha rol phyin cing mngon par shes pas rnam par rtsen1/ /rig pa'i snang ldan rnam grol nyon mongs bral bas 'gro la skyedasamos tshal dang 'dra/ /gang la dkar ba'i spyod pa'i gzhal myed khang mdzes sna tshogs spyod pa ston pa po/ /'gro ba kun la rgyan rnams du ma rab tu ston kyang sems las g.yo ba myed/ /bsam pa shin tu shes pas brtanas pa rab tu mkhas shing pha rol phyin gyur pas④/ /mkhas pa dag ni dag cing sbyangs pa'i byang chub phyag rgya snang 5ba'i ye shes kyis(6ri/ /'gro ba dag dang myi mtshungs zhum myed khyu mchog lhag pa'i bsam pa spyiri bo 'dra/ /ye shes rgya mtsho 'dra dang yon tan myi zad don du spyod pa chen po spyod/ /de dag rin chen 'dra ba'i gnas la rdo rje lta bu'i go cha 8bgos pas gnas/ /shin tu rgya chen rtsom la rab tu mkhas shing 'gro ba kun na thub myed pa9)/ /byang chub mchog tu lung bstan skyon myed khong du chud pa'i rgya chen sems la gnas/ /sangs rgyas gter mchog mi zad thob nas thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'tshang rgya'o/ /rtag tu kun rdzob 4shes pas dbang 'gyur rnam par 'phrul pa rnams la mkhas pas spun/ /zhing rnams kun dang chos kyi hu7yul la rnam par 'phrul ba'i ye shes rgyud la gnas/ /lusal dang smon lam spyod yul ye shes rnam par 'phrul pa la yang 1gede bzhin te/ /'gro ba dag la rnam par rtse ba bye ba sakhrag khrig du ma nyidamang po ston/ /mngon par shes pa'i rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis 7rnam par 'phrul zhing nges par rnam par rtse/ /khyu mchog de dag sangs rgyas yul la stobs thob 'gro ba kun gyis nyurtethub pa myed/ /mkhas pa 'jigs pa myed dang bag tsha myed dang ma 'dres rnams kyis shin tu brgyan32/ /sangs rgyas sras dag las rnams thams cad byed cing shin tu mdzes pa'i lus 37—584

dang ldan/ /de dag lus kyi las kyi dngos po shin tu rgya che dag kyang dag cing dge /de yang 'byin pa'i tshe na rgyal bas byin gyis brlabs7)shing las ni mchog kyang byed/ /dam pa de dag sems bskyed gcig la sems rgyas byed pa'i sems kyang rab tu ston/ /rgyal ba'i dbang ((po thob pas rtag tu dbang po'i ting ③'dzin dbang la rab tu gnas/ /bsam pa dag cing g.yo sgyu rnams dang bral te lhag pa'i bsam pa mngon sum gyur/ /mos pa'i 'jug pa rnam pa sna tshogs tha dad 'gro ba dag la rab tu ston/ /bag chags thams cad spangs nas spyod pa dam pa rab tu 'dzin/ /nan tan bya ba grub 4)pa'i ye shes mkhas pas thams cad mkhyen pa5nye'atshang yang rgya/ /bsam pa rnam par spangs nas de dag skyon med gnas pa zhi ba'i 6)mchog kyang thob47)/ /mkhas pa 'di lam ⑧shin tu bslabs pa de dag ming ni yon tan sgo nas grags/ /mtha' yas sems kyi yul ldan gnas pa myed par lam rnams yang du sgom pa byed/ /ye shes tshul la gnas shing 'gro ba rnams la lam gyi rgyan rnams shin tu ston/ /spyod pa lag pa lta bu dga'ashedang ldan pa/sto yin snying po ye shes mchog /snying ni rdo rje lta bu snying rje'i go (1ba gos ye shes gdab pa'i mtshon cha tu yin/ /shes rab mgo ste chos rtogs7)myig yin byang chub spyod pa yang ni rna ba yin/ /tshul khrims dag cing nyon mongs myed la gtsang ste mun pa zhi byed sna yin te/ /spobs pa lce yin lus ni rig pa yin te sems ni ye shes dam pa yin/ /spyod pa rgyu ba yin te byang chub shing gnas seng ge'i khri ni 'dug pa yin/ /tshangs pa'i lam rnams dgamathuni lam yin stong pa chags skyed dam pa spyod yul lo/ /gang gi 8de dag snang bar 'gyur ba'i snang ba bde bar gshegs kyi ye shes yul/ /sems can spyod la rnam 37—585
