par lta ba ye shes mchog ste rnam pa sna tshogs bsgyings/ /sems can dben zhing chags dang bral ba'i sbyin pa bsnyems7pa myed pa'i tshul khrims dang / /bzod pa mi 'khrug 5brtson 'grus myi ldog dbang bsgyur zhub ni bsam gtan dam pa yin / /rgyu ba myed cing nam mkha' 'dra ba shes rab byams pa sems can rnam par 'dren/ /skyo rigemed snying rje rnam5gedag chos ni dga' ba nyon mongs gnas las btang yang snyoms/ /don ni zhi ba 6)chos kyi yul la nye bar 'gro ba bsod nams 'gro la bsngos/ /ye shes tshogs ni ral gyi rgyarnon po lta bu snang ba chen posnyerig pa ste/ /'gro ba rnams la thos pa ston pas mi ngoms bskal par 'dren kyang 'jigs pa myed/ /nan tan byed la gnas te bdud rnams btul nas bdud kyi lam yang rab tu bcad/ /rgyal ba rnams kyi 'phrin las gang yin ye shes spyod dang 9lhag pa'i bsam pas 'dzin/ /nga rgyal las rnams rnam par spangs te/rtag tu ye shes kyi'ang bya ba byed/ /bdud rnams byin gyi rlabs7)bcom mkhas —pa de dag sangs rgyas byin gyi 1 rlabs kyis 'phags/ /chos kyi byin gyi rlabs hunyethob blo gros chen po 'chang ba lha yi gnas su 'dong / /lha rnams byas te 'chi 'phos song thunas mchog gi 'amangal ni shin tu phra bar 'gro/ /skye ba mchog ni nye bar bstan nas tshamachog gi gom pa bdun ni 'dor ba kyi tshobyed/ /mkhas pa de dag sems can kun la bzo dang spyod dang btsun mo'i 'khor kyang ston/ /chags pa myed par mngon par byung nas byang chub shing drung chos kyi rgyan kyang byed/ /stong pa'i bstan nyu8las 'od zer dra ba yangs pa bkye hu/zhing yang dag bskul du ) ba byed//bdud rnams btul te byang chub go 'phang sangs rgyas chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu skor 1rka/ /sangs rgyas sa yang rab tu bstan nas 'dren pa de dag mtshungs pa 37—586

myed par bzhud/ /gang gis mkhas pa bskal pa bye bar rnam par rtse zhing yang dag byung gyur nas/ /sems can bye ba khrag khrig stong phrag du ma sangs rgyas yon tan rab 'god kyang / /rnam pa kun tu sems can myi gnas chos la ma yin spyod lam yin pa'i①/ /de dag gi ni spyod pa 'di 'dra mtha' yas shin tu rgya chen mdor bstan to/ /de 'dra'i spyod dang ldan pa'i ye shes khyu mchog rdzu 'phrul dag gis rnam par rtse/ /zhing rnams bye ba stong yang skra tsho rtse gcig la bskal pa khrag khrig brgyar 'dzin te/ /lag tu khyer te zhing rnams bye bar 'gro yang lus lasko ngal dub gang yang myed/ /mkhas pas khyer nas ji lta'i gnas su bkod kyang 'gro ba dag la gnod pa myed/ /'jig rten mkhyen pa'i zhing gi rgyan rnams ji snyed rnam pa tha dad bstan pa dag /kun kyang ba spu cigacig gi bu gar khyu mchog de dag yang dag rab tu ston/ /mkhas pa ba spu'i bu gar rgya mtsho'ilo3)chu rnams ma lus khong chud rab ston kyang / /'phel zhing 'gri ba myed 'gro ba dag la gnod par 'gyur myed bya ba de yang ston/ / khor yug 7 bokhrag khrig shin tu phra ba'i 98 rdul byas lag gis bsdus yo)khyer zhing / /zhing rnams khrag khrig bye ma snyed du 'dor byedashigacig tu gnyis kyang gzhog mi /1byed/ /zhing rnams de dag rdul du byas te de bzhin gzhan yang lha rnam par 'jig byed de/ /de 'dra'i rjes su dpag pa (nyezad par gyur kyang 'jug pa de dag mi zad do/ /'jig rten kun gyi nyi ma zla ba skar ma gang dag stong rnams ji snyed dang / /gang yang nor bu'i 'od dang mye yi 'od dang gang na begang rnams lha dbang 'od/ /mang po de dag rab tu 'das pa'i 'od zer khrag khrig spu gcig khung nas 'gyed/ /'jig rten kun gyi ngan song sdug bsngal zhi bar byed cing chos kyi dam pa ston/ /'gro ba ma lus sgra 37—587

yi rnam pa sna tshogs skad rnams thams cad ji snyed pa/ /khu7)mchog de dag tshig gcig rab tu brjod pas sgra rnams thams cad tshang bar brjod / /srog chags bye ba rnams kyis yid du 'ong ba'i sgra thos dga' zhing mgu bar 'gyur/ /rgyal bas bstan pa'i chos kyi rnam pa ji snyed thams cad de las thos par 'gyur/ /gang yang ji snyed 'das pa'i bskal bapa yod pa de dag ma 'ongs bskal ④par ston / gang yang ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar byung ba ji snyed de dag 'das par ston//khyu mchog dag ni zhing rnams 'tshig dang gnas pa rnam 3)pa tha dad ston par stibyed / /'gro ba ji snyed thams cad mkhas pa de dag skra rtse gcig la rab tu 'god tsho / /'das dang ma byon pa dang phyogs bcu kun na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba ji snyed pa/ /de dag thams cad rang gi lus las ma nor dbang bsgyur0)rnam par 'phrul pa ston/ /sprul pa'i byin gyis3skurlabs la shes pa'i mkhas pa de dag 'gro ba ji snyed sems/ /de snyed lus rnams rdug dang bral ba ston kyang lus la gnas pa gang yang myed/ /lam rgyud0 )drug po gang rnams ji snyed yod pa'i 'gro ba kun gyi 11lus bsdus shing / /brgya byin tshangs pa 1ge'ajig rten mgon po rnams dang de bzhin lha dang myi yi rnams/ /gang yang nyan thos rang rgyal rnams la dad cing sangs rgyas sku la mos pa la/ /sangs rgyas byang chub 'grub pa'i spyod pa dag dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i spyod pa ston/ /'gro ba kun gyi 'du shes dra ba rab dang 'bring dang tha mar 'jug pa hunyernams/ /thams cad shes shing byin rlob byang chub 'tshang rgya zhing rnams kun kyang rab tu ston/ /'du shes dra ba rnams sgoms 〉blo ldan 'jig rten 'du shes rnams la dbang bsgyur 3)ba/ /bya ba dang ni sbyor ba ji snyed pa dang dkonamatshamachog byang chub spyod pa ston/ /de dag de dang 37—588

rnam par 'phrul pa shin tu rgya chen dam pa gzhan yang ston/ /de dag gang la 'jig rten sa myin pa dang yul myin de dag bya ba ston/ /ston kyang lta hu)ba lhur len ma yin gzhan yang phyir zhing gong du ston pa byed/ /de dag sems can rnams kyi bsam pa ji bzhin spyod pa ji bzhin yang dag 'jug /lus ni nam mkha' lta bu dag dang yid la chags myed 'jig rten gsum gyi gtso/ /tshul khrims spos kyilabyug pa rab tu zhi ba gos yin yon tan sna tshogs rgyan / /chos kyi go 'phang skyon myed thob cing thams cad mkhyen pa yid bzhin nor bu ste/ /bde gshegs kun gyi ④ye shes dbang bskur 3)thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyal po'i thabs la gnas/ /pha rol phyin pa rtag 'byung 'khor lo yin te glang po mngon par shes pa mchog /ye shes rdzu 'phrul rta ste chags pa myed 'gro shes rab nor bu dam pa yin/ /spyod pa btsun mo bzang mo bsdu ba rnam pa bzhi po khyim bdag dam pa'o / /thabs la shin tu mkhas pa blon po yin te mkhas pa de dag 'khor los sgyur⑥ / /stong pa mtshukhyim ste ting 'dzin grong khyer mchog yin byams dang snying rje'i nigo ca'o⑨/ /shes rab ral gyi nya )yin te dran pa gzhu mdzes dbang po rno ba mda' yang yin/ /'jig rten mkhyen pa rnams kyi byin gyi 11chabs ni gdugs te ye shes rgyal mtshan bsgreng / /de dang de dag bzod pa'i stobs kyis 32bdud kyi dpung dang sde rnams 'dus pa 'joms3nye/ /gzungs ni sa ste byang chub spyod pa chu klung ye shes lu ma shes rab shing / /me tog byang chub yan lag ting nge 'dzin ni rta ste rdzu 'phrul rnam par brgyanas/ /stong pa rnam thar brgyad mapa rdzing bu yin te rnam par dpyod pa bzang mo 9btsun mo yin/ /thar pa bdud rtsi bza' ba yin te chos ni btung ba theg pa gsum gyis 3 rtse/ /de dag spyod pa de 'dra yid 37—589

'ong /khyad par 'phags te de bas gong du mang / /gang gisaltebaskal pa bye ba khrag khrig stong du skyo ba yongs su myi skyo bar / /ston pa mchod cing rnam dag zhing la brtson pas 'gro ba ye shes mchog la 'god/ /kha na ma tho kun myed ye shes rab gnas thams cad mkhyen pa nyid rgyas byed/ /zhing rnams rdul gyisa'abrur blags re re nas kyang bgranga'agazhing brtsi bar nus gyurasnyil/ /bar snang mkha' chen 'di yang skra yis57)gzhal te zad par bya bar nus srid de'u)/ /skad cig gcig la 'gro ba rnams kyi 9 sems ni bgrang tshul shes par nus srid kyi/ /sangs rgyas sras rnams spyod pa dag ni bskal pa brgyar brjod zad par myi nus so//gang zhig yon tan rnam dag 'di dag 'thob 3 )par 'dod cing gong du gzhan 'dod dang / /gang zhig sdug bsngal rnams las 'gro ba thar byas bde la 'god par 'dod 11pa dang / /gang zhig bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs dang mnyam du 'gyur bar 'dod pa dgayo /des ni rdo rje lta bur〈nyebartan pa'i sems su gyis 7te yon tan bslab par byos/ / shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo sangs rgyas phal po che zhes bya ba lasam/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i le'u ste/ bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi pa'o// // sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdoyi/ bam po nyi shu bzhi 1 pa/ bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa'i dzem ta'i tshal skyabs myed pa la 19zas sbyin gyi 3 kun dga' ra ba'i nang (stopo brang brtsegs pa rgyan rdu chen po can na lha/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po dang 'jam dpal la stsogs pa 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes pa〈 ge37—590

dam pa'i0)ye shes dang / brtan pa dam pa'i ye shes dang / chags myed dam pa'i ye shes dang / me tog dam pa'i ye shes dang / nyi ma dam pa'i ye shes dang ske/ zla ba dam pa'i ye shes dang / dri myed dam pa'i ye shes dang / rdo rje dam pa'i ye shes dang / rdul myed dam pa'i ye shes dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnam par snang bas dam pa'i ye shes dang / byang chub sems dpa' skar ma'i rgyal mtshan dang / ri rab rgyal mtshan dang / rin chen rgyal mtshan dang /chags myed rgyal mtshan dang / me tog rgyal mtshan dang / dri myed rgyal mtshan dang ske/ nyi ma'i rgyal mtshan dang / mdzes pa'i rgyal mtshan dang / rdul myed rgyal mtshan dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnam par snang ba'i rgyal mtshan dang /byang chub sems dpa' rin chen gzi brjid dang / blo gros chen po'i gzi brjid dang ske/ ye shes rdo rje'i gzi brjid dang / dri ma myed pa'i gzi brjid dang /chos kyi nyi ma'i gzi brjid dang / bsod nams ri bo'i gzi brjid dang / ye shes snang ba'i gzi brjid dang / kun nas dpal gyi rigazi brjid dang / kun nas 'od dpal gzi brjid dang / byang chub sems dpa' phyogs bcu snang bas rgyas par 'gengs pa'i gzi brjid dang / byang chub sems dpa' sa'i snying po dang ske/ nam mkha'i snying po dang / pad+ma'i 4snying po dang / rin po che'i snying po dang ske/ nyi ma'i snying po dang / yon tan rnam dag snying po dang / chos rgya mtsho'i snying po dang / rnam par snang ba'i snying po dang / gtsug gi snying po dang /byang chub sems dpa' pad+mo 5)dpal gyi snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa' bzang po'i myig dang / rnam par dag pa'i myig dang / dri ma myed pa'i myig dang ske/ chags pa myed pa'i myig dang / kun nas lta 6ba'i myig dang / shin tu 37—591

rnam par lta ba'i 1 myig dang / ut+pa la'i myig dang / rdo rje'i myig dang /rin po che'i myig dang / byang chub sems dpa' nam snyemakha'i myig dang / byang chub sems dpa' lha'i cod pan dang / chos kyi dbyings snang ba'i blo gros cod pan dang / byang chubamagudam pa'i cod pan dang / phyogs rnam par snang ba'i cod pan dang / sangs rgyas thams cad yang dag par 'byung ba'i snying po'i cod pan dang / 'jig rten thams cad las mngon par 'phags pa'i cod ⑤pan dang / kun nas rnam par snang ba'i cod pan dang / zil gyis non pa myed pa'i cod pan dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi seng ge'i khri 'dzin pa'i cod pan dang / byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi yidabyings nam mkha' kun nas snang ba'i cod pan dang / byang chub sems dpa' tshangs pa'i dbang po'i gtsug phud0)dang / klu'i dbang po'i gtsug phud dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sprul pa snang ba'i gtsug phud dang / byang chub dam pa'i gtsug phud dang / smon lam rgya mtshosathams cad rab tu sgrogashepa'i rin chen rgyal po'i gtsug phud dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'od kyi dkyil 'khor rab tu 'gyed pa'i nor bu rin chen 3 )'brug sgra'i gtsug phud dang / nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad tha myi dad par rnam par dmyigs pa'i rin chen rgyal pos brgyan pa'i gtsug phud dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rnam par 'phrul pa snang ba'i rgyal mtshan dang nyu1// rin po che'i rgyal po5)dra bas kun nas yog pa'i nyusnyegatsug phud dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi 'khor lo sgrog pa'i gtsug phud dang / byang chub sems dpa' dus gsum gyi mying (stethams cad rab tu sgrog pa'i gtsug phud dang / byang chub sems dpa' rgya chen 37—592

po'i 'od dang / gzi brjid dri ma myed pa'i 'od dang / rin po 1che'i 'od dang ske/ rdul dang bral ba'i 'od dang / skar ma'i 'od dang / chos kyi 'od dang zhi ba'i 'od dang / nyi ma'i 'od dang rnam par 'phrul pa'i 'od dang /byang chub sems dpa' lha'i 'od dang / byang chub sems dpa' bsod nams dpal dang / ye shes dpal dang / chos kyi nadapal dang / mngon par shes pa'i dpal dang / 'od kyi dpal dang / me tog dpal dang / rin po che'i dpal dang / byang chub kyi dpal dang / tshangs pa'i dpal dang / byang chub sems dpa' kun nas snang ba'i dpal dang / byang chub sems dpa' tshangs pa'i dbyangs dang / rgya mtsho'i dbyangs dang sa sgra'i dbyangs dang / 'jig rten dbang po'i dbyangs dang / ri dbang rgyal po 'thab pa'i dbyangs dang /chos kyi dbyings kun tu rgyas pa'i dbyangs dang / chos rgya mtsho thams cad rab tu sgrog pa'i dbyangs dang / bdud kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad rab tu 'dul ba'i dbyangs dang / snying rje chen po'i tshul gyi sprin rab tu sgrog 4pa'i dbyangs dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa' 'gro ba thams cad sdug bsngal rab tu zhi bar bya ba'i 5dbugs 'byin pa'i dbyangs dang / byang chub sems dpa' chos kyis phyi 'phags pa dang / khyad par gyis 'phags pa dang / ye shes kyisam 'phags pa dang ske/ bsod nams ri bos 'phags pa dang / yon tan gyi tshogs kyis 'phags pa dang / grags pas 'phags pa dang / kun tu snang bas 'phags pa dang ske/ byams pa chen pos 'phags pa dang / ye shes rgya mtshos 'phags pa dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa' nade bzhin gshegs pa'i rgyud 9kyi gdung gis 'phags pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' 'od kyi dpal dang / mchog gi 37—593

dpal dang / kun tu 'phags pa'i dpal dang / rnam par snang ba'i dpal dang ske/ chos kyi dpal dang / zla ba'i dpal dang / nam mkha'i dpal dang /rin po che'i 1dpal dang / dpal gyi dpal dang / byang chub sems dpa' ye shes kyi dpal dang / byang chub sems dpa' ri'i dbang po'i rgyal po dang /chos kyi dbang po'i rgyal po dang / 'gro ba'i dbang po'i rgyal po dang / tshangs pa'i dbang po'i rgyal po dang / tshogs kyi dbang po'i rgyal po dang / lha'i dbang po'i rgyal po dang / zhi ba'i dbang po'i rgyal po dang / mi g.yo ba'i dbang po'i rgyal po dang / khyu mchog gisko nodabang po'i rgyal po dang / byang chub sems dpa' mchog gi dbang po'i rgyal po dang / byang chub sems dpa' rab tu zhi ba'i sgra dang / chags pa myed pa'i sgra dang / sa'i dbyangs kyi sgra dang /rgya mtsho'i 'brug gi sgra dang / sprin gyi dbyangs kyi sgra dang / chos snang ba'ishogesgra dang ske/ nam mkha'i dbyangs pa kyi sgra dang / sems can kun gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba rab tu sgrog 6pa'i sgra dang / sngon gyi smon tsham yongs su bskul pa'i sgra dang /byang chub sems dpa' bdud kyi dkyil 'khor bcom zhing myed par byed dun pa'i sgra dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa' rin po che'i blo dang / ye shes ri bo'i blo dang /nam mkha'i blo dang / dri ma myed pa'i blo dang / chags pa myed pa'i blo dang /rnam par sangs rgyas pa'i blo dang / dus gsum snang ba'i blo dang / yangs pa'i blo dang / kun tu snang ba'i blo dang / byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi dbyings su snang ba'i blo dang / de dag la stsogs pa 9)byang chub sems dpa' lnga stong tsam ste/ kun kyang byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa dang /smon lam gyis byung ba 1 sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad rgyas par 'gengs pas11/37—594

chags pa myed pa'i spyod yul can/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis1)drung du 'dong bsashelus mtha' yas pa'i byin gyi ri kyirlabs dang ldan pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnam par 'phrul pa sayongs su bstan pas5rnam par ne nodamyigs param cibya ba la bsgrib 3)pa myed pa'i myig gi 9 dkyil 'khor rnam par dag pa1 / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mngon par 'tshang rgya ba'i tshe/ nye bar 'dong ba 31rgyun myi gcod pas/ tshad myed par phyin pa/ chos rgya mtsho'i tshul thams cad la ye shes snang ba/ rab tu thob pas snang ba mtha' yas pa dang ldan pa/ so so 12yang dag par rig hunyepa rnam par dag pas bskal pa mtha' yas par shin tu ston pa myi zad pa 'gro ba'i bsam pa ci 7lta ba bzhin du gzugs kyi lus yongs su ston pas nam mkha'i dbyings kyis 'aklas pa'i ye shes kyi spyod yul rnam par dag cing myi gnas pa/ sems can gyi khams sems can myed pa dang / srog myed pa yongs su shes pas rab rib myed pa/ chos kyi dbyings thams cad du 'od zer gyi dra bas rgyas par 'gengs pas nam mkha' dang mnyam pa sha stag dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs so/ /nyan thos rdzu 'phrul chen po dang ldan pa lnga brgya ste/thams cad kyang bden pa'i tshul gyi 1'arang bzhin mngon par khong du chud pa/yang dag pa'i mtha' kyi mngon sum du gyur pa/ chos kyi rang bzhin la zhugs 38pa/srid pa'i rgya mtsho las gyen du 'phags pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs su 'gyur ba'i spyod yul can kun nas sbyor ba dang / bag la nyal ba dang bcings pa rnam par bzlog pa/ chags pa myed pa'i gnas la brten 19pa/ nam mkha' ltar zhi ba la rnam par spyod pa/ sangs rgyas la the tsom 2 dang nem nur dang /yid gnyis yongs su chad pa/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes rgya mtsho la mos pa'i lam du 37—595

zhugs pa sha stag dang / 'jig rten gyishedabang po sngon gyi rgyal ba la bya ba byas pa / 'gro ba thams cad la phan pa dang / bde ba'i don du zhugs pa/ gsol ba ma btab par dge ba'i bshes gnyen⑧du gyur pa/ sems can gzhan bsrung ba la zhugs pa/ 'jig rten thams cad las 'phags pa'i khyad par dang ldan pa'i ye shes kyi sgo la zhugs pa/ sems can thams cad yongs su myi gtong ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bstan pa'i spyod yul la༄byung ba de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa yongs su bsrung ba la zhugs pa/ sangs rgyas kyi rigs yang dag par gzung phyiba'i smon lam gyis yang dag par skyes pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdung gi rgyudakyidu 'byung lab mngon du gyur pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la mngon par mos pa sha stag dang yang thabs gcig go/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'khor dang bcas pa de dag dang / nyan thos rdzu 'phrul chen po dang ldan pa/ de dag dang 'jig rten gyibadabang po 'khor dang bcas pa de dag 'di snyam du gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yul dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi spyod ḍā yul dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi7rlabs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i myi bsnyengs pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i〈tshe/ting nge 'dzin dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par spyod pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i mnga' (redang /de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes dang hunye/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs dang ske/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i mthu dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sngon gyi smon lam dang / sngon legs par spyad 8pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi skyabs dang /37—596

dad pa'i myiganyeyongs su dag pa dang / rgya chen po la mos pa'i snang ba rab tu thob pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i lhag pa'i bsam pa ②rnam par dag pa dang ske/ bsam pa thag pa'ishethams cad mkhyen pa nyid dungaX)smon cing yang dag par zhugs pa ma gtogs par lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis 'jug pa'am/khong du chud pa'am yid chesalgepa'am/ yongs su shes pa'am/ rnam par rtogs6)pa'am / gzungasheba'am rnam par dpyadas pa'am/ rnam par bsgom pa'am/rnam par dbye ba'am/ rnam par dgrol spuba'am/ rab tu brjod pa'am/sems can pha rol gyi rgyud du phyin par bya bar ni myi nus na/ bcom ldan 'das nyid kyisarwaste bdag cag byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bsam pa'i tshul ji lta ba dang ske/ sems can bsam pa rnam pa tha dad pa dang / mos pa sna tshogs dang /shes pa sna tshogs kyi tshig dang / brda sna tshogs su gyur pa/ dbang bsgyur71ba'i sa gzhan dang / gzhan la hunyeganas pa dbang po sna tshogs su rnam par dag pa/bsam pa dang sbyor ba rnam pa gzhan dang gzhan can/ sems dang bsam pa'i yul kho/nyegazhan dang gzhan can/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan gzhan dang gzhan la gnas pa/ chos bstan pa gzhan dang gzhan la mos pa dag la sngon thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du zhugs pa lta'ang yang dag par bstan grang / sngon byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam mngon par bsgrub /stepa lta'ang yang dag par bstan grang / sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su dag pa lta'ang yang dag par bstan grang / sngon gyi 8byang chub sems dpa'i sa yongs su mnan pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa lta'ang yang dag par bstan snagrang ske/ sngonatshwanyebyang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i dkyil 'khor mngon par bsgrub 37—597

pa yongs su rdzogs par mdzad pa lta'ang yang nyu)dag par bstan grang / sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa'i tshul mngon par bsgrub pa rnam par phye ba'i snang ba lta'ang yang dag par bstan grang / sngon byang chub sems dpa'i lam gyi rgyan na yongs su dag par mdzad pa lta'ang yang dag par bstan rigang / sngon byang chub sems dpa'i 'byung 4ba'i tshul rgya mtsho mngon par bsgrub pa lta'ang yang dag par bstan grang / sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa'i yang dag par bsgrub pa dang /rnam par 'phrul pa'i rgyan 5phun sum tshogs pa lta'ang yang dag par bstanamachi67grang /byang chub sems dpa'i sngon gyi ri sbyor ba rgya mtsho lta'ang yang dag par bstan grang /mngon par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi sgos rnam par 'phrul pa lta'ang yang dag par bstan grang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ ba'i rnam par 'phrul pa dang / khyu mchog gi mthu lta'ang yang dag par bstan grang /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa dang kye)rnam par 'phrul pa lta'ang yang dag par bstan grang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sems can gyi 9khams 'dul 1 ba'i thabs kyi sgo lta'ang yang dag par bstan grang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi /1chos kyi grong khyer la mnga' mdzad pa lta'ang yang dag par bstan grang / de bzhin gshegs pa sems can thams cad kyi lam snang bar mdzad pa lta'ang yang dag par bstan grang / de bzhin gshegs pa sems can thams cad kyi gnas su gshegs shing rnam par 'phrul pa mdzad pa lta'ang yang dag par bstan grang / de bzhin gshegs pa sems can thams cad kyi yon bzhes pa 12mdzad pa lta'ang yang dag par bstan grang / de bzhin gshegs pa sems can thams cad kyi bsod nams dang yon tan 12ston 37—598

pa'i cho 'phrul mdzad pa lta'ang yang dag par bstan grang / de bzhin gshegs pa sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi tshul la sangs rgyas kyi gzugs brnyan dmyigs pa mdzad pa lta'ang yang dag par bstan 1 grang / de bzhin gshegs pa sems can thams cad la/ rnam par 'phrul pa'i cho 'phrul mdzad pa lta'ang yang dag par bstan grang / de bzhin gshegs pa sems can thams cad la yongs su bstan pa dnga'age/ rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul mdzad pa lta'ang yang dag par bstan grang / de bzhin gshegs pa sems can thams cad la sangs rgyas kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi spyod yul bsam gyis myi khyab pas rnam par 'phrul pa mdzad pa lta'ang yang dag par bstan grang snyam pa dang / de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis ri/byang chub sems dpa' de dag gi 4)sems kyi yongs su rtog 5pa thugs kyis mkhyen nas/seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin nam mkha' dang mnyam pas 6)dpe myed pa 'gro ba thams cad du rnam par snang ba'i rgyan ri ridang ldan pa/thugs rje chen po'i sgo'i rang 487)bzhin can/ thugs rje chen po'i sgo dang ldan pa/thugs rje chen po tho /sngon du 'gro ba/ thugs rje chen po'i chos can la mnyam par gzhag nya )go/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi 11de ltar mnyam par bzhag ma thag tu pho brang kyi brtsegs pa rgyan kyi chen po can yang mtha' dang dbus myed par yangs shing rdo rje thub pa myed pa'i rgyal skomatshan gyis sa'i gzhi borab tu bkod sapa dang / nor bu rin po che'i rgyal po thams cad kyi dra ba kun tu bkram pa/ rin po che du ma'i me tog sil mas chal kyi bar gang ba/ nor bu rin po che dam pa mdzes par bkram pa dang / bai ḍūr+ya'i 18ka bas mdzes par byas pa/ rin po che'i rgyal po 'gro ba rnam par snang bas rgyan shin tu rnam par phye ba19/ rin po che bzang po mang po 37—599

dang ldan pa'i nor bu rin po che 'dzam bu'i chu klung0)gi phung pos shin tu brgyanasnyepa dang / rin po che thams cad las7sgo gang5gedang / rta babs dang / pu shu dang / skar khung byas shing khri 'phang grangs myed pa rnam par ⑤dag pas brgyan pa dang / 'jig rten gyi dbang po thams cad dang 'dra ba'i nor bu rin po che'i 6rgyan dang ldan pa dang / 'gro ba rgya mtsho'ishenor bu rin po che rnam par phye ba dang / nor bu rin po che thams cad kyi dra bas kun nas yog pa'i gdugs dang ske/ rgyal mtshan rab tu bsgreng ba dang / sgo dang rta babs thams cad las 'od zer chos kyi dbyings su rgyas par 'gengs pa rab tu 'byung bas rnam par mdzes par byas pa dang / phyi rol gyi ⑧'khor gyi dkyil 'khor gyi skyesa'i gzhi stegs bu brjod du myed pas brgyan pa dang / phyogs kun nas them skas kyi phreng ba nor bu rin po ches brtsegs shing shin tu rnam par phye bas rab tu mdzes par kun nas gnas par gyur to/ /dze〈 )ta'i tshal thams cad kyang71chu zheng gab par shin tu yangs shing rgya che bar kun nas gnas par gyur te/ sangs rgyas kyi mthus sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du myed pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi (rtesangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams kyang chu zheng kun tu rgya che zhing yangs pa dang / rin po che thams cad kyi rgyan sna tshogs dang ldan zhing / sa'i gzhi nor bu rin po che sna tshogs brjod du myed pas kun nas grub pa dang / nor bu rin po che grangs myed pa'i ra 1 bas kun nas bskor ba dang / rin po che sna tshogs kyi shing ta la'i phreng7bas mdzes par skabargyan par kun nas gnas par gyur to/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag na spos chu'i hu chu klung tshad myed pa klongs mtha' yas par5)'khyil pa'i spos kyi chus yongs su gang ba/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi me tog mang po dang 'dres par 37wa 600

gyur la g.yas phyogs su 'khyil cing7)'bab pa/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad dbyingasasnyesu sgrog⑧pas rab tu brgyan pa dag kyang kun nas gnas par gyur to/ /rin po che'i me tog pun da7ri ku'i phreng ba dang / rin po che'i shing gam yo'asnirin po che thams cad kyi pad+mo rab tu rgyas shing / shin tu 'phags pas mdzes par brgyan ⑥pa dang / rin po che sna tshogs kyi khang pa brtsegs pa'i phreng ba bsam gyis myi khyab pa nor bu rin po che thams cad kyil dra bas kun nas yog bsnyenor bu rin po che grangs myed pa'i dra ba kun tu tshesnang bas brgyan cing7 mdzes pa dang ske/ nor bu rin po che'i gzhal myed khang nor bu rin po che thams cad kyis brgyan parwategrangs myed pa spos thams cad kyi ngad kun nas 'byung ba bdugasngo spos kyi sprin gyi rgyan dang ldan pa dag kyang kun nas gnas par gyur to/ /rin po che'i rgyal mtshan grangs myed pa dang / gos kyi rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan gyi rgyal mtshan dang / rin po che'i hu snam bu'i rgyal mtshan dang / me tog gi rgyal mtshan dang ske/ rgyan gyitswargyal mtshan dang / phreng ba'i rgyal mtshan dang / rin po che sna tshogs kyi dril bu'i rgyal mtshan dang / rin po che'i rgyal ba'ichagadugs kyi rgyal mtshan dang / nor bu rin po che snang bas kun tu rgyas par 'gengs pa'i rgyal mtshan dang / nor bu rin po che'i rgyal po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mtshan gyi 'khor lo'i dbyangs rab tu sgrog pa'i rgyal mtshan dang / nor bu rin po che'i rgyal po seng ge yid du 'ong ba'i rgyal mtshan dang / nor bu rin po che'i rgyal po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sngon gyi sbyor ba rab tu sgrogatshwa)pa'i rgyal mtshan dang / nor bu rin po che'i rgyal po chos kyi dbyings thams cad rab tu snang ba'i rgyal mtshan dang / rgyal mtshan gyi rgyan rnam par phye ba thams cad 37—601

phyogs kun nas rgyan 1tu gyur pa dag kyang kun nas gnas par gyur to/ /dze〈 rata'i tshal gyi na nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad kyang lha'i gzhal9)myed khang gi sprin bsam gyis myi khyab pas brgyan par kun nas gnas par gyur te/ dze〈lta ta'i tshal nyid kyang spos sna tshogs kyi shing grangs myed pa'i sprin gyis kun nas yog cing brgyan pa dang / brjod du myed pa'i rgyan sna tshogs dang ldan pa'i ri rab kyisam9)kun nas 'khor cing rgyan rtso pa dang / rol mo brdung ba dang / dkrol ba brjod du myed pa'i sprin las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la bstod pa'i dbyangs dang nang ro snyan pa 'byung bas kun nas brgyan pa dang / rin po che'i pad+mo brjod du myed pa'i sprin gyis kun nas yog cing brgyan pa dang / rin po che'i seng ge'i khri brjod du myed pa'i steng lha rdzas kyi rin po che'i stan bting ba la/byang chub sems dpa' 'khod cing de bzhin gshegs pa la bstod pa'i sgra dbyangs snyan pa 'byin pa'i sprin gyis 9kun nas brgyan pa dang / lha'i dbang po brjod du myed pa'i gzugs brnyan 1 mngon par 'byung ba'i nor bu rin po che'i 'bru'i sprin gyis kun nas brgyan pa dang / mu tig dkar po'i dra ba'i sprin brjod du myed pas kun nas brgyan pa dang / mu tig dmar po'i khang pa brtsegs pa'i sprin brjod du myed pas kun nas yog cing brgyan pa dang / rdo rje lta bur /nya sra ba'i mu tig gi sprin brjod du myed pa'i char mngon par 'bab 32pas rab tu brgyan par kun nas gnas par gyur to/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos dkar po'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i khyu mchog gi mthu dang / byin gyi rlabs1snye/ bsam gyis myi khyab 37wa 602

pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gcig gis 17'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du rgyas par 'gengs pa larnam par 'phrul pa bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gcig tu zhugs ri pas/sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnam par phye ba thams cad la yang dag par gzhol ba'i byin gyi 4rlabs yongs su ston pa bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams rdul shin tu phra ba gcig la chos kyi dbyings thams cad kyi gzugs brnyan rnam par dmyigs par yongs su ston par rig mdzad pa bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i phyir rol/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ba spu'i bu ga gcig tu sngon gyi mtha'i 6)de bzhin gshegs pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud 7 pa yongs su ston par〈nyamadzad pa bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi 'od zer gcig gi po)sgo nas 'jig rten gyi khams 'byam 1 )klas pa snang bar 'gyur ba bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ba spu'i rtse mo gcig las sprul pa'i sprin 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis 37sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad rgyas par 'gengs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ba spu'i sgo gcig nas 'jig rten gyi khams 'du ba dang ske/ 'jig pa'i bskal pa yongs su ston pa bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /ji ltar dze 12ta'i tshal de lta bu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pas yongs su dag par kun nas gnas par gyur pa de bzhin du phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i nyinamathas gtugs pa thams cad kyang yongs su dag par kun nas gnas shing rab tu brgyan pa dang / shin tu spud tshapa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i skus 15yongs su rgyas pa dang / dze 37wa 603

tsho1ta'i tshal du yang dag par gzhol ba dang / byang chub sems dpasasheyongs su rgyas pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho shin tu rnam par gnas pa dngas rgyan thams cad kyi sprinasagyi char mngon par 'bab pa dang ske/ rin po che thams cad kyi 'od kyis rab tu snang ba dang / rin po che sna tshogs thams cad kyi sprin gyi char mngon par 'bab tshepas brgyan pa dang / zhing thams cad kyi rgyan gyis5)sprin gyis kun nas yog par brgyan pa dang / lha rdzas kyi lus thams cad 4sprin gyi char rab tu 'bab pas brgyan pa dang / me tog sna tshogs thams cad kyi sprin shin tu rgyas pa'i lhun gyis kun tu rgyas shing brgyan pa dang ske/ gos thams cad kyi shing gi sprin gyi mdzod nas gos kha dog sna tshogs su mdzes pa'i char rab tu 'bab pas brgyan pa dang / phreng ba dang lda ldi dang sem/shemo do'i rgyan thams cad kyi sprin gyi char rgyun mi chad 9)par mngon par 'bab pas brgyan pa dang / spos sna tshogs kyi bdug spos phyogs kun 3 )nas 'thul ba'i sprin dang na bun gyi char thams cad kyi lus kyi hu1dbyibs ltar mngon par 'bab pas brgyan 12pa dang / rin po che thams cad kyi me tog gi dra ba'i sprin las rin po che'i rgyal po'i phye ma zhib bu'i char rgyun myi 'chad 1 par rab tu 'bab pa dang /rin po che thams cad kyi rgyal mtshan dang ba dan gyi sprin lha'i bu mo'i lag na khyer ba nam mkha'i dbyings kun tu rgyu zhing 'khor bsakhebargyan pa dang / rin po che thams cad kyi pad+mo rin po che sna tshogs kyi 'dab ma'i dkyil 'khor can chu ba mthon thupo dang ldan pa'i ze ba la skyarol mo bkod pa kun nas sgra 'byin cing dbyangs snyan par sgrog pas brgyan pa dang / rin po che'i 'bru sna tshogs kyi dra ba dang ske/ rin po che seng ge'i dra ba sna tshogs rnam pa tha dad pa'i phreng ba dang /37wa 604

se mo dos brgyan par kun nas gnas shing snang bar gyur to/ /de ltar khrocom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i ting nge 'dzin chen po seng ge 3)rnam par bsgyings pa de la mnyam par bzhag ma thag tu/ de'i tshe shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyikhukhams rgya mtsho sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du myed pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi pha rol gyi 'jig rten gyi khams gser gyi sprin sgronamu ma'i rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad dpal gyi gzi brjid rgyal po'i lgosangs rgyas kyi zhing nas byang chub sems dpa' rnam par snang ba'i smon lam gyi gtsug gi 'od zer snang ba zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du myed pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang lhan cig tu bcom ldan 'das des gnang nas 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho de nas skor)'phags te/ nam mkha'i dbyings rgyan sna tshogs kyi sprin gyisasho'ubargyan pa dang / lha rdzas kyi me tog gi sprin gyi char mngon par dbabalgepa dang / lha rdzas kyi spos kyi sprin gyi char rab tu dgye ba po)dang / lha rdzas kyi rin po che'i pad+mo'i sprin gyi char mngon par gtor ba thodang ske/ lha rdzas kyi phreng ba'i sprin gyi char rab tu gtang bob dang / lha rdzas kyi rin po che'i sprin gyi char mngon par dbab hunyapa dang / lha rdzas kyi rgyan gyi sprin gyi char mngon par dgye brwarnyedang / lha rdzas kyi rin po che'i gdugs kyi sprin gyi char mngon par bsgrub pa dang / kha dog sna tshogs rnam pa tha dad cing shin tu phra ba'i lha rdzas kyi gos kyi hunyespyin gyi char mngon par dbab 7pa dang / lha rdzas kyi rin po che'i rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan gyi sprin nam mkha'i dbyings las byin gyis brlab 8pa dang / rin po che sna tshogs kyi sprin gyi rgyan yid du 'ong bas nam mkha'i dbyings rgyas par 'gongs par byed cing / myi mjed 7kyi 'jig rten gyi 37—605

khams gang na ba der lhags nas bcom ldan 'das ga la ha)ba der dong ste/'khor dang bcas pas bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas shar phyogs su brten tshonate / khang pa brtsegs pa rgyan kun dang ldan zhing nor bu rin po che'i dra bas kun nas khyab pa dang / seng ge'i khri nor bu rin po che phyogs rab tu snang ba'i pad+mo'i snying po can dag mngon par sprul nas nor bu rin po che yid bzhin gyi rgyal po'i dra ba'i rgyan gyis 4kun nas brgyan pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i lus su byin gyis brlabs 5nas skyil mo krung 6bcas te 'khod do/ /lho phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du myed pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi pha rol gyi 'jig rten gyi khams rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi snying po zhes bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa dpal gyi snying po kun nas snang ba'i rgyal po'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po brtson 'grus kyi shugs thub rtso)par dka' ba'i rgyal po zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du myed pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang lhan cig tu bcom ldan 'das des gnang ༷sanas 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho de nas 'phags te/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho thams cad spos kyi lda ldi dang dra bas kun tu 'brel bar byin gyis brlab 47pa dang ske/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'byam nya tshoklas pa thams cad rin po che sna tshogs kyi lda ldi dang dra ba chen pos kun tu 'brel bar byin gyis brlab 11pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rgyud thams cad me tog thams cad kyi lda ldi dang / phreng ba'i dra bas kun tu 12'brel bar byin gyis brlab pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi 'khor thams cad phreng 1 ba dang lda ldi dang / se gemo do'i dra bas kun nas 'brel bar byin gyis tshabarlab pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi dkyil 'khor 37wa 606

thams cad 'og gi gzhi yo rten rdo rje thams cad kyi phreng bas yongs su gzung dun bar byin gyis brlab pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi tshul thams cad nor bu rin po che sna tshogs kyi dra bas ri kun nas 'brel bar byin gyis chedabarlab pa dang /'jig rten gyi khams thams cad gos sna tshogs kyi lda ldis kun nas yongs su blangs shing gzung gebar byin gyis brlab pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad rin po che sna tshogs kyi lus kyi phreng ba dang lda ldi mang po'i dra bas kyi kun nas 'brel bar mngon par bsgrub pa dang / zhing thams cad nor bu rin po che dpal gyi 'od zer gyi lda ldi dang / phreng ba'i dra bas kun nas 'brel bar byin gyis ri )brlab pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad rin po che rnam par snang ba'i lda ldi dang / dra bas kun tu 'brel bar byin gyis brlab pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi gzhi nor bu rin po che seng ge yid du 'ong ba'i phreng ba dang / lda ldi'i dra bas yongs su gzung nabar byin gyis brlab pa byed cing /myi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang na ba der lhags nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong ste/ 'khor dang bcas pas bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas / lho phyogs su brten smyo te/ nor bu rin po che 'gro ba la rnam par snang ba'i khang pa brtsegs pa dang / seng ge'i khri nor bu rin po che phyogs kun tu rnam par nya risnang ba'i pad+mo'i snying po can dag mngon par sprul te/ rin po che thams cad kyi me tog gi dra ba'i rgyan gyis kun nas brgyan pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i lus su byin gyis brlabs nas skyil mo krung 11bcas te 'khod do/ /nub phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du myed pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi pha rol gyi 'jig rten gyi khams rin po che'i ri rab rnam par 37wa 607

snang ba'i rgyal mtshan mar mye zhes bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes sgron ma'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas byang chub sems dpa' dpal kun nas 'phags pa'i gzi brjid ces bya ba byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho brjod du myed pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang lhan cig tu bcom ldan 'das des gnang nas 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho de nas 'phags te/ chos kyi dbyings thams cad bdug spos kha dog sna tshogs dang / dri sna tshogs su ldan pa'i ri rab kyi sprin sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du myed pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis rgyas par dgang 31ba dang / chos kyi dbyings thams cad spos kha dog sna tshogs dang ldan pa'i ri rab kyi sprin sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du myed pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis ②rgyas par dgang〈kyeb dang / chos kyi dbyings thams cad bdug spos kha dog dang dri du maral0ldan pa'i ri rab kyi sprin sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du myed pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis ④rgyas par dgang ⑥ba dang /chos kyi dbyings thams cad spos kha dog sna tshogs dang ldan pa'i ri rab kyi sprin sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du myed pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis gergyas par dgang 8ba dang / chos kyi dbyings thams cad nor bu rin po che'i rgyal po mdangs 'byung bas thams cad kyi rdul gyi7kha dog dang 'dra ba'i ri rab kyi sprin sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du myed pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis 3 )rgyas par dgang 31ba dang / chos kyi dbyings thams cad nor bu rin po che skar ma'i rgyal mtshan 'od kyi dkyil 'khor sna tshogs kyi rgyan 3rnyedang ldan pa'i ri rab kyi sprin sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du myed pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis (nyergyas par dgang 〉ba dang / chos kyi dbyings thams cad rin po che'i rgyal po rdo rje'i snying 37wa 608

po kha dog sna tshogs can/ rgyan nya)rnam pa tha dad pa'i yul dang ldan pa'i ri rab kyi sprin sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis rgyas ( napar dganga'i ba dang chos kyi dbyings thams cad nor bu rin po che pa'adzam bu'i chu klung 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du snang ba'i yul dang ldan pa'i ri rab kyi sprin sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis rgyas par dgangasnyib dang / nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad nor bu rin po che'i rgyal po chos kyi dbyings thams cad rab tu snang ba'i ri rab kyi sprin sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis 6)kun nas khyab par byin gyis brlab47pa dang / sems can gyi khams kyi yul thams cad nor bu rin po che'i rgyal po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mtshan rab tu snang ba'i ri rab kyi sprin sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis rgyas par dgang lab dang / chos kyi dbyings thams cad kyi nam mkha' rin po che'i rgyal po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sngon gyi sbyor ba rab tu snang b.ram1)yongs su ston cing ske/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i sgra 'byin pa'i ri rab kyi sprinatshamagyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis 17rgyas par dgang nyu ba dang /phyogs bcu thams cad rin po che'i rgyal po de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po byang chub rab tu snang hurteba'i 'od dang ldan pa'i ri rab kyi sprin sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis 34rgyas par 'gengs pa 3gebyed cing / myi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang na ba der lhags nas bcom ldan 'das gangasrin ba der dong ste/ 'khor dang bcas pas bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas/ nub phyogs su brten te/ khang pa brtsegs pa spos kyi 37wa 609

rgyal po thams cad kyi lhun dang ldan pa mu tig gi 1)dra bas kun nas khyab pa dang /seng ge'i khri nanor bu rin po che lha'i dbang po rab tu snang ba'i rgyal mtshan gyi pad+mo'i snying po can dag mngon par sprul nas/ rin po che gser gyi rngo /dra bas kun nas brgyan pa dang / yid bzhin gyi rgyal po'i macod pan bcings pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i lus su byin gyis brlabs (5)nas skyil mo krungakhebacas te 'khod do / /byang phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyis khams rgya mtsho sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi pha rol gyi 'jig rten gyi khams rin po che'i gos yongs su snang ba zhes bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi dbyings nam mkha'i dpal rnam par snang ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas byang chub sems dpa' chags pa myed pa'i dpal gyi rgyal po zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho brjod du med pa'i 8)rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang lhan cig tu bcom ldan 'das des gnang nas 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho de nas 'phags te/nam mkha'i dbyings rin po che'i snam bu'i sprin gyi rgyan gyis brgyan par byin gyis brlab pa dang / nam mkha'i dbyings rin po che'i gos kha dog ser po dang /mdog ser po'i sprin gyi rgyan gyis brgyan 9par byin gyis nya brlab pa dang / nam mkha'i dbyings 11rin po che'i gos spos sna tshogs kyis 12dri zhim por byas pa'i 32sprin gyi char rab tu 'bab pa'i 1 rgyan gyis brgyan par byin gyis brlab pa dang /nam mkha'i dbyings rin po che'i rgyal po benyi ma'i rgyal mtshan gyi sprin gyi rgyan gyis brgyan par byin gyis brlab pa dang / nam mkha'i dbyings nor bu rin po che gser gyi samadog shin tu 'bar ba'i sprin gyi nya rgyan gyis brgyan par byin gyis brlab pa dang / nam mkha'i dbyings nor bu'i rgyal po rin po che 'bar ba'i 37—610

gos kyi 6)sprin gyi rgyan gyis brgyan par byin gyis brlab pa dang / nam mkha'i dbyings7rin po che skar ma thams cad kyi gzugs brnyan gyisang kyisna tshogs su gyur pa'i gos kyi sprin gyi rgyan gyis brgyan par byin gyis brlab pa dang / nam mkha'i dbyings phyogs bcu kun nas nor bu rin po che ri snam bu khra bo'i rdo bltar snang ba'i sprin gyis yongs su rgyas par byin gyis brlab pa dang / nam mkha'i dbyings phyogs bcu kun nas rin po che'i rgyal po rnam par snang ba'i dpal rab tu 'bar ba'i 'od dang ldan pa'i gos kyi sprin gyis yongs su rgyas par byin gyis brlab pa dang ske/ nam mkha'i dbyings phyogs bcu kun nas nor bu'i rgyal po snang ba shin tu gsal bas phyogs kyi dbyings rnam par snang ba'i gos kyi sprin gyis yongs su rgyas par byin gyis brlab pa dang / nam mkha'i dbyings rin po che'i rgyal po rgya mtsho'i rgyan gyi gos kyi sprin gyis kun nas yog par byin gyis brlab pa ne byed cing /myi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang na ba der lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong ste/ 'khor dang bcas pas 7bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas/ byang phyogs su brten nate/ rin po che'i rgyal po rgya mtsho yongs su 'byung ba'i khang pa brtsegs pa dang / seng ge'i khri bai ḍūr+ya'i ri9 pad+mo'i snying po can dag mngon par sprul nas/ nor bu rin po che'i rgyal po seng ge mdzes pa'i dra 1 )bas yongs su brgyan pa dang / rin po che skar ma'i rgyal mtshan mgo la thogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i lus su byin gyis brlabs nas skyil 11mo krung 12bcas te 'khod do/ /byang dang shar gyi phyogs mtshams 1 kyi 'jig rten gyi 1 khams rgya mtsho sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi pha rol gyis/lha'ajig rten gyi khams sa chen po 17thams cad du mdzes pa'i rin po che 1 37—611

'od zer gyi dra ba rab tu 'gyed pa zhes bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa myi dmyigs pa'i spyanas3)gyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi dbyings su shin tu 'phrul ba'i smon lam zla ba zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang lhan cig tu bcom ldan 'das des gnang nas 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho ②de nas 'phags te/'jig rten gyi khams 'byam klas pa zhu)thams cad rin po che'i khang pa brtsegs pa'i sprin gyis cakun nas khebs par byin gyis brlab pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams 'byam klas pa ༄5)thams cad spos kyi khang pa brtsegs pa'i sprin gyis kun nas khebs par byin gyis brlab pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams 'byam klas pa thams cad bdug spos kyi khang pa brtsegs pa'i sprin gyis kun nas khebs par byin gyis brlab pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams 'byam klas pa57thams cad tsan dan gyi khang pa brtsegs pa'i sprin gyis kun nas khebs par byin gyis brlab pa dang ske/ 'jig rten gyi khams 'byam klas pa 52)thams cad me tog gi khang pa brtsegs pa'i sprin gyis kun nas khebs par byin gyis brlab 97pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams 'byam klas pa the rithams cad rin po che'i khang pa brtsegs pa'i sprin gyis /1kun nas khebs par byin gyis brlab pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams 'byam klas pa 12thams cad rdo rje'i khang pa brtsegs pa'i sprin gyis kun nas khebs par byin gyis brlab shā pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams 'byam klas pachathams cad gser gyi khang pa brtsegs pa'i sprin gyis kun nas khebs par byin gyis brlab pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams 'byam klas pa 8thams cad gos kyi khang pa brtsegs pa'i sprin gyis kun nas khebs par byin gyis brlab 7pa dang /37—612

'jig rten gyi khams 'byam klas pa7thams cad pad+mo'i khang pa gebartsegs pa'i sprin gyis kun nas khebs par byin gyis brlabasngo dpa byed cing / mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang na ba der lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong ste/ 'khor dang bcas pas bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas byang dang shar gyi phyogs mtshams7su brten te/ nor bu rin po che'i khang pa brtsegs pa sgo chos kyi dbyings thams cad la mngon par lta〈de)ba dang / seng ge'i khri rin po che'i rgyal po spos mtshungs pa myed pa'i pad mo'i snying po can dag mngon par sprul nas rin po che'i rgyal po'i ⑥me tog gi dra bas ⑦yongs su brgyan pa dang /rin po che'i rgyal po mdzod sna tshogs kyi dra ba'i cod58)pan bcings pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i lus su byin gyis brlabs nas skyil mo krungs1)bcas te hu spra'akhod do/ /shar dang lho'i〈nyephyogs mtshams72kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi pha rol gyi 'jig rten gyi khams spos kyi sprin gyis brgyan tu pa'i rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa klu dbang gi0stergyal po'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas byang chub sems dpa' 8chos kyi 'od 'phro ⑩ba dang ldan pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho brjod du myed pa'i rdul shin tu phra brwa snyed dang lhan cig tu bcom ldan 'das des gnang nas 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho de nas 'phags te/nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gser gyi kha dog lta bu'i sprin gyis〈nyekun tu khyab par bya ba dang / nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad rin po che kha dog7)mtha' yas pa'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sprin gyis kun tu khyab par bya ba dang / nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i mdzod spu'i 37wa 613

kha dog gi 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 1sprin gyis kun tu khyab par bya ba dang / nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad 5rin po che sna tshogs kyi kha dog lta bu'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sprin gyis kun tu khyab par bya ba dang / nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad pad+mo'i snying po 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sprin gyis kun tu khyab par bya ba dang ske/ nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad nor bu'i rgyal po rin po che'i shing gi yal ga'i dkyil 'khor lta bu'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sprin gyis kun tu ri khyab par bya ba dang / nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor lta bu'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sprin 5gyis kun tu khyab par bya ba dang /nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad 'dzam bu'i chu klung gi gser gyi kha dog lta bu'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sprin gyis kun tu khyab par bya ba dang / nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad nyi ma'i kha dog lta bu'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sprin gyis kun tu khyab par bya ba dang / nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad zla ba dang / skar ma'i tshogs kyi kha dog lta bu'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sprin gyis kun tu khyab par byed cing / mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang na ba der lhags nas bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong ste/ 'khor dang bcas pas bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas/ shar dang lho'i phyogs mtshams 6su brten te/ rin po che rdul dang bral zhing rnam par snang ba phun sum tshogs pa'i me tog gi khang pa brtsegs pa dang / seng ge'i khri rin po che 7seng ge nardo rje'i pad+mo'i snying po can dag mngon par sprul nas nor bu'i rgyal po rin po che'i 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba'i dra bas yongs su brgyan pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i lus su byin gyis brlabs 9nas skyil mo krung 1 bcas te 'khod do/ /lho dang nub kyi phyogs 37—614

mtshams tsho1)kyi 'jig rten gyi du khams rgya mtsho sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi pha rol gyi 'jig rten gyi khams rin po chem nyi ma rab tu snang ba'i snying po zhes bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa chos kyi 'khor lo'i 4)ye shes kun tu snang ba'i rgyal po'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas byang chub sems dpa' bdud kyi dkyilas 'khor thams cad rnam par 'thor ba'i ye shes rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho brjod du med pa'i 6)rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang lhan cig tu bcom ldan 'das des gnang nas/ 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho de nas 'phags te/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas me tog 'od 'phro ba'i sprin nam mkha'i dbyings ltar yangs pa rab tu dgye77)ba dang / ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas rol mo 2)'od 'phro ba'i sprin nam mkha'i dbyings 'odiltar yangs pa rab tu dgye 3 rib dang / ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas nor bu rin po che 3sto'od 'phro ba'i sprin nam mkha'i dbyings ltar yangs pa rab tu dgye 32ba dang /ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas rin po che'i gos 'od 'phro ba'i 12spos dang /bdug spos sna tshogs kyis 1 rirnam par bdugs 15pa'i sprin nam mkha'i dbyings ltar yangs pa rab tu dgye skyab dang / ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas klus rnam par sprul pa'i glog gi hu 'od 'phro ba'i sprin 18nam mkha'i dbyings ltar yangs pa rab tu dgye /)ba dang / ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas nor bu rin po che rnam par snang ba ge )'od 'phro 31ba'i sprin nam mkha'i dbyings ltar yangs pa rab tu dgyes 2ba dang / ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas nor bu rin po che gser rab tu 'bar ba 'od rab tu 32'phro ba'i sprin nam mkha'i dbyings ltar yangs pa rab tu dgye 2 ba dang / ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas rin po che'i rgyal po dpal gyi snying po 37—615

'bar ba 'od 'phro ba'i sprin nam mkha'i0)dbyings ltar yangs pa rab tu dgye7ba dang ske/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas nor busarin po che de bzhin gshegs pa'i dgongs pa rgya mtsho ltar dus gsum gyi rgyud rab tu snang ba'i tshul dang ldan pa'i ④'od 'phro ba'i sprin nam mkha'i dbyings ltar yangs pa rab tu dgye7ba byed cing /myi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang na ba der lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong ste/ 'khor dang bcas pas bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nasal/ lho dang 65nub kyi phyogs mtshamasashes brtenarabate/ nor bu rin po che chen po 'od zer gyi dra ba phyogs kun tumanyamangon par gzhol ba'i thig les chos kyi dbyings thams cad du rab tu snang ba'i khang pa brtsegs pa dang / seng ge'i khri nor bu rin po che spos kyi sgron ma yonye'od 'phro ba'i pad+mo'itsha/nyesnying po can dag mngon par sprul nas/ rin po che'i rgyal po dri ma med pa'i snying po'i7dra bas yongs su brgyan pa dang / rin po che'i rgyal po sems can thams cad rab tu 'dzud pa'i dbyangs dang ldan pa'i cod pan bcings pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i lus su byin gyis brlabs rlonas skyil mo krung 8bcas te 'khod do/ /nub dang byang gi phyogs mtshams sna kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi pha rol gyi 'jig rten gyi khams rnam par snang mdzad kyi snying po zhes bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa dpal gyi ri bo kun nas rnam par snang ba'i rgyal po'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas byang chub sems dpa' rnam par snang ba'i smon lam ye shes dpal zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang lhan cig tu/ bcom ldan 'das des gnang nas 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho de nas 'phags te/37—616

mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po thams cad dang / ba spu'i sgo ①thams cad dang /lus thams cad nas dus gsum du gshegs pa'i⑧de bzhin gegashegs pa thams cad kyi skusnyigazugs brnyan5gegyi sprin kun tu dgyel)ba dang / mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po thams cad dang / ba spu'i sgo thams cad dang / lus thams cad nas dus gsum du byung ba'i /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi lus kyi gzugs brnyanaphanagyi sprin kun tu dgye7)ba dang / mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po thams cad dang / ba spu'i sgo thams cad dang / lus thams cad nas dus gsum du gshegs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi lus kyi gzugs brnyan gyi bosprin kun tu dgyes(gleb dang / mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po thams cad dang / ba spu'i sgo thams cad dang༄shrī/ lus thams cad nas dus gsum du gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sprul pa'i tshogs kyi rtegazugs brnyanamatshamang po'i sprin kun tu dgye7tsheb dang / mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po thams cad dang / ba spu'i sgo thams cad dang / lus thams cad nas dus gsum du gshegs pa'i tshade bzhin gshegs pas3 thams cad kyi (/)sngon gyi sbyor ba'i hurtegazugs brnyan sa )mang po'i sprin kun tu dgye dustob dang /mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po thams cad dang / ba spu'i sgo thams cad dang /lus thams cad nas dus gsum du byung ba'i nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi lus kyi gzugs brnyan ni rab tu dgyes ba dang / mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po thams cad dang / ba spu'i sgo thams cad dang / lus thams cad nas dus gsum du gshegs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi snying po byang chub dang / byang chub kyi shing gi gzugs kyi gzugs brnyan gyi sprin kun tu 37wa 617

dgye ca17ba dang / mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po thams cad dang / ba spu'i sgo thams cad dang / lus thams cad nas dus gsum du gshegs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnam par 'phrul pa'i gzugs brnyan ldumang po'i sprin kun tu dgye ( kyib dang / mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po thams cad dang / ba spu'i sgo thams cad dang / lus thams cad nas dus gsum du byung byujeba'i 'jig rten gyi dbang po thams cad kyi lus kyi gzugs brnyan 45gyi sprin kun tu dgyel5ba dang / mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po thams cad dang / ba spu'i sgo thams cad dang / lus thams cad nas dus gsum du byung 77ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa cir/thams cad kyi gzugs brnyan 49)gyi sprin kun tu dgye bas/ / skad cig skad cig tu nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad rgyas par 'gengs shing mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang na ba der lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong ste/'khor dang bcas pas bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas/ nub dang byang gi phyogs mtshams 11su brten 12te/ rin po che'i rgyal po phyogs kun nas rnam par snang ba'i snying po'i 1 seng ge'i khri rin po che 'gro ba rnam par snang ba'i pad+mo'i snying po can dag mngon par sprul nas mu tig bo'od thub pa med pa'i skad bas yongs su brgyan pa dang / rin po che 'od kun tu snang ba'i cod pan bcings pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i lus su byin gyis brlabs nas skyil mo krung 〉bcas te 'khod dol/ /'og gi phyogs kyi 1 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi ma / rol gyi 'jig rten gyi khams de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'od kyi dkyil 'khor rnam par snang ba zhes bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa ye shes nam mkha' lta bur chags pa med pa'i dpal gyi nyu9rgyal 37wa 618

mtshan rgyal po'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas byang chub sems dpa' bsgribs ①pa thams cad rnam par 'thor ba'i ye shes kyisamatsho nornam par non da pa zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang lhan cig tu bcom ldan 'das des gnang nas 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho de nas 'phags te/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas 'gro ba thams cad kyi skad dang sgra dang dbyangs dang nges pa'i tshig mngon par bsgrub pa rgya mtsho rab tu brjod pa dang / dus gsum gyi byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 'byung ba'i tshul rgya mtsho'i sprin gyi 'brug sgra rab tu bsgrag la pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi smon lam mngon par bsgrub pa'i tshul rgya mcho1re dbyangs rab tu bsgrag ⑤pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa 6)yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i tshul rgya mtsho'i sprin gyi spyisgra rab tu bsgrag 3)pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyod pa'i dkyil 'khor zhing thams cad du 9 rgyas par 'gengs pa'i tshul rgya mtsho'i dbyangs nya rirab tu bsgrag 31pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi yang dag par bsgrub pa dang / rnam par 'phrul pa'i tshul rgya mtsho'i dbyangs rab tu bsgrag nya pa dang ske/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad snying po byang chub tu nyagegashegs pa dang bobadud kyi dkrugs ma rnam par 'thor ba dang / snying po byang chub tu 8rnam par 'tshang rgya ba dang / rnam par 'phrul pa mdzad pa'i dbyangs rgya mtsho rab tu bsgrag pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi 'khor lo 'khor 7ba dang / mdo 1 sde'i tshul dang 1 ming rgya mtsho'i dbyangs kyi sprin gyi 'brug sgra bsgrag 17pa dang / 'gro ba 'dul ba thams cad dus la bab pa'i 'khor los 37wa 619

'dul ba'i chos kyi tshul dang thabs kyi sgra rab tu bsgrag pa dang / ye shes thams cad khong du chud par bya ba'i phyir smon lam ji ltar btab pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba'i 07khyad par dang dus dang thabs dang / chos kyi tshul rgya mtsho'i dbyangs rab tu bsgrag pa tsho byed cing / mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang na ba der lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong ste/ 'khor dang bcas pas55 bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas/ 'og gi phyogs su brtenasate/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gzhal med khang gzugs brnyan〈perab tu snang bas3)rin po che sna tshogs thams cad kyi mdzod kyi57)khang pa brtsegs pa dang / seng ge'i khri rin po che thams cad kyi gzugs kyi pad mo'i shesnying po yongs su bzung ba gedag mngon par sprul nas/ rin po che'i snying po byang chub thams cad kyi gzugs brnyan rab tu snang ba'i rgyal mtshan gyi cod ⑩pan mgo la bcings pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i lus su byin gyis brlabs 3nyanas/ skyil mo krung kyi bcas te 'khod do / /steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi pha rol gyi nyanye'ajig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi rigs mi zad pa shin tu ston pa zhes bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa saye shes kyi dkyil 'khor kun tu snang ba'i dbyangs kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi dbyings kyi smon lam gyi gzhi rab tu rtogs pa zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa' 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang / lhan cig tu bcom ldan 'das des gnang nas/ 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho de nas 'phags te/ mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po thams cad dang ske/ ba spu'i sgo thams cad dang / lus thams cad dang / yan lag dang 37wa 620

nying lag thams cad dang / tshig gi lam thams cad dang / gos dang smad g.yogs ①thams cad nas byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor thams cad dang / bdag dang ②bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad dang / sngon gyi rigumatha'i mur thug pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa 'das pa thams cad dang / phyi ma'i mtha'i mur thug pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa lung bstan pa dang / lung ma bstan palo4)ma byon pa thams cad dang / da ltar byung bamasaphyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'byam klas pa ⑥thams cad na bzhugs pa rnams kyi sngon 6)sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa mdzad pa dang ldan pa'i sngon gyi sbyor ba rgya mtsho dang / len pa dang sbyin pa'i dngos po thams cad kyi gzugs brnyan byamatshan dang dpe byad bzang po dang /ba spu'i sgo dang lus thams cad dang / yan lag dang nying lag dang tshig gi tso lam dang gos dang smad g.yogs7 )thams cad la rab tu snang bar gyur paras37rnam par bstan pa dang tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad dang ldan pa'i sngon gyi sbyor ba rgya mtsho dag kyang rab tu snang bar yongs su bstan pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan par hurteyan lag dang nying lag thams cad 'thub lhapa rab tu bstan pa dang ldan pa'i sngon gyi sbyor ba rgya mtsho rab tu snang bar gyur pa yongs su bstan pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi brtson 'grus dang drag shul dang / rnam par gnon pa dang ldan pa'i sngon gyi sbyor ba rgya mtsho rab tu snang bar gyur pa yongs su bstan pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bsam gtan rgya mtsho yongs su tshol zhing rab tu bsgrub pa dang ldan pa'i sngon gyi sbyor ba rgya mtsho rab tu snang bar gyur pa yongs su bstan pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i tshul yongs su bsgrub 37—621

cing ske/ chos yongs su tshol 17ba dang ldan pa dang / bdog pa thams cad yongs su gtong 2zhing shin tu zhe non pa'i lus dang ngo'i gugazugs brnyan rnam par dmyigs par bya bas sngon gyi sbyor ba rgya mtsho rab tu snang bar gyur pa yongs su bstan pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mthong zhing dga' ba dang /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi lam la 'gro ba thams cad mngon par mos par byed pa dang ldan pa'i sngon gyi sbyor ba rgya mtsho rab tu snang bar gyur pa yongs su bstan pa dang / rki byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi smon lam rgya mtsho mngon par bsgrub 4pa'i sgo yongs su dag pa'i rgyan dang ldan pa'i sngon gyi sbyor ba rgya mtsho rab tu snang bar gyur pa yongs su bstan pa dang char/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi stobs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rab tu grub pa dang / rnam par mnan 6pa dang / rnam par dag par byas pa dang ldan pa'i sngon gyi sbyor ba rgya mtsho rab tu snang bar gyur pa yongs su bstan pa dang / chos kyi dbyings rgya chen po rnam par 'phrul pa thams cad kyi sprin gyis rgyas par bkang ste/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor dang ldan pa'i sngon gyi sbyor ba rgya mtsho rab tu snang bar gyur pa yongs su bstan pa 7byed cing / myi mjed 8)kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang na ba der lhags smyonas/ bcom ldan 'das gang 3 na ba der dong ste/ 'khor dang bcas pas bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas/steng gi phyogs su brten 11te/ rdo rje'i nya dbang po sna tshogs thams cad kyi /lhargyan gyi snying po can gyi khang pa brtsegs pa dang / seng ge'i khri rdo rje dang / yin dra nī 1 la'i pad+mo'i snying po can dag mngon par sprul nas genor bu'i rgyal po rin po che thams cad rab tu 'bar ba'i dra bas kun nas brgyan pa dang / rin po che'i 37wa 622

rgyal po dus gsum gyi08de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshanar dbyangs su sgrog pa'i phreng ba rab tu 'phyang ba dang / mgo la rin po che'i cod pan thogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i )lus su byin gyis brlabs rinas skyil mo krung ri'i bcas te 'khod dol// // sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/6) bam po nyi shu lnga pepa/ byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyang 'khor dang bcas par byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa dang smon lam gyis byung ba (25de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi zhabs kyi drung nas zhal du lta dzoḍaskab/ye shes yongs su dag pa'i myig dang ldan pa de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi 'khor lo dang / mdo sde'i tshul gyi khogasung rgya mtsho la rna ba yongs su gzhol ba/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi dbang rab tu thob par bya ba la / dam pa'i 31pa rol tu bgrod par 12phyin pa'i mchog thob pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi drung du 'dong ba/ skad cig skad cig tu/ yongs su bstan par 12rnam par 'phrul pas byung ba/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad lus gcig gis rgyas par dgang ba'i yul 1 dang ldan pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor du lus tshamangon par 'byung zhing rnam par snang ba/ rdul shin tu phra ba gcig la 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khams gcig tu snang zhing khongs su chud par yang dag par ston pa'i yul tshadang ldan pa 'gro ba thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba dang / 'dul 1 ba'i dus la sdod par gzhol ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi 'khor lo'i sprin gyi 'brug sgra ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas rab tu sgrog pa'i yul dang ldan pa/37wa 623

sems can gyi khams thams cad sgyu ma lta bur yongs su shes pa rab tu thob pa/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cadanyemig yor lta bur khong du chud pa/ srid pa'i rgyud du skye ba thams cad rmi lam lta busashes par7byung ba las dang rnam par smin pa thams cad gzugs brnyan ④lta bur shes pas rnam par dag pa/ ye shes mngon par grub pa thams cad smig rgyu galta bur mngon par shes pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams 'byam klas 0pa thams cad sprul pa lta bur khong du chud pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang ye shes kyi snang ba rab tu thob pa/ myi 'jigs pa'i khyu mchog dang / seng ge'i nga ros rnam par gnon pa/ so sosnyeyang dag par rig 9pa myi zad pa'i rgya mtshor zhugs pa/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi skad rgya mtsho dang 1 / chos kyi nges pa'i tshig gi ye shes rab tu thob pa/ chos kyi dbyings dang 31nam mkha' ltar chags pa myed pa'i ye shes kyi spyod yul dang ldan pal/ chos thams cad la sgrib 8pa med pa'i ye shes rab tu thob pa/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi mngon par shes pa la ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor rnam par dag pa bdud kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad rnam par dkrug pa'i brtson 'grus dang ldan pa/ dus gsum thams cad shes pa'i stobs la rab tu gnas pa/chos thams cad la ye shes sgrib nyi pa med pa rab tu thob pa/ gnas myed pas nam mkha'i spyod yul dang ldan pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i sa len pa myed pa/nam mkha' lta bu'i brtson 'grus dang ldan pa/ srid pa thams cad myi dmyigs pa'i ye shes kyi spyod yul can/ chos kyi dbyings thams cad kyi tshul rgya mtsho la rab tu bozhugs pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad tha myi dad pa'i ye shes kyi sgor zhugs pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad gcig nas gcig tu gzung 37—624

ba'i rnam par 'phrul pas byung banya)/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud〈gethams cad du skyes pa'i lus yongs su ston pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi dbyibs phra ba dang / rgya che ba dang yangs patre0dang / dog pa sna tshogs rab tu rtogs pa shin tu phra zhing ④rgya chen po yang dag par gzud pa'i (nyeyi shes khong du chud pa/dmyigs pa rgya chen po shin tu phra bar shes pa dang ldan pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad dang sems kyi skad cig la 'grogs pa rab tu thob pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyi rlabs9)kyi ye shes kyi lus dang ldan pa/ phyogs rgya mtsho thams cad du mgo rmongs pa myed pa'i ye shes rab tu thob pashesems kyi skad cig gis phyogs rgya mtsho thams cad du rnam par 'phrul pas rgyas par 'gengs pa sha stag ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs ri kyis de lta bu'i yon tan tshad myed pa dang ldan pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sha stag gis dze tso/ta'i tshal thams cad yongs su rgyas par gyur kyang / nyan thos chen po sham7ri'i bu dang / mo'u dgal thenagyi bu dang 'od srungasal chen po dang / nam 'gru nyusnyedang / rab 'byor dang ske/ 'gag myed dang / mos pa dang / ka t+ya'i gebu dang / byams gang gi bu la stsogs (nyepas dze〈rteta'i tshal na 'khod bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa de dag ma mthong ngo / /sangs rgyas kyi bkod pa de dag dang /sangs rgyas kyi khyu mchog gi mthu dang / sangs rgyas kyi rnam par rol pa dang /sangs rgyas kyi cho 'phrul dang / sangs rgyas kyi mnga' chen po dang / sangs rgyas sbyong ba'i〈 7rnam par 'phrularwa pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi mthu dang / sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs (rjedang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa yang ma mthong ngo / /byang chub sems dpa'i yul bsam gyis myi khyab pa de dag dang /37—625

byang chub sems dpa' kun nas 'ongs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' kun nas 'dus pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' kun nas tshogs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' nye bar 'ongs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i7rnam par 'phrul pa nadang / byang chub sems dpa'i cho 'phrul dang / byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi ri dkyil 'khor dang / byang chub sems dpa'i phyogs su 'khod pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i seng ge'i khri bkod pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i khang pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par spyod pa dang /byang chub sems dpa'i ting ngesame'adzin gyis rnam par rtsesab dang / byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par lta ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par bsgyings pa dang byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par gnon pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i de bzhin gshegs pa mchod pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i lung bstan pa dang /byang chub sems dpa'i yongs su smin par gyur pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sngon du 'dor ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i chos kyi lus rnam par dag pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ye shes kyi lus yongs su rdzogs pa dang /byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam gyi lus rnam par dmyigs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i gzugs kyi lus yongs su grub pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i mtshan phun sum tshogs pa yongs su dag pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i 'od kyi dkyil 'khor kha dog mtha' 6)yas pa'i bkod pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i 'od zer gyi dra ba rab tu 'gyed pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sprul pa'i sprin kun tu 'gyed pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i7phyogs kyi dra ba rgyas par 'gengs pa 9dang / byang chub sems dpa'aspyo )spyod pa'i dkyil 'khor rnam 37—626

par sprul pa yang ma mthong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ dge ba'i rtsa ba myi mtshungs pa'i phyir te/ de dag gis ni sngon sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa mthong ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ma bstsags 33so/ /de dag la ni sngon sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams su gtogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi yon tan dang / bkod pa h+phuyongs su dag pa yang dag par bstan pa mas —nomadzad do/ /de dag la ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis byasangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa yang dag parasnyibarjod pa ma mdzad do/ /de dag gis 46)ni sngon 'khor ba na 3)'khor ba'i tshe sems can rnams/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yang dag par bskul ba ma byas so/ /de dag gis ni gzhan gyi sems kyi rgyud la byang chub tu sems nibaskyed pa rab tu bzhag pa ma byas so/ /de dag gis 3)ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdung rgyun the )myi gcod 31pa'i phyir zhugs pa ma yin no/ /de dag gis tsho/rteni sems can thams cad yongs su bsdu ba'i phyir brtson pa ma yin no//de dag gis ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams pha rol tu phyin pa la yang dag par bskul ba ma byas so/ /de dag gis ni sngon 'khor ba na 'khor ba'i tshe/ 'gro ba thams cad las khyad par du 'phags pa'i ye shes kyi sa la dmigs pa 3lham byas so//de dag gis ni thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du 'gyur ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba nye bar bstsags 8pa ma byas so/ /de dag gis ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su ma bsgrubs so/ /de dag gis ni sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa thams cad du rnam par 'phrul pa'i mngon par shes pa khong du ma chud do/ /de dag gis ni byang chub sems dpa'i 15mig gi lam gyis 937—627

rnam par dmigs par bya ba 'jig rten las 'das pa thun mong ma yin pa'i byang chub tu dmigs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam chen po las byung ba khong du ma chud do/ /nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kun gyis ni byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i ye shes gyi mig gi lam gyis0)rnam par dmigs pa thun mong ma yin pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabasakhulas byung ba'i sgyu ma'i rnam pa'i chos nyid kyisasagrub pa/ byang chub sems dpa' 'du shes sna tshogs yongs su 'dzin pasabyin gyis rlobalgepa/ byang chub sems dpa'i dga'akhuba'i shugs chen po rnam par 'phel bar byed pa khong du ma chud do/ /de bas na nyan thos chen po mchog gi zung50dang / bzang po'i zung la sogs7pa de dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa de mi mthong ngo7) / /myi thos57so/ /mi shes so/ /khong du mi chud do/ /mi rtogs so/ /mi rig go/ /yid mi ches sol/ /mi sems so/ /rnam par mi lta'ohunye/ /rtogs par mi lta'o13/ /nges par mi sems sotsha/ /nye bar mi sems so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni sangs rgyas kyi spyod yul te nyan thos kyi spyod yul ma yin no/ /de bas na nyan thos chen po de dag dze mata'i tshal de nyid na 'khod kyang 8/ sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa de dag mi mthong stohu tsho/ de dag la de dang mthun 32pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba med do/ /de dag gis sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa de dag mthong du de lta bu'i ye shes kyi myig rnam par ma dag go/ /dmyigs pa chung ngu la rgya chen po'i byin gyi〈rtenabs kyis 'jug tu ting nge 'dzin de lta bu med do/ /de dag shes pa dang / blta ba'amakha mo khong du chud par bya ba'am/ rtogs par bya ba'am/ rgyas par dgang par bya ba'am/ 'jug par bya ba'am/ rnam par blta 37ba'am/37wa 628

nyams su myong bar bya ba'am/ gnan pa'am/ rnam par gnan ①pa'am/gzhan gyis thos par bya ba'am/ bstan par bya ba'am/ smos par bya ba'am/yang dag par bstan par bya ba'am/ bstabs〈kyepar bya ba'am/ sbyin par bya ba'am / de la sems can rnams yongs su bskul bar bya ba'am/ sbyar bar bya ba'am/ rab tu dgodashepar bya ba'am/ sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa'i chos nyid la sems can dgod par byarashogeyang de dag la de lta bu'i rnam par thar pa med do/ /de lta bu'i rdzu 'phrul med do/ /de lta bu'i khyu mchog gi mthu med do//de lta bu'i stobs med do/ / de lta bu'i dbang med dzo/ /de lta bu'i gnas med do/ /de lta bu'i 'du shes med do/ /de lta bu'i myig gi mthu med do/ /de lta bu'i ye shes med do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de dag ni de ltar nyan thos kyi theg pas byung ba nyan thos kyi lam gyis yongs su grub pa/ nyan thos kyi spyod pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa/ nyan thos kyi 'bras bu la gnas pa/bden pa snang ba shes pas nges par rtogs rtsipa/ yang dag pa'i mtha' la gnas pa / shin tu zhi ba'i mthar thugaporipa/ snying rje chen po'i bsam pa med pa(1)/'jig rten gyi khams thams cad la myi lta mi sdod pa/ rang gi don grub pa dag ste / de dag ni dze〈nyeta'i tshal de nyid du kun nas 'dus te 'khod la/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga dang g.yas g.yon 3rnyedang / snam logs 3lhen bcom ldan 'das la mngon du lta bar gnas kyang / dze mita'i tshal der sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa de dag mthong bar ma gyur to/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shesasnyiyang dag par ma bsgrubasalgepa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes yang dag par ma bsdus pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la 37—629

yang dag par ma zhugs pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la smon lam yang dag par ma btab pas1dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes mngon par ma bsgrubs napa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes yongs su ma bsgoms7pa dang ske/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes ma sbyangs pa de dag gis ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rnam/ par 'phrul pa de la 'jug cing rtogs par bya ba'am / blta zhing khong du chud par bya bar myi nus so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/de ni byang chub sems dpa' 4rigs dang ldan pa rnams kyi myig gi lam gyis byu ltabalta ba yin gyis / nyan thos kyi myig gis 7blta ba ma yin no/ /de bas na nyan thos chen po de dag dze nasata'i tshal de nyid na 'khod kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' she)kun nas 'dus pa yang mthong bar ma gyur to/ /de'ang 'di lta ste dper na/ gang gā'i chu klung chen po'i ngogs pha rol tshur 11rol du yi dgas 12bkres pa dang / skom pas rab tu mnar 1 ba gcer ba 1 tshogos myed pa/ lus kyi mdog dang kha dog tshig cing 'jum pa 7rlung dang nyi mas bskams pa/ bya rog mang pos gtse ba/ spyang ki dang / was tho btsams pas/ brgya stong mang po kun nas 'dus kyang / gang gā'i 1 chu klung chen po myi mthong ste/ sgrib pa'i las kyis bsgribs 38pa'i phyir la las ni bskams 19te chu med par mthong ngo / /la las ni thal bas yongs su gang bar mthong ngo / /de bzhin du nyan thos chen po gnas brtan de dag dze 3 sduta'i tshal de nyid na 'khod kyang thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang myi mthun 21pa'i phyogs ma rig pa'i ling tog na gis myig kun nas khebs 2pa dang / thams cad 37wa 630

mkhyen pa nyid kyi sa'i (11dge ba'i rtsa ba'i mthus yongs su ma bzung ba'i phyir/de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa de dag ma mthong ma shes so/ /'di lta ste dper na 'dun mas chen po 'dus pa'i skye bo mang po'i54)dbus su myi la la zhig gnyid kyis〈༄myos te/ log par gyur nas de gnyid kyis log pa'i rmyi lam du gnas yide nyid na lha'i grong rdal me brgya byin gyi gnas blta na mdzes pa dang /ri rab kyi steng shing dang bcas pa/ bza' shing gi rinaskur ba'i 'khor dang bcas pa / lha'i bu mo bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gis gang ba/ lha'i bu khrag khrig brgya phrag stong snyed gnas pa 9)lha'i me tog sna tshogs kyis nyi yongs su gang ba dang /yid bzhin gyi shing lha rdzas kyi gos dang mu tig gi phreng ba dang / rin po che'i rgyan dang / se mo do sna tshogs mang po 'byin pa dang / lha rdzas kyi sil snyan rnam pa sna tshogs rlung gis yongs su bskyod cing sgra dbyangs yid du 'ong la snyan 31pa 'byin pa'i sil snyan gyi shing mang po dang / dga' ba'i rtsed mo'i 32bkod pa rnam pa sna tshogs mthong bar gyur la/ lha'i bu mo mang pos glu blangs pa dang /lha rdzas kyi rol mo byas pa'i sgra yid du 'ong zhing snyan pa thos par gyur tenyurta/bdag nyid kyang de na 'dug pa snyam byed la/ lha rdzas kyi bkod pas klubs pa'i gnas de dag thams cad mthong bar gyur kyang / skye bo'i tshogs mang po de dag gis gnas de nyid na 'khod bzhin du myi mthong / mi 'ashes/ khong du mi chud do / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni skyes bu gnyid kyisama'ilog pa de nyid kyi skyi lam gyis blta ba yin gyi/ gnas de nyid na 'khod kyang skye bo mang po de dag gis blta ba ma yin no/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' de dag dang / 'jig rten gyi dbang po byang chub la mngon par mos pa de dag sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi sarlabs 37—631

rgya chen po dang / rang gi dge ba'i rtsa ba'i stobs ma nor bar shin tu bstsagasatupa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du smon lam shin tu mngon par bsgrubasashepa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan thams cad la shin tu zhugs pa dang /byang chub sems dpa'i lam bkod pa chen po dang ldan pa la shin tu gnas pa dang ske/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi chos nyid dang / yan lag rnam pa thams cad du shin tu rdzogs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa'i khyad par dang / smon lam yongs su rdzogs par bya ba rnam par dag pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sa thams cad kyi ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor yongs su gnon nga dpa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis rnam par spyod pa thams cad la rnam par rtse ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ye shes kyi spyod yul thams cad la chags pa myed par rnam par spyod pas bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i sangs rgyas kyi khyu mchog gi mthu phyung ba de dag dang / sangs rgyas kyi rnam par rol pa de dag mthong zhing khong du chud la byanyams su myong bar gyur kyang /nyan thos chen po mchog gi zung dang / bzang po'i zung la stsogasalgepa de dag la byang chub sems dpa'i myig myed pas mthong bar ma gyur shes par ma gyur to/ /'di lta ste dper na/ ri'i rgyal po kha ba can sman gyi 'byung gnas kyis gang ba la sngags 7dang / rig sngags dang / sman gyi tshul dang / blang ba'i rgyus shes shing rig tshon sngags grub pa'i skyes bu gnas pa/ sman gyi cho ga thams cad shes pa sman blang ba'i las byed kyang / ri bo'i dbang po de nyid la gnas pa'i phyugs dang ske/ ba lang dang ra lug 'tsho ba dang / rngon pa dang de ma yin pa'i myi sman gyi tshul myi shes pa gzhan dag gis( )/ sman de dag gi cho ga dang / sman gyi ro 37—632

dang mthu dang yon tan dang byin dang / thabs dang 'phrod pa mi shes so/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi yul la zhugs pa byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par 'phrul pa'i yul gyis7byung ba/ de dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rnam par 'phrul pa'i yul de dag mthong yang nyan thos chen po mchog gi zung dang / bzang po'i zung la stsogasalgepa rang gi dgos pas tshim par gyur pa/ gzhan gyi dgos pa yal bar gzhog ③pa/btang snyoms can de dag dze ta'i tshal de nyid na gnas kyang / tshe 'di la bde bar spyod pas bde zhing dga' bar gnas pa las phar de bzhin gshegs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rnam par 'phrul pa'i yul de dag khong du mi chud rga/ /'di lta ste dper na/ sa chen po rin po che thams cad kyi 'byung gnas phun sum tshogs pa / gter brgya stong du mas gang ba rin po che sna tshogs rnam pa tha dad pas yongs su gang ba 'di la'ang rin po che'i 'byung gnas dang / gter gyi rgyus la mkhas shing byang ba'i myi rin po che brtag pa'i gtsug lag gis7blo shin tu byang ba gter gyi gtsug lag dang rgyus dang / dan57rtags gya gnom par lobasalgepa/bsod nams rgya chen po'i stobs kyis brtan pa mdag de las rin po che ci 'dod par blangs shing / bdag kyang yongs su tshim par byed/ pha dang ma la'angarwatelegs par rim gro /tshonyebyed/ bu pho smos kyang legs par gso bar byed cing / de ma yin pa'i sems can rgan pa hu dang / na ba dang / dbul ba dang / nyam nyes pa dang / kha zas dang / gos kyis myi 'byor pa rnams la sdud micing khyab78par bgosnyibasha' byed la3 rme/ nor gyi〈snyedaga' ba sna tshogs nyams su myong bar byed kyang / sems can rin po che'i 'byung gnas dang / gter gyi〈pergyus myi 37—633
