shes pa bsod nams ma byas pa/ rin po che la shes pa'i myig yongs su ma dag pa/de dag nyid na 11'khod kyang / rin po che'i 'byung gnas de dag⑧dang rin po che'i gter de dag khong du myi chud myi shes pas rin po che'ang blang du myed do/ /rin po che'i don kyang byar med do/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa'i yul bsam gyis myi khyab pa la sheye shes kyi myig shin tu rnam par dag pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi yul bsam gyis myi khyab pa la ④zhugs pa/ de dag dze sata'i tshal na 'khod cing sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa de dag mthong la chos kyi tshul rgya mtsho la 'jug cing ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya yongs su sgrub ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yimachod pa dang / rim gro la brtson zhing dam pa'i chos yongs su gzung 47)ba la mngon par brtson te/ bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis sems can de dag yongs su sdud kyang / nyan thos chen po de dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa de dag dang / byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs chen po kun nas 'dus pa de lta bu'ang ma mthong ma shes so/ /'di lta ste dper na/ skyes bu la la zhig myig gnyis gos kyis ri bkab ste/ rin po che'i gling du phyin par gyur na/ des rin po che'i gling der phan tshun 'gro ba dang ske/ 'greng ba dang 'dug pa dang nyal ba byas kyang rin po che'i 'byung gnas de (myi mthong ngo / /rin po che'i shing dang gos kyi rin po che dang / spos kyi〈 )rin po che dang / rin po che thams cad kyang myi mthong la/ rin po che de dag gi spyod yul lam/ rin 11thang ngam/ yongs su spyod nyu pa'i rgyus kyang mi shes pas / de ni rin po che de dag len kyang myi len la/ rin po che'i don kyang nyams su myong bar myi byed do/ /gang gi myig la bsgribs hunyepa med pa de dag gis 37—634

ni de dag thams cad mthong zhing shes so/ /de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa' chos rin po che'i gling chen por phyin pa de dag gis bla na med pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa7rin po che7'jig rtenang ci thams cad kyi rgyan du gyur pa mngon du gyur te / dze geta'i tshal na bzhugs shing sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa bsam gyis myi khyab pa ⑤yongs su ston pa mthong yang nyan thos chen po de dag /de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhabs kyi drung de nyid na gnas shing spyod kyang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi yul rnam par 'phrul pa'i cho 'phrul de dag ma mthong ngo / /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs mang po de lta bu'i rin po che'i 'byung gnas chen po yang mthong bar ma gyur to/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi khyu mchog gi mthu phyung ba dang / cho 'phrul 6bsam gyis myi khyab pa de dag ltar ④thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dang mi mthun 3pa'i phyogs kyi ma rig pa'i gos kyis ye shes kyi mig bkab pa/ de dag la byang chub sems dpa'i ye shes kyi mig yongs su dag pa de lta bu med do/ /de dag gis chos kyi dbyings gcig nas gcig tu brgyud du pa la 'jug pa de lta bu khong du ma nyi mchud do/ /'di lta ste dper na/ myig yongs su dag pa rdul dang bral bas rab tu snang ba dang ldan pa zhes bya ba 31rab rib dang / mun pa thams cad dang mi 'grogs pa yod de / de myi la la zhig gis /tsho thob par gyur na/ de rdul dang bral bas rab tu snang ba dang ldan pa'i mig yongs su dag pa dang ldan pas mtshan mo mun pa'i mun nag shin tu gnag par gyur pa'i nang na sems can bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong kun nas 'dus pa dang / cho ga nya dang spyod lam rnam pa sna tshogs dang ldan zhing mun pa'i rab rib kyis myig yongs su 'khrugs 3 par gyur pa dmyi'i khrod na 'dug cing 37—635

rnam par rgyu la phan tshun 'gro ba dang / 'greng ba dang spyod lam rnam pa sna tshogs kyis spyod kyang mi de dag gis skyes bu spyod lam sna tshogs kyi7spyod pa de mi mthong myi shes so/ /skyes bu des ni 'gro ba'i tshogs chen po spyod lam dang cho gsasna tshogs kyis zhurnam par spyod pa/ phyogs tha dad du mngon par bltas pa/dbyibs kyi rnam pa tha dad pa kha dog gi rnam pasatha dad pa dmigs pa'i tshul tha dad pa thams cad kyang mi mthong ba med do/ /de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi 'khor mnga' ba/ rnam par dag cing chags pa mi mnga' ba'i spyan dang ldan pas 'jig rten thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs te/sangs rgyas kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi rnam par 'phrul pa dang cho 'phrul chen po bstan pa mdzad kyang / nyan thos chen po de dag gis ⑤de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes dang ting nge 'dzin gyis rnam par sprul pa'i cho 'phrul chen po de dag mthong bar ma gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa'50chen po'i tshogs chen po de lta bu yang mthong bar ma gyur to/ /'di lta ste dper na/ dge slong la la zhig skye bo mang po'i tshogs kyi dbus su sas khyab pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pa'amatho/chus khyab pa'am/ mes khyab pa'am/ rlung gis khyab pa'am/ sngon pos khyab pa'am / ser pos khyab pa'am/ dmar pos khyab pa'ayoshe/ dkar pos khyab pa'am / lhas khyab pa'am/ sems can sna tshogs kyi lus kyis khyab pa'am/ sgra dang rtso)dbyangs kun gyis 1 khyab pa'am/ dmigs pa thams cad kyis hu)khyab pa'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs na 'gro ba mang po'i tshogs de dag gis5)chu'i phung po de mi mthong ngo / /me'i snang ba de yang mi mthongatsha/nyengo / /sems can sna tshogs kyi lus kyis khyab pa dang / dmigs pa thams cad kyisashekhyab pa'i bar 37—636

du yang mi mthong ste/ ting nge 'dzin de la snyoms par zhugs shing rnam par spyod pa rnams ni ma gtogs so/ /de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pas sangs rgyas kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi7yul gyi rnam par sprul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa de dag yongasari su bstan pa mdzad na nyan thos chen po de dag gis tsho mthong zhing shes par ma gyur te/byang chub sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs pa'i lam la zhugs pa de dag gis ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i yul de dag mthong ngo / /khong du chud do/ /'di lta ste dper na/ bsku ba grubalgepa'i myi ni mig gnyis bskus ma thag tu/ skye bo mang po thams cad kyis7lus mi mthong ngo / /des ni 'gro'um 'dug gam/ 'greng yang rung ste/ 'gro bsnyemang po thams cad mthong ngo / /de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten las 'das pa tho'agro ba thams cad kyi yul las yongs su 'das pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi yul du zhugs pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i ye shes kyi mig gisasheshes par bya ba des 'gro ba thams cad gzigs kyang nyan thos chen po de dag gisakede bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa de dag matumathong ngo / /'di lta ste dper na/ myi'i tsher 'grogs pa'i lha rtag tu rjes su 'brang ba ni/ des myi de mthong yang myis lha de mi mthong ngo / / de bzhin du lha ༵de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi yul la zhugs pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kun nas 'dus pa chen po'i dbus su sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa chen po yongs su bstan pa mdzad kyang / nyan thos chen po de dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa dang / cho 'phrul chen po dang byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil huma'akhor gyi rnam par 'phrul pa de dag kyang ma mthong ngo7)/ /ma shes so/ /'di lta ste nyi dper na/ dge slong 37—637

sems can 37thams cad la dbang gi dam pa'i gepha rol tu bgrod par phyin pa'i mchog thob pa ri'adu shes dang tshor ba 'gog gepa la snyoms par zhugs pa ni shes pa med la tshor ba med pas dbang po drug gis gekyang bya ba gang yang nyams su mi myong ste/ mya ngan las 'das pa'ang ma yin la 'jig rten gyi tha snyad 3)thams cad gnas de 7yod kyang snyoms par zhugs pa de nyid kyi byin gyi rlabs gedang mthus des mi shes myi mthong ngo / /de bzhin du nyan thos chen po de dag dze sputa'i tshal de na'ang rnam par spyod la de dag la 3 byedabang po drug kyang yod de/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rnam par 'phrul pa dang khyu mchog gi mthu phyung ba dang / cho 'phrul 31de dag mthong bar ma gyur/ khong du chud par ma gyur shes par ma gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa'i cho 'phrul chen po de dag dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par 'phrul pa de dag kyang khong du ma chud ma mthong ma shes so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sangs rgyas kyi yul ni zab cing yangs la tshad med de/ blta bar dka' zhing rtogs par dka' ste/ khong du chud par dka' la 'jig rten thams cad las yongs su 'das pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi yul ni bsam gyis mi khyab sna ste/ nyan thos dang / rang tunyesangs rgyas thams cad kyis 1 mi 'dus pa'o/ /de bas na nyan thos chen po de dag dze cheta'i tshal de nyid na 'khod cing / bcom ldan 'das kyi 15zhabs kyi drung na spyod kyang sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa de dag dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs chen po de dag kyang ma mthong ngo / /dze 1 ta'i tshal 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rnam par dag pa'i yon tan dang / rgyan 18yongs su 'dus pa de dag kyang 19ma mthong ma shes te tsho/ de ni snod 1du ma gyur pa'i phyir ro/ /de 37wa 638

nas byang chub sems dpa' rnam par snang mdzad kyi 1smon lam gyi gtsug gi 'od zer rab tu snang bas sangs rgyas kyi byin gyiston rlabs kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pasa'adi dag smras so/ /ltos shig sems can dam pa yi ni/ /sangs rgyas byang chub bsam myi khyab/ /rgyal bas sangs rgyas rnam 'phrul pa/ dze ta'i rgyal mtshan 'dirakhebastan to/ /rang byung rnams kyi byin gyi 6 rlabs/ /bgrang du med par 'byung ba la/ /sangs rgyas chos tshul mi shes pa'i/ /'jig rten kun kyang mgo rmongs sotho/ /chos kyi rgyal po'i cho 'phrul dag /tshad med bsam gyis mi khyab cing / /shin tu zab pa 'byung ba na ni/ /de la 'jig rten 'bab 59 mi nus / /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kha dog mdog /mtshan gyis shin tu rnam par klubs / /yang dag sangs rgyas bskyed pa yis/rte/ /chos rab de dag mtshan nyid med / /rnam 'phrul mtha' dang dbus myed la11/ /tshig gi lam gyis brjod 12dka' ba'i/ /rnam 'phrul shin tu zab pa dag /rgyal bas dze 1 ta'i tshal du bstan / /rgyal sras bdag nyid che ba'i rnams/ /zhing rnams bsam yas bye ba nas / /rgyal ba'i zhal ltar mos dga' ste/ /kun nas 'dus pa'i tshogs la ltos / /smon lam yongs su phun sum tshogs/ /spyod sgolam spyod pa chags med pa / /de dag bsam pa shes par ni/ /'jig rten kun gyis mi nus so/ /de dag sems dang spyod yul dang / /spyod pa dag kyang nyan thos dang / /rang rgyal thams cad yongs kyis kyang / /rnam pa kun tu shes mi nus/ /rgyal sras shes rab chen podza8rnams/ /gzhan gyis thub dka' pham byed 15la/ /dpa' ba'i rgyal mtshan ma 'dres shing / /ye shes sa la gzhol gyur pa/ /ting 'dzin dpag tu tshad med la/ /grags 1 chen mnyam par gzhag pa 1 rnams/ /chos dbyings 37wa 639

thams cad rgyas bkang zhing / /rnam par 'phrul pa kun kyang ston/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' thub par dka' ba'i brtson 'grus kyi shugs kyi rgyal pos sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi grarlabs kyis/ phyogs bcur rnam par bltas nas/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /bsod nams snying po shes rab che/ /byang chub spyod pa'i tshul rtogs shing / /'jig rten kun la bde byed pa'i/ /bde gshegs sku las skyes pa ltos/ /yid gzhungs blo gros mtha' yas shing / /shin tu mnyam gzhagashesems ldan pa/ /mtha' dang dbus med zab pa yi ye shes rgya chen spyod yul can/ /rgyan rab mang pos mdzes byas pa'i/ /dzesata'i nags tshal rgya che ba/ /byang chub sems dpas kun rgyas shings/ /bde gshegs bzhugs pa'i gnas gyur pa⑥/ /gnas med mi gnas gyur pa7rnams/ /phyogs rnams bcu nas ⑧kun 'dus te/ /pad+mo'i stan la 'khod pa dag /rgya mtsho mang la blta spurib gyis/ /gnas myed len pa med pa rnams/ /spros pa med cing myi rten la/ /rdul bral chags pa'i sems med pa/ /chos kyi dbyings la gzhol ba dang / /ye shes rgyal mtshan5merab dpa' ba/ /rdo rje'i sems ni mi g.yo zhing / /grub pa med pa'i chos rnams la/ /mya ngan 'da' bar gang ston pa / /phyogs bcu'i zhing mang bye brwanyernams/ /grangs kyis7phyi chod kun nas 'dus / /yang dag sangs rgyas drung du lhags/ /gnyis kyi 'du shes rnam par spangs / /rang 'byung shākya seng ge nam/ /rnam par 'phrul pa 'di dag mthong / /de yi byin rlabs dam pa a8/ /byang chub sems dpa' 'di dag lhags/ /sangs rgyas chos la 'byedam pa med/ /chos dbyings gzhi la'ang de bzhin te/ / tha snyadamo/ tshotsam du yongs 'byed pa'i/ /pha rol phyin pal rgyal ba'i sras/ /chos 37—640

kyi dbyings la dbyer med pa'i/ /mtha' la thug pa7de dag gnas/ /tshig rnams yongs su zad med pas/ /chos la dbye ba'ang rab tu byed②/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa'arnyukun nas 'phags pa'i gzi brjid rgyal pos/ sangs rgyas kyi byin gyiḍūrlabs kyis phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /ltos shig sems can dam pa yi/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor shin tu yangs/ /dus dang dus myin mkhyen mdzad cing / /sems can rnams la chos kyang ston/ /mu stegs ldan pasatshogs 'dus pa'i/ /rgol ba thams cad rab tu 'joms⑥/ /sems can bsam pa ji bzhin du/ /rnam par 'phrul pa yongs su ston/ /phyogs na mi bzhugs bde gshegs rnams/ /sangs rgyas yul gyi rjes mi7bzhud/ /tshad med pa dang tshad yod las2/ /thub pa chen po 'das pa myin/ /nyi ma mkha' las 'gro ba ni/ /nyin par 'grangs pa smos pa byed⑨/ /de bzhin mkhyen pas mkhas ston pa/ /dus gsum chags pa med pas brjod / /zla ba nya ba'i mtshan mo la/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'phags par snang //de bzhin chos dkar yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /mgon mapo rnams kyang mthong ba yin(me / /bar snang nam mkha'i dbyings 'di las(2/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rgyu ba ni8/ /gar yang thogs pa med par 'gro/ /sangs rgyas rnam 'phrul de bzhin no / /ji ltar nam mkha'i phyogs rnams kyi/ /zhing rnams kun la mi gnas pa/ /de bzhin 'jig rten sgron ma yi/ /sangs rgyas rnamarwanye'aphrul shes par bya ji ltar sa ni 'jig rten na/ /lus can kun gyi gnas yin pa / /'jig rten sgron ma'i 'jig rten na/ /chos kyi 'khor lo de ltar gnas/ /ji ltar rlung ni chags med par/ / mkha' las tsomagyogs par rab rgyu ba/ /de bzhin sangs 37—641

rgyas chos nyid kyang / /'jig rten khams su rab tu rgyu/ /ji ltar chu yi phung po la / /zhing rnams 'grangs 1pa kun gnas pa/ /de bzhin dus gsum sangs rgyas kyang / /ye shes tshogs la rab tu gnas/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' dpal gyi snying po chags pa med pa'i rgyal pos/ sangs rgyas kyi byin gyitshunarlabs kyis phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras sol/ /ji ltar rdo rje'i ri dang 5brag /zang yag geshin tu mtho yod pa/ /dkeltar 'jig rten kun skyob pa'i/ /sangs rgyas mngon par 'phags pas mtho/ /ji ltar rgya mtsho'i chu chen dag /tshad med rnyog pa med pa ltar/ /sangs rgyas mthong ba'ang de bzhin te/ /'jig rten kun gyi skom pa gcod/ /rgya mtsho'i7chu las 'phags pa yi/ /ri bo ri rab ci 'dra ba / /de bzhin 'jig rtenamari sgron ma yang / /chos kyi mtsho ri9las mngon par 'phags/ /rin chen kun gyi 'byung gnas kyis/ /rgya mtsho rgyas pa ji bzhin du/ /rang byung ye shes de bzhin te/ /mi zad skad cig rab 1 rimakhyen panyu1/ /mgon po'i ye shes shin tu zab/ /tshad med de bzhin bgrang du myed/ /de bas sangs rgyas rnam 'phrul pa/ /bsam gyis myi khyab tshad med ston/ /sgyu ma'i mtshan nyid ston pa yi/ /sgyu mkhan mkhas pa ji lta 12ba/ /de ltar sangs rgyas mkhyen dbang yang / /rnam par 'phrul pa rab tu ston/ /yid bzhin nor bu rnam dag pa/ /bsam don rdzogs byed ji lta ba / /de bzhin bsam pa dag pa la/ /rgyal ba smon lam rdzogs pa mdzad/ /'od snang gsal ba byed pa yi/ /rin chen rnam snang ji lta ba/ /de ltar thams cad mkhyen pa dag1da /'gro ba'i bsam pa gsal bar mdzad/ /ji ltar phyogs la mngon lta ba'i1 / /rin chen zur brgyad rab gnas pa/ /de bzhin chags 37—642

med sgron ma yang / /chos dbyings rab tu snang ba mdzad/ /chu 'dang pho rin chen 'od gsal ba/ /ji ltar dri med chu 'dang ri byed/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas mthong bas kyang / /'gro ba'i dbang po dag par 'gyur/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi dbyings su smon lam rab tu 'phrul ba'i zla ba'i rgyal pos/sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyisamasaphyogs bcur rnam par bltas te/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /phyogs 'di yin dra nī la yi ri/ /kha dog mdog gcig⑧byas pa ltar/ /sangs rgyas mthong bas skye dgu rnams/ /de bzhin byang chub mdog tu 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas rdul phran re re la/ /rnam par 'phrul pa sna tshogs rnams/ /tshad kyis 6rigazhal du med pa nyaston/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnam dag mdzad/ /de ni rmad byung shin tu zab/ /mtha' yas bsgrub paramachadaka' ba ste/ /blo ldan ye shes yul de la/ /'jig rten rnams ni 'bab mi nus/ /byang chub sems dpa' bsgrub don du/ / bkod pa po/phun sum tshogs pa dang / /sangs rgyas tshul gyis rnam sbyangs pa'i/ /chos kyi dbyings la 'jug pa ston/ /sangs rgyas zhing rnams bsam 1 /yas pa/ /blo ldan bskor ba'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /kun nas gang bar gyur pa yang / /rgyal ba de la ston pa mdzad/ /chos kun mnga' sgyur ston pa ste/ /shā 11kya'i khyu mchog skyes par gyur rte/ /de yi cho lha 'phrul tshad med pa / /'di dag rab 35tu byung ba yin//brtan pa'i spyod pa sna tshogs rnams/ /tshad med rnam par gzigs gyur tshanas/ /rnam par 'phrul pa mtha' yas pa/ /tshad med gzi can ston pa mdzad/ /'jig rten mgon po rgyal sras rnams/ /chos kyi dbyings la slob pa mdzad/ /chos rnams thams cad yongs la yang / /chags med ye shes spyod yul 'gyur1 / /37—643

skyes bu0)dbang po'i byin rlabasam47kyis/ /cho 'phrul brgya dang rab ldan zhing / /'jig rten thams cad rnam spyod pa'i/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskoral/ /sems can gtso bo'i yul la yang / /ye shes dkyil 'khor yongs sbyongs shing / /shes rab chen po'i klu chen rnams/ /'jig rten thams cad 'grel bar 'gyur/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi don gyi blo gros gzi brjid rgyal pos/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad ④pa 'di dag smras so/ /drang srong dam pa'i mchog rnams kyi/ /dus gsum nyan thos gang byung ba/ /de dag kun gyis bde gshegs kyi⑦/ /gshegs thabs 'jog 'degamatho)mi shes sonya/ /dus gsum ma lus thams cad kyi//ma nor rang rgyal gang byung ba/ /de dag gis kyang mgon po yi/ /gshegs thabs 'jog 'deg tu)mi rig go/ /ma rig mun pas bsgribs pa rnams/ /khyi ltar stong tshal rgyus 37pa yi/ /sems can de 'dra kun gyis ni/ /mgon po myi shes smos mi dgos/ /rgyal ba tshad mas gzhal ba myin/ /de ni shes par mi nus te / /sangs rgyas chags med ye shes can/ /tshig gi lam las shin tu 'das/ /zla ba nya rgyas 'od mnga' ba/ /brtan pa mtshan gyis rnam par bris/ /de ni bskal pa dpag yas par/ /rnam 'phrul thogs7)med spyod pa mdzad/ /tshul sgo re res sangs rgyas la/ /shin tu mnyam bzhag bsamatshwanyebyas kyang / /bskal pa bye ba bsam yas pa/ /brjod du med pa zad 'gyur 8gyi/ /rang byung rnams kyi yon tan las 8/ /phyogs gcig cha yis mthar myi phyin/ /sangs rgyas de yi zhal bltas kyang / /sangs rgyas chos ni bsam mi khyab/ /gang zhig de la smon byed cing ske/ /gang zhig yid kyis dga' mos pa/ /de dag kun gyil snade 'dra ba'i/ /37wa 644

spyod yul blta dka' 'thob par0)'gyur/ /bsod nams ye shes mtha' yas shings/ /tshogs can⑧yangs pas rnam gnon la/ /dri med blo ldan sems gnas pa/ /de dag 'di yishetshul la 'jug /de dag smon lam rgya che bas/ /sems dang sdom pa rgya che ste/ /rgyal ba'i spyod yul thob gyur cingalo3)/ /byang chub rgya chen gnon par 'gyur/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' bdud kyi dkyil 'khor rnam par 'thorasheba'i ye shes rgyal mtshan gyi rgyal pos/ sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi0rlabs kyis phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te/ /de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /chags med ye shes sku mnga' bas/ /rang byung rnams ni sku med de/ /bsam yas ye shes yul tsamanga' bas/ /de dag bsam par mi nus so/ /phrin las dkar po bsam yas pas/ /sangs rgyas sku rab bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /de la 'jig rten gsum mi 'gote/ /mtshan dang dpe byad bzang pos mdzes/ /chos kyi dbyings kyis rnam sbyangs pas/ /'jig rten kun tu snang ba mdzad/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sgo yin te/ /ye shes kun gyi nyurtaganas chen no/ /chags pa thams cad rnam spangs pas/ /rdul med spros pa mi mnga'o1ste/ /ye shes 'od zer rab 'gyed pas/ /'jig rten kun tu nyi ma 'dra/ /khams gsum thams cad rnam sbyong pas8/ /srid pa'i 'jigs pa pornam par gcod/ /byang chub sems dpa'achabasgrub pa mdzad/ /byang chub 'byung gnas de bzhin no/ /kha dog mtha' yas ston mdzad kyang / /kha dog kun la gnas pa med/ /sems can kun gyis bsam yas pa'i/ /kha dog tshad med yongs su ston/ /skad cig gcig la sangs rgyas kyi7/ /byang chub bsam yas sbyangs pas na/ de yi7)ye shes mthar phyin par/ /rtag hu)par sus kyang mi nus so/ /ye shes bstan〈 3 pa 37—645

zad myi shes/ /rang bzhin rnam par 'gyur ba med/ /de la dus gsum rgyal ba kun / /skad cig gcig gis rab tu brjod/ /rtag par las gzhan yongs btang ste/ /shes ldan byang chub don gnyer bas/ /sems la sems shes bya ba lhayang ske/ /de la sems skye med par bsam/ /gang gitshunasangs rgyas bskyed pa yi/ /sangs rgyas chos rnams bsam mi khyab/ /de dag brjod pa'i yul ma yin/ /shin tu zab pas tshig lam spangs/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' rnam par snang mdzad kyi smon lam dpal gyi rgyal mtshan gyis/ /sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis 4phyogs bcur rnam par bltas tegano/ /de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /dran pa rmongs med dag pa snenarnams/ /chos 'dzin shin tu nges rtogs 7shing / /blo gros bsam gyis mi khyab lan/ /byang chub rgya mtsho myi zad pa/ /de dag yid ni 'di la nges/ /de dag spyod pa'i spyod yul yin/ /de dag shes pa 'dir myi g.yo/ /de dag 'di la the tsom 'chad99ri/ /de dag skyo bar myi 'gyur te/ /de dag yid kyang zhum mi 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas chos la rab gzhol bar/ /de dag sems kyang rab tu 'byung / de dag dad pa rting tshugs shing ske/ /yang dag 'phags pa rab tu bskyed1 no/ /dmigs med gnas pa med pa yi / /ye shes 'di la de dag dga'/ /bskal pa bye bar bstsags 37pa yi/ /yongs su rdzogs pa'i 12dge ba'i chos/ /ye shes 'di 'dod mtshungs pa med32/ /de dag thams cad yongs su sngo1 / /'khor ba'i nang na rnam rgyu geyang / /'khor ba dag la gnas pa myin/ /sangs rgyas chos rnams rab rtogs pas/ /sangs rgyas yul la rab tu rtses/ /sems can khams ni sna tshoji snyed du/ /'jig rten phun sum tshogs rgyu ba/ /de dag thams cad brtan pas spangs/ /sangs 37wa 646

rgyas phun sum tshogs la gnas/ /sangs rgyas rtag tu 'byung 'gyur 3kyang / /'jig rten don med rab tu gnas/ /chags med spyod pa de dag ni/ /rtag tu sems can don la gnas/ /de dag spyod pa mtshungs med de/ /lus can kun gyis bsam mi khyab/ /'jig rten bde ba kun sems pas/ /de dag sdug bsngal rnam par bzlog /'jig rten kun la snying brtse tshonazhing / /byang chub ye shes rnam rgyadag pas/ /de dag 'jig rten snang bar gyurang/ /'jig rten thams cad rab tu 'grelan / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sgrib 6pa thams cad rnam par 'thor ④ba'i rgyal pos/ sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis phyogs bcur rnam par bltas te/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /bskal pa bye ba phrag brgyar 8)yang / /sangs rgyas sgra ni rab dkon rtsonon/ /the tsom 3)thams cad gcod pa yi/ /dam pa 11mthong ba ci zhig smos/ /chos kun thugs su chud rtogs pa/ /'jig rten gsum po'i bsod nams stegs/ /sems can thams cad rnam sbyong ba'i12/ /'jig rten sgron ma mthong gis nya dga' / /sems can gtso bo ma smad pa'i〉/ /gzugs kyi sku ni mthong gyur na / /bskal pa bye ba khrag khrig tu/ /ngoms shing tshim pa skyer 8mi btub/ /myi'i dbang po'i sku gzugs la/ /rgyal ba'i 1 sras rnams lta lta 18zhing / /rang gi dge ba'i 3/chags med pa/ /gzhan don brtson pa byang chub bsngo ci tsho/ /thub pa chen po'i gzugs kyi sku/ /de las so so 21yang dag rig she /chags med ye shes 'byung 'gyur bas snye/ /de ni sangs rgyas byang chub sgo byu/ /sems can bsam yas tshad myed pa/ / snang bar nanamadzad de theg chen la/ /btsud zhuganas thub pa chen po'i namachog /byang chub dam par lung yang ston / /bsod 37wa 647

nams chen po'i rang bzhin zhing / /ye shes dkyil 'khor shar cing 'byungatu/ /'jig rten tshad med kun tu snang / /bsod nams phung po rnam 'phel mdzad/ /sdug bsngal dra ba rab tu gcodage/ /ye shes phung po rnam par spyod①/ /gang gis rgyal ba bsnyen bkur ba/ /de dag ngan song 'jigs pa med/ /rkang gnyis dam pa mthong gyur na/ /shin tu yangs pa'i sems skye ste/ /'di0snang gsal ba'i shes rab mthu/ /grangs med pa yangs)skye bar 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas skyes bu'i mchog mthong zhing / /byang chub dam par nges par 'gyur/ /de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur bya zhes/ /de dag kun kyang nges par sems/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi dbyings kyi rmen lam gyi gzhi rab tu rtogs pas/sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /yon tan mtha' yas phunaskrubaldan pa/ /'ashekya'i khyu mchog thub mthong nas/ /yongs su bsngo ba byed pa'i sems/ /theg pa che la rnam par 'dag⑩ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /thugs rje che mnga' brtan pa51rnams/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor mdzad pa/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung bar 'gyur/ /bskal pa khrag khrig phrag brgyar yang / /sems can don la brtson mdzad pa'i/ /sangs rgyas rnams la lus can rnams/ /kun gyis lan glan cis kyang nus/ /ngan song gsum po5)mi bzadatshwanyepar/ /bskal pa bye bar btsos7bla yi/ /chags pa thams cad zlog thamadzad pa'i/ /ston pa mi mthong ma yin no/ /sems can kun gyi rgyud rnams na/ /sdug bsngal phung po 47yod pa/ /ma lus nyams su bzod nus kyi/ /sangs rgyas mi mthong ma yin no/ /'jig rten 'di dag thams cad na/ /tha dad ngan song rgyud yod pa/ /de dag yun ring gnas bla 37—648

yi/ /sangs rgyas mi mthong0)ma yin no/ /sems can dmyal ba re reramadu yang / /bskal pa tshad med gnas bla yi/ /mtha' yas rgyal bsam brnyes pa yoge/ /byang chub mchog las ring gnas myin/ /ci zhig phyir ni ngan song du/ /yun ring gnas par 'dod cesamen/ /rgyal ba'i dbang po mthong ba ni/ /ye shes 'phel ba'i rgyur 'gyur phyir/ /rgyal ba stso)'jig rten mchog mthong na/ /sdug bsngal thams cad 'chad par 'gyur/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas spyod yul gyi'achi/ /ye shes khong du chud pa7'byung / /sangs rgyas myi yi mchog mthong zhing / /sgrib pa thams cad zad par 'gyur/ /byang chub gang gis 'thob pa yi/ /bsod nams tshad med 'phel bar 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas mthong bas7sems can rnams/ /the tsom7yid gnyis chad par 'gyur/ /'jig rten 'das dang 'jig rten gyi/ /bsam pa'ang yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po kun tu bzang pos byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad la rnam par bltas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ting nge 'dzin seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa 'di nyid de bas kyang rnam par dbye ba dang rgya cher brjod pa dang /gsal bar bya ba dang rab tu brjod pa dang / yang dag par bstan pa dang /shin tu snang bar bya ba dang / rab tu gsal bar bya ba dang man ngag bstan pa'i phyir / chos kyi dbyings kyi tshul nam mkha'i dbyings dang mnyam pas/ dus gsum mnyam pa nyid dang / chos kyi dbyings mnyam pa nyid dang71sems can gyi khams mnyam pa nyid dang / 'jig rten thams cad mnyam pa nyid dang las kyi rgyud thams cad mnyam pa nyid nyurtedang sems can gyi bsam pa mnyam pa nyid dang / sems can gyi mos pa mnyam pa nyid 1snyedang / chos kyi snang ba mnyam pa 37—649

nyid dang / sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i dus mnyam pa nyid dang /'gro ba thams cad kyi dbang po mnyam pa nyid kyis17/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ting nge 'dzin seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa/ 'di nyid byang chub sems dpa' de dag la bstan pa'i tshul bcus yang dag par rab tu ston te/ bcu gang zhe na/'di lta sten/ chos kyi dbyings thams cad du gtogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul shin tu phra ba rnams la/ sangs rgyas gcig nas gcig tu brgyudar pa bstan pa dang / 'di lta ste/ nam mkha'i dbyings kyis klas ri4)pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du/ phyi ma'i mtha'i mur thug pa'i bskal ri par de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan rjes su brjod pa bstan pa dang / 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su skye ba dang / mtha' dang dbus 6med pa'i mngon par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi sgo rgya mtsho yongs su brjod cing bstan pa dang / 'di lta ste/ nam mkha'i dbyings kyis rtsonoklas pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor gyi 2dkyil 'khor gyi byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun snying po 9byang chub la mngon du gyur pa'i gnas bstan pa nyu )dang ske/ 'di lta ste dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyi sku dang 'dra bar 11sprul pa ba spu'i sgo thams cad nas/ sems skad cig la rab tu dgye 12zhing chos kyi dbyings rgyas par dgang ba bstan pa dang / 'di lta ste/ phyogs rgya mtsho thams cad du sangs rgyas kyi zhing rgya mtsho gzhi mnyam par byin gyis brlabartso/ cing lus gcig gis rkergyas par dgang ba bstan pa dang / 'di lta ste/ dmigs pa'i gzhi thams cad la sangs rgyas kyi 15rnam par sprul pa dus gsum thams cad yang dag par gzhol bar 'gyur ba'i byin gyi rlabs yang dag par bstan 10pa dang / 'di lta ste zhing 37—650

thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba rnams la/ dus gsum gyi zhing gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa dang / bskal pa rgya mtsho yongs su bshad cing bstan pa dang / 'di lta ste/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyi smon lam rgya mtsho thams cad ba spu'i sgo thams cad nas rab tu brjod pa phyi ma'i mthar tsho1byin gyis brlabs na pas/ byang chub sems dpa' yang dag par 'byung ba bstan pa dang / 'di lta ste/ chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa'i seng ge'i khri dang / byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dang / snying po ribyang chub kyi〈byargyan tha myi dad pa dang / chos kyi 'khor lo rnam pa tha dad pa 5rab tu bskor ba/ phyi ma'i mthar byin gyis brlabasko6 pa bstan pa'o/ /kye rgyal ba'i sras de ltar seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa'i 3ting nge 'dzin 'di la bstan pa bcu po de kun/dag la stsogs 1)pa shin tu bstan pa sangs rgyas 1 kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed yod 11de/ kye rgyal ba'i sras dag de ni nyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes kyi spyod yul lo/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang pos de bzhin gshegs pa'i ting nge 'dzin chen po seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa nyusnye'adi nyid kyi don gyi phyogs bstan pa'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis the de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhal du lta 15zhing 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho thams cad la rnam par bltas nas/ sangs rgyas kyi yul bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rnam par 'phrul pa mtha' dang dbus med pa la rnam par bltas te/ 'jig rten gyi khams bsam gyis mi khyab par 19gzhol ba la rnam par bltas 3 tshonas ye shes bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i sgyu ma'i chos nyid la rnam par bltas te/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas mnyam pa nyid 37—651

bsam gyis mi khyab pa la rnam par bltas nas/ mtha' dang dbus med pa'i ngag07gi lamashedang nges pa'i tshig dang / chos kyi tshul thams cad la rnam par bltas te / de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /ba spulagacig la rgya mtsho rgal baba'i zhing / /zhing kun shin tu phra ba'i rdul dang mnyam/ /de nasashesangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor/ /kun gyis yongs bskor sangs rgyas gdan la bzhugs/ /spu gcig rtse la zhing mang rgya mtsho7rnams/ /snying po byang chub pad+mo'i gdan gnas pas/ /chos dbyings rgya chen yongs su rgyas bkang zhing / /shing drung dam pa kun na mgon po snang / /zhing rnams kun gyi rdul phran rab mang rnyed47ske/ /rgyal ba spu rtse gcig la yongs bzhugasalgepa/ /byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyis7yongs su bskor/ /kun kyang bzang po'i spyod pa ston pa mdzad/ /zhing mchog gcig na rgyal ba bzhugs gyur kyang / /byang chub sems dpa'i sprin mang mi zad pa/ /de dag phyogs bcu ma lus thams cad nas/ / 'byam klas zhing kun bkang zhing kun kyang 'ong / /zhing rnams bye ba'i rdul phran mnyam pa yi//byang chub sems dpa' yon tan rgya mtshorwame'od/ /phyogs bcu'i chos dbyings rgyas pa 12kun bkang zhing / /ston pa de la kun kyang 'khor nas ldang / /zhing rnams kun tu gzugs brnyanacharab tu ston/ /chos kyi rgyal po rgyal ba'i ye shes mtsho / /de dag kun kyang bzang po'i spyod la gnas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi 'khor du nye bar 'dong / / 'byam klas7zhing rnams kun na 'khod spyod cing / /byang chub sems dpa'i dga' ba rab gnas te/ /chos kyi sprin mnyan dpa' bo de dag ni/ /zhing gcig du yangakhebaskal pa bye bar spyod/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod par byed/ /chos kyi gang7chen mtsho spyod rnam par snang / /37—652

smon lam rgya mtsho kun la rab tu 'jug /de dag sangs rgyas sa yi spyod yul gnas / /rgyal ba'i chos rnams gzhan dang gzhan byung ༅7ba'i/ /de dag kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa shes/ /sangs rgyas yon tan legs pa rgya mtsho dang / /rnam par 'phrul pa rgya chen yangs la 'jug /bde gshegs chos dbyings kun tu rgyas bkang zhing / /zhing rnams kun gyi rdul phran ji snyed pa'i/ /sku yi sprin rnams rtag tu 'gyed mdzad cing / /chos kyi char gyis byang chub rab la dgod kyi// // sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo ri/ bam po nyi shu drugasapa/ de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' de dag sangs rgyas kyi ting nge 'dzin seng ge rnam 5 par bsgyings pa 'di nyid la de bas kyang brnan7te/ 'god pa mdzad ri pa'i don du smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu'i nang nasasnyichos kyi dbyings sgo kun nas rnam par dmigs pas dus gsum snang ba zhes bya ba'i 'od zer chen po 'od zer gyi po/'khor sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang ldan pa bkye ste/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho thams cad kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'byam 7klas pa thams cad snang bar mdzad do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' dze 11ta'i tshal du tshogs pa de dag gi hurtechos kyi dbyings thams cad du gtogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mtha' klas pa thams cad dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba'i khongs su 12chud pa'i ngasangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba dag la/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi mying du bya ba kha dog sna tshogs dang / rnam pa sna tshogs su rnam par tshadag pa dang / zhing tshasna tshogs dang / dbyibs sna tshogs dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing dag na/37—653

byang chub sems dpa' 〉snying po byang chub tu phyin te/ seng ge'i khri la 'dug pa 'jig rten gyi dbang po thams cad kyis shin tu mchod pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis kun nas bskor ba/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya bar namathong ste/ la la na ri ni sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du myed pa tsam du shin tu yangs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor gi na/chos kyi dbyings rgyas par khyab pa'i dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor gyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba zimathong ngo / /la la na 6ni lha'i gnas na 'dug /la la na ni klu'i gnas na 'dug /la la na ni gnod sbyin gyi 7gnas na 'dug /la la na ni lha ma yin gyi gnas na 'dug /la la na ni nam mkha' lding gi gnas na 'dug /la la na ni mi'am ci'i gnas na 'dug /la la na ni lto 'phye chen po'i gnas na 'dug /la la na ni mi'i dbang po'i gnas 8na 'dug /la la na ni mi'i 'jig rten gyi grong dang / grong khyer dang / grong rdal 9dang / ljongs dang /khams dang / rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor dag na rnam par 'phrul pa sna tshogs dang /spyod lam sna tshogs dang / lus sna tshogs dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo rnam par dmyigs pa sna tshogs dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi mngon par shes pa sna tshogs dang /rigs dang rgyud sna tshogs su byung ba dang / kha dog rnam par dmigs pa sna tshogs dang 'od kyi dkyil 'khor sna tshogs dang / 'od zer gyi dra ba dgye 7ba sna tshogs dang / dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor sna tshogs dang / gtam gyi skyes bu'i gzhi sna tshogs dang / bstan pa'i gzhi sna tshogs dang / tshig dang yi ge dang 11nges pa'i tshig sna tshogs kyis 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor sna tshogs na chos ston pa mthong bar gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' ji snyed kyi 12'jig rten gyi khams 37—654

chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa phyogs bcu na rnam par gnas pa/ phyogs kyi rgyud mtha' yas par77'dus pa/ phyogs rgya mtsho thams cad du gtogs pa/ chos sna tshogs kyi sgo dang ldan pa/ phyogs kyi mying du bya ba sna tshogs su gtogs pa/ phyogs sna tshogs kun tu gzhol ba/ phyogs cha rnam pa tha dad par gtogs pa/ phyogs sna tshogs kyi rjes su song ba/phyogs rgya mtsho sna tshogs su gtogs pa 'di lta ste/ shar phyogs dang / lho phyogs dang / nub phyogs dang / byang phyogs dang / byang dang shar gyi phyogs mtshams dang / shar dang lho'i phyogs mtshams dang / lho dang nub kyi phyogs mtshams dang / nub dang byang gi phyogs mtshams dang / 'og dang steng gi phyogs kyi zhing gi nilhun gyi phyogs dang / sems can gyi lus kyi phyogs dang /sems can gyi mying du bya ba'i phyogs dang ri/ sngon gyi mtha'i mur thug 4)pa'i phyogs dang / phyogs bcu'i 3)da ltar byung ba'i phyogs dang / nam mkha'i khongs 6)thams cad du skra'i rtse mo shin tu phra ba dgod pas dmigs pa'i phyogs dang ske/ zhing thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa'i phyogs la 'jug pa khong du chud par bya ba'i phyogs dang / las kyi 'du byed sna tshogs kyis yongs su grub pa'i phyogs dang / skra'i rtse mo gcig la mtha' dang dbus med pa'i nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mying du bya bar gtogs pa'i phyogs kyi khongs su gachud pa'i dus gsum gyi dbyings mnyam pa nyid du gzhol bas/ kun tu gtogs pa'i 'gro ba thams cad tha myi dad pas/ sems can thams cad kyi 'du shes kyi rnam pa la mnyam pa'i sgra dbyangs su gyur pa'i 'gro ba thams cad 3)kyi sems la gzugs brnyan rab tu snang bar gyur pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i sangs 37—655

rgyas kyi ting nge 'dzin rnam par 'phrul pa/ sems can thams cad kyi lus la mngon par lta0ba/ dmigs par bya bas 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad du 'gro ba'i tshul dang ldan pa/ bskal pa thams cad la ye shes tha myi dad pa/zhing thams cad la kun tu snyoms pas sems can gyi bsam pa ji lta ba der bzhin du gzugs mngon sum du bstan pa rnam par dmigs pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad yang dag par bstan pas/ sems can thams cad 'dul ba rgyun gemi 'chad pa mthong bar gyur pa de dag thams cad ni sngon/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyis dge ba'i spyod pa skala'abab mnyam pa dang / bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhis yongs su bsdus pa mthong ba dang mnyam pa dang / rjes su dran pa dang7bsnyen bkur bas yongs su smin par byas pa dag go/ /sngon bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed dushebatsud pa dag go/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de dang de dag gi drung du gshegs pa'i tshe dge ba'i rtsa bas yongs su bsdus pa dag ste / de ltar dge ba'i rtsa ba skal 2)pa mnyam pas/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su smin par 'gyur ba'i thabs kyis khashin tu bzung ba'i phyir/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi rnam par 'phrul pa chos kyi dbyings ltar yangs shing nam mkha'i dbyings kyi mthas gtugs par gyur pa dag kyang mthong zhing khong du chud par gyur pa yin te/ la la ni chos kyi sku la 'jug gol/ /la la ni gzugs kyi sku la 'jug go/ /la la ni sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa'i yongs su bsgrub pa la 'jug go/ /la la ni pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs pa la 'jug go/ /la la ni spyod pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su dag pa'i rgyan 37—656

la 'jug go/ /la la ni byang chub sems dpa'i sa yi rnam par 'phrul pa la 'jug go / /la la ni mngon par byang chub pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa la 'jug go/ /la la ni sangs rgyas rnam par spyod pa'i ting nge 'dzin tha myi dad pa'i 11rnam par 'phrul pa la 'jug go/ /la la ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs dang myi bsnyengs pa la 'jug go/ /la la ni sangs rgyas kyi so so ②yang dag par rigs45)pa rgya mtsho la 'jug go/ /de dag la stsogs ④pa sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa rgya mtsho sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa mephyag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed la 'jug ste mos pa sna tshogs dang lam sna tshogs dang / sgo sna tshogs dang / 'jug pa sna tshogs dang ske/ 'bab pa sna tshogs dang / rnam pa 46)sna tshogs dang / rjes su 'brang ba sna tshogs dang / phyogs sna tshogs dang snod sna tshogs dang yul sna tshogs dang /'jig rten sna tshogs dang khong du chud pa sna tshogs dang / tshogs sna tshogs dang rnam par 'phrul pa tshesna tshogs dang / thabs sna tshogs dang ting nge 'dzin sna tshogs kyis shesangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa rgya mtsho de dag la 'jug go/ /ting nge 'dzin sna tshogs kyis spu'ajug pa 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin chos kyi dbyings kun nas brgyan pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin dus gsum thams cad la thogs pa med par yul snang bar byed pa dang /byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin chos kyi dbyings kyi gzhi tha myi dad pa'i ye shes snang ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin de bzhin gshegs pa'i yul gyi dbyings la 'jug pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin nam mkha'i dbyings su snang ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge mi'adzin de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu 'thob pas rnam par 'byed pa dang / byang chub 37—657

sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin sangs rgyas kyi bsnyengs0)pa mi mnga' ba'i rgyan gyis rnam par gnon cing rnam par bsgyings ②pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin chos kyi dbyings kyi tshul thams cad kyi klong gi snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin chos kyi dbyings thams cad du thogs pa med par sgra sgrogasam pas rgyas par 'gengs pa'i zla ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin chos kyi dbyings mnyam pa nyid kyis brgyanamachogapa'i 'od kyi55)byang chub sems dpa' 6)de dag bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyishesangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa rgya mtsho 3)de dag la rab tu 'jug go/ /byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po'i thabs chags pa myed pa'i rgyal mtshan dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin dmyigs pa thams cad la sangs rgyas rgya mtsho rnam par lta ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin 'jig rtenawogyi rgyud thams cad du tha myi dad pa'i lus tshasnang ba'i rgyal mtshan dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku tha dad pa'i yul la 'jug pa dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin 'jig rten thams cad kyi rgyud kyiphanye rjes su 'jug pa snying rje'i 12snying po can dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin chos thams cad kyi gnas la rten nya pa'i byin gyi 〉rlabs dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin shin tu zhi la rab tu zhi bas kun tu snang ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin sprul pa bzang po dmyigs su med pas/ kun tu 'phrul pa'i gzugs brnyan dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin zhing thams cad yongs su 'du ba'i byin gyis snyenabs dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge tshe'adzin zhing thams cad du mngon par 'tshang rgya ba'i 37—658

rnam par mngon par nyu)bsgrub pa dang byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin 'gro ba thams cad du dbang po'i du kha dog gis rnam par spyod pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin 'gro ba thams cad du khyad par du 'phags pa'i dkyil 'khor chags pa med pa'i (4rnam par spyod pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad skyed 5)pa las byung ba'i byin gyi tri rlabs dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin yon tan rgya mtsho thams cad la nan tan gyis57'jug pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzinapo)dmyigs pa ma lus pa thams cad du rnam par 'phrul pa mngon par bsgrub 1pas/phyi ma'i mthar byin gyis rlob bopa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sngon gyi sbyor ba rgya mtsho la 'jug pa dang /byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin phyi ma'i mthar de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs yang dag par 'dzin pa'i byin gyi 1 rlabs dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin phyogs 12bcu'i zhing rgya mtsho da ltar byung ba thams cad yongs su dag par mos pa'i byin gyi rlabs 1lhadang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin sems kyi skad cig gcig la sangs rgyas thams cad dang rnam par spyod cing 'grogs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin dmigs pa thams cad la chags pa med pa'i mthar 'jug pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad sangs rgyas kyi zhing gcig tu byin gyis rlobs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin sangs rgyas thams cad kyi skur 'phrul pa mngon par sgrub mapa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin dbang po rgya mtsho rdo rje'i dbang po lta bu thams cad khong du chud pa dang / byang 37—659

chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad sku gcig pa'i snying po'i byin gyi 1)rlabs dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin sems kyi skad cig gcig gi cha la chos kyi dbyings kyi tshul thams cad khong du chud pas khom par gnas pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin chos kyi dbyings thams cad du zhing 'byam klas55)pa bsgrub pa yongs su ston pa'i byin gyisarlabs dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin spyi'u tshugs su5gegazhi la rnam par spyod pa'i byin gyi rlabs parabadang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi sems can gyi lus tha myi dad par byin gyis rlob pa dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin ye shes kyi klong thams cad la mngon sum du yang dag par gzhol ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin rtsonomatshan nyid yongs su shes pas rab tu 'byed pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin dus gsum sems kyi skad cig zhe la tha myi dad pa'i dkyil 'khor dang byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin sems kyi skad cig thams cad chos kyi 9ridabyings kyi tshul gyi rang bzhin dam pa dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs kyi rjes su 'brang ba'i ye shes kyi hu )rnam par gnon pa'i seng ge dang /byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin dmyigs pa thams cad chos kyi dbyings su shes pa'i mig gi dkyil 'khor dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin stobs bcu'i rtsal gyis rnam par gnon pas yang dag par rtsom pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin dmigs 17pa thams cad kun nas mthong ba'i mig gi dkyil 'khor dang byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin kha dog thams 37—660

cad ①dkyil 'khor gyis 'gro bar ②shin tu mdzes pa mngon par sgrub ①pa dang /byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin glongadzazi)mi g.yo ba'i snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin chos gcig la chos thams cad yongs su 'du bar ston pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin chos gcig gi tshig gi lam la nges pa'i ngag gi⑧rab tu 'byed pas/ byang chub sems dpa' de dag bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad kyi sangs rgyas kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis〈pi)rnam par 'phrul pa rgya mtsho de dag la rab tu 'jug go/ /byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rgyal mtshan ༷byin gyi rlabs kyis 48)chos ston pa dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin dus gsum gyi mu lalo)mthar thug pa med pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin bskal pa thams cad khong du chud pas tha myi dad pa'i ye shes dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin tshul shin tu phra bas stobs bcu khongs su 7chud pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin myi 'phrogs 31pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bskal pa thams cad du mngon par sgrub pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin phyogs thams cad kun tu shugs kyis mngon du thar 12pa'i sprin dang /byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin mngon par 'tshang rgya ba'i rnam par 'phrul pa rnam par sgrub pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin tshor ba thams cad kyis7reg pa med pas bde ba'i rgyal mtshan dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin rgyan thams cad du nam mkha'i rgyan mngon par sgrub pa dang /byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin skad cig skad cig tupha 'gro ba snyed kyi sprul pa'i gzugs brnyan7gyi sprin mngon par sgrub pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i 37—661

ting nge 'dzin de bzhin gshegs pa'i51)zla ba'i 'od nam mkha' ltar rdul dang bral ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad nam mkha' ltar 5byin gyis rlob pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin chos thams cad la dbang po'i rgyan rab tu snang ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin chos thams cad kyi don rnam par 'byed pa'i sgron ma dang /byang chub sems dpa'i /ting nge 'dzin stobs bcu'i dkyil 'khor snang ba dang /byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dpal gyi rgyal mtshan dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin sangs rgyas thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa'i snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin skad cig skad cig la brtsams pa thams cad mthar phyin par byed pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin bsod nams mi zad pa'i snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin sangs rgyas mtha' yas pa mthong ba'i yul rab tu snang ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin chos thams cad la rdo rje'i seng ge ltar rab tu gnas pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sprul pa yongs su bstan pas kun tu rnam par dmigs 4pa mngon par sgrub pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mnyan da/pa'i nyi ma gnon pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin dus gsum gcig tu spyod pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis du )rab tu zhi bar sgra dbyangs kun tu sgrogs 7pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin sangs rgyas thams cad mthong ba'i sa mtshams na'adzin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i 37—662

ting nge 'dzin chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad kyi gnas kyi pad mo'i tshal rab tu rgyas pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin gnas med pa'i chos kyi51)nam mkha' la rnam par lta ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin phyogs gcig tu phyogs bcu rgya mtsho yongs su sdud pa'i klong dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin chos kyi dbyings kyi migazhi thams cad kyi sgor 'jug pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin chos rgya mtsho thams cad dang ldan pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin sems can thams cad la 'od rab tu 'gyed pas/ rab tu zhi ba'i lus su 'gyur ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin sems kyi skad cig gcig la mngon par shes pa dang /smon lam thams cad mngon par sgrub pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin rtag par thams cad du kun nas ririmangon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i byin gyilorlabs dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin chos kyi dbyings thams cad rgyan gcig tu khong du chud par 'jug pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin sangs rgyas thams cad dran pa'i rang bzhin gyis 'chirab tu snang ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge neri'adzin 'gro ba thams cad du khyad par chen po dang ldan pa'i ye shes mngon par shes pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin sems kyi skad cig gcig tshi gis chos kyi dbyings kyi tshul mtha' yas pa rang gi lus kyis rgyas par 'gengs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin chos kyi dbyings tshul gcig gis 3chos thams cad tshul gcig par rnam par dgod pa'i 'od dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo gzi brjid kyi byin gyi 37—663

rlabs0byedang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin sems can gyi khams mig 'phrul lta bu yongs su bsdu ba'i smon lam dang / spyod pa byin gyis rlobalgepa dang /byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin chos kyi dbyings kyi gzhi thams cad tha myi dad pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin pad+mo'i byin rnam par 'phrul pas kun tu rnam par gnon pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin sems can thams cad kyi lus kyi rgyud khong du chud pas mngon par shes pa dang /byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin lus sems can thams cad la mngon du ①byin gyis rlob bapa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin sems can thams cad kyi dbyangasasnyikyi yan lag rgya mtshor 'gro ba thams cad kyi skad yongs su 'byed pa'i tshul mngon par shes pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin 'gro ba'i gzhi tha dad pa thams cad khong du chud pas mngon par shes pa dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin snying rje chen po'i mdzod tha mi ⑥dad pa'i snying po dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin sangs rgyas thams cad de bzhin nyid du rtogs pa'i mtha' la 'jug pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rnam par thar pa'i pho brang la rnam par lta57bas seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa dang / de dag la stsogasalgepa byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi lam la 'jug pa dang ⑨/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis/ byang chub sems dpa' de dag de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa rgya mtsho de dag la rab tu 'jug go/ /sems kyi skad cig re re la chos kyi dbyings thams cad du rgyas par 'gengs par 'jug pa'i tshul gyis sngon 37wa 664

bskal7pa mnyam par spyad pa yang rjes su dran no/ /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' de dag dze ②ta'i tshal du phyin cing / bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga〈 cigan 'khod pa/ seng ge'i khri rin po che sna tshogs kyi pad mo'i snying po can 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra bas0dang mnyam par yangs pa la 'khod pa/ ye shes dang mngon par shes pa chen po'i rnam par 'phrul pas byung ba/ ye shes dang mngon par shes pa rno ba dang ldan pa'i sa〈perjes su thob pa/ye shes kyis kun tu rnam par dpyod 7)pa/ shes rab kyi 'byung gnas kyi rigs su byung ba/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes la mngon du gyur pa/ ye shes kyi mig rab rib med pa dang ldan pa/ sems can gyi kha lo bsgyur ⑧ba'i rang bzhin thob pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam pa nyid kyi rjes su song ba/rtag tu rnam par rtogalo)pa med par/chos la spyod pa/ chos kyi dmyigs pa thams cad rab tu rtogs pa/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis zhi bar dmigs pa 'jig rtenaphamathams cad shin tu zhi bas/ gnas tha dad pa med pa la rab tu gzhol ba/ 'jig rten tha dad pa thams cad du sna rab tu zhugs pa/ gnas med par zhing thams cad du 'dong banyurte/ chos kyi gnas thams cad la brtenamatshapa med par chos thams cad bla gab 32med pa'i gzhal med khang du phyin /—9pa/'gro ba thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba dang / gdul ba la zhugs pa sems can thams cad la bde ba'i lam ston pa/ ye shes dang rnam par thar pa shin tu 'phags pa'i gnas kyi spyod yul can/ 'dod chags dang bral ba'i mthar phyin pa'i ye shes kyi lus dang ldan pa/ srid pa'i rgya mtsho thams cad las gyen du 'phags pa/ 'gro ba thams cad la yang dag pa'i mtha' rnam par ston pa/37—665

chos rgya mtsho7shes rab snang ba'i dkyil 'khor can/ ting nge 'dzin gangakhuchen mtsho dang ldan pa'i dbyings la'༄shin tu mnyam par bzhag cing / snying rje chen po rab tu sems pa/ chos kyi tshul sgyu ma'i rnam pa 'di lta burahorab tu rtogs pa/'jig rten gyi khams thams cad la rmi sprilam lta bur zhugs pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa mthong ba thams cad mig yor lta bur khong du chud pa/ sgra skad dang dbyangs thams cad sgra brnyan (7lta bur rnam par rig pa/ chos thams cad mngon par sgrub pa'i ye shes sprul pa lta bur rab tu rtogs pa/ khyad par du 'phags pa'i smon lam shin tu bstsags7pa/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor kun nas 3nidag pa'i mkhas pa dang ldan pa/ sems shin tu zhi zhing rab tu zhi ba dang ldan pa gzungs kyi rgyud thams cad kyitsho)yul dang ldan pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs kyis dogs pa med par 7kun nas rab tu gnon pa chos kyi dbyings kyi gnas kyi mthar phyin pa'i mig dang ldan pa/ chos thams cad la dmigs pa med par rnam par spyod pa rab tu thob pa shes rab rgya mtsho mtha' yas pa la rnam par spyod pa/ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i pha rol tu song ba/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i stobs dang / shugs thob pa/ rdzu 'phrul gyi pha rol tu phyin pas 'gro ba thams cad kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ting nge 'dzin gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dbang du gyur pa / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi don mkhas pa la phyin ci nyu7log med pa'i ye shes dang ldan pa/ chos kyi mdzod dbye ba'i cho ga la mkhas pa/ nges pa'i tshig shes pa la mngon par mkhas pa/ spobs rtepa'i stobs dang / chos kyi sprin zad myi shes pa dang ldan pa/ myi 'jigs pas khyu mchog dang seng ge'i nga ro 'byin pa/ gnas med pa'i chos kyi dga' ba la dga' bas〈nyemos pa chos 37wa 666

thams cad la rab rib myed pa'i myig gis lta7ba/ 'jig rten thams cad kyi 'byung ba dang / 'jig pa7shes pa'i zla bar gyur pa / shes rab kyi dkyil 'khor gyis bden pa'i tshul thams cad la rnam par spyod pa'i 'od zer can/ ye shes kyi rdo rje bsod nams kyi khor yug tu gyur pa/ dper bya ba thams cad las shin tu 'das pa/ chos thams cad la dbang po dang ye shes kyi myu gu rab tu skyes pa / dpa' ba'i rgyal mtshan dang ldan pa/ bdud thams cad kyi rgyal mtshan rab tu snyol ba la dpa' ba ye shes mtha' yas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi gzi brjid can / 'gro ba thams cad las mngon par 'phags pa'i lus dang ldan pa/chos thams cad la shes rab sgribasapa med par zadam0pa dang / myi zad pa'i mtha'i ye shes kyis rnam par sangs rgyas pa/ yang dag pa'i mtha'i ⑦kun gyi mthar phyin pa la gnas pa/ mtshan ma med pa la rnam par lta ba'isheye shes kyi myig mngon sum can/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad mngon par bsgrub pa'i rgyu la mkhas pa/ myi gnyis pa'i ye shes kyi spyod yul dang ldan pa 'jig rten gyi 3)rgyud thams cad la rnam par lta tshib/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rgyud gnas myed pa la 37thams cad du gzugs brnyan snang bar gyur pa/ chos thams cad la mun pa dang rnam par bral ba ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor mun pa myed pa la rab tu zhugs nyunyepa/ phyogs kun tu chos gyi snang ba〈nyerab tu bkye ba/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi bsod nams kyi zhing mchog tu gyur pa/ thos pa dang mthong ba dang ske/ smon lam don yod pa'i zla ba/ bsod nams kyi ri rab 'jig rten thams cad las mngon par 'phags pa/ phas kyi rgol ba'i tshogs thams cad tshar gcod pa la shin tu dpa' ba/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du sgra skad 37—667

dang dbyangs kyi nga ro 'byin pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku mthong bas myi ngoms pa/ sangs rgyas kyi sku'i gzugs brnyan gyi dbang bsgyur ba0)dang ldan pa/'gro ba gdul ba dang mthun mipa'i lus su byin gyis rlob pa/ zhing 'byam klasaphupa thams cad du lus gcig gis rgyas par 'gengs pa/ mngon par 'du bya7ba myed pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi dkyil 'khor yongs su dag pa/ thogs pa myed par 'gro ba'i ye shes chen po'i theg pa'i na gru dang ldan pa/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gyis chos kyi dbyings thams cad du lus rab tu snang ba/ ye shes kyi nyi ma 'gro ba thams cad du shar ba/ 'gro ba thams cad bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du dga' ba'i kha dog dang ldan pa/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi bsam pa dang / dbang po rab tu rtogs pa'i ye shes can/ chos thams cad bsgribasalgepa med pa'i yul khong du chud pa/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin skye ba med pa rnam par rig pa phralab dang yangs pa phan tshun du yongs su bsdu ba la dbang bsgyur ⑨ba sangs rgyas kyis 1 snazab mo'i tshul nges par rtogs pa/ don zab mo'i tshig dang / yi ge'i tha snyad la mkhas pa/ tshig dang yi ge dang / don myi zad pa hunyerab tu brjod pa/mdo sde rgya mtsho thams cad tshig gcig tu chud par rab tu ston pa/ gzungs dang ye shes kyi lus rgya chen po byin gyis rlob pa/ bskal pa mtha' yas par yongs su 'dzin pa'i gzungs dang ldan pa'i byin gyi rlabs can/ sems kyi skad cig gcig gis bskal pa brjod du myed par gnas pa/ rab tu rtogs pa'i ye shes can/ sems kyi skad cig gcig gis dus gsum shes pas(1/ 'jig rten thams cad mngon par shes pa /nye/ chos kyi gzungs kyisakhesangs rgyas kyi chos rgya mtsho mtha' yas pa dran zhing spobs pa 'gro ba thams cad kyis shes par 'gyur 37—668

ba'i thabs kyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba las phyir myi ldog pa/ sangs rgyas kyi yul la ye shes snang ba rab tu thob pa/ gya nom par snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin la rtag tu mnyam par bzhag ①pa/ chags pa myed pa'i mtha'i chos thams cad rab tu dbye ba'i ye shes la mngon par mkhas pa/ chos thams cad las khyad par du 'phags pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa'i yul la ye shes kyis rnam par rtse ()ba/dmigs pa thams cadashergyan bzang por7byin gyis rlob pa/ chos kyi dbyings phyogs myed pa la phyogs kyi rjes su 'brang bas rab tu zhugs pa phyogs thams cad rnam par dbye bas chos kyi dbyings la ⑤yang dag par gzhol ba shin tu phra ba ste/yangs pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba la byang chub tu rnam par 'tshang rgya ba/ rang bzhin kha dog myed pa las ༅kha dog thams cad yongs su ston pa/ phyogs gcig la yang dag par gzhol ba de lta bu'i yon tan dang ye shes mtha' yas pas yang dag par bskyed de/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi snying po dang ldan par gyur pa/sangs rgyas thams cad kyis bstod pa bsngags pa bkur stib tshig dang yi ge myi zad pas yon tan dang legs pa brjod du yoda'akhyapa'i byang chub sems dpa' dze〈)ta'i tshal du 'dus te⑩/ 'khod pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan rgya mtsho la 'jug pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od zer gyis rab tu snang bar gyur pa/ de dag gi5)lus thams cad dang / khang pa brtsegs pa de dag dang / byang chub sems dpa'i longs spyod de dag dang / byang chub sems dpa'i stan de dag dang / dze〈geta'i tshal thams cad nas kyang〈nye/ dga' ba chen po'i shugs rab tu thob pa'i chos nyid dang / byang chub sems dpa'i chos snang ba bsam gyis myi khyab pa rab tu thob pas dga' ba'i shugs las byung ba'i rnam par 'phrul pa chen 37—669

po'i rgyanas༅mngon par 'thon nas/ chos kyi dbyings thams cad rgyas pakhukhyab par gyur to/ /'di lta ste sems kyi skad cig re re la 'od zer gyi dra ba'i sprin shin tu yangs pa/ 'gro ba thams cad yongs su tshim par byed pa mngon par 'thon te/ phyogs bcu rgyas pa khyab par gyur to/ /rin po che sna tshogs kyi dril bu'i sprin mngon par 'thon te/ dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yon tan dang legs pa rab tu brjod pa'i sprin gyi nga ro rjes su bsgrags pas phyogs bcu rgyas par khyab par gyur to/ /dmyigs pa thams cad las 'gro ba thams cad zherol mo'i sprin mngon par 'thon te/ sems can thams cad kyi las dang rnam par smin pa rol mo'i sgra snyan par blang bas ri'u)rjes su sgrog cing phyogs bcu rgyas par 7khyab par gyuraston to/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi smon lam dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa sna tshogs yang dag par ston pa'i tshul gyi sprin mang po mngon par 'thon nas/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi smon lam gyi sgra dbyangs rab tu sgrog 9 pas phyogs bcu rgyas par khyab par gyur to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sprul pa dang / rnam par 'phrul ba'i sprin mang po mngon par 'thon nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung 1 gi dbyangs rjes su brjod cing / phyogs bcu rgyas par khyab par gyur to / /byang chub sems dpa'i lus 3nyamatshan dang dpe byad bzang pos rnam par brgyan pa'i sprin mang po mngon par 'thon nas/ zhing thams cad du 'byung rdzo/rteba'i sangs rgyas skye ba gcig nas1lha/ gcig tu brgyud pa rab tu brjod cing phyogs bcu rgyas paratemikhyab par gyur to/ /dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang mnyam pa'i snying po byang chub kyi sprin mang po mngon par 'thon 37wa 670

nas / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyanatubyung ba yongs su ston cing / phyogs bcu7rgyas par khyab par gyur to/ /dmyigs pa thams cad las klu'i dbang po'i lus gyi sprin mang po mngon par 'thon nas/spos sna tshogs kyi char rab tu 'bebs shing phyogs bcu rgyas par khyab par gyur to//'gro ba thams cad kyi dbang po'i ④lus dang 'dra ba'i sprin mang po mngon par 'thon nas/ byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa yongs su brjod pa byed cing / phyogs bcu rgyas par khyab par gyur to/ /zhing yongs su dag pa rin po che thams cad kyi rang bzhin yongs kyi gzugs brnyan5bgyi sprin mang po mngon par 'thon nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi7chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba mngon par ston cing / phyogs bcu rgyas par khyab par gyur to/ /de dag la stsogs (pepa byang chub sems dpa' de dag gi (2)byin gyi rlabs spudang /chos7) snang ba rgya mtsho bsam gyis myi khyab pa rab tu thob pa'i chos nyid kyis zhu1rgyan chen po rnam par sprul pa'i sprin sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du myed pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed byung bar gyur to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal gyis sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi sngo rlabs kyis rnam par 'phrul pa de dag yongs su ston pa byed cing phyogs bcur rnam par bltas nas/ de'i tshe tshigs su bcadama'i pa 'di dag smras so/ /dzemo8ta'i tshal du sangs rgyas byin gyi 8nabs/ /mtha' yas rgya chen yongs su byung la ltosami/ /dmigs pa kun las lus kyi sprin chen rnams/ /mngon par 'thon cing tunyephyogs rnams kun tu khyab/ /bde gshegs sras po rnams kyi 3)sna tshogs rgyan1tshe/ /kha dog mtha' yas rgya chen rnam dag pa/ /stan dang dmyigs pa yongs su bcas pa la/ /de dag thams cad gzugs brnyan 37—671

'byungamanya)ba snang / /rgyan rnams snar tshogs rin chen 'od 'phro'i sprin/ /bde gshegs sras po rnams kyisam spu rtse las/ /sangs rgyas gsung rnams rab tu sgrog byed cing / /zhing rnams kun gyi dbyings su khyab par 'phro rangs pa'i dbang po'i gzugs 'dra 4 lus rnams dang / /spyod lam rab tu zhi ba dag pa'i gzugs / /zhing gi me tog kun las mngon 'thon te/ /bsam gtan yan lag brjod cing kun tu 'dong / /kun tu bzang po 'dra ba'i rgyal ba'i sras/ /mtshan rab dpe byad bzang pos brgyan pa'i lus/ /grangs myed bsam yas bde gshegs ba spu las/ /sprul pa de 'dra thogs pa myed par 'byung / /bde gshegs sras po dus gsum byung ba gernams/ /yon tan rgya mtsho'i legs pa brjod pa dag /rgya dzimatsho che mnyam rgyan sprin de dag kun/ /dzes)ta'i tshal na gnas shing rab tu brjod/ /phyogs rnams kun gyi sems can yongs kyi las/ /rgya mtsho chen po sna tshogs ma lus par/ /dze ta'i tshal gyi shing gi gzugs rnams kyil/ /gseb nas byung bar gyur pa kun tu grag48) /dus gsum byung khyaba'i rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ /zhing rnams kun gyi ma lus rnam nyu )'phrul ba/ /zhing rnams rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed de dag kyang / /so so'i 31dmyigs kyis hurtedamigs par gyur pa nyugesnang / /sangs rgyas phyogs kyi zhing rnams rgya mtsho'i78spyin/ /spu rtse re rer sna tshogs rnam skaphye ba'i/ /sangs rgyas gnas rnams skad cig re rer snang tso/ /de dag la yang sangs rgyas sprin mang bzhugs/ /'gro dang mnyam par phyogs rnams kun bkang zhing / /sems can thabs kyis yongs su smin par byed/ /de dag 'od las spos kyi 'od 'phro dang / /me tog phal chen rgya mtsho'i tsho/chusprin kyang 'byung ske/ /mkha' ltar tshad myed rin chen gzhal med khang / /ma lus rgyan rab 37wa 672

kun gyis rnam mdzes pa/ /de dag thams cad phyogs rnams kun khyab byed/ /zhing dang snying po byang chub de bzhin no/ /dus gsum byung ba'i rgyal ba'i sras rnams kyis/ /kun tu bzang po'i7spyad pa'i rnam mitshul du/ /zhing rnams rgya mtsho rnam par dag byas pa'i / /rgyan rab sna tshogs 'gro ltar tshad myed pa/ /phyogs rnams dus gsum kun tu gang byung rnams/ /bskal pa rgya mtsho chen por rnamasasbyangs pa/ /de dag kun kyang dze dun)ta'i nags tshal gyi/ /bar snang mkha' la gzugs brnyan tshul du snang / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi ting nge 'dzin gyis/ rgyud shin tu snang bar byas pa de dag las/ byang chub sems dpa' re res kyang / snying rje chen po'i sgo sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du myed pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed du zhugs par gyur nas/ de dag de bas kyang 'gro ba thams cad la phan pa dang / yongs su bsdu ba'i don du zhugs par gyur te / de ltar mnyam par bzhag pa de dag gi ba spu'i sgo re re nas kyang / 'od zer sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du myed pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed mngon par 'thon par gyur te/ 'od zer depo)dag gi sgo re re nas kyang / byang chub sems dpa'akhu'aphrul ba'i sprin 'jig rten gyi dbang po thams cad dang 'dra ba'i lus dang / 'gro ba thams cad la mngon par ltar3)ba'i lus dang / sems can thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba dang / 'phrod pa'i lus dang ldan pa mngon par 'thon te/ mngon par 'thon nas kyang / phyogs thams cad kyi chos kyi dbyings rgyas par bkang nas/ sems can thams cad yang dag par bskulasazhing yongs su smin par bya ba dang / gdul bar (1byed do/ /lha'i gnas na shi 'pho bsngo yongs su bstan pa'i sgo dang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du 37—673

skye ba yongs su bstan pa'i sgo dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su bstan pa'i sgo dang / rmi lam yongs su bstan pa'i sgo0)sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis sems can yongs su bskul bsngon byed do/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi smon lam gyis byungakhuba'i sgo dang / 'jig rten gyi khams yongs su bskyod pa'i sgo dang / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i spyod pa yongs su bstan pa'i sgo dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yon tan la nan tan du ④bya ba dang / rab tu bsgrub pa'i sgo dang ske/ yan lag dang nying lag gcod pa'i bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su bstan pa'i sgo dang / byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par 'phrul pa chen pos brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su bstan pa'i sgo dang / byang chub sems dpa'i bsam gtan dang rnam par thar pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang snyoms par 'jug pa thams cad dang / sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi lam gyi dkyil 'khor snang ba rab tu brjod pa'i sgo dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad yongs su btsal ba'i phyir chos kyi tshig dang yi ge re re'i phyir/ lus grangs med pa yongs su gtang ba 5yongs su bstan pa'i sgo dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi drung du 'gro zhing chos thams cad yongs su dri nyeba'i sgo dang /dus la ji ltar 'bab pa dang /3 bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du 'gro ba'i drung du 'gro zhing thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su smin par 'gyur ba thob par bya ba'i tshul rgya mtsho snang ba'i narnam par dmyigs par bya ba'i sgo dang / byang chub sems dpa'i bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs thams cad bdud dang / pas kyi 9)rgol bas myi tshugs pa'i stobs kyi rgyal mtshan yongs su bstan pa'i sgo dang /37—674

bzo thams cad shes shing mkhas pa dang ldan pa'i ye shes kyis nyayongs su bstan pa'i sgo dang / 'gro ba thams cad las khyad par du 'phags par shes shing mkhas pa dang ldan pa'i ye shes kyis yongs su bstan pa'i sgo dang / sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa'i khyad par shes shing mkhas pa dang ldan pa'i ye shes kyis yongs su bstan pa'i sgo dang / sems can thams cad kyi dbang po la 'jug pa'i thabs kyis (minyon mongs pa dang / bag chags sna tshogs yang dag par gzhom pa la shes shing mkhas pa dang ldan pa'i ye shes kyis yongs su bstan pa'i sgo dang / de dag la stsogs pa ( dasems can khyo)yongs su smin par bya ba dang /gdul ba'i thabs dang bsdu ba'i sgoge/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du myed pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyis byang chub sems dpa' de dag sems can thams cad kyi gnas su phyin par snang ste/ la la ni lha'i gnas su phyin par snang ngo / /la la ni klu'i gnas su phyin par snang ngo / /la la ni gnod sbyin gyi gnas su phyin par snang ngo / /la la ni dri za'i gnas su phyin par snang ngo / /la la ni lha ma yin gyi gnas su phyin par snang ngo / /la la ni nam mkha' lding gi gnas su phyin par snang mngo / /la la ni mi'am ci'i gnas su phyin par snang ngo / /la la ni lto 'phyedza chen po'i gnas su phyin par snang ngo / /la la ni tshangs pa'i dbang po'i gnas su phyin par snang ngo / /la la ni mi'i gnas su phyin par snang ngo / /la la ni gshin rje'i gnas su phyin par snang ngo / /la la ni yi dgasam kyi gnas thams cad du tso kyiphyin par snang ngo / /la la ni sems can dmyal ba'i 'jig rten thams cad du phyin par snang ngo / /la la ni yi dgas r+sha )kyi skye gnas kyi rgyud thams cad du phyin par snang ste(me/ mthong bas 'dul ba'i sems can dang / thos pas 37—675

'dul ba dang rjes su dran pas 'dul ba dang / dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor gyisala'adul ba dang / mying gi chu klung gi sgras 'dul ba dang / 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyis 'dul ba dang / 'od zer gyi dra ba tshirab tu dgye bas ga'adul ba dang /sems can rnams kyi bsam pa'i tshul ji lta ba bzhin du yongs su smin par bya ba dang ske/ gdul ba'i phyir snying rje chen po tha myi dad pa dang smon lam tha mi dad pa dang ye shes tha myi dad pa dang / sems can yongs su bsdu ba tha myi dad pa'i tshul du byang chub sems dpa' de dag dze ④rta'i tshal nas rnam par 'phrul pa'i rgyan rnam 55pa sna tshogs kyis 'jig rten gyi khams 'byam yiglas pa thams cad dang ske/ sems can gyi khams 'byamatshamathas pa thams cad du〈rgyas par 'gengs par 15byed par snang yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhabs kyi drung nas myi g.yo ste/la la ni rang gi gnas dang khang pa brtsegs pa dang / stan dang 'khor dang〈 )bcas pas/ phyogs bcu rgyas par byed par snang yang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhabs kyi drung nas myi g.yo'o/ /la la ni sprul pa'i sprin rab tu 'gyed par snang ngo nyu1/ /la la ni sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i don du gcig purwarteganyis su myed par 'gro bar snang yang /hu de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor nas khomyi g.yo'o/ /la la ni dge sbyong gi gzugs/ la la ni tshangs pa'i gzugs/ la la ni brtul 1gezhugs can thams cad kyi cha byad dang / cho ga dang chu zheng gi gzugs/ la la ni sman pa'i gzugs/ la la ni tshong pa'i gzugs / la la ni snyan 1 pas 'tsho ba'i gzugs/ la la ni gar mkhan gyi gzugs / la la ni lha khyer ba'i gzugs/ la la ni bzo thams cad dang ldan pa'i gzugs su grong dang grong khyer dang / grong rdal dang / ljongs dang / 37—676

khams dang / rgyal po'i pho brang 'khor du phyin par snang ste/ dus kyi dbang gis dus kyi rjes su 'brang zhing mying dang gzugs dang lus mngon par bsgrub pa tha dad pa dang / lus kyi kha dog dang dbyibs tshul dang 'dra ba dang dbyangs rnam pa tha dad pa dang / skad rnam pa tha dad pa dang / spyod lamanyernam pa tha dad pa dang / gnas rnam pa tha dad pas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dngas/'gro ba thams cad myig 'phrul lta bur shes pa dang / bzo'i 'khor thams cad rab tu brjod pa dang / 'gro ba thams cad kyi shes pa brjod pas snang ba'i sgron ma dang / bde ba thams cad kyi byin gyi rlabs7kyis brgyan pa dang / las thams cad snang bar byed pa'i 'od dang ldan pa dang / phyogs thams cad theg pa la gnas pas rab tu sbyong bsredang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa chos thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor rab tu snang ba la spyod cing / sems can yongs su spyin par bya ba dang / gdul seba'i don du grong dang grong khyer dang / grong rdal dang ljongs dang / khams dang / rgyal po'i gnas dag du phyin par snang ngo ske/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa gnas pa myed pa'i khang pa brtsegs pa na 'dug 'dug pa las skal ba mthun7pa'i byang chub sems dpa' de dag dang / rtag tu phyi bzhin 'brang ba'i lag na rdo rje dag dang / 'jig rten thams cad kyi nyams〈blta ba la 3)brtson zhing sangs rgyas thams cad bsnyen bkur bar smon pa'i sems dang ldan pa'i lus kyi risarka)su gtogs pa'i lha dag dang ske/ sngon gyi smon lam gyi78rjes su 'brang ba'i rkang gis 'gro ba'i ris hu)su gtogs pa'i lha dag dang / chos mnyan pa la mngon par mos pa'i sa'i lha dag dang ske/ snying rje chen po la brtson pa'i lu ma0rnyedang / mtsho dang mtshe'u dang /37—677

rdzing bu dang khron pa dang / chu klung gi lha dag dang / shes rab kyi 'od snang bas rab tu gsal ba'i me'i lha dag dang / rin po che'i cod tsho)pan thogs pa'i rlung gi lha dag dang / chos kyi phyogs snang ba mikhong du chud pa'i phyogs kyi lha dag dang ske/ ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal57ba la brtson pa'i mtshan mo'i lha dag dang /de bzhin gshegs pa'i nyi ma mngon par bsgrub pa la brtson pa'i nyi ma'i lha dag dang ske/ chos kyi dbyings thams cad kyi nam mkha'asnyibargyan pa la brtson pa'i nam mkha'i lha dag pa dang / 'gro ba thams cad srid pa'i rgya mtsho las bsgral bar brtson pa'i gang zhi chen mtsho'i lha dag dang / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du tshogs yang dag par bstsalas 7pa la brtson zhing / dge ba'i rtsa ba'i sgo5shemangon par 'phags pa'i sems dang ldan pa'i ri'i lha dgashedang / 'gro ba thams cad kyi lus brgyan par brtson zhing sangs rgyas thams cad kyi kha dog dang byin gyi rlabs la smon cing brtson pa'i chu klung gi lha dag dang / 'gro ba thams cad kyi sems kyi grong rdal yongs su bskyang bar brtson pa'i grong gi lha dag dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i chos kyi grong khyer du smon cing mos pa'i klu'i dbang po dag (nyadang /sems can thams cad yongs su bsrung /stob la zhugs pa'i gnod sbyin gyi dbang po dag dang / sems can thams cad kyi dga' ba'i shugs rnam par 'phel bar bya ba la brtson pa'i dri za'i dbang po dag dang / yi dgas52kyi rgyud thams cad rnam par bzlog pa la brtson pa'i grul bum gyi dbang po dag dang / sems can thams cad srid pa'i rgya mtsho nas gdon pa'i smon lam gyis zhugs pa'i nam mkha' 7lding gi dbang po dag dang / 'jig rten thams cad las 'phags pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku dang / stobs yongs su bsgrub par smon lam yongs su 37—678

bskyed7pa'i lha ma yin gyi dbang po dag dang / de bzhin gshegs pasko mthong bas dga' bar gyur cing / lus rab tu 'dud pa'i lto 'phye chen po'i dbang po dag dang / 'khor ba las skyo ba'i yid dang ldan zhing ngor blta ①ba'i lha'i dbang po dag dang / rim gro chen po rab tu byed cing lus rab tu 'dud pa'i tshangs pa'i dbang po dag dang / lhan cig tu de dag gis rim gro chen pos mngon par bstod ④de mchod cing / de lta bu'i byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par gnon pa'i 6)rgyan phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par4)rang gi gnas nas byung ste/bcom ldan 'das la g.yas phyogs su bskor ba lan brgya phrag du ma zhig tu byas nas / mchod pa rnam pa du mas mchod de/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga nas phyir byung nas/ lho phyogs logs su yul rgyu zhing song ngo // // sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdozha bam po nyi shu bdun52)pa/ de nas sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyis7/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bus 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par 'phrul pa'i rgyan phun sum tshogs pa de 'dra bas/ dzemanyata'i tshal nas byung ste/ lho phyogs logs su 'gro ba mthong nas/ de 'di snyam du gyur te/bdag kyang 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa dang lhan cig tu yul rgyu zhing 'gro'o72snyam nas/ de dge slong drug cu 32tsam gyis bskor cing mdun du byas te/ rang gi gnas nas byung nas/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der song ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal nas/ bcom ldan 'das la zhus te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gnang ba dang / bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum du mibaskor ba byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngamatshanas phyir byung ste/37—679

'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa gang na ba der dge slong lhan cig tu spyod pa rab tu byung nas ring po ma lon paraspyigasar du zhugs pa sha stag ste/ 'di ltar dge slong rgya mtsho'i blo dang / legs par byin pa chen po dang / bsod nams kyi 'od dang / bu chen po dang kunasakhyab sbyin pa dang / rnam dag spyod pa dang /lha'i dpal dang rlo )/ dbang po'i blo gros dang / tshangs pa'i dam pa dang /dge slong zhi ba'i blo gros dang / de dag la stsogs pa'i⑧dge slong drug cu tsamasakun kyang / sngon gyi rgyal ba la bya ba byas pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed 0pa/mos pa zab mor gyur pa/ dad pa'i myig yongs su dag pa/ sems rgya chen pos yongs su spyod pa/ sangs rgyas kyi phyogs rnam par blta ba la mthu yod pa/chos kyi ngo bo nyid dang / rang bzhin nges par rtogs pa'i sems dang ldan pa/gzhan la phan par gyur pa'i blo can/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan la mngon par mos pa/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas〈chos bstan pas 'dul ba sha stag dang 'grogs shing mdun du byas te sngon du bdar nas/ 'jarma dpal gzhon nur gyur pa gang na ba der dong ngo / /de nas tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i7bus de ltar lam du zhugs te/ 'dong ba'i7tshe dge slong de dag kun la bltas nas/ dge slong rgya mcho1re blo la smras pa/ rgya mchoXre blo byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal gyi lus mtshan dang dpe byad bzang pos rnam par brgyan cing ske/ yongs su dag pa/ lha dang mir bcas parwaskrebasam gyis myi khyab pa dang /'od kyi dkyil 'khor yongs su dag cing sems can tshad myed pa'i (nyedaga' ba yongs su skyed pa dang / 'od zer gyi dra ba'i rgyan sems can dpag tu myed pa'i sdug bsngal rab tu zhi bar byed pa dang / 'khor phun sum tshogs pa sngon gyi 37wa 680

dge ba'i rtsa bas7yongs su bzung ba dang / lam gyi rgyan 'gro na⑧lam myigashemangs ris su gnas pa dang lam rnam par gnon pa'i rgyan phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad la mngon par lta b.rasreganas pa dang / bsod nams phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyan g.yas g.yon nas gter chen polamangon par 'thon pa dang sngon gyi sangs rgyas la rim gro byas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dang rgyu mthun ⑥pas/shing gi gseb ④thams cad nas rgyan mang po 'byung ba dang / 'jig rten gyi dbang po thams cad la'umachod pa'i sprin gyi char mngon par 'bebs shing btud de phyag 'tshal ba dang / phyogs bcu nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'od zer gyi dra ba'i dkyil 'khor mang po bkye ba/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad rab tu sgrog cing spyi bor 'char ba la ltos shig ces de dag la sogasalgepa tshe dang ldan pa shā ri'i bus/ 'jam dpal gzhon51nur gyur parwanyelam du zhugs pa'i yon tan gyi rgyan tshad med pa dag /dge slong de dag la〈nyeyongs su bstan to / /brjod do bshad do/ /smos so/ /bkrol lo/ /rab tu brjod do/ /rnam par phye'o/ /gsalachabar byas so/ /de ltar gnas brtan shāmosari'i bus 'jam dpalacagazhon nur gyur pa'i yon tan ci7tsam ci tsamanyedu brjod pa de tsam de tsamarwa'edu dge slong de dag gi sems rnam par dag par gyur to/ /rab tu dang bar gyur to/ /dga' ba'i shugs rnam par 'phel bar gyur to/ /mos pa skyes par gyur to/ /de dag gi sems kyi5 kyergyud las zhu su rung bar gyur to/ /dbang po rab tu dang bar gyur to/ /yid bde ba rnam par 'phel bar gyur to/ /yid myi bde ba rab tu byang nyebar gyur to/ /sems kyi skyon dang bral bar gyur to/ /sgrib pa thams cad phyir ldog par gyur to/ /sangs rgyas blta ba la mngon par 37—681

mos par gyur to/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos la sems rab tu gzhol bar gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dbang po yongs su dag par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa'i dad pa'i shugs skyes par ༅7gyur to/ /snying rje chen po byungakhubar gyur to/ /pha rol tu phyin pa'i dkyil 'khor gnon par gyur to/ /snying rje chen po yongs su skyes par gyur tori no/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rgya mtsho yongs su snang bar gyur to / /de ltar de dag thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du mos pa'i shugs thob par gyur nas 'di skad 'dzer to/ /mkhan po bdag cag kyang skyes bu dam pa de'i drung du phyin par mdzad du gsol zhes nas/ de nas tshe dang ldan pa shā'ageri'i bu dge slong de dag dang 45'grogs te/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa gang na ba der song nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /'jam dpal dge slong 'di dag ni khyod la blta bar 'dod pa dag go/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas dge slong de dag dang / 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor gyisayisa'i phyogs de tsam dang7bcas par geglang po'i lta stangs kyi rtsogazi dang ldan par khyab par bltas pa dang / de'i rjes layodage slong de dag gis 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal nas/ thal mo sbyar te 'di skad ces smras so/ /skyes bu dam pa khyod mthong ba dang / khyod la phyag 'tshal ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dang bdag cag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba gzhan khyod kyis mkhyen pa dang / mkhan pos thugs su chud pa dang / gang yang bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa shākya 3nyathub pas mngon du gzigs pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba des/ khyod ci 'dra ba de 'dra bar gyur 8te/ rnam pa 'di 'dra ba'i lus thob par shog shigatu / rnam pa 'di 'dra ba'i dbyangs dang / rnam pa 'di 'dra ba'i mtshan dang / 'di lta bu'i 37wa 682
