rnam par 'phrul pa dag kyang khyod ji lta ba bzhin du ①thob par shog shig ②ces dge slong de dag gis de skad du smras pa dang / 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas dge slong de dag la 'di skad ces smras so/ /dge slong dag yongs su myi skyo ba'i sems bskyed pa bcu dang ldan pa'i rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo theg pa chen po la zhugs pa ni byang chub sems dpa'i sashelta smos kyang ci smosasnyikyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sa yang gnon par 'gyur ro/ /bcu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad blta ba dang / bsnyen bkur ba dang /mchod pa dang rim gro bya ba lasayongs su mi skyo ba'i sems bskyed pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad bstsags ⑥pa las phyir mi ldog cing yongs su myi skyo ba'i sems bskyed pa dang / chos thams cad btsal ba la yongs su myi'uskyo ba'i sems bskyed pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad sbyor ba ⑨la yongs su myi skyo ba'i sems bskyed pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin thams cad yongs su bsgrub pa la yongs su myi skyo ba'i sems bskyed pa dang / dus gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa thams cad du 'jug pa la yongs su mi skyo ba'i sems bskyad pa dang / phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing rgya mtsho rgyas par dgang zhing yongs su dag par bya ba la/ yongs su myi skyo ba'i sems bskyed pa dang / sems can gyi khams thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba dang /gdul ba la yongs su mi skyo ba'i sems bskyed pa dang / zhing dang bskal pa thams cad du byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa mngon par bsgrub pa la yongs su mi skyo ba'i sems bskyed pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad kyi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sbyar bas sems can gcig yongs su smin par bya 37—683

ba'i tshul du sems can thams cad yongs su smin par bya bas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs gcig yongs su bsgrub pa la yongs su mi skyo ba'i sems bskyed pa'o/ /dge slong dag yongs su mi skyo ba'i sems bskyed pa bcu po 'di dag dang ldan pa'i rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo dad pa dang ldan pa ni dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad la yongs su 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /'khor ba'i rgyud thams cad las phyir ldog par 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten gyi7rgyud thams cad las gyen du 'phags par 'gyur ro/ /nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi sa thams cad las 5yongs su 'da' bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs dang rgyud du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi smon lam la yang dag par 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yon tan gyi nan tan la rnam par dag par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa thams cad la yongs su dag par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi stobs la yang dag par 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bdud dang phas kyi ci margol ba thams cad rab tu 'dul bar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub tsums dpa'i sa yongs su gnon par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sa dang shin tu nye bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas dge slong dedza4dag gis chos kyi tshul 'di thos nas/sangs rgyas thams cad rnam par mthong ba la chags pa med pa'i mig gi 'a)yul zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob par gyur to/ /de'i mthus phyogs bcu mtha' yas mu med pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams na bzhugs pa'iyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor mthong bar gyur to/ /'jig rten gyi khams de dag gi 'gro ba'i rgyud du skyes pa'i sems can de dag kyang ma lus pa 47)mthong bar gyur 37—684

to / /'jig rten gyi khams de dag gi sems can rnams kyang ma lus par mthong bar gyur to/ /'jig rten gyi khams de dag kyang rnam par phye ba sna tshogs su mthong bar gyur to/ /'jig rten gyi khams de dag na rdul shin tu phra btuji snyed yod pa de dag kyang bgrang ba'ikhutshul gyis rab tu shes par gyur to/ /sems can de dag gi rin posache'i gnas dang / longs spyod de dag kyang mthong bar gyur to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gi dbyangs kyi yan lag rgya mtsho yang thos par gyur to/ /chos bstan pa de dag kyang tshig dang yi ge dang nges pa'i tshig0dang skad dang ming dang brdas yongs su shes par gyur to/ /sems can de dag gi sems dang dbang po dang bsam pa la yang rnam par lta bar gyur to/ /sngon gyi mtha' dang phyi ma'i mtha'i tshe rabs bcu yang rjes su dran par gyurarnyuto/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gi chos kyi 'khor lo bcu'i nges pa'i tshig mngon par bsgrub pa la yang rab tu zhugs par gyur to/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rnam par 'phrul pa mngon par bsgrub pa bcu la yang rab tu zhugs par gyur to/ /bstan pa'i tshul mngon parasnyibasgrub pa bcu la yangalo)rab tu zhugs par gyur to/ /rjes su bstan pa'i tshig ⑩mngon par bsgrub pa bcu la yang rab tu zhugs par gyur to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gi so so (hayang dag par rig 8pa'i tshul mngon par bsgrub pa bcu la yang rab tu zhugs par gyur te(rte/ ting nge 'dzin de thob ma thag tu/ byang chub kyi sems kyi yan lag stong phrag bcu yang yongs su rdzogs par gyur to/ /ting nge 'dzin stong phrag bcu yang yongs su non par gyur to/ /pha rol tu phyin pa'i yan lag stong phrag bcu yang rnam par (stedag par gyur〈nyete/snang ba chen po rab tu thob cing shes rab chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi 0snang bar 37—685

gyur pa de dag gis byang chub sems dpa'i mngon par shes pa bcu rab tu thob par gyur to/ /de ltar mngon par shes pa'i myu gu gzhonanyezhing shin tu phra ba thob ste / byang chub tu sems bskyed7pa brtan pa la gnas pa de dag 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas/ byang chub sems dpa'ashekun tu bzang po'i spyod pa la yang dag par bskul zhinas rab tu bkod do/ /de ltar byang chubashesems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa la rab tu gnas pa de dag smon lam chen po rgya mtsho la zhugs shing mngon par sgrub par gyur to/ /de ltar smon lam chen po ⑧rgya mtshos mngon par bsgrub pa'i sems rnam par dag pas lus yongs su dag pa rab tu thob par gyur to/ /lus rnam par dag pas lus yang bsherab tu thob par gyur to/ /de ltar lus rnam par dag pa dang lus yang bas tshimangon par shes pa'i sgo de dag shin tu yangs par byed pas/ mi nyams shing rjes su 'brang ba'i mngon par shes pa rab tu thob par gyur to/ /mngon par shes pa desngomathob pas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i /rtenang pa'i drung nas kyang mi g.yo la/sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad yongs su bsgrub pa'i phyir phyogs bcur yaring de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku'i 'phrin las kyi sprin mngon par bsgrub par gyur to/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas/ dge slong de dag bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bkod nas mthar gyis hunyeyul rgyu zhing lho phyogs logs su 3 skyid pa'i 'byung gnas zhes bya ba'i grong rdal chen po gang na ba der logs su song ste/ phyin nas grong rdal chen po skyid pa'i 'byung gnas kyi shar/ phyogs logs na nags tshal chen po sā lasnyisna tshogs kyi rgyal mtshan gyi rgyan ces bya ba sngon gyi sangs rgyas bzhugs bzhugs pa'i mchodarwa rten 37—686

sems can smin par mdzad7pa'i don du/ de bzhin gshegs pas byin gyis brlabs pa②/ zhing mtha' yas par ming gi sgra rjes su grags pa / sngon cadasnyibacom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa mdzad pa'i tshe/ yongs su gtangasnyibar dka' ⑥ba du ma yongs su btang bsheste/ sa'i phyogs de na lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang dri za dang lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang /mi'am ci dang lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa rnams rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par mchod pa la brtson pa'i gnas yod pa der 'khor dang bcas te phyin nas der 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas/ mdo sde chos kyi dbyings kyi tshul rab tu snang〈ba/ zhes bya ba mdo sde bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag bcu 'byung ba bstanasheto/ /de bstan pa'i tshe rgya mtsho chen po nas klu bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma nye bar lhags te/ de dag gis nyamachos kyi tshul de thos nas/ klu'i rgyud la rnam par smod cing / de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan la mos par gyur nas klu'i rgyud rnam par bzlog rte/rteste/ lha dang mir skye ba yongs su 'dzin par gyur nas / der klu stong phrag bcu bla na med pa yang dgasngo par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par gyur to/ /chos de tsobastan pa'i tshe sems can gyi khams mtha'achadang dbusam med pa/ theg pa gsum gyis dus gzhan dang gzhan du rnam par dul bar gyur to/ /de nas skyid pa'i 'byung gnas kyi mi rnams kyis/'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa nyusheskyid pa'i 'byung gnas kyi grong rdal du phyin te/ sā la tunyesna tshogs kyi rgyan gyi mchod rten py-i )gyi gzhi 'di nyid na rnam par spyod do zhes thos nas/ dge bsnyen tshong dpon shes rab chen po la sogasams1pa/ dge bsnyen pha dang / dge bsnyen ma dang / khye'u dang bu mo mang po dag so so nas 37—687

'khor lnga brgya lnga brgya0)dang bcas te/ skyid pa'i 'byung gnas kyi grong rdal nas byung nas/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa gang na ba der dong ngo / /de la dge bsnyen shes rab chen po ni dge bsnyen bzang pos byin dang / lhas7byin dang ske/ bsod nams 'od dang / grags pa'i lha dang grags pas byin dang /zla ba'i dpal dang / zla ba yidaga' bosredang / blo gros bzang po dang / blo gros chen po dang / sgra gcan rgyabazang po dang / dge bsnyen bzang po'i dpal dang ske/ de dag la sogs ⑥pa dge bsnyen lnga brgyas bskor cing mdun du byas te/'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa gang na ba der dong nas/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la lan gsum du bskor ba byas nas/ phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /de la dge bsnyen ma shes rab chen mo ni/ dge bsnyen ma 'od bzang mo dang /lus bzang mo dang / dge ba yod pa dang / dge ba'i dpal dang / gazla ba'i 'od dang / dpal gyi 'od dang / dpal bzang mo dang / dge bsnyen ma mig bzang mo dang / de dag la sogs kyepa dge bsnyen ma lnga brgyas bskor cing mdun du byas te/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa gang na ba der dong nas/'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la lan gsum du bskor ba byas nas/ phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /de la tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs7ni/ tshong dpon gyi bu brtul zhugs bzang po dang / tshul khrims bzang po dang / ngang tshul bzang po dang / rnam par gnon pa bzang po dang / bsam pa bzang po dang / blo gros bzang po dang / blo bzang po dang / mig bzang po dang / lag pa 37—688

bzang po dang / tshong dpon gyi bu hu)'od bzang ④po dang / de dag la sogasashepa tshong dpon gyi bu lnga brgyas bskor cing mdun du byas te/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa gang na ba der dong nas/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la lan gsumaphubaskor ba byas tephyi/ phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /de la khyim bdag shes rab chen po'i bu mo dge ba bzang mo ni bu mo bzang mo (5)dang / yid du 'ong ba'i bzhin dang / brtan pa'i blo gros dang / dpal bzang mo dang /tshangs pas byin⑧dang / dpal gyi 'od dang / bu mo 'od bzang mo la sogs59)pa bu mo lnga brgyas bskor cing mdun du byas te/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa gang na ba der dong nas/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la lan gsum du bskor ba byas nas/ phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas skyid pa'i 'byung gnas kyi grong rdal nas 0skyes pa dang / bud med dang khye'u dang bu mo de dag 'dus te/ 'khod par shes nas bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du bstan pa'i byin gyi tunyezil gyis mnan hu te byams pa chen po'i byin gyis tshim〈nyepar byas nas/ snying rje chen po'i byin gyis chos bstan pa mngon par bsgrubs te/ ye shes kyi byin gyis sems dang bsam pa rnam par phye nas/ so so0yang dag par rig7pa chen pos chos bstan par dga' ste / tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangasarwanyel bltas so/ /tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs /rteshes bya ba ci'i phyir nor bzangs shes bya zhe na/ tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs zhes du 3 bya ba de tethog ma ma'i mngal du zhugs ma thag tu khyim de'i 'khor kun nas rnam par 37wa 689

phye ba'i rin po che sna bdun gyi sdong po 'thon par 3)gyur to/ /rin po che'i sdong po de dag gi 'og na rin po che'i gter bdun yod de/ gser dang dngul dang be+e ḍūr+ya rinanodang / shel dang mu tig dmar po dang / a sma gar bha nodang / mu sa ra gal pa dang / rin po che des/bdun gyi rin po che'i sdong po de dag kyang gter de dag nas skyes te/ sa'i gzhi brtol nas mngon par 'thonas/par gyur to / /de yan lag dang nying lag7thams cad yongs su rdzogs te/ zla ba bcu lon nas btsas pa dang / de'i tshe gter chen po bdun po de dag kyang chu zheng9)dang rngams su khru bdun tsam du sa'i steng 8)nas mngon par 'phags te/ snang bar byung 9nas rnam par snang zhing mdzes par gyur tong/ /khyim der rin po che sna tshogs kyi snod lnga brgya yang byung bar gyur te/ 'di ltar mar gyi snod dang /til mar gyi snod dang sbrang rtsi'i snod dang mar sar 31gyi snod dang / gzhan dag kyang so so nas yo byad sna tshogs thams cad kyis 1geyongs su gang ba dag ste(gye/'di ltar rdo rje'i snod spos sna tshogs kyis 8yongs su gang ba dang / spos kyi snod gos sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba dang / man shel gyi snod kha zlos dang /spyan gzigs sna tshogs ro mchog tu zhim pas yongs su gang ba dang / nor bu'i snod rin po che sna tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba dang / gser gyi snod dngul sil mas yongs su gang ba dang / dngul gyimatshasnod gser phyes yongs su 19gang ba dang ske/ phra men gyi 1 snod nor bu rin po che be+e ḍūd+mas /sheyongs su gang ba dang /shel gyi snod mu sa ra gal pas yongs su gang ba dang / mu sa ra gal pa'i snod rin po che shel gyis 1(yongs su gang ba dang / a sma gar bha'i tsu nosnod mu tig dmar pos yongs su gang ba dang / mu tig dmar po'i snod a sma gar bhasam137wa 690

yongs su gang ba dang / nor bu rin po ches3)skar ma'i'i rgyal mtshan gyi snod nor bu kyerin po che chu 'dang gis 3)yongs su gang ba dang / nor bu rin po che chu 'dang gi snod nor bu rin po che skar ma'i rgyal mtshan gyisas)yongs su gang ba dang /de dag la sogs 4)pa rin po che'i snod lnga brgya 'thon par gyur to/ /tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangasamacho de btsas ma thag tu khyim dang bang ba dang mdzod thams cad du nor dang 'bru dang / dbyig dang / gser dang rin po che sna tshogs kyi char mngon par bab par gyur to/ /de la bram ze'i ltas 3)pa dang / pha dang ma dang gnyen gyi tshogs kyis 'di btsas ma thag tu nor mang po phun sum tshogs pa 'byungs 9)bar gyur pas na/ nor bzangs nor bzangs zhes bode ltar ming du btags te/tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs hunyade ni sngon gyi rgyal ba la bya ba byas sonye/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa'o/ /mos pa rgya chen po dang ldan pa'o/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi〈nyerjes su 'brang ba'i bsam pa can no/ /lus dang ngag dang yid kyi spyod pa kha na ma tho ba med pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa'i lam yongs su sbyangs pa skyel rab tu brtson pa'o/ /thams cad mkhyen pa la mngon par mos pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi snod du gyur pa'o/ /bsam pa'i nam mkha' yongs su dag pa'o / /byang chub kyi sems chags pa med pa yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas tshong dpon gyi /2bu nor bzangs 14la bltas te/dga' ba'i gtam byas nas de la 'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad las kyang brtsams/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad yang dag par bsdu zhing /thob 7par bya ba las kyang brtsams/ sangs rgyas thams cad gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa las kyang brtsams/ sangs rgyas nyi gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa nyurte37wa 691

thams cad shes par bya ba las kyang brtsams/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnam par dag pa las kyang brtsams/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi 'khor lo dang sprul pa'i rgyudamanyu)las kyang brtsams/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ri gzugs kyi sku'i mtshan dang dpesabyad bzang po rnam par dag pa las kyang brtsams/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi skuseyongs su grub pa las kyang brtsams / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung rnam par phye ba las kyang brtsams/sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi brgyan⑧rnam par dag pa las kyang brtsams/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mnyam7pa nyid las kyang brtsams te/chos kyang bstan par gyur to/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas/tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs medang / skye bo'i tshogs chen po de dag chos dang mthun 8༄pa'i gtam gyis tho)bstan te/ yang dag par bskul nas spro ba bskyed de17ske/ dga' bar byas nas/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed du btsud de/ sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su dran par byas nas / skyid pa'i 'byung gnas kyi grong rdal de'i sems can rnams kyi batsham pa ji lta ba bzhin du chos bstan pas/ byin gyis brlabs te hu)bde bar byas nas7de nas song ngo / /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis 8'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa las rnam pa de lta bu'i sangs rgyas kyi yon tan dang / che ba nyid thos nas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mos shing brtson pas phyi bzhin du 'brang ste/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la tshigs su bcad de mngon par bstod do/ /blo gros chen po mtha' yas spyod yul can/ /khyod kyi mthus ni sems can sman slad du/ /bdag kyang byang chub mchog tu zhugs par 37—692

gyur/ /de la nges pa gang mchis bdag lasashegason/ /dga' ba'i chusalabakang 'obs kyis kun nas bskor/ /nga rgyal dregs pa'i ra ba mtho ②bar brtsegs/ /sems can lam rgyudangusgo rnams btsud cing gdangs⑤/ /de 'dra'i khyim ni srid gsum ming ldan che7/ /de ni gti mug ma rig 9)gzings pas khebs / /'dod chags zhe snang me lces rab tu gdungs/ /rtag par bdud kyi dbang po'i dbang du gyura'u)/ /de la byis pa ma rig rten kyang 'cha'/ /sredashepa'i sgrog dang zhags pas ⑩shin tu glags/ /g.yo dang sgyu yi skyon gyis tho btsams5)shing / /the tsom0)yid gnyis dag gis mig mdongs pa/ /log pa phyin7phyogs lam la rab tu zhugs/ /phrag dog ser sna'i thag pas btags shing bcings / / yi dgas 8byol song sems dmyal mi khom rgyu'i/ /rga shi na tshadang skye bas rab tu mnar/ /mgo rmongs lam rgyud 'khor lo kun tu 'khor/ /de la khyod ni thugs 0rje rnam dag pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor ye shes 'od zer snang ba mdzad / /nyon mongs rgya mtsho bskamatshwanyepar shar te 'phags/ /nyi ma 'dra bas bdag la snang ba mdzod/ /byams pa bsgoms pas dkyil 'khor rdzogs shing nya/ /bsod nams zla 'od bde ba'i gzer 'gyed pa/ /sems can kun gyi gnas su shar gyur mirte/ /zla ba nya ba lta bus bdag snang mdzod/ /dkar mthus〈kye thams cad yongs bstsags dkor nyamanga' zhings nye/ /chos dbyings mkha' la chags pa med5 nyemanga' ba/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rin chen sngon 'drenamanyepas/ /rgyal por gyur pas bdag la bstan du gsol/ /byang chub theg pa'i smon lam mthumanyamanga' ste / /bsod nams ye shes shin tu yangs bstsags5 9shing / /sems can kun la phan pa'i don zhugs rdunyepa'i/ /ded dpon chen pos bdag kyang bskyang du 37wa 693

gsol / /bzod pa brtan zhing sra ba'i go man bas te/ /ye shes bshanatumanga' thugs rje'i phyag ring bas/ /bdud kyi dmaga'ad dpung tshogs rnams mngon gyur par ske/ /dpa' ba chen pos bdag gi bselalogayang mdzod/ /chos kyi ri rab sposalal brtan bzhugs 6shing / /ting 'dzin mchog gi lha mos kun nas bskor/ /nyon mongs sgra gcan 7lha min 'dul mdzad〈nyepa/ /brgya byin gyur pas bdag kyang gzigs su gsol/ /byis pa'i gnas gyur khams gsum khang pa na/ /nyon mongs las rnams rnam par bsal ba mkhyen/ /rgyu yi sa dang lam rgyud 'khor rmongs par/ /me mar 'dra bas bdag kyang shul bstan gsol/ /ngan 'gro'i lam rnams rnam par zlog gnyamadzad cing / /bde bar 'gro ba'i lam rnams rnam sbyong ba/ /'jig rten kun gyi lam gyi rgyud las 'das/ /bdag la'ang thar pa'i sgo ni bstan du gsol/ /rtag dang bdag dang bde bar 'du shes ldan/ /log 'dzin sgo re'i 1 skyabs kyis gcad gyur kyis37/ /bden pa'i ye shes spyan rno mchog mnga' bas/ /thar sgo bdag la'ang myur du dbye bar gsol/ /yang dag log pa'i lam la mkhas gyur cing / /lam gyi hu rgyus dang tshul la bsnyengs mi mnga' / /lam rnams kun gyis 'dul ba thugs chud pa1rnye/ /bdag la byang chub shul ni nyu bstan du gsol/ /yang dag lta ba'i skas yi thang la bzhugs/lha/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi yon tan chab kyis bskrunanyi rme/ /sangs rgyas chos legs me tog char 'bebs pa/ /byang chub shul ni bdag la bstan du gsol/ /rgyal ba gang 'das ma byon gang rnams dang / /da ltar byung ba'i rgyal ba snang mdzad pa/ /sems can gtso bo legs par gshegs pa'i phyogs/ /de yang lam sgron nyi mdzad pas 19bdag bstan gsol/ /las kyi 'khrul 'khor tshul la mi bsnyengasalo )pa/ /37—694

chos theg shing rta'i 'khrul 'khor mkhyen gyur cing / /ye shes theg pa'i tshul la rnam nges pa/ /byang chub theg pa bdag la bshad du gsol/ /mos shing smon pa'i 'khor lo7)mu khyud can/ /bzod pa rdo rjedza snying rje srog shing brtan / /dad pa'i gnya' shing rin chen legs spras pa'i/ /byang chub theg la bdag kyang bskyonam༅du gsol/ /gzungs rnams kun gyi〈rnam dag dkyil 'khor can/ /byams pa brtsegs pa'isridaga' bas rab brgyan pa/ / so sosheyang dag rigashoshepa'i dril 'phringamatshecan/ /theg mchog bzang po bdag la bstan du gsol/ /tshangs pa'i spyod pa'i lam gyis mngon par brgyan/rmi/ /ting 'dzin bud med khrag khrig kun nas rgyu/ /chos kyi rnga yi〈nyedabyangs chen rab bsgrags hu pa/ /theg pa'i dam pakhebadag la bstabs sulagasol/ /bsdu ba bzhi yi mi zad mdzod ldan pa/ /ye shes rin chen yon tan phreng gis tsobargyan/ /khrel yod dul ba'i 'phreng bas mchog bsdams pa'i/ /theg pa'i nyurtedam pa bdag la bstan du〈shegasol / /sbyin pa'i 'od zer dkyil 'khor bzang po can/ /tshul khrims tsan dan snying rje'i byug ldan zhing / /bzod pa'i gzer gyis mtshams nyurternams dam sbyar ba'i/ /theg pa'i mchog la myur du bdag bzhag zhu) gsol/ /sems can thams cad 'dul las mi ldog 31pa/ /bsam gtan ting 'dzin kha52khyer mthor sgron cing / /shes rab thabs gnyis 'byor mthun dro 'gro rgyu ba'i/ /chos kyi theg pa'i kunamachog la bdag bzhag (gegasol/ /smon lam 'khor los lam gyi 'khor sbyong ba/ /chos kyi gzungs dam mthu brtan che ldan zhing / /ye shes 'khrul 'khor legs sbyangs legs byas pa'i/ /chos kyi theg pa de la bdag skyon (5gsol / /kun tu bzang du po'i spyod pas rab sbyangs shing / /sems can lta bas 37—695

rgyu la thogs med pa/ /kun tu bzang po'i spyod pas gnon gyur pa'i①/ /ye shes theg⑧pas bdag la bsdud7du gsol/ /de ni brtan pas rdo rje bzhin gnas pa/ /ye shes sgyu mas legs sbyangs legs byas shing / /sgrib dang chags pa thams cad gcod pa yiyi/ /bzang po'i theg la bdag kyang bskyon du ⑦gsol / /'gro mnyam dri med shin tu yangs gyur pal/ /sems can thams cad skyobashepas bde sgrub cing / /chos dbyings shin tu rgya chen rnam snang ba'i/ /byang chub theg la bdag kyang bskyon du gsol/ /sdug bsngal phung po rab 'byung gcod byed pa/ /nyon mongs las kyi rdul mang sbyong sel cing / /bdud dang phas kyi rgol ba kun 'joms (7pa'i/ /chos kyi theg la bdag kyang bskyon du gsol / /phyogs rnams kun tu ye shes rab snang ba/ /chos dbyings nam mkha' rnam par klubs hu byed cing / /sems can kun gyi bsam pa rdzogs byed pa'i(nye/ /chos kyi theg la bdag kyang bskyon du gsol/ /rnam dag mkha' ltar tshad med mi zad pa/ /sred dang ma rig lta ba'i skyon med cing / /sems can kun la phan par rab gnas pa'i/ /chos kyi theg la bdag kyang bskyon du gsol/ /rlung chen langs pa'i shugs kyi shugs ldan pas/ /smon lam mthu7yis 'jig rten kun 'dzin cing / /zhi ba'i gnas rab kun sar skyel byed pa'i/ /chos kyi theg la bdag kyang bskyon du gsol/ /sa chen bzhi yi stobs kyi stobs7ldan pa/ /snying rje'i mthu dang shugs kyis khur khyer zhing / /ye shes lo togaca'agro ba nyer 'tsho ba'i/ /theg pa'i mchog la bdag kyang bskyon〈nyedu gsol/ /nyi ma lta bur 'gro ba nyer 'tsho zhing / /bsdu ba rab yangs 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor can/ /gzungs kyi stobs mchog dag pa'i 'od bzang ba'i(7/ /ye shes nyi ma bdag la 37—696

bstan du gsol/ /bskal pa mang po du mar rab bslabs pas①/ /rgyu yi tshul dang sa kun mkhas gyur pa/ /gang gis 'dus byas grong khyer gzhom 'gyur ba'i/ /shes brtan rdo rje 'phags pas bdag la stsalasadu gsol/ /sangs rgyas legs kun bslab pa phun sum gyis/ /ye shes rgya mtsho yangs pa gang zhig la/ /tshad med rgya mtsho'i blo mang bslab gyur pasal/ /de legs ci ④'dra 'phags pas bka' stsalasnyegasol/ /gang na yang dag spyan mnga' khyod bzhugs shing / /ye shes rgyal po'i cod pan legs brgyan te/ /chos kyi dbu thod dam pas dbu bcings pa'iyi/ /chos kyi rgyal po'i pho brang bdag kyang ston/ de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas glang po'i lta stangs kyisashebaltas te/ tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangasashel 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu de ltar khyod kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed de/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rjes su 'brang zhing byang chub sems dpa'i lam yongs su rdzogs par bya bar 'dod de(spe/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yongs su dri bar bsam pa legs so legs ru'inye/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la bsnyen (stecing bsten pa dang / rim gror bya ba 'di ni thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yongs su grub par 'gyur ba'i gzhi yin te 'di ni mthun tunyepa'i rgyu yin gyisatso/ rigs kyi bu de bas na khyod kyis / dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsnyen〈nyebakur bas yongs su mtshwanyeskyo bar gyis shig /nor bzangs kyis5 bye smras pa / 'phags pa ji ltar byang chub sems dpas tebyang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bgyi/ ji ltar nan tan du bgyi/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa brtsam (nyapar bgyi/ ji ltar byang chub sems 37—697

dpas7byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa lakhuspyad par bgyi/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpas ③byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yongs su rdzogs par bgyi/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpas ④byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yongs su sbyang bar bgyi / ji ltar byang chub sems dpas7byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug par bgyi/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpasarnyubyang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa mngon par bsgrub par bgyi/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpasashebyang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i rjes su 'brang bar bgyi/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpas〈kyebyang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la lhag par dmigs par bgyi/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rgyas par bgyi/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpas kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ba rgya cher bstan du gsol/ de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur7)gyur pas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs la tshigs su bcad de smras pa/ / dge ba'irwatebasod nams gang nyi chen mtsho/ /de ltar khyod ni nga yi drung du nyer phyin te/ /snying rje snying brtse 3)rgya chen gyi/ /yid ldan byang chub dam pa tshol bshelegs/ /'gro ba thams cad dgrol don du/ /spyod pa mtshungs med don du smon lam rab 'debs shing / /'gro ba kun gyi skyabs 'gyur ba/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pasnyitsal 'di yin/ /byang chub sems dpa'i brtan pa7rnams/ /'khor ba'i nang na skyo med yid kyis 3)spyod byed pa/ /de dag kun tu bzang po asnye/ /spyod pa thub med chags med 'thob par 'gyur/ /bsod nams 'od can bsod nams dpal/ /de ltar khyod ni kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa la/ /'gro la phan phyir smon byed pa/ /bsod nams rgya mtsho dge zhing ཿ/dag pa'i mtshan/ /mtha' 37—698

dang dbus7skyed tshad myed pa'i/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten sangs rgyas kun kyang mthong bar 'gyur/ /dran pa'i mthu dang stobs kyis7kyang / /de dag chos kyi sprin kyang yongs su 'dzin par 'gyur/ /de ltar khyod kyis phyogs bcu yi/ /sangs rgyas zhing rnams kun tu rgyal ba mthong nas kyang / /byang chub spyod pa'i don gyi phyir/ /de dag kun la smon lam rgya mtsho dag byed 'gyur/ /'jig rten gtso5kyil slob byed cing / /gang rnams sangs rgyas sa la gnas ni bcas byas shing ske/ /'di tshul rgya mtshor zhugs gyur pa/ /de dag kun kyang thams cad gzigs par 'gyur/ /khyod ni 'byamasnyiklas zhing kun tu/ /bskal mang zhing rdul snyed du kun tu bzang po gyi/ /spyod pa'i dam pa spyod byas shing / /byang chub dam pa zhi ba 'thob par 'gyur/ /zhing rnams mtha' dang dbus med pa⑦/ /ma lus kun tu bskal pa rgya mtshor spyad par gyis/ /kun tu bzang po'i spyod mchog phyir/ /smon lam rgya chen yongs su rdzogs par byos/ /khyod ni7smon lam thos gyur nas/ /sems can khrag khrig dga' ba yongs su skyes gyur cing / /kun tu bzang0)po'i ye shes kyis/ /byang chub mchog tu smon pa byed la ltos/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas tshigs su bcad pa de dag smras nas/tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangasatshamal 'di skad ces bsgo'o(nye/ /rigs kyi bu de ltar khyod bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed cing /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yongs su btsal bar sems pasko7legs so legs so / /rigs kyi bu 'di ltar bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa de lta bu'i sems can yang rab tu dkon te/ de bas kyang tunyegang gisatshwastebla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed nas/37—699

byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yongs su tshol ba de lta bu'i sems can ni ches dkon no/ /rigs kyi bu de bas na byang chub sems dpas7)thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes thob par bya ba'i phyir/ yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen las gdon mi za bar rtogs pa thob par gyis shig /dge ba'i bshes gnyen yongs su btsal khub la yongs su skyo ba'i yid med par gyis shig /dge ba'i bshes ①gnyen blta ba la ngoms pa med par gyis shig /dge ba'i bshesasnyiganyen gyis bstan pa la mthun 5par 'dzin par gyis shig /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi ⑥thabs mkhas pa'i spyod pa la khong khro ba med par gyis shig /rigs kyi bu lho phyogs kyi rgyud 'di nyid na/ yul mi mo gya rnam mchog ces bya ba yod de/ de na mgul legs pa zhes bya ba'i ri zhig yod pa de la/ dge slong sprin gyi dpal zhes bya ba 'dug gis 7de'i gan du song la/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bya ba dang / ji ltar nan tan5bdu bya ba dang ske/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa brtsamashepar bya ba dang / ji ltar byang chub sems dpas yibyang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la spyad 11par bya ba dang / ji ltar byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yongs su rdzogs par bya ba dang / ji ltar yongs su dag par bya ba dang / ji ltar 'jug〈rtepar bya ba dang / ji ltar mngon par bsgrub par bya ba dang / ji ltar rjes su 'brang bar bya ba dang / ji ltar lhag par snyedamigs par bya ba dang / ji ltar rgyas par bya ba dang / ji ltar byang chub sems dpasam kun tu bzang po'i 8spyod pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ba dris shig dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen des khyod skyal kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa'i dkyil 'khor ston to/ /de 37wa 700

nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs7dga' rangs te②/ mgu zhing nyams bde la tshimakhuzhing yid bde ba skyes nas/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la lan brgya stong du mar g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas nas/ lanasrebargya stong du mar phyir bltas te/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen yid du 'ong ba'i sems dang ldan pas/dge ba'i bshes gnyen mi mthong ba0mi bzod de/ gdong mchims gang bar du zhing 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa'i drung nas ⑥song ngo / /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs ⑦mthar gyis yul mi mo gya nom mchog ces bya ba der song ste phyin nas/ yul mi mo gya rnam mchog nas rnam par brgyus7te/ sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa bas byung zhing las rgya chen pos7byin gyis brlabs pa'i longs spyod yid du 'ong ba la yongs su spyod cing ri mgul legs pa gang na ba der phyin nas/mgul legs pa'i ri la 'dzegs te/ dge slong sprin gyi dpal la chosarwa)tshol zhing ske/ shar phyogs logs su byung ngo / /de bzhin du lho dang nub dang byang dang byang7shar gyi phyogs mtshams dang / shar lho'i phyogs mtshams dang / lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams dang / nub byang gi phyogs mtshams su yang byung7ste/ bla 'og tu'ang lta cizhing dge slong sprin gyi dpal tshol tshol ba las des zhag bdun lon pa dang / dge slong sprin gyi dpal ri rtse cig gisnyisman ljongs na 'chag cing 'dug pa mthong nas/ de (nyidage slong sprin gyi dpal gang na ba der song ste/dge slong sprin gyi dpal gyi rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal nas/ dge slong sprin gyi dpal la g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas te/ mdun du 'dug nas thal mo sbyar te 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phags parwanyethugs su chud par mdzad du 37—701

gsolam/ bdag gis0)bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed na/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bgyi ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bgyi ba dang / ji ltar byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa brtsam ri pa dang / ji ltar byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la spyad (par bgyi ba dang / ji ltar byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yongs susnyirdzogs par bgyi ba dang / ji ltar yongs su dag par bgyi ba dang / ji ltar 'jug par bgyi ba dang / ji ltar rjes su 'brang bar bgyi ba tshedang / ji ltar mngon par bsgrub par bgyi bsnyodang / ji ltar lhag par dmigs par bgyi ba dang ske/ ji ltar rgyas par bgyi ba dang / ji ltar byang chub sems dpa'7kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ba ma 'tshal te/'phags pa khyod ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gdams5ningag dang / rjes su ston pa mdzad ces thos natsos/ 'phags pa ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu 'byung bar 'gyur ba bdag la bstan du gsol/ de skad ces smras pa dang / dge slong sprin gyi dpal gyis tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs mil 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu de ltar khyod kyis 11bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed cing /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yongs su 'dri kyi ba legs so thegelegs so/ /rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yongs su btsal ba dang /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod yul yongs su btsal ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i 'byung nyasteb rnam mapar dag pa yongs su btsal ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i lam rnam par dag pa yongs su btsal ba dngamo / byang chub sems 37wa 702

dpa'i spyod pa rgya chen po7rnam par dag pa yongs su btsal ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i mngon par shes pa bsgrub pa rnam par dag pa yongs su bcol ba dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa yongs su bstan pa dang /byang chub sems dpa'i snang ba'i snying rje'i rgyud yongs su bstananesapa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i 'gro ba'i bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du rjes su 'brang ba dang /byang chub sems dpas〈 )'khor ba dang / mya ngan las 'das pa'i sgo yongs su bstan pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'athobarnams kyi 'dus byas dang / 'dus ma byas kyi skyon dang / 'jigs pas mi gos pa'i rgyud yongs su btsal ba 'di ni dka'o / /shin tu dka'o/ /rigs kyi bu kho bo ni mos pa'i stobs kyipo)dbang gis mig gi blo gros dang / dad pa'i mig rnam par dag pas kun tu mngon par lta ba'i ye shes kyi 'od snang ba/ phyin tshon phyogs med pa dang / yul kun la thogs 6)pa med cing sgrib hu )pa 9/7thams cad dang / bral ba'i lhag mthong la mkhas pa dang / mig gi yul kun nas yongs su dag pa'i lus rnam par dag pa dang ske/ phyogs kyi rgyud 'byamatsha/)klas pa thams cad du mngon par 'dud pa'i lus kyis 'dud pa la mkhas pa dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi sprin yongs su 'dzin pa'i gzungs kyi〈nyestobs kyis phyogs kyi rgyud thams cad minas mngon du gzigs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams mthong ste/ 'di ltar shar phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa gcig kyang mthong ngo / /sangs rgyas gnyis dang bcu dang /sangs rgyas brgya dang / sangs rgyas stong dang / sangs rgyas brgya phrag stong dang ske/ sangs rgyas bye ba dang / sangs rgyas bye ba brgya dang be/ sangs rgyas bye ba stong dang / sangs rgyas bye ba brgya phrag stong dang / sangs rgyas bye ba khrag 37wa 703

khrig brgya phrag 3)stong nas de bzhin gshegs pa tshad med pa②/ dpag tu med pa400/ grangs med pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa mtshungs pa med pa/ kun tu mtha' yas pas mtshams med pa/ gzhal du med pa/ brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa dag kyang mthong ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa 'dzam bu'i7gling gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyang mthong ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa7gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi 56)rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang / stong dang / stong gnyis pa dang / stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i mesangs rgyas kyi zhing gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyang mthong ngo ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyang mthong ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing brgya'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing brgya phrag stong gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed da nga /sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba phrag brgya'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba phragashestong gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba brgya phrag stong gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba khrag khrig brgya phrag stong gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed nas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed dag kyang mthong ste/ shar phyogs logs su ji lta bsngo snabazhin du/ lho phyogs dang nub phyogs dang / byang phyogs dang / byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams dang / shar lho'i phyogs mtshams dang / lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams dang / nub byang gi phyogs mtshams dang / 'og dang bla'i phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa gcig kyang mthong ba nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa 37—704

sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'isheyang brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed ②dag kyang mthong ba'i bar du ste/ phyogs re rer rnam par bltas kyang /de bzhin gshegs pa kha dog sna tshogs mnga' ba dang / dbyibs sna tshogs mnga' ba dang / rnam par 'phrul pa sna tshogs mnga' ba dang / khyu mchog gi mthu dang /rnam par rol pa sna tshogs mnga' ba dang / 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor gyi rgyan rnam pa sna〈nyetshogs mnga' ba dang / 'od zer gyi dra ba snang ba kha dog du ma can dang /kha dog mtha' yas pa gerab tu 'gyed pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnam par dag pa dang / pho brang dang rgyan sna tshogs mnga' ba dang / sku che'i tshad rnam par dag pa rnam pa ⑤sna tshogs mnga' ba dang / 'gro ba'i bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du rnam par dmigs par mdzad pa dang / mngon par 'tshang rgya ba rnam par dag pa'i sgos rnam par 'phrul pa rnam pa sna tshogs mnga' ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi khyu mchog dang seng ge'i nga ro rnam par sgrog pa mang po mthong ngo / /de ltar rigs kyi bu kho bos ni sgo kun nas dmigs pa thams cad rnam par rig pa la yang dag par gzhol ba'i sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa 'di thob par zad na/byang chub sems dpa' zhu)ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor rnam par dag pa gang gisam/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing dngamasapho brang rnam par dag pa'i rgyan mngon par mthong bas/ sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i sgomatso)kun nas snang ba'i dkyil 'khor rab tu thob pa dang / bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du rnam par dmigs par de bzhin gshegs pa mthong bas7rnam par dag pas / sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i sgo 'gro ba thams cad du sgro btags hu7pa rab tu thob pa dang / gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu tshad med 37—705

pa'i rjes su 'brang bas 1)sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i sgo/ stobs kyis sgro btags ( pa rab tu thob 5)pa dang / gang gis 6)chos mnyan pa'i rnam pas/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku'i sprin la lta grubs/ sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i sgo chos kyis 46 sgro btags pa rab tu thob (3)pa dang gang gis phyogs rgya mtsho thams cad kyi sangs rgyas rgya mtsho tha mi dad pa la 'jug⑧pas/ sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i sgo phyogs rnam par snang ba'i snying po rab tu thob pa dang /gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa dang / khyu mchog gi mthu phyung 9)ba la 3 rab tu phra bar dmigs shing 'jug hu7pas/ sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i sgo phyogs thams cad du 'jug pa rab tu thob pa dang / bskal pa thams cad du de bzhin gshegs pa mthong zhing rnam par dmigs pa dang mi bralasngonabs / sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i sgo bskal par sgrorwanyebatags pa rab tu thob pa dang / gang gis dus thams cad du de bzhin gshegs pa mthong zhing 'grogs pa dang mi 'bral bas/ sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i sgo dus su sgro btags pas rab tu thob pa dang / gang gis sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad nas mngon par 'phags shing zil gyis bomi non pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku yongs su mthong zhing rnam par rig pa'i 17sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i sgo zhing du sgro btags pa rab tu thob pa dang / gang gis dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor rang gi sems dang bsam par yang dag par gzhol bas/ sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i sgo dus gsum du sgro btags pa rab tu thob pa dang / gang gis dmigs pa thams cad la de bzhin gshegs pa gcig nas 3 tshogacig tu brgyud 38pa yang dag par tshogs pa mthong zhing dmigs pas sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i sgo dmigs 37wa 706

par7sgro btags padza rab tu thob pa dang / gang gis skad cig gcig la 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba rnam par dmigs pas/ sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i sgo zhi bas sgro btags pa rab tu thob pa dang / gang gis nyin gcig tu gnas mthams cad du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gshegs par rnam par dmigs pas/sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i sgo 'bral gebs sgro btags pa rab tu thob pa dang /gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa re re skyil mo krung55)du bzhugs pas kyang / chos kyi dbyings thams cad du rgyas par khyab pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku rnam par dmigasar+sā)pas / sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i sgo shin tu yangs pas sgro btags pa rab tu thob9)pa dang / gang gis skra'i rtse mo gcig la sangs rgyas brjod du med pa byung ba mnyes par bya ba la 'jug pas/ sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i sgo shin tu phra bas sgro btags pa rab tu thob pa dang / skad cig gcig la 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du mngon par 'tshang rgya zhing / rnam par 'phrul pa ston pa rnam par dmigs pas/ gang gis sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i sgo rgyanas)du sgro btags pa rab tu thob pa dang / sangs rgyas byung ba thams cad kyi chos kyi 'khor lo dang / rnam par 'phrul pa dang / ye shes snang ba rab tu thob pas gang gis sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i sgo bgosas49)par sgro btags pa rab tu thob pa dang / rang gisam7sems dang bsam pa la bltas nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad snang ba rab tu (1thob pas(ge/ sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i sgo sems kyis sgro btags pa rab tu thob pa dang / 'gro ba thams cad kyis nyusnyelas rnam pa ji 8lta bur bstsags 7pa'i gzugs brnyan yongs su ston pas/ gang 37—707

gis sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i sgo las kyis7)sgro btags pa rab tu thob pa dang /chos kyi dbyings ma lus pa thams cad pad mo'i tshal gyis rgyas par sangs rgyas rnam par 'phrul pa rgya chen po ston pa/ phyogs kun tu mngon sum du dmigs pas / gang gis sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i sgo rnam par 'phrul pas sgro btags pa rab tu thob pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs brnyan gyi sprin dbyangs sgrogs tshon)pas chos kyi dbyings dang nam mkha' kun nas snang ba /gang gis sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa'i sgo nam mkhas gesgro btags pa rab tu thob pa de dag gi spyod pa shes pa'am/ yon tan brjod par nus re skan/ /song rigs kyi bu lho phyogs kyi rgyud 'di nyid na phyogs kyi ljongs rgya mtsho'i sgo zhes bya ba yod pa de na/ dge slong rgya mtsho'i sprin ces bya ba 'dug goge/ de'i gan du song la ji ltar byang chub sems dpas stso)byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bya ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bya ba dris shig dang / rigs kyi bu dge ba'i bshes 7gnyen de 8)khyod la dge ba'i rtsa ba'i tshogs dang / rgyu yongs su ston par 'gyur ro/ /tshogs kyis rgya chen po yang khong du chud par byed do/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba'i stobs dang / shugs rgya chen po yang yongs su skyed 1)par byed do/ /byang chub kyi sems kyi tshogs dang rgyu rgya chen po yang yongs su brjod par 'gyur rol/ /theg pa chen po rab tu thob hu7pa dang / snang bar 'gyur bsngonargya chen po yang bskyed nyu par byed do/ /pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshogs kyi stobs rgya chen po yang rab tu ston 〉par byed do/ /spyod pa rgya mtsho la 'jug pa'i tshul rgya chen po yang rab tu rjod 8par 'gyur ro/ /smon lam gyi dkyil 'khor rgya chen po yang yongs su sbyong bar tsha'agyur ro/ /sgo kun nas 'byungatshwa ba'i rgyan rgya chen po yang rnam 37wa 708

par sbyong b.ratu'agyur ro/ /snying rje chen po'i stobs rgya chen po yang yongs su 'phel bar byed do/ /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis5gedage slong sprin gyi dpal gyi rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal nas/ dge slong sprin gyi dpal la lan brgya stong du mar g.yas phyogasashesu bskor ba byas te/ lan brgya stong du mar phyir bltas nas/ dge slong sprin gyi dpal gyi drung nas5bsong ngo // // sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdesnyo/ bam po nyi shu brgyad paX/ de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs57dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gdams ngag de bzhinas rjes su bsam pa dang / ye shes snang ba de7)rjes su dran par bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa de rnam par dpyad pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi tshul de rjes su sbyang ba dang byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtsho'i tshul de blta57ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi dkyil 'khor de la mngon par mos par bya bsngortedang / sangs rgyas〈rtebalta ba'i phyogs de la mngon par spro bar bya ba dang / sangs rgyas rgya mtsho de la rjes su bsam pa dang / sangs rgyas gcig nas gcig tu brgyud 8pa de rjes su dran par bya ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi tshul rtogs par bya ba de khong du chud par bya ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi nam mkha' de la rjes su blta bar 3nyebyed cing /mthar gyis phyogs kyikyiljongs rgya mtsho'i sgo gang na ba dang / dge slong rgya mtsho'i sprin gang na ba der phyin nas/ dge slong rgya mtsho'i sprin gyi rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ dge slong rgya mtsho'i sprin la lan brgya stong du mar g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas nas/ dge slong rgya mtsho'i sprin gyi mdun du 'dug ste thal5nyemo sbyar nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phags pa bdag ni bla na med pa 37wa 709

yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par zhugs te/ bla na med pa'i ye shes rgya mtsho la 'jug par 'tshal na/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpa' rnams 'jig rten gyi rgyud las phyir ldog cing de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su 'grub par 'gyur ba dang / 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las rgal0)zhing thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgya mtshor 'jug par 'gyur ba dang / byis pa so so'i skye bo'i sa las gyen du 'phags par 'gyur zhing / de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs su 'grub par 'gyur ba dang / 'khor ba'i rgyud las ldog par 'gyur zhing / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i rgyud du 'jug par 'gyur ba dang / 'khor ba'i⑧rgya mtsho ②rgyud kyi 'khor lo 4las phyir ldog cing byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dang / smon lam gyi 'khor lor 'jug par 'gyur ba dang / bdud kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad rab tu 'joms shing dzesangs rgyas kyi dkyil 'khor 'byung ba thams cad rab tu ston pa dang / srid pa'i rgya mtsho yongs su skems shing snying rje chen po'i mtsho rnarme par 'phel bar byed pa dang / mi khom pa dang ngan song dang / ngan 'gro dang log par ltung ba thams cad kyi sgo gcod cing / mtho ris dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i sgo 'byed 6)pa dang / khams gsum gyi grong khyer gyi sgo rnam par gcod cing thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi pho brang gi sgo rnam par 'byed pa dang /yo byad thams cad kyi sred pa rnam par spong zhing 'gro ba thams cad bsdu ba'i smon lam yongs su bskyed 3 par 'gyur ba ma 'tshal lor/ /de skad ces smras pa dang /dge slong rgya mtsho'i sprin gyis tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs 9)la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyis de ltar bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa legs so legs so/ /rigs kyi bu dge ba'i rtsa ba ma 37—710

bskyed pa'i sems can rnams ni byang chub tu sems7kyang mi skye ba'i⑧dge ba'i rtsa ba sgo kun tu snang ba rab tu thob pa dang / thabs kyi snying po dang ldan pa'i lam gyi ting nge 'dzin gyi ye shes snang bas rab tu snang bar 'gyur ba (midang /bsod nams kyi7rgya mtsho'i tshogs rgya chen po bstsagasalgepa dang / dkar po'i tshogs thams cad kyi rgyun mi 'chad pa dang / dge ba'i bshes ⑥gnyen thams cad bkur bas yongs su skyo ba med pa dang / lus dang srog la 'phangs pa〈7mi rtsi0ba dang / dngos por 'dzin pa thams cad dang bral ba dang / mthon dman7)med pa'i sa ltar sems mnyam pa dang / rang bzhin gyi snying rje che zhing byams par sems pa dang ldan pa dang / srid pa'i lam gyi rgyud thams cad du gnas par 'dug57pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i yul la mngon par mos pa'i sems can rnams 8byang chub tu hu sems skye ste/ 'di ltar skosems can thams cad yongs su bskyab skopa'i phyir snying rje chen po'i sems dang 'gro ba thams cad la snyoms par nan tan du bya ba'i phyir byams pa chen po'i (9sems dang /'gro ba thams cad kyi sdug bsngal gyi phung po zhi bar bya ba'i phyir bde ba'i sems dang ske/ mi dge ba'i chos thams cad las rnam par bzlog pa'i phyir phan pa'i sems dang / 'jigs pa thams cad las yongs su bsrung ba'i hu phyir snying brtse ba'i sems dang / bsgribs hu pa thams cad rnam par bzlog pa'i phyir chags pa med pa'i sems dang / chos kyi dbyings thams cad rgyas par dgang ba'i phyir/rgya chen po'i sems dang nam mkha'i dbyings kun tu gzhol zhing kun tu 'gro bar bya ba'i phyir mtha' yas pa'i sems dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mthong zhing rnam par dmigs par bya ba'i phyir dri ma med pa'i sems dang /37—711

dus gsum gyi dmigs pa ma lus par ye shes kyis rgyas par dgang ba'i phyir rnam par dag pa'i sems dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes rgya mtsho la 'jug par bya ba'i phyir ye shes kyi sems kyang skye bar 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu kho bos ni phyogs kyi ljongs rgya mtsho'i sgo 'dir lo bcu gnyis su rgya mtsho chen po 'di la dmigs te/ mngon du byas nas 'di ltar rgya mtsho rgya che zhing tshad med pa lanyerjes su bsam pa dang / dri ma med cing dang ba dang / zab cing gting dpag dka' ba dang / bags kyisalgegazhol zhing legs par gnas pa dang / rin po che'i 'byung gnas du mas rnam par brgyan pa dang / chu'i phung po tshad med pa dang ske/ kha dog rnam pa tha dad pa mang zhing bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / 'byung po lamatha' yas pa'i gnas su gyur pa dang srog chags mang po sna tshogs kyi rten du gyur pa dang / sprin chen po'i char yongs su 'dzin pa dang / gang zhing 'bri bar 'gyur ba med pa la rjes su sems par7byed cing gnas te/ rigs kyi bu de la kho bos 'di snyam du bsam motsho/ /'jig rten gyi khams 'di na⑧rgya mtsho chen po 'di bas kyang 'phags par rgya che la 'di bas kyang yangs shing 'di bas kyang tshad medagatso)la/ 'di bas kyang ngo mtshar dang ldan pa la la zhig yod dam snyam sterdzo/ de01ltar kho bo5)tshul bzhin du bsam pa yid la byed pa la brtson par gnas pa'i tshege/ rgya mtsho chen po'i 'og gichagazhi las pad mo7chen po nor bu rin po che in+d+ra 57la thub pa med cing rdo rje lta bur sra ba'i chu ba can/ nor bu rin po che bai ḍūr+ya dam pa'i rgyan dang ldan pa/ 'dzam bu chu klung gisnyigaser ltar dri ma med pa'i lo ma rgya chen po can/ dus dang mthun57pa'i tsan dan gyi snying po'i rgyan gyis5)brgyan pa/ rin po che a sma gar bha'i5)ze ba can/ rgya 37—712

mtsho tsam du yangs shing rgya che ba lha ma yin gyi dbang po brgya stong phrag bcus sdong po'i lhun nas bzung ba/ rin po che sna tshogs brgya phrag stong gi dra bas kun nas yoganyepa/ klu yi dbang po brgya stong phrag bcus spos〈michu'i char mngon par phab pa / nam mkha' lding gi dbang po brgya stongam phrag bcus dar dngasarin po che'i lda ldi dang se ⑤mo do mang po mchus bzung thozhing rab tu sbyangs 9)pa mi'am ci'i dbang po brgya stong phrag bcus phan pa'i sems kyis kun nas blta ba/ lto 'phye chen po'i dbang po brgya stong phrag bcus 'khor nas mngon par 'dud pa/ srin po'i dbang po brgya stong phrag bcus lus 'dud5bcing mngon par mchod pa/ dri za'i dbang po brgya stong phrag bcus rol mo dang glu /7sna tshogs snyan pas bstod cing mchod pa/ lha'i dbang po brgya stong phrag bcus lha rdzas kyi me tog dang /spos dang phreng ba dang / bdug spos dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang /gos dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / lha'i ba dan gyi sprin gyi char mngon par phab pa/ tshangs pa'i dbang po brgya stong phrag bcus spyi bos gtugs77te / phyag 'tshal zhing mchod pa/ gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha brgya stong phrag bcus thal mo sbyar cing phyag bya ba/ mi'i dbang po 'khor los sgyur5)ba brgya stonganyephrag bcus rin po chetshaskyebadun gyis bsu zhing mngon par mchod pa/ rgyalamatsho'i lha brgya stong phrag bcus mngon par mthon7cing phyag bya ba/ nor bu rin po che skar ma'i ngad ⑩brgya stong phrag bcus tsho/she'od zer gyi rgyan gyis rab tu snang bar byas pa/ nor bu rin po che bsod nams kyis dag pa (7brgya stong phrag bcus mkhosam )su phebs par 'phel zhu)pas rab tu brgyan pa/ nor bu rin po che rnam par snang ba brgya du stong phrag bcus snying po rab tu gsal bar byas pa/37—713

nor bu rin po che dpal gyi snying po brgya stong phrag bcus dpal chen po shin tu 'bar bar gyur7pa/ nor bu rin po che'i mdzod snang bshebargya stong phrag bcus mtha' yas par snang bar byas pa / nor bu rin po che 'dzam bu'i chu klung brgya stong phrag bcus yongs su ston par gnas pas rab tu brgyan pa/ nor bu rin po che rdo rje'isnyiseng ge brgya stong phrag bcus thub pa med par brgyan pa/ nor bu rin po che nyi ma'i snying po brgya stong phrag bcus rgya cher gsal bar bsgrubs ༷pa/nor bu rin po che 'bar ba brgya stong phrag bcus kha dog sna tshogs su brgyan pa/nor bu rin po che yid bzhin gyi rgyal po brgya stong phrag bcus mi zad pa'i rgyan dngasre'od 'bar bar byas pa byung ste/ pad+mashechen po de ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba las byung ba'o⑧/ /byang chub sems dpa'i bsam pas yongs su brtan7pa'o/ /phyogs thams cad du mngon par dmigs su yod pa'o/ /sgyu ma'i rnam pa'i chos kyis5)byung ba'o/ /rjen pa'i dri ma med pa'i las kyis7byung ba'o/ /nyon mongs pa med pa'i chos kyi tshul gyis7brgyan pa'o/ /mi lam lta bu'i chos nyid kyis yongs su byung ba'o/ /mngon par 'du bya ba med pa'i chos kyisnyitsal gyis rgyas btab pa'o/ /chags pa med pa'i chos kyi tshul dang ldan pa'o/ /phyogs kyi khams kun tu chos kyi dbyings rgyas par 'gengs pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi yul brjod pa dang mthunasnyipa ste/ de'i rnam pa dang yon tan dang dbyibs dang / kha dog dang rgyan gyisalgemathar phyin pa tunyeni bskal pa brgya stong grangs med par yang khong du chud par mi nus te/pad mo chen po de yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku skyil mo krung5)du bzhugs pas khyab cing yongs su rgyas par mthong ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i5)sku de yang 37—714

'di nas bzung ba nas/ srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar gyi mthas7)klas par mthong ngo //de bzhin gshegs pa de'i gdan gyi rgyan bsam gyis mi khyab pa yang mthong ngo52/ /'khor gyi dkyil 'khor gyi rgyan bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi rgyan bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / mtshan phun sum tshogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / dper byad bzang po sna tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang /sangs rgyas kyi khyu mchog gi mthu (go/dang / sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku 5)mdog rnam par dag pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / spyi gtsug ltar 46)mi mthong ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / ljags yangs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa yang mthong ngos) sangs rgyas kyi gsung gi rgyan bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor bsam gyis mi khyab pa'angaspo thos so/ /stobs tshad med pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang mi bsnyengs 9 pa'i rgyan7rnam par dag pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / so so01yang dag par rig78pa'i stobs mngon par bsgrub pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa yang rjes su shes so/ /sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yang dag par bsgrub pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa yang rjes su dran no/ /mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa 32yang mthong ngo / /chos kyi sprin gyi 'brug sgra mngon par bsgrags pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang payongs su bstan pa rnam par dmigs pa'i gnas dang / rgyan bsam gyis mi khyab pa'ang thos so/ /g.yas g.yos makyi sku'i rnam pa mtshad med pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / sems can gyi don dang dgos pa bsam gyis 1 mi khyab pa yongs su grub par 'gyur ba'ang 18mthong ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa des kyang phyag g.yas pa brkyang zhing 37—715

kho bo'i mgo la byugs gyo)nas/ chos kyi rnam grangs kun nas myig ces bya ba de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi yul byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rab tu brjod pa chos kyi dbyings kyi gzhi dang / rnam pa tha dad pa thams cad rab tu snang ba chos thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor la yang dag par gzhol zhing snang bar byed pa/ zhing gi dkyil 'khor dang rnam pa thams cad ②rnam par dag pas yongs su snang ba/ phas kyi rgol ba'i dkyil 'khor thams cad rnam par 'thor ba bdud gyi dkrugs ( )ma'i dkyil 'khor thams cad du 'jomasalgepa sems can gyi khams thams cad shin tu tshim par byed pa/ sems can thams cad kyi sems kyi 55thibs po rab tu snang bar byed pa/ sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du rnam par dmigs pa/ sems can thams cad kyi dbang po'i 'khor lo'i rgyud dang / mthu snang bar56byed pa yang dag par bstan te/kho bos yang 7)kun nas mig gi chos kyi rnam grangs de blangs so/ /bzung ngo tsāspel to bsams so/ /de ltar bzung ba de la'ang bri na ni snag tsha rgya mtsho chen po'iphuphung po tsam dang / spyilo)gu'i phung po ri rab ri'i rgyal po tsam zad par gyur kyang chos kyi rnam grangs de las le'u re re dang sgo re re dang chos kyi tshul re re dang chos kyi tshig rnam par phye ba re re las kyang zad pa'am/ 'grib pa'am/ 'byang〈3 ba'am / mthar thug pa'am/ mtha' zad par 'gyur ba dmigs par mi rung ngo ske/ /rigs kyi bu de ltar bdag gis 31lo bcu gnyis tshang bar chos kyi rnam grangs kun nas mig ces bya ba 'di la nyi ma gcig cing hurteyang thos pa 'dzin pa'i gzungs kyi 'od snang bas le'u grangs med pa zhig khong du chud do/ /zhi ba'i sgo'i gzungs kyi 'od snang bas //le'u grangs medatswapa zhig la zhugs so/ /glong mtha' 37—716

yas pa'i gzungs kyi 'od snang bas le'u grangs med pa zhig la yang dag par 'jug go/ /sa la rnam par dpyod7cing rjes su rtog⑧par byed pa'i gzungs kyi 'od snang bas le'u grangs med pasazhig rnam par bsgoms te7rnam par dbye ba byas so/ /gzi brjid dang ldan pa'isnyigazungs kyi 'od snang bas le'u grangs med pa zhig yongs su blangs so/ /pad mo'i rgyan gyi gzungs kyi 'od snang bas le'u grangs med pa zhig mngon par bsgrubs so/ /dbyangs kyi tshul gyi gzungs kyi 'odashesnang bas le'u grangs med pa zhig yang dag par bshad do/ /nam mkha'i snying po'i gzungs kyi 'od snang bas le'u grangs med pa zhig rab tu phye ba'opo)/ /skar ma brtsegs pa'i gzungs kyishe'od snang bas le'u grangs med pa zhig shin tu rgyas par byas so/ /rgya mtsho snying po'i gzungs kyi 'od snang bas le'u grangs med pa zhig yongs su bkod do/ /kho bo'i drung du shar phyogs logs〈nyenas lha dang lha'i7dbang po'am/ klu dang klu'i dbang po'am/ gnod sbyin dang gnod sbyin gyi dbang po'am/ dri za dang dri za'i dbang po'atshonye/ lha ma yin dang lha ma yin gyi dbang po'am/ nam mkha' lding dang nam mkha' lding gi dbang po'am/ mi'am ci dang mi'am ci'i dbang po'am/ lto 'phye chen po dang78/ lto 'bye chen po'i dbang po'am/ mi dang mi'i dbang po'am/ tshangs pa dngasnyi/ tshangs pa'i dbang po'am/ sems can gang su 'ongs kyang rung ste/ de dag thams cad de bzhin gshegs pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa snang ba'i chos kyi rnam grangs kun nas mig ces bya ba 'di nyid la rab tu bkod cing btsud de⑩/ de dag kun kyang kun nas mig gi chos kyi rnam grangs 'di nyid la mos par byas so/ /rtog〈nyetu btsud do/ /yongs su bstan to/ /yang dag par brjod do/ /yongs 37—717

su gsal hunyebar byas so/ /rnam par phye'o/ /rgyas par byas so/ /mngon par bstan to/ /rnam par bkrol52lo rab tu phye'o/ /shin tu snang bar byas so/ /de ltar shar phyogs la ji lta ba de bzhin du lho phyogs dang / nub phyogs dang /byang phyogs dang / byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams dang / shar lho'i phyogs mtshams dang / lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams dang / nub byang gi phyogs mtshams dang ske/ 'og dang bla'i phyogs nas sems can gang su 'ongs kyang rung ste/ kun la yang snga ma bzhin no/ /rigs kyi bu de ltar kho bos ni chos kyi rnam grangs gcig cig shes par zad na/ byang chub sems dpa'i mismon lam yongs su dag pa dang ldan pas/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rgya mtsho thams cad la zhugs pa dang / bskalam pa thams cad du gnas pa rgyun mi 'chad ④pa'i phyir smon lam rgya mtsho thams cad la zhugs pa dang / bsam 6)pa ji lta ba bzhin du rjes su 'brang bar bya ba'i phyir sems can rgya mtsho thams cad la zhugs pa dang /stobs bcu'i ye shes chags pa med pa'i snang ba yongs su bskyed pa'i phyir 'gro ba thams cad kyi sems rgya mtsho la zhugs pa dang / yongs su smin par bya ba dang /gdul ba'i dus la 7)mi 'da' bar bya ba'i phyir sems can thams cad kyi dbang po rgya mtsho la zhugs pa dang / zhing thams cad rnam par dag par bya ba'i lasmon lam mngon par bsgrubs pas kyi/ zhing rgya mtsho thams cad la zhugs pa dang /de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod cing rim gro byed pa'i stobs kyisam/dzosangs rgyas rgya mtsho thams cad la zhugs pa dang / ye shes rnam par rigarwa1pas chos rgya mtsho thams cad la zhugs pa dang / nan tan dang ldan pas yon tan rgya mtsho thams cad la zhugs pa dang / brjod pa thams cad du chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba 37—718

mngon par bsgrub pa'i phyir/ 'gro ba'i skad rgya mtsho thams cad la zhugs pa rnams kyi spyod pa7shes pa'am/ yon tan brjod par nus re skan/ /songasarigs kyi bu 'di nas dpag tshad drug cu gyi'adas pa'i lho phyogs kyi gnas 'di nyid na/ lang ma'i gnas rgya mtsho'i ngogs shes gebya ba yod de/ de na dge slong shin tu brtan pa zhes bya ba 'dug gis(5)/ de'i gan du song la/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpas7byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yongs su sbyang bar bya ba dris shig /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis〈pedage slong rgya mtsho'i sprin gyi rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ dge slong rgya mcho1re sprin la lan brgya stong du mar g.yas phyogs su bskor0)ba byas nas yang dang yang bltas te/ dge slong rgya mtsho'i sprin gyi drung nas song ngo / /3)de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs7 dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gdams7stongag de dang / kun nas mig gi〈rtechos kyi rnam grangs de yang rjes su dran par byed cing de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa de yang rjes su bsam pa dang / chos kyi tshig 3gedang yi ge'i sprin de dag kyang yongs su gzung ba bodang / chos kyi sgo rgya mtsho'i tshul de dag la'ang 'jug par bya ba dang chos kyi tshul de'ang marnam par blta ba dang / chos kyi le'u dang glong gi tshul de dag la 'jug par bya ba dang / chos kyi nam mkha' de la yang dag par gzhol bar bya ba dang / chos kyi dkyil 'khor de yang rjes su sbyang te bar bya ba dang / chos rin po che'i gling derwa yang rjes su sems shing mthar gyis lang ku'i gnas rgya mtsho'i ngogs shes0shebya ba gdan pa der phyin nas/ dge slong shin tu brtan pa mthong bar dga' zhing shar phyogs su bltas so/ /de bzhin du lho phyogs dang / nub phyogs dang / byang phyogs dang / byang shar gyi phyogs 37wa 719

mtshams dang / shar lho'i phyogs mtshams dang / lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams dang la/ nub byang gi phyogs mtshams dang / bla )dang 'og tushedage slong shin tu brtan pa mthong bar dga' ste/ kun tu bltas pa dang / des dge slong shin tu brtan pa nam mkha'i dbyings la lha brgya stong grangs med pas yongs su bskor cing phan tshun du 'chag bapa mthong ngo / /nam mkha'i dbyings de yang lha'i dbang po rnams kyis ④dge slong shin tu brtan pa la mchod pa'i las su bya ba'i phyir / lha rdzas kyi me tog sil ma'i sprin gyis yog pa dang / lha rdzas kyi rol mo'i sprin gyi sgra dang / dar gyi ba dan grangs med pa'i rgyan gyis⑤brgyan par mthong ngo ske/ /klu'i dbang po rnams kyis yinam mkha' de la a ga ⑦ru nag po'i spos mngon par 'thul ba'i sprin shin5btu mtho ba las 'brug sgra bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung bar byas pa mthong ngo / /mi'am ci'i dbang po rnams kyis nam mkha'ashede 3 )la lha rdzas kyi ngag snyan pa'i rgyud kyi bstod tuskrepa'i rol mo brdung ba dang /dkrol ba dang glur blangasngo ba'i dbyangs thams cad sbyar cing blangs pa thos par gyur to/ /lto 'phye chen po'i dbang po rnams kyisatshwanyenam mkha' de la gos7shin tu phra zhing mdog bzang ba'i 3nyespyin bsam gyis mi khyab pa dag yid dga' bas bkye sto 7/ dge slong shin tu brtan pa la dad cing mos pa'i gzugs su phyung ba mthong ngo / /lha ma yin gyi dbang po rnams kyis kyang nam mkha' de la nor bu rin po che'i sprin bsam gyis mi khyab pa byin gyis brlabs〈nyete/ yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyan snang ba dang ldan par byas pa temathong ngo / /nam mkha' lding gi dbang po mang po yang myi'i gzugs dang kha dog (nyedang dbyibs su 'khod cing nam mkha' lding gi dbang po'i bu mos kun nas bskor te/ gsod nyapa med 37—720

patul dga' zhing thal mo sbyar te gnas pasabasam gyis mi khyab pa mthong ngo / /gnod sbyin gyi dbang po brgya stong 'khor dang bcas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dag kyang nam mkha' de la shin tu mi sdug pa'i gzugs su dge slong shin tu brtan pa la byams pa'i mthu dang ldan par 'khod pa mthong ngo / /srin po'i dbang po brgya stong 'khor dang bcas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dag kyang nam mkha' de la dge slong shin tu brtan pa yongs su bsrung〈ba byed cing kun tu rgyu ba mthong ngo /tshangs pa'i dbang po brgya stong bsam gyis mi khyab pa dag kyang nam mkha' de la thal mo sbyar cing dga' ba dngasayid du 'ong ba'i tshig gi rgyud kyisnyibastod pa rab tu brjod pa mthong ngo / /gnas gtsang ma'i lha brgya stong bsam gyis mi khyab pa dag kyang nam mkha' de la dge slong shin tu brtan pa la mchod pa'i las su bya ba'i phyir thal mo sbyar cing gzhal med khang na zhuganas pa mthong ngo / /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis medage slong shin tu brtan pa nide ltar nam mkha'i dbyings la 'chag 7cing 'dug pa mthong nas dga' rangs te mgu zhing nyams bde la tshim zhing yid bde ba skyes nas/ dge slong shin tu brtan pa la thal mo sbyar te phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phags pa bdag gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed nas / ji ltar byang chub sems dpa'i tunyesangs rgyas kyi hurtechos btsal bar bgyi ba tunyedang /ji ltar byang chub sems dpas sangs rgyas kyi chos yongs su bsgrub par bgyi ba dang / ji ltar byang chub sems dpas gesangs rgyas kyi chos yongs su bsdu bar bgyi ba dang / ji ltar byang chub sems dpas sangs rgyas kyi chosamatshabastan par bgyi ba dang / ji ltar byang chub sems dpas sangs rgyas kyi chos bsgom par 37—721

bgyi ba dang / ji ltar byang chub sems dpasatusangs rgyas kyi chos kyisarjes su 'brang bar bgyi ba dang / ji ltar byang chub sems dpasashesangs rgyas kyi chos yongs su brtul bar bgyi ba dang / ji ltar byang chub sems dpas sangs rgyas kyi chos yongs su bsgom par bgyi ba dang / ji ltar byang chub sems dpas sangs rgyas kyi chos rnam par dag par bgyi ba dang / ji ltar byang chub sems dpas sangs rgyas kyi chos yongs su sbyang bar9)bgyi ba dang / ji ltar byang chub sems dpas sangs rgyas kyi chos khong du chud par bgyi ba ma 'tshal te/ 'phags pa ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gdamasatsongag dang rjes su bstan pa mdzad dol/ /zhes bdag gis5yethos na/ 'phags pa ji ltar byang chub sems dpas sangs rgyas kyi chos la nan tan du bgyi(kye/ ji ltar nan tan〈nyebagyis na yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin dang / skol 3)bar mi 'gyur ba'i slad du sangs rgyas mthong ba dang mi 'bral ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba dang ske/ tshul gcig tu 'gyur ba'i slad du byang chub sems dpa' mthong ba dang mi 'bral ba dang / ye shes rtogs par 'gyur ba'i slad du sangs rgyas kyi chos dang mi 'bral ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi don yongs su thob par bgyi ba'i slad du byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam thams cad dang mi 'bral ba dang / bskal pa thams cad du gnas pas yongs su mi skyo bar bgyi ba'i slad du byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dang mi 'bral ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad yongs su dag par bgyi ba'i slad du sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad rgyas par dgang ba dang mi 'bral ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rnam par 'phrul pa thams cad rnam par dmigs par bgyi ba'i 37—722

slad du sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa mthong ba dang mi 'bral ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa sprul pa lta bus srid pa'i rgyud thams cad du skye zhing 'chi7'pho ba'i skye mched rang gi lus kyis zhunyams su myong bar bgyi ba'i slad du 'dus byas kyi gnas dang mi 'bral ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi sprin yongs su gzung ba'i ji slad du chos mnyan pa dang mi 'bral ba dang ske/ dus gsum gyi ye shes khong du chud cing rjes su 'brang bar bgyi ba'i slad du / ye shes snang ba dang mi 'bral bar 'gyur ba de bdag la bstan du gsol/de skad ces smras pa dang / dge slong shin tu brtan pas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangasasnyil 'di skad ces smras so/ /de ltar khyod kyis ⑧bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed de/ sangs rgyas kyi chos dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i chos dang rang byung gi chos 'dri ba legs so/ /legs so/ /rigs kyi bu kho bo 6)ni byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa thogs (3)pa med pa'i sgo thob pa 2ste/ rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa thogs pa med pa'i sgo de kho bos blangs te/ yongs su bzung nas rjes su 'brang zhing rnam par dbye ba dang / rnam par dpyad pa dang rnam par brtag tso pa dang snang bar bya ba dang / rab tu snang bar byas pas thogs 3 tshopa med pa'i mtha' zhes bya ba'i ye shes snang ba thob bo/ /de thob pas kho bo 11ni sems can thams cad kyi sems dang spyod pa khong du chud par bya ba la thogs pa med do/ /sems can thams cad kyi skye ba dang 'chi 12'pho yongs su shes par bya ba la thogs pa med do / /sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran par bya ba'i sgor 'jug pa la thogs pa med do/ /phyi ma'i mtha'i bskal par 'gro ba thams cad dang 'grogs 12par bya ba la thogs 37wa 723

pa med do/ /da ltar byung ba'i dus kyi 'gro ba thams cad rnam par rig par bya ba la thogs pa med do/ /sems can thams cad kyi sgra skad dang / kun rdzob yongs su shes par bya ba la thogs pa med do/ /sems can thams cad kyi the tsomatugacad par bya ba la thogs pa med do/ /sems can thams cad kyi dbang po tha dad parasho khong du chud par bya ba la thogs pa med do/ /sems can thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba dang / gdul ba'i dus su 'gro bar bya ba la thogs pa med do/ /nyin mtshan dang skad cig dang yud tsam dang thang cig dang / dus kyi ming du bya ba khong du chud par bya ba la thogs pa med do/ /dus gsum rgya mcho'i rgyud du 'jug par bya ba5snyel thogs pa med do/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing rang gi lus kyis5gergyas par dag pa b.rasabya ba la thogs pa med do / /de ni de ltar dngos po med pa la gnas shing mngon par 'du bya ba med pa'i rdzu 'phrul thob pa'i phyir te/ rigs kyi bu dngos po med pa la gnas shing mngon par 'du bya ba med pa'i rdzu 'phrul de'i byin gyis kho bo nam mkha' dudabyings 'di las phan tshun du 'gro zhing 'dug spupa dang / snyes pa dang spyod lam sna tshogs su spyod do/ /mi snang bar byed do/ /snang bar 'byung〈nyengo / /du ba 'thul nyurtebar byed do/ /me lce 'bar bar byed do/ /gcig tu byas7shing mang por bsgyur miro/ /mang por byas shing gcig tu bsgyur ro/ /snang ba dang mi snang ba'ang nyams su myong bar byed do/ /rtsig pa la'ang thag thogs med7pa dang rab la'ang thag thogasamatshemed par 'gro ste/ dper na nam mkha' la bya bzhin no/ /nam mkha' la'ang〈sheskyil mo krung5)gis 'gro ste/ dper na 'dabasngo nye chags bya bzhin no/ /sa la yang bye'u zul dang steng du 'byung ba byed de(te/37—724

dper na chu la bya ba bzhin no/ /chu la yang byingatub med par 'gro ste/ dper na sa la bya ba bzhin no/ /du bku'athul ba dang / me lce 'bar bshebyed de/dper na me'i phung po chen po bzhin no/ /sa yang yongs su g.yo༄bar byed do/ /nyi ma dang zla ba 'di gnyis de ltar rdzu 'phrul che zhing de ltar mthu che la/ de ltar gzi brjid chesnyeyang lag pas kun nas yongs su zhug go/ /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten gyi bar0dag tu yang lus kyis dbang bsgyur〈nyer/ /'jig rten spos kyi dud pa na7bun du chags pa'i sprin gyis kun nas khebs par byas shing rab tu 'bar bar byed do/ /rin po (7che thams cad kyi 'od zer gyi sprin gyi dra bas 'jig rten kun nas khebs par byas shing / 'gro ba thams cad dang 'dra ba'i sprul pa'i sprin rab tu 'gyed do/ /kha dog mtha' yas pa'i 'od kyi dra ba'i sprin rab tu bkye zhing phyogs kun tu'ang 'gro ste/ 'di ltar shar phyogs su7'gro'o/ /lho phyogs dang nub phyogs dang byang phyogs dang / byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams dang / shar lho'i phyogs mtshams dang / lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams dang /nub byang gi phyogs mtshams dang / 'og dang bla'i phyogs su yang 'gro'o/ /sems kyi skad cig re re zhing tunyeyang shar phyogs logs su 'jig rten gyi khams gcig kyang 'da'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams gnyis dang bcu yang 'da'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams brgya dang / 'jig rten gyi khams stong dang / 'jig rten gyi khams brgya phrag stong dang / 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba phrag brgya dang 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba phrag stong dang / 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba brgya phrag stong dang / 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba khrag khrig brgyachaphrag stong dang / 'jig rten gyi khams tshad med pa dang / 'jig rten gyi 37—725

khams dpag tu med pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams grangs med pa dang 'jig rten gyi0)khams bsam gyis na mi khyab pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams mtshungs pa med pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams gzhal du med pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams kun tu mtha' yas pa dang / 'jig rten gyi zhukhams mu med pa dang 'jig rten gyi khams mtshams gemed pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams brjod du med pa'i g.yang brjod du med pa dag kyang 'da' bar byed de/ 'jig rten gyi khams de dag na nesangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ji snyed cig bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong (7la 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho de dang de dag dang / 'jig rten gyi khams 'byam /klas pa de dang de dag dang / 'jig rten gyi khams kyi phyogs de dang de dag dang / 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud de dang de dag dang / 'jig rten gyi khams yongs su 'du ba de dang de dag dang / 'jig rten gyi khams 'byung ba de dang de dag dang / 'jig rten gyi khams su bya ba de dang de dag dang ske/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sgo de dang de dag dang / 'jig rten gyi khams kyi bskal par bya ba de dang de dag dang / 'jig rten gyi khams su 'jug pa de dang de dag dang / 'jig rten gyi khams kyi snying po byang chub rnam par bkod pa de dang de dag dang / 'jig rten gyis597)khams kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor de dang de dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ji snyed cig chos ston pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa de dag las de bzhin gshegs pa re re zhing yang sangs rgyas kyi zhing mtha' yas pa'i 1 rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi lus sna tshogs dang / lus re re zhing yang sangs rgyas kyi zhing mtha' yas pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi mchod pa'i sprin gyi char 'bebs shing spyan sngar 11'gro'o/ /de dag tu phyin nas kyang me tog 37wa 726

thams cad dang spos thams cad dang / phreng ba thams cad dang phye ma thams cad dang / byug pa thams cad dang na bza' thams cad dang / rgyal mtshan thams cad dang lha'i ba dan thams cad dang bla re thams cad dang / dra ba thams cad dang gzugs thams cad kyi nyamachod pa rgyun ma chad par byed do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis gang ji snyed du gsungs pa dang /bstan pa dang / brjod pa dang / yang dag par bshad pa dang / yang dag par smos pa dang / yongs su brjod pa dang / man ngag du gsungs pa dang /shin tu bstan pa dang rab tu brjod pa de dag thams cad kyang shes shing 'dzin to / /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa ji snyed pa de dag thams cad kyang rjes su dran no/ /shar phyogs su ji lta ba deshebazhin du lho phyogs dang / nub phyogs dang byang phyogs dang / byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams dang / shar lho'i phyogs mtshams dang / lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams dang / nub byang gi phyogs mtshams dang / 'og dang steng gi phyogs su yang 'jig rten gyi khams gcigs kyang 'da'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams gnyis dang bcu yang 'da'o/ /'jig rten ④gyi khams brgya nas 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i〈rdul shin tu phra ba snyed57kyang 'da'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams de dag na sangs rgyas bcom ldanashe'adas ji snyed cig bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong gel/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgyas17mtsho de dang de dag dang / 'jig rten gyi 1 )khams rnam par dag pa de dang de dag nas/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor de dang de dag na chos ston pa de dag kun kyang mthong ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa de dag la'ang me tog 37—727

thams cad nas gzugs thams cad kyi bar gyitumachod pa byed do/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis gang ji snyed du gsungasalgepa nas/ rab tu brjod pa'i bar de dag thams cad kyang yongs su shes shing 'dzin to/ /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa gang ji snyed pa de dag thams cad kyang rjes su dran no/ /sems can gang gis kho bo mthong bar gyur pasnyedang / gang dngasre'agrogs par gyur pa de dag kun kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nges par 'gyur ro/ /sems can phra mo'am rags pa'am ngan pa'am bzang ba'am bde ba'am mi bde ba gang ji snyed cig kho bos mthong bar gyur pa de dag kun la yang yongs su smin par bya ba dang /'dul ba'i dus las mi 'da' bar bya ba'i phyir/ khong ta de dag gi lus kyi tshad dang mnyam par lus byin gyis rlobatupo/ /sems can ji snyed cig kho bo'i drung du 'ong bsnyede dag thams cad kyang / byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa kun tu 'gro ba 'di dang / byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa rnam par gnon pa don yod pa la rab tu gzhog go/ /rigs kyi bu kho bos ni byang chub sem sa dpa'i rnam par thar pa thogs pa med pa'i sgo kun tu 'gro ba de bzhin gshegs pa'i〈nyemachod pa dang / rim gro rab tu sbyor ba sems can thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba dang / mthun pa 'di shes par zad na/ kho bos byang chub sems dpa'aphanyesnying rje chen po'i ngang tshul can/ theg pa chen po'i ngang tshul can/ byang chub sems dpa'i lam dang mi 'bral ba'i ngang tshul can/thogs pa med pa'i ngang tshul can/ byang chub sems dpa'i bsam pa'i snying po chud mi gson7pa'i ngang tshul can/ byang chub kyi sems yongs su mi gtong ba'i 37—728

ngang tshul can/ sangs rgyas kyi chos la lhag par dmigs pa'i ngang tshul can/thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ①yid la bya ba dang mi 'bral ba'i ngang tshul can/nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i ngang tshul can/ 'jig rten thams cad la mi gnas pa'i ngang tshul can/ chud mi gson⑧pa'i ngang tshul can/ ma nyamasalgepa'i ngang tshul can/ ma gon⑧pa'i ngang tshul can/ glags5 med pa'i ngang tshul can / ma 'dres pa'i ngang tshul can/ rnyog ⑥pa med pa'i ngang tshul can/'gyod pa med pa'i ngang tshul can/ rnam par dag pa'i ngang tshul can/ byang chub sems dpa' rdul dang7bral ba de dag gi spyod pa shes pa'am/ yon tan brjod pa nus re skan/ /song rigs kyi bu lho phyogs kyi rgyud 'di nyid na/dra byi la'i grong rdal rdo rje'i7grong khyer can phortebya ba yod de/ de na dra byi la'itsosprin ces bya ba 'dug gis5stede'i gan du song la ji ltar byang chub sems dpasalgebyang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bya ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bya ba 'dris shig /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis ⑩dge slong rab (nyetu brtan pa'i rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal nas/ lan brgya stong du mar g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas te/ yang dang yangarwa)bltas nas dge slong shin tu brtan pa'i drung nas song ngo / /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs tsho 3 chos kyi dad pa'i shugs dang / byin gyis non5)pa/ sangs rgyas yid la bya ba'i 'du shes dang ldan pa/ dkon mchog gsum gyi (gegadung mi gcad (nyepa la rab tu brtson pa/ dus gsum snang bas sems snang bar gyur pa smon lam chen po yid la byed pa dang ldan pa sems can gyi khams thams cad yongs su bskyab pa'i thabs la zhugs pa/ 'dus byas kyi dge〈 steb thams cad la mi gnas pa'i sems 37—729

dang ldan pa/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin nges par rtogs par bya ba la brtson pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad yongs su sbyang ba'i smon lam las mi g.yo ba/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor na gnas pa med par gnas pa chos kyi snang ba de7)rjes su dran par bya ba dang / dge ba'i bshesasnyeganyen rjes su dran par bya ba dang / 'dod chags dang bral ba'i rigs yongs su brjod pa50byed cing / mthar gyis7dra byi la'i grong rdal rdo rje'i grong khyerasnyidu phyin nas/ dra byi la'isnyisprin yongs su tshol tshol ba las/ grong khyer gyi khyams spyishig na chos bstanam pa'i don du seng ge'i khri la 'dug cing / srog chags stong phrag 1)bcu tsam zhig la chos kyi rnam grangs yi ge'i 'khor lo'i rgyud kyi rgyan ces bya ba yongs su ston cing 'dug pa mthong ngo / /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis 7dra byi la'i51sprin gyi rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ dra byi la'i /rnyespyin la lan brgya stong du mar g.yas phyogs su bskor 3)ba byas nas mdun du 'dug ste/ thal mo sbyar nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phags pa bdag gis 39bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed na/ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bgyi ba dang / ji ltar nan tan dusnyibagyi ba dang / ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub kyi sems srid pa'i lam rgyud thams cad du chab hu 7mi 'tshal ba dang /ji ltar yongs su skyo ba ma mchis shing / bsam pa brtan 32par 'gyur ba dang /ji ltar thub pa ma mchis shing lhag pa'i bsam pa yongs su dag par 'gyur ba dang ske/ ji ltar nyu)yongs su skyo ba ma mchis shing snying rje chen po'i stobs yang dag pa 3 )skye bar 'gyur ba dang ji ltar sgo kun nas rnam par dag cing gzungs kyi 37wa 730
