stobs gnon par 'gyur ba dang / ji ltar ma rig pa'i rab rib dang sgrib pa rnam par 'thor zhing / shes rab kyi 'od chos thams cad la rab rib ma mchis pa'i snang ba skye bar 'gyur ba dang / ji ltar don dang chos dang nges pa'i tshig dang spobs ①pa la mkhas pa'i ②dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs shing / so sosheyang dag par rig⑧pa'i stobs gnon par 'gyur ba dang / ji ltar sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'khor lo tha mi dad pa yang dag par 'dzin cing dran pa'i stobs yongs su gnon par 'gyur ba dang / ji ltar chos thams cad kyi phyogs rigs pa'i snang ba rjes su rtog cingar+sā)/ rig pa'i stobs rnam par dag par 'gyur ba dang / ji ltar byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs chos thams cad kyi don rnam par gdon mi za bar rab tu dbye ba la brtson pas 'grub par 'gyur ba ma 'tshal to/ /de nas dra byi la'i lasprin gyis byang chub sems dpa' la rim gro7bya ba'i phyir seng ge'i khri de lasashelangs te babs nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs la lus thams cad kyis phyag byas nas/ tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs7)la gser gyi 3)me tog gi phung pos mngon par gtor to / /nor bu rin po che rin thang 32med pa mang po dang / tsan dan gyi phye ma dam pas kyang (stemangon par gtor to/ /gos tshon sna tshogs rnam pa tha dad〈nyepas kha dog bsgyur ba brgya stong phrag du mas kyang mngon par bkab bo/ /spos kyi me tog kha dog rnam pa tha dad cing yid du 'ong la 8blta na sdug pa mang pos kyang mngon par gtor nas mchod pa'i tu starnam pa sna tshogs gzhan dag gis tunyekyang /mchod pa dang rim gro dang / bkur ste dang bsti5cesang cher byas te/ tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs zhu )la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyis de 37—731

ltar bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa legs so legs so/ /rigs kyi bu gang gis7bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa de ni/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gdung mi gcadashepa'i phyir zhugs pa yin no(mi/ /'dod chags dang bral ba'i rigs yang dag pa ci'ulta ba bzhin du rnam par rig5gepar bya ba la brtson pa yin/ zhing gi7rgyud thams cad yongs su dag par bya ba la zhugs pa yin/ sems can gyi rigs thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba dang / 'dul meb la sta gon du gnas pa yin/chos kyi rigs thams cad yang dag pasaji lta ba bzhin du0)brtag pa la brtson pa yin / las kyi rigs thams cad dang mi 'gal bar gnas pa yin/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i rigs thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bya ba la rab tu brtson pa yin/ smon lam gyi rigs thams cad rgyun mi 'chad57pa'i phyir yang〈nyedag par zhugs pa yin/ dus gsum gyi rgyud thams cad ye shes kyitsokhong du chud par bya ba la zhugs pa yin/ mos pa'i rigs7shin tu brtan par bya ba'i phyir brtson pa yin tem/ de ni de bzhin gshegs pa mang po thams cad kyi7byin gyis brlabs pa yin/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyis7yang dag par dgongs pa yin / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang mnyam pa nyid du gyur pa yin/'phags pa thams cad kyis/tshonyerjes su dgyes par bya ba yin/ tshangs pa'i dbang po thams cad kyis mngon par dga' bar byas pa5)yin/ lha'i dbang po thams cad kyis yang dag par mchod pa yin/ gnod sbyin gyi dbang po thams cad kyisasngo — )yongs su bsrung ba yin/ srin po'i dbang po thams cad kyis terim gror byas pa yin / klu'i dbang po thams cad kyis〈sgrubasu ba yin/ mi'am ci'i dbang po 37—732

thams cad kyisatumangon par bstod pa yin/ 'jig rten gyi dbang po thams cad kyis7yang dag par bsngags pa yin/ des ni sems can gyi khams thams cad kyang ngan song gi lam rgyud gsum po yongs su gcadashepa dang mi khom pa dang /ngan 'gro'i lam thams cad bzlog pa dang / dbul ba'i lam thams cad las yang dag par bzla ba dang / lha dang mi'i phun sum tshogs pa thob par bya ba dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen mthong ba dang mi 'bral ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos rgya chen po mnyam pa dang / 'bral bar mi 'gyur ba dang / byang chub kyi sems kyi yan lag yongs su dag par bya ba dngasnyi/ byang chub kyi semasakyi'abyung ba'i rgyudasheyongs su bsgrub pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i lam snang bshethob par bya ba dngashe/ byang chub sems dpa'i ye shes khong du chud par bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sa la gnas par bya bas dbugs phyin par byas pa yin/ rigs kyi bu de la bdag 'di snyam du sems te/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni dka' ba byed pa ste/ 'byung bar dka' zhing mthong bar dka' ba'o / /byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni sems can rnamasarwanyal bag dro bar byed pas pha dang ma7lta bu'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi rgyan tu gyur pa'o⑩/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba rnams la skyabs su gyur pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni 'gro ba thams cad yongs su bsrung ba'i phyir gnas su gyur pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams 8ni 'jigs pa sna tshogs kyis gtses 8pa rnams la dpung gnyen du gyur pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni 'gro ba thams cad ngan song gsum du lhung ba las yongs su rton ⑩pa'i phyir rlung gi dkyil 'khor ⑩lta 37—733

bu'o / /byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni sems can thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba rnam par 'phel bar byed pas sa lta bu'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni bsod nams rin po che'i mdzod mi zad pa'i gtos gyo)dang ldan pas rgya mtsho lta bu'o / /byang chub sems rimidapa' rnams ni ye shes kyi 'od kyisam snang bar byed pa'i phyir nyi ma lta bu'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni dge ba'i rtsa bas ④shin tu mtho bas ri rab lta bu'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni snying po byang chub tu ye shes kyi zla ba 'char bar 'gyur ba'i phyir zla ba lta bu'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni snyenabadud kyi sde thams cad rab tu 'joms (5)pas dpa' bor gyur pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni rang byung gi chos kyi grong khyer du phyin par byed pas rtul phod pa lta bu'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni sems can thams cad kyi bag gal byams pa'i rlan yongs su skem 'u)pas me lta bu'o / /byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni chos kyi 9)sprin rgya chen po'i char mngon par 'bebs pas pasprin lta bu'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni sems can gyi dbang po dad pa la stsogs nyi pa'i myu gu rnam par 'phel bar byed pas char pa lta bu'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' nyugernams ni chos 12rgya mtsho'i 'gram yongs su ston pas mnyan sna pa lta bu'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni sems can thams cad 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las yang dag par sgrol ba'i phyir zam pa lta bu'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams 8ni sems can thams cad kyis tsomangon par bgrod par bya ba'i phyir mu stegs lta bu'o/ /de ltar dra byi la'i nya tshosprin gyis tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyi 3shemadun du 'dug ste/ tshig gi rgyud de dag gis7)byang chub sems dpa' rnams la yongs su bsngags pa byas nas/ tshong dpon gyi 37—734

bu nor bzangs7la legs so zhes50bsngags so/ /de ltar dephaṭabyang chub sems dpa' yang dag par dga' bar bya ba'i phyir tshig brjod pa'i tshe/ kha'i9)sgo nas 'od 'phro ba'i phung po rnam pa 'di lta bu byung ste/ 'od 'phrom ba'i phung po des stong gsum gyi7'jig rten gyi khams rgyas par gang bar gyur nas/ lha dang lha rdzu 'phrul chen po'am/ klu dang klu rdzu 'phrulasdo chen po'am/ gnod sbyin dang gnod sbyin rdzu 'phrul chen po'am/ dri za dang dri za58)rdzu 'phrul chen po'am/ lha ma yin dang lha ma yin rdzu 'phrul chen po'am/ nam mkha' lding dang nam mkha' lding rdzu 'phrul chen po'am/ mi'am ci dang mi'am ci tso rdzu 'phrul chen po'am/lto 'phye chen po dang lto 'phye chen po rdzu 'phrul chen po'am/ mi dang mi rdzu 'phrul chen po'am/ / mi ma yin pa dang mi ma yin pa rdzu 'phrul chen po'am/kyi ri tshangs pa dang tshangs pa57rdzu 'phrul chen po'am/ sems can gang sus mthong yang rung ste / snang ba des yongs su snang bar byas pa de dag dra byi 32la sprin gyi drung du 'ongs so/ /de nas de ltar dra byi la sprin gyis bsam hu pa byin gyis brlabasamatsha shing thal mo sbyar te/ gnas pa lus dang sems sim par gyur pa/ dga' ba rgya chen po skyes pa/ sri zhu chen po la gnas pa/ nga rgyal gyi rgyal mtshan bcom pa/g.yo rgyu dang bralasnyib/ dbang po rnam par dang bar gyur pa de dag la dra byi la'i tsosprin gyis chos kyi rnam grangs yi ge'i 'khor lo'i rgyud kyi rgyan ces bya ba de nyid rgya cher yang dag par bstan te/ khong du chud pa dang rtogs pa dang shes pa dang rig par byas so/ /de thosatshwa nas kyang de dag thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par gyur to/ /de nas de'i phyir chos kyi stan la 'dug nas/ tshong 1shedapon gyi bu nor bzangs tu la 'di skad ces smras 37—735

sol/ /rigs kyi bu kho bo ①ni dbyangs dang ldan pa'i gzungs thob pa ste/ de'i mthus kho bo50stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'disalha rnams kyi lha'i skad kyang shes so/ /de bzhin du klu dang gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang /lha ma yin dang nam mkha' lding dang mi'am ci dang / lto du'aphye chen po dang /mi dang mi ma yin pa dang / tshangs pa rnams kyi tshangs pa'i skad kyang shes so/ /lha rnams kyi lha'i skad sna tshogs kyang shes so/ /de bzhin du klu dang gnod sbyin dang dri za dang / lha ma yin dang nam mkha' lding dang mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa dang / tshangs pa rnams kyi tshangs pa'i skad sna tshogs kyang shes so/ /lha rnams kyi lha'i skad gcig pa yang shes so//de bzhin du klu dang gnod sbyin dang dri za dang / lha ma yin dang nam mkha' lding dang mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / mi dang mi ma yin pa dang /tshangs pa rnams kyisatshangs pa'i skad gcig pa yang shes so/ /lha rnams kyi lha'i skad tha dad pa yang shes so/ /de bzhin du krushedang gnod sbyin dang dri za dang lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang mi dang mi ma yin pa dang / tshangs pa rnams kyi tshangs pa'i skad tha dad pa yang shes so/ /byol song gi skye gnas su skyes pa'i sems can rnams kyi brda〈nyadang skad dang ming tha dad pa'ang〈nyeshes so/ /sems can dmyal ba pa'i sems can rnams kyi skad dang / ming rnamasatswakyang shes so/ /gshin rje'i 'jig rten pa'isnyisems can rnams kyi skad dang ming rnams kyang shes so/ /'phags pa'i skad dang ming rnams kyang shes so/ /'phags palam yin pa'i skad dang ming rnams kyang shes so/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi tshig dang brda dang / nges pa'i 37—736

ngag sems can gyi bsam pa bzhin du 'byung ba yang shes so/ /sems kyi skad cig ①re re la yang dus gsum du gshegs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi dbyangs kyi yan lag dang gsung ②rgya mtsho sems can thams cad kyi ming dang gtam gyi sgra dang / tshig tu ldan pa yang rtogs shing khong du chud do/ /ji ltar stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di'i sems can rnams kyi brda dudang nges pa'i tshig dang skad dang ming rgya mtsho la 'jug ④cing shes pa de bzhin du shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong tshad med pa / grangs med parjo/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ mtshungs pa med pa/ kun tu mtha' yas pa mu med pa/ sa mtshams med pa gzhal du med pa/ brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa dang / de bzhin du lho phyogs dang / nub phyogs dang byang phyogs dang / byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams dang / shar lho'i phyogs mtshams dang / lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams dang / nub byang gi7phyogs mtshams dang / 'og dang steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong tshad med pa nas ⑦brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i bar gyi sems can rnams kyi brdusnyedang / nges pa'i tshig she)dang skad dang ming rgya mtsho thams cad la 'jug cing shes te/ 'di ltar lha rnams kyi lha'i skad kyang shes so//tshangs pa rnams kyi tshangs pa'i skad kyi bar du'ang shes so/ /rigs kyi bu kho bos ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gzungs 31snang ba dbyangs dang ldan pa hu)'di shes par zad na/ kho bos byang chub sems dpa' 'gro ba sna tshogs kyi brda'i rnam pa rgya mtsho la zhugs pa de dag dang / 'gro ba sna tshogs kyi skad dang /ming rgya mtsho la zhugs pa de dag dang / 'gro ba sna tshogs kyi ming shin tu bstan 37—737

pa ming 3)rgya mtsho la zhugs pa de dag dang 'gro ba sna tshogs kyisngo skabarjod pa rab tu bkod pa dang / rnam par spyod pa rgya mtsho la zhugs pa de dag dang / tshigashethams cad kyi mtshams sbyar ba 4)rgya mtsho la zhugs pa de dag dang / tshig lhur blangs te bstan pa rgya mtsho la zhugs55)pa de dag dang / dus gsum gyi dmigs pa thams cad dmigs pa gcig tu rnam par spyod pa rgya mtsho gang 6)chen mtsho la zhugs pa de dag dang / tshig gis57)brtsegs te bstan gepa rgya mtsho la zhugs pa de dag dang / tshig gnyis nas brtsegs te bstan59)pa rgya mtsho la zhugs pa de dag dang / tshig rab tu phye ste bstan pa rgya mtsho la zhugs pa de dag dang /chos thams cad rab tu dbye bas 'dul ba'i tshul bstan pa rgya mtsho la zhugs pa de dag dang / 'gro ba thams cad kyi skad rgya mtsho la zhugs pa lha )de dag dang /dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor rnam par dag pa'i rgyan thams cad la zhugs pa de dag dang ske/ yi ge'i 'khor lo'i mthar phyin par bya bas rab tu dbye ba las〈1byung ba de dag gi spyod pa shes pa'am/ yon tan brjod par nus re skan/ /song rigs kyi bu lho phyogs kyi rgyud 'di nyid na yul nags mtshal na gnas pa zhes bya ba yod de/ de na tshong dpon btang nya brjod ces bya ba 'dug gi ⑩de'i gan du song la ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa57la brtson paratsobya ba dang / ji ltar 'byung / bar bya ba dang / ji ltar sems〈nyenges par bzhags37par bya ba dris shig /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis )/ dra byi la sprin gyi rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ chos kyi rim gro byas nas/dad pa'i mtshan nyid rtsa ba tshugs pa la rab tu brtag 21pa dang / dge ba'i bshes dgeganyen las 'ongs da pa'i thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la yang dag par lta〈pe37wa 738

zhing gdong mchi mas gang bar 37ngus ༷na/te/ dra byi la gyisprin la lan brgya stong du mar g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas nas/ yang dang yang (gebaltas te 5)phyag 'tshal zhing dra byi la sprin gyi drung nas song ngo // // sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo5)/ bam po nyi shu dgu (7pa/ de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs rin byang chub sems dpa'i gzungs snang ba dbyangs dang ldan pa'i rgyan de nyid la rjes su bsam pa dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa'i skad kyi tshul rgya mtsho de nyid la 'jug par bya ba dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshul phra mo la 'jug pa de nyid rjes su dran par bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sems rnam par byang59tshobs/ rnam par dag pa de nyid kyi rjes su 'brang bar bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i mdage ba'i rtsa ba'i bag chags bsdu zhing bsgrub pa mngon par bsgrub pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i yongs su smin par bya ba'iri sgo de nyid rnam par sbyang 117ba dang /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi 32sems can bsdu ba'i ye shes de nyid shin tu byang bar bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i bsam pa'i stobs rnam par dag pa dzo/nyebya ba de nyid brtan par bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i lhag pa'i bsam pa'i stobs de nyid nye bar brtan par bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i mos pa'i rgyud de nyid yongs su sbyang mib dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sems de nyid gdon mi za bar dge bar bsam pa dang byang chub sems dpa'i yi midam chen po de nyid mthar phyin par byed cing / tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs yi dam la brtan zhing smon lam gyi sems kyis yongs su skyo ba med pa'i rgyud kyi rgyan dang ldan pa/ phyir mi ldog pas rnam par gnon pa'i brtson 'grus can/37wa 739

yid kyis brtul7)ba las mi zlogasam pa/ dad pa mi 'phrogs pa'i stobs dang ldan pa/ rdo rjes )mthu bo chesami phyed7pa'i sems dang ldan pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen thams cad kyi gdams56)ngag 'thunashepar len pa/ shes rab kha ma bab pa'i yul dang ldan pa/ sgo kun nas rnam par dag pa la mngon du gyur pa/ ye shes rnam par dag pa'i spyod yul thogs pa med pa kun tu ④lta ba'i ye shes kyi tshul snang ba dang ldan pa/ sa'i gzungs kun nas snang ba rab tu thob pa/chos kyi dbyings kyi 9rigazhi'i bye brag la mngon sum du gyur pa'i sems dang ldan pa/gzhi kun la rten 1 )pa'i rgyan rnam par dag pa'i rang bzhin rnam par dmigs pa gnas pa 1 med pa dang / bdag gi med pa dang77gnyis su med pa'i spyod yul la rab tu brtson pa/ 'du shes thams cad las 'da' bar byed pa'i ye shes kyi sgo rnam par dag pa/ chos kyi phyogs dang gzhi tha dad pa'i phyogs la so sor rtogatsopa med pa 'jig rten gyi gzhi dang phyogs kyi bye brag las phyir mi ldog pa/ chos kyi gzhi sadang phyogs kyi bye brag las phyir mi ldog pa sangs rgyas kyi phyogs dang gzhi tha dad pa mthong ba dang / rnam par rig par bya ba la gzhol btso/ dus kyi phyogs dang gzhi'i bye brag khong du chud pa'i ye shes can/ chos kyi 'khor lo yid du 'ong bas yang dag par bsgrubs 7pa'i blo dang ldan pa/ ye shes kun nas snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rnam par snang bas sems gsal bar byas pa/ yid kyi yul lus 32kun dang ldan pa'i sa la zhugs pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i ye shes snang bas rgyud shin tu snang bar byas pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du dad pa'i dba' rlabs kyi shugs kyis rab tu rlobamanyunyepa/ sangs rgyas kyi chos la mos pa'i shugs dang 'bral ba da )med pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabs kyis byin du 37—740

brlabasalgepa/ sangs rgyas thams cad rang gi sems kyi rgyudashekhong du chud pa'i 'od kyis〈snang bar gyur pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi dra ba thams cad rang gi lus kyis rgyas par dgangasnyiba'i smon lam dang chos kyi dbyings thams cad rang gi lus su yang dag par bsdu ba dang / mngon par bsgrub pa la brtson pa/ de mthar gyis song song ste/ lo bcu gnyis kyisasheyul nags tshal na gnas par phyin nas/ des7tshong dpon btang brjod7de btsal btsal03 te mthong ngo /mthong nas kyang lus thams cad kyis phab stote/ phyag 'tshal nas mdun du 'dug ste/ thal mo sbyar nas 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phags pa bdag de ring dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang mjal bar gyur pa ni bdag gis 'thob par bgyi ba legs par thob bo/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams ni mthong bar dka' ba'o/ge/ /'byung bar dka' ba'o/ /mjal5nyebar dka' ba'o/ /bgrod par dka' ba'o/ /bsnyen bkur bgyi bar dka' ba'o/ /mnyes par bgyi b.rachadaka' ba'o/ /'grogs par dka' ba'o/ /rim grokhebagyi bar dka' ba'o/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams ni rjes su 'brang bar dka' ba lags na/ de lta bu'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang 'grogs pa de ring bdag gis thob par gyur to/ /'phags pa bdag gisarwa)'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas thams cad〈nyebasnyen bkur ba dang / sangs rgyas thams cad la rim gro7)bgyi ba dang ske/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi zhal blta ba dang / sangs rgyas thams cad rnam par dmigs par bgyi ba dang / sangs rgyas thams cad dang〈 khyamanyam pa nyid thob par bgyi ba dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi smon lam khong du chud par bgyi ba dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi smon lam yongs su rdzogs par 37—741

bgyi ba dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyis3)yang dag par bsgrub pa'i ye shes snang bar bgyi ba dang / sangs rgyas thams cad rang gi lus su mngon par bsgrub pa dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyis smyo yang dag par bsgrubs57pa rang gi spyod pa 4mngon par bsgrub par bgyi ba dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rnam par 'phrul pa mngon sum 5du rtogs par bgyi ba dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi stobs dang mi bsnyengs pa yongs su dag par bgyi ba dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos bstan 6pa mnyan pas mi ngoms par bgyi ba dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 7 chos bstan 8pa mnyan cing blang bar ༄9 bgyi ba dang /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos bstan pa sna )yang dag par gzung nyu1 bar bgyi ba dang ske/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos bstan pa rnam par dbye bar bgyi ba dang /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos 1 bstan pa yongs su gzung ba hu dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / tshul gcig tu 'gyur bar bgyi ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang skal ba mumanyam par bgyi ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyod pa yongs su dag par bgyi ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par bgyi ba dang /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi smon lam mngon par bsgrub pa rnam par dag par bgyi ba bodang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs 17kyi mdzod rab tu thob par bgyi ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi chos kyi gter dang mdzod mi zad pa'i ye shes snang ba thob nyi tshopar bgyi ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi ting nge nyi 'dzin gyi gter dang mdzod khong du chud par bgyi ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 37—742

kyi mdzod tshad med pa mngon par bsgrub pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi snying rje chen po'i gter dang mdzod sems can 'dul ba'i mthar phyin par bgyi ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi rnam par 'phrul ba'i gter dang mdzod rnam par dmigs par bgyi ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi dbang gi 31gter dang / mdzod rang gi sems kyis snodabang du bgyi ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi rnam par dag ba'i gter dang ske/ mdzod rnam pa thams cad du brgyan par bgyi ba'i slad du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed nas/ 'phags pa de lta bu'i sems kyis bdag 'dir mchis sos)/ /bsam pa de lta bu5gedang yid la smon pa de lta bu dang / mngon par dga' ba de lta bu dang / sems pa53)de lta bu dang /gdon mi 'tshal bar〈yebasgrub par bsam pa de lta bu dang / spyod yulamanyamangon du bgyi ba de lta bu dang / tshul khong du chud par bgyi ba la mos pa de lta bu dang /rnam par dag pa la gzhol ba de lta bu dang / rnam par dpyod 3)pa'i bsam pa de lta bu dang / rab tu gzhol ba'i sems de lta bu dang / dge ba'i sbyor ba de lta bu dang / mngon du 'gyur ba'i 1)dbang po de lta bus bdag 'dir mchis te/'phags pa ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gdams 1 snangag dang / rjes su ston pa mdzad cing tshul ni nye bar ston pa mdzad/ rtogs par bgyi ba ni snang bar mdzad/ lam ni bstan pa 31mdzad/ mu stegs la ni 'jog 12par mdzad/chos kyi sgo ni rnam par 'byed pa nyurtemadzad/ the tsom tsheni yongs su gcod par mdzad / nems nur ni sel bar mdzad/ yid gnyis kyi zug rngu ni 'byin par mdzad / dogs pa'i dri ma ni sbyong bar mdzad/ sems kyi thibs po ni snang bar 37—743

mdzad/ sems kyi dri ma ni yongs su sel bar mdzad/ sems kyi rgyud ni rab tu dang bar mdzad/ sems kyi g.yo sgyu ni yongs su sel bar mdzad/ sems kyi gdung ba ni7yongs su sim par mdzad/ 'khor bshelas ni sems rnamasapar bzlog par mdzad/ mi dge ba'i las ni phyir bzlog⑧par mdzad/ sems can dmyal ba las ni ldog par mdzad/ gnas dang ni dbral bar mdzad/mngon par zhen pa las ni gyen du bskyon⑧pa mdzad/ chags pa thams cad las ni yongs su 'grel bshemadzad/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du ni bsgrub pa mdzad/chos kyi grong khyer tu )du 'jug par bgyi ba'i slad du ni mngon du gyur par mdzad/snying rje chen po la ni rab tu bsgrub pa mdzad/ byams pa chen po la ninyerab tu gzhog pa mdzad/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la ni rab tu sbyor ba mdzad/ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo bsgom pa la ni 'dzud pa mdzad/ rtogs par 'gyur ba'i sgo la ni gnas par mdzad/ rang bzhin nges par rtogs pa la ni gzhag par mdzad / stobs dang ldan bas ni khyab par mdzad/ 'gro ba thams cad mnyam pa nyid du ni sems rnam par dbye ba mdzad do/ /zhes thos na/ 'phags pa ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la brtson par bgyi/ji ltar sbyar bar bgyi/ ji ltar brtson par bgyis na/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i dkyil 'khor rnam par dag paraca'agyur ba bdag la bstan du gsol/de nas tshong dpon btang brjod kyis 8de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo sangs rgyas kyi (9zhing thams cad yang dag par 'du ba zhes bya batshwa 7gzungs kyi sgo klong mtha' yas pa sngon du 'gro ba la/ sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba'i shugs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi rlabasacadang / 'jam dpal 37wa 744

gzhon nur gyur pas yang dag par bsamasanyeshing ye shes snang ba nye bar bsgrubs pas snyoms par zhugs sos/ /tshong dpon btang brjod de ltar snyoms par zhugs ma thag tu gzugs kyi lus yongs su dag pa rnam pasa'adi lta bur gnas par gyur 0te/ lus yongs su dag pa de'i mthus phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa dang bcas/ 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas/ 'od rnam par dag pa dang bcas/ sngonasaspyod pa la zhugs57pa dang bcas/ sangs rgyas kyi ⑦rnam par 'phrul pa dang bcas/ smon lam gyi tshogs dang bcas/spyod pa dang 'byung ba'i rgyan rnam par dag pa dang bcas/ mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba yongs su ston pa dang bcas/ chos kyi 'khor lo shin tu ston pa dang bcas/ sems can yongs su smin par mdzad pa dang bcas/ chos kyi mu'i mthar thug⑧pa dang bcas par kun kyang lus kyi khongs su7chud cing 'dus par snang ste/ de dag kyang phan tshun ma 'dres pa dang / phan tshun mchod pa dang ske/ phan tshun shin tu rnam par phye ba dang / phan tshun shin tu rnam par gnas pa dang / tshul sna tshogs su zhugs71pa dang yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du rnam par dmigs pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing rgyan sna tshogs can mnga' ba dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor sna tshogs kyi rgyan dang ldan pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa sna tshogasamatshayongs su ston par snang ngo ske/ /theg pa sna tshogs rnam par dgod pa mdzad pa dang / smon lam gyi sgo sna tshogs yongs su brjodatshwanyepa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams la la na ni dga' ldan gyi pho brang du skyes shing sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin tshalas thams cad mdzad par snang 37—745

ngos3)/ /la la na ni dga' ldan gyi pho brang nas 'pho ba dang / la la na ni yum gyi sku na bzhugs shing rnam par 'phrul pa sna tshogs yongs su ston pa dang / la la na ni skye ba dang / la la na ni byis pa'i rtsed mo ston pa mdzad pa dang / la la na ni btsun (2mo'i 'khor gyi nang na bzhugs pa dang / la la na ni mngon par 'byung ba dang / la la na ni snying po byang chub tu gshegs te/ rnam par 'phrul pa'i rgyan chen pos bdud kyi sde pham par mdzad pa dang / la la na ni lha dang klu dang ske/ gnod sbyin dang / dri zas yongs su bskor cing tshangs pa'i dbang pos chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gsol ba gdab pa dang / la la na ni chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba mdzad pa dang / la la na ni sems can thams cad kyi gnas na bzhugs pa dang / la la na ni yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar snang ngo / /'jig rten gyi khams la la na ni de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan las 'das pa rnams kyi ring bsrel rnam par dgoda' par snang ngo / /sangs rgyas kyi zhing la la na ni lha dang mi rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten la rgyan gyis klubs pa byed par snang ste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis sems can gyi ris rnam pa tha dad pa dang / sems can gyi 'jig rten gyi (snyernam pa tha dad pa dang /sems can gyi lam rnam pa tha dad pa dang / sems can gyi skye gnas rnam pa tha dad pa dang / sems can gyi tshogs rnam pa tha dad pa dang / sems can gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba'i rgyud rnam57)pa tha dad pa dang / sems can gyi lam gyi rgyud rnam pa tha dad pa dang 33/ sems can gyi bsam pa'i rgyud rnam pa tha dad pa dang ske/ sems can gyi7mos pa'i rgyud rnam pa tha dad pa dang / sems can gyi dbang po'i rgyud rnam pa tha dad pa dang / dus kyi rgyud rnam pa tha dad pa dang /37—746

sems can gyi las kyi bye brag rnam pa tha dad pa dang / sems can gyi las mi mthun7pa rnam pa tha dad pa dang / sems can gyi 'jig rten⑧rnam par dbye ba rnam pa tha dad pa dang / sems can gyi tshul lam dang spyod pa rnam pa tha dad pa la rnam par50spyod pa dang / sems can rgya mtsho bsam pa dang sbyor ba'i rnam pa tha dad pa dang dbang po mi mthun 6)pa sna tshogs rnam par dag zhi)pa dang /nyon mongs pa dang / bag chags sna tshogs bag la nyal bar gyur pa'i sems can 'byam klas pa durnams la sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa rnam pa ⑦sna tshogs yongs su bstan pa dang / yul sna tshogs kyi nges pa'i tshig dang /dbyangs kyi yan lag dang gsung rnam pa sna tshogs su bsgrubasalgepa dang / mdo sde ①sna tshogs kyi tshul rab tu brjod pa dang / gzungs kyi sgo rnam pa tha dad pa'i rgyud dang so so ( )yang dag par rig 31pa'i tshul gyi gzhung sna tshogs dang /'phags pa'i bden pa'i ming rgya mtsho'i rgyud rnam pa sna tshogs dang / sangs rgyas kyi khyu mchog dang seng ge'i nga ro rab tu bsgrags nyu2pa dang / sems can gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba sna tshogs bstan pa'i cho 'phrul yongs su bstan pa dang / dran pa'ipha/snyesgo sna tshogs can shin tu bstan pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' lung bstan pa'i seng ge'i nga ro sna tshogs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo'i mthu phyung ba rnam pa sna tshogs kyi tso'akhor gyi dkyil 'khor mtha' dang dbus med pa mtha' yas par rnam pa tha da da pa phan tshun mchod pa dang ske/ rnam par dag pa'i 'khor gyi78dkyil 'khor sna tshogs yangs 7pa dang /'khor gyi dkyil 'khor shin tu phra bar 'dus pa dang / dpag tshad gcig gi tshad tsam dang / dpag tshad bcu'i tshad tsam dang / dpag tshad brgya'i tshad 37—747

tsam nas/ 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor 'jig rten gyi khams sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi tshad tsam du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag gis/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung ①dbyangs kyi yan lag dang / sgra skad thams cad kyi rjes su 'gro bas chos ji snyed du bstan pa de dag thams cad kyangs/kye/ tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyisalgethos so blangs so/ /yang dag par bzungasnyingo bsams so/ /sangs rgyas kyisnyirnam par 'phrul pa de dag kyang mthong ngo / /byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dzikhu mchog gi mthu phyung ba de dag kyang mthong ngo / /de nas tshong dponabatang brjod 7dran zhing shes bzhin du ting nge 'dzin de las langs nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs la5ba'adi skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu kho bo ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par thar pa thogs pa med pa'i rgyan ces bya ba yongs su blangs shing 'dzin pa ste/ rigs kyi bu de ltar kho bo ⑨de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par thar pa thogs pa med pa'i rgyan de la rtog cing dpyod pa'i tshe/ shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'dzam bu chu klung gi mdog dang ldan pa na⑩/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas skar ma'i dbang phyug rgyal po zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa' rnam par snang ba'i snying po la sogs 31pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs pa'ang mig lam du snang ngo / /lho phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams stobs thams cad kyi shugs dang ldan pa na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas spos kun tu rnam par yangs pa zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa' bsam pa'i rgyal po la stsogasamanyepa/ byang chub 37—748

sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs pa'anganyemig lam du snang ngo / /nub phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams spos thams cad kyi 'od dang ldan pa na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ri rab mar me'i rgyal po zhes bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa' chags pa med pa'i sems la stsogasalgepa byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad dang / thabs gcig tu bzhugasalgepa yang mig lam du snang ngo / /byang phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams ngur thig gi⑧rgyal mtshan na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje rab tu 'dul ba zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa' rdo rje'i gom pas rnam par gnon pa la sogs pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i〈pe'akhor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs pa yang mig lam du〈snang ngo / /byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams 0kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rin po che thams cad rab tu 'bar ba na/de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mi dmigs pa'i spyan rnam par dmigs pa zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa' dmigs pa med par shin tu sprul pa la stsogs pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs pa yang mig lam du snang ngo / /shar lho'i phyogs mtshams5)kyi 'jig rten gyi khams spos kyi 'od zer rab tu snang ba na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas spos kyi mar me zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa' chos kyi dbyings kyi gzhi tha dad pa'i dpal gyi rgyal po la stsogasalgepa byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs pa'ang mig lam du snang 37—749

ngo ske/ /lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams nyi ma'i 'od ①gzer ltar snang ba na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sgo kun nas ye shes rnam par snang ba'i dbyangs zhes mibya ba byang chub sems dpa'i me tog gi ④ri'od kun nas 'phro tshobar gtsug phud rab tu 'phyang ba la sogs 55pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i53)'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs pa'ang mig lam du snang ngo / /nub byang gi phyogs mtshams 75kyi 'jig rten gyi khams spos kyi rgyan yid du 'ong ba'i〈8)dge ba'i snying po na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yon tan rgya mtsho tshad med pa'i 'od ces bya ba/ byang chub sems dpa'ashelus kyi 'od zer thogs pa med pa'i gzi brjid rgyal po blo gros la stsogs hu sapa/ byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs 11pa'ang mig lam du snang ngo / /'og girwa)phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams rin po che'i seng ge kyi snang zhing 'bar ba na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od zer chos kyi dbyings su snang ba zhes bya ba byang chub sems dpa'atsha'ichos kyi dbyings 'od 'phro zhing rnam par snang bar byung ba'i blo gros la sogs skupa byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs pa'ang mig lam du snang ngo / /steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyis khams mtshan gyi 'od rnam par snang ba na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yon tan grags pa thogs pa med pa'i rnam par thar pa'i 'od kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba /rdzo byang chub sems dpa' stobs dang / brtson 'grus thogs pa med pa'i blo gros51shel sogs7tshe37—750

pa / byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs pa'ang mig lam du snang ngo / /rigs kyi bu de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa 'di dag la sogs0)pa/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa ribadagra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed mthong yang de bzhin gshegs pa de dag kyang 'dir mi byon/kho bo yang der 'gro ba med de nam 'dod pa de na bde ba yod pa'i 'jig rten gyishobakhams na/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'od snang gamatha' yas pa (gebazhugs pa'ang mthong ngo / /tsan dan yod pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams na de bzhin gshegs pa 'od snang7rdo rje bzhugs pa'ang mthong ngo / /spos dri yod pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams na de bzhin gshegs pa 'od snang lha)rin chen bzhugs pa yang mthong ngo / /pad mo yod pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams na/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'od snang〈2)rin chen pad mo bzhugs pa'ang mthong ngo / /gser yod pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams na de bzhin gshegs pa 'od snang zhi ba bzhugs pa'ang mthong ngo / /mngon par dga' ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams na de bzhin gshegs pa mi sgul 3)ba bzhugs pa'ang mthong ngo / /shin tu brtan 9pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams na de bzhin gshegs pa seng ge bzhugs pa'ang mthong ngo / /me long gi dkyil 'khor ltar snang ba'i 'jig rten gyiphamakhams na de bzhin gshegs pa blo gros zla ba bzhugs pa yang mthong ngo / /rin chen dpal gyi dad pas brgyan pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams na de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad bzhugs pa yang mthong ngo /rigs kyi bu de ltar kho bos ni phyogs gang dang gang na nyi 'jig rten gyi khams gang dang gang gi de bzhin gshegs pa gang dang gang mthong bar 'dod pa'i de bzhin 37—751

gshegs pa de dang de dag kyang mthong ngo / /dusashegang dang gang du dmigs pakhugang dang gang la sngon gyi spyod pa gang dang gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa mthong bar 'dod pa dang / rnam par 'phrul pa gang dang gang gi don dang / sems can 'dul ba gang dang gang gi ri don du de bzhin gshegs pa gang dang gang mthong bar 'dod pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa de dang de dag kyang mthong ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag kyang 'dir gshegs pa ma yin/ bdag kyang der phyin pa ma yin no/ /rigs kyi bu de ltar kho bos de bzhin gshegs pa rnams gakyilas kyang byon pa med par shes la/ rang gi lusasakyang gar yang 'gro ba med par shes pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams rnam par dmyigs pa yang rmi lam lta bur shes la/ rang gis 7sems rnam par dmigs pa yang mi lam dang 'dra bar rgyu bar shes pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams rnam par dmyigs pa yang gzugs brnyan lta bur shes la rang gi sems rnam par dmyigs pa yang chu'i snod gsal ba lta bur shes pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rnams rnam par dmigs pa yang sgyu mas byas pa'i ri nogazugs brnyan〈shelta bur shes la rang gishesems rnam par dmyigs pa yang sgyu ma lta bur shes pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung yang sgra brnyan 1 /ri'i brag cham37lta bur brjod par shes la rang gi sems rnam par dmyigs pa yang sgra brnyan lta bur shes pas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad ni rang gi sems kyi byin gyi rlabs 9/gelas 'byung〈rtengo / /zhes bya bar rjes su rtogs skyeshing khong du chud do/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa thams cad kyang rang gi7sems kyi byin gyi rlabs so/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yang rang gi sems kyi byin gyi rlabs〈nyeso/ /sems 37—752

can thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba dang / gdul ba yang rang gi57sems kyi byin gyi rlabs7so/ /byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam mngon par bsgrub pa yang rang gi sems kyi byin gyi rlabasas so/ /thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi grong khyer du phyin par bya ba yang rang gisnyisems kyi byin gyi55)rlabs so/ /rnam par thar pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas rnam par 657)ba yang rang gi sems kyi byin gyi rlabs7so/ /sangs rgyas kyi byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgyasheb yang rang gi sems kyi byin gyi rlabasamatho so/ /chos kyi dbyings kun nas 'dus par khyu mchog gi mthu dbyung zhing /7rnam par 'phrul pa yang rang gi sems kyi byin gyi rlabasasngorteso/ /bskal pa thams cad shin tu phra bar bsdu ba'i ye shes kyang rang gi5nyesems kyi byin gyi rlabs so/ /zhes bya bar khong du chud cing rjes su rtogs so / /rigs kyi bu de la kho bo 'di snyam du sems te/ dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyis ni rang gi 8sems nyid nye bar brtan7par bya'o/ / chos kyi sprin gyis ni rang gi sems nyid yongs su brlan sna par bya'o/ /sgrib 37pa'i chos rnams las ni rang gi sems nyid yongs su sbyang bar bya'o/ /brtson 'grus kyis ni rang gi sems nyidam 3brtan par bya'o/ /bzod pas ni rang gi 37sems nyid mnyam par bya'o/ /ye shes khong du chud par bya ba la ni ni rang gi sems nyid 22gzhol bar bya'o/ /shes rab kyis5 steni rang gi sems nyid yongs su sbyang bar bya'o/ /(gedabang rnams la ni rang gi sems nyid mngon par bsgrub par bya'o/ /sangs rgyas dang bumanyam pa nyid la ni rang gi rdu phosems nyid rgyas par bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcus ni rang gi trisnyesems nyid snang bar bya'o snyam mo/ /rigs kyi bu kho bo5)ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par thar pa thogs pa med pa'i 37—753

rgyan 'di shes te/ blangs shing yongs su 'dzin par zad0)na/ kho bos byang chub sems dpa' chags 2pa med pa'i sems dang ldan pa chags pa med par rnam par spyod pa'i /spyod yul dang ldan pa/ da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas thams cad mngon sum du bzhugs 4pa'i ting nge 'dzin rab tu thob pa/ mya ngan las 'da' ba myed pa'i mtha' la gnas pa'i slordzogs pa'i byang chub kyi sgo'i ting nge 'dzin rab tu thob pa/ dus gsum mnyam pa nyid du gyur pa/ gzhi kun nas phyed pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi spyod yul gyi tshul shes pa/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du lus rnam par bkram pa/ sangs rgyas kyi yul tha myi dad pa la rnam par spyod pa/ phyogs thams cad du mngon par phyogs pa'i spyod yul dang ldan pa/phyin 6)phyogs med pa'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gyis rnam par lta ba de dag gi lus la 'jig rten gyi khams 7)thams cad 'jigams)cing 'du bar snang yang de dag la bdag dang 'jig rten gyi khams su gnyis kyi 'du shes med pa de dag gi spyod pa shes pa'am/ yon tan brjod par nus re skan/ /song rigs kyi bu lho phyogs kyi rgyud 'di nyid kyi 'dzam bu 9)gling gi mgo 'gebs pas rgyas par 'gengs pa zhes bya ba yod de/ de na dge slong rgya mcho'i rgyal mtshan ces tu )bya ba 'dug gis31 / de'i gan du song la ji ltar byang chub sems dpas7byang chub sems dpa'i nyunyespyod pa la bslab par bya ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bya ba dris shig /de nas tshong dpon gyi 14bu nor bzangs kyis getshong dpon btang brjod kyi rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ tshong dpon btang brjodamotshal lan brgya stong du mar sna g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas nas/ yang dngatsha//yang bltas te/ tshong dpon btang brjod kyi nyu9yon tan grangs med pa la snyan par brjod de/ brtag 37—754

pa dang / mos par bya ba dang / mi btang nyu1bar bya ba sems shing ngu ste〈(smre sngags bton )nas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen sdug par sems shing dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rjes su 'brang ba dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen la rigabasnyen bkur bar mos pa dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis bsgo ba dang / myi 'gal bar byed pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dge ba'i bshes (5)gnyen la rag lus par rjes su blta tshib dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen la rjes su bsam pa dang ske/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la mugayo sgyu med par spyod pa dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi sems kyi dbang du 'gro bar bya ba dang ldan pas dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams gnod()pa thams cad yongs su spong bar byed pas ma tsam du sems/dge ba'i rtsa bsheyongs su bskyed sna pas pha tsam du sems shing tshong dpon btang brjodarwanyekyi drung nas5)song ngo / /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs /nyatshong dpon btang brjod kyis bstan pa de la rjes su sems shing / tshong dpon btang brjod kyi gdams ngag la nan tan du 7bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rjes su 'brang bar bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ye shes snang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa rjes su dran par bya ba dang / chos kyi dbyings la 'jug cing 'bab pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa khong du chud par bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi yongs su 'du b.ratshadabya ba'i tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa la 'jug par bya ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i lha rjes su blta bar bya ba dang /sangs rgyas kyi 7zhing yongs su bsdu ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa la mos par bya ba dang ske/ sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi 3)rlabs kyi rgyan rjes su sbyang ba dang / byang chub 37—755

sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin dang / rnam par thar pa'i rnam par dgod pa dang /khyu mchog gi 'o)mthu phyung ba bsam gyis ②phyi khyab pa la yongs su brtag pa dang /'jig rten gyi khams tha dad pa la sgrib pa med pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa la 'jug pa dang sne/ byang chub sems dpa'i las la bsam pa shin tu brtan pa de la nan du bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i las dang / smon lam gyi rgyudakyibasam gyis mi khyab pa de'i rjes su spyod cing mthar gyis 'dzam bu7gling gi mgo 'gebs pas rgyas par 'gengs pa zhes bya ba gang na ba der phyin nas/ dge slong rgya mcho3re rgyal mtshan tshol tshol ba las/ 'chag pa'i57gnas shig gi 'chag pa'isnyimathar 'dugs49riste/ ting nge 'dzin la mnyam 3) par bzhag nas dbugs phyi nang du rgyu ba med cing myi g.yo la byed pa med cing lus drang por bsrang ste/ dran pa mngon du byas nas ting nge 'dzin gyi rnam par 'phrul pa bsam gyis myi khyab pararwalharnam par 'phrul zhing g.yas g.yon dang / steng logs su lus mtha' yas la tshad med cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyi gtsug bltar mi mthong ba/ kha dog du ma'i lus dang ldan pa sems kyi skad cig re re la kha dog rnamachapa tha dad pa tshad med pa yongs su ston pa de/ de 32de ltar mnyam par bzhag cing zab la zhi (steste/g.yo ba med cing dmigs pa med la dga' bas lus mtho bar gyur pa de'i ba spu'i sgo thams cad nas byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pas rnam par 'phrul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa rab tu 'gyed par 8byed cing 'dug pa mthong ngo / /rnam par thar pas rnam par 'phrul pa de'i mthus sems kyi skad cig re re la sems can thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi mchod pa sbyar 9ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad yongs su dag 37—756

par bya ba dang / sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal gyi phung po rnam par bzlog pa dang / ngan song gi lam thams cad yongs su gcad yo)pa dang /sems can thams cad kyi bde ba'i lam gyi sgo dbye ba (gyedang / sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa'i gdung ba rab tu zhi bar bya ba dang / sems can thams cad kyi mi shes pa'i sgrib pa rnam par gtor ba dang sems can thams cad thams cad ①mkhyen pa nyid la dgod pa'i phyir rnam par 'phrul pa'i bye brag rnam pa sna tshogs mtha' yas pas chos kyi dbyings thams cad rgyas par 'gengs shing de'i rkang pa'i mthil gnyis nas/ tshong gyodapon gyi tshogs bkur ste dang /rim gro sna tshogs byed pa 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du gtogs pa'i tshong dpon dang 'dra ba'i gzugs dang ldan pa lhag pa'i yul la spyod pa/ rgyan sna tshogs kyis lus shin tu klubs pa/ thor tshugs dang gtsug gi rin po che dang /codakyipan sna tshogs thogs pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed byis pa bye ba 'phyesal)pa'i 'khor dang ldan pa byung53)ba mthong ngo / /bram ze dang khyim bdag mang po bza' btung rnam pa mang po dang / ro'i yan lag sna tshogs su sbyar ba thams cad dang / rgyan thams cad dang / gos thams cad dang ske/ me tog thams cad dang / phreng ba thams cad dang / spos thams cad dang ske/ byug pa thams cad dang / 'dod pa'i yo byadapo)thams cad dang /rin po che thams cad dang / gnas thams cad dang / snod rnam pa sna tshogs thams cad dang / yo byad rnam pa sna tshogs thams cad kyis sems can dbul po rnams yongs su sdud7cing / 'gro ba sdug bsngal ba rnams dbugs dbyung ba dang ske/ sems can gyi huX sems tshim par bya ba dang / sems can gyisto/stobasam pa 37—757

rnam par dag par bya ba dang / sems can rnams byang chub tu yongs su smin par byed cing phyogs bcu bkang ste/ 'dong btumathong ngo / /pus mo'i lha nga gnyis nas rgyal rigs mkhas pa'i gzugs dang / bram ze mkhas pa'i gzugs dang ske/ 'jig rten na namakhas pa'i gzugs dang / bzo sna tshogs la mkhas pa'i gzugs dang / mi'i 'gro ba'i rgyud na mkhas pa'i gzugs dang / 'jig rten pa dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i las kyi ri tshul dang / rgyus la gsal zhing mkhas pa'i gzugs dang / 'jig rten gyisaslob dpon du bya bar mkhas pa'i gzugs cha byad rnam pa du ma dang ldan pa/ dbyibs dang rgyan rnam pa du ma dang ldan pa/ yid du 'ong ba'i tshig mang po brjod pas/ yid rgyami bde ba'i sems can rab tu dga' bar byed cing chos kyi skunor gyis dbul ba'i sems can rnams la phan gdags pa dang / sdug bsngal ba'i sems can rnams bde bar bya ba dang / log par ltung tsheba'i sems can rnams mngon par gdon pa dang /theg pa'i gru la nyam nyes su gyur pa'i sems can rnams dbugs dbyung ba dang /'jigs napa'i sems can rnams yongs su bskyab pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba'i sgra kun tu grags 9par bya ba dang / sdig pa tshalas bzlog pa'i sgra yongs su bsgrag hunya pa dang / dge ba'i chos yang dag par blang ba nyi la sems can gzung ba dang /don spyod 1 pa la sems can dgod pa dang / dga' ba'i shugs yongs su bskyed pa dang / snyan par smra ba'i bsdu ba'i dngos po yongs su brjod pa dang /'jig rten la don mthun 1 par bsgrub pa ston par mabyed cing phyogs bcu rgyas par bkang ste 'dong ba mthong ngo / /lte ba'i dkyil 'khor nas drang srong mang potshage 'gro ba thams cad kyi lus kyi 1 dbyibs su 'khod pa/ pags 32pa dang shun pa'i 37—758

gos gyon pa ril ba thogs pa/ gzugs dang cha byad dang dbyibs sna tshogs can spyod lam rab tu zhi ba dag 3)byung nas/ steng gi bar snang las sangs rgyas kyi yon tan brjod pa byedamacho cing / chos kyi sgra yongs su bsgragasho pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi sgra brjod pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun yongs su bstan pa dang / tshangs pa'i spyod pa yongs su brjod pa dang / dbang po dben pa la sems can dgod pa dang / rang bzhin med pa'i don rab tu brtag pa dang /ye shes kyi don la 'jig rten rab tu dgod pa dang / 'jig rten gyi gtsug lag gi rnam pa yongs su brjod pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i rigaye shes kyis 'byung ba'i lam gyiḍūtshul rab tu bstan pa dang / mthar gyis bya ba'i las la sems can rab tu dgod pa byed cing / phyogs bcu bkang ste 'dong ba mthong ngo ske/ /rtsi ba logs gnyis nas/ klu'i bu mo 'jig rten rgyu ba thams cad kyi567grangs dang mnyam pa/ lus kyi 7)dbyibs bsam gyisa' mi khyab pa du ma dang ldan pa byung ste klu'i rnam par 'phrul pa bsam gyisam9 mi khyab pa yongs su bstan pa dang /spos kyi sprin gyi rgyan bsam gyis mi khyab pa nam mkha'i dbyings la byin gyis brlab nyu tshopa dang / me tog gi sprin gyi rgyan 31bsam gyis mi khyab pas nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad brgyan pa dang / phreng 12ba'i sprin bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyan gyis nam mkha'i hu dbyings thams cad rnam par klubs 8pa dang / rin po che'i gdugs kyi sprin bsam gyis 8mi khyab pa'i rgyan gyis/ chos kyi dbyings thams cad yongs su khebs par bya ba dang / rin po che'i rgyal mtshan gyi sprin tshubasam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyan dang / rin po che'i lha'i ba dan gyi sprin bsam gyis nyi 7mi khyab pa'i rgyan dang / rin po che'i phyang 'phrul lha sna tshogs kyi sprin dang / char 3737—759

bsam gyis7mi khyab pa'i rgyan dang / nor bu rin po che dam pa'i sprin gyikhuchar 'bab pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyan dang / rin po che'i se mo do sna tshogs dang / me tog gi sprin gyi char〈mibasam gyis mi khyab pa'i brgyan dang / rin po che'i khri la skyil mo krung ⑤du 'khod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' dusangs rgyas kyi chos kyi sprin gyi char bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'bebs pa'i rgyan dngashe/ lha rdzas kyi rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs dang ldan pa'i lha'ishebu mo mang po chos kyi glu snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs kyitshwa)sprin gyi char7'bebs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / rin po che'i7pad mo ze ba mtho ba mu tig gi dra bas brgyan pa/ rin po che'i rgyal po thams cad kyi 'bru'i sprin gyi char rnam par 'thor ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyan dang ske/ rin po che'i cod pan gyi sprin nor bu rin po che thams cad kyis rab tu brgyan pa/ 'od zer gyi sprin mtha' yas pa'i char 'bebs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyan dang / lha'i lus kyi sprin gyi me tog dang / phreng ba dang / gdugs dang ske/ rgyal mtshan dang / lha'i ba dan bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyan dang /lha'i bu mo mang po'i lus kyi sprin thal mo sbyar te/ gser gyi me tog snyim pas 'dor ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa la yon tan dang / legs pa thams cad du bstod pa'i sprin gyi 'brug sgra 'byin cing char 'bebs pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyanas snyenam mkha'i dbyings la byin gyis rlob cing / spos kyi phung po'i sprin rin po che thams cad kyi kha dog tu 'dug pa dang7/ bdug spos kyi na bun dang sprin shin tu rgya che bas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khoradza ste mngon par khebs par bya ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams 'byamatshu nyeklas pa thams cad rab tu brgyanamanyapa dang / sems can thams cad rab tu dga' bar bya ba 37—760

dang ske/ sangs rgyas thams cad mchod pas skad cig skad cig tu chos kyi dbyings thams cad rgyas par 'gengs pa tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis stimathong ngo ske/ /mthongakhuka'i dpal gyi〈be'u nas lha ma yin gyi dbang po sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed byung ste/ lha ma yin gyi sgyus rnam par 'phrul pa bsam gyis ④mi khyab pa ⑤rab tu ston cing chu 'dzin chen po yongs su bskyam pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams brgya stong rab tu bskyod pa dang / ri'i rgyal po chen po thams cad 'thabashepar bya ba dang / lha'i gnas thams cad yongs su bskyod7pa dang / bdud kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad zil gyis gnan7pa dang / bdud kyi sde thams cad rab tu gdul ba dang / nga rgyal dang rlom pa dang dregs pa thams cad rab tu gzhom pa dang / gnod par sems pa'i tu dīsems bzlog cing dga' bar bya ba dang / 'tho 'tsham5)pa'i sems phyir bzlog par bya ba dang / sems can rnams kyi mi dge ba'i chos rab tu zhi bar bya ba dang ske/ nyon mongs pa'i ri rnam par gtor tshib dang / nyon mongs pa'i thab mimo shin tu zhi bar bya ba dang / lha ma yin gyi sgyus 34rnam par 'phrul pa dang /rnam par rtsesab sna tshogs kyis sems can rnams skyo bar bya ba dang / sdig pa las gyen du bskyod pa dang / 'khor bas 'jigs par bya ba dang / srid pa'i lam gyi rgyud thams cad nas gyen du bskyod de gnas med pa la rab tu gnas par byatshwa snab dang / byang chub kyi sems la sems can rnams rab tu dgod pa dang /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa rnam par dag par bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams pha rol tu phyin pa la rab tu dgod par bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i〈shes la rab tu gzung ba rjedang /37—761

byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis0)sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi tshul snang ba yongs su bskyed pa dang / chos kyi tshul rnam par dgod pa sna tshogs kyis7sems kyi skad cig re re zhing chos kyi dbyings rgyas par 'gengs par byed pa/ tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyisar1mthong ngo / /rgyab kyi gzhung nas nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas mang po sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed byung nas nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyis 'dul ba'i sems can bdag tu mngon par zhen pa rnams la bdag med pa dang / sems can med pa yongs su brjod par /byed cing / rtag par mngon par zhen pa rnams la 'du byed thams cad myi rtag par yongs su bstan pa dang / 'dod chags kyi spyod pa can rnams la myi sdug pa dang / zhe snang gi spyod pa can rnams la byams pa dang / gti mug gi spyod pa can〈rnams la rkyen las byung ba'i rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba brjod pa dang / cha mnyam pa'i spyod pa can rnams la ye shes kyi yul dang ldan pa'i chos kyi tshula'alamangon par bstan pa dang / yul la mngon par dga' ba rnams la gnas med pa rab tu brjod pa dngashe/ zhi ba la gnas su sems pa rnams la smon lam gyi khyad par gyis spro ba ⑨bskyed pa dang / phyogs kyi rgyud dang sgo thams cad du chos kyi tshul rgya mtsho'i rgyud dang / sgo thams cad sems can thams cad kyi don du brjod par 8byed cing chos kyi themedabyings rgyas par 'gengs pa tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyisalgemathong ngo / /phrag pa'i lhun gnyis las gnod sbyin dang / srin po'i dbang po hu)dbyibs sna tshogs dang ldan zhing lus mi sdug pasakha dog dang chu zheng sna tshogs can spyod lam gyi rnam pa sna tshogs dang ldan pa / bzhonas pa sna tshogs la zhon pa/ 'khor sna tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba/37—762

sems can gyi khams yongs su bskyang ba la brtson pa/ 'od sna tshogs kyis snang bar bya ba la brtson pa/ dbyangs sna tshogs rab tu sgrog pa/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa'i0rdul shin tu phra ba snyed byung nas thabs mngon par bsgrub pa sna tshogs ma 'dres pas phyogs dang phyogs mtshams7kun gyi nam mkha' rgyas par 'gengs shing dge ba'i spyod pa thams cad yongs su bsrung ba dang /'phags pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad yongs su bsrung ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad yongs su gzung ba dang / lag na rdo rje'i las kyis yang dag par song ba dang / yang dag par zhugs pa thams cad yongs su bsrung ba dang / sangs rgyas thams cad la mchod pa dang rim gro〈gubya ba dang /sems can log par lhung (8)ba rnams kyi ngan song gi lam gyi ribargyud thams cad rnam par bzlog pa dang / 'jig rten thams cad kyi nadaphakyedang / gnod pa dang 'jigs pa thams cad zhi bar byed pa'ilo7don du brtson pa/ sems can gyi don bya bas 'jig rten yongs su bskyang ba la brtson pa rnams bsod nams dang /ye shes kyi 'khor lo yongs su rdzogs par bya ba dang / chos kyi 'khor lo'i()rjes su 'brang bar bya ba dang / phas kyi rgol ba'i 'khor tshar gcod par0)byed cing /chos kyi dbyings thams cad rgyas par 'gengs parasgo byed pa/ tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis 3nyamathong ngo / /mdun gyi lto nas myi'am ci'i dbang po7sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed mi'am ci'i dbang po'i bu mo'i 'khor brgya stong grangs med pa can dang / dri za'i dbang po sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed/ dri za'i dbang po'i bu mo'imatsha'akhor brgya stong grangs med pa can dag byung nas/ lha'i rol mo brgya stong grangs med 37wa 763

pa'i sgra snyan paphanyu1dang / glu'i dbyangs〈gekyis chos kyi rang bzhin dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bstod pa brjod pa byed7cing / byang chub kyi sems7yongs su bsngags pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yongs su brjod pa dang /mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya 3)ba'i sgo thams cad la mngon par bstod pa dang ske/ chos kyi 'khor lo'i sgo thams cad du 'jug pa dang / rnam par 'phrul pa'i sgo thams cad la mngon par spro bar bya ba dang yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba'itso sgo thams cad yongs su brjod pa dang / sangs rgyas kyis57bstan pa'i sgo thams cad yongs su gzung ba dang / sems can gyi sgo thams cad rab tu dga' bar bya ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi 3)zhing gi sgo thams cad yongs su dag par bya ba dang / chos kyi sgo thams cad mngon par bstan par bya ba dang /sgrib pa'i sgo thams cad rnam par bzlog par bya ba dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba'i sgo thams cad yongs su bskyed pa ⑨byed cing / chos kyi 7dbyings rgyas par 'gengs pa tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis 3nyamathong ngo / /kha'i sgo nas 'khor los sgyur tu ba'i rgyal po rin po che bdun dang ldan zhing stobs kyi yan lag bzhi'i tshogs kyi 12'khor dang ldan pa byung minas/ sbyin pa chen po'i 8'od zer gyi rgyan rab tu 'gyed cing rin po che'i 'byung gnas thams cad yongs su gtang ba dang / nor bu rin po che'i tshogs thams cad sbyin pa dang / dbul po rnams nor dang ldan par bya ba dang / srog gcod pa las 'jig rten rnam par bzlog pa dang / byams pa'i sems la sems can rab tu dgod pa dang / ma byin par len pa dang rab tu dbral ba dang / rgyan gyis shin tu brgyan pa'i bu mo bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong yongs su gtang tu)ba dang / 'dod pas log par 37—764

g.yem pa las rnam par bzlog pa dang / tshangs pa'i spyod pa la rab tu dgod pa dang / brdzun du smra ba las rnam par bzlog pa dang / bslu0ba skyed pa la gzhol bar rab tu dgod pa dang / phra ma'i tshig las rnam par bzlog pa dang /gzhan 'dumasapar brtson pa'i tshig rab tu brjod pa dang / zhe gcod pa'i tshigashelas 'jig rten rnam par bzlog pa dang / 'jam zhing yid du 'ong ba'i tshig rab tu brjod pa dang / gnod pa'i chos dang ldan pa'i byung rgyal du smra ba las sems can rnam par bzlog pa dang / don zab mo'i tshig rab tu dbye ba gdon mi za ba la yang dag par dgod pa dang / ngag gi nyes pa thams cad las 'jig rten rnam par bzlog pa dang / snying rje dang ldan pa'i tshig rab ⑤tu brjod par bya ba dang / 'jig rten gyi snying gi dri ma yongs su sel cing 'dod pa chung ba dang / chog shes pa la brtson par sems can rab tu dgod pa dang /chags sems las 'jig rten rnam par bzlog pa dang / gzhan gyi sems kyi rgyud dga' bar byed pa la rab tu dgod pa dang / lta ba'i dra ba thams cad las 'jig rten rab tu gdon pa dang / yid gnyis kyisher ba thams cad rnam par gtor ba dang / the tsom gyi spo ④thams cad yang 6nyerab tu gzhom pa dang /nem nur dang som nyi'i rab rib yongs su bstsal5)ba dang / chos rnam par dbye ba'irwanye'ajig rten du rab tu dbyi7ba dang / rkyen las byung batshwanyerab tu brjodarwanyepa dang / rang bzhin gyis bden7pa'i tshul la sems can rab tu dgod pa dang / sgrib pa thams cad rnam par bzlog pa dang / sgrib pa med pa'i tshul la gzung ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi don gyi tshul sna tshogs brjod pa byed cing / phyogs bcu'i chos kyi dbyings rgyas par 'gengs pa tshong dpon gyi bu 37—765

nor bzangs kyis ga1rimathong ngo / /mig gnyis nas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor brgya stong sangs rgyas gyi zhing grangs med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed byung ste/ sems can dmyal ba chen po thams cad yongs su snang bar byed cing 'jig rten gyi mun pa chen po sel ba dang / sems can rnams kyi da nagati mug gi rab rib sel ba dang /grang ba'i sems can dmyal ba na 'khod pa'i sems can rnams kyi grang ba'i lasdug bsngal rab tu zhi bar byed pa dang / sa'i rang bzhin gyi zhing rnams su 'od kha dog dkar po can rab tu 'gyed pa dang / gser gyi rang bzhin gyi zhing rnams su 'od be+e ḍūr+ya'i bakha dog can tsho'udirab tu 'gyed pa dang be+e ḍūr+ya'i ⑥rang bzhin gyi zhing rnams su 'od dngul (spyigyi kha dog can rab tu 'gyed pa dang / dngul gyi rang bzhin gyi zhing rnams su 'od gser gyi kha dog can rab tu 'gyed pa dang /ci/ gser gyi rang bzhin gyi zhing rnams su 'od shel gyi kha dog can stirab tu 'gyed pa dang / gser gyi rang bzhin gyi zhing rnams su 'od mu tig dmar po'i kha dog can rab tu 'gyed pa dang / a sma gar+bha'i 3 cirang bzhin gyi zhing rnams su 'od gser gyi kha dogs37can rab tu 'gyed pa dang / gser gyi rang bzhin gyi sna zhing rnams su 'od a sma gar+bha'i 12kha dog can rab tu 'gyed pa dngakhe/yin dra nī bela'i rang bzhin gyi zhing rnams su 'od rin po che'i rgyal po nyi ma'i snying po'i kha dog can rab tu 'gyed pa dang 7/ rin po che'i rgyal po nyi ma'i snying po'i rang bzhin gyi zhing rnams su 'od rin po che'i rgyal po sna yin dra nī nyusnyela'i kha dog can rab tu 'gyed pa dang / mu tig dmar po'i rang bzhin gyi zhing rnams su 'od rin po che'i rgyal po zla ba'i 'od zer gyi dra ba dang dkyil 'khor gyi snying po'i kha dog can rab tu 'gyed pa dang / rin po che'i rgyal po zla ba'i 'od zer gyi dra 37wa 766

ba dang dkyil 'khor gyi 1)snying po'i rang bzhin gyi zhing rnams su 'od mu tig dmar po'ikhukha dog can rab tu 'gyed pa dang / rin po che gcig gi rang bzhin gyi gzhing rnams su 'od rin po che sna tshogs kyi kha dog can rab tu 'gyed pa dang /rin po che sna tshogs kyis)rang bzhin gyi zhing rnams su 'od rin po che gcig gi kha dog can rab tu 'gyed pa dang / de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad du sems can gyi don tshad med pa la brtson zhing chos kyi dbyings rgyas par 'gengs pa tshong dpon gyi bu snyenor bzangs kyis 6)mthong ngo ske/ /smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu nas zla ba mang po sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed byung nas/ lha'i dbang po thams cad zil gyis sheganon cing / 'jig rten thams cad kyi 'dod pa'i dga' ba rnam par bzlog pa dang / sangs rgyas blta bar dga' ba la rjes su bsngags pa59 byed cing ske/ sems can tshad myed pa gdul ba la71 )brtson par phyogs bcu'i chos kyi dbyings rgyas par 'gengs par hu7mthong ngo / /'phral 32ba nas tshangs pa chen po spyod lam rab tu zhi ba sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed byung ba〈nyenas/ tshangs pa'i dbyangs su brjod de/ sangs rgyas thams cad la gsol ba gdab hustepa dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rab tu dga' bar bya ba78byed cing sems can gyi don tshad med pa la brtson par phyogs bcu'i chos kyi dbyings rgyas par 'gengs pa tshong dpon gyi bu tshanor bzangs kyis 1 mthong ngo ske/ /mgo nas byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed byung nas/ kha dog dang dbyibs sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i lus yongs su ston cing / dpe nyu8byad bzang pos rnam par bris pa'i lus rab 37wa 767

tu ston0)pa dang / 'od kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sprin mtha' dang dbus med pa rab tu dgyelab dang / ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa nas bzung ste/ gtong ba dang len pa dang /dngos po yongs su gtong ba'i〈 sprin mang po rab tu dgyetswab dang / pha rol tu phyin pa sna tshogs dang ldan pa'i sngon gyi sbyor ba rgyasnyimatsho yongs su bstan pa dang /sbyin pa'i spyod pa 'jig rten du yongs su brjod pa dang / ser sna'i dri ma rnam par bzlog pa dang / chags pa thams cad spang ba la sems can rab tu dgod pa dang / 'jig rten rin po che sna tshogs thams cad kyi rgyan gyis brgyan7par byin gyisastonabarlab pa dang / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la sems can rab tu dgod pa dang / mtshan thams cad kyi yon tan yang dag par brjod pa dang /sangs rgyas kyi mtshan 'byung ba'i rgyu ston pa7byed pa mthong ngo / /yang byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs myed pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed byung nas/tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su brjod cing / ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i ⑨sngon gyi sbyor ba rgya mtsho yongs su bstan pa dang / sems can thams cad lam gyi rgyud dang yul las phyir phyogs par byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yul la mngon mdu phyogs par bya ba dang / 'jig rten gyi 'dod pa la rnam par smad pa dang ske/ 'jig rten gyi phyin ci log gi ling tog (7rnam par bsal tunyeb dang /log pa'i rnam par rtog pa rab tu zhi bar byas nas byang chub sems dpa'i tshul khrims la yang dag par dgod pa dang / snying rje chen po'i tshul khrims yongs su brjod cing de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshul khrims rab tu thob par bya ba'i phyir/37—768

sangs rgyas kyi lam nan tan du bya ba'i tshul khrims la sems can rab tu dgodatupa dang / srid pa'i lam gyi rgyud rmi lam lta bur sems can rnams la rab tu brjod cing / rmi lam gyi tshul dang mnyam par yongs su gzhol bar bya ba'i phyir yul yongs su 'dzin pa dang nyon mongs pa la dbang bsgyur bar 7sems can rnams rab tu dgod pa byed pa mthong ngo / /yang byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed byung nas/ 'jig rten rnams la mdog gser gyi kha dog lta bum —nomangon par ston cing / khromabab med pa dang ske/ 'khrug⑧pa med pa dang / shar 6)gnyer ba med pa dang / zhe sdang ba med pa dang / chud gson ⑦pa med pa dang / khong khro ba med pa'i sems la sems can rab tu dgod ba dang / byol song gi skye gnas kyi lam gyi rgyud thams cad yongs su gcod7pa'i phyir/ ba spu'i 1)sgo thams cad nas bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i sngon gyi sbyor ba'i sprin rab tu 'gyed cing bzod pa'i stobs la sems can rab tu dgod pa dang / chos la dbang bsgyur〈nyab la sems can rab tu snang bar byed pa mthong ngo / /yang byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed byung ste / byang chub sems dpa'i brtson 'grus kyi stobs mtha' yas pa shin tu ston cing ske/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du brtsamasatshwa pa las phyir myi ldog pa'i stobs kyis thos pa rgya mtsho yongs su btsal bas mi skyo bar bya ba 32yongs su brjod pa dang ske/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mchod cing rim gro bya ba la sems can rab tu gzud pa dang 0/ sdug bsngal gyi phung po thams cad rnam par bzlog pa'i brtson 'grus chen po la sems can rab tu dgod pa dang / brtson 'grus 37wa 769

kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i sngon gyi sbyor ba mang po'i sprin lus thams cad las rab tu 'gyed cing byang chub sems dpa'i brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i spyod pa yongs su bstan pa dang / sems can rnams kyi le lo'i ri rnam par gtor ba dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la sems can rab tu dgod pa dang las la dbang bsgyur ba lasko17'jig rten rab tu gzud pa dang / rgyun mi chad par dzubartson par byed pa mthong ngo / /yang byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed byung nas/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rjes su dran pa'i lamatshwa la sems can thams cad rab tu dgod cing sgrib ri4)pa dang / bar du gcod pa dang / rab rib thams cad rnam par selamacholtab dang / rlom pa dang bag med pa thams cad las sems can rnam par bzlog phyi pa dang / bag yod pa'i chos la rab tu dgod pa dang / khengs pa 'gying bas dang / nga rgyal gyi rgyal mtshan rab tu snyol58)ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi bsam gtan gyi yan lag rgya mtsho brjod pa dang / 'jig rten rnams la bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su bsngags pa dang / ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i sngon gyi tshul mang po'i sprin rab tu dgye ba thodang / sems hu tshol dbang bsgyur nyu1ba la sems can rab tu dgod pa 12byed cing skad cig re re la chos kyi dbyings rgyas par 'gengs pa mthong ngo / /yang byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa'i rdul 12shin tu phra ba snyed byung ste/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas sangs rgyas kyi chos yongs su tshol ba dang ldan pa'i sngon gyi sbyor ba mang po'i sprin mirab tu dgye ba dang / dbyangs kyi yan lag rgya mtsho'i skad thams cad kyis 7shes rab kyi pha 37wa 770

rol tu phyin pa'i sprin gyi 'brug sgra sgrog pa dang / yang dag par lta hu)ba'i glogasherab tu 'gyed pa dang / chos kyi rang bzhin gyi sgra dbyangs rab tu bsgrag⑧pa dang ske/ sems can rnams kyi bdag tu lta ba'i ri'i lhun rab tu gzhigs gepa dang /lta ba thams cad kyi zug rngu dbyung ba dang / the tsomatshamadang yid gnyis dang nem nur gyi rab rib rnam par bstsalar+sā)ba dang / ye shes kyi dbang yang dag par bsngags pa byed cing / sems kyi skad cig re re la (7)chos kyi dbyings rgyas par 'gengs pa mthong ngo / /yang byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed byung nas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thabs mkhas pa'i tshul gyi dkyil 'khor rab tu brjodapo)pa byed cing ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas thabs mkhas pa dang ldan pa'i sngon gyi sbyor ba mang po'i sprin rab tu dgye ba dang / 'jig rten rnams la thabs mkhas pa'i spyod pa rab tu brjod pa dang /theg pa chen po'i 'byung ba mngon par bstan pa dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor yang dag par bsngags pa dang / 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa tha myi dad pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yongs su bstan pa dang /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thabs mkhas pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la sems can rab tu dgod pa dang / 'jig rten rnams la byang chub sems dpa'i dbang gi dkyil 'khor rab tu bstan pa byed cing / sems bskyed pa re re la chos kyi dbyings rgyas par 'gengs pa mthong ngo / /yang byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed byung ste/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi hu tshomatshan rgya mcho'i sprin gyi 'brug sgra sgrog cing / ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas byang chub sems dpa' sems can01

thams cad kyi smon lam gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa dang ldan pa'i sngon gyi sbyor ba mang po'i sprin rab tu dgye7ba dang / smon lam gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang dag par bsngags pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i dbang thams cad la sems can rab tu dgod pa dang / smon lam chen po'i shing rta'i 'khor lo phyi ma'i mtha'i ༷mur thug par 'dril ba/ chos thams cad kyi rjes su 'brang ba nyon mongs pa thams cad rnam par bzlogasho pa/ mi shes pa'i ri7rnam par 'thor ba/'jig rten du rab tu brjodalo pa byed cing / smon lam sna tshogs kyi rnam par 'phrul pas/ sems kyi skad cig re re la chos kyi dbyings rgyas par 'gengs pa mthong ngo sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/ bam po sum cu pa/ye yang byang chub sems dpa'57sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed〈khubyung ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i stobs rab tu snang bar (5bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i stobs yongs su bsgrub pa'i sgra rab tu dbyung 9ba dang / ba spu'i nyu)bu ga thams cad nas hunyestobs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa sgrub cing 'byin pa'i sngon gyi sbyor ba mang po'i sprin rab tu dgye tunyeb dang /bdud dang phas kyi rgol ba thams cad kyis mi thubalgepa'i stobs yongs su bstan pa dang / khor yug dang rdo rje'i ri 8thams cad lus kyi steng du rdibs8kyang mi nyams 3 tshopa'i stobs rab tu brjod pa dang / bskal7)pas tshig pa5)thams cad kyi me shu skurgya mtsho'i nang na gnas kyang lus la gnod pa med pa'i stobs yongs su bstan pa dang / 'jig rten gyi khams 'byam57klas pa thams cad lag pa'i mthil gyis nam mkha'i dbyings su ston pa'i stobs yongs su ston pa byed cing /37wa 772

sems7kyi skad cig re re la chos kyi dbyings su〈'gengs pas7rgyun mi gcod pa mthong ngo / /yang byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed byung nas/ sems can rnams la ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor ston cing ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas ye shes kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su dag pa dang ldan pa'i sngon gyi sbyor ba mang po'i sprin rab tu dgye bsredang / 'jig rten rnams la sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yon tan dang / ye shes mngon par shes pa dang ldan pa'i ye shes kyis rab tu brjod pa dang / sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mtshanasnyemangon par shes pa dang ldan pa'i ye shes kyis4)mngon par bstan pa dang / smon lam thams cad mngon par bsgrub pa'i ye shes mngon par shes pa dang ldan pa'i ye shes kyis yongs su brjod pa dang / sems can thams cad yongs su bsdu ba'i smon lam mngon par bsgrub pa'i ye shes mngon par shes pa dang ldan pa'i ye shes kyis shin tu yangs par bya ba dang / sems can thams cad bdag myed pa'i rang bzhin la gzud pa mngon par shes pa dang ldan pa'i ye shes kyis rnam par bstan pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi sems rgya mtsho rnam par blta ba mngon par shes pa dang ldan pa'i ye shes kyis rab tu brjod pa dang ske/ sems can thams cad kyi dbang po rnam par dbye ba'i ye shes mngon par shes pa dang ldan pa'i ye shes kyis rab tu dbye ba dang / sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa dang mos pa rnam par blta ba'i ye shes mngon par shes pa dang ldan pa'i ye shes kyis yang dag par brjod pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi las rgya mtsho la 'jugashepa'i ye shes mngon par shes pa dang ldan pa'i ye shes kyis rnam par grol〈ba dang / sems can thams cad kyi smon lam rgya mtsho la 'jug 37—773

pa'i ye shes mngon par shes pa dang ldan pa'i ye shes kyis yongs su bstan pa ①byed cing / sems kyi skad cig re re la chos kyi dbyings rgyas par 'gengs pa tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis du mthong ngo / /spyi bo'i gtsug tor ③gyi gseb nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed mtshan dam pa dang / dpe〈gebyad bzang po rnam par dag pas brgyan pa/ 'dzam bu chu klung gi gser gyi ri bo shin tu 'bar ba ltar snang ba 'od kyi rinanodakyil 'khor phyogs bcur spang )zhing tshad med par 'bar ba dang / chos kyi dbyings tshul gyis rgyas par 'gengs pa'i5medabyangs mnga' ba/ sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa mtha' dang dbus med pa yongs su ston pa kye'agro ba thams cad la tha mi dad par chos kyi sprin gyi7char mngon par 'bebs pa ste/ 'di ltar snying po byang chub mchog tu phyin pa'i byang chub sems dpa'apha rnams la chos kyi dbyings kyi 11gzhi'i bye brag mngon sum7du shes pa'i sprin ces bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' dbang bskur〈nyeb thob pa rnams la gzhi kun tu rten pa'i sprin ces bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' chos chen po'i rgyal tshabacatu dbang bskur ba rnams la sgo kun nas 'jug pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab 'apa dang / byang chub sems dpa' gzhon nur gyur pa rnams la kun nas brgyan pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi the char mngon par dbab pa dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa' phyir mi ldog pa rnams la snying rje chen po'i tshogs shin tu brtan pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang /byang chub sems dpa' lhag pa'i bsam pa dag pa rnams la chos thams cad kyi 37—774

rang bzhin gyi bye brag shes pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i hu)chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sngon gyi sbyor ba dang ldan pa rnams la 'gro ba yongs su sdud pas kun nas brgyan pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' tsher skyes pa rnams la dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor mngon sum du dmigs pa'i sprin ces bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnal 'byor la spyod pa rnams la chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin dang gzhi rab tu sgrog pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' las dang po pa rnams la snying rje chen po'i tshul dang thabs kyi snying po'i sprin kun tu 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i chos kyi khusprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dang po bskyed pa rnams la dga' bar bgyisaba'i mdzod shin tu bstsagasams)pa'i snying po zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' yangs pa la mos pa rnams la gernam par thar pa mi zad pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i smon lam gyis dga' bar byed pa'i mdzod ces bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang / gzugs la spyod pa'i sems can rnams la gzhi kun tu mi zad pa'i mdzod ces bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang / tshangs pa'i ris kyi lha rnams la tshul rgya mtsho tshad med pa'i 'brug sgra'i dbyangs shes 6)bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang / dbang bsgyur gyi ④lha rnams la stobs 'byung ba'i chos kyi yo byad mi zad pa'i mdzod ces bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang / bdud kyi ris kyi lha rnams la thams 37—775

cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi tshogs ①rgyal mtshan sna tshogs ②can yang dag pa ③bsgrub pa'i dbyangs shes ④bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang /'phrul dga'i lha rnams la ye shes rin po che sna tshogs la brtson pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyisnyisprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang / dga' ldan gyi lha rnams la byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam rin po che sna tshogs kyi rgyal0mtshan zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang / mtshe ma'i lha rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rjes su dran pa'i mdzod ces bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang / lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyi gnas su de bzhin gshegs pa mthong bas dge ba'i shugs 'byung bshezhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang / gnod sbyin gyi dbang po'i gnas su chos kyi dbyings kyi nam mkha' la de bzhin gshegs pa'i gnas ⑨rnam par 'phrul pas rgyas pararwa1'gengs pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang /dri za'i dbang po'i gnas su de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos yang dag par bgro〈nyeb zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa〈nyedang / lha ma yin gyi gnas su ye shes kyi tshul rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor ces bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang / nam mkha'5)lding gi dbang po'i gnas su de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'byung ba'i thabs kyi sprin ces bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang / mi'am ci'i dbang po'i gnas su chos kyi sprin yang dag par 'gro ba thams cad kyi dbyangs shes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang / klu'i dbang po'i gnas su byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par 'phrul pa sgrog cing srid pa'i lam gyi rgyud las skyo ba bskyedasnyepa 37—776

zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang / lto 'phye chen po'i dbang po'ituganas su dga' ba rgya mtshos rnam par 'phel bar byed pa'i shugs shesasnyebya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang / myi'i gnas su 'gro ba thams cad las khyad par du 'phags pa'i ye shes rnam par 'byed pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang / sems can dmyal ba'i 'jig rten du 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad rab tu zhi ba'i dbyangs dang /'phags pa'i lam gyi tshig gi rgyud kyis brgyan pa zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang / byol song gi skye gnas su las kyi lam kha na ma tho ba med pa la nan tan du bya ba'isnyidabyangs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa rjes su dran pa'i sprin gyi dkyil 'khor gyi lhun ces ⑥bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten du de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bsgrag pa⑦/ sems can thams cad kyi gtong ba'i sems 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon pan dbab pa dang / sems can log par ltung bshernams la sdug bsngal thams cad zhi ba rab tu 'thob pas dbugs 'byung khyaba'i dbyangs kyi nga ro zhes bya ba'i chos kyi sprin gyi char mngon par dbab pa mdzad cing chos kyi dbyings rgyas par 'gengs pa tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis mthong ngo / /ba spu'i bu ga thams cad las ba spu'i nyunyasgo re re nas kyang 'od zer gyi dra ba dang / dkyil 'khor gyipha kha dog dang gzugs kyi glongasnyadang rgyan grangs med pa can dgos pa sna tshogs grangs med pa la sta gon du gnas pa/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing grangs med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed byung nas/phyogs bcu'i chos kyi dbyings rgyas par 'gengs pa mthong ste/ 'di ltar ba spu'i 37—777

sgo'i 'od zer gyi dra ba dang / dkyil 'khor la la las ni sbyin pa'i7spyod pa skyon med pas/ bdog pa thams cad yongs su gtong brkurnam par 'phrul pa mthong ngo ske/ /ba spu'i sgo'i dra ba dang / dkyil 'khor la la las ni dus gsum gyi byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi tshul khrims dang brtul zhugs dang / yi〈gedam dang tshul khrimasasnyikyi dkyil 'khor du rnam par 'phrul pa mthong ngo / /ba spu'i sgo'i 'od zer gyi dra ba dang mi/ dkyil 'khor la la las ni byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bzod pa'i spyod pa'i (9)rnam pa dus gsum du byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams rka 47lag dang / yan lag gi dam pa bcad ④kyang nyams su bzod pa byed pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa dang / khu tshur dang dbyig pas bsnun te/ mtshon gyis lus la btab kyang nyams su bzod par byed pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa dang / lus thams cad gshegs sam3)/ snying dang myig phyung yang nyams su bzod pa byed pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa mthong ngo / /byang chub sems dpa' 7dus gsum du byung ba rnam par brtags pa'i lus dang ldan pa gzhan dag gis 31thams cad mkhyen pa 32nyid yongs su btsal ba'i ched du lus dang ske/ sems la gnod pa thams cad dang yan lag dang nying lag bcad nyartepa thams cad kyang snying rje chen pos dbang du byas pa'i phyir nyams su bzod par byas pa dang / bag la zha khebar byas pa dang btang78stoms su bzhag pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i bzod pa'i spyod pa rnam par 'phrul pa'i gzugs brnyan gyi gzugs de lta bu dag kyangs mthong ngo / /ba spu'i7 snasgo'i 'od zer gyi dra ba dang /dkyil 'khor la la las ni byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi brtson 'grus kyi spyod pa rnam pa tha dad pa rnam par phye ba'i gzugs dang / byang chub sems 37—778
