dpa' 'das pa dang / ma 'ongs pa dang da ltar byung ba'i brtson 'grus kyi rnam par 'phrul pa 'jig rten yongs su bskyod pa dang rgya mtsho yongs su bskyod ①pa dang ske/ sems can yongs su skyo bar bya ba dang / mu stegs can thams cad yongs su tshar gcad pa dang / bdud thams cad spa dgongakhub dang / chos kyi phyogs snang bar bya ba'i byang chub sems dpa'i mthu chen porasarnam par 'phrul pa mthong ngo / /ba spu'i sgo'i 'od zer gyi dra ba dang / dkyil 'khor la la las ni byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyod pa rnam par rgyu ba'i rnam grangs ji snyed pa dang lus nye bar len pa ji snyed pa dang / rigs su skye ba yongs su bzungasnyib ci po)snyed pa dang / gzugs kyi lus yongs su grub pa ji snyed pa dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis rjes su bstan pa yongs su bzung ba ji snyed pa dang /⑥dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis (7)man ngag la nan tan du bya ba'i gnas ji snyed pa dang ske/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ༄8)bsam gtan gyi yan lag yongs su bsgrub pa dang ske/ 'thun7pa'i gtsug lag khang bodang / gnas dang / gzhal med khang dang ske/ yul dang / ri'i sul71ji snyed pa dang / bsam gtan gyi yan lag de dag sus yongs su bsgrub pa'i drang srong gi lus ji snyed pa dang / rgyal po'i thabs ji snyed pa dang / 'byung ba la mngon par mos pa ji snyed pa dang /brtul zhugs dang yi dam dang / tshul dang spyod lam ji snyed pa de dag thams cad kyang tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis 3)mthong ngo / /ba spu'i sgo'i 'od zer gyi dra ba dang / dkyil 'khor la la las ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i spyod pa la rnam par spyod cing / chos thams cad yongs su tshol ba dang ldan pa'i lus yongs su bzung ba mthong ste1ge/ lus gang gis stechos kyi tshig gciganyegi 37—779

don du yang ba dog pa thams cad yongs su btang ste/ sems can thams cad las yongs su btsal ba dang rim gro dang / bkur sti thams cad kyis dge ba'i bshes gnyen thams cad las yongs su btsal ba dang / dad pa dang sri zhus lus rab tu btud de/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams las yongs su btsal ba dang ske/ chos kyi tshig gcig la ji lta ba de bzhin du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i chos kyi tshig thams cad la'ang de bzhin te/ 'gro ba thams cad du gzugs brnyan byung ba'i lus thams cad kyi hu)yongs su btsal ba de ②dag thams cad kyang tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis lab spu'i sgo gcig gi 'od zer gyi dra ba dang dkyil 'khor las mthong ngo / /ba spu'i sgo'i 'od zer gyi dra ba dang ske/ dkyil 'khor la la las ni byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi sems can yongs su smin par bya ba'i thabs 'gro ba'i rgyud rgya mtsho thams cad du 'byam klas pa4/ sems can thams cad yongs su bsdu zhu)ba'i sbyor b.ratswamathong ngo /sems can re re la yang lus dang spyod pa'i tshul gyi sgo/ sngon7gyi lus nye bar blangs pa na thabs mkhas pa'i spyod pa la brtson pa'abye/ sems can thams cad kyi lus dang 'dra bas yongs su sdud pa yang ba spu'i sgo'i 'od zer gyi dra ba'i dkyil 'khor gcig las mthong ngo / /ba spu'i sgo'i 'od zer gyi dra ba'i dkyil 'khor la la las ni sngon 11bcom ldan 'das kyi 12bskal pa thams cad kyi tu smon lam mngon par bsgrubs tshapa'i spyod pa dang / sems can thams cad yongs su smin par bya ba'i smon lam mngon par bsgrubs78pa'i spyod pa dang / zhing thams cad yongs su dag par bya ba'i smon lam mngon par bsgrubs hu)pa mdzad pa ji snyed pa dang /smon lam thams cad mngon par bsgrubs rkyu tshopa'i dkyil 'khor ji snyed cig de 37wa 780

bzhin gshegs pa de dang7de dag gi zhabs kyi drung du 'khorasheba'i skyon thams cad las so so'ishere re'i gnyen por mngon par bsgrubs parasemadzad pa/ de dag thams cad kyang tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis0ba spu'i sgo'i 'od zer gyi0dra ba'i dkyil 'khor gcig las mthong ngo / /ba spu'i sgo'i 'od zer gyi dra ba'i dkyil 'khor la la las ni stobs kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i spyod pa thams cad dang ldan pa'i sngon gyi sbyor ba rgya mtsho mthong ngo / /ba spu'i sgo'i 'od zer gyi dra ba'i dkyil 'khor la la las ni ye shes kyi spyod pa rnam par rgyu ba thams cad dang ldan pa7mi shes pa'i gnyid kyisatso)log pa'i sems can sad par byed pa'i rang bzhin dang ldan pa'i sngon gyi sbyor ba rgya mtsho mthong bar gyur to/ /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs khyadage slong rgya mtsho'i rgyal mtshan de ltar mnyam par bzhag pa la sems shing rtog pa dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi rnam par thar pa'i dkyil 'khor de rjes su dran par bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi khyu mchog gi (nyamathu phyung ba de la rjes su rnam par bsam pa dang /sems can gyi don gyi tshul rgya mtsho de la 'jug par bya ba dang / mngon par 'du bya ba'i sgo rgyud kun la mngon du gnas pa'i rgyan de'i rjes su 'brang zhing khong du chud par bya ba dang / chos kyi dbyings kyi rgyan rnam par dag pa'i ye shes kyi sgo de la 'jug par bya ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs 8yang dag par mnodarwanyepa'i ye shes de la rab tu brtag7pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i dbang gi stobs de yongs su bskyed pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam gyi stobs de brtan par bya ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i stobs de shin tu rgyas par bya ba byed cing / dge slong rgya mtsho'i rgyal mtshan gyi mdun 37—781

du nyin zhag gcig kyang lon no/ /nyin zhag gnyis dngatre①bdun yang lon no/ /zla ba phyed dang zla ba gcig dang / zla ba gnyis dang zla ba drug gi bar dang /nyin zhag kyang drug tu dge slong rgya mtsho'i rgyal mtshan gyi mdun du lon te/ de ltar zla ba drug dang / nyin zhag drug 'das nas dge slong rgya mtsho'i rgyal mtshan ting nge 'dzin de las langs so/ /de nas nor bzangs kyis ②smras pa/'phags pa ting nge 'dzin 'di de ltar zab la/ de ltar rgya che zhing de ltar〈 tshad ma mchis pa'i yul dang ldan pa dang / de ltar bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyan dang ldan pa dang ri ri/ de ltar snang ba mtshungs pa ma mchis pa dang / de ltar grangs ma mchis pa'i srirgyan dang ldan pa dang / de ltar mi 'phrogs yipa'i spyodalo7yul dang ldan pa dang / de ltar ma 'dres pa'i yul dang ldan pa dang / de ltar phyogs kun tu rnam par snang ba dang / ting nge 'dzin 'di de ltar sems can gyisar don tshad ma mchis pa rab tu sgrub par gyur 1)pa ni ngo mtshar te/ de ni /dī sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal gyi phung po tshad ma mchis pa rnam (1par zhi bar bgyi ba la sta gon du gnas / pa ste/ 'di ltar dbul ba'i sdug bsngal zhi bar bgyi ba la sta gon du gnas so/ /sems can dmyal ba'i lam gyi nya rgyud rgyun bcad 8pa dang ske/ byol song gi skye gnas kyi lam gyi rgyud las yongs su bskyab kyigepa dang /mi khom pa'i lam gyi rgyud kyi sgo thams cad gcad tshapa dang / mtho ris kyi lam gyi rgyud du phyin par bgyi ba dang / lha dang mi'i dga' ba dang / bde ba 'byung bar bgyi ba dang / bsam gtan gyi yul gyis sna tshodaga' ba nyams su myong bar bgyi ba dang / 'dus byas la spyod pa'i bde ba yongs su 'phel bar bgyi ba dang /khams gsum pa las 'byung 1sheba'i sgo yongs su bstan pa la sta gon du gnas so/rte//37wa 782

byang chub kyi sems yang dag par skye ba'i rgyu yongs su brjod pa la sta gon du gnas sel/ /bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs yang dag par skye ba'i rgyu rnam par 'phel bar bgyi ba dang / snying rje chen po'i shugs rgya chen po rnam par 'phel bar bgyi ba dang / smon lamashechen po'i stobs yongs su bskyed par bgyi ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i lam snang ba rab tu thobasngo0par bgyi ba dang /pha rol tu phyin pa chen po'i theg pa rnam par dgod pa dang / theg pa chen po'i khyad par la 'jug pa mngon par bsgrub pa dang / kun tu bzangashepo'i spyod pa shes shing snang bar bgyi ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sa dugeshes shing snang bsdogethob par bgyi ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi smon lam dang spyod pa dang / 'byung ba'i (7rgyan rnam par dag pa yongs su bsgrub pa dang /thams cad mkhyen pa'i sa gnanasapa la thogs pa ma 1)mchis par bgyi ba la4) sta gon du gnas pa'o/ /'phags pa ting ngepha1'dzin de'i ming ci zhes bgyi smras pa/rigs kyi bu shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa kun nas lta ba'i btang snyoms yongs su thob pa zhes bya ba yod de/ ting nge hu 'dzin 'di ni de'i snang ba ste/ sgo kun nas rnam par dag pa'i rgyan ces bya'o3nye/ /rigs kyi bu shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa kun nas lta ba'i btang snyoms rab tu thob pa'i snang ba las skyes pa'i ting nge 'dzin sgo kun nas rnam par dag pa'i rgyan ces bya ba 'di 8shin tu bsgoms na sgo kun nas rnam par dag pa'i rgyan la stsogasalgepa ting nge 'dzin brgya stong grangs med pa phrag bcu tshang ba yongs su 'grub skyapar 'gyur ro/ /smras pa/ 'phags patshwanating nge 'dzin 'di'i yul der bas sam ma bsatunye/ smras pa/ rigs kyi bu ting nge 'dzin 'di (khel snyoms par zhugs pa la 32 ni 'jig rten gyi khams rnam 37wa 783

par0)dmigs pa la thogs pa med do/ /'jig rten gyi khams su 'jug par bya ba la thogs pa med do/ /'jig rten gyi khams rnam par gnon⑧pa la thogs pa med do/ /'jig rten gyi khams yongs su brgyan pa la thogs pa med do/ /'jig rten gyi khams yongs su sbyang bsrel thogs pa med do/ /'jig rten gyi khams yongs gesu dag par bya ba la thogs pa med do/ /sangs rgyasasnyibalta zhing rnam par dmigs par bya ba la thogs pa med do/ /sangs rgyas kyi bdag nyid che ba brtag ④pa la thogs pa med do/ /sangs rgyas kyi rnam par 'phrul pa yongs su shes par bya ba la thogs pa med do/ /sangs rgyas kyi stobs la 'jug cing khong du chud par bya ba la thogs pa med do/ /sangs rgyas kyi yon tan rgya mtshor 'jug pa la thogs pa med do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi sprin gyi char yongs su gzungakhub la thogs pa med do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi 'khor lo 'khorasnyem 'dres pa shes shing khong du chud par bya ba la thogs pa med do/ /sangs rgyas kyi khyi'akhor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho la 'jug cing khong du chud par bya ba la thogs pa med do/ /phyogs bcur 'jug cing rjes su bgrang (nyebar bya ba la thogs pa med do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos bstan pa rjes su brtag par bya ba la thogs pa med do/ /sangs rgyas kyi phyogs rjes su brtag par bya ba la thogs pa med do/ /snying rje chen po'i phyogs rnam par mi spang tsho/geb la thogs pa med do/ /byams pas phyogs rgyas par dgang ba skol thogs pa med do/ /sangs rgyasasnyibalta ba'i phyogs la 'jug pas mi ngoms par bya ba la thogs pa med do/ /sems can rgya mtsho thams cad du 'jug cing khong du chud par bya ba la thogs pa med do/ /sems can gyi dbang po rgya mtsho thams cad shes shing khong du chud par bya bsnyul thogs pa med 37—784

dol/ /sems can gyi dbang po tha dad pa0)thams cad shes par bya ba la thogs pa med do/ /rigs kyi bu kho bos ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rnam par spyod pa 'di shes su zadashen/ byang chub sems dpa' shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rnam par spyod pa rgya mtsho la zhugs pa chos kyi dbyings kyi yul la blo gros rnam par dag pa/ chos thams cad la rigashepa rjes su 'brang ba'i ye shes can/ blo shin tu yangs pas tshad med pa'i yul rgyas par 'gengs pa gzungs chen po'i snang ba la dbang bsgyur rgyab/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor snang ba thams cad shin tu dag pa mngon par shes pa55)rnam par 'phrul pa dang / khyu mchog gi mthu 'byin pa la shin tu byung ba so so9)yang dag par rigasapa mi zad pa'i7rgya mtsho la zhugs pa/ ngag snyan pa masa'i snying po dang ldan pa 37brjod pa 'gro ba thams cad kyi rten du gyur pa rnams kyi spyod pa shes pa'am/ yon tan brjod pa'am/spyod yul bstan pa'am/ yul rab tu brjod pa'am/ smonatsha/selam chen po'i stobs yang dag par bsngags pa'am/ 'byung ba'i sgo yongs su snang bar bya ba'am / yang dag par bsgrub pa mngon par brjod pa'am/snye/ lam yongs su bstan pa'am/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyun gyi rjes su 'brang bar bya ba'am/ sems kyi yul shes par bya ba'am/ ye shes mnyam pa nyid khong du chud par bya bar nus re skan/ /song rigs kyi bu lho phyogs kyi rgyud 'di nyid na phyogs kyi gnas rgya mtsho rnam par rlob 8pa zhes bya ba yod de/ de na bza' shing gi ra ba 'akun nas rnam par brgyan pa zhes bya ba zhig grong khyer 'od chen po zhes bya ba'i shar phyogs logs na yod de⑩/ de na shed hu snalas skyes pa'i rgyal po 'od bzangs kyi 1)chung ma dge bsnyen ma yid bzhin zhes bya ba yod kyisahurte/ de'i gan du song la ji ltar byang 37—785

chub sems dpas she)byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bya ba dang /ji ltar nan (2)tu bya ba dris shig /de nas tshong dudapon gyi bu nor bzangs ④dga' rangs te'u)/ mgu zhing nyams bde la tshim zhing yid bde ba skyes nas/dge slong rgya mcho3re rgyal mtshan 6)las snying po yongs su blangs te/ chos kyi nye bar 'tsho bshon)byas pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyi yul la zhugs pa/ snang ba thob pa ye shes kyis59)snang bar gyur pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyi snang ba rab tu thob pa/ mos pa rnam par dag pa 7khong du chud pa/ sems can7techos kyi tshul gyis〈nyesnang ba'i rjes su song ba/ rnam par dag pa'i sgos snang ba dang ldan par gyur pa/phyogs su nyi ye shes kyi snang batshachurab tu 'dalatsha/geb des/ dge slong rgya mtsho'i rgyal mtshan gyi rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ lan brgya stong du mar g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas nas/ dge slong rgya mcho1re rgyal mtshan la btud de phyag 'tshal nas/ yang dang yang lta zhing yang dang yang mngon par blta ba dang /phyag bya ba dang / rab tu gdudam pa dang / gus par bya ba dang / rim groratshwa 7bya ba dang / yid la bya ba dang / bsam pa dang / bsgom pa dang / yongs su bsgom 18pa dang / legs par brjod pa dang / ngo mtshar du bya ba dang /yon tan mngon du bya ba dang / rjes su bsngags pa dang / rjes su 'brang bar bya ba dang / rjes su dran par bya ba dang / brtanatshwa)par bya ba dang / mi gtang ni )ba dang / yid la bsam pa dang / rjes su 'brang bar bya ba dang /smon lam gyi rjes su 'jug par bya ba dang / mthong bar dga' ba (1dang /dbyangs kyi mtshan ma gzung (2ba dang / gzungs kyi rjes su bsam pa dang /ming yongs su gzung ba'i sa rjes su song ba'i sems dang ldan par bya ba dang /37wa 786

kha dog dang / dbyibs rjes su dran par bya ba7)dang / ye shes kyi yul rjes su bsam pa dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi yul la rjes su 'jug par bya ba dang / smon lam gyi yul la rjes su 'brang bar bya ba dang / spyod yul gyi yul rnam par sbyang b.rarnyubya ba dang / ye shes kyi snang ba yongs su gzung bshebyed cing / dge slong rgya mtsho'ibargyal mtshan gyi drung nasa'agasong ngo // // sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdo/⑥ bam po so gcig 9)pa/ de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs dudage ba'i bshes gnyen gyi yon tan gyis ni mgu/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis ni yang dag par bsngags te btang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen mthong ba'i byin gyis ni byin du brlabs / dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi gdams (pengag la ni nan tan du byed/dge ba'i bshes gnyen yid du 'ong ba ni rjes su sems/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la ni sangs rgyas kyitshwanye chos kyi 'byung gnas tsam du lta/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni sangs rgyas kyi chos ston pa yin par nyu1yang dag par lta/rte/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi chos la rjes su lta3lhe/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni sangs rgyas nam mkha' blta ba sal mig tsam tu lta zhing 8mthar gyis phyogs kyi yiganas rgya mtsho rnam hu par rlob pa'i bza' shing gi ra ba kun nas rnam par brgyan pa/ gang na ba der phyin nas des mthong ba/ / bza' shing gi ra ba kun nas rnam par brgyan pa/ rin po che thams cad kyi 3)ra bas kun nas bskor ba/ rin po che'i shing gi phrengams )ba spel ba 37legs pas yongs su brgyan pa/rin po che thams cad kyi shing gi phreng zhugeba'i me tog srabam bu yid du 'ong ba'i sprin rab tu 'brul stebs gzhi rgyas pa/ rin po che thams cad kyi shing gis yang dag 37wa 787

par brgyan pa/ shing thams cad kyi me tog shin tu 0)rgyas pa sna tshogs kyis ④yongs su gang ba/ spos sna tshogs kyi shing gi phrengasheb las phyogs kun tu spos kyi ngad zhim pa rin po che'i phreng 'ba'i shing sna tshogs kyi lhun las rin po che ⑤sna tshogs kyi phrengs 9)ba 'phyang ba/ rab tu 'byung zhing char ltar mngon par babashepa/rin po che'i rgyal po rinathams cad kyi shing dang nor bu rin po che sna tshogs kyis mdzes shing spa la/ rgya cher brgyan pa'i gzhi can yid bzhin gyi gos kyi0)shing thams cad las kha dog sna tshogs kyi gos 'byung bas gam yo khebs shing mdzes par brgyan pa/ sil snyan gyi shing thams cad las 0lha rdzas las kyang 'phags pa'i sil snyan rlung gis bskyod cing sgra 'byin pa'i dbyangs snyan par (nya'abyung ba/sa'i gzhi mthon dman tsho/gemed par gnas pa nyunyergyan gyi shing sna tshogs kyi gseb nas/rgyan sna tshogs rnam pa tha dad pa yirgyun tu 'byung zhing 'phyang bas rab tu brgyan pa'i rgyan dang ldan pa mthong ste/ bza' shing gi ra ba chen po kun nas rnam par brgyan pa de'i nang na khang pa bye ba brgya 8stong phrag bcu kun kyang nor bu rin po che dam pa sna tshogs kyi ba gam gyis rnam par mibargyan pa dang / khang pa brtsegs pa brgya 3 ༷stong phrag bcu 'dzam bu chu 3)klung gi gser las brtsegs pa'i bde dang ldan pa dang / gzhal med khang brgya stong phrag bcu 15)gdung rin po che rnam par snang ba / las bres pa lha/ rdzing bu brgya stong phrag bcu5)rin po che thams cad las gzhi blangs te/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi pha gus mu khyud byas pa/rin po che thams cad kyi them skas btags pa/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi0)stegs bus bskor ba/ lha rdzas kyi tsan dan gyi dri dang ldan pa'i chus gang ba/ gser gyi bye mas gi kun tu gram sa pa/ gzhi nor bu rin po che chu 'dang0nyakun tu bkram 37wa 788

pa / phyogs bzhi nas them skas rnam par bres pa/ yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chusalgegang bal/ nga ngurashedang / rma mdang / khu byugatso)dang / khrung khrung dang / ka la ping ka dang / kun la'i〈sgra skad7snyan pa'i dbyangs dang ldan pa/ rinashepo che'iphuta la'i phrengapo)bas kun nas brgyan pa/ gser gyi dril bu'i dra bas kun nas7yog pa/ rlung gis bskyod pa'i sgral1yid du 'ong ba 'byung ba/ steng nas rin po che'i bla re chen po bres pa/ rin po che sna tshogs kyi shing gi ra bas yongs su bskor ba/ rin po che'i dra bsasngo brgyan pa'i tu gdugs dang rgyal mtshan legs par bsgreng ba/ lu ma brgya stong phrag bcu dus dang mthun ④pa'i tsan dan gyi 'dam gyis mtha' 'khor ba rin po che sna tshogs kyi kha dog tu 'dug pa'i pad mos yongs su khyab pa/ rin po che'i pad mo'i 'od chen pos snang bar gyur pa'i chu dri ma med pa dang ldan pa yod pa ste/ bza' shing gi ra ba de'i dbus na gzhal med khang chen po rgyal mtshan sna tshogs zhes tsobya brkyunye/sa'i gzhi rin po che rgya mtsho'i snying po las blangs pa/ nor bu rin po che'i ka ba bkye btso'adzam bu chu klung gi gser gyi lhun mngon par 'phags pa nor bu rin po che 'gro bar rnam par snang ba'i spang leb bkye bas brgyan pa/ gzhi nor bu rin po che 'bar ba grangs med pa'i dra5 ) bas bres pa/ rin po che'i rgyal po mi pham pa'i spos〈 )kyi dris gam yo kun nas bdugs ninyepa/ rin po che'i rgyal po sgra snyan pa 'byin pa'i dri tsongad kun tu ldang ba/ rin po che'i rgyal po dri rnam par gsal stebar byed pas dbang po rno ba'i bag chags rnam par bsgrub pa dang ldan zhing gzhal med khang chen po rgyal mtshan sna tshogs der stan grangs med cing tshad med pa bting nyebar gyur pa 'di lta ste〈9pad mo'i snying po can dang / nor bu 37wa 789

rin po che phyogs snang bar byed pa'i pad mo'i snying po can dang / nor bu rin po che rnam par snang ba'i pad mo'i snying po can dang / nor bu rin po che 'gro ba yid du 'ong ba'i pad mo'i snying po can dang / nor bu rin po che mdzod sna tshogs kyi 17pad mo'i snying po can dang / ②rin po che seng ge'i shing thags kyisapad mo'i snying po can dang / nor bu rin po che dri ma myed pa'i pad mo'i snying po can dang ske/ nor bu rin po ches brgyan pa'ilobapad mo'i snying po canasnyedang / nor bu rin po che sgo kun nas brgyan pa'i pad mo'i snying po can dang / nor bu rin po che 'od kyi rgyan gyi pad ma'i56)snying po can dang / nor bu rin po che rgya mtsho'i gnas rnam par dag pa'i rin po ches rnam par brgyan pa'i 'od zer kun tu 'byung ba'i pad mo'i snying po can dang / nor bu rin po che rdo rje'i seng ges gnon pa'i pad mo'i snying po can dag bshams shing bting ba ste/ gzhal med khang chen po rgyal mtshan sna tshogs de'i ba gam mang po yang / rin po che7bsam gyis mi khyab pa las byas pas ririn po che sna tshogs kyis7rnam par brgyan7pa/ kha dog bsam gyis 11mi khyab par mdzes shing gzugs yid du 'ong ba dag go/ /bza' shing gi ra ba kun nas brgyan pa de1rnye/ steng nas bla re chen po brgya stong phrag bcus kun nas hu khebs pa ste/ 'di ltar gos kyi bla re dang khri7shing gi bla re dang me tog gi bla re dang / phreng skoba'i bla resadang / spos kyi bla re dang /nor bu rin po che'i bla re dang / gser gyi bla re dang / rgyan gyi bla re dang /rin po che rdo rje 1 snang ba'i bla re nyu8dang / glang po'i〈(shugs dang ldan pas sprul pa'i lha mo'i bla re dang / nor bu rin po che brgya byin mngon par dga' ba'i bla re dang / de dag la sogs da dpa bla re brgya stong phrag bcus kun nas khebs5)37wa 790

par byas pa'o/ /rin po che'i dra ba brgya stong phrag bcus kun nas yog pa ste/'di ltar rin po che dam pa'i dril bu'i dra ba dang / rin po che'i gdugs kyi dra ba dang / rin po che'i 'bru'i dra ba dang / mu tig rgya mcho1re snying po'i dra ba dang ske/ nor bu rin po che be+e ḍūr+ya 3)sngon po'i dra ba dang / seng ge'i khri7shing gi dra ba dang / nor bu rin po che chu shel gyi dra ba dang / spos kyi gzugs kyi dra ba dang ske/ rin po che'i cod pan dang / rin po che'i phreng ba'i drasheb dang / de dag la sogs ⑦pa rin po che'i dra ba brgya (9stong phrag bcus kun nas yog paX/snang ba chen po brgya stong phrag bcus kyang kun nas yog pa ste/ 'di ltar nor bu rin po che skar ma'i 'od zer gyi snang ba dang / nor bu rin po che nyi ma'i snying po'i snang ba dang / nor bu rin po che zla ba'i rgyal mtshan gyi ⑦snang ba dang /nor bu rin po che spos kyi dud pa 'od 'phro ba'i snang ba dang / nor bu rin po che dpal gyi snying po'i snang ba dang /6) nor bu rin po che pad mo'i snying po'i〈)snang ba dang / nor bu rin po che skar tshima'i rgyal mtshan gyi snang ba dang / nor bu rin po che sgron ma chen po'i snang ba dang / nor bu rin po che phyogs kun tu rnam par snang ba'i snang ba dang / nor bu rin po che spos kyi sprin chen po〈stodang /klogasanyunyegi phreng〈nyeb 'byung ba'i snang ba dang / de dag la sogs78pa nor bu rin po che'i snang ba chen po brgya stong phrag bcus rtagashetu snang bar byas pa'o8/ /bza' shing gi ra ba de ni rgyan chen po'i sprin brgya stong phrag bcu'i char 'bab pa'i rgyan dang ldan pa ste/ dus dang mthun sna pa'i tsan dan gyi sprin brgya stong phrag bcu'i 'brug sgra rab tu 'byung bar/snye/ lha rdzas7)las 'das pa'i phreng 3 )ba dang /lda ldi'i sprin chen po nyakun tu mched pas rab tu brgyan pa/ lha rdzas las 'das 37wa 791

pa'i gos tshon ①sna tshogs dang ldan pa'i sprin brgya stong phrag bcu'i sprin mngon par 'bab pa/ lha rdzas las 'das pa'i rgyan gyi sprin brgyalastong phrag bcus rnam par klubasalgepa/ lha'i bu brgya stong phrag bcu mthong b.rashedaga' ste/ 'og tu lta zhing rab tu 'dud pa'i phyag char bzhin du 'bab pa/ lha mo'isnyisprin brgya stong phrag bcu sngon gyi spyod pa'i skal ba ⑥mnyam pas ⑦rang rang gi lus 'bul ba'i char mngon par 'bab pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i sprin brgya stong phrag bcushechos mnyan57pas/ skom zhing 'ong ba'i char mngon par 'bab5)ste/ de na dge bsnyen ma yid bzhin gser gyi snying po'i khri chen po la 'dug cing / mu tig rgya mtsho'i snying po'i dra bas brgyan pa'i cod pan thogs pa/ lag pa la lha rdzasalgelas 'das pa'i gser gyi dpung rgyan dang / gdub bu thogs pa/ lag pa nor bu rin po che dpal gyi rang bzhin gyi 'od zer gyis rnam par mdzes par gyur pa/ rna cha rin po che mthon ting7dri ma med pa rab tu 'phyang ba/ mgo nor bu rin po che'i dra bas mdzes par brgyan pa/ nor bu rin po che seng ge'i gdong gi rna ba'i gong rgyan thogs pa/ nor bu rin po che yid bzhin gyi rgyal po'i mgul kor thogs ⑩pa/ lus rin po che thams cad kyi dra bas yog cing 'od rab tu 'bar ba/ srog chags bye ba khrag khrig girwa tsholus rab tu btud de/ phyag bya ba zhig 'dug ste/ dge bsnyen ma yid bzhin de'i drung du shar phyogs nas tshangs pa chen po'am/ tshangs lha nye phan dngatso/ tshangs pa'i ris su gtogs pa'am/dbang byed dam/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi ris su gtogs pa'am/ rab 'phrul dga' 'am/ 'phrul dga'i ris su gtogs pa'am/ rab dga' ldan nam / dga' ldan gyi ris su gtogs pa'am/ rab mtshe0 ma'am mtshe ma'i 37—792

ris su gtogs pa'am/ lha'i dbang po'am/ sum cu7rtsa gsum gyi ris su gtogs pa'am/ gnod sbyin gyi dbang po'am/ gnod sbyin nam/ dri za'i dbang po'am/ dri za'am/ grul bum gyi dbang po'am/ grul bum 'a'akho/klu'i dbang po'am/ klu'am/ lha ma yin gyi dbang po'am/ lha ma yin nam/nam mkha' lding gi⑧dbang po'am/ nam mkha' lding ngam/ mi'am ci'i dbang po'am / mi'am ci'am/ lto 'phye chen po'i dbang po'am/ lto 'phye chen po'am/gshin rje'am/ gshin rje'i bu mo'am/ yi dgas brdzu 'phrul chen po'am/ yi dgas7sam/ mi'i dbang po'am/ mi'ang rung stedu/ sems can tshad med grangs med pa dag 'ong ba dang / de bzhin du〈 lho phyogs dang / nub phyogs dang ske/ byang phyogs dang / byang shar gyi phyogs mtshamasasnyidang / shar lho'i phyogs mtshamasashedang / lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams dang / nub byang gi phyogs mtshams〈tedang / 'og dang steng gi phyogs nas kyang / tshangs pa chen po'am/tshangs lha nye phan nam/ tshangs pa'i ris su gtogasalgepa'am/ dbang byed dam/sri dbang byed kyi ris su gtogs pa nas/ mi'i dbang po'am/ mi'i bar gyi sems can mang po 'ong ba/ de dag nad sna tshogs zhig7gis btab pa'amanya/ nyon mongs pa sna tshogs kyis kun nas 'khor tam/ lta ba'i rnam pa sna tshogs la mngon par zhen tam/ las kyi sgrib pas bsgribs pa zhig yod na'ang / de dag gis dge bsnyen ma yid 7bzhin de mthong ma thag tu nad thams cad kyang〈 1rab tu zhi bar gyur/ sems can gyi hunyenyon mongs pa'i dri ma dang yang bral bar gyur⑩/ lta ba'i gsal shing yang phyin par gyur() / sgrib pa'i ri thams cad kyang rnam par bshig par gyur(1/ rnam par dag pa'i dkyil 37—793

'khor bsgribs7)pa med pa yang khong du chud par gyuradza gte/ rnam par dag pa'i dkyil 'khor de yod pas ni ri dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyang rab tu byang bar gyur la/ dbang po'i myu 55gu thams cad kyang rnam par 'phel bar gyur(6)/thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi tshul rgya mtsho (pel yang dag par gzhol bar gyuragasu / gzungs kyi sgo rgya mtsho thams cad la'angalonye'ajug par gyurayi/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo dang tshul rgya mtsho thams cad kyang mngon sum du gyur(1/ smon lam gyi sgo thams cad kyang yang dag par skye bar gyuranyuge/ spyod pa'i sgom thams cad kyang rab tu byung bar gyuras/ yon tan mngon par bsgrub pa'i sgo thams cad kyang rnam par /shedag par gyur34/ sems rgya chen po yang mngon par shes pa thams cad dang ldan pa'i tshul du byung bar gyur3 / lus thogs pa med 3nyepas kyang thams cad du rjes su 'gro bar gyur totunye/ /de nas tshong 3 dpon gyi bu nor bzangs ri stobaza' shing gi ra ba du kun nas rnam par brgyan pa'i nang du phyin te bltas nasari snye/ dge bsnyen ma yid bzhin khri bzang po la 'dug pa mthong nas/de dge bsnyen ma yid bzhin gang na ba der song ste/ phyin nas dge bsnyen ma yid bzhin gyi rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ dge bsnyen ma yid bzhin la lan brgya stong du mar g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas nas/ 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phags ma bdag gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed na lha/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpas 64byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab da par bgyi ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bgyis nab ma 'tshal te/ 'phags ma ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gdamasa'i 'ongag dang rjes su bstan pa mdzad do/ /zhes thos nas / 'phags ma ji ltar byang chub 37wa 794

sems dpas7byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bgyi ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bgyi ba bdag la bshad du gsol/ des smras pa rigs kyi bu kho mo ni byang chub sems dpa'i ②rnam par thar pa mya ngan med pa chabade ba'i rgyal mtshan thob pa ste/ rigs kyi bu kho mo ni de'i mthus mthong na dogayod pa'o/ /mnyan na don yod pa'o/ /rim gror byas na don yod pa'o/ /gnas gcig na 'grogs pa don yod pa'o/ /rjes su dran par byas pa don yod pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu kho mo ni sems can dge ba'i rtsa ba ma bskyed pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su ma zin pa/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyisalgem dgongs pa rnams kyis mthong zhing rnam par dmigs par mig lam du 'ong bar mi 'gyur te/ rigs kyi bu kho mo mthong bsnyitsam gyis ni sems can rnams kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ro/ /gzhan yang rigs kyi bu kho mo'i drung du shar phyogs nas de bzhin gshegs pa dgashebyon cing / gdan rin po che'i khri 'disnye la bzhugs nasam/nyachos ston to/ /shar phyogs nas ji lta banyebazhin du phyogs bcu nas kyang de bzhin te/ rigs kyi bu de lta bas na/ kho mo ni de bzhin gshegs pa mthong ba dang mi 'bral〈nyeba'o/ /chos mnyan pa dang mi 'bral ba'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' dang 'grogs pa dang mi 'bral ba'o/ /rigs kyi bu kho mo dang spyod pa'i skal bakhemanyam pa'i srog chags bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag brgyad cu7rtsa bzhi po bza' shing gi ra ba kun nas rnam par brgyan pa 'di na gnas pa de dag thams cad kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog pa sha stag go/ /rigs kyi bu sems can gzhan gang 'di na gnas pa de dag kyang bla na med pa yang dag parasnyi37—795

rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir7mi ldog pa/ phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun du gtogs pa sha stag ste/ kho mo dang spyod pa'i skal bsnyemanyam pa dag go/ /smras pa las zhu'aphags ma khyod kyis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yun ji srid cig nas thugs bskyed/ smras pa rigs kyi bu kho mo 0ni sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran no')/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mar me mdzad ces bya ba byung ba de bzhin gshegs pa de'i drung durasnerakho mos tshangs pa'i spyod pa spyad do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de kho mos mchod do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de las chos bstan pa kho mos yongs su bzung ngo ske/ /de'i snga rol du de bzhin gshegs pa dri ma med pa zhes bya ba byung ste/de'i bstan pa la'ang kho mo rab tu byung ngo / /chos kyi 'khor lo yang kho mos bzung ngo / /de'i snga rol du de bzhin gshegs pa dpal zhes bya ba byung ste/ de seyang kho mos bsnyen bkur to/ /de'i snga rol tu de bzhin gshegs pa ri rab dpal zhes bya ba byung ngo / /de'i snga rol tu de bzhin gshegs pa pad mo'i snying po zhes bya ba byung ngo / /de'i snga rol tu de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par snang mdzad ces ⑨bya ba byung ngo / /de'i snga rol tu de bzhin gshegs pa kun tu gzigs pa zhes bya ba byung ngo / /de'i snga rol tu de bzhin gshegs pa tshangs pa dag pa zhes bya ba byung ngo / /de'i snga rol tu de bzhin gshegs pa tshurdo rje'i gtsug hunyaces bya ba byung ngo / /de'i kun5)snga rol tu de bzhin gshegs pa chu bo'i lha zhes bya ba byung ste/ rigs kyi bu gzhung de ltar tshe gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa dang / bskal pa gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa'i sangs rgyas gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshams 'dabasngo)chags su bsams 37—796

te / dran par byas na①/ gang kho mos rim gror byas te/ bsnyen bkur ba dang / mchod pa dang / bstisastang du byas pa dang / gang gi spyan sngar〈kyes mos chos thos par gyur pa0dang / gang gi bstan pa la kho mos tshangs pa'i spyod pa spyad pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa chu klung gang gā sum cu phyirtsa drug gi bye ma snyed rjes su dran teX/ rigs kyi bu de phan cad du kho mos de bzhin gshegs pa ji snyedakucig bsnyen bkur ba ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyisalgemakhyen to/ /rigs kyi bu sems dang po bskyed ma thag tu chos kyi dbyings rgyas par 'gengs pas byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni tshad5) med pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu snying rje chen po'i khongs su 'gro ba thams cad chud tunyepas/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams7ni tshad med pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu smon lam chen pos phyogs bcu'i chos kyi dbyings kyi gzhi zad zad du 'gro bas byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni tshad med pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu byams pa chen pos 'gro ba thams cad rgyas par 'gengs pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams7ni tshad med pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pas zhing thams cad du bskal pa thams cad yongs su sdud pas/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni tshad med pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs kyis byang chub sems dpa'i lam las phyir mi ldog pas byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni tshad med pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu gzungs kyi stobs kyis 'gro ba thams cad yongs su 'dzin pa'i gzungs kyi tshul khong du chud par byed pas byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni tshad med pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu ye shes snang ba'i stobs kyis dus gsum gyi ye shes kyi tshul/ khong du chud par byed cing ske/ yang dag par 'dzin pas byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni tshad med 37—797

pa'o / /rigs kyi bu mngon par shes pa'i stobs kyis zhing thams cad du sems can rnams kyi 3)bsam pa dang / mos pa ci ②lta ba bzhin du 'od kyi dra ba'i 'khor lo mngon par bsgrub pas byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni tshad med pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu so sol yang dag par rigs47pa'i stobs kyis tshigashegacig brjod kyang 'gro ba thams cad shin tu tshim par byed pas/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni tshad med pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu lus rnam par dag pas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad rang gi lus kyisas/)rgyas par 'gengs pas/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni tshad med pa'o/ /nor bzangs kyis7smras pa/ 'phags ma khyod ji srid cig na bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par ④'tshang rgya bar 'gyur1)/ smras pa rigs kyi bu 'di lta ste/ sems can gcig cig7la dmigs shing gdul bar bya ba dang / smin par bya ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sems byang chub tu skye ba ma yin te/ sems can brgya'i phyir ma yin/ sems can stong gi phyir ma yin(sto/ sems can5)brgya phrag stong gi phyir ma yin/ sems can bye ba'i phyir ma yin/ sems can bye ba brgya'i phyir ma yin/ sems can bye ba stong gi phyir ma yin/ sems can bye ba brgya phrag stong gi phyir ma yin te/hunye sems can bye ba khrag khrig brgya phrag stong gi don du/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi sems byang chub tu skye ba ma yin noyi/ /sems can thams thams 8kyi phyir ma yin/ sems can khrag khrig gi phyir ma yin/sems can gang ya'i kyi phyir ma yin/ sems can ban bun gyi phyir ma yin/sems can phyar〈nyephyur gyi phyir ma yin/ sems can byang bying gi phyir ma yin/sems can nyer 'jal gyi phyir ma yin/ sems can phyal phyol gyi phyir ma yin/37—798

sems can yal yol gyi phyir ma yin/ sems can lngad ljon 7kyi phyir ma yin/sems can phyod zim gyi phyir ma yin/ sems can phyad phyod kyi phyir ma yin/sems can ldam ldem ②gyi phyir ma yin/ sems can ya gangs kyi phyir ma yin/sems can cho ⑧ma'i phyir ma yin/ sems can khram khrim gyi phyir ma yin/sems can nab nub kyi phyir ma yin/ sems can brgyud yasasho stekyi phyir ma yin/sems can btang yas kyi phyir ma yin/ sems can bkra yar gyi phyir ma yin/sems can gsalamasayas kyi phyir ma yin/ sems can gzhal brtag gi (7phyir ma yin / sems can mtshungs med kyi phyir ma yin/ sems can lam lum mo)gyi phyir ma yin/ sems can rab rib kyi phyir ma yin/ sems can thab thib kyi phyir ma yin/ sems can 'grigs yol na gyi phyir ma yin/ sems can then phyo'i7phyir ma yin/ sems can bsam phyod kyi 7phyir ma yin/ sems can 'dra mnyam gyi phyir ma yin/ sems can brang 31breng gi phyir ma yin/ sems can bgrong (nyeyas kyi phyir ma yin/ sems can rgyas 'dal gyi phyir ma yin/sems can bsngo yas kyi 3nyephyir ma yin/ sems can zang yag gi phyir ma yin/sems can 'phro thestebakye'i phyir ma yin/ sems can rtse 'phyo'i phyir ma yin/sems can yong tan gyi78phyir ma yin/ sems can 'brug tshagayos kyi phyir ma yin / sems can sang yal gyi phyir ma yin/ sems can thing yug gi sna 7phyir ma yin/ sems can snang yal gyi phyir ma yin/ sems can nan pa'i phyir ma yin/sems can yid 'phyo'i phyir ma yin/ sems can nab deb kyi phyir ma yin/sems can khrig thams nyu)kyi phyir ma yin/ sems can yal yol 37gyi phyir ma yin/sems can bgrang yas kyi phyir ma yin/ sems can thug yal gyi phyir ma yin/37—799
