lam nam mkha'i dbyings rnam par dag pa'i mtha' gang du thug pa de'i mthas klas par shog shig① /bdag gi smon lam 'jig rten gyi khams rnam par dag pa'i mtha' gang du thug pa7de'i mthas klas par shog shigatso /bdag gi smon lam sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa dang / bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba dang / bag la nyal ba'i mtha' gang du thug pa de'i mthas klas par shog shig④ /ces de ltar smon lam btab bo/ /smras pa/ 'phags ma rnam par thar pa 'di'i ming ci zhes bgyi/ smras pa/ rigs kyi bu rnam par thar pa 'di ni nyon mongs pa med pa bde ba'i rgyal mtshan zhes bya bsnyiste/ rigs kyi bu kho mos kyang byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa de gcig pu shes par zad na byang chub sems dpa' sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad yang dag par 'dzin pa'i phyir / sems rgya mtsho dang ldan pa lhag pa'i bsam pa brtan pa'i phyir ri rab dang 'dra ba/ sems can thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa'i nad rab tu sosalgepar byed pa'i phyir sman gyi rgyal po mthong na legs pa lta bu/ sems can thams cad kyi ma rig pa'i mun pa sel ba'i phyir nyi mar gyur pa/ sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa'i gnas su gyur pas sa lta bu'i sems dang ldan pa/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi don byed pa'i phyir rlung du gyur pa/ sems can thams cad la ye shes kyi snang ba 'byin pa'i phyir mar mer gyur pa/ zhi ba'i sgras sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi char7yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du 'bebs spupa'i phyir 0sprin du gyur pasang/tebasod nams kyi 'od gzer gyi dra rteb rab tu 'gyed pa'i phyir zla ba lta bu(nye/ 'gro ba thams cad yongs su bsrung ba la zhugs pa'i phyir/ brgya byin lta bu de dag gi spyod pa shes pa'am/ yon tan brjod pa'am/ byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa 37—809

bsam gyis mi khyab pa smos pa'am/ byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam gyi rnam pa mtha' dang dbus med pa0)yongs su bstan par nus re skan/ /song rigs kyi bu lho phyogs kyi rgyud 'di nyid kyi rgya mtsho rnam par rlob ②pa 'di (kyen yul chu ba 6)gtsang ma zhes bya ba yod de/ de na drang srong 'jigs mchog dbyangs shes7bya ba 'dug gi⑧de'i gan du song la dris shig dang / desasherigs kyi bu khyod la byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa ston par 'gyur ro/ /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis dudage bsnyen ma yid bzhin gyi rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ dge bsnyen ma yid bzhin la lan brgya stong du mar g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas nas/ yang dang yang bltas te phyag 'tshal nas/ ngo mchi mas gang bar ngus te/ byang chub mchog tu dkon pa rjes su sems shing dge ba'i bshes gnyen rim gror0)bya ba dkon patsha rjes su bsam pa dang / skyes bu dam pa dang tsho1'phrad pa dkon pa rjes su bsam pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i dbang po 'thob 7par bya ba rjes su bsam pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i bsam pa yongs su dag pa dkon pa hunyerjes su bsam pa dang / skal ba mnyam pa'i dge ba'i 1chubashes gnyen dang phrad 3gepa dkon pa 34rjes su bsam pa dang /byang chub tu yang dag pa ji lta ba bzhin du mngon par mos shing sems nges par gzhog pa dkon pa nyu 7rjes su bsam pa dang / mi mnyam pa med pa'i chos kyi tshul rjes su bstan pa'i sbyor ba dkon pa snanarjes su bsam pa dang / sems dri ma med cing mi 'phrogs pa'i sbyor ba yang dag par bsgrub par dka' ba77rjes su bsam pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du shugs drag po rnam par bskyedam )pa'i chos kyi snang ba dkon pa 1rjes su bsam pa byed cing / dge bsnyen ma yid 37wa 810

bzhin gyi drung nas song ngo / de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs7byang chub sems dpa'i gdams ngag gi rjes su song ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yongs su dag par byed pa'i〈rjes su song ba'i sems dang ldan pal/ byang chub sems dpa'i bsod nams kyi stobs rnam par 'phel bar bya ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ sangs rgyas blta ba'i shugs drag pos rab tu snang bar bya ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ chos kyi gter 'thob par bya bsnyil shugs drag po skyes pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ smon lam chen po mngon par bsgrub pa'i shugs drag po rab tu 'phel ba'i sems dang ldan pa chos thams cad kyi phyogs la mngon du lta ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ chos kyi rang bzhin gyi 'od kyis snang bar byas pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ sgrib pa thams cad rnam par 'thor ba'i sems dang ldan pa⑥/ chos kyi dbyings la mun pa med par rnam par〈pelta ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ rdo rje rin po che mthu bo ches myi choms pa lharalcedri ma med pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ bdud thams cad kyi dpung gis brgal bar dka' zhing thub par dka' ba'i sems dang ldan pa de mthar gyis yul chu ba7)gtsang ma ga la ba der phyin nas/ drang srong 'jigs mchog dbyangs tshol tshol ba las/ de'i tshe drang srong 'jigs mchog dbyangs dge ba sbyang ba'itshwa —riganas shing dang / shing phran sna tshogs grangs med pa'i nags tshal mdangs dga' ba/ lo mas rgyas pa'i shing gis kun nas 'grigs7)pa/ rtag tu me tog rgyas pa dang ldan pa'i shing sna tshogs can/ rtag tu shing togatshwa mang po dang ldan pa'i shing togarwa gi shing dang ldan pa/ nor bu rin po che sna tshogs kyipha7shing drung nor bu rin po che'i spang leb kyis rtag tu gshibasalgepa dang ldan pa/ tsan dan dam pa'i shing kun nas rnam 37wa 811

par tu)bres pa/ a ga ru yid du 'ong ba'i shing las spos kyi dri rtag tu 'byung bas rab tu brgyanatshwa pa/ phyogs bzhi nas shing bsnyeta la rnam par mdzes par skyes pas 44)yongs su brgyan pa/ rgyamadu'ugro da'i shing dbyibasam༅yid du 'ong ba dang ldan pal/ 'dzam bu'i shing las rtag tu shing tog masmin pa 'brul ba/ me tog gi tshal pad+mo dang uta〈8)pa la gsar du skyes pas rab tu brgyan pa zhig na 'dugashe'adug ste / tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis 3 )drang srong 'jigs mchog dbyangs drang srong stong phrag bcus bskor cing / tsan dan gyi yal ga shin tu 'brel ba'i bya skyibs shig na/ thor tshugs kyi cod pan can/ pags nyunyapa dang / rtsa'i〈rtegos gyon pa/ shing shun gyi smad yogs can rtsa'i tsho/nyestan la 'dug pa mthong ngo / /mthong nas kyang drang srong 'jigs mchog dbyangs ga la ba der song ste/ phyin nas yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang phrad pa'i bsam pas dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni yang dag pa'i lam ston pas/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid 'byung ba'i sgo yin par yang dag par lta / thams cad mkhyen pa'i sa la gzhog pas/thams cad mkhyen pa nyid /geni dge ba'i bshes miganyen gyi gdams ngag la rag lus par yang dag par lta/ / stobs bcu'i ye shes rin po che'i gling du skyel bas / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi mnyan pa la rag lus par yang dag par lta/snye/ stobs bcu'i ye shes snang ba yang dag par bskyedarwartepas thams cad mkhyen pa nyid nitsha nodage ba'i bshes gnyen gyi sgron mas snang bar bya ba yin par yang dag par ltarmo lku/ nyam nyes med par thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi grong du phyin par byed pas/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi lam ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin par yang dag par lta/gye/ mnyam pa dang mi mnyam pa 37wa 812

yongs su ston pas/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi mar me ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin par yang dag par dzo/ g.yang sa'i 'jigs pa thams cad med par byed pas thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi stegs nisnyedage ba'i bshes gnyen yin par yang dag par dzo/ byams pa chen po'i stobs kyis sim pa yongs su bskyedasnyipa'i phyir thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi gdugs ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin par yang dag par lto/ snying rje chen po yongs su bskyed pas thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi shugs drag po ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin par yang dag par lta rjozhing chos kyi rang bzhin gyi tshul rab tu snang bar byed pas thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsal bar mthong ba ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la rag las par mthong nas/ lus thams cad kyis phab ste/ phyag byas nas langs te⑦/ drang srong 'jigs mchog dbyangs la lan brgya stong du mar bskor〈ba byas nas mdun du 'dug ste/ thal mo sbyar nas yid du 'ong ba'i tshul gyis yid du 'ong ba'i tshig brjod de/ 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phags pa bdag gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed na/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpas ⑨byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bgyi ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bgyi ba ma 'tshal te/ 'phags pa ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gdams ngag dang / rjes su bstan pa mdzad do zhes thos na⑩/ 'phags pa ji ltar byang chub sems dpas7byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bgyi ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bgyi ba bdag la bshad du gsol/ de nas drang srong 'jigs mchog dbyangs kyis bram ze'i byis pa stong phrag bcu po de dag la bltas te/ 'di skad ces smras so/ /byis pa dganyerigs kyi bu 'dis bla na 37—813

med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed de/ sems can thams cad 'jigs pa med pa la mgron gyo)du gnyer to/ /rigs kyi bu 'di ni sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba'i don du sta gon du gnas pa ste/ye shes rgya mtsho la mimangon du gyur pa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos zhukyi sprin gyi char btung bar 'dod pa'o/ /chos kyi tshul rgya mtsho thams cad la 'jug par 'dod pa'o/ /ye shes kyi snang ba chen po la gnas par 'dod pa'o/ /snying rje chen po'i sprin bsdu bar 'dod pa'o/ /chos kyi char chen po mngon par dbab par ge'adod pa'o/ /ye shes chen po'i zla ba 'jig rten du shar bar byas te / nyon mongs pa'i gdung ba thams cad rab tu gzhil bar 'dod pa'o/ /sems can thams cad kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba rnam par spel bar 'dod pa'o/ /de nas bram ze'i byis pa stong phrag bcu po de dag gis me tog dri zhim la yid du 'ong zhing kha dog sna tshogs dang ldan pa mang pos tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs ⑤la gtor to/ /mngon par gtor to/ /rab tu gtor to/ /mngon par phyag 'tshal to / /de ltar 6)btud de phyag 'tshal nas/ g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas te/ tshig 'di skad du 7)brjod do/ /'di ni sems can thams cad yongs su skyob par 'gyur ro/ /sems can dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad rab tu zhi bar bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /byol song gi skye gnas kyi lam gyi rgyud thams cad rnam par gcod par 'gyur ro/ /gshin rje'i 'jig rten rin gyi lam gyi rgyud thams cad rnam par bzlog par 'gyur ro/ /mi khom pa'i sgo thams cad gcod par 'gyur ro/ /sred pa'i rgya mtsholo)yongs su skems 3ci )par 'gyur ro/ /srid 37pa'i 'ching 12ba gcod par 'gyur ro/ /sdug bsngal gyi phung po rnam par bzlog par 37—814

'gyur ro/ /ma rig pa'i mun pa sel bar 'gyur ro/ /bsod nams kyi khoramastiyug gis 'jig rten yongs su bskor〈(bar 'gyur ro/ /ye shes rin po che'i 'byung gnas sukhuyongs su ston par 'gyur ro/ /ye shes kyi nyi ma 'char5gebar bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /chos kyi mig rnam par sbyong bar 'gyur ro/ /'jig rten rnams la mnyam pa dang mi mnyam pa yang dag par ston par 'gyur ro/ /de nas drang srong 'jigs mchog dbyangs kyis byis pa de dag la 'di skad ces smras so / /byis pa dgasnyigang gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa de ni byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe/ sems can thams cad kyi bde ba rab tu bskyed de/ rim gyis thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyang 'thobalgepar 'gyur ro/ /byis pa dag 7)rigs kyi bu 'dis ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed pa ste/ de bas na 'di ni sangs rgyas kyi yon tan thams cad kyis yongs su sbyong bar 'gyur ro6)/ /de nas drang srong 'jigs mchog dbyangs kyis/ tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangasaphyel 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu kho bo ni byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i rgyal mtshan thob pa'o/ /nor bzangs kyis nyi )smras pa / byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa gzhan gyis mi thub pa 'di'i yul ji lta bu zhig mchis/ de nas drang srong 'jigs mchog dbyangs kyis lag pa g.yas pa brkyang ste/ tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyi 11mgo la byugs nas lag pa g.yasatshwa pas bzung ngo / /tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs 3nyel drang srong 'jigs mchog dbyangs kyis lag pa g.yas pas bzung nyu༄ma thag tu de'i mod la tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis8/ phyogs bcur sangs rgyas kyi 7zhing brgya 37wa 815

stong phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing mthong bar gyur te/de dag gi de bzhin gshegs pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing brgya stong phrag bcu'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed kyi zhabs kyi drung na bdag nyid 'dug par7shes par gyur to/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing de dag kyang rnam pa grangs med par rnam par dag pa'i rgyan dang ldan par mthong ngo / /de dag na'ang de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho kha dog sna tshogs can⑧rgyan rnam pa tha dad pa dang ldan pa dag 'khod pa semathong ngo / /'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho de dag na'ang de bzhin gshegs pa'i skusamatshan dang dpe byad bzang po 'bar bas brgyan pa dag bzhugs pak+shimathong ngo / /de dag las kyang tshig dang yi ge gcig las kyang phyir phyogs pa59)med par chos bstan pa nyan to④/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo de dag kyang phan tshun⑧ma 'dres par yang dag par 'dzin to/ /chos kyi sprin gyi char sems can gyi ⑨bsam pa sna tshogs la 'bab pa de dag kyang yang dag par 'dzin to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gi sngon gyi smon lam mos pa sna tshogs kyi stobs kyis rnam par sbyangs pa rgya mtsho la yang zhugs so/ /sangs rgyas kyi yang57dag par bsdu ba smon lam sna tshogs rgya mtshos rnam par dag pa rgya mtsho de dag la yang zhugs so/ /sangs rgyas kyi sku mdog sems can gyi bsams pa ji lta ba bzhin du tshim par 'gyur bar tunyernam par dmyigs pa de dag kyang mthong ngo / /sangs rgyas kyi 'od gzer gyi dra ba 'dod chags dang bral ba sna tshogs kyis rnam par dag pa'i78rgyan gyi dkyil 'khor dechadag kyang mthong ngo / /sangs rgyas kyi stobs de dag la'ang ye shes rnam par〈nyesnang ba bsgribs5nyepa med pa dang ldan pas zhugs so/ /de ltar tsho/)byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa 37—816

gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi ye shes kyi 'od kyis snang bar gyur pa/ting nge 'dzinaturnam par snang mdzad kyi snying po snang ba rab tu thob pa/ ting nge 'dzin ye shes myi zad pa'i rnam par thar pa dang ldan pa②/ gzungs kyi sgo snang bsaphyogs kun gyi dra ba rab tu thob pa/ gzungs kyi sgo rdo rje'i snying pos sems rab tu gsal bar byas pa/ ting nge 'dzinasaye shes brtsegs pa rnam par phyesheba'i yul la rnam par phye ba rab tu thob pa/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rnam par spyod pa gzhi kun nas rnam par brgyan pa'i snying po yul du gyur pa/ting nge 'dzin gyi snang ba sangs rgyas nam mkha'i snying po'i dkyil 'khor la rab tu zhugs pa/ ting nge 'dzin sangs rgyas thams cad kyi chos kyi 'khor lo'i mu khyud kyis sems rab tu snang bar byas pa/ ting nge 'dzin gyi snang bshedus gsum gyi ye shes rin po che mi zad pa'i dkyil0)'khor lasherab tu brtson pa des de bzhin gshegs pa la la'i zhabs kyi drung du ni nyin zhag gcig lon par shes so/ /la lar ni nyin zhag bdun lon pa snyam/ la lar ni zla ba phyed lon pa snyam/ la lar ni zla ba gcig lon pa snyam/ la lar ni lo gcig lon pa snyam/ la lar ni lo brgyar lon pa snyam/ la lar ni lo stong lon pa snyam/ la lar ni lo brgya phrag stong lon pa snyam/ la lar ni lo bye ba lon pa snyam/ la lar ni lo bye ba brgya nyu1lon pa snya4nye/ la lar ni lo bye ba stong lon pa snyam/ la lar ni lo bye ba brgyal)phrag stong lon pa snyam/ la lar ni lo bye ba khrag khrig lon pa snyam/ la lar ni bskal pa phyedamanyelon pa snyam/ la lar ni bskal pa gcig lon pa snyam/la lar ni bskal pa brgya lon pa snyam/ la lar ni bskal pa stong lon pa snyam/la lar ni bskal pa brgya phrag stong lon pa snyam/ la lar ni bskal pa bye ba lon 37—817

pa snyam/ la lar ni bskal pa bye ba phrag brgya lon pa snyam/ la lar ni bskal pa bye ba phrag 3)stong lon pa snyam/ la lar ni bskal pa bye ba brgya phrag stong lon pa snyam / la lar ni bskal pa bye ba khrag yakhrig brgya phrag stong lon pa snyam byed pa nas / de bzhin gshegs pa la la'i zhabs kyi drung du ni bskal pa brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa ((snyed lon par gyur pa snyam byed deX/ de bzhin gshegs pa la la'i zhabs kyi drung du ni bskal pa 'dzam bu'i gling gi rdul shin tu phra ba snyed lon pa snyam byed pa nas/ bskal pa sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med pa'i rdul shin tu phra ba snyed lon pa snyam byed par gyur to/ /de nas drang srong 'jigs mchog dbyangs kyis/ tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs btang zheb dang / des yang bdag drang srong 'jigs mchog dbyangs kyi mdun du yi'adug par shes par gyur to/ /de la drang srong 'jigs mchog dbyangs kyis smras pa rigs kyi bu dran mod/ smras pa 'phags pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi byin gyis rlabs kyis dran no/ /smras pa rigs kyi bu kho bos ni byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i rgyal mtshan 'di shes par zad na/byang chub sems dpa' 'gro ba thams cad las khyad par du 'phags pa'i ye shes mngon par shes pa dang ldan pa'i ting nge 'dzin thob pa/ dus thams cad du 'khor lo bskor ri ba/ sangs rgyas kyi mtshan dang / ye shes mngon par bsgrub pa la mkhas pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa byung ba'i nyi ma la rnam par dmigs pa'i rgyan rab tu dgod 9pa dus gsum gyi yul skad cig gcig gi tu )yi shes su yang dag par sdud 31pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du lus shin tu rnam par bkram pa chos kyi dbyings thams cad la ye shes snang ba'i rang bzhin dang ldan pa/37—818

sems can thams cad kyi bsam pa ji lta ba57bzhin du mngon sum du mngon par langs pa/ sems can gyi bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du spyod pas/ rnam par spyodatshwa pa dang mthun ②pa'i tshul dang ldan pa 'dod pa bzhin du kun tu snang zhing dri ma med la 'od dang ldan pa'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor rnam par dag pa/ de dag gi spyod pa shes pa'am/ yon tan brjod pa'am/ smon lam gyi khyad par smos pa'am/ zhing gi mngon par 'du bya ba shes pa'am/ ye shes kyi yul la 'jug par bya ba'am/ ting nge 'dzin gyi spyod yul gyi rjes su 'brang bar bya ba'am / rdzu 'phrul dang rnam par 'phrul pa la 'jug par bya ba'am/ rnam par thar pa'i khyu mchog gi mthu phyung ba dang grwa/ rnam par rtsengan)ba'i rjes su 'brang bar bya ba'am/ lus rnam par phye ba'i mtshan ma gzung bar yibya ba'am/dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor rnam par dag pas snabarjod pa'am/ ye shes kyi snang ba rab tu bstan⑧par nus re skan/ /songs9rigs kyi bu lho phyogs kyi rgyud 'di nyid na yul yongs su tshol ba zhes bya ba yod de/ de na bram ze borgyal ba'i 31drod kyi skye mched ces bya ba 'dug gisakyi / de'i gan du song la ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bgyi nyi ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bgyi 0ba dris shig /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs 8dga' rangs te mgu zhing nyams bde la tshim zhing yid bde ba skyes nas/ drang srong 'jigs mchog dbyangs kyi rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ drang srong 'jigs mchog dbyangs la lan brgya stong du mar g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas nas/ yang dang yang bltas te drang srong 'jigs mchog dbyangs kyi drung nas song ngo // //37wa 819

sangs rgyas rmad ga cad ces bya ba shin tu rgyas pa chen po'i mdonyu/ bam po sum cu gnyis50pa/ de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs②/ byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi ye shes kyis snang bar byas pa/ sangs rgyas kyi yul gyi rnam par 'phrul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa la mngon sum du rnam par spyod pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'isnyimangon sum gyi ye shes kyis mngon par shes pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes kyis/ sems snang bar gyur pa dus thams cad du yang dag par 'jug pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi ye shes ⑤snang ba rab tu thobalgepa/ 'du shes kyi rnam pa thams cad la yang dag par 'jug pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi yul gyis snang bar gyur pa/ 'gro ba thams cad las khyad par du 'phags pa dang ldan pa'i ye shes snang ba thob pa/ thams cad kyi rjes su song ba'i spyod yul la rnam par spyod pa mngon tu gyur pa/ gnyis su rnam par rtog pa med pas mnyam pa nyid du bstan pa'i ye shes lhur len pa/dmyigs pa thams cad la rab tu 'dal (peba'i ye shes snang ba dang ldan pa/mnyam rinasapa thams cad la mngon du gyur pa'i bzod pa rnam par dag pa la mos pa'i mdzod la mkhas pa rang bzhin gyi chos la bzod pa khong du chud pa'i ye shes mngon par shes pa dang ldan pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i rang bzhin bsgom pa dang mi 'bral ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi shugs drag po las phyir mi ldog pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ stobs bcu'i ye shes snang ba'i 'od rab tu thob pa/ chos kyi dbyings brjod pa la mngon par mos pas / ngoms pa med pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la 37—820

rnam par spyod pa'i spyod yul la 'jug pa ②khong du chud pa'i sems dang ldan pa/byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i rgyan mtha' yas pa mngon par bsgrub pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i smon lam gyi dkyil 'khor mtha' yas pa/rnam par spyad7pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi dra ba mi zadasnyepa / khong du chud pa'i ye shes mtha' dang dbus med pa mngon du gyur pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ sems can rgya mtsho mtha' yas pa yongs su smin par bya ba dang / gdul bar bya ba la zhum pa med pa'i sems dang ldan pa des/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i byayul mtha' yas pa la yang dag par blta ba dang /'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud rnam pa tha dad pa mtha' yas pa la yang dag par blta0ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams rnam par phye ba sna tshogs mtha' yas pa la yang dag par blta ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas pa dmyigs pa phra ba dang / yangs pa'i khongs su chud par bya ba la yang dag par blta ba dang /'jig rten gyi khams kyi gzhi mtha' yas pa'i ming gi dra ba sna tshogs yang dag par blta ba dang / 'jig rten gyi khams su rnam par spyad pa/ rnam par gdags pa mtha' yas pa'i kun rdzob rnam pa tha dad pa la yang dag par blta ba dang /sems can gyi mos pa sna tshogs mtha' yas pa la yang dag par blta dub dang /sems can rnam par phye ba'i rnam pa tha dad pa/ mtha' yas pa la yang dag par blta ba dang / sems can mtha' yas pa 6)yongs su smin par bya ba dang / gdul ba khonganyedu chud par bya ba la〈nyeyang dag par blta ba dang / sems can dang phyogs dang dus mtha' yas pa'i mying gi rnam pa sna tshogs la yang dag par blta ba dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen mngon du bya ba byed cing mthar gyis yul 37—821

tshol ba dang ldan pa gang na ba dang / bram ze0)rgyal ba'i drod kyi skye mched ga la ba der phyin to/ /de'i tshe bram ze rgyal ba'i drod kyi skye mched thams cad mkhyen pa nyid 5bsgrub pa'i gzhir byas shing dka' thub drag po la spyod dedu/ de'i phyogs bzhi nas me'i phung po ri rab 0tsam du che ba bus pa dang / ri shin tu mtho ba'i g.yang parasa'i lam gyi rgyud spu gri'i sos gshibs pas 'khodamanyapar snang ngo ske/ /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis53)bram ze0)rgyal ba'i drod kyi skye 1)mched kyi rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ mdun du 'dug nas thal mo sbyar te/ 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phags pa bdag gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed na/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems 1 chodapa'i spyod pa la spyad 37pa dang / ji ltar nan tan du bgyi ba ma 'tshal te/ 'phags pa ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gdams ngag dang / rjes su bstan pa mdzad do zhes bdag gis thos na/ 'phags pa ji ltar byang chub sems dpas 32byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bgyi ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bgyi ba bdag la bshad du gsol des smras pa rigs kyi bu song la spu gri'i so dang ra 1 ba'i ri 'di la 'dzegs te/ me'i 'obs 'dir mchongs shig dang / des khyod kyi byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yongs su dag par 'gyur ro zhes nasal/ tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs7'di snyam du sems par gyur te/ mi khom pa brgyad las rnam par ldog pa yang shin tu dkon/myir gyur nyizhete khom pa phun sum tshogs shing / rnam par dag pa yang lha shin tu dkon / sangs rgyas 'byung ba yang shin tu dkon/ dbang po nyams pa hunyeskyed pa yang shin du dkon/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thos pa yang shin du dkon/ skyes 37wa 822

bu dam pa dang phrad pa yang shin tu dkon/ yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen yang shin tu dkon/ yang dag pa'i tshul rjes su bstan pas legs par sdud pa yang shin tu dkon/ yang dag par 'tsho bar bya ba yang shin tu dkon/mi'i 'jig rten na chos dang gnyer ba'i chos la nan tan byed pa yang shin tu dkon na6)/ de skad zer zhing bdag gi dge ba'i bar chad mil zhugs la〈bde ltar bdag gi srog gcad par brtson pa 'di bdud dam cig ④ma yin nam/bdud kyi 'a)byin gyis 6)brlabs pa'am/ bdud kyi ris su gtogs pa'am/dge ba'i bshes gnyen ltar brdzus dzipa'am/ byang chub sems dpa' la myi gcagasapo)pa byed pa zhig ma yin grang0)/ bdag gi thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la bgegs byed par 'dod pa zhig ma yin grang 3lha/ bdag lam gol ba ngan par gzhugasngo par 'dod pa zhig ma yin grang / bdag gis sangs rgyas kyi chos khong du chud par bya ba'i chos kyi 3)sgo la bgegs skobyed pa zhig ma yin grangatsham/ snyam nas / de de ltar sems shing yid la byed pa'i tshe/ tshangs pa stong phrag bcu steng gi bar snang la gnas te/ 'di skad ces 'dzer to0/ /rigs kyi bu de lta bu'i sems mi nya 1brtan par ma byed cig /rigs kyi bu 'phags pa 'di ni ting nge 'dzin rdo rje 'od 'phro ba'i snang ba rab tu thob pa ste/ brtson 'grus ldog pa med pa'o/ /brtsams pa chen po mthar dbyung badz+wa la zhugs pa'o/ /'gro ba thams cad kyi sred pa'i rlan bskam pa la mngon par brtson pa'o/ /lta ba'i rnam pa dang dra5)ba thams cad gtub niX pa la brtson pa'o/ /nyon mongs pa'i lcag (1 rtsig thams cad zad par bsreg pa la sta gon du gnas pa'o/ /mi khom mi shes pa'i bas mtha'i gedagon pa thams cad snang bar bya ba la brtson pa'o/ /sems 37wa 823

can thams cad kyi rga shi'i g.yang sa dang / 'jigs pa rnam par bzlog pa la yinyedam brtan pa'o/ /dus gsum gyi mun pa bsal7ba la mngon par brtson pa'o/ /chos thams cad kyi 'od gzer dgyesab la zhugs pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu 'phags pa 'di dka' thub lngas yongs su gdung ba mdzad pa'i tshe/ tshangs pa ji snyed cig mkhan po dang dbang bsgyur0ba dang / 'jig rten thams cad kyi gtso bor rang rang rlom zhing sems pa/ lta0ba'i rnam pa sna tshogs la mngon par zhen pa/de dag thams cad 'phags pa 'di'i rjodaka' thub dang / brtul zhugs kyi thugs dam gyi mthus rang rang gi gnas na bag dga' ba med cing / de dag bsam gtan gyi ro dga' ba myong ba med pas/ 'phags pa 'di'i drung du 'dong ngo / /de dag phyin pa dang / 'phags pa 'di'i rdzu 'phrul gyi sbyin pashedang /drag shul gyi dka' thub dang / brtul zhugs kyishezil gyis mnan te/ lta ba'i rnam pa thams cad rnam par bzlog pa dang / nga rgyal dang rlom sems thams cad rab tu spang ba'i7phyir chos ston to/ /'gro ba thams cad la byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen pos khyab par bya ba dang / byang chub kyi bsam pa brtan par bya ba dang / byang chub tu sems bskyed pa shin tu yangs par bya ba dang ske/ sangs rgyas thams cad yang dag par blta ba la mngon par brtson par bya ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi gsung gi dkyil 'khor thob par bya ba yongs su rdzogs par bya ba dang / thams cad du grags57pa'i sangs rgyas kyi dbyangs la thogs pa med cing bsgribalgepa med par bya ba'i phyir chos ston to/ /bdud stong phrag bcu yang steng gi bar snang la 'khod nas/ lha rdzas kyi nor bu rin po ches mngon par gtor te/ 'di skad ces 'dzer to/ /rigs kyi bu 'phags pa 'di 37—824

dka' thub lngas yongs sushegadung ba mdzad pa'i tshe/ 'od 'phro ba'i phung po 'di las snang ba chen po byung zhing kho bo cagashegi khyim dang / lus dang rgyan gyi longs spyod thams cad zil gyis gnon to/ /de'i phyir kho bo gcag kyang so so'i gnas gnas na bag dudaga' ba med pas 'khor dang bcas te 'phags pa 'di'i drung du 'dong ngo / /kho bo cag 'di'i drung du phyin nas kyang / 'phags pa 'di ni kho bo cag la 0ci nas kyangakherang rang gi sems sor chud nas byang chub tu sems bskyed de/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ba de lta de ltar nichos ston to/ /dbang bsgyur 0gyi lha'i rgyal po/stong phrag bcus kyang lha rdzas kyi me tog gis mngon par gtor te⑩/ 'di skad ces 'dzer totunye/ /rigs kyi bu 'phags pa 'di dka' thub lngas tsoyongs su gdung ba7byed pa'i tshe/ kho bo cag kyang rang rang gi gnasalgen dga' ba med de8/ de ltar bdag cag kyang rang rang gi skye bo'i 'khor dang bcas te 'di'i drung du 'dong ngo / /bdag cag 'di'i 8drung du phyin pa dang 'di ni bdag cag la rang rang gi sems la dbang bsgyur ba thobs par bya ba'i phyir chos ston to/ /nyon mongs pa thams cad la dbang bsgyur ba thob〈nyepar bya ba dang / bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du skye ba la dbang bsgyur5)ba thob par bya ba dang / las kyi sgrib pa thams cad rnam par dag pa'i dbang rab tu thob par bya ba dang / snyoms par 'jug pa thams cad la dbang rab tu 3 thob par bya ba dang / yo byad la dbang ba'i rgyan yongs su dag par bya ba dang / bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du tshe la dbang bsgyur〈 skyeb thob par bya ba'i phyir chos ston to/ /rab 'phrul dga'i lha'i rgyal po stong phrag bcu yang steng gi bar snang la 'khod de/ lha rdzas kyi glu yang 37—825

dag par sbyar ba'i nga ro snyan pa'i dbyangs bsgrags te①/ mchod pa byas nas 'di skad ces 'dzer to/ /rigs kyi bu 'phags pa 'dishedaka' thub lngas yongs su gdung ba mdzad pa'i tshe/ me'i phung po 'di las de dang 'dra ba'i 'od byungasazhing desamaXkho bo cag gi gzhal med khang 'di dag rnam par dag ste/ gsal ba dang 'od shin tu dang bar gyur toyi/ /rgyan 'di dag dang lha'i bu mo 'di dag kyang rnam par dag cing gsalalo7)la 'od shin du dang bar gyur toni/ /de bas na bdag cag kyang lha'i bu dang lhanyemo'i tshogs kyi 'khor dang bcas par7'dod pa la dga' bar tshor ba med do/ /'dod pa'i bde ba la mngon par dga' ba med pas lus dang sems tshim57par gyur nas/ 'phags pa 'di'i drung du dong7ba yin te/rte/ 'phags pa 'di ni bdag cag de ltar phyin pa rnams la sems rnam par dag par bya ba'i phyir chos ston to/ /sems kyi 'od 'dang78bar bya ba dang /sems shin du dag par bya ba dang / sems las su rung bar bya ba dang /sems kyi dga' ba yongs su bskyed pa dang / stobs bcu'i ye shes 'thob pa rnam par dag par bya ba dang / chos kyi shugs chen po rnam par 'phel bar bya ba dang ske/ sangs rgyas kyi sku tshad med pa mngon par bsgrub pa'i phyir lus rnam par dag par bya ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung thob par bya ba'i phyir ngagatshwanyernam par dag par bya ba dang / thams cad mkhyen pa nyid rab tu thob par bya bar〈nyesems rnam par dag par bya ba'i phyir chos ston to/ /rab dga' ldan gyi lha'i rgyal po stong phrag bcu'i〈7lha'i bu dang / lha'i bu mo'i tshogs kyi 'khor dang bcas pa dag kyang steng gi bar snang la 'khod nas / spos sna tshogs kyi phye ma'i sprin gyi char mngon par phab pas mchod pa byas te/ phyag 'tshal nas 'di skad 37—826

ces 'dzer to/ /rigs kyi bu 'phags pa 'di dka' thub lngas yongs su gdung btumadzad pa'i tshe/ bdag cag kyang rang rang gi gnas na ri dga' ba med de/de ltar dga' ba med pas 'di'i drung du 'dong ste/ bdag cag phyin pa rnams la 'phags pa 'di ni yul thams cad la ltos pa med par bya ba'i phyir chos ston to / /chog shes pa'i sems su bya ba dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba yang dag par bskyed5bapa dang / byang chub tu sems bskyed pa rab tu thob par bya ba nas/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir chos ston to/ /rab mtshe ma'i lha'i rgyal po stong phrag bcu lha'i bu dang / lha'i bu mo'i tshogs kyi 'khor dang bcas pa dag gis kyang lha rdzas kyi me tog man da〈per ba'i char mngon par phab stese/ 'di skad ces 'dzer to/ /rigs kyi bu 'phags pa 'di dka' thub lngas yongs su gdung ba mdzad pa'i tshe/ bdag cag kyang lha rdzas kyi glu snyan pa la dga' ba med de/ de ltar dga' ba med pas 'phags pa 'di'i drung du 'dong ste / bdag cag phyin nas kyang / 'phags pa 'di ni 'dod pa'i dga' ba thams cad rnam par bzlog par bya ba nas/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad rab tu thob par bya ba'i phyir chos ston to/ /lha'i dbang po brgya byin stong phrag bcu so so nas/ nye ba'i dbang po sum cu57rtsa gnyis dang / lha'i bu dang / lha'i bu mo'i tshogs kyi 'khor dang bcas pas/ lha rdzas kyi gos dang / rin po che'i rgyan dang / me tog gi sprin gyi khuchar mngon par phab ste/ 'di skad ces 'dzer to/ /rigs kyi bu 'phags pa 'di/ dka' thub lngas yongs su gdung ba mdzad pa'i tshe/ bdag cag kyang brgya byin gyi khang pa dang / bza' shing gi ra ba dang / rtse ba'i nags tshal dang / lha rdzas kyi rol mo brdung zhing dgrol ba 37—827

dang ske/ gam yo na glu len pa'i longs spyod la dga' ba med de3)/ de ltar bdag cag dga' ba med pas 'di'i drung du 'dong ngo / /bdag cag der phyin nas ri kyang 'phags pa cha'adi ni kho bo cag la 'dod pa'i dga' ba thams cad yongs su spang ba'i phyir chos ston to/ /'di dag thams cad ni rtag pa ma yin te/mi brtan zhing 'jig57par 'gyur ba'i chos can no zhes bya ba'i tshig brjod do/ /dregs pa dang bag med pa thams cad yongs su gcad pa dang / bla na med pa'i byang chub tu spro ba bskyed pa'i phyir chos ston to/ /rigs kyi bu gzhan yang 'dis bltas pa tsam gyis ri rab kyi rtse mo thams cad kyang g.yo bar 'gyur te/ des bdag cag gshigs ⑤pas sems skyo bar gyur nas/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i sems brtan pas/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes su smon lam mngon par sgrub bo / /klu'i rgyal po shugs ldan dang / dga' bo dang / bsnyenarnyudaga' bo la stsogs ⑦pa/ klu brgya stong phrag bcu dag kyang steng gi bar snang la gnas shing dus dang mthun nipa'i lha rdzas kyi tsan dan gyi sprin dang / klu'i bu mos glu ⑨blangs pa'i nga ro snyan pa'i dbyangs dang / lha rdzas kyi spos chu'i rgyun rab tu 'bab pa'i char mngon par phab ste/ 'di skad ces 'dzeratshwakye to/ /rigs kyi bu 'phags pa 'di dka' thub lngas yongs su gdung ba mdzadarwa1pa'i tshe/ me'i phung po chen po 'di las 'od chen po byungarwarteste/ des klu'i gnas5nyethams cad snang bar byas nas/ bye ma'i char dang / nam mkha' lding gi 'jigs pa yongs su sel to/ /khro ba 'byung ba yang zhi bar byas te/ lus sim par byas nas7yid shin tu mos par byed do/ /de ltar hunyesems shin tu mos par gyur nas/'phags pa 'di ni bdag cag la chos ston te⑩/ 'di ltar klu'i lam gyi rgyud 37—828

ngan pa rnam par smad pa dang / sgrib pa'i las thams cad rab tu spang ba'i phyir nyes pa 'chags su btsud cing7bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed du btsud de thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la rab tu dgon⑧do/ /gnod sbyin gyi dbang po stong phrag bcu yang nam mkha'i dbyings la 'khod de/mchod pa rnam pa sna tshogs kyis bram zesargyal ba'i drod kyi skye mched dang / tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs dul mchod pa byas nas 'di skad ces 'dzer to/ /rigs kyi bu 'phags pa 'di dka' thub lngas yongs su gdung ba mdzad pa'ikhutshe/kho bo cag gi 'khor kun kyang mi rnams la byams pa'i sems skye bar 'gyur te/gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / grul bum thams cad kyang byams pa'i sems dang ldan par gyur to④/ /de dag byams pa'i sems dang ldan zhing 'tshe ba med pa la zhugs pa rnams kho bo cag gi drung du 'ong ngo / /kho bo cag kyang de ltar byams pa'i dbang giloril gyis non pas/ rang rang gi gnas de dang /de dag na dga' ba med de/ de ltar bdag cag kyang rang ranganyegi skye bo'i 'khor dang bcas te/ 'phags pa 'di'i drung du 'dong ngo / / 'phags pasnyibadag cag de ltar 'ongs pa rnams la 'phags pa 'di'i sku las byung ba'i 'od kyis lus thams cad snang bar byas shing / bdesnyibs khyab par mdzad de/ de ltar bdag cag lus dang sems bde bar gyur nas/ 'phags pa 'di ni ci nas kyang bdag cag la gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang grul bum dang / lus srul po mang po byang chub tu sems skye bar 'gyur ba de ltar chos ston to/ /dri za'i dbang po stong phrag bcu dag kyang steng gi bar snang la 'khod nas 'di skad ces 'dzer to/ /rigs kyi bu kho bo cag kyang rang rang gi gnas na 'khod pa'i tshe/37—829

'phags pa 'di dka' thub lngas yongs su gdung ba nya)mdzad pa'i tshe/ me'i phung po 'di las 'od byung ri ste/ bdag cag gi gnas snang bar gyur tog/ /de ltar bdag cag 'od des phog ste3)/ bde ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan par gyur pas/ 'phags pa 'di'i drung du 'dong ste/ bdag cag drung du phyin nas kyang 'phags pa 'di ni bdag cag ci nas kyang / bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir mi ldog par 'gyur ba de ltar chos ston to/ /lha ma yin gyi dbang po stong phrag bcu dag kyang rgya mtsho'i nang nas mngon par 'thon te/nam mkha' la pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga btsugs rigete/ thal mo sbyar nas phyag 'tshal zhing 'di skad ces 'dzer to/ /rigs kyi bu 'phags pa 'di dka' thub lngas yongs su gdung ba mdzad pa'i tshe/ kho bo cag gi lha ma yin gyi56)'jig rten rgya mtsho dang rir bcas pa'i sa chen po'i dkyil 'khor rab tu g.yo bar gyur te/bdag cag kun gyi nga rgyal dang rlom sems dang / dregs pa thams cad brtul shugs nadang / dka' thub kyi zil gyis duspunon te/ 'phags pa 'di'i drung du 'dong ngo / /der phyin nas kyang 'phags pa 'di ni bdag cag la g.yo sgyu thams cad rab tu spang ba dang / chos zab mo'i bzod pa la gzud pa 1 ridang / mi g.yo ba'i chos nyid la rab tu dgod pa dang / stobs bcu'i ye shes yongs su grub par bya ba'i phyir chos ston to/ /nam mkha' lding gi hunyadabang po shugs chen po 'dzin pa la stsogs / pa nam mkha' lding gi dbang po stong phrag bcus kyang bram ze'i bu shin tu sdug /nyegu'i gzugs su mngon par sprul te/ 'di skad ces 'dzeramathuto / /rigs kyi bu 'phags pa 'di dka' thub lngas yongs su gdung ba mdzad pa'i tshe/ me'i phung po 'di dag las 'od chen po byung ste/ bdag cag gi 837wa 830

gnas snang bar byas nas/ yongs su g.yo bar byed do/ /des bdag cag kyang 'jigs shing skrag ste/ skyo ba'i yid dang ldan par gyur nas 'phags pa 'di'i drung du 'dong ngo / /'phags pa 'di yang bdag cag la chos ston cing /byams pa chen po la yang dag par sbyor ba0)mdzad do/ /snying rje chen po la yang dag par dgod pakumadzad do/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor 'jug pa la yang yang dag par sbyor ba mdzad do/ /'dod pa'i 'dam du bying ba'i sems can mngon par gdon par bya ba la'ang yongs su sbyor bsnyemadzad do/ /lhag pa'i bsam pa'i sgo rnam par dag par bya ba la'angakhurab tu sbyor ba mdzad do/ /shes rab dang thabs shin tu gsalasab la'ang yang dag par sbyor ba mdzad do/ /rnam pa ji lta bur yongs su sbyin par bya ba'i semasashecan rnams gdul bar bya ba la'ang rab tu sbyor ba mdzad do/ /mi'am ci'i dbang po stong phrag bcu yang steng gi bar snang la 'khod de du'adi skad ces 'dzer to/ /rigs kyi bu 'phags pa 'di dka' thub lngas yongs su gdung ba mdzad pa'i tshe/ kho bo cag gi gnas na 'khod pa'i shingasheto la'i phreng ba las dril bu'i dra ba rin po che'i srad bus lda ldir brgyus pa'i sil snyan dang / rol mo'i yo byad dang / rin po che'i rgyan dang /khyim gyi longs spyod thams cad las sangs rgyas kyi sgra byung〈nye ngo / /chos kyi sgra dang phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun gyi sgra dang / byang chub tu yang dag par zhugs pa'i smon lam gyi sgra byung7)ngo / /'jig rten gyi khams kyi grangs su bya ba che ge mo zhig na ni byang chub sems dpa' mying 'di dang lha 'di zhes bya ba zhig byang chub tu smon lam 'debs so/ /'jig rten gyi khams kyi grangs su bya ba che ge mo7nyezhig na ni byang chub sems dpa'i mying 'di dang78'di 37—831

zhes bya ba zhig dka' ba yongs su gtong ba byed do/ /'jig rten gyi khams kyi grangs su bya ba che ge mo zhig na ni byang chub sems dpa' mying 'di dang ①'di zhes bya ba zhig thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor yongs su sbyong ba byed do/ /'jig rten gyi khams kyi grangs su bya ba che ge mo zhig na ni byang chub sems dpa' mying 'di dngam 'di zhes bya ba zhig snying po byang chub tu 'gro'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams kyi grangs su bya ba che ge mo zhig na ni byang chub sems dpa' mying 'di dang55)'di zhes bya ba zhig dpung dang bzhonasdo dpar bcas pa'i bdud rab tu pham par byas te/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya'o/ /'jig rten gyi khams kyi grangs su bya ba che ge mo zhig na ni de bzhin gshegs pa mtshan 'di dang ④'di zhes bya ba zhig chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba 6)mdzad do/ /'jig rten gyi khams kyi grangs su bya ba che ge mo zhig na ni de bzhin gshegs pa 427mtshan 'di dang ni che ge mo ④zhig sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las ma lus par mdzad nas/ phung po ma lus pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'isngoX dbyings su yongs su 11mya ngan las 'da' ba 1 mdzad do/ /zhes bya ba'i sgra 'byin te/ rigs kyi bu 'dzam bu'i 1 gling gi rtswa dang shing dang / yal ga dang /lo ma dang / 'dab ma thams cad rdul shin tu phra ba'i char blags pa'i mur thug par ni rung yang srid kyi de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gi mtshan dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi smon lam dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i khyad 14par gang kho bo cag gi gnas na yod pa'i shing ta la'i phreng〈deb las rol mo'i yo byad dang / rin po che'i rgyan dang / khyim gyi longs spyod rlung gis bskyod pa'i sgra 'byung zhing / nga ro 'byin pa dang / rna lam du grags 7pa'i 37wa 832

mtha' ni thug par mi rung ngo / /de ltar bdag cag kyang sangs rgyas dang /chos dang / dge 'dun dang / byang chub sems dpa' rab tu 'jug pa'i smon lam dang / spyod pa dang mtshan gyi chu klung gi sgras dga' ba chen po'i shugs drag pos nyams bde ba skyes te/ 'phags pa 'di'i drung du 'dong ngo / /de ltar bdag cag phyin par gyur nas kyang / 'phags pa 'di ni bdag cag la ci nas kyang ske/ kho bo cag gi 'khor gyi sems can du ma zhig bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub las phyir myi ldog par 'gyur ba de lta bur chos ston pa mdzad do / /'dod pa la spyod pa'i lha'i bu stong phrag dpag tu med pa kha dog shin tu mdzes pa dag kyang nam mkha' la 'khod cing yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pas 3 mchod pa byas nas 'di skad ces 'dzer to/ /'phags pa 'di dka' thub lngas yongs su gdung ba mdzad pa'i tshe/ me'i phung po 'di dag las rnam pa 'di lta bu'i 'od byung te/ 'od des mar na semanar med pa yan chad du sems can dmyal bsnyernams snang bar byas nas/ sems can dmyal ba pa'i gesems can thams cadamagekyi sdug bsngal rtse zil bar byas te/ 'od de nyid kyis 'phags pa 'di bdag cag gi myig lam du snang bar bstan pasaho7de'i phyir kho bo cag ri kyang 'phags pa 'di la sems mos par gyur nas/ 'dod pa la spyod pa'i lha'i ris nyams su bde bar skyes so/ /de ltar bdag cag kyang 'phags pa 'disasngonamadzad pa la drin du gzo 1)zhing mthong bas mi ngoms pas 'dod pa'i dga' ba thams cad yongs su spangs te/ 'phags pa 'di'i drung du 'dong ngo / /der bdag cag phyir bonas kyang 'phags pa 'di ni ci nas kyang / sems can tshad myed pa nya1rnams byang chub tu smon lam 'debs par 'gyur ba de ltar chos ston pa mdzad do//37—833

de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis7chos kyi tshul5)rnam pa 'di lta bu thos nas dga' rangs te/ mgu zhing nyams bde la tshim zhing7yid bde ba skyes te/bram ze rgyal ba'i drod kyi skye mched la yang dag pa'i dge ba'isnyibashes gnyen du 'du shes bskyed de6)/ bram ze rgyal ba'i drod kyi skye mched kyi rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phags pa de ltar bdag gis dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi bka' dang / 'gal bar bgyis pa'i nongs pa la nongs par bshags so/ /de nas bram ze rgyal ba'i drod kyi skye mched kyis/tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs57la tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag smras so/ /byang chub sems dpa' gang zhig rjes su bstan dang 'thun ⑦byed cing / /dran pa nye bar gzhag ri ste bla ma'i ngag gcog mi byed na/ /de 0phyir de yi don rnams thams cad 'thun par pa'agrub par 'gyur/ mthunasngonapa'i sangs rgyas ye shes byang chub drung du 'tshang yang rgya/ de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis ri'i kyi g.yang sa'i lam spu gri hu so gshibs pa la 'dzegs te/ me'i phung po chen po der mchongs so/ /de des7ltar mchongs pa'i tshe/ byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin shin tu brtan pa zhes bya ba thob par gyur to/ /mye des reg nas kyang byang chub sems dpa'i ting nge 'dzin rab tu zhi ba'i bde ba mngon par shes pa zhes bya ba thob par gyur nas des 'di skad ces smras so/ /'phags pashimye'i phung po la de ltar reg na bde ba dang / ri'i lam spu gris gtams pa 'di yang de ltar reg na bde ba de ni ngo mtshar che'o/ /des smras pa/ rigs kyi bu kho bo ni byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa5)dkyil 'khor yongs sunyemi zad pa thob pa /rteste/ rigs kyi bu gi chikho bos ni byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa rte37—834

dkyil 'khor yongs su mi zad pa 'di shes par zad na/ kho bos byang chub sems dpa' me'i phung po0)lta bu 'gro ba thams cad kyi nyon mongs pa dang / lta ba'i rnam pa thams cadasayongs su zad par bya ba'i smon lam can ru mtshon phyir mi ldog pa dang ldan pa/ sems la thub pa med cing sems dma' ba med pa dang ldan pa/ yid zhum pa med pa can rdo rje'i snying po dang ldan pa'i mthu bo che lta bu brtsams pa chen po mthar phyin par bya ba la sgyidakyilug pa med pa sbyor ba lhod pa skyed pa/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor lta burasnyi'agro ba thams cad kyi don du brtson pa/brtson 'grus phyir mi ldog pa dang ldan pa/ phyir mi zlog pa'i go ca bgos pa/de dag gi spyod pa shes pa'amanya/ yon tan brjod par nus re skan/ /song rigs kyi bu lho phyogs kyi rgyud 'di nyid na grong khyer seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa zhes bya ba yod de/ de na rgyal po seng ge〈)dpal gyi bu mo byams ma zhes bya ba bu mo lnga brgya'i 'khor dang bcas pa 3)'dug gis5)de'i gan du song la ji ltar byang chub sems dpas 1)byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bya ba dang /ji ltar nan tan du bya ba dris shigaci /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis8 / bram ze rgyal ba'i drod kyi skye mched kyi rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ bram zerwanyergyal ba'i drod kyi skye mched la lan brgya stong du mar g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas nas yang dang7)yang bltas te/ bram ze57rgyal ba'i drod kyi skye mched kyi drung nas song ngo / /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangasamatsha dge ba'i bshes gnyen la rim gro bsam gyis myi khyab pa la zhugs pa mos pa rgya chen pos rnam par dag pa theg pa chen po la mngon du phyogs pa/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes la mngon par mos pa/ sangs rgyas kyidza —rtechos la du snyeyang dag par zhugs pa/37—835

dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi rjes su 'brang bar spro ba/ chos kyi rim gro la rnam par spyod pa/ chags pa med pa'i ye shes la mngon du gyur pa/ yang dag pa'i mtha' shin tu rtogs pa/ ye shes kyi mtha' la 4)gnas pa'i yul dang ldan pa/dus gsum skad cig gi cha shas la khong du chud par byed pa/ nam mkha'i mtha' gnyis su med pa ri mngon du gyur pa/ mi gnyis pa'i mtha' rnam par gdona'i mi za ba thob pa/ chos kyi dbyings kyi mtha' la rnam par mi rtog par gnas pa/bsgribs 4pa med pa'i mthas gdul ba khong du chud par bya ba la zhugs pa/chos kyi mtha' dang myi 'gal bar bya ba la gzhol ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtha' la mtha' med par khong du chud pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mtha' la rnam par mi rtog dpar gnas pa/ sems can thams cad kyi 'du shes kyi 56)dra ba rnam par gtor ba'i ye shes la gzhol ba/ zhing la mngon par chags pa thams cad dang bral ba/ sangs rgyas kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad la chags pa med pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad yongs su dag par bya ba la gnas pa med par spyod pa/ sems can thams cad la bdag med pa dang ske/ sems can med pa'i 'du shes dang ldan pa/ sgra thams cad tshig gi lam lta bur khong du chud pa/ gzugs thams cad gzugs kyi gzugs brnyan dang mnyam par rnam par rig par bya ba la gzhol ba 7de mthar gyis seng ge rnam par bsgyings 8pa'i grong khyer gang na ba der phyin te/ bu mo byams ma tshol zhing yongs su med med pa las/ rgyal po seng ge 9dpal gyi bu mo byams ma 'khor bu mo lnga brgya dang ldan pa de khang pa rnam par 1 snang ba'i snying po zhes bya ba'i nang na khri tsan dan sbrul gyi snying po'i rkang pa can/ gser gyi lcag phod sna kyi dra bas 37—836

legs par blas7pa/ lha rdzas kyi stan⑧bting ba la 'dug cing chos ston to/ /zhes thos nas/ seng ge rnam par bsgyings pa'i grong khyer du song ste/ rgyal po seng geshedapal gyi gnas gang na ba der phyin nas/ rgyal po'i phyi sgo'i sgo gang〈gen bu mo byams ma mthong bar dga' ba'i phyir sdod cing 'dug 'dug pa dang /des der srog chags brgya phrag du ma dang / srog chags stong phrag du ma dang /srog chags brgya stong phrag du ma 'dong ba55)mthong nas/ khyed gang nas 'ongs4)/da gang du 'dong zhes dris pa dang / de dag na re rtso)nged ni bu mo byams ma'i drung du chos mnyan pa'i phyir 'dong ngo zhes nas/ des bsamasam pa 'dir ni su 'gro yang bgagashepa med pa lta zhig snyam ste/ de yang nang du phyin to/ /de ltar phyin te bltas na khang pa rnam par snang ba'i snying po can de yang / gzhi shel du 'dug pa'i sa las blangs te/ be+e ḍūr+ya'i stoka ba bkye ba/ rtsig pa rdo rje las byas pa/ 'dzam bu chu klung gi gser gyi nyu)lhun dang ldan pa'i rmo/geb gam brgya phrag stong gis brgyan pa/ nor bu rin po che grangs med pas rnam par bris pa/rin po che stong gi snying po'i me long gi dkyil 'khor gyis shin tu spa /thubar byas pa/nor bu rin po che 'gro ba'i yid du 'ong bas rnam par brgyan pa/ rin po che'i shing thags 8grangs med pas yongs su bskor ba/ gser gyi dril bu brgya stong shin tu 'khrol ba'i sgra snyan pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rgyan tshadang ldan pa 'dug 3 trepar mthong ngo / /bu mo byams ma de 32yang mig dkar nag 'byes pa/ skra mthon ting57du 'dug pa/ mdog gser gyi kha dog ltar 'dug pa mthong nas/des de'i ci )rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag (1'tshal te/ lan brgya stong du mar g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas nas thal mo sbyar te mdun du 'dug nas/ 'di 37wa 837

skad ces smras so/ /'phags ma bdag gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed na/ ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bgyi ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bgyi ba ma 'tshal te/ 'phags ma ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gdams ngag dang /rjes su bstan pa mdzad do zhes bdag gis thos na①/ 'phags ma ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bgyi ba dang /ji ltar nan tan du bgyi ba bdag la bshad du gsol/ smras pa/ rigs kyi bu/kho mo'i gnas kyi rgyan la ltos〈geshig /ces nas7des kun tu byul0te bltasasnyipa dang / rtsig pa re re dang / ka ba re re dang / me long gi dkyil 'khor re re dang / rnam pa'i bye brag re re dang / dbyibs re re dang / nor bu rin po che re re dang / gser gyi dril bu re re dang / rin po che'i shing re re dang /ba spu'i bu ga re re dang / rin po che'i se mo do re re4)las kyang / chos kyi dbyings thams cad na bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thog ma thugs bskyed pa dang bcas pa/ spyod pa dang smon lam gyi yul dang bcas pa/ 'byung ba'i rgyan dang bcas pa/ mngon par 'tshang rgya ba'i rnam par 'phrul pa dang bcas pa/chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang bcas pa/ yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba73ston pa dang bcas par gzugs brnyan gyi tshul du mthong bar gyur to/ /dmyigs pa de dag re re las ji lta brtsolabazhin du dmyigs pa thams cad las kyang mthong bar gyur to/ /'di lta ste dper na/ chus yongs su gang ba'i mtsho7dang zhing rtog pa med la77rnam par gsal5)ba la ni nam mkha' gnyi zla5sridang / skar ma'i tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ gzugs brnyan gyi tshul du yongs su snang ngo / /de 37—838

bzhin du khang pa rnam par snang ba'i snying po'ishedamyigs pa re re las kyang chos kyi dbyings kunasnyen bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gzugs brnyan gyi tshul du yongs su〈snang bar gyur te/ de ni bu mo byams ma'i sngon gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba'i rgyu'i7phyir te/ des de ltar rnam par bltas nas/ sangs rgyas mthong ba'i rgyan gyi mtshan ma de yongs su bzung ste/ thal mo sbyar nas/ bu mo byams ma'i gdong du bltas pa dang / des smras pa/ rigs kyi bu kho mo ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo'i rgyud kun nas rnam par brgyan pa zhes bya ba thob pa ⑤ste/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo'i rgyud 'di ni kho mos de bzhin gshegs pa chu klung gaṅgā'i klung sum cu7rtsa drug gi bye ma snyed las yongs su btsal7ba ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gis kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo'i rgyud kun nas rnam par brgyan pa 'di sgo sna tshogs kyi khong du chud par bya bas rtogs par mdzad de/ gcig gis gangasnyegasungs pa de'ang gnyis kyis ma gsungs so/ /smras pa/ 'phags ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo'i rgyud kun nas rnam par brgyan pa 'di'i7yul ji lta bu zhig mchis/ smras pa/ rigs kyi bu shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo'i rgyud kun nas rnam par brgyan pa 'di la kho mo〈 )mngon du byed cing / sems parwaskredang rjes su 'brang bar bya ba dang / rnam par dpyod pa dang / rjes su sems pa〈nyedang / dran par bya ba dang / yongs su gzung ba dang / rnam par brtagatshwa pa dang / mngon par bsgrub pa dang /yang dag par brgyan par bya ba dang / rab tu rnam par dbye ba7byed pa'i tshe/gzungs kun nas sgo zhes bya ba yongs su skye ste/ gzungs kyi dkyil 'khor der ni chos kyi sgo brgya stong grangs med pa phrag bcu yongs su 'du'o/ /khong du7chud 37—839

do/ /mngon du gyur to①/ /mngon par 'du'o/ /khongs na⑧'khod do/ /'di lta ste/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi⑧tho dang / sangs rgyas kyi sgo dang / chos kyi sgo dang / sems can gyi sgo dang / 'das pa'i sgo dang / ma 'ongs pa'i sgo dang ske/ da ltar byung ba'i sgo dang / gnas pa'i mtha'i7sgo dang / bsod nams kyi sgo dang / bsod nams kyi tshogs kyi sgo dang / ye shes kyi sgo dang /ye shes kyi tshogs kyi sgo dang / smon lam gyi sgo dang / smon lam gyi rnam pa'i sgo dang / spyod pa'i sgo dang / spyod pa7rnam par dag pa'i sgo dang / spyod pa yongs su 'byung ba'i sgo dang / spyod pa yongs su rdzogs par bya ba'i sgo dang /las kyi sgo dang / las dang mi 'gal ba'i sgo dang / las kyi rgyun57gyi sgo dang /las5semangon par 'du bya ba'i sgo dang / mi mnyam pa'i las yongs su spang ba'i sgo dang / yang dag pa'i las la nan tan du bya ba'i sgo dang / las la dbang bsgyur〈nyeba'i sgo dang / legs par spyad pa'i sgo dang / legs par spyad pa yang dag par blang ba'i sgo dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo dang / ting nge 'dzin khong du chud par bya ba'i sgo dang / ting nge 'dzin la rnam par spyad pa'i sgo dang /ting nge 'dzin gyi51spyod yul gyi sgo dang / ting nge 'dzin las ldang ba'i sgo dang /mngon par shes pa'i sgo dang / sems rgya mtsho'i sgo dang / sems kyipha7rnam grangs kyi sgo dang / sems kyi rgyud yongs su dag par bya ba'i sgo dang / sems kyi thibs po snang bar bya ba'i sgo dang / sems kyi mtsho dang b.ram8bya ba'i sgo dang ske/ sems 'byung ba'i sgo dang / sems rnam par rgyu ba'i sgo dang / sems can kun nas nyon mongs pa rgyu ba'i sgo dang / nyon mongs pa'i bag chags kyi sgo dang / nyon mongs pa'i sbyor ba'i sgo dang / mos pa'i sgo dang / sems 37wa 840

can gyi spyod pa'i sgo dang / sems can gyi spyod pa rnam pa tha dad pa'i sgo dang /'jig rten 'byung ba'i sgo dang / sems can gyi bsam pa'i sgo dang / sems can gyi 'du shes kyi rnam pa'i sgo dang / phyogs kyi sgo dang / chos kyi phyogs kyi sgo dang / snying rje chen po'i sgo dang / byams pa chen po'i sgo dang / zhi ba'i sgo dang ske/ ngag gi lam gyi sgo dang / tshul gyi sgo dang / khong du chud par bya ba'i sgo dang / rnam par phye ba'i sgo dang / yang dag par 'du ①ba'i sgo dang /chags pa med pa'i mtha'i sgo dang / kun gyi sgo dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi sgo dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa'i chos kyi sgo dang / nyan thos kyi chos kyi sgo dang /rang sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi sgo dang / 'jig rten gyi chos kyi sgo dang / 'jig rten 'byung ba'i chos kyi sgo dang / 'jig rten 'jig pa'i chos kyi sgo dang /'jig rten kun nas gnas pa'i sgo dang / 'jig rten gyi khams rnam par dag pa'i sgo dang / 'jig rten gyi khams kun nas nyon mongs pa'i sgo dang /'jig rten gyi khams kun nas nyon mongs pa la mirnam par dag pa'i sgo dang /'jig rten gyi khams rnam par dag pa la ri kun nas nyon mongs pa'i sgo dang /'jig rten gyi khams gcig tu kun nas nyon mongs pa'i sgo dang / 'jig rten gyi khams gcig tu rnam par dag pa'i sgo dang / 'jig rten gyi khams gzhi mnyam pa nyid du khong du chud par bya ba'i sgo dang / 'jig rten gyi khams snrel zhi'i rigesgo dang / 'jig rten gyi khamasama'ispyi'u tshugs su rgyu ba'i sgo dang / myig 'phrul du 'jug pa'i sgo dang / 'jig rten gyi khams kyi rgyud kyi sgo dang /gnas kyi 'du shes kyi nernam par gyur pa'i sgo dang / phra ba rgya chen por khong du chud par bya ba'i sgo dang / rgya chen po phra bar khong du chud par bya ba'i sgo dang /37—841

sangs rgyasatumathong bar bya ba'i sgo dang / sangs rgyas kyi sku rnam pa tha dad pa'i sgo dang / sangs rgyas kyi 'od gzer gyi dra ba rnam pa tha dad pa'i sgo dang /sangs rgyas kyi gsung gi dkyil 'khor rnam par phye ba'i sgo dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi 'khor lo mngon par bsgrub pa'i sgo dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi 'khor lo thakhudad pa'i sgo dang / dusangs rgyas kyi chos kyi 'khor lo7nges pa'i tshig gi sgo dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi 'khor lo 'khor bshekun tu 'khor ba'i sgo dang /sangs rgyas kyi phrin las kyi sgo dang / sangs rgyas kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor gyi sgo dang ske/ sangs rgyas kyi 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnam par phye ba'i sgo dang /sangs rgyas kyi 'khor gyi57dkyil 'khor rgya mtshor 'jug pa'i sgo dang / sangs rgyas kyi stobs snang ba'i sgo dang / sangs rgyas kyi ting nge ⑦'dzin gyi sgo dang /sangs rgyas kyi ting nge 'dzin gyis rnam par 'phrul pa'i sgo dang / sangs rgyas kyi rnam par spyod pa'i sgo dang / sangs rgyas kyi byin gyi rlabs kyi sgo dang / sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa'i sgo dang / sangs rgyas kyi sems can⑧pa rol gyi sems thugs su chud pa'i sgo dang / sangs rgyas kyi rdzu 'phrul gyis〈)rnam par 'phrul pa'i sgo dang ske/ dga' ldan gyi pho brang na bzhugs pa'i sgo nas yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba bstan pa'i bar gyi sgo dang / sems can gyi don tshad myed pa mdzad pa'i sgo dang / chos zab mo'i tshul gyi sgo dang / chos sna tshogs kyi tshul gyi sgo dang ske/ byang chub kyi sems kyi chos kyi rnam pa'i sgo dang / byang chub kyi sems 'byung ba'i rnam pa'i chos kyi sgo dang / byang chub kyi sems kyi tshogs kyi rnam pa'i sgo dang / smon lam gyi rnam pa'i sgo dang / spyod pa'i rnam pa'i sgo dang /mngon par shes pa'i rnam pa'i sgo dang / 'byung ba'i rnam pa'i sgo dang /37—842

gzungs rnam par dag pa'i rnam pa'i7sgo dang / ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor rnam par dag pa'i rnam pa'i sgo dang / shes rab yongs su dag pa'i rnam pa'i sgo dang /byang chub tshad myed pa'i rnam pa'i sgo dang / dran pa〈rnam par dag pa'i rnam pa'i sgo dag ste/ rigs kyi bu de ltar kho mos shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgo'i rgyud dran pas kun nas rnam par brgyan pa 'di shes par zad na/ kho mos byang chub sems dpa' sems dunam mkha'i dbyings dang mnyam pa/ blo gros chos kyi dbyings ltar yangs pa/ rgyud bsod nams kyi tshogs kyis brtan pa/'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam du zhugs pa/ 'jig rten gyi chos yongs su myi rgyu ba/ ye shes snang ba'i myig rab rib myed pa rab tu thob pa/ chos kyi dbyings thams cad mun pa myed par khong du chud pa/ blo nam mkha' ltar tshad med pa dang ldan pa/ dmyigs pa thams cad kyi rjes su song ba'i myig can/chags pa med pa'i ⑤snang ba'i snying po dang ldan pa/ chos thams cad kyi don rab tu dbye ba la mkhas pa/ zil gyis gnon 'kha/ 'jig rten kun gyi zil gyis mi non⑧pa/ 'jig rten gyi spyod pa'i tshul la7rnam par spyod pa/ 'jig rten gyi lam gyi rgyud thams cad na kha na ma tho ba med pa/ 'jig rten gyi don byed pa la brtson pa/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi rten du gyur pa(nya 'gro ba thams cad kyi ngag gi tshul dang / rnam pa la mkhas pa/ 'gro ba thams cad du gnas pa'i bsam pa dang ldan pa/ bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du rnam par dmyigs pa ston pa/ dus kyi 'khor lo thams cad la dbang bsgyurasnyib de dag gi spyod pa shes pa'am/ yon tan brjod par nus re skan/ /song rigs kyi bu/ lho phyogs kyi rgyud 'di nyid na yul myig gsum pa zhes bya ba yod de/ de na dge slong 37—843

blta na sdug pa zhes bya ba spyi'adug gisami/ de'i gan du song la ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bya ba dang / ji ltar nan tan du bya ba dris shig /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangs kyis7bu mo byams ma'i rkang pa gnyis la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ bu mo byams ma gel lan brgya stong du mar g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas nas yang dang yang bltas te/bu mo byams ma'i drung nas song ngo / /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangasalgebyang chub sems dpa'i ye shes kyi rnam par spyod pa zab mo rjes su bsam pa dang /chos kyi dbyings kyi gzhi zab mo khong du chud par bya ba /yirjes su bsam pa dang /sems can gyi ye shes shin tu phra zhing zab pa rjes su bsam pa dang / 'jig rten gyi 'du shes kyi rnam pa zab mo rjes su bsam pa dang / mngon par 'du bya ba med pa'i dbyings zab mo rjes su bsam pa dang / sems kyi rgyud kyikyidabyings zab mo rjes su bsam pa dang / rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i dbyings zab mo rjes su bsam pa dang / rang bzhin gyis dben78)pa'i dbyings zab mo rjes su bsam pa dang / 'gro ba thams cad kyi rnam par dpyod pa bden ⑨pa'i dbyings zab mo rjes su bsam pa dang / chos kyi dbyings brgyan pa'i 7dbyings zab mo rjes su bsam pa dang / lus kyi 'khrul 'khor shugs kyis 'khor ba'i dbyings zab mo rjes su bsam pa dang / las kyis sna tshogs su gyur pa'i (1dbyings zab mo rjes su bsam pa byed cing mthar gyis 'iyul myig gsum pa gang na ba der phyin te/ yul gyi 'khor dang / grong khyer gyi 'khor dang / tshong dus 32kyi 'khor dang / grong rdal gyi 'khor dang / yul gru'i 'khor dang /lhas kyi 'khor dang / drang srong dge ba sbyong ba'i 1steganas kyi 'khor dang /37wa 844

yul dang phyogs kyi 'khor dang / chu'i rgyud kyi 'khor dang / ri'i sal7sul gyi 'khor dang / nags tshal chen po'i 'khor dag tu dge slong blta na sdug pa yongs su tshol tshol ba las des dge slong blta na sdug pa nags tshal stugasnyepo zhig na / gzhon zhing dar la bab pa/ gzugs mdzes shing sdug la blta na yidasnyedu 'ong ba/ skra mthon ting ④g.yas phyogs su 'khyil ba dang ldan pa/ mgo gdugs ltar 'dug pa/ gtsug torasnyigyi spyi bo can/ 'phral0ba yangs pa/myig dkar nag 'byes shing ringakhul/ rdzi ma ba'i rdzi ma ltar5kyi'adug pa/ sna'i dbyibs legs shing bzang la/ ran7par mdzes pa dang ldan pa/ mchu mtshal ltar mdog bzang shing hunyeshin tu legs pa dang ldan pa/ so mnyam zhing thags bzang la3)/ shin tu dkar ba bzhi bcu tshang ba dang ldan pa/ 'gram pa'i lha nga seng ge ltar 'dug pa/ mkhur ba shas gang zhing rgyas pa/ phyin tshugs gzhu ltar 'dug cing ring la/ shin tu mdzes pa/ mdzod spu zla ba'i kha dog ltar 'dug pa'i thig le can/ rna shal ring zhing lhod par 'phyang ba/ zla ba nya ba ltar bzhin mdangs dang ldan zhing shin tu bzang ba/ mgul zlum zhing dung ltar mdzes pa/ snying ku78dpal gyi be'us brgyan pa/ ro stod seng ge'i ro7stod ltar 'dug pa/ thal gong shin tu rgyas pa/ dpung mgo'i lhun legs shing zlum pa / lag pa ring la/ dra bsatso'abrel pa'i sor mo can/ rka7lag 'khor los brgyan pa/ rka3nyelag 'jam zhing gzhon la shasasngo/)rgyas pa/ bdun shin tu mtho ba/ rked pa rdo rje ltar 'dug pa/ lus che zhing drang ba/ brla skum pa/pho mtshan gsang ba'i sbubs namanya'adug pa/ byin pa ri dgasalgem ne ya'i byin pa nyeltar 'dug pa/ sor mo ring ba/ rkang pa'i rting〈 nyepa yangs pa/ 'od 'dom 37—845

gang ba dang ldan pagyo)/ mdog gser gyi kha dog ltar 'dug pa/ ba spu re re nas g.yas phyogs su gyen du 'khyil ba/ shing n+ya gro da'i⑧rgyal po ltar chu zheng gab pa/ lus mtshan dang dpe byad bzang pos shin tu brgyan pa/ myig myi 'gebs shing mi rgod pa/ dran pa nye bar gnas pa/ ri'i rgyal po kha ba can ltar rtswa' dang / nags tshal dang / sman dang shing phran sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/blo shin tu yangs pa/ ye shes kyi spyod yul dang / yul la thub pa myed pa/dbyangs7kyi dkyil 'khor gyi rgyan sprinasnyigyi sgra lta bu dang ldan pa/ g.yo ba dang /rlom sems dang / g.yeng ba dang spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ ye shes kyi spyod yul ma 'dres pa/ sangs rgyas kyi yul rgya chen po'i snang ba thob pa/ sems can thams cad yongs su sbyin par bya ba dang /gdul ba'i bsam pa54)rgyun myi 'chad pa/ snying rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor shin tu yangs pa skyes pa/ de bzhin gshegs pasamethams cad kyi chos kyi tshul yongs su gzung (2ba dang / sems can thams cad kyi ye shes snang ba yang dag par ⑨bskyed pa'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshul rjes su dran zhing 'gro ba thams cad kyi don du 'chag pa la zhugs te/ drag dal myed cing pad ral med la shin tu mdzes par 'chag pa/ gnas gtsang ma'i lha'i gos dang ldan pa/ lha dang /klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / myi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po dang / brgya byin dang / tshangs pa dang / 'jig rten gyi mgon po dang / myi dang myi ma yin pas bskor cing 'dug pa mthong ngo / /dge slong blta na mdzes pa de 'chag pa'i tshe/ phyogs mngon du gyur pa'i phyogs kyi lha rnams phyogs kyi dkyil 'khor yongs su bsgrub pa 37—846

byed do/ /rkang gis 'gro ba'i lhanyernams rin po che'i pad+mos gom pa 'dor ba'i tshe / yongs su blang badzamibyed do/ /mye'i lha snang ba'i dkyil 'khor zad myi shes pa rnams kyang / mun pa dang rab rib rnam par sel to/ /'dzam bu rgyal mtshan gyi nags tshal gyi lha rnams kyang me tog mang po'i〈9char mngon par 'bebs sol/ /sa'i lha mi g.yo ba'i snying po can rnams kyang rin po che'i 'byung gnas mang po ston to/ /nam mkha'i lha kun nas snang ba'i dpal dang ldan pa rnams kyang nam mkha'i dbyings yongs su brgyan pa byed do/ /rgyasamatsho'i lha dpal kun nas 'byung ba rnams kyang rin po che dam pa mang pos mngon par 'thor to⑤/ /ri rab kyi lha dri ma med pa'i snying po can rnams kyang thal mo sbyar cing phyag 'tshal tokhyam/ /rlung gi lha thogs pa med pa'i stobs can rnams kyang / spos dang /bdug spos dang / me tog 'thor ba'i rlung rab tu 'gyed do/ /mtshan mo'i lha gnas par byed pa lus shin tu brgyan ④pa rnams kyang lus shin tu btud cing phyag 'tshal tol/ /nyin mo'i lhalo7rtag tu sad huX par byed pa'i dkyil 'khor can rnams kyang nor bu rin po che phyogs snang bar byed pa'i rgyal mtshan thogs shing /snang ba bskyed pa'i phyir nam mkha'i dbyings la 'khod do/ /de nas tshong dpon gyi bu nor bzangasarwastodage slong blta na sdug pa gang na ba der phyin nas/ dge slong blta na sdug pa'i rkang pa'i bol gnyis la spyi bos gtugs hurtete phyag 'tshal nas / dge slong blta na sdug pa'i rkang pa'i bol gnyis la bzhin sbyar te/legs par phyinasnyinas mdun du 'dug ste/ thal mo sbyar nas 'di skad ces smras so / /'phags pa bdag ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yang dag par zhugs nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yongs su tshol ba zhig 37—847

lags te/ 'phags pa ni byang chub sems dpa' rnams la gdams ngag dang /rjes su bstan7pa mdzad do zhes bdag gis7thos na/ 'phags pa ji ltar byang chub sems dpas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la bslab par bgyi ba dang /ji ltar nan tan du bgyi ba bdag la bshad du gsol/ des smras pa/ rigs kyi bu/ kho bo ni tshes btab na dar la bab pa/ rab tu byung bas btab na gsar du zhugs pa ste/ rigs kyi bu/ kho bos ni tshe de 'dra ba gcig gis de bzhin gshegs pa chu klung gaṅgā sum cushertsa brgyad kyisadrung du tshangs par spyod pa spyad de/ bdag gis7de bzhin gshegs pa la la'i zham ring du ni7nyin zhag⑧gcig du tshangs pa'i spyod pa spyad do/ /la lar ni nyin zhag bdun du/ la lar ni zla ba phyed du/ la lar ni zla ba gcig tu/ la lar ni lo gcig tu/ la lar ni lo brgyar/ la lar ni lo stong du/ la lar ni lo brgya phrag stong du/ la lar ni lo bye bar/ la lar ni lo bye ba khrag khrig du/ la lar ni lo brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med par/ la lar ni7bskal pa bar marakyi la lar ni bskal pa phyed du/ la lar ni bskal par/ bdag gis de bzhin gshegs pa la la'i zham ring du ni(sto/ bskal pa brjod du med pa'i yang brjod du med par7tshangs pa'i〈nyespyod pa spyad de/ bskal pa bgrang ba'i tshul 'di nyid kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad las chos bstan pa thos te/ gdams ngag dang /rjes su bstan pa yang dag par blangs so/ /smon lam gyi rgyun7yongs su sbyangs sol/ /yang dag par bsgrub pa'i yul la zhugs so/ /spyod pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su sbyangs so/ /pha rol tu phyin pa rgya mtsho yongs su rdzogs par byas so/ /mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i rnam par 'phrul pa/ yongs su shes par 37—848
